jobs.title: AI Resident
jobs.description: **Why RoboForce** RoboForce is an AI robotics company developing Physical AI–powered Robo\-Labor for dull, dirty, and dangerous work. The company's robots are engineered for demanding industrial environments, with a focus on real\-world deployment and scalability. **The AI Residency Program** The AI Residency Program is designed for exceptional early\-career researchers and engineers who want to tackle some of the hardest problems in robotics and AI. Residents will work alongside a deeply technical team on core challenges in embodied physical intelligence, including Vision\-Language\-Action (VLA) models, World Models, World Action Models, and 3D foundation models, as well as the full stack of real\-world learning—from efficient data collection systems and simulation to reinforcement learning and deployment on physical robots. This is a hands\-on residency for people who want to do ambitious work with real consequences: building learning systems that connect perception, reasoning, and action in service of capable, deployable robots. What makes this program different is the direct connection between research and real\-world deployment. Residents work with actual RoboForce robots, iterate quickly between simulation and physical execution, and contribute to systems designed for real use. The problems are hard, the standards are high, and the goal is to build systems that matter outside the lab. **Research Focus Areas** As an AI Resident, you may contribute across several core areas: * Vision\-Language\-Action (VLA) models for general\-purpose robotic behavior * World Models for predictive modeling, planning, and long\-horizon decision\-making * World Action Models for jointly modeling action and environment dynamics * Simulation and sim\-to\-real transfer for scalable training, evaluation, and data generation * Reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and policy optimization for embodied agents * Multimodal learning across vision, language, proprioception, force, and action * Learning systems for manipulation and real\-world embodied interaction **What You'll Do** * Conduct research and build systems for embodied physical intelligence * Develop and evaluate methods in VLA, World Models, World Action Models, simulation, and RL * Design and run experiments on robotics tasks involving perception, planning, control, and long\-horizon behavior * Build training and evaluation pipelines for large\-scale embodied learning systems * Work closely with research and engineering teams to move ideas from prototype to real or simulated robot platforms * Explore how multimodal foundation models can improve robot capability in real deployment settings * Contribute to technical reports, internal research discussions, and, where appropriate, publications **Basic Qualifications** * PhD student, recent graduate, or early\-career researcher/engineer in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or a related field * Experience with modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow * Experience using AI\-assisted coding tools and agentic development workflows to prototype, iterate, and build quickly * Ability to implement, debug, and evaluate research ideas in a fast\-moving environment * Strong engineering judgment, including the ability to validate, refine, and productionize AI\-assisted code **Preferred Qualifications** * Rich hands\-on experience in robotic manipulation, mobile manipulation, or industrial robotics * Experience training, fine\-tuning, or evaluating multimodal or embodied models * Experience with World Models, action\-conditioned prediction, model\-based learning, planning, or control * Strong hands\-on experience with simulation platforms such as Isaac Gym, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, ManiSkill, Habitat, or similar systems * Experience with reinforcement learning, imitation learning, or post\-training for robotic policies * Experience working with real robot hardware, data collection systems, evaluation workflows, or deployment pipelines * Demonstrated technical initiative through research, open\-source contributions, or high\-impact engineering work **Compensation and Resources** **Duration:** * 3–6 months, full\-time **Compensation:** * $10,000 monthly salary **Benefits:** * Company\-provided lunch and dinner, a fully stocked kitchen, and team events * Premium fitness center membership covered by the company **Resources:**Access to large\-scale GPU clusters and production\-grade infrastructure, with dedicated support to enable fast, uninterrupted experimentation on ambitious robotics and AI workloads

jobs.title: Applications Engineer - Fiber Optics
jobs.description: Connexis Group is an advance interconnect solution company, solving advanced engineering problems by designing and manufacturing high\-performance solutions for medical, aerospace \& defense, semiconductor and industrial markets. We are looking for an **Applications Engineer** specifically in Fiber Optics. This is a customer\-facing technical\-commercial role responsible for converting customer problems and early\-stage opportunities into technically viable, manufacturable and commercially attractive fiber\-optic solutions. Working alongside the Inside Sales team, this individual engages directly with customer engineering and R\&D teams to understand applications, define requirements, assess feasibility and move opportunities toward prototype, RFQ, qualification and production. The role serves as the technical bridge between the customer and internal engineering and manufacturing teams. Key Responsibilities Customer Application Discovery * Participate in customer discovery and technical meetings with the Inside Sales Lead. * Understand the customer application, system architecture, performance requirements, environmental conditions, interfaces, volumes and qualification requirements. * Ask the technical questions required to determine whether the opportunity fits current or adjacent capabilities. * Help customers translate early concepts or incomplete specifications into actionable technical requirements. Technical Feasibility \& Solution Development * Rapidly evaluate technical fit and identify applicable products, fiber types, optical configurations and manufacturing platforms. * Recommend preliminary technical approaches and identify where customization or development is required. * Evaluate optical performance considerations such as wavelength, numerical aperture, transmission, coupling, geometry, power handling and environmental requirements. * Identify technical risks and missing information early and coordinate more complex reviews with plant engineering and operations. RFQ, Prototype \& Qualification Support * Help convert technical discussions into complete, quotable requirements and RFQs. * Develop or review technical assumptions supporting quotations and coordinate drawings, specifications or preliminary designs as required. * Coordinate prototypes, samples and development builds and help establish technical success criteria. * Support testing, qualification, failure analysis and iterative design adjustments through production approval. Commercial \& Customer Support * Partner with the Inside Sales Lead throughout the opportunity lifecycle and participate in targeted customer and prospect discussions. * Provide technical responses quickly enough to maintain commercial momentum. * Assist in overcoming technical objections during the quote\-to\-close process. * Identify additional applications, programs and engineering contacts while engaging with customers. Internal Collaboration \& Knowledge Development * Work with manufacturing, quality and engineering to balance performance, manufacturability, cost and scalability. * Document repeatable applications, technical solutions, lessons learned and reference designs. * Help identify product\-platform opportunities that can be leveraged across multiple customers and markets. * Provide customer and market feedback that can inform product and process development. Requirements * Bachelor’s degree in engineering, physics, optics, photonics or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * Technical experience with optical fibers and fiber assemblies, fused fiber bundles and light guides, illumination systems and optical coupling, optical power handling, laser and LED\-based systems, Numerical aperture, wavelength and transmission, Medical\-device illumination and imaging, Sensors, spectroscopy and semiconductor optical systems, Industrial photonics and optical component integration. * Comfort communicating directly with customer engineers, R\&D teams and technical decision\-makers. * Ability to make practical technical judgments in early\-stage situations where requirements may be incomplete. * Understanding of the relationship between design choices, manufacturing capability, cost and scalability. * Strong written communication, organization and sense of urgency. * Experience in medical devices, semiconductor equipment, sensing, spectroscopy, industrial optics or similar markets is highly desirable.

jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Lead
jobs.description: **Continuous Improvement Lead** **Continental Tool Group \| Operations – Cranberry Township, PA** **Reports To:** General Manager **FLSA:** Non\-exempt, Hourly, Full\-time **Level:** Senior **Direct Reports:** None; leads cross\-functional project teams **Position Summary** The Continuous Improvement (CI) Lead builds and runs the continuous\-improvement program at CTG’s Cranberry Township, PA facility, reporting to the General Manager and partnering with Operations, Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and frontline teams. The CI Lead is accountable for measurable gains in safety, quality, delivery, productivity, cost, and inventory, and for making those gains stick. This is an outcomes\-based, hands\-on role: success is measured by documented, sustained results, not by the number of events held or tools applied. The CI Lead spends significant time on the production floor, leads through influence rather than direct authority, and grows Lean problem\-solving capability in the people who run the operation. Annual targets are set with the General Manager and evaluated on a rolling 12\-month basis. **Key Outcomes — What Success Looks Like** * **CI Program \& Pipeline:** Within 90 days, establish baseline KPIs and a prioritized project pipeline tied to plant SQDC goals; within 12 months, run a repeatable CI framework (chartering, tracking, monthly results review) embedded in the Cranberry Township operating rhythm. * **Financial Impact:** Deliver finance\-validated annual savings at or above the agreed target (measured as a % of COGS); every completed project has a documented baseline, result, and control plan, with gains sustained for at least 12 months. * **Productivity \& Flow:** Improve labor productivity, throughput, and OEE year over year; reduce manufacturing cycle time and setup/changeover time on targeted lines; improve schedule adherence and on\-time delivery. * **Quality \& Safety:** Reduce scrap, rework, and recurring defects in targeted areas, with repeat problems closed at root cause; every layout, workstation, and process change improves or maintains safety and ergonomics, with no incidents attributable to CI changes. * **Inventory \& Material Flow:** Partner with Supply Chain to improve inventory turns, reduce excess and obsolete inventory, and improve material availability, replenishment, and internal logistics. * **People \& Culture:** Train supervisors and frontline teams in Lean and structured problem solving to an agreed annual target; increase employee\-led improvements; sustain 5S, standard work, and visual management as shown by audit scores. **Core Responsibilities** * Build and own the CI program: identify and prioritize opportunities, charter projects, track progress, and report results and financial impact to the General Manager each month. * Lead Kaizen events and Lean projects from identification through sustainment, applying 5S, value stream mapping, standard work, visual management, SMED, Kanban, and waste elimination. * Lead structured problem solving (A3, 5\-Why, Fishbone, Pareto, DMAIC) with cross\-functional teams; make sure corrective actions address root causes and are locked in with control plans and follow\-up. * Analyze cycle time, labor utilization, throughput, OEE, quality, and inventory data to quantify opportunities and validate results; develop operational KPIs and visual performance\-management systems. * Partner with Engineering and Operations on layout, workstation, material\-flow, tooling, and automation improvements; build ROI cases for capital projects; support new product introductions and process transfers. * Partner with Supply Chain and Planning to apply Lean to inventory, replenishment, warehouse, purchasing, and internal\-logistics processes. * Coach supervisors, managers, and frontline employees in Lean principles and problem solving; build a culture of ownership, accountability, and fact\-based decisions. **Decision Authority** Recommends and, with the General Manager, sets CI project priorities, scope, and resourcing. Leads cross\-functional project teams and approves changes to standard work, layouts, and visual systems in partnership with area owners. Recommends capital and automation investments with supporting ROI. Escalates changes that affect customer commitments, product quality or safety requirements, or spending beyond delegated limits. **Education, Qualifications \& Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field. * 7\+ years of continuous\-improvement, Lean manufacturing, operations, or process\-improvement experience in a manufacturing environment (10\+ preferred), with a record of leading complex, cross\-functional projects that delivered measurable, sustained results. * Strong command of Lean and structured problem\-solving methods; hands\-on experience with OEE, takt time, cycle\-time analysis, line balancing, and capacity analysis. Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt preferred. * Advanced Excel and data\-analysis skills; experience with ERP/MRP systems and manufacturing data. * Excellent communication, facilitation, and project\-management skills; able to influence without authority and equally effective with frontline teams and senior leadership. * Preferred: discrete manufacturing of engineered products, machinery, tools, or industrial products; multi\-site or enterprise\-wide improvement initiatives; automation, manufacturing engineering, or capital projects. **Physical Demands \& Working Conditions** Based at the Cranberry Township, PA facility. Splits time between office and the manufacturing floor, with significant time on the floor working directly with teams; occasional travel may be required. As a non\-exempt position, hours worked over 40 in a workweek are paid at overtime rates. Requires prolonged standing and walking on concrete floors, the ability to lift up to 50 lbs, and use of required PPE (safety glasses, hearing protection, steel\-toe footwear). Exposure to compressed\-air systems, noise, oil mist, dust, and vibration. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **How Performance Will Be Measured** The CI Lead and the General Manager agree on a one\-page annual scorecard that weights the outcomes above: documented CI savings vs. target (% of COGS); labor productivity, throughput, and OEE; cycle time and changeover time; scrap and rework; on\-time delivery; inventory turns and E\&O reduction; project completion and 12\-month sustainment rate; and training completion and employee participation in improvement activities. *This job description reflects the principal outcomes and responsibilities of the role. It is not intended to be exhaustive and may be updated as business needs evolve. Continental Tool Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

jobs.title: Cryogenic Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **Full\-time \| On\-site in the Research Triangle area, North Carolina \| Reports to the Scientific and Technical Director** LH3M is developing a cryopump and sorption collector for lunar gases. Initial work uses small loads of standard helium, predominantly He\-4, followed by controlled mixed\-gas experiments. We seek an engineer or experimental physicist with substantial hands\-on experience designing, commissioning and troubleshooting low\-temperature apparatus. You will own the collector’s cryogenic and thermal performance. Evaluate commercial cryopumps and refrigeration hardware, develop cold surfaces and sorbent assemblies, and determine how collected gas can be retained and recovered through controlled regeneration. **Responsibilities** * Assess commercial cryopump suitability, required operating temperatures, cooling capacity, access and modification constraints. * Develop thermal budgets, shielding, supports, thermal interfaces, temperature sensing and control with the systems engineer. * Evaluate staged capture of water, nitrogen and oxygen while measuring helium transmission, retention and losses. * Design and conduct tests of capture efficiency, sorption capacity, breakthrough, regeneration and recovery over repeated cycles. * Commission cold and vacuum systems, diagnose performance limits, and establish documented operating and safety procedures. **Required experience** * Degree in mechanical engineering, physics, applied physics or a related field, or equivalent specialist experience. * Demonstrated personal responsibility for helium\-temperature cryogenic apparatus, including cooldowns, thermometry, thermal troubleshooting and vacuum operation. * Working knowledge of conduction and radiation heat loads, vacuum practices, leak detection and gas handling. * Ability to design quantitative experiments, assess uncertainty and explain results clearly. Relevant industrial and research experience are both welcome. **Preferred experience** Cryopumps, adsorption or sorption, cryocoolers, cold traps, residual gas analysis, and gas inventory measurements. Experience modifying commercial equipment is especially valuable. A PhD is welcome but not required. **What success looks like** A defensible cold\-system design and repeatable measurements showing where helium goes during capture, retention and regeneration, with thermal limits and losses understood. *Provide a résumé and describe a cryogenic system you personally commissioned or modified, including a performance problem you diagnosed.* Pay: $125,000\.00 \- $155,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Paid time off Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Developer (Python, AWS)
jobs.description: About Peregrine Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. People first. Ownership always. We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will develop Python services on Amazon Web Services (AWS) that read and route federal filings automatically. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are. This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. Your first project Your first project will likely have you helping a federal agency move a manual, paper\-heavy intake process onto an intelligent pipeline. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Develop cloud services in Python that read, interpret, and route a high\-volume stream of filer applications. * Extract structure and meaning from filings at scale by combining optical character recognition (OCR) with AI. * Score each extraction for confidence and write the logic that decides where a document goes next. * Implement exact and fuzzy matching and the business rules that validate each submission. * Build human\-review workflows for the decisions a machine should not make alone. You help deliver an automated intake pipeline that takes filings from submission to decision at volume, in a setting where accuracy and auditability are not optional. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 4\+ years of hands\-on software development experience using Python * Bachelor's degree * Experience building cloud document\-processing systems with Amazon Textract or an equivalent service, from OCR through extraction * Data validation experience, including exact and fuzzy matching * Experience with application programming interfaces (APIs) and SQL for moving documents through a processing workflow to a decision * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel Preferred* Applied experience with large language models (LLMs), machine learning, or natural language processing (NLP) * Familiarity with Amazon Bedrock * PDF processing experience Who you are You have a hacker's mindset: you would rather ship a working prototype tonight than a perfect plan next week. You have built real document\-processing systems in Python, and you move at the speed of the tools, not the clock. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. What you bring* Deep, practical Python skills and hands\-on experience with cloud document processing on Amazon Textract or a comparable service, covering OCR through extraction. * The supporting engineering: validating data, matching records, and building the APIs and SQL that carry each document to a decision. * Sound judgment for building in a regulated environment where accuracy and auditability are not optional. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. When we talk Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. The technical assessment is a live Python coding exercise. **Benefits** This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $92,000 to $133,000 per year. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. What we offer You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. What we commit to As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

jobs.title: Embedded Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: **Embedded Firmware Engineer** ============================== **Efference** \- Robust Robotic Perception **Location**: North Beach, San Francisco, CA **Employment** **Type**: Full Time **Location** **Type**: On\-site **Department**: Engineering **Company Overview** -------------------- Efference builds robust, high\-performance robotic perceptual systems that make robots easier to develop and faster to deploy. Our technology integrates proprietary optical designs, advanced sensor fusion, depth estimation, image sensor processing, and tightly optimized hardware\-software stacks to enable reliable perception across general and specialized robotic systems. We are currently deploying the first generation of vision systems with state\-of\-the\-art hardware and software while actively prototyping generations two and three of our core perceptual system. Efference was founded by Gianluca Bencomo, a PhD student at Princeton University whose research spans visual neuroscience, Bayesian filtering for fast and robust sensor fusion, neural network inductive biases, and robotics perception. The company is backed by Y Combinator and Anti Fund. **Position Overview** --------------------- As a Embedded Firmware Engineer at Efference, you will lead the design, implementation, and integration of low\-level software that powers our next\-generation robotic perception systems. You will work at the boundary between custom hardware and advanced perception software, enabling reliable, high\-performance sensing across cameras, IMUs, and other robotic sensors. This role requires deep expertise in embedded Linux, real\-time systems, and hardware bring\-up, as well as the ability to collaborate closely with PCB designers, perception researchers, and full\-stack engineers. Your work will directly influence the performance, reliability, and deployability of Efference’s custom camera and sensing platforms across multiple product generations. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Lead firmware architecture and development for ARM\-based SoCs and MCUs * Read, modify, and maintain device trees, BSPs, and board support packages * Review and approve schematics and PCB layouts, with a focus on signal integrity, power distribution, and manufacturability * Develop and maintain embedded Linux systems using Buildroot and Yocto * Implement and optimize RTOS\-based firmware for real\-time sensing and control * Write and maintain kernel drivers and low\-level device drivers for sensors and peripherals * Integrate and optimize MIPI\-CSI camera pipelines, including basic camera bring\-up and tuning * Implement and debug WiFi and Bluetooth connectivity on embedded platforms * Work with a wide range of communication interfaces, including CAN, USB, RS\-485, UART, I²C, SPI, GMSL, etc. * Integrate and calibrate sensors such as IMUs, cameras, LiDAR, and other robotic sensing modalities * Perform hands\-on hardware debugging using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other lab tools * Collaborate with perception, robotics, and full\-stack teams to support teleoperation, data collection, and on\-device inference * Contribute to product roadmaps, technical documentation, and platform evolution across multiple hardware generations **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering or a related field * 3\+ years of professional experience in embedded systems or firmware engineering * Strong proficiency in C/C\+\+ for embedded and systems programming * Experience working with embedded Linux on ARM\-based SoCs * Deep understanding of hardware–software co\-design, including power, clock, and memory subsystems * Proven experience bringing up custom hardware from early prototypes through production * Familiarity with common MCUs and peripheral architectures * Strong debugging and root\-cause analysis skills across hardware and software layers **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with Rust for embedded or systems programming * Background in robotics, perception, or sensor fusion * Familiarity with robotic control systems and real\-time constraints * Personal interest or hands\-on experience in robot learning or autonomous systems * Experience supporting high\-throughput image or sensor data pipelines **Benefits** ------------ * Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a seed\-stage, venture\-backed startup * Opportunity to work at the cutting edge of robotic perception and applied research * Close collaboration with world\-class researchers and engineers * High\-impact role with significant technical ownership and growth opportunities

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer - Firmware & Motion Control
jobs.description: **Benefits:** * Competitive salary * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Opportunity for advancement * Paid time off * Vision insurance SQ4D is a construction technology company developing and deploying advanced robotic systems for concrete 3D printing. Our Autonomous Robotic Construction System (ARCS) combines large\-scale robotics, automation, software, motion control, and material delivery systems with the goal of Changing the Way the World is Built ™. **Position Overview** The ideal candidate has a strong background in embedded software development, firmware engineering, and machine motion control. You will work directly with our engineering team to understand the existing Duet firmware architecture, implement custom functionality, troubleshoot complex software and hardware interactions, and develop new capabilities for our construction 3D printers. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working close to the hardware, investigating how systems operate at the code level, and translating software improvements into measurable performance gains in physical machines. **Key Responsibilities** *Firmware Development \& Codebase Customization* Analyze, modify, and extend the Duet firmware to support SQ4D's specialized robotic construction equipment. * Develop custom firmware features, commands, and machine\-control functionality. * Investigate existing firmware architecture, dependencies, and execution flows to understand and improve system behavior. * Debug software defects, resolve unexpected machine behavior, and improve code reliability and maintainability. * Evaluate upstream firmware updates and integrate relevant improvements while maintaining SQ4D\-specific customizations. * *Motion Control \& Machine Integration* Develop and optimize firmware functionality related to coordinated motion, motor control, homing, positioning, and machine initialization. * Investigate interactions between firmware, motor drivers, encoders, sensors, and other connected hardware. * Improve the execution and reliability of G\-code commands, macros, and custom machine operations. * Troubleshoot timing, synchronization, communication, and motion\-related issues in a real\-world industrial environment. * *Software Architecture \& Development Practices* Maintain a structured Git\-based development workflow, including branching, code reviews, testing, and release management. * Write clean, documented, maintainable code and contribute to software architecture decisions. * Develop unit tests, integration tests, and debugging tools to validate firmware changes. * * Maintain documentation for firmware modifications, configuration changes, known issues, and release procedures. Maintain and extend SQ4D's operator interface, a Vue.js/TypeScript fork of Duet Web Control, and its automated build and deployment * *Testing \& Continuous Improvement* Reproduce and diagnose firmware issues through code analysis, logs, controlled experiments, and hardware testing. * Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, automation, and manufacturing engineers to resolve system\-level problems. * Validate firmware changes on physical ARCS machines before deployment. * Identify opportunities to improve system stability, responsiveness, fault handling, and recovery from errors. * Contribute to the long\-term development of a more autonomous, intelligent, and reliable robotic construction platform. * **Required Qualifications** Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * Demonstrated experience developing or modifying embedded software and firmware * Proficiency in C and C\+\+, and working knowledge of JavaScript/Typescript and Python. * Experience navigating, debugging, and contributing to an existing software codebase. * Familiarity with Git and structured software development workflows. * Strong debugging and analytical skills, including the ability to isolate complex software issues. * Ability to work across software and hardware boundaries and systematically troubleshoot physical systems. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with RepRapFirmware and Duet controllers Experience with Vue.js or another front\-end framework, and with HTTP/REST APIs * Experience with 3D printer control systems, CNC machines, robotics, or industrial automation. * * Familiarity with G\-code interpretation, motion planning, kinematics, and stepper motor control. jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Alt is unlocking the value of alternative assets, starting with the $5 B trading\-card market. We let collectors buy, sell, vault, and finance their cards in one place and we are backed by leaders at Stripe, Coinbase, Seven Seven Six, and pro athletes like Tom Brady and Giannis Antetokounmpo. Our next frontier is real\-time pricing at scale—the Alt Value that powers every trade, loan, and product on the platform. We're looking for an Infrastructure Engineer to own the platform that Alt's engineering team builds on. Today, infrastructure work at Alt is distributed across product engineers with no dedicated owner. You'll change that. You'll lead our cloud infrastructure, developer environments, and observability, making the entire engineering org faster, more reliable, and more cost\-efficient. This is a foundational hire. You'll define how Alt operates as an AI\-native engineering organization, from the environments our agents run against to the deployment pipelines our engineers ship through every day. ### **What You'll Do Here:** * **Own cloud infrastructure end\-to\-end:** Take ownership of Alt's AWS footprint (ECS, RDS/Aurora, EC2, S3, SQS, ALB, and more). Right\-size over\-provisioned resources, de\-provision orphaned services, implement resource tagging, and build cost visibility so we can make informed trade\-offs as we scale. * **Build reproducible environments:** Lead the effort to give every engineer (and every AI agent) the ability to spin up isolated, prod\-like instances of Alt on demand. This means database cloning, per\-branch services, routing, seed data, and auto\-teardown. This is the substrate for how we want to build software. * **Fix staging:** Make non\-production environments reliable and representative, so engineers can stop testing in production, stop setting up test state by hand, and stop working around flaky search infrastructure. * **Bring Terraform under control:** Fix infrastructure\-as\-code drift, build CI/CD automation, and make infrastructure changes safe and reviewable. * **Own observability and incident response:** We run Datadog, Sentry, and Posthog across the stack. Rationalize our monitoring, improve alerting, and make sure we catch issues before our users do. * **Be a multiplier:** You'll be the infrastructure leader for a growing engineering team. Level up the org through documentation, tooling, code reviews, and mentorship. Set the standard for how we operate. ### **This is a perfect fit if you…** * **Think in systems, not tickets:** You see the connection between a flaky staging env, a rising cloud bill, and engineering velocity. You want to fix the root cause, not patch symptoms. * **Care about developer experience:** You measure your success by how much faster and more confidently your teammates can ship. You build tools and platforms, not just infrastructure. * **Are cost\-conscious by instinct:** You know the difference between saving money and cutting corners. You think about unit economics when you see over\-provisioned instances. * **Are excited about AI\-native engineering:** You see reproducible environments as the substrate for AI agents to do real work, and you want to build that substrate. * **Want to lead, not just execute:** This isn't a role where someone hands you Terraform tickets. You'll define the infrastructure roadmap, make trade\-off decisions, and own outcomes. ### **What You Bring to the Table:** * 7\+ years of infrastructure, platform, or SRE experience with deep AWS expertise (ECS, RDS/Aurora, EC2, ALB, IAM, CloudFormation or Terraform) * A track record of owning and improving CI/CD pipelines, deployment infrastructure, and developer tooling at a growing company * Experience building or managing non\-production environments: staging, ephemeral environments, seed data systems, or similar * Strong opinions on observability. You've instrumented systems, built dashboards, and improved incident response. * Strong collaboration and communication skills. You write great docs, ask smart questions, and give thoughtful feedback. * Bonus: Experience with cost optimization at scale ### **What You'll Get From Us:** * **Direct impact:** You'll be the first dedicated infrastructure hire, the person who defines how Alt's engineering platform works and scales. * **Autonomy:** High\-trust environment with ownership over critical infrastructure and developer experience. **What we offer:** ================== ***For full\-time Employees*** * We cover 85% of your medical, dental, and vision, and up to 50% for dependents. HSA/FSA available * Generous PTO that people actually take * Parental leave at full salary * $200/month wellness \+ $100/month home office stipend * Free DoorDash Pass membership, because dinner shouldn't be a decision * Remote\-first (for most positions), with WeWork access when you want a room with other humans * 401(k) * Alt Equity to all full\-time employees Compensation Range: $200K \- $250K

jobs.description: **About the role** ------------------ We are looking for an exceptional researcher to design and build the next generation of AI benchmarks for cybersecurity. You will create high\-impact, challenging evaluations that push the boundaries of what we can measure in foundation models. This role is ideal for someone with deep research expertise who wants to see their work directly influence how the world evaluates AI systems. You will lead the design and development of novel benchmarks that assess real\-world capabilities and risks of LLMs. Our benchmarks shape how foundation models are developed and generative AI applications are built. We work with every major foundation model lab \- along with leading financial institutions and the application\-layer companies pushing the frontier forward. Our work has been featured by the Wall Street Journal, New York Times, Washington Post, and Bloomberg. We are building the standard for evaluating the ability of LLMs to perform real\-world tasks. You will be at the forefront of defining what that standard looks like. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Design and develop novel, high\-impact benchmarks that assess challenging real\-world capabilities for cybersecurity * Conduct research to ensure our benchmarks are valid, reliable, and meaningful * Collaborate with foundation model labs and enterprise security teams to understand evolving evaluation needs * Analyze model performance across benchmarks and articulate results * Publish research findings and contribute to the broader security and evaluation research communities * Work closely with the infrastructure team to implement your benchmark designs at scale * Stay current with the latest developments in LLM cyber capabilities and evaluation methodologies **Requirements** ---------------- * **Cybersecurity experience:** Hands\-on work in security, e.g., as a security engineer, penetration tester, red teamer or vulnerability researcher. You may have found and reported vulnerabilities through bug bounty programs or CVEs. * **Systems depth:** Strong grounding in operating systems, cloud infrastructure and networking. * **Interest in benchmarking:** You care about measuring capability rigorously, not just demonstrating it. Ideally, you've built cyber evals, CTF challenges or security benchmarks before. * **AI\-forward:** You already use LLMs in your security work and want to work with them every day. * **Communication**: Ability to clearly communicate complex research ideas to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * **Collaboration**: Experience working in research teams and integrating feedback. * **Location:** We are an in\-person team in San Francisco and will support relocation or transportation as needed. **Nice to haves** ----------------- * You've previously worked as a security engineer at a security company or on an in\-house security team, and/or you have experience on an AI or ML team at a security company * Strong ties to the security community: CTF teams, conference talks, open\-source security tools, or research collaborations, published security research, papers or well\-read technical write\-ups **What we offer** ----------------- * Highly competitive salary and meaningful ownership. Excellence is well rewarded. * Relocation and transportation support * Health/dental insurance coverage * Lunch and dinner provided, free snacks/coffee/drinks * Unlimited PTO * $1,500 housing stipend (within one\-mile radius) * Collaborate with leading AI labs and work on the front lines of AI development and evaluations * Opportunity to publish and present your work **About us** ------------ **Founding team**: The core methodology behind this platform comes from NLP evaluation research we conducted at Stanford. We raised a $5M seed from some of the top institutional and angel investors in the valley. Our team has prior work experience at NVIDIA, Meta, Microsoft, Palantir and HRT. Collectively, we have over 300 citations in our published work. Our early team includes Stanford PhDs, ex\-Jane Street quants, and the first designer at Snorkel. We recently announced our $40M Series A at a $400M valuation, led by **Andreessen Horowitz**, with participation from existing investors **8VC**, **Pear VC**, and **Bloomberg** and new investors **Hudson River Trading** and **NextLadder Ventures****.** **Tech stack**: We use Python for most things at Vals AI. Our platform is built on Django, with a React frontend. All of the infra is on AWS using CDK for IaC. **What We're Looking For** * **Learning velocity:** The role encompasses a wide variety of tasks. Rather than expecting you to be an expert on Day 1, we are looking for someone who can learn new skills and technologies quickly. * **Ownership**: Working in a small, talent\-dense team, we expect everyone to show initiative to build where it's needed, not where it's asked. We strive for autonomy over consensus. * **Intensity**: The LLM landscape is constantly changing. Foundation model labs are continuously pushing the frontier. The unicorn companies that will emerge from this technology shift are being built now. Those that win will have an incredibly high speed of execution. * **Solution\-oriented mindset**: We're looking for people who see opportunities to craft solutions at each juncture, not those who pass hard problems to others or admit defeat. **Vals in the Media:** * AI tools mostly fumble basic financial tasks, study finds * The Winners (and Losers) of This New Vibe\-Coding Benchmark Will Surprise You * OpenAI’s Less\-Flashy Rival Might Have a Better Business Model * Meta Announces New AI Model in Major Test of Company’s Ambitions * DeepSeek’s Sequel Set to Extend China’s Reach in Open\-Source A.I. jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer - Field Deployment & Support
jobs.description: **About Destro AI** Destro AI is building the intelligence layer for robotics — the system that coordinates robots, humans, and workflows across complex real\-world operations. Founded by former leaders from HAI Robotics, Dexterity, and Matic, Destro is built on a simple thesis: robotics has solved movement, but not decision\-making. Destro is backed by investors who have previously invested in and built companies like Brex, Figma, Notion, and Instacart. Destro's MothershipOS is a shared brain across all robots, unlocking complex factory and warehouse workflows. Unlike traditional systems that rely on local intelligence on each robot, Destro brings global intelligence across the entire operation. Destro recently closed its Seed round at one of the highest valuations for a robotics company at this stage, and is already deploying in production with large enterprise operators. **About The Role** We're hiring a Robotics Forward Deployed Engineer, to own the software that runs MothershipOS in live customer warehouses. This role is responsible for writing and maintaining production code, not solely for troubleshooting it, and will serve as the engineering presence on\-site when systems need to be brought up, stabilized, or restored to full function. **Schedule Expectations** This is a field deployment role, not a standard office\-hours position. Warehouse operations run multiple shifts, and go\-lives, incidents, and integrations are not confined to business hours. * Regular work outside standard business hours should be expected, including nights and weekends. Go\-lives are frequently scheduled during off\-hours or weekend downtime windows to avoid disrupting customer operations. * This role may be paged for production issues, including robot faults, network outages, and server failures, outside normal hours, and is expected to respond promptly, either remotely or on\-site. * Extensive travel to customer sites is required, at times on short notice. * Candidates seeking a fixed 9\-to\-5, Monday\-through\-Friday schedule are unlikely to find this role a fit. **What You'll Do** *Software* * Write, test, and maintain the software services that run MothershipOS at customer sites, including deployment tooling and diagnostic utilities. * Design and build internal tools that make field deployments faster and more repeatable. * Translate field learnings into production\-hardening fixes and improvements in the core codebase. * Maintain clear technical documentation and runbooks so issues can be diagnosed consistently across sites. *Field Deployment* * Deploy and validate Destro's software stack in live warehouses, working directly with customer operations, IT, and engineering teams. * Own production issues end\-to\-end during launch and stabilization, including off\-hours incidents. * Improve uptime, throughput, and reliability of deployed systems through both code and infrastructure changes. *Systems and Infrastructure* * Build and maintain containerized services (Docker Compose) running on Destro\-managed servers and edge devices. * Work with cloud infrastructure (GCP) for image management, versioning, and deployment tooling. * Configure and troubleshoot networking, including VLANs, DHCP, internal DNS, and certificate\-based service security. * Debug across the full stack: robot state faults, sensor issues, API failures, container networking, database queries, and monitoring dashboards. **Who You Are** * 2 to 6 years of experience in systems engineering, robotics software, backend engineering, infrastructure, or field engineering, with genuine software development experience rather than field support alone. * Comfortable being paged off\-hours and traveling on short notice. * Able to operate independently in ambiguous, high\-pressure environments without a fully specified solution. * Calm under pressure, direct with customers, and demonstrates strong ownership. **Technical Skills** *Required* * Strong Python or C\+\+, with the ability to write maintainable, production\-grade code. * Hands\-on Docker/Docker Compose experience, including building, deploying, debugging, and versioning images. * Linux/server administration: command line, logs, processes, systemd, firewalls. * Networking fundamentals: DHCP, DNS, VLANs, static IP reservations, TLS/certificates. * Experience with APIs and communication protocols (REST, WebSockets, MQTT). * Proficiency with Git and standard software development workflows. *Strongly Preferred* * Experience with AMRs, warehouse automation, or fleet management. * Cloud deployment experience, ideally GCP. * Familiarity with observability tooling such as Grafana, Prometheus, or time\-series databases. * WMS/WES/ERP integration experience. *Nice to Have* * Experience with robot task allocation, scheduling, or routing. * Experience with wearables, scanners, or other warehouse hardware.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Category: Data \& AI \| Type: Full\-Time or Contract \| Condition: Permanent or Contract \| Location: Remote **About the Role** Merci Technologies is partnering with a leading client organization to hire a Senior Data Engineer. Our client is investing heavily in AI and advanced analytics and needs an experienced engineer to design, build, and optimize the data infrastructure behind those efforts. You will work directly with the client’s data, analytics, and engineering teams to build reliable pipelines, modernize legacy data environments, and deliver platforms ready for machine learning and generative AI workloads. This is a high\-impact, hands\-on role for an engineer who enjoys solving complex data problems and seeing the work turn directly into business outcomes. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain scalable batch and real\-time data pipelines using modern ELT/ETL patterns * Develop and optimize data models in cloud data warehouses and lakehouses such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, or Azure Synapse * Build streaming data solutions using Kafka, Kinesis, Event Hubs, or Spark Structured Streaming * Prepare and curate high\-quality datasets that support machine learning, analytics, and generative AI use cases, including retrieval augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and vector data stores * Orchestrate workflows using Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or equivalent tools * Implement transformation layers using dbt and SQL best practices * Establish data quality, validation, and observability frameworks to ensure accuracy and reliability * Apply data governance, lineage, cataloging, and access controls in line with security and compliance requirements * Lead migration of legacy on\-premises data systems to modern cloud platforms * Use infrastructure\-as\-code and CI/CD practices to automate deployment of data infrastructure * Partner with the client’s data scientists, ML engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions * Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering standards and documentation **Qualifications** *Required* * 5\+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, or a related field * Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python (Scala or Java a plus) * Hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) * Strong experience with Snowflake, Databricks, or a comparable cloud data platform * Experience with Apache Spark and distributed data processing * Solid understanding of data modeling, including dimensional modeling and medallion architecture * Experience with workflow orchestration and dbt * Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience *Preferred* * Experience supporting ML pipelines, feature stores, or MLOps workflows * Exposure to vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector) and LLM data preparation * Knowledge of data governance tools such as Unity Catalog, Collibra, Alation, or Purview * Experience in regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, CPG, or public sector) * Certifications such as Databricks Certified Data Engineer, SnowPro, AWS Data Engineer, Azure Data Engineer Associate, or Google Professional Data Engineer **What You Will Bring** You are a builder who takes pride in data that just works. You think in systems, write clean and maintainable code, and understand that reliable data is the foundation for every AI and analytics initiative. You communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders, take ownership of outcomes, and keep up with the fast\-moving data and AI ecosystem. Above all, you want your work to make a measurable difference. Must have: Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, dbt

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description: **Job Requirements** Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world\-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: * **Building the future of Disney’s media:** Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. * **Reach, Scale \& Impact:** More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney\+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. * **Innovation:** We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Ad Platforms is responsible for Disney’s industry\-leading ad technology and products – driving advertising performance, innovation, and value in Disney’s sports, news, and entertainment content, across all media platforms. The research/AI team is the dedicated AI/ML and data science arm of the Ad Platform organization. Its mission is to advance AI and machine learning capabilities across Ad Platform by delivering scalable, high impact AI/ML and data science solutions that enhance ad decisioning, forecasting, experimentation and ad experience. We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join this innovative team. This role is a great opportunity for a seasoned data science professional who thrives at the intersection of advanced analytics, machine learning, and business strategy. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will spearhead ML and data science initiatives that shape the future of advertising technology. You will be responsible for designing and executing ML and data science solutions that drive measurable impact across ad decisioning, forecasting, experimentation, and user experience optimization, as well leading evaluation and optimization of generative AI mixed media advertisement creation and enhancement technologies. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** * Drive innovation and apply data science and statistical analysis in a variety of areas to enhance every aspect of advertising serving, including inventory forecasting, ad experience, ad pacing, pricing, targeting, advertising creation and enhancement, and efficient ad delivery. * Translate business questions into data science framework; develop data analysis and ML models for complex ad challenges with fast turnaround. * Define and evaluate key metrics in various product areas. * Partner closely with generative AI specialists to support the creation of datasets for generative AI modeling applications. * Develop Standard Operating Procedures for human\-driven evaluations or labeling. * Deliver data insights and provide data\-driven recommendations to cross\-team stakeholders. * Design and analyze A/B tests for machine learning algorithm iterations. * Establish strong partnership with stakeholders, including product managers, engineers and program managers, in a collaborative environment. **WHAT TO BRING** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, statistics or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of relevant industry experience in data science at leading internet or technology companies. Experience in the advertising domain is a strong plus. * Experience creating ML datasets and rigorous dataset labeling or evaluation processes for models. * Strong interest to learn about generative mixed media, generative video, and diffusion\-based technology. * Solid knowledge of data science and statistics. Strong communication skills and business acumen. * Proficient in SQL, Python, Java, or R. Familiar with Tableau, and/or other visualization tools. * Experience designing and building machine learning models. * Passionate about understanding the ad business, applying data science to relevant business scenarios, and seeking innovation opportunities to enhance business effectiveness. * Interested in supporting rapid prototyping, generative AI, and creative technologies, including applications to advertisement creation and enhancement. * Experienced building data\-driven services and applications for production. * A proven track record of thriving in a fast\-paced, data\-driven, and collaborative work environment is required. **NICE\-TO\-HAVES** * Masters or PhD degree. * Experience in digital video advertising or digital marketing domain. * Experience in production\-grade development, rapid prototyping, or generative AI related. research using LLMs, generative imagery or video, or agentic flows. Otherwise a strong interest to learn. * Experience with Airflow, data warehouse, Databricks or Sagemaker. **Disclaimer** PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Santa Monica \& Glendale, CA is $144,100 to $193,200 per year and in Seattle, WA is $150,900 to $202,400\. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. This position is with Disney Entertainment \& Sports LLC, which is part of a business we call Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology. To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. Disney Entertainment \& Sports LLC is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION FOR EMPLOYMENT APPLICATIONS The Walt Disney Company and its Affiliated Companies are Equal Employment Opportunity employers and welcome all job seekers including individuals with disabilities and veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or apply for a position, visit the Disney candidate disability accommodations FAQs. We will only respond to those requests that are related to the accessibility of the online application system due to a disability. Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced **Senior Full Stack Software Engineer** to join our dynamic and growing team. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in designing, building, and maintaining scalable web applications and APIs, leveraging cloud\-native technologies. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of software development, from conception to deployment, including designing system architecture, implementing solutions, and optimizing performance. Deep cloud engineering expertise is essential for this role, including hands\-on experience architecting, developing, deploying, and operating production\-grade cloud\-native applications. Candidates with substantial Azure/AWS experience demonstrating a level of technical depth and responsibility commensurate with the requirements outlined below will be considered. ### **Key Responsibilities** * **API Development**: Design, develop, and maintain robust, secure, and scalable RESTful APIs using Java and Spring Boot, integrating with Azure services and external platforms through Azure API Management. * F**ull Stack Development**: Build responsive, high\-performance front\-end and back\-end applications using modern frameworks and technologies (Java, Spring Boot, React, Node.js, etc.), leveraging Azure cloud services. * **Automated Test Development**: Develop automated API and microservices tests, including contract testing and service virtualization, as well as UI tests using modern automation tools and frameworks. * **Cloud\-Native Architecture:** Design and implement scalable, cloud\-native applications on Microsoft Azure, leveraging Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), following best practices for security, reliability, scalability, and performance. * **Containerization**: Build, deploy, and manage containerized applications using Docker, Azure Container Registry (ACR), Azure Container Apps, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), including container orchestration and automated scaling. * **Distributed Systems**: Design and develop scalable, distributed systems on Azure that support high availability, fault tolerance, resilience, and disaster recovery. * **Event\-Driven Architecture**: Implement event\-driven architectures using Apache Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, Azure Service Bus, and Azure Event Grid to enable real\-time data processing, asynchronous communication, and loosely coupled services. * **Microservices**: Design, develop, and maintain independently deployable microservices using Java and Spring Boot, leveraging Azure\-native infrastructure, service discovery, API gateways, and distributed observability. * **Unit Testing**: Write and maintain comprehensive unit and integration tests for front\-end and back\-end applications using frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito, Jest, and React Testing Library to ensure code quality and stability. * **CI/CD Pipelines**: Build and maintain continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines using Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions, and infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform and Azure Bicep. * **Database Design \& Optimization**: Design, implement, and optimize relational databases (Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure SQL Database, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (Azure Cosmos DB), focusing on performance, scalability, availability, and data integrity. * **Collaborate**: Work closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, architects, and other engineers to deliver high\-quality products on schedule, following Agile development methodologies. * **Code Reviews**: Participate in code reviews using Azure DevOps Repos or GitHub, providing constructive feedback and ensuring high standards for code quality, security, performance, and maintainability. ### **Skills and Qualifications** * **Experience**: 8\+ years of experience as a Full Stack Software Engineer or in a similar role. * **API Development:** Strong proficiency in designing, developing, and integrating RESTful APIs and GraphQL services, including experience with Azure API Management. * **Containerization**: Expertise in Docker and container orchestration technologies, including Kubernetes, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Container Apps, and Azure Container Registry (ACR). * **Azure Cloud Services**: Proven experience with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Virtual Machines, Azure Storage, Azure SQL Database, Azure Service Bus, and Azure API Management. * **Distributed Systems**: Experience designing and developing scalable, highly available distributed systems and event\-driven architectures using Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Hubs, Azure Event Grid, or Apache Kafka. * **Programming Languages**: Strong programming skills in Java (Spring Boot), JavaScript/TypeScript (React, Node.js), and related technologies. Experience with Python or Go is a plus. * **Unit Testing**: Experience with unit and integration testing frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito, Jest, Mocha, and React Testing Library for front\-end and back\-end applications. * **CI/CD Pipelines**: Experience building and maintaining automated CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar tools. * **Database Technologies**: Experience designing and optimizing relational and NoSQL databases, including Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure SQL Database, MySQL, and Azure Cosmos DB. * **DevOps \& Infrastructure as Code:** Solid understanding of DevOps practices, including CI/CD automation, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Azure Bicep), monitoring, and observability using Azure Monitor and Application Insights. * **Front\-End Development**: Proficiency with modern front\-end frameworks, particularly React, with familiarity in Angular or Vue.js. * **Microservices \& Serverless:** Experience designing and implementing microservices and serverless architectures using Java, Spring Boot, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, and Azure API Management. * **Security \& Performance**: Knowledge of cloud security best practices, including Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Key Vault, managed identities, role\-based access control (RBAC), and application performance optimization. * **Problem\-Solving:** Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across distributed applications and cloud infrastructure. * **Agile Methodologies**: Experience working in Agile development environments, including Scrum, sprint planning, iterative delivery, and continuous improvement. * **Communication \& Collaboration**: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, architecture, and business teams. **Work Authorization:** Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship. **Location Requirement:** Must be a resident of the continental United States. **Compensation** **W2 Employment:** $150,000–$300,000/annually with full benefits, including: **401(k)** with employer matching 6% **Health**, **dental**, and **vision** insurance Generous Paid time off Life insurance At DevAltus, we’re a boutique consultancy specializing in cloud\-native infrastructure, cybersecurity, and custom software solutions. As a **Senior Full Stack Software Engineer**, you’ll play a key role in building secure, scalable systems for enterprise clients while collaborating with a team that values innovation, autonomy, and technical excellence. We’re looking for passionate engineers who thrive on solving complex problems across the stack in a collaborative, high\-trust environment. If that’s you, we’d love to connect. *Please ensure your resume reflects relevant skills and experience that match this role, particularly AWS and DevOps tools listed in the application.*

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - ESPN
jobs.description: Disney Entertainment \& ESPN Technology On any given day at Disney Entertainment \& ESPN Technology, we’re reimagining ways to create magical viewing experiences for the world’s most beloved stories while also transforming Disney’s media business for the future. Whether that’s evolving our streaming and digital products in new and immersive ways, powering worldwide advertising and distribution to maximize flexibility and efficiency, or delivering Disney’s unmatched entertainment and sports content, every day is a moment to make a difference to partners and to hundreds of millions of people around the world. *A few reasons why we think you’d love working for Disney Entertainment \& ESPN Technology* * Building the future of Disney’s media business: DE\&E Technologists are designing and building the infrastructure that will power Disney’s media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. * Reach \& Scale: The products and platforms this group builds and operates delight millions of consumers every minute of every day – from Disney\+ and Hulu, to ABC News and Entertainment, to ESPN and ESPN\+, and much more. * Innovation: We develop and execute groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and enhance how audiences experience sports, entertainment \& news. Product Engineering is a unified team responsible for the engineering of Disney Entertainment \& ESPN digital and streaming products and platforms. This includes product engineering, media engineering, quality assurance, engineering behind personalization, commerce, lifecycle, and identity. Job Summary: ESPN is investing in large‑scale data infrastructure and real‑time processing platforms that power next‑generation personalization and live sports experiences. jobs.title: Senior OT Network Engineer
jobs.description: **S****enior OT Network Engineer** **About LGES Vertech** LG Energy Solution Vertech, Inc. a subsidiary of LG Energy Solution is a leading provider of grid\-scale integrated energy storage systems, delivering safe, reliable, and high‑performance solutions to customers worldwide. Powered by our proprietary AEROS® energy operating system, we use advanced monitoring and controls to help customers optimize system performance and maximize the value of their energy storage assets. At LGES Vertech, you’ll be part of a collaborative, team‑oriented organization that aspires to be humble, hungry, and smart, working together to transform the energy landscape and create a more sustainable future. We value innovation, accountability, and growth. Our diverse and growing team enjoys competitive salaries, generous benefits, **including 100% employer sponsored medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance.** For more information, visit www.lgensol\-vt.com. **Position Overview** LGES Vertech is seeking a Senior OT Network Engineer to help design, plan and implement the network for LGES Vertech integrated SCADA systems and products. **Primary responsibilities (include but not limited to):** * Plan and design LG Vertech production and SCADA network infrastructure, including routers, switches and firewalls to support the smooth functioning of LG Vertech’s industrial operations. * Work with LGES systems engineering to design cost effective, scalable network designs and solutions for LG SCADA integrated products. * Configure and optimize network devices to ensure seamless communication and data transfer between SCADA components and other network systems. * Work with customer, commissioning and field teams to set up and implement the network in Production sites as per the design specifications. * Monitor, Identify and resolve network issues, including connectivity problems, hardware failures, and performance bottlenecks. * Conduct regular network troubleshooting to ensure minimal downtime and efficient communication between SCADA systems. * Implement and maintain network security measures to protect against unauthorized access, cyber threats, and data breaches. Monitor network security and respond to incidents promptly. * Maintain comprehensive documentation of network designs, configurations and processes to facilitate troubleshooting and knowledge sharing. * Conduct regular network assessments, performance evaluations, and system audits to maintain the highest standards of reliability and efficiency. * Collaborate with LGES Corporate, third\-party vendors and suppliers to ensure the integration of their products and solutions into the LGESVT SCADA network. * Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to drive continuous improvement in SCADA network design and implementation. * Provide training and technical guidance to technical support teams as needed. **Qualifications****:** * In\-depth knowledge of networking protocols, including TCP/IP, SNMP, Modbus, DNP3, and Ethernet/IP, as well as familiarity with industrial communication protocols. * Proficiency and working knowledge in configuring and managing Routers, Switches and firewalls especially Cisco, MOXA, Palo Alto and Fortinet. * Proven experience as a Network Engineer, preferably with a focus on complex and critical infrastructure. * Hands\-on experience with network security practices, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, Remote access VPN, IPSEC L2L. * Strong working knowledge of ICS network security monitoring tools particularly around network visibility, vulnerability management and asset management * Demonstrate clear technical cybersecurity and programmatic understanding of security best practices preferably NERC CIP. * Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex network issues. * Communication Skills: Clear communication skills to collaborate with corporate management, team members and customers and convey technical information to non\-technical stakeholders. * Strong project management skills, with the ability to handle multiple tasks and priorities effectively. · * Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, SCADA\-specific certifications, and cybersecurity certifications are a plus. · * Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work seamlessly in cross\-functional teams. * Willingness to travel occasionally for on\-site deployments, maintenance, and collaboration with remote teams. **Education and Experience:** A degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Network Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or other concentrations combined with direct on\-the\-job training. Minimum of 8 to 10 years of experience directly related to the development, implementation, and ongoing management of ethernet network and cybersecurity designs preferably in an industry dealing with critical infrastructure.
