jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- **Job title** Senior Software Engineer **Department** Engineering **Reports to** Director of Engineering **Location** Remote (US); **Classification** Full\-time **Experience level** 8\+ years professional software engineering ### **Position summary** The Senior Software Engineer builds, maintains, and improves the backend services, APIs, and third\-party integrations that power SureCost’s pharmacy purchasing and inventory platform, which over 1,600 pharmacies use every day. The role writes production software with fully agentic AI development workflows. AI agents (Claude Code or equivalent) are the main environment for writing, testing, and running code. The work is backend focused and centered on .NET, within a full\-stack ownership model. The engineer owns features end to end: the API contract, the service logic, the data layer, any external integrations, the supporting UI where needed, deployment, and production support. They work in a cross\-functional pod with other senior engineers and QA. ### **Essential duties and responsibilities** * Design, develop, and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs in C\# / .NET (ASP.NET Core) on the company’s current and next\-generation platforms. * Build and maintain integrations with third\-party systems, such as accounting platforms, ERP, EDI, and vendor APIs. This covers authentication (OAuth 2\.0\), data mapping and sync, webhooks, rate limiting, retries, idempotency, and error reconciliation. * Design data models and write efficient, well\-tested data access against relational databases (SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL), including schema migrations and query performance tuning. * Direct agentic AI development workflows to write, test, refactor, and document code. Review agent output and confirm it passes the company’s blocking quality gates before release. * Own delivered work end\-to\-end: design, implementation, automated tests, deployment, monitoring, and fixing production issues that arise from that work. * Build and maintain automated test coverage (unit, integration, and contract tests), including AI\-authored test suites, as a condition of feature completion. * Work with the pod on API contracts. Build or modify React / TypeScript front\-end code when needed to finish a feature without handoffs at team boundaries. * Take part in sprint planning, estimation, code review, and the pod’s operational cadence. Report status and blockers clearly and early. * Contribute to shared libraries, integration patterns, and platform foundations. ### **Required qualifications** * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial production backend work in C\# / .NET. * Hands\-on experience building and supporting production integrations with third\-party platforms. * Demonstrated experience shipping production code through fully agentic AI development tools (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor agent mode, or equivalent). This means using agents to write, test, and operate substantial production code, not only code completion. * Strong proficiency in ASP.NET Core, RESTful API design, asynchronous programming, and dependency injection, plus an ORM such as Entity Framework Core and/or Dapper. * Solid relational database skills (SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL): schema design, query optimization, and migrations. * Working proficiency in React and TypeScript, enough to build and modify front\-end features as part of full\-stack delivery. * Strong problem\-solving skills: able to read unfamiliar codebases quickly, debug across layers (API, data, external systems, UI), and make sound technical decisions under time pressure. * Working fluency in at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; GCP or Azure acceptable), including messaging and queuing (e.g., SQS/SNS), and the ability to learn new stacks quickly. * Demonstrated end\-to\-end ownership of production software, including post\-release support. ### **Preferred qualifications** * Experience with additional accounting, ERP, or financial integrations (e.g., Xero, NetSuite, Sage) or EDI (X12 850/855/810\). * Event\-driven and asynchronous architectures: background workers, message queues, and reliable sync / reconciliation patterns. * Containerized deployment (Docker, ECS, or Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code (Terraform). * Observability tooling (e.g., Datadog) for tracing, logging, and alerting on integration health. * React PWA, React Native / React Native Web, or design\-system experience. * Data\-dense B2B application experience (purchasing, invoicing, ERP\-style workflows). ### **Success measures (first 6 months)** * Independently delivers the pod’s committed backend and integration work through the release gate, sprint over sprint. * Uses the team’s agentic development pipelines fluently, and agent\-authored test coverage ships with every feature. * Owns at least one production service or integration surface with no unresolved escaped defects attributable to delivered work. ### **Working relationships** Reports to the Director of Engineering (career line) and takes technical direction from the pod lead. Works daily with pod engineers, QA, the product owner, and contractor teammates. nvgL4HvyTB

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Realtime Pipeline
jobs.description: **About Bridge Neurotech** -------------------------- Bridge Neurotech is building a non\-invasive functional ultrasound imaging (fUSI) platform with AI\-based neural decoding for brain\-computer interface applications. We are a seed\-stage neurotechnology company developing technology that has the potential to transform how we interact with the human brain. **About the Role** ------------------ We are looking for a Software Engineer \- Realtime Pipeline to own the realtime system that runs from raw RF data off the probe all the way to decoded outputs from our neural decoding model — beamforming, imaging preprocessing, and ML inference, all in one tightly coupled latency budget. The inference latency budget is tightly coupled to the imaging pipeline latency budget: they share GPU, share memory, share the data stream. This role owns the entire realtime path and is accountable for it as one system. Given the neural decoding model, you turn it into a production realtime decoder, sitting on top of the imaging pipeline you have also built. We build from open primitives like the Mach beamformer (https://github.com/Forest\-Neurotech/mach), and you provide the technical leadership and strategy to mature the system — designing, developing, testing, deploying, and enhancing it into a scalable software solution — including what to extend, what to replace, and what to push upstream. You will work closely with our ML/AI Lead on the model serving boundary, our Embedded Systems Engineer on the data handoff from the probe, our Imaging Scientist on the imaging pipeline itself, and our Applications Engineer on the decoded output handoff downstream. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Own the end\-to\-end realtime path: raw RF data ingestion, beamforming, processing (e.g., clutter filtering), ML preprocessing, model inference, and decoded output. * Build the ML inference engine: model loading from artifacts, GPU memory residency, batching, TensorRT/ONNX or hand\-built CUDA inference, and kernel\-level integration with the upstream imaging compute. * Integrate, extend, and, where appropriate, contribute to GPU beamforming. * Hit and hold realtime throughput and latency targets at multi\-Gbit/s ingest with deterministic tail latency suitable for closed\-loop decoding. * Define and own the model serving contract with the ML/AI Lead and the path for model updates without service interruption. * Build the streaming and storage layer that serves raw and processed data to both offline training and realtime inference. * Collaborate with other team members to define the upstream interface to the device acquisition layer and the downstream interface to the BCI applications layer. * Build observability into every stage and develop benchmarks and regression tests that lock in both pipeline performance and inference correctness as the system evolves. **Who You Are** --------------- **Required** * BS/MS/PhD in computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field, with 8\+ years building production realtime or HPC systems. * Expert\-level CUDA and modern C\+\+; experience writing or extensively modifying GPU kernels for signal processing or imaging workloads. * Demonstrated experience building production ML inference systems: taking trained PyTorch (or equivalent) models to deployment on GPUs under hard latency budgets. Hands\-on with TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, Triton, or hand\-built CUDA inference engines. * Demonstrated experience building realtime data pipelines at multi\-Gbit/s rates with tight latency budgets. * Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and the signal processing stack relevant to imaging or RF: beamforming concepts, FFTs, IQ demodulation, SVD\-based filtering, autocorrelation. * Proficiency in Python and the PyTorch ecosystem sufficient to collaborate with the ML team, identify what needs to change for production, and have informed conversations about model architecture trade\-offs that affect latency. **Nice to Have** * Experience with functional imaging or other high\-data\-rate imaging modalities. * Experience integrating ML inference with upstream realtime compute, including shared GPU memory layouts and minimizing host–device round\-trips. * Experience with high\-bandwidth I/O: GPUDirect Storage, RDMA, kernel\-bypass networking, NVMe arrays. **What We Offer** ----------------- * The opportunity to shape a role and a team from the earliest stages. * Direct collaboration with leading clinicians and neuroscientists at top\-tier academic institutions. * Excellent medical benefits and a 401(k) with 6% match. Bridge Neurotech is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Staff AI Research Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us:** Lovelace is the only provider of enterprise\-scale context engines capable of analyzing trillions of real\-time data points to create knowledge graphs that are usable by autonomous agents at the speed, scale, and accuracy required for mission\-critical analysis. Lovelace’s context engine platform, Elemental, uniquely integrates data ingestion, entity resolution, and graph building into a single pipeline that empower agentic deployments, delivering 1000X the investigative power for complex queries. With its proprietary ground\-breaking YottaGraph, Lovelace provides enterprises with real\-time, real\-world context, enabling agents to understand the impact of global intelligence on enterprise data for unmatched insights with millisecond precision. Founded in 2023 by Andrew Moore, former head of Google Cloud AI, dean of Carnegie Mellon’s School of Computer Science, and first AI advisor for U.S. CENTCOM, Lovelace currently works with some of the largest public and private enterprises in the world. **Job Summary:** * The Staff AI Research Engineer will lead the design, development, and deployment of advanced AI models and systems that power Lovelace’s context engine and agentic platforms. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include researching and productionalizing ML models, pipelines, and services and working closely with product management and infrastructure engineers. In this role you will develop key components of the Elemental platform including multimodal data ingestion, entity resolution and knowledge graph construction, and agentic search. The Staff AI Research Engineer will mentor team members, collaborate cross\-functionally with product and infrastructure groups, and contribute to externally facing research, technical documentation, and internal best practices. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Pittsburgh, PA. **Qualifications:** * Strong foundation in Machine Learning and AI Engineering, with experience building and scaling production\-grade AI systems. * Graduate degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Proficiency in ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, training pipelines, and deploying and scaling models on Kubernetes\-based infrastructure (e.g., GPU scheduling, model serving, and MLOps tooling). * Ability to design rigorous experiments, interpret results, and communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Preferred Skills:** * Advanced expertise in one or more of the following: Multimodal ML, NLP, Entity Resolution, Knowledge Graphs, Agentic Search. * PhD with published research works in major ML or NLP conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AAAI, EMNLP, etc.). * Experience in a technical leadership role that required mentoring, communicating technical findings to external stakeholders, and cross\-functional project management. * Experience getting a product to market and working backwards from the customer to get to the right solution, balancing technical rigor with practical delivery. **Benefits:** LovelaceAI offers competitive compensation packages, comprehensive benefits. We provide a supportive and inclusive work environment where your skills and expertise can make a significant impact on the safety and security of our communities. **Lovelace’s founding team includes:** **Andrew Moore**, who has a track record of building impactful AI systems, designing them with human rights impact assessments as a top priority, leading the AI division of one of the world’s foremost cloud companies, and actively participating in machine learning and AI research over the past two decades. **Toby Smith**, well known in the Pittsburgh Tech community for his engineering leadership and design skills, and who has led many of the most ambitious and complex system infrastructure projects in Google Pittsburgh and NetApp. Here is a note from Andrew Moore to people who are reading these Job Postings: “Hi folks, I’m so glad you are potentially interested in Lovelace AI. This area means a lot to me because while I am an AI optimist, I also think that we technologists owe it to a rightly skeptical world to show that modern intelligent systems can actually be useful. Usefulness comes in many guises: from life sciences to education and from transportation to entertainment and many others. For many of us, security and public safety is also very high on that list. That reasoning leads to this conclusion: I’m determined to make sure that the people building Lovelace AI gain a lot from the experience, including the chance to solve fascinating problems in computer science, AI, business development, customer success and product management. I also hope that we all learn from each other in a highly enriching work environment. But my main hope is that we have a shared sense of accomplishment as we see an increasing number of national security and public safety domains made safer through sensible and robust use of advanced computer science."

jobs.title: Talent Partner - Technical
jobs.description: **About AIUC** ============== AIUC builds standards and insurance for frontier AI. Our mission is to Underwrite superintelligence. We exist because risk, not capability, is becoming the binding constraint on AI being useful. History offers lessons for how to build confidence in new technology; electricity burned down houses until insurers funded Underwriters Laboratories (UL) to certify products against their standards. Today, the UL mark is a trustmark on every light bulb in America. We’re building that for AI. AIUC\-1, our standard for agent security, serves frontier builders like Cursor, Lovable, ElevenLabs, and Harvey. We've raised $55m from Ribbit, First Harmonic and Nat Friedman to audit frontier AI. Our team comes from METR, Anthropic, McKinsey, and OpenAI. Come join us. **The Role** ------------ Most of our hiring over the next year is technical: forward deployed engineers who get customers' agents into our evaluation system, platform engineers building the product that runs those evaluations, and specialists in evals, security, and research. Every one of these hires shapes a small team. We're looking for a Talent Partner to own that hiring end to end. You'll work directly with our engineering leads and founders to define what great looks like for each role, find people who aren't looking, and close them. You'll be the first person most engineers talk to at AIUC, so you'll need to pitch the mission credibly to someone who has heard every pitch. In your first 90 days you'll take over our active engineering searches and get our newest technical roles from zero to a live pipeline. ### **In this role, you will:** * Own full\-cycle recruiting for engineering and research roles, from intake and calibration through sourcing, screening, offer, and close * Partner with hiring managers to turn vague briefs into clear profiles and target lists * Build talent maps and sourcing plays for hard\-to\-find profiles in AI evals, security, and forward deployed engineering * Screen for what you can judge, and hand our technical interviewers candidates worth their time * Run offer conversations, including equity, for candidates with strong options elsewhere * Own the agency relationships for your searches * Track your funnel and tell us what's working and what isn't * Help make AIUC a place engineers want to work, through events and our team's networks **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * **5\-7** years of full\-cycle technical recruiting in high\-growth tech, ideally at an early\-stage AI or infrastructure company. (Impact matters more than years.) * You can explain what separates a great engineer from a good one, and engineering leaders trust your read * Concrete, creative sourcing for passive candidates * You've closed candidates with competing offers from top AI companies * You use data to run your searches, and you're comfortable pushing back when it tells you something the team doesn't want to hear **Nice to Haves** ----------------- * Experience recruiting ML, research, or security engineers * An engineering or technical background * You've used AI or automation tools to make sourcing and screening faster **Our Values** ============== We are in the business of building trust. We take our values seriously and treat them as commitments to each other, held to the same bar as the ones we make to customers. * Strong back: high standards, keep our promises, work hard. * Fast feet: experiment, cut scope, take delight in pace. * Eyes up: wrestle with the mission, and let where AI is heading shape our strategy, our teams and our day\-to\-day work. * Open heart: say the scary thing, create connection, make room for emotions. Underwriting superintelligence is our life's work. If you want it to be yours, apply now. **Compensation \& Perks** ========================= * Competitive annual salary * Equity (significant part of total compensation) * Health, dental and vision insurance for you and your dependents * Visa sponsorship and relocation stipend to bring you to SF, if needed * Daily lunch, dinner \& snacks

jobs.title: Manager, Identity & Access Management

TEAM is a mission\-driven company serving over 110,000 clients and employing over 130,000 caregivers across all 50 states. We operate in a large and growing market and have grown nearly 40% annually since inception through our relentless focus on delivering best\-in\-class client experience. TEAM is led by a high\-performing team passionate about improving access to home\-based care in America. **The Role:** The Associate Modern Workplace Engineer supports the daily administration, maintenance, and optimization of TEAM's modern workplace technology environment. This role assists with Microsoft 365 services, endpoint management, identity administration, and enterprise infrastructure to ensure reliable technology operations and a productive employee experience. Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Modern Workplace Engineering, the Associate Modern Workplace Engineer collaborates with IT team members to troubleshoot technical issues, maintain security and compliance standards, and support the standardization of workplace technology across the organization. Primary Responsibilities * Administer user accounts, security groups, distribution lists, and access permissions within Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory) and Microsoft 365\. * Support Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot operations, including device provisioning, configuration profiles, application deployments, compliance policies, patching, and endpoint lifecycle management. * Assist with Exchange Online administration, including mailbox management, shared mailboxes, distribution groups, and mail flow troubleshooting. * Provide technical support and troubleshooting across Microsoft 365 services, including Teams, SharePoint, Defender, identity platforms, and managed endpoints. * Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and runbooks while collaborating with senior engineers on security compliance, platform standardization, and process improvements. **What you Bring to the Table:** Qualifications * 5\+ years of progressive experience in Identity and Access Management, information security, or a related IT discipline, including at least 2 years in a leadership or management role. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field; certifications such as CISSP, CIAM, or CISA are a plus. * Experience with enterprise IAM platforms such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, SailPoint, CyberArk, or equivalent solutions. * Strong knowledge of Zero Trust architecture, least\-privilege principles, role\-based access control (RBAC), and attribute\-based access control (ABAC). * Experience developing IAM governance programs, managing access reviews, and supporting regulatory compliance and audit readiness in enterprise environments. Skills * Enterprise identity governance and access management strategy * SSO, MFA, PAM, IGA, and IAM platform administration * Security frameworks, regulatory compliance, and risk management * Strategic planning, program management, and technical problem solving * Team leadership, executive communication, and cross\-functional collaboration **What we Bring to the Table:** * Company\-sponsored medical, dental, and vision plan for employees and their dependents * 401(k) participation after 3 months of continuous service * wellness program, learning development program * life insurance, long\-term disability coverage * charitable contribution matching, volunteer time off, and employee assistance program * In addition to accrued vacation time and sick time, TEAM recognizes 12 paid federal holidays *24 Hour Home Care is an Equal Opportunity Employer that is proud of its culture of diversity and inclusion. Individuals seeking employment are considered without regards to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. Additionally, 24 Hour Home Care will consider qualified candidates with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the law.* *By completing this application, you are providing consent to receiving text messages from 24 Hour Come Care and associated vendors at the phone numbers provided. Message and data rates may apply.* *For California applicants: by applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to the collection, use, and disclosure of your personal information in accordance with our* *privacy policy* *and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA).*

jobs.title: AI Factory Architecture Lead

You will set technical direction, prioritize and coordinate architecture activities across delivery teams, and ensure that the appropriate competence and capacity are available to meet portfolio needs. * This is a technical leadership and design authority role. You will lead the architecture capability and enable architects and technical experts across delivery organizations to create coherent, reusable and future\-ready solutions. **Global Opportunity – Open to Candidates Worldwide***\** While this job posting may display only a limited number of locations, we welcome applications from qualified candidates globally. If you believe your skills and experience are matching this role, we encourage you to apply regardless of your current location. This position does **not require relocation**. The successful candidate will be employed and hosted through their current ABB location or the nearest suitable ABB office **You will be mainly accountable for:** --------------------------------------- * Lead and orchestrate AI architecture across the AI Factory portfolio, setting technical direction, priorities and sequencing of architecture work. * Provide technical and design authority, reviewing and approving AI solution architectures within the defined governance framework. * Ensure the right architecture competence and capacity are available to meet portfolio needs, working with delivery teams and AI Factory Operations to address gaps. * Drive common architecture, standards and reuse, ensuring that reference architectures, reusable patterns and technical guardrails are developed, maintained and adopted. * Lead the AI architecture community, connecting architects and technical experts across delivery organizations to share knowledge, challenge approaches and shape technical direction. * Anticipate the rapid evolution of AI, leading assessment of emerging technologies and ensuring the technology roadmap remains relevant and avoids unnecessary technical debt or early obsolescence. * Lead technical alignment with Functions, IS, Data organizations, delivery teams and external technology partners, including technical evaluation of delivery approaches and vendors. * Resolve and govern key architecture decisions, balancing innovation, speed, security, sustainability and long\-term maintainability, and escalating significant cross\-domain decisions through AI Factory governance where required. *Our team dynamics* * You will lead and orchestrate the AI architecture capability across Energy Industries, coordinating architects and technical experts embedded across multiple delivery teams and organizations. * You will be accountable for technical direction, prioritization of architecture work, appropriate architecture competence and capacity, and approval of AI solution architectures within the defined governance framework. * The role leads primarily through technical authority, functional leadership and influence rather than direct line management. The approved role already positions this function as the principal AI technical authority influencing architects, engineers, delivery teams and external partners. **Qualifications for the role** ------------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field. * At least 8 years of experience in architecture, engineering, solution design or technology leadership. * Strong technical background with the credibility to lead senior architects and technical specialists. * Experience leading architecture or technical work across multiple teams and complex initiatives. * Experience delivering AI, analytics, machine learning or digital platforms in complex enterprise environments. * Strong knowledge of the AI technology ecosystem and emerging trends. * Ability to translate business priorities into technical direction and make sound decisions balancing speed, quality, reuse and sustainability. * Strong stakeholder leadership and communication skills. **Preferred background** * + Experience in industrial digitalization or engineering\-led environments. + Experience in technical authority, lead engineering, architecture leadership or comparable functional leadership roles. + Experience in consulting, scale\-up or high\-growth technology environments. + Experience leading technical communities and working across internal and external delivery organizations. **Your application will get our interest if you** * + Are a technical leader and orchestrator with the depth and credibility to challenge experienced architects and make sound technical decisions. + Enjoy enabling talented specialists and creating clarity when priorities compete for limited capacity. + Bring a builder mentality, technical curiosity and a practical approach to execution. + Are comfortable making decisions in a rapidly changing technology landscape. + Influence effectively across organizational boundaries and challenge established thinking constructively. + Balance innovation with reuse, maintainability and minimizing technical debt. * *This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.* *The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.* Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit **https://www.abb.com** to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: **Data Scientist** On\-site in Longmont, Colorado. Monday through Friday, business hours, Mountain Time. **About** **Docketly** Docketly, a sister company to ABC Legal Services, is a fast\-growing legal\-tech company based in Longmont, Colorado. For the creditors' rights industry, we make hiring a stand\-in attorney easy, fast, and reliable. We pair proprietary software with a nationwide network of attorneys. **Job Overview** You build and run the machine learning and analytics systems behind Docketly's operations. You build and run production models, from first idea to a live, monitored system on AWS. ABC Legal's data science team is your sounding board on methods. You build the BI reporting that leadership, operations, and client teams use daily. You support pricing and margin decisions with financial modeling. You work closely with backend engineers on data infrastructure and production issues. This role can grow into Senior Data Scientist as you take full ownership of the production model and the pricing roadmap. **Key Responsibilities** **Model development and MLOps** * Build and run the full lifecycle of production ML models: framing, feature engineering, training, validation, deployment on AWS SageMaker (Model Registry, real\-time endpoints), inference infrastructure (for example, AWS Lambda), and ongoing monitoring. * Build and maintain automated retraining and drift monitoring for deployed models. * Run staged production rollouts with holdout comparisons to prove model impact before full release. Review the test design with the team before launch. * Use AI coding tools to speed up analysis, modeling, and MLOps work. **Analytics, pricing, and reporting** * Build and maintain the BI layer leadership relies on for exec reporting on revenue, margin, and volume, from dashboard design through data accuracy. * Run pricing and margin analysis for client accounts, including ad hoc investigations for named strategic accounts. Model the financial impact of proposed pricing changes before they go live. * Build and maintain rules\-based pricing and case\-difficulty logic by court and county, alongside statistical and ML approaches. * Build and tune large scoring and prioritization frameworks in Metabase, such as weighting, percentile scenarios, and drop\-rate analysis, that drive daily operational decisions such as Hearing priority and assignment. * Turn ambiguous business questions into clear, well\-scoped analyses. **Cross\-functional partnership and documentation** * Partner with engineering on data pipelines (AWS Glue, Lambda, EventBridge). Investigate and help resolve production database performance issues, such as ORM query patterns and indexing, alongside backend engineering. * Write down your methods and decisions in Confluence or an equivalent shared space, as you go, so other teams can find your reasoning and build on it without asking you directly. **Systems \& Skills** **Required** * Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience, and 3\+ years of experience with applied statistics or machine learning. * Applied statistics: probability, hypothesis testing, and model evaluation across classification and regression/quantile models (for example, precision, recall, calibration, quantile coverage, and drift). * 3\+ years of experience with SQL and a relational database in a professional capacity. Docketly's production database runs on MySQL/Aurora, about 400 tables. * Python for data analysis and modeling: pandas, scikit\-learn, and a gradient\-boosting framework (XGBoost, LightGBM, or CatBoost). Our production model uses CatBoost\-based quantile regression. * Experience training and deploying at least one model to production, or on a cloud ML platform such as AWS SageMaker. * Metabase or comparable BI tooling. * Clear written and verbal communication with non\-technical stakeholders. **Preferred** * Staged production rollouts (canary or phased release) with holdout comparisons to prove model impact before full release. * AWS Glue, S3, Lambda, EventBridge, CloudFormation. * Comfortable using AI coding tools such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot to move faster on analysis and modeling work. * Experience diagnosing production database performance issues, such as query plans, indexing, and ORM\-generated query patterns, in a large, high\-table\-count schema. * Software\-engineering practices applied to ML code, such as automated testing with pytest, for production pipelines. **Benefits** * Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance * 401(k) with Company Matching * Paid Time Off * 7 Paid Company Holidays * 4 Floating Holidays per Year * Life Insurance and AD\&D Insurance * Long\-Term Disability * Health Care Reimbursement Flexible Spending Account (FSA) * Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Pet Insurance **Schedule \& Location** Schedule: Monday\-Friday, 8:00 AM\-5:00 PM (Mountain Time) in Longmont, CO. Salary Range: $110,000\-$130,000 depending on experience ***Application closing date: November 20, 2026, at 11:59pm***

practice: strong baselines, ablations, and sound evaluation on real\-world data, including rare\-event and heavily imbalanced problems. * Strong proficiency in Python and PyTorch, with a solid jobs.title: Junior IoT Engineer
jobs.description: Note * Hybrid, may be asked to come into the office for hands\-on tasks Junior IoT Engineer **No engineering degree required, but curiosity is.** We're a small IoT company building and deploying real\-world sensor systems, and we're looking for someone early in their engineering career who loves learning how things work. You might be getting an Electrical Engineering or Computer Science degree. You might have gone to trade school. You might be self\-taught and have a desk covered in Arduinos, Raspberry Pis, wires, and half\-finished projects. We're interested in what you can **do and learn**, not the name on your diploma. Show us what you've built Seriously. Built something with an Arduino? Designed a PCB? Made a robot? Automated your house? Written firmware? Set up a home server? Repaired electronics? Built something completely ridiculous just because you wanted to see if you could? **Tell us about it.** Personal projects, hobbies, and things you've taught yourself matter to us. What you'll do You'll work with real IoT hardware throughout its entire lifecycle—from engineering prototypes to devices deployed in the field. Your work will include: * Configuring and preparing IoT devices for deployment * Managing firmware and device settings across our fleet * Testing and QA'ing sensors before they become finished goods * Troubleshooting devices that don't behave the way they're supposed to * Using fleet data to investigate problems and identify trends * Testing new hardware and firmware designs * Presenting feedback to the rest of the R\&D team * Learning to diagnose PCB, sensor, power, firmware, and RF problems * Helping us improve the tools and processes we use to configure, test, and deploy devices Some days you'll be working with production hardware. Other days you might be looking through logs, testing a prototype, chasing down an RF problem, writing a script to automate something annoying, or putting an oscilloscope on a board to figure out what went wrong. That's part of the fun. Things you'll learn We **do not expect you to already know all of these.** Experience with any of them is a bonus. More importantly, we're looking for someone **excited to learn**: * Microcontrollers and embedded systems * Linux and the command line * Firmware and device management * PCB debugging * Sensors and IoT systems * RF and wireless communications * Data analysis and troubleshooting * Python and scripting * Electronics test equipment, including: * Multimeters * Oscilloscopes * Logic analyzers * Programmable power supplies and loads * Other lab equipment you'll probably find an excuse to play with You'll get exposure to the full lifecycle of an IoT product: **prototype → hardware → firmware → testing → production → deployment → fleet data → field troubleshooting** Who we're looking for We're looking for someone who is: * Curious * Hands\-on * Comfortable saying, "I don't know, but I can figure it out" * Excited to learn new tools * Willing to dig into weird problems * Careful enough to do good production and QA work * Interested in understanding *why* something failed instead of simply replacing it * Happy working across hardware, software, data, and production rather than staying in one narrow lane If you've ever spent an evening trying to figure out why an Arduino wasn't doing what you told it to do, taken apart an electronic device just to see what was inside, or taught yourself something because you couldn't stop wondering how it worked, you may be exactly who we're looking for. What it's like working here You'll report directly to our **Head of Research \& Engineering**. We don't expect a junior engineer to walk through the door already knowing everything. Teaching and mentorship are a major part of how our R\&D team operates. You'll start with problems you can tackle and take on increasingly difficult ones as your skills grow. Because we're a small company, you won't be isolated from the rest of the product. You'll work alongside the people designing, programming, testing, deploying, and supporting the systems you're working on. That means you'll get exposure to a lot of engineering very quickly. We're also a team that genuinely enjoys working together. We take the engineering seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. Expect bad puns, plenty of joking around, people jumping in to help each other debug problems, and coworkers who actually enjoy hanging out together. You do NOT need * An engineering degree * Years of professional experience * To know every tool or technology listed above * To pretend you know something when you don't Bring curiosity, a willingness to learn, and something cool you've worked on. **We can teach a lot of the rest.** Pay: $20\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour Expected hours: 30\.0 per week Work Location: Hybrid remote in Cincinnati, OH 45202

Protocol (MCP). * Develop and maintain support for IATA NDC 17\.2 and 24\.1 API workflows. * Generate and validate XML/SOAP requests and responses for NDC testing. * Develop automated validations using XPath, Groovy, and SoapUI. * Design and maintain AWS\-based services using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, ECS Fargate, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, Cognito, and CloudWatch. * Implement secure jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description: We are looking for a hands\-on Director of Engineering to lead our engineering function and scale AVA, Acclinate's community intelligence platform, into an enterprise\-grade product. You will report to our Head of Product \& Marketing and lead and grow a small engineering team while shipping code yourself. You will work inside a unit that owns the path from customer and community need to product, launch, and growth. Product decides what we build and why. You own how it gets built, whether it is ready for production, and whether the data behind it can be trusted. You prioritize impact over flawless code. You join customer calls, turn thin specs into working software, and keep a clear boundary between fast iteration and rigorous, compliant production releases. ### **About Acclinate Inc.** Acclinate is the catalyst for health equity. We use trust, technology, and community engagement to help the healthcare ecosystem connect with those they aim to serve. Our approach ensures innovation is inclusive, empowering communities to take actions for better health. ### **Description** **What you will own** --------------------- ### **Architecture and systems** * Own the architecture and full\-stack systems behind complex proprietary data, analytics pipelines, and LLM\-powered features. * Maintain and modernize our core stack: GCP\-native infrastructure (Cloud Run, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Vertex AI), containers, CI/CD, and Ruby on Rails. * Evaluate a new stack to modernize the frontend and backend, and bring a migration recommendation to the Head of Product \& Marketing. * Own integrations across our data and business systems, including Metabase, HubSpot, and the tools connecting product, analytics, customer, and operational data. * Think in systems. Every feature touches an external platform, a background job, a database, an API contract, a client, and a customer report. Design so a break is visible before a customer sees it. ### **Data confidence and traceability** * Know where every number comes from. The platform pulls from several external sources, runs predictive scoring models, and reports back to customers. * Trace a wrong metric to its source and fix the pipeline when an upstream platform changes. * Write the SQL that answers a customer's question, and stand behind the number. ### **Quality, security, and compliance** * Set delivery standards: small PRs, tests that prove behavior, migrations that don't break a deploy, and structured logs and traces. * Build and maintain the technical controls for data security, audit trails, HIPAA, and SOC 2, working with our Director of Quality Assurance and Compliance, who owns the compliance program. * Modernize engineering processes through streamlined code review, automated testing, and production monitoring. ### **Partnership with Product and the business** * Turn product priorities into a delivery plan, and be clear about what it will take. * Join customer and partner calls when the work calls for it. Turn a thin spec into working software without waiting for exhaustive documentation. * Push back when an ask won't hold up in production, and propose a better path. Your manager expects this. * Work with Community, Customer Success, and Commercial teams so engineering output supports how we sell, deliver, and support the product. ### **Team building and mentorship** * Manage, mentor, and work alongside the engineering team, including engineers supporting AVA and NOWINCLUDED. * Build the team intentionally, hiring engineers who are strong at rapid prototyping, system design, and disciplined delivery. * Onboard new engineers into the codebase and the customer context. ### **AI\-native development** * Use Claude Code, Cursor, or an equivalent for most of your output. Know when to prompt, when to code by hand, and how to evaluate AI\-generated work critically. * Write the repo instructions, decision records, and plans that help AI agents produce correct code the first time. * Review agent output with the rigor you'd give a junior engineer's PR. * Help the team improve how it uses AI through better workflows, shared practices, and internal tooling. **What you bring** ------------------ ### **Leadership and engineering experience** We're open to several profiles: * 8\+ years of engineering leadership, with a recent and proven shift to AI\-native ways of working. * 5\+ years in AI\-native engineering teams, with deep fluency in how they operate. * 3–5 years, if you have clearly outpaced peers with more experience through speed and shipping. In every case, you have led engineers directly and are comfortable reporting to a product and commercial leader rather than a technical one. ### **Technical depth** * 5\+ years building production systems, including at least one you took from early design to customers using it. * **Data engineering and AI:** data pipelines, data security, and LLM APIs or modern AI tooling in production. * **Cloud infrastructure:** strong cloud experience, GCP preferred, including Cloud Run, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Vertex AI, and CI/CD practices. * **Full stack:** backend architecture, data infrastructure, APIs, integrations, and front\-end work. Ruby on Rails and a typed client framework preferred; strong Rails plus React and a willingness to learn Flutter also works. * **Data\-model\-first thinking:** you design tables and APIs before screens, and can explain the tradeoffs. * Healthcare or regulated\-data experience (HIPAA, SOC 2, audit trails) is a strong plus. ### **AI tooling fluency** * Daily use of AI coding agents on real codebases, with a clear view of where they fail. * A concrete approach to structuring a repo so an agent produces correct code, and to checking its work before merging. ### **Communication** * Plain, direct writing. Most coordination is asynchronous: PR descriptions, decision records, Slack updates, and memos a non\-engineer can follow. * You can explain technical risk and tradeoffs in business terms to a non\-technical manager and to customers. * Comfort with a small team, a real customer base, and ambiguity. Shipping is expected. **Salary and Benefits** Compensation depends on experience and includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. At Acclinate, we offer a competitive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance with 50% of premiums covered by the company. We also provide a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) policy alongside dedicated paid sick leave. #### **Salary** $140,000 \- $170,000 per year

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Role** ======== The Senior Full\-Stack Engineer exists to solve problems that make Acquisition.com's advisory and client application efforts more successful. The goal is a better net client experience, built by designing systems and processes around client data inside our platforms and integrations. Some of those problems are integrations. Some are net\-new applications. Some are automations that replace manual work nobody should be doing. The common thread is that you see a problem, figure out the right solution, and build it end\-to\-end. Acquisition.com operates across advisory, media, and technology functions, each generating its own set of systems, data flows, and process challenges. You will work across these functions, building the internal tools, automations, and application layers that let the business move faster and serve clients better. The work is varied by design. One week you might be standing up a new client\-facing workflow; the next, you might be wiring two systems together or rebuilding a pipeline that has outgrown its original architecture. This is a hands\-on, individual\-contributor role. You will own projects from idea through production, working directly with engineering, leadership, and business teams to understand what needs to exist and then making it real. **Responsibilities** ==================== * Build and ship full\-stack applications, services, and internal tools that improve the client experience and support advisory operations * Design and implement automations that replace manual processes and reduce operational overhead across business functions * Architect and maintain integrations between internal systems and external platforms to keep client data accurate and accessible * Own projects end\-to\-end, from scoping the problem with stakeholders through deployment, monitoring, and iteration * Collaborate with engineering, leadership, and business teams to translate raw needs into working software that delivers measurable results * Continuously evaluate and improve system architecture for performance, scalability, and reliability as the business grows **Requirements** ================ * Proven ability to build production applications across the stack, not just one layer, with 5\+ years of experience delivering complex or high\-impact systems * Strong experience designing and shipping automations and process\-driven tooling that reduced real operational burden * Demonstrated skill building integration frameworks and data pipelines that connect multiple systems reliably at scale * Proficiency in both Python and TypeScript for building scalable services, automation workflows, and application layers * Track record of working directly with non\-technical stakeholders to understand the real problem before writing code * Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), CI/CD, observability tooling, and agent\-driven development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code **Results** =========== * The net client experience improves because the systems and processes around client data are reliable, well\-designed, and built for how the business actually operates * Advisory and client application teams operate faster because the tools they depend on work and are built for their actual workflows * Manual processes are replaced by automations that save measurable time and reduce errors across business functions * Integrations between systems are seamless, accurate, and maintainable, reducing the overhead of keeping data in sync * New capabilities move from idea to production quickly because you own the full path and do not wait for handoffs * Engineering patterns and reusable components emerge from your work, raising the baseline for the entire platform **Schedule** ============ * Work hours aligned with local timezone or Pacific timezone (8a\-5p M\-F) * Availability to support critical launches or events when needed **Location** ============ * Full\-time, remote (US\-based) * Quarterly on\-sites in Las Vegas **Compensation:** ================= * $170,000 \- $200,000 base salary * The salary range may be inclusive of several levels that would be applicable to the position. Final salary will be based on a number of factors including, level, relevant prior experience, skills, and expertise. This range is only inclusive of base salary, not benefits (more details below). **Benefits:** ============= We offer a comprehensive, evolving benefits package designed to support your health, family, and wellbeing. Some key offerings: * Flexible Unlimited Paid Time Off and Company\-wide Holidays * Employer sponsored Medical, Dental, \& Vision plans + $1,950 annual Employer HSA contribution + FSA options including dependent care + Employee assistance program and mental health resources * Employer match program for 401(k), eligible for both Traditional and Roth accounts * $1,200 annual wellness reimbursement through JOON that supports health, family care, pet care, fitness, and more! * For local or visiting team members, enjoy access to a state of the art gym at our HQ in Las Vegas * *Benefits eligibility applies only to full\-time exempt roles.* **ACQ Core Values:** ==================== Our core values are the heart and soul of this incredible company. The right person for this role will appreciate each of these values, personally subscribe to them, and understand why each is critical to having a great business. **Competitive Greatness** ------------------------- Be at your best when your best is needed. Enjoyment of a hard challenge. Those who have the drive to constantly improve, the superior intellect and long term commitment to see incremental improvements become compounding returns. **Sincere Candor** ------------------ Have the self awareness to accurately perceive and communicate hard truths that improve others and self, the courage to do so, and the humility to accept them, even when it hurts. Nothing great can be built without feedback: internally or externally. **Unimpeachable Character** --------------------------- Be the type of person with whom people are always proud to associate, personally and professionally. We look for true alignment of thoughts, words, and actions towards a goal worth pursuing. Compensation Range: $170K \- $200K

in Python and C\+\+. * Experience integrating generative AI into applications and workflows, including model inference, training or fine\-tuning, prompt design, tool calling, structured output, and retrieval\-augmented generation. * Experience running or integrating models in local or privately hosted environments. * Understanding of dataset preparation, model evaluation, context management, and defect\-tracking systems such as Jira or Bugzilla. ### **Compensation and Benefits** **$128,000 \- $192,000 per year** Final compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, Identity Engineering owns the systems responsible for onboarding all consumers and managing their authentication and verification journeys across Affirm's product surfaces. In this role, you will need to gain a deep understanding of the business, product and engineering context, and utilize that context to own and deliver high\-availability and low\-latency systems on the critical paths for all of our products **What you'll do** * You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers on your team through ambiguity to solve open\-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery. * You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design \& analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade\-offs. * You will proactively identify project, process, technology or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them. * You will support the operations and availability of your team's artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting "keep the lights on" \& on\-call efforts. * You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks. * You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example. **What we look for** * You have 4\+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin. * You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes. * You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others. * You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely. * Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders. * You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team. * This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor's degree in a related field. Pay Grade \- N Equity Grade \- 9 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job\-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.) USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $195,000 \- $255,000 USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $173,000 \- $233,000 \#LI\-Remote **Remote\-first with flexibility built in** Affirm is proud to be a remote\-first company. jobs.title: Senior Performance Test Engineer
jobs.description: **About Agadia** We specialize in healthcare management technology and offer a suite of utilization management software solutions for our clients. Our mission is to improve the quality of care and expedite the delivery of health care services by advancing and automating utilization management processes. We are based in Parsippany, NJ, with clients across the United States. As we grow, we are looking for a detail\-oriented, self\-motivated, independent Software Engineer to help analyze, design, and refine business requirements. Agadia is seeking a Senior Performance Test Engineer to perform performance testing for its healthcare SaaS applications. The role covers requirements analysis, workload modeling, test automation, execution, bottleneck investigation, and reporting. The engineer will work with Development, QA, DevOps, Infrastructure, DBAs, and Production Support to validate performance, investigate regressions, and provide evidence for release and capacity decisions. **Roles and Responsibilities** * Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to define measurable acceptance criteria for critical workflows, including response\-time percentiles, throughput, error rates, and recovery behavior. * Assess application architecture, dependencies, deployment topology, and production usage to develop performance test strategies, estimates, schedules, and entry and exit criteria. * Design realistic workload models covering concurrent users, transaction arrival rates, customer mix, think time, pacing, peak periods, ramp\-up and sustained load. * Plan and execute baseline, load, stress, spike, endurance, and scalability tests; coordinate controlled failover and recovery tests with the responsible teams. * Develop and maintain reusable **JMeter** or **k6** scripts with authentication, session handling, dynamic value correlation, parameterization and assertions that verify successful business transactions. * Build modular suites for case creation, review, sign\-off, queue management and document management, with configurable customer profiles, user credentials and datasets. * Prepare and manage approved synthetic or masked test data, including extraction, seeding, validation and cleanup; protect credentials and maintain customer data isolation. * Validate test environment readiness, data volumes, cache state, and load\-generator capacity; document differences that affect comparison with production. * Monitor and correlate test results with Dynatrace or equivalent APM tooling, IIS and Windows metrics, application logs, and SQL Server activity. * Investigate bottlenecks across application, API, database, and infrastructure layers, including slow queries, blocking, thread or connection pool contention, memory growth, and resource saturation. * Compare releases against approved baselines, record reproducible performance defects, collaborate with engineering teams on remediation, and verify fixes through retesting. * Provide measured capacity and scalability findings, with documented assumptions, to support infrastructure planning and growth forecasts. * Integrate appropriate performance checks into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines and scheduled test runs; continuously improve scripts, framework reliability and reporting. * Deliver technical reports and stakeholder summaries covering workload assumptions, results against targets, bottleneck evidence, business impact, limitations and release readiness recommendations. **Required Qualifications** * At least 5 years of hands\-on experience in load and performance testing of web applications and APIs. * Strong proficiency in JMeter or k6, including independent script development, debugging, maintenance, and command\-line test execution. * Sound understanding of performance testing concepts, workload modeling, and interpretation of latency percentiles, throughput, error rates, and resource utilization. * Experience testing multi\-tier applications, with working knowledge of HTTP/HTTPS, REST APIs, JSON, authentication, session management, and dynamic data correlation. * SQL proficiency for test data preparation, validation, and investigation of database\-related performance issues. * Experience using an application performance monitoring tool, server metrics, and logs to investigate bottlenecks and support findings with evidence. * Ability to develop supporting automation using JavaScript, YAML, Groovy, or a comparable scripting language. * Experience with Git, repeatable test execution, and performance regression analysis across software releases. * Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to manage testing priorities and explain findings to technical and business stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Dynatrace Managed and performance analysis of Windows Server, IIS, .NET, and SQL Server environments. * Hands\-on experience with both JMeter and k6, and integration of performance tests into Azure DevOps pipelines. * Experience testing multi\-tenant SaaS or healthcare applications and handling sensitive test data. * Browser performance analysis using developer tools, Playwright, or k6 browser, alongside API and protocol\-level load testing. * Understanding Azure or AWS architecture, scalability, and migration performance validation; Azure experience is preferred. * Exposure to background processing, caching, messaging, and failover or recovery validation. **Key Deliverables** * A maintained performance test strategy, workload model, and reusable regression suite. * Release reports with clear pass or fail results, supporting evidence, test limitations, and unresolved performance risks. * Verified remediation outcomes and capacity recommendations based on measured results. **Please note:** The Salary range is based on our market pay structure \& includes benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, life Insurance, 401 \& PTO, etc.), and will be determined based on the candidate's experience, qualifications, and evaluation. * Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States, and the company does not provide employment visa sponsorship now or in the future **Key Competencies** **Communicates effectively**– Attentively listens to others, provides timely and helpful information and is effective in a range of professional settings. Gives and receives feedback in a productive, professional manner. Demonstrates excellent oral and written communication skills. **Manages Ambiguity \-**Operating effectively, even when things are not certain, or the way forward is not clear. Is flexible in approach and is able to adapt their approach to meet changing business needs. **Manages complexity \-**Makes sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems. Has strong organizational skills and is able to manage multiple activities at once. Has high attention to detail. **Ensures** **Accountability \-**Follows through on commitments and makes sure others do the same. Able to work independently as part of a small team.

jobs.title: Applied AI Demo Engineer
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ Anthropic's customer\-facing teams are often the first place a customer sees what Claude can do. As a Demo Engineer, you'll build the demos, reference implementations, and reusable tooling that help those teams make new capabilities tangible, relevant, and trustworthy, ideally within days of a product launch rather than weeks after. This role sits between product engineering, technical storytelling, and GTM execution. You'll own ambiguous, high\-leverage problems end to end: prototyping an agentic experience for a new capability, then hardening it into something reliable that other teams can run on their own. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Operations, and our sales and solutions teams, and you'll bring what you learn from customer\-facing work back to the people building the products. Because a demo is frequently someone's first impression of what our models can and can't do, accuracy and honesty matter as much as polish. Success in this role looks like customer\-facing teams demonstrating new capabilities sooner and with more confidence, recurring requests becoming reusable assets rather than one\-off projects, and field insights shaping product and launch\-readiness decisions. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Own demo readiness for new and priority Claude capabilities, including environments, integrations, synthetic data, evaluations, reliability checks, and fallback paths * Build prototypes, agents, and reference flows that make complex capabilities concrete and tie them to clear customer outcomes * Turn recurring requests into reusable accelerators such as companion apps, templates, Skills, plugins, and self\-service demo packages that scale across customer\-facing teams * Partner with GTM colleagues on high\-impact customer moments, unblock critical technical gaps, and spot the patterns worth turning into shared assets * Build internal agentic systems that automate demo preparation, validation, and asset maintenance, so demos stay current as products change * Translate patterns from customer\-facing work into product feedback, launch\-readiness priorities, and systemic improvements with Product and Engineering * Define and raise the bar for demo quality across accuracy, safety, reliability, usability, and adoption * Decide when a customer need calls for a bespoke build and when it should become a shared capability **You may be a good fit if you have** ------------------------------------- * Proficiency in Python or TypeScript, with experience shipping working software end to end * Hands\-on experience building applications or agents on top of LLM APIs, including prompting, tool use, and retrieval * Experience designing integrations with third\-party APIs, data sources, and services * The ability to take an ambiguous capability or customer need to a working prototype quickly, and then make it reliable * Clear communication of technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including sales and solutions teams * Comfort collaborating across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Operations, and GTM teams * Experience in a demo engineering, solutions engineering, sales engineering, forward deployed engineering, developer relations, or product engineering role * A track record of building reusable internal tools, templates, or self\-service assets that other teams adopted * Hands\-on experience with Claude Code, the Claude Agent SDK, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), Skills, or plugins * Experience building evaluation or validation harnesses for AI systems, including reliability checks and graceful fallbacks * Experience building always\-on or scheduled agentic systems that automate internal workflows * Experience building synthetic or sanitized datasets that make demos realistic without exposing sensitive information * Front\-end or product design skills that help demos feel polished and intuitive * Experience supporting product launches or running launch\-readiness programs * A history of turning field feedback into concrete product input that influenced a roadmap * A passion for making powerful technology safe and beneficial, and a commitment to representing model capabilities accurately and honestly The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $240,000 \- $315,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

model governance, data protection, information barriers, and AI risk\-ma * * 8\+ years of professional software engineering, data engineering, machine learning engineering, or related experience. * production\-quality software. * Experience designing and developing APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and cloud\-native applications. * Hands\-on experience with a major cloud platform, preferably Azure. * Experience with containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and modern DevOps practices. * Practical experience building LLM applications using techniques such as RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, tool use, or agentic workflows. * Familiarity with model evaluation, testing, observability, and production monitoring for AI systems. * Understanding of software security, authentication and authorization, secrets management, and secure development practices. * Experience delivering highly scalable, reliable production systems. * jobs.title: Associate Engineer I, Validation
jobs.description: Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq ARWR) is a commercial stage biopharmaceutical company that develops medicines that treat intractable diseases by silencing the genes that cause them. Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead's RNAi\-based therapeutics leverage this natural pathway of gene silencing. Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. The depth and versatility of our RNAi technologies enables us to potentially address conditions in virtually any therapeutic area and pursue disease targets that are not otherwise addressable by small molecules and biologics. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates. Arrowhead's corporate headquarters is in Pasadena, CA with research and development teams in Madison, WI \& San Diego, CA, and a state of the art manufacturing facility in Verona, WI. Our employees are nimble, science\-driven innovators who are collaborating to bring new therapies to patients in need. **The Position** The Associate Engineer I, Validation is an entry level position providing support for equipment, utility, analytical instrument, and facility qualification at the Arrowhead Verona site. The Associate Engineer I, Validation will coordinate and execute commissioning and qualification (C\&Q) activities supporting internal GMP drug substance manufacturing and testing. This may include C\&Q activities in support of new systems, modifications to existing equipment, and periodic reviews. The Associate Engineer I is responsible for ensuring internal system specifications and quality standards are applied and followed throughout the equipment lifecycle. *Responsibilities* * Creates C\&Q and temperature mapping worksheets and protocols from site templates with oversight by management or senior team members. * Advances internal and external C\&Q and equipment lifecycle documentation through the review and approval process. * Execute, or oversee vendor execution, for simple or routine qualification testing with Subject Matter Expert support. Identifies protocol events and investigates with manager support. * Completes qualification documentation following good documentation practices. * Prepares and reviews requirement trace matrixes and qualification reports from internal or vendor provided qualification protocols. * Participates on project teams to report status and meet project deliverables including qualification testing, and event resolution, and closure. * Develops ability to manage individual tasks against project schedule. Works with manager to prioritize commitments across projects. * Participates on teams during the preparation of system design and specification documents and supports updates with oversight from team members. * Supports completion of gap assessments for existing equipment qualifications in response to new products introduced into a manufacturing platform. Shares gaps with project team develop and execute action items. * Supports senior team members in execution of qualification activities for systems of growing complexity, automated equipment, and systems integrated with validated computer systems. * Responsible for completion of periodic reviews for simple equipment per assigned schedules. * With management or team member oversight reviews simple equipment changes for impact to qualification, identifies actions needed, and completes requalification deliverables to support change completion. * Develops an awareness of qualification best practices and looks to apply a science and risk\-based approach to C\&Q. * Begins to understand qualification requirements for automated equipment and systems integrated with validated computer systems under guidance of senior team members. * Performs other related duties as assigned. **Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related scientific field * Strong communication and documentation skills * Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite **Preferred** * Prior experience or internship in the pharmaceutical industry, preferably with validation or quality systems. * Prior experience with automated manufacturing equipment. * Familiar with Blue Mountain Regulatory Asset Manager software. * Awareness of cGMP requirements. * Familiar with engineering drawings such as P\&IDs, piping, and electrical drawings. Arrowhead provides competitive salaries and an excellent benefit package. Candidates must have current, valid authorization to work in the country where this role is located. California Applicant Privacy Policy
