jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, ML Evaluation & Introspection Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Who we are** Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self\-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly. The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone. At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn. **What we are looking for** We’re searching for a **Senior Software Engineer, ML Evaluation \& Introspection Infrastructure** to join our Behavior Analysis team, reporting to the team’s engineering manager. Aurora’s trucks already haul freight on Texas highways with no one on board, and every new version of the learned model that drives them has to prove, on real driving data, that it is better and safer than the one before. Behavior Analysis builds the systems that make that call: the evals that compare model versions, the embedding search that makes every driving scenario findable, and the introspection tools that show why a model did what it did. Engineers build more than 100 training and eval datasets a week through our tools. We’re a small team, so each engineer owns whole systems, and we work agent\-first: our tools are built for AI agents to drive as easily as engineers do. You’ll own core pieces of that loop and help lead what comes next: putting LLMs, VLMs and agents to work on analysis, so questions that take days to answer today take minutes. **In this role you will** * Build and scale evaluation pipelines that compare model versions on large driving datasets: offline evals, slice\-based metrics, regression detection, and model\-vs\-model reports. * Own embedding and vector\-search pipelines over driving data, versioned per model, so engineers can search, cluster and compare how any model represents the world. This is where you’d start: owning embedding generation and search end to end. * Build model introspection infrastructure (attention, attribution, ablations) that turns “why did the model do that?” from a research project into a query. * Help define how frontier LLMs, VLMs and agents change ML analysis here: triaging, labeling, clustering and summarizing driving scenarios and eval results. We already have a prototype using LLMs for data curation, and you’d help decide where it goes next. * Work side by side with the ML engineers training these models to decide what to measure, then make those measurements trustworthy, observable and cheap enough to run on every candidate model. * Build the web app and CLI that engineers and AI agents use to find datasets, training runs, evals and their costs, designed with agents as first\-class users. **Required qualifications** * Typically 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend, data or ML infrastructure. * Strong Python, and proficiency with SQL. * Designed and operated large\-scale batch or data pipelines on cloud infrastructure, including backfills, retries and cost management. * Built systems that measure or evaluate something: metrics, experimentation, evaluation or analytics platforms. * Experience with distributed compute and container orchestration (e.g. Kubernetes, AWS Batch or similar). **Desirable qualifications** * ML evaluation infrastructure: eval harnesses, golden datasets, regression detection, A/B model comparison. * Embeddings and vector search, or model introspection and interpretability tooling. * Using LLMs, VLMs or agentic workflows to automate analysis, labeling or data curation. * Autonomous vehicles, robotics or other large\-scale sensor data. * Observability for data systems (metrics, alerting, SLOs), and everyday use of AI coding agents. * Coming from backend or data engineering and want to learn ML evaluation? Apply anyway: we’ll teach you the ML side. *For roles based in Mountain View, CA:* The salary range for this position is $162,000 \- $260,000 per year. Aurora’s pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. jobs.title: Mid-Level and Senior Software Engineers - Rust
jobs.description: **Company Description** Founded and headquartered in Switzerland, Avaloq is continuously expanding its global footprint with around 2,500 colleagues in 12 countries, and more than 170 clients in 35 countries. We are an industry\-leading provider of wealth management technology and services for financial institutions around the world, including private banks and wealth managers, investment managers, as well as retail and neo banks. Our research led approach and continual innovation is powered by the passion and creativity of our colleagues. We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world’s leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential. **Job Description** Avaloq’s R\&D Lab is building a SaaS, API\-first, composable banking platform. You will help develop its Rust backend, creating financial technology where precision, quality and scalability matter, while working closely with engineers in Fort Lauderdale and Zurich. These 3 roles are among the first engineering roles at our new Fort Lauderdale development center, offering significant scope for ownership as the team grows. You will work directly with clients, see how your solutions are used and bring those insights back into the product. The role includes onboarding with the Zurich team, collaborative mornings and productive afternoons, with regular travel to Switzerland and occasional travel to client sites. **Our stack** Rust with Tokio and the AWS SDK for Rust. Serverless\-first on AWS, using Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS and S3, with GitHub Actions for CI/CD. Clients integrate through our APIs and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). We do not run containers. **Useful domain experience** Depending on the role, relevant experience may include wealth and asset management, discretionary portfolio management, investment performance and attribution, portfolio valuation and rebalancing, benchmarks and fees, or US investment taxation, including tax lots, cost basis, holding periods, wash sales, corporate actions, withholding and tax reporting. What you'll do: * Design, develop and test Rust backend services for complex financial products, with a focus on accuracy, scalability and reliability. * Translate complex financial rules and mathematical concepts into precise, efficient and testable software, accounting for numerical precision and edge cases. * Build scalable solutions using historized, non\-relational data models and asynchronous, event\-driven architectures. * Contribute to technical specifications, design discussions and code reviews, using AI coding agents while maintaining rigorous review standards and accountability. * Own features through the development lifecycle, from implementation and automated testing to deployment and monitoring, working alongside Platform and SRE engineers. * Work directly with clients and domain specialists to analyse product questions, solve problems and bring insights back into product development. **Qualifications** * Strong programming foundations in a statically typed language such as Rust, C\+\+, Java, Scala, Kotlin, C\#, Go or TypeScript. * Master’s degree or PhD in computer science, mathematics, physics or a related quantitative field. * Strong modelling skills, including experience or understanding of historized data, effective dating, immutability and audit trails. * Strong analytical ability and intellectual curiosity, with the ability to quickly learn new technologies and complex financial domains. * Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts effectively to both technical and business audiences. * Ability to work independently within a distributed team and travel to Switzerland and client sites when required. It would be a real bonus if you have: * Production Rust experience, or experience with another systems/strongly typed language such as C\+\+, Haskell, OCaml or Scala. * Experience in wealth or asset management technology, including investment performance, portfolio construction/rebalancing, or tax, accounting and other rule\-heavy financial software. * Experience with AWS serverless and event\-driven architecture, particularly Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, S3 and API Gateway, or related distributed\-systems technologies. * Experience with AI\-assisted engineering, client\-facing product development, research or open\-source software. **Additional Information** This role includes onboarding with the existing team in Zurich, regular travel to Switzerland and occasional travel to client sites. We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices. In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self. We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way. Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations. \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.description: **Company Description** **About Axiado** Axiado is redefining how AI infrastructure gets secured and managed. Founded in 2019, we’re a fast\-growing, well\-funded team of over 180 people worldwide, building the Trusted Control/Compute Unit (TCU), a new class of semiconductor that integrates hardware security, real\-time platform management, and AI\-driven optimization. Our TCU\-based Platform Efficiency Controller is shipping hardware that makes AI servers measurably more efficient, more secure, and more reliable, and we’re extending that foundation into a hardware\-anchored management fabric that scales from a single board to the whole fleet. Backed by strong funding and validated by commercial programs with Tier 1 industry leaders, Axiado has earned recognition through numerous industry awards, including the 2026 AI in Cybersecurity Innovation Award from TMCnet, a Diamond award for Zero Trust Solution of the Year at the 2026 Pinnacle Awards, and Gold at the 2026 Cybersecurity Excellence Awards for AI Security Solution, as well as being a finalist for the Start\-Up to Watch Award from the Global Semiconductor Alliance. Every employee holds equity, meaning your work directly builds your stake in the company’s future, not just a paycheck. If you want to help define what comes next, let’s talk. **Job Description** **Job Description** * Design, develop, and maintain BMC software solutions for our products. Like sensor monitor,event log WebUI etc. * Implement function in firmware to communicate with peripherals via SPI, I2C, UART etc, per protocol specification and chipset datasheet. * Perform code reviews, unit testing, and debugging to ensure high quality and reliable BMC software. * Develop and maintain documentation, including design specifications, user manuals,and release notes. **Qualifications** **Qualifications** * BMC product/stack software solution experience is a must * Good understanding of server power management via BMC is a must * Must have 5\+ years experience in C\+\+ coding in linux application, including well design concepts and code tracing skill. * Hardware debugging skill is must. * Solid Knowledge of low\-level protocol, including I2C, PMBUS, SPI, UART, JTAG, GPIO. * Good understanding of BMC IPMI2\.0 including IPMI Messaging, SDR, SEL, FRU, SOL, IPMB, LAN, KCS, event log, PEF, ME, NM, PECI. * Must have worked on MCTP and PLDM * Experience in porting BMC to multiple HW. * Experience with AMI SPX/OneTree product is preferred * Good to have worked on DCSCM card. **Additional Information** Axiado is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber talent in a diverse and multifaceted environment. We are headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, with access to the world's leading research, technology and talent. We are building an exceptional team to secure every node on the internet. For us, solving real\-world problems takes precedence over purely theoretical problems. As a result, we prefer individuals with persistence, intelligence and high curiosity over pedigree alone. Working hard and smart, continuous learning and mutual support are all part of who we are. Axiado is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Axiado does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non\-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

jobs.title: Network Operations Security Engineer (US - Remote)
jobs.description: AXON Networks delivers a robust AI\-driven, analytics\-based orchestration platform and a wide portfolio of next\-gen high\-speed routers that leverage the newest Wi\-Fi technologies. Together, these technologies give ISPs the ability to manage and troubleshoot their networks in real time, and to deliver an outstanding customer experience. AXON Networks is a trusted strategic partner for its customers, helping them evaluate their current technologies and business models, and creating and executing strategies that enable them to innovate faster, accelerate their digital transformations, and strengthen their relationships with consumers. AXON Networks is headquartered in Irvine, CA USA with Asia HQ in Singapore and also operating in Denmark, Spain and Vietnam. The Network Operations Security Engineer serves as the designated Security Champion for Network Operations. The role translates enterprise security requirements, vulnerabilities, and threat information into actionable operational controls and coordinated remediation across production networks, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes\-based services, and device\-management environments. The engineer partners with centralized Information Security, Engineering, DevOps, NOC, and Support to reduce operational security risk without compromising service reliability or customer availability. This is an embedded, production\-focused security engineering role—not ownership of the enterprise information security program, not a general compliance analyst position, and not a replacement for Engineering or system\-owner responsibility to implement technical fixes. **Responsibilities** -------------------- ### **Security Champion and Information Security Partnership** * Act as the designated Network Operations representative in the Security Champions Council; communicate security requirements, emerging threats, standards, and priorities to operational teams. * Coordinate with centralized InfoSec on risk classification, remediation deadlines, escalations, exceptions, evidence, and technical guidance. * Promote security awareness, practical controls, and repeatable secure operating practices within NOC, Support, and Operational Excellence. ### **Production Vulnerability Remediation** * Assess how reported CVEs, scanner findings, misconfigurations, and exposures affect production network and infrastructure services; work with asset and service owners to confirm applicability and customer impact. * Coordinate remediation plans with Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Operations, and system owners; identify maintenance windows, dependencies, service risks, rollback requirements, and validation steps. * Track operational execution and provide verified closure evidence to InfoSec; escalate overdue or high\-risk remediation while avoiding a duplicate enterprise vulnerability tracking program. ### **Operational Security and Change Readiness** * Review production\-impacting designs, releases, and changes for operational security readiness, including access, network exposure, segmentation, logging, monitoring, recovery, and rollback. * Identify negative/failure scenarios and security\-sensitive operational dependencies; recommend controls and document residual risks for the appropriate approval authority. * Partner with Change Management and Operational Readiness functions to ensure secure deployment and post\-change validation. ### **Network, Cloud and Infrastructure Security** * Assess operational security posture of network devices, connectivity, management interfaces, cloud workloads, containers, Kubernetes, IAM, secrets, and service\-to\-service access within the supported environment. * Work with platform and network engineering owners to improve configuration baselines, privileged access, patching, network segmentation, telemetry, and resilience. * Help identify and reduce risk in CPE/device\-management workflows, remote management, firmware rollouts, and associated production services where applicable. ### **Security Incident Readiness and Response** * Participate in security\-related production incidents, supporting scoping, triage, containment, recovery, customer\-impact analysis, and evidence preservation under the enterprise incident response framework. * Coordinate NOC/Support/Engineering response and operational communications with InfoSec; support post\-incident reviews and ensure operational corrective actions are completed. * Improve security\-relevant alerts, runbooks, escalation paths, and operational response exercises. ### **Automation, Metrics and Continuous Improvement** * Partner with Operational Excellence and automation engineers to reduce manual security checks and improve security\-related monitoring and response workflows. * Maintain operational metrics for remediation execution, overdue actions, security change readiness, control coverage, and recurring security incidents; feed authoritative data into InfoSec reporting. * Drive lessons learned into monitoring, documentation, change procedures, and production **Required qualifications** --------------------------- * 5\+ years in network/infrastructure security engineering, production operations, cloud infrastructure, SRE, or a closely related technical role. * Strong understanding of TCP/IP, routing, DNS, TLS, firewalls, segmentation, access controls, and troubleshooting in production environments. * Practical experience assessing vulnerabilities, CVEs, exposure, risk, remediation planning, and validation; familiarity with vulnerability and cloud security tools. * Experience with production incidents, change management, rollback planning, operational readiness, and cross\-functional engineering coordination. * Working knowledge of cloud environments, containers/Kubernetes, monitoring/logging, and infrastructure security concepts. * Ability to communicate technical risk and operational tradeoffs clearly to Engineering, Operations, and Information Security. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Telecom/broadband/ISP, CPE, gateways, routers, ONTs, Wi\-Fi, ACS, TR\-069, TR\-369/USP, or fleet/device\-management environments. * GCP or OCI experience; Kubernetes workload security; IAM, infrastructure\-as\-code, CI/CD, or DevSecOps collaboration. * Familiarity with Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, Wiz, Orca, Prisma Cloud, Trivy, SIEM, or comparable tools. * Automation/scripting experience (Python, Bash, APIs); relevant certifications such as Security\+, CISSP, CCSP, or GIAC. **Success Measures** -------------------- * Timely remediation of Network Operations\-owned security actions within InfoSec\-defined targets. * Fewer repeat security\-related production incidents and unresolved operational exposures. * Security requirements consistently incorporated into production change and operational readiness reviews. * Improved security telemetry, runbooks, escalation readiness, and remediation validation. * Effective participation in the Security Champions Council and clear cross\-team accountability. ***This position is fully remote within North America. Please note that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.*** Annual salary range: $120,000 \- $175,000 USD Join AXON Networks! At AXON Networks, we promote equal opportunities in all our recruitment processes, ensuring non\-discrimination on the basis of gender, age, origin, disability, or any other personal circumstances. We assess talent based on objective criteria and foster an inclusive and diverse working environment. axon\-networks.com axon\-networks.hire.trakstar.com

jobs.title: Security Analyst
jobs.description: **Company Description** BCC Software develops innovative software and data solutions that power critical customer communications for organizations across North America. With more than 45 years of industry leadership, we combine deep postal expertise with modern technology to help our customers streamline operations, improve efficiency, and drive growth. **Job Description** The Security Analyst supports BCC Software’s cybersecurity program by defining, validating, and reporting on security controls to protect company assets and sensitive information and reduce cyber risk. This role uses recognized frameworks, third\-party audits, and defined service\-level agreements to guide security governance, operations, and continuous improvement. IT owns day\-to\-day system administration. Essential Functions * Strengthen identity security using Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, phishing\-resistant MFA, and Privileged Identity Management (PIM). * Integrate, deploy, support, and continuously improve security tools and the Microsoft security stack, including Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel and KQL, and Microsoft Intune security capabilities. * Oversee the managed detection and response (MDR) provider, including escalations, tuning, and service reviews. * Own the vulnerability and exposure management program, establish remediation SLAs, verify remediation evidence, and report status, exceptions, and risk trends. * Lead incident response and serve as the primary security contact during incidents; maintain playbooks, escalation procedures, tabletop exercises, and on\-call expectations. * Establish Azure cloud security guardrails for landing zones and oversee Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and related cloud security controls. * Own data protection controls through Microsoft Purview sensitivity labeling and data loss prevention for customer data and personally identifiable information. * Enforce the AI Usage Policy and govern risks associated with Microsoft Copilot oversharing, shadow AI, and SaaS discovery. * Manage third\-party and vendor security risk, including due diligence, recurring reviews, evidence collection, and customer security questionnaires. * Manage security ticket workflows for access reviews and phishing reports; define response SLAs and verify supporting evidence. * Create and maintain security documentation, including policies, the risk register, incident response records, and audit evidence. * Align the security program with NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2\.0, CIS Controls, SOC 2 Type II, USPS licensing security requirements, and cyber insurance attestations. * Validate ransomware resilience through evidence of immutable backups and recurring recovery testing. * Manage the security awareness training program and work across teams to reinforce security policies, controls, monitoring, and best practices. * Provide backup support for network, server, and cloud administration as needed, without assuming primary responsibility for routine administration. * Assist with security\-related budgets and purchases. * Serve as liaison with security and IT professionals at BlueCrest and Platinum. * Develop and manage security reports and dashboards for management. **Qualifications** * 5\+ years of cybersecurity operations experience or equivalent experience. * Strong understanding of secure network architecture and networking principles. * Knowledge of Windows, macOS, and Linux operating systems. * Hands\-on security experience with Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Azure, including Entra ID, Conditional Access, phishing\-resistant MFA, PIM, Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Intune security capabilities, Defender for Cloud, and Azure Policy. * Ability to review the security configuration and risk posture of network infrastructure, including Juniper and Cisco switches and Fortinet firewalls. * Experience supporting SOC 2 Type II audits, including control validation and evidence collection. * Familiarity with NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2\.0 and CIS Controls. * PowerShell scripting and KQL query skills for security operations, investigation, and automation. * Ability to respond quickly to critical problems and willingness to participate in an on\-call rotation. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to define security SLAs, evaluate evidence, report risk, and communicate requirements to technical and business stakeholders. * Understanding of adversary tactics and tooling (MITRE ATTACK; e.g., Cobalt Strike and Mimikatz) sufficient to detect, hunt, and validate controls. * One or more relevant security certifications are preferred, including Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC\-200\), Azure (metrics, logs, traces, alerts) that tells us whether the storage platform is healthy and where it is degrading * Build reporting, dashboards, and visualizations that give engineering and leadership a clear view into fleet health, capacity, and operational trends * Build system health tooling that detects failing hardware, drifting configuration, and capacity risk before they turn into incidents * Lead technical design discussions and produce clear design documents for changes that span multiple services and teams * Drive the implementation of large features from design through rollout, including the migration and backfill work that real systems require * Partner with the on\-call rotation to turn recurring toil and incident findings into automation and better signal **The Right frameworks or platforms that other engineers build on * Experience building large scale software systems running on thousands of servers * Experience building automation or tooling that other engineers depend on daily, whether internal platform services, operational tooling, or a deployment and configuration pipeline * Working knowledge of an observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK, Datadog, or equivalent), including instrumenting a service and designing alerts people trust * Strong Linux fundamentals and comfort operating in a bare\-metal or hybrid environment rather than a fully managed cloud * Professional experience incorporating AI\-assisted development tools (Gemini, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) * Comfortable with all aspects of the software development lifecycle, including design, implementation, testing, and rollout * Exhibits curiosity and seeks to understand before offering solutions * Communicates proactively in a remote environment by keeping the team informed, surfacing blockers early, and moving work forward * Applies analytical thinking to ambiguous problems **Bonus points for:** * Proficiency in Java * Experience with configuration management or infrastructure\-as\-code tooling (Ansible, Salt, Puppet, Chef, Terraform) * Experience designing SLOs and error budgets, or reducing alert noise on a fleet running at scale * Experience with time\-series databases and query languages such as PromQL * Experience automating hardware lifecycle work: burn\-in, failure detection, drive replacement, decommissioning * Experience with discovering and implementing performance improvements, including CPU and IO * Understanding of Linux internals and file systems * Familiarity with hard drive performance and optimization, including host\-managed SMR * Experience building and interpreting models, dashboards, or reports **Required for all Backblaze Employees:** * Good attitude and willingness to do whatever practices * Relentless attention to detail * Excellent interpersonal skills and good oral/written communication * Excellent troubleshooting and problem solving skills **Backblaze Perks:** * Healthcare jobs.title: Director, Full stack AI Engineer
jobs.description: What Makes Us a Great Place to Work We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the \#1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. Who You’ll Work With You will be part of a team building Bain’s integrated suite of agentic decisioning tools that gives large organizations always\-on intelligence across their most important growth decisions. The role sits at an intersection few organizations can offer: the analytical depth and client access of a top\-tier consultancy, the technical ambition of a product company, and engineering work at the frontier of applied AI. You will work inside Bain’s standing product team, building software that helps the world’s largest companies answer the questions that drive their business: where to invest, where to focus, and how to win. The impact of what you build is direct and immediate, and the platform compounds in value with every release. **The platform has two layers working together:** an agentic core and a set of decision modules, each solving a distinct commercial problem. The build lifecycle is connected to the real world: as case teams work alongside clients across industries and geographies, that feedback flows straight back to engineering and into the product. Every client engagement makes the platform smarter, broader, and more resilient. This is a startup inside an established company. You get genuine early\-stage ownership and real influence over architecture and product direction, backed by Bain’s global scale, client relationships, and leadership commitment; the pace of a startup with the runway of a global firm. We are looking for engineers who see how to make a product better and bring that instinct to every sprint without being asked, and who are comfortable with problems that do not have a known answer. The work involves real\-time decision engines, cloud\-native infrastructure, and data problems with no off\-the\-shelf answer. Experience with agentic systems matters: tool and context protocols such as MCP, evaluation harnesses, memory design, and entity resolution across messy enterprise data. This is applied AI in production, at scale, with real users depending on what you build. The field is moving quickly and the team is built to move with it, so the willingness to keep learning counts for as much as what you already know. Where You’ll Fit Within the Team The Full\-stack Engineer owns the build and operation of the product interfaces and backend services that surface Growth AI Performance System capabilities to users across the full suite: the dashboards, workflow tools, scenario planning interfaces, and output views that Expert Consultants, specialists, and senior client stakeholders use in live commercial engagements. This is a platform\-wide role within the Agentic Core and Interface team: you are building for all three product modules, not for one. You will work closely with the Design Lead and Designer on the front\-end, with AI Engineers on the integration of agentic and LLM\-powered capabilities into the interface layer, and with the Data Engineer on the data access and API layer that feeds what users see. You are responsible for the quality, reliability, and performance of the full stack: from the API surface that serves domain model outputs through to the React components that render them for users. This is also a people\-leadership role. You will be the line manager for a small team of mid\- to senior\-level engineers within the Agentic Core and Interface team, owning their day\-to\-day work, performance, and growth: running weekly check\-ins, serving as the point of escalation, writing mid\-year and annual performance reviews, and setting professional development plans that build the team’s fluency with AI\-assisted engineering practices. You will work across the platform and product modules focused on marketing ROI, brand, and pricing strategy, building interfaces that make complex analytical outputs navigable and credible for professional users who need to act on them quickly. The users of this product are sophisticated; the interfaces need to be fast, dense, and unambiguous. This role has direct client proximity. You will engage with consulting teams to understand how the interfaces are being used in live engagements, where performance or reliability is creating problems, and what engineering changes are needed. What You’ll Do Building and shipping product interfaces * Build and ship end\-to\-end product f ontext * Familiarity with design system implementation: able to translate design token specifications, component documentation, and interaction guidelines into engineering conventions that a team can build from consistently * Active use of AI\-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) to accelerate development, prototype faster, and raise the engineering productivity floor of the team Experience * 10 or more years in full\-stack software engineering roles with significant hands\-on building responsibilities across both frontend and backend * Direct experience managing a team of engineers: running performance reviews, professional development planning, and day\-to\-day people management, in addition to technical leadership * Track record of building and shipping production applications with data\-dense analytical interfaces that real professional users depend on * Experience leading the engineering implementation of a design system or component library across a multi\-feature product * Experience mentoring engineers and setting engineering standards within a team * Experience in client\-facing or consulting\-adjacent environments where interface decisions have direct consequences for how professional users trust and act on what they see is a strong advantage * Experience working in agile, cross\-functional product teams; strong troubleshooting and production issue resolution skills Education Associate’s degree / Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related technical field; or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience. U.S. Compensation Information Compensation for this role includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, 401(k) plan with an annual employer contribution based on years of service and Bain’s best in class benefits package (details listed below). Some local governments in the United States require a good\-faith, reasonable salary range to be included in job postings for open roles. The estimated annualized compensation for this role is as follows: * In Illinois, the good\-faith, reasonable annualized full\-time salary range for this role is between $196,000\-235,250; placement within this range will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to experience, education, licensure/certifications, training and skill level * In Massachusetts, the good\-faith, reasonable annualized full\-time salary range for this role is between $204,750\-$245,750; placement within this range will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to experience, education, licensure/certifications, training and skill level * Annual discretionary performance bonus * This role may also be eligible for other elements of discretionary compensation * 4\.5% 401(k) company contribution, which increases after 3 years of service and is 100% vested upon start date Bain \& Company’s comprehensive benefits and wellness program is designed to help employees achieve personal independence, protection and stability in the areas most important to you and your family. * Bain pays 100% individual employee premiums for medical, dental and vision programs, offering one of the most comprehensive medical plans for employees without impacting your paycheck * Generous paid time off, including parental leave, sick leave and paid holidays * Fully vested 401(k) company contribution * Paid Life and Long\-Term Disability insurance For all other locations, the good\-faith, reasonable annualized full\-time salary range for this role is commensurate with competitive geographic market rates for this role and will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to experience, education, licensure/certifications, training and skill level. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - CFA
jobs.description: Baker Hill builds commercial and small\-business loan origination software used by banks and credit unions. We’re building our next\-generation cash flow analysis product, and we need a Forward Deployed Engineer – Cash Flow Analysis (CFA) who can sit with bankers, understand how they actually spread and analyze C\&I and complex CRE lending, and turn that into working AI\-powered software. You’ll embed with customers and design partners, build and deploy solutions in their real environments with their real documents, and carry what you learn back to our product and engineering teams. This role combines credit analyst fluency with hands\-on technical skill. You can spread a rent roll and a borrowing base, and you can also ship code. **Essential Functions/Job Duties** * Embed with bank and credit union credit teams to observe, document, and improve how they spread financials, normalize statements, and calculate DSCR, global cash flow, and NOI\-based metrics * Build, configure, and deploy AI\-assisted workflows for document extraction, statement classification, spreading, adjustments, and narrative generation, then tune them against real customer data * Rapidly prototype solutions in the field (extraction pipelines, spreading templates, validation rules, integrations) and take the proven ones back to product and engineering for productization * Own technical delivery for pilots and design partner implementations, from kickoff through production, including data mapping, integration with origination and core systems, and customer enablement * Apply C\&I expertise: working capital and borrowing base analysis, EBITDA normalization and add\-backs, covenant testing, seasonality, concentration risk, and multi\-entity operating companies * Apply complex CRE expertise: rent roll and T\-12 analysis, NOI normalization, stabilized vs. as\-is underwriting, lease rollover and tenant concentration, construction and lease\-up projections, owner\-occupied vs. investor properties, and global cash flow across sponsor and guarantor portfolios * Build evaluation harnesses that measure accuracy, explainability, and auditability against analyst\-spread benchmarks, and report results to customers and internal teams * Identify edge cases (complex ownership structures, cross\-collateralized relationships, K\-1 flows, messy scans) and turn them into test sets, feedback for the AI team, and product requirements * Be the voice of the customer in roadmap discussions, with evidence from the field rather than opinion * Support sales and client success with technical demos, proofs of concept, and credibility in front of credit officers and executives * Stay current on credit policy, regulatory expectations, model risk management guidance, and competitive offerings **What Success Looks Like** * First 90 days: Learn our current CFA capabilities, architecture, and customers; shadow analysts end to end across C\&I and CRE; ship a first working prototype against real customer documents * 6 months: Lead one or more design partner pilots live in production, with a benchmark showing accuracy and analyst time saved * 12 months: Field\-proven AI capabilities folded into the core product, with a repeatable deployment playbook and satisfied reference customers **Who You Are** You’re a credit analyst who learned to code, or an engineer who learned to read a credit memo. You get energy from being in the room with the customer, you’re comfortable being handed a messy rent roll and a deadline, and you’re honest about where AI works, where it doesn’t, and where a banker will insist on checking the work. **Skills/Qualifications Required** **Required** * BA/BS in Finance, Lending Operations, Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field. * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience spreading financial statements and performing cash flow analysis in a bank, credit union, or lending environment, or in a fintech role directly supporting those workflows * Demonstrated specialization in both C\&I and complex CRE underwriting * Strong working knowledge of business and personal financial statements, tax returns, and cash flow methodologies (UCA, EBITDA\-based, global cash flow, DSCR, NOI\-based CRE analysis) * Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python preferred) and comfort with SQL, APIs, JSON, and scripting for data transformation and integration * Experience building or deploying software solutions in customer environments, such as implementation engineering, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or similar * Strong communication skills with both bankers and engineers, and the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to a chief credit officer * Willingness to travel to customer sites 50% * One\-hour SAFe overview; to be completed within the first 90 days of employment. **Preferred** * Hands\-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, retrieval, intelligent document processing, or ML evaluation * Experience with spreading software or loan origination and credit analysis platforms * Familiarity with bank security, data privacy, and model risk management requirements * Background in construction lending, SBA lending, or credit risk review * Experience in fintech or banking software * Formal credit training (RMA, credit analyst programs) or a degree in finance, accounting, computer science, or a related field * A recognized AI or AI platform fundamentals credential; or to be completed within the first year of employment **STANDARD REQUIREMENT** Use AI responsibly and in alignment with policy, including ongoing learning, and incorporate AI into routine tasks such as drafting communications, summarizing meetings, and organizing information. As the organization’s AI champion, this role is additionally expected to model that standard visibly, help colleagues meet it, and surface policy questions and risks rather than working around them. **This role is expected onsite if candidates live near Carmel HC office. Candidates should expect to extensive travel to and from client sites. Candidates must be able to commit to 50% travel to be successful in this role.** *Disclaimer:* *The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Management reserves the right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this position at any time as business needs evolve.*

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager
jobs.description: **JOB SUMMARY** =============== * Owns a major area of the BSWH AI use\-case roadmap and is accountable for translating customer jobs\-to\-be\-done into AI\-powered experiences that improve customer outcomes, operational efficiency, and business value. * Leads prioritization, roadmap development, requirements definition, launch planning, and success measurement for AI\-enabled capabilities across one or more customer journey areas. * Works closely with Digital, Journey, Clinical, Analytics, Data, Ontology, Architecture, Engineering, and Operations teams to define, deliver, and continuously improve AI\-powered customer experiences. * Ensures AI capabilities solve meaningful customer problems, achieve measurable outcomes, and are designed for safe, scalable, and reusable implementation across BSWH use cases. * Drives alignment across stakeholders while balancing customer needs, technical feasibility, operational constraints, regulatory requirements, and enterprise priorities. * Partners with AI platform and architecture teams to leverage reusable AI capabilities while maintaining accountability for customer and business outcomes within the assigned product area. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS OF THE ROLE** =================================== **AI Use Case Product Strategy \& Roadmap** ------------------------------------------- * Own the product strategy, roadmap, and backlog for one or more priority AI use\-case areas. * Translate customer, operational, and clinical problems into clear jobs\-to\-be\-done, product requirements, delivery priorities, and measurable outcomes. * Define success metrics and key performance indicators that measure business impact, customer value, adoption, engagement, satisfaction, and operational improvement. * Identify, evaluate, and prioritize opportunities where AI can create differentiated customer experiences or operational advantages. * Develop business cases and prioritization frameworks that balance strategic value, implementation complexity, risk, dependency management, and expected return. **Customer Outcomes \& Jobs\-to\-Be\-Done Ownership** ----------------------------------------------------- * Lead discovery efforts to understand customer needs, stakeholder requirements, operational workflows, and pain points that can be addressed through AI\-enabled capabilities. * Frame AI use cases as concrete customer jobs\-to\-be\-done and ensure each use case has a clear problem statement, target outcome, measurable success criteria, and responsible stakeholders. * Partner with customer journey leaders, clinical and operational subject matter experts, and analytics teams to validate that proposed capabilities address the right problems. * Ensure product decisions stay grounded in customer value, clinical/operational integrity, and measurable business impact rather than technology novelty alone. **AI Capability Definition \& Experience Design** ------------------------------------------------- * Define AI\-enabled product capabilities, workflows, agent behaviors, escalation paths, guardrails, and customer experiences for assigned AI use cases. * Translate strategy into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, success metrics, and delivery priorities that engineering and AI teams can execute against. * Collaborate with architecture and engineering teams to determine when solutions should use orchestration, retrieval, deterministic rules, personalization, automation, or human review. * Partner with design, research, and customer experience teams to ensure AI\-powered interactions are understandable, helpful, trustworthy, and aligned with BSWH experience standards. **Cross\-Functional Delivery \& Adoption** ------------------------------------------ * Lead cross\-functional collaboration across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Journey, Clinical, Analytics, Data, Ontology, Security, Privacy, Compliance, and Operations teams. * Manage roadmap tradeoffs across customer experience, speed of delivery, technical complexity, operational readiness, safety, compliance, and long\-term scalability. * Communicate product vision, roadmap priorities, delivery progress, risks, launch readiness, and outcomes to leadership and stakeholders. * Support launch planning, adoption, training, stakeholder readiness, and operational handoffs for AI\-enabled capabilities. **Evaluation, Measurement \& Continuous Improvement** ----------------------------------------------------- * Define expected AI behaviors, quality expectations, guardrails, and acceptance criteria in partnership with clinical, operational, technical, and AI quality stakeholders. * Partner with engineering, analytics, and AI quality teams to establish evaluation approaches, testing criteria, performance expectations, and feedback loops. * Monitor AI capability performance, adoption, customer outcomes, operational outcomes, and quality metrics to identify improvement opportunities. * Drive iterative improvement using customer feedback, evaluation   * Comfort operating in a regulated or high\-trust environment where safety, privacy, compliance, auditability, and customer trust are critical. **BENEFITS** Our competitive benefits package includes the following * Immediate eligibility for health and welfare benefits * 401(k) savings plan with dollar\-for\-dollar match up to 5% * Tuition Reimbursement * PTO accrual beginning Day 1 Note: Benefits may vary based upon position type and/or level**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS** ======================== **Education** ------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Business, Product Management, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Healthcare Administration, or related field. * Master’s degree preferred. **Experience** -------------- * 8–12 years of product management experience. * Demonstrated ownership of digital products, platforms, customer experiences, or technology\-enabled services with measurable business impact. * Experience managing complex cross\-functional roadmaps involving product, engineering, design, analytics, data, and business stakeholders. * Experience working with AI\-enabled products, machine learning systems, conversational experiences, personalization platforms, automation solutions, search experiences, recommendation systems, or decision\-support technologies. * Strong experience translating customer and business needs into structured product requirements, prioritized roadmaps, user stories, and acceptance criteria. * Experience defining and measuring product success using KPIs, customer outcomes, business metrics, usage analytics, and qualitative customer insights. * Healthcare, life sciences, financial services, or other regulated\-industry experience preferred but not required. **Required Technical Expertise** -------------------------------- * Strong understanding of AI\-enabled product development and modern AI capabilities, including where AI can and cannot reliably improve customer or operational outcomes. * Familiarity with concepts such as large language models, AI agents, orchestration, retrieval, personalization, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows. * Product ownership across the full lifecycle, including strategy, discovery, requirements, prioritization, delivery, launch, measurement, and optimization. * Experience working with APIs, integrations, enterprise systems, data products, analytics, and platform capabilities that support reusable product development. * Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, architects, data teams, analytics teams, clinical stakeholders, and operational stakeholders. * Strong analytical skills and comfort interpreting performance data, customer metrics, adoption trends, quality signals, and product outcomes. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ============================ * Experience owning AI\-powered customer experiences, digital assistants, conversational interfaces, recommendation systems, search experiences, workflow automation products, or decision\-support capabilities. * Experience applying Jobs\-to\-Be\-Done, customer\-centered design, design thinking, agile product development, or outcome\-based product management methodologies. * Familiarity with AI product evaluation approaches, including quality measurement, experimentation, benchmark definition, feedback loops, and performance optimization. * Experience operating in healthcare, life sciences, financial services, or similarly regulated environments involving sensitive data, safety requirements, auditability, and compliance considerations. * Experience launching products involving AI models, enterprise systems, APIs, cross\-functional delivery teams, and operational adoption requirements. * Experience working with product analytics, experimentation frameworks, customer research, behavioral insights, and customer experience measurement. * Strong ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across business, technology, clinical, operational, and executive stakeholders.

jobs.title: Mobile Software Engineer
jobs.description: At Benjamin Moore, we empower our team members to achieve their goals and make a positive impact in our communities. We offer a rewarding and inspiring work environment that fosters creativity, collaboration, and a strong sense of camaraderie. Our culture of excellence and transparency encourages our colleagues to bring their authentic selves and unique perspectives/ideas every day. With 140 years of rich history behind our brand, we know that our people are the driving force behind our success. We believe in investing in our colleagues by offering work\-life balance, competitive/ benefits, ongoing learning/continuing education, and skill development. Through a positive and engaging workplace, we facilitate growth, development, and fulfillment for all. Join us and be a part of a brand that inspires creativity, innovation, and passion in support of locally\-owned stores around the world. Click here to see how you can paint your future! **Job Summary** Benjamin Moore is currently seeking a Mobile Software Engineer with hands\-on experience building hybrid mobile applications using React Native for both iOS and Android to join our Digital Products team at our Corporate Headquarters in Montvale, NJ. jobs.title: Data Platform Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Berkshire Hathaway Homestate Companies, Workers Compensation Division, is looking for a Data Platform Engineering Manager to lead the team responsible for the organization's enterprise data platform and is accountable for its performance, reliability, security, scalability, and cost efficiency. This individual oversees the selection, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of the technologies that store, process, and move data across the organization. The position requires broad expertise across relational, NoSQL, and analytical data platforms, with responsibility for developing and strengthening these capabilities within the team. The Manager leads day\-to\-day platform operations, including 24x7 support and incident response, and ensures delivery through Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and GitOps practices aligned with the Autonomous Composable Development (ACD) model. **ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES** ------------------------------ ### **TEAM LEADERSHIP AND DEVELOPMENT** * Directly supervises Database engineers day\-to\-day direction, workload prioritization, performance management, 1:1s, and reviews aligned to the IC level framework. * Accountable for developing the team’s depth across relational, NoSQL, and analytical platforms, and for raising automation, IaC, and GitOps proficiency. * Accountable for closing the gap between defined standards and demonstrated team practice. * Manages on\-call rotation scheduling and escalation coverage. * Surfaces risks, gaps, and disagreements in writing at the time they are identified rather than after work is underway. * Resolves cross\-team blockers directly with peer leaders and escalates only what cannot be settled at that level. ### **DATA PLATFORM OWNERSHIP** * Owns the operational data store estate: OLTP and NoSQL across MS SQL, Cosmos, and equivalents. Recommends the right store for a given workload rather than defaulting to a single engine. * Owns transformation and data movement: ADF, Airflow, and the replacement of the HVR and SSIS approaches currently in place. * Operates the analytical data platform — OneLake and the Bronze, Silver, and Gold tiers — to the same standards as the relational estate. * Selects technology within each category, and is accountable for the reliability, performance, and cost of what is chosen. * Manages data platform cost, licensing, and capacity per organizational guidelines. ### **AUTOMATION AND DELIVERY** * Defines standards for GitOps schema management, IaC provisioning, and lifecycle automation. Authors and reviews T\-SQL, PowerShell, and IaC templates (Terraform, Azure DevOps) for database provisioning and schema deployment. * Accountable for moving the team’s work from manual execution to self\-service — including database change management through Liquibase or equivalent tooling, and the automation of environment refreshes. * Responsible for the team’s participation in cross\-team automation initiatives, including timely delivery of post\-configuration requirements, provisioning inputs, and integration constraints to partner engineering teams. * Champions Claude and LLM tooling for schema documentation, data lineage, query optimization, and automation; mentors engineers on advanced usage. ### **DATABASE OPERATIONS, RESILIENCE AND PERFORMANCE** * Remains hands\-on in the design, implementation, and administration of the data platform estate — Azure SQL, Managed Instance, SQL Server, and the relational, NoSQL, and analytical platforms adopted over time. Serves as the final technical escalation point for complex incidents. * Owns redundancy planning, high availability design, and failover execution across the estate, including Always On availability groups, geo\-replication, and tested failover procedures. Validates HA/DR through regular testing and drives remediation of single points of failure. * Defines monitoring standards on Dynatrace and oversees performance, availability, and capacity monitoring across the data platform estate. Leads complex performance tuning and bottleneck resolution. * Participates in the 24x7 on\-call rotation. Reviews post\-incident reports and drives remediation to closure. ### **STANDARDS, COMPLIANCE AND CROSS\-TEAM LEADERSHIP** * Implements and enforces enterprise data classification, PII handling, retention, and audit compliance requirements within the data platform estate; partners with Security on data security aligned with NYDFS Part 500 and SOC requirements. * Ensures team adherence to documentation and change management standards; reviews and approves change records before implementation. * Leads tooling evaluations and vendor assessments; coordinates with the Director on capacity planning, budgeting, and staffing. * Represents the data platform in cross\-functional work with DevOps, Application Engineering, Security, and Analytics, and resolves technical boundaries between teams directly. * Communicates technology trade\-offs and platform risk to Director and VP levels; authors aform, Azure DevOps, PowerShell). Experience automating database provisioning and schema deployment. * Clause or LLM usage for data engineering preferred. * Track record designing and operating data systems in regulated industries preferred. ### **TECHNICAL/FUNCTIONAL KNOWLEDGE** * Expert\-level SQL Server 2016–2022, Azure SQL, and Managed Instance. Working knowledge of Microsoft Fabric. * Familiarity with relational and NoSQL platforms beyond the Microsoft stack — Postgres, MySQL, Cosmos, Mongo — sufficient to evaluate and recommend the right store for a given workload. * ETL/ELT patterns and tooling (Azure Data Factory, SSIS, Fabric pipelines, HVR, Databricks) and medallion and lakehouse patterns. * Terraform, Azure DevOps, Git\-based workflows, PowerShell, and Python. Repository and GitOps fluency sufficient to review and direct the team’s IaC contributions. * Dynatrace monitoring. Advanced Claude/LLM usage for data engineering and automation. * NYDFS Part 500, SOC audit compliance, and PII handling. ### **LANGUAGE ABILITY AND COMMUNICATION** * Presents technology decisions and trade\-offs to Director, VP, and Analytics leadership. * Authors standards, runbooks, change records, performance feedback, and investment proposals that are clear, defensible, and financially grounded. * Communicates status, risks, and team capacity to the Director proactively and in writing, without requiring prompting. * Bridges technical data concepts and business outcomes for non\-technical stakeholders. ### **ON\-CALL REQUIREMENTS** This position is required to participate in a scheduled on\-call rotation. On\-call responsibilities include responding to critical incidents, system alerts, and operational emergencies outside of normal business hours. Active participation in the on\-call program is a mandatory condition of employment and will be evaluated as part of performance reviews. **WHAT WE OFFER** ----------------- * Work From Home Program (up to 2 days per week upon eligibility) * Modernized Historical Setting in East Sacramento * Free Lot Parking * Paid Time Off * Paid Holidays * Retirements Savings Match * Group Health Insurance (Medical, Dental, and Vision) * Hospital Indemnity Insurance * Life and AD\&D Insurance * Long Term Disability Insurance * Accident and Critical Illness Insurance * Flexible Savings Accounts * Paid Community Volunteer Day * Employee Assistance Program * Tuition Reimbursement Program * Employee Referral Program * Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Program *This pay scale is an estimate of the salary range the employer reasonably expects to pay for the position based on potential employee qualifications, operational needs and other considerations consistent with applicable law. The actual salary may be above or below the range. The pay scale applies only to this position and only if it is filled in Sacramento, California. The pay scale may be different for other positions or in other locations.* **ABOUT US** ------------ With more than 50 years in business, BHHC has grown from a regional organization to a national insurance group, offering insurance products from coast to coast. Relationships are the cornerstone of our culture, and we believe in doing the right thing. That means we invest in our business in every way possible to deliver on our mission and demonstrate that people are what powers our success. Our commitment to financial strength and integrity means our customers can rest assured that we will be there when it counts. At BHHC we embrace diversity and foster an environment where our people can be their authentic selves. Our differences make us stronger and better together, which fosters a harmonious workplace—something we truly value. We’ve created an approachable and collaborative atmosphere. Here you’ll find a welcoming workplace where everyone can feel valued, supported, and inspired to do great work. Together, we raise the bar by being curious, remaining customer\-focused, and operating with integrity.

jobs.title: Content Pipeline Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ We are seeking a **Content Pipeline Engineer** to design and implement reusable pipelines for extracting, structuring, indexing, and retrieving information from permitting documents, maps, and other unstructured content. The Content Pipeline Engineer will build document\-processing capabilities spanning OCR, document parsing, multimodal extraction, metadata enrichment, vector indexing, semantic retrieval, and agentic workflows. The role will support documents such as PDFs, scanned forms, well files, plats, survey drawings, maps, and legal descriptions and make their content available to downstream applications and AI services. This position is remote. **Duties \& Responsibilities** * Design and implement reusable ingestion and processing pipelines for PDFs, scanned documents, images, forms, maps, and other unstructured content. * Implement OCR and multimodal document\-processing workflows for both standard documents and map\-related materials. * Extract text, tables, metadata, identifiers, and domain\-specific attributes from source documents. * Support extraction of information from plats and survey drawings, including legal descriptions, labels, bearings, distances, and other spatially relevant information. * Develop document parsing, classification, normalization, chunking, and metadata\-enrichment processes. * Maintain linkage and provenance between extracted information, source documents, originating systems, and related business records. * Build document and vector indexes using OpenSearch or comparable technologies. * Implement embeddings, semantic search, and retrieval pipelines. * Develop APIs and reusable interfaces enabling downstream applications and AI services to search and retrieve document content. * Implement **agentic workflows** for activities such as document classification, extraction strategy selection, validation, exception handling, and quality assurance. * Establish confidence thresholds and human\-review processes for uncertain or ambiguous extractions. * Work with GIS engineers to connect map and document extraction results with georeferenced and vectorized geometry. * Work with Data Scientists to create evaluation datasets and measure OCR, extraction, retrieval, and classification quality. * Build automated testing, monitoring, and observability for document\-processing pipelines. * Optimize processing for accuracy, throughput, repeatability, and cost. **Educational Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field. **Requirements** * **5\+ years** of software engineering, data engineering, search, document\-processing, or related experience. * Strong Python development experience and experience building production\-grade data or content\-processing pipelines. * Hands\-on experience processing PDFs, images, scanned documents, and semi\-structured content using OCR and document\-extraction technologies. * Experience with document stores, search engines, or vector databases, including embeddings and semantic retrieval. * Experience with document parsing, classification, chunking, metadata enrichment, and preservation of source provenance. * Experience with **LLM\-enabled or agentic document\-processing workflows**, including extraction, validation, routing, or exception handling. * Experience building robust pipelines with automated testing, logging, monitoring, error handling, and quality controls. * Experience evaluating OCR and extraction quality using measurable criteria and confidence thresholds. * Strong problem\-solving skills for working with complex and inconsistent document formats. **Bonus Skills** * Experience with **OpenSearch**. * Experience with AWS document\-processing, AI, or machine\-learning services. * Experience with **agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar orchestration frameworks**. * Experience with multimodal models, vision\-language models, or LLM\-based document extraction. * Experience building RAG or enterprise semantic\-search solutions. * Experience with maps, engineering drawings, plats, survey documents, or legal descriptions. * Experience extracting bearings, distances, coordinates, or other geospatial information from documents. * Experience working in the **U.S. Federal Government space**. Experience with permitting, environmental, energy, land\-management, or regulatory documents. **Benefits and Salary** ----------------------- We attract the best people in the business with our competitive benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision coverage, 401k plan with employer contribution, paid holidays, vacation, and tuition reimbursement. If you enjoy being a part of a high performing, professional service and technology focused organization, please apply today!

jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Network Engineer** =========================== ### **Network, Security, Escalations, and Technical Leadership** **Department:** Service Delivery **Role Type:** Remote with client\-site support as needed **Reports To:** Service Delivery Manager **About Black Mountain Dynamics** --------------------------------- Black Mountain Dynamics secures, deploys, and supports IT infrastructure for startups, venture\-backed companies, and growing organizations. We partner with innovative clients to design, deploy, and operate reliable network, security, identity, and endpoint environments that support critical business systems. Our approach emphasizes security, performance, documentation, operational resilience, and high\-touch service delivery. As our client base grows, we are expanding our engineering team to support increasingly complex customer environments across multiple locations, platforms, and technical stacks. **Role Overview** ----------------- We are seeking a **Senior Network Engineer** who is passionate about networking, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and solving complex technical problems. This role serves as the senior escalation point for the Service Delivery team and owns the most complex issues across network, security, identity, endpoint, SaaS, monitoring, and client infrastructure environments. This role combines hands\-on technical engineering with service leadership. You will lead advanced troubleshooting, guide major incident response, support project execution, mentor Tier 1 and Tier 2 engineers, improve documentation and standards, and provide trusted technical guidance to clients and internal stakeholders. The Tier 3 Engineer is expected to raise the technical bar across the team by creating repeatable processes, improving operational visibility, reducing recurring incidents, and ensuring that technical work is completed securely, cleanly, and with strong documentation. Success in this role requires calm ownership, technical judgment, and cultural leadership. Tier 3 engineers are expected to model blameless problem solving, create leverage through documentation and standards, communicate clearly during pressure, and improve the team’s ability to prevent repeat issues. **Primary Mission** ------------------- **Own the hardest problems, lead escalations and security response, and raise the technical standard across the Service Delivery organization.** **Core Responsibilities** ------------------------- ### **Advanced Escalations \& Technical Ownership** * Own highest\-complexity escalations across network, security, identity, endpoint, SaaS, monitoring, and infrastructure issues. * Lead troubleshooting for complex, recurring, architectural, or security\-sensitive issues, ensuring the team understands the root cause, client impact, resolution path, and prevention opportunity. * Support Tier 2 engineers when tickets require deeper analysis, senior validation, architectural review, or risk assessment. * Provide clear escalation guidance, recommended next steps, and technical decision\-making under pressure. * Ensure complex tickets include strong documentation, impact analysis, troubleshooting history, and next\-action clarity. ### **Network Engineering \& Infrastructure** * Design, implement, troubleshoot, and support LAN, WAN, WLAN, firewall, VPN, VLAN, NAT/PAT, and segmentation environments. * Configure, install, and maintain routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, and related network infrastructure. * Lead network deployments, client buildouts, site changes, and infrastructure modernization efforts. * Use monitoring platforms such as PRTG, Unimus, and related tools to identify patterns, bottlenecks, outages, false positives, and repeat issues. * Review firewall policies, logs, routing, wireless health, ISP issues, and client\-impacting network events. * Provide senior review and sign\-off for firewall changes, network changes, and higher\-risk technical work. ### **Security, Incident Response \& Risk Reduction** * Coordinate incident response for critical security events, including stabilization, communication, containment, remediation, documentation, and follow\-up prevention. * Use tools such as SentinelOne, firewall logs, SIEM/monitoring platforms, and ticket history to investigate security events. * Conduct threat analysis, vulnerability review, and root cause analysis for security\-impacting incidents. * Identify systemic risks and recommend preventative controls, process improvements, or architecture changes. * Ensure secure execution through least privilege, documented change plans, rollback paths, and proper stakeholder communication. ### **Identity, SaaS \& Endpoint Escalation** * Provide senior support for JumpCloud, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, MDM, SSO/SAML, SCIM, JIT provisioning, and related identity workflows. * Troubleshoot SAML assertion errors, certificate issues, attribute mapping, provisioning failures, and authentication problems. * Support Apple  niper, Ruckus, Cisco, Aruba, Meraki**, or similar. * Strong working knowledge of monitoring and alerting tools such as **PRTG, Unimus, SIEM platforms**, or related systems. * Experience with security tools and processes, including EDR, firewall logs, vulnerability management, incident response, and threat analysis. * Experience supporting cloud identity and SaaS platforms such as **JumpCloud, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace**, SSO/SAML, SCIM, and MDM. * Strong documentation habits using tools such as **Hudu**, ticketing platforms such as **HaloPSA**, and internal communication tools such as Slack. * Ability to lead complex troubleshooting efforts and communicate clearly with clients, vendors, peers, and leadership. * Experience mentoring junior engineers or acting as a senior escalation point. * Ability to participate in on\-call, NOC escalation, after\-hours maintenance, or incident response as needed. **Desired Qualifications** -------------------------- * Certifications such as **CCNP, CCIE, CISSP, Security\+, Network\+, Palo Alto Certifications,** or equivalent practical experience. * Experience working in an MSP, MSSP, startup, or fast\-moving client\-service environment. * Experience with scripting or automation using **Python, PowerShell**, or related tools. * Familiarity with compliance or security frameworks such as **NIST, ISO 27001**, or similar. * Experience designing long\-term network, infrastructure, or cybersecurity strategies. * Experience leading technical projects, client buildouts, wireless deployments, firewall migrations, identity integrations, or security improvement initiatives. * Experience creating technical diagrams, RCA reports, SOPs, escalation playbooks, and operational standards. **Key Strengths for Success** ----------------------------- * Strong technical ownership and accountability. * Calm decision\-making during pressure or ambiguity. * Advanced troubleshooting and analytical thinking. * Ability to balance hands\-on engineering, client communication, and internal leadership. * Strong mentorship mindset. * Excellent written clarity through ticket notes, diagrams, SOPs, RCA summaries, and technical recommendations. * Comfort operating across multiple concurrent priorities, customers, and projects. * Security\-first thinking and disciplined change management. * Ability to create leverage through standards, automation, documentation, and process improvement. **Working Conditions** ---------------------- This is a remote role residing in the Pacific Time Zone. * Travel to client sites within the San Francisco Bay Area. * Occasional travel to additional locations within the United States. * Approximately **10–20% travel**, depending on project and client requirements. * Occasional evening or weekend work may be required for infrastructure deployments, maintenance windows, incident response, or urgent escalations. * Participation in on\-call, NOC escalation, or PagerDuty rotation may be required. **Benefits** ------------ Black Mountain Dynamics offers a comprehensive benefits package, including: * Competitive salary commensurate with experience. * Performance\-based bonuses. * Health, dental, and vision insurance. * 401(k) retirement plan with company match. * Professional development opportunities and certification reimbursement. * Paid time off and company holidays. * Flexible work arrangements where applicable. **Growth Opportunity** ---------------------- This role offers opportunities to grow into broader technical leadership positions as Black Mountain Dynamics continues to expand. Potential career paths include: * Senior Infrastructure Architect * Principal Engineer * Security Engineering Lead * Engineering Leadership or Program Leadership roles Engineers in this role will have the opportunity to influence infrastructure strategy, mentor other engineers, improve operational maturity, and contribute to the long\-term technical direction of the organization. Compensation Range: $125K \- $140K

If you’re looking for the chance to not just develop software, but to create a system that will make a difference, we need you on our team.
