This role requires strong technical expertise, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to work in a fast\-paced environment. **What You’ll Work On:** * Design, develop, and maintain high\-performance web applications using within Google and Amazon Cloud environments. * Integrate AI and ML components and services into the application architecture to drive intelligent data processing and user\-facing features. * Design, develop, and maintain high\-performance web applications using React for the front\-end and Python for back\-end services. * Architect and implement efficient Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) pipelines to manage data ingestion and processing, ensuring data integrity and system performance. * Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to translate complex requirements into functional, technical solutions with a high sense of urgency. * Build responsive, accessible, and intuitive user interfaces that meet the needs of our end\-users. * Develop robust server\-side logic, APIs, and seamless integrations with external systems using Python. * Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement initiatives to maintain high code quality. * Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications for performance, specifically focusing on database interactions with MySQL. * Stay up\-to\-date with emerging technologies and best practices in software engineering. Join us. The world can’t wait. **You Have:** * 8\+ years of experience with software development, including delivering full\-stack solutions * Experience with Python for back\-end development and API creation * Experience with modern front\-end development, and writing clean, responsive HTML5 and CSS * Experience designing and maintaining ETL pipelines for data\-heavy applications * Experience deploying and managing applications in cloud environments * Experience with security best practices for web and cloud applications * Knowledge of RESTful APIs, microservices, and web architecture supported by Git version control * Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced, Agile environment * Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust or Suitability/Fitness determination based on client requirements * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Systems **Nice If You Have:** * Experience building AI\-driven features using Gemini or similar LLMs, including prompt engineering, managing frontend API state, and optimizing production applications for streaming responses and latency * Ability to pay strict attention to detail and display a passion for learning new technologies * Possession of excellent problem\-solving skills * Possession of excellent communication skills **Vetting:** Applicants selected will be subject to a government investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements of the U.S. government client. \&\#xa;Skills Assessment\&\#xa;As part of Booz Allen’s skills first hiring process, candidates must complete the required skills assessment to ensure they meet the Basic Qualifications for this role. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. jobs.title: Senior DSP Engineer
jobs.description: Available in 2 locationsAvailable in 2 locations See allSee all **Senior DSP Engineer** ----------------------- Available in 2 locations Framingham, Massachusetts, United States of America Remote, Massachusetts, United States of America Category: Engineering Job ID: R29309 Brand: Bose Corporation, U.S.A Posted Date: October 19th 2026 widget: Full time **Description** --------------- At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer\-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound. Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation. **Job Description** =================== At Bose, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth. We bring together research, engineering, and a passion for audio to create experiences that people love. Join us to turn advanced signal processing into reliable, reusable technology that reaches products across multiple platforms and form factors. **Role Overview** We are seeking a **Senior DSP Engineer** to develop, port, optimize, integrate, and validate audio signal processing software for embedded platforms. You will independently own substantial DSP components or workstreams, taking algorithms from reference models through production deployment. You will turn MATLAB/Simulink models and research implementations into robust C/C\+\+ components that can be reused across audio products. The work combines practical DSP engineering, target optimization, and hands\-on integration, with an emphasis on audio quality, testability, and maintainability. This role is based onsite in Framingham, MA, working closely with algorithm, systems, firmware, hardware, and QA teams. You will learn and work within Bose’s proprietary audio technologies and collaborate with ML and ANC/ANR engineers as needed. **Key Responsibilities** * Implement, port, and validate DSP algorithms for embedded audio applications, translating reference models into production\-quality C/C\+\+. * Independently own DSP components from implementation planning through integration, verification, and release, while communicating progress, risks, and technical tradeoffs. * Develop modular, reusable processing blocks and integrate them into configurable audio chains and embedded frameworks. * Apply fixed\-point and floating\-point techniques, selecting appropriate numerical representations and validating behavior against reference models. * Profile and optimize compute, memory, latency, and real\-time performance on DSP and embedded targets such as Cadence HiFi, ARM, and Qualcomm Hexagon. * Build unit tests, reference test vectors, and automated regression tests, documenting numerical accuracy, audio behavior, and target performance. * Debug algorithm and system integration issues on reference and product hardware using lab equipment, debuggers, and profiling tools. * Collaborate with firmware engineers on interfaces, build environments, and integration dependencies, adapting implementations as requirements evolve. * Contribute to design and code reviews, maintain clear technical documentation, and provide guidance to less experienced engineers. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * 8\+ years of relevant DSP or embedded software development experience, with substantial hands\-on DSP implementation work. * Strong DSP fundamentals and practical experience implementing signal processing algorithms for embedded or real\-time systems. * Strong C/C\+\+ programming skills and MATLAB/Simulink experience for algorithm analysis, modeling, and validation. * Experience implementing fixed\-point and floating\-point algorithms and evaluating numerical accuracy and hardware trade\-offs. * Hands\-on development experience with at least one relevant DSP or embedded processor architecture, such as Cadence HiFi, ARM, or Qualcomm Hexagon. * Demonstrated ability to independently take DSP components through implementation, optimization, integration, and validation. * Strong debugging and profiling skills, with experience diagnosing performance, memory, and real\-time processing issues. * Experience with automated testing, version control, code reviews, and clear engineering documentation. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to work onsite in Framingham, MA. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master’s degree in a relevant engineering discipline. * Experience with audio DSP, including equalization, dynamics processing, filtering, sample\-rate conversion, spatial audio, or voice processing. * Processor\-specific optimization using SIMD/vector intrinsics or assembly, including Cadence HiFi, ARM Neon/Helium, Qualcomm Hexagon, or x64 SIMD. * Experience developing reusable DSP libraries and integrating low\-latency audio processing into RTOS or embedded Linux systems. * Experience with Embedded Coder or similar code\-generation tools, Python\-based validation, or continuous integration. * Experience deploying ML algorithms or partnering with ANC/ANR controls engineers. \#LI\-hybrid \#LI\-remote At Bose, you're inspired to be and do your best and are rewarded for your unique talents! Our compensation is thoughtfully tailored to your skills, experience, education, and location, and goes beyond base salary. The hiring range for this position in the primary work location of Framingham, Massachusetts is: $138,100\-$189,850\.The hiring range for other Bose work locations may vary.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;In addition to competitive base pay we offer rewards including bonus programs, comprehensive health and welfare benefits, a 401(k) plan, plus exclusive perks designed to support your wellbeing, and a generous employee discount where you can immerse yourself in our products and experiences. We are a proudly independent company—driven by purpose, guided by our values, and united by a belief in the power of sound. As the world leader in audio experiences, we’re creating what’s next—pushing boundaries and delivering transformative sound experiences for people everywhere. Join us and make your next career move a mic\-drop. Let’s Make Waves.

work with accuracy; reliability; resourcefulness; good judgment. * Ability to understand construction plans. * Ability to use a desktop computer, CAD software, and Microsoft Office. * Possess and maintain a valid driver’s license. **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:** * Coordination of research, planning, design, and other comprehensive materials needed for engineering projects and activities. * Operating AutoCAD, Civil 3D, other engineering software and Microsoft Office to create detailed drawings, plans, and specifications for civil engineering projects. * Directly supports the operations of the Engineering Department with routine projects to ensure familiarity with the full range of operating conditions. * Participates in the development of designs, plans, and specifications for projects. * Attend project meetings and contribute to discussions on project progress and challenges. * Perform field inspections as needed. * Interpret specifications for city, state, and federal requirements as needed. * Prepare periodic project status reports. * Provide performance and task analysis required to complete projects. * Assist in the collection and interpretation of survey data for engineering projects. * Interpret specifications and provide information on pertinent codes. * Work collaboratively with all levels of all departments in development and design. jobs.title: Director Cybersecurity
jobs.description: We are seeking a hands\-on Director of Cybersecurity to lead the design, implementation, operation and continuous improvement of Bridgewater Bank’s cybersecurity architecture, engineering, and technology controls. This role combines strategic leadership with direct technical involvement across Azure, Microsoft 365, hybrid infrastructure, identity, SaaS platforms, applications, APIs, integrations, automation, and defensive security technologies. The Director is responsible for developing, coordinating, and executing cybersecurity capabilities aligned to the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), including security architecture, identity and access management, security operations, threat and vulnerability management, incident response, and cyber resilience. The role leads the implementation and ongoing effectiveness of technology security controls designed to protect the bank's systems, applications, data, and customers. The position partners closely with the Information Security Officer, Internal Audit, Compliance/ERM, and technology and business leaders to ensure alignment between cybersecurity operations, governance, risk management, and regulatory expectations. The Director also leads technology control assurance activities, supports Internal Audit and regulatory examinations, coordinates control testing across IT teams, and drives timely remediation and closure of identified issues. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Lead technical architecture, standards, strategic roadmap development, vendor evaluation, and technology investment recommendations for Azure, Microsoft 365, hybrid infrastructure, SaaS platforms, web technologies, APIs, integrations, automation, and application enablement. * Own the technical strategy and control design for Microsoft Entra ID/Azure AD, identity and access management, Conditional Access, phishing\-resistant multifactor authentication, single sign\-on, SAML/OIDC federation, SCIM/JIT provisioning, privileged access, service identities, and joiner\-mover\-leaver lifecycle controls. * Lead technical cybersecurity incident response activities, including preparation, detection, containment, eradication, recovery, lessons learned, and coordination with the Information Security Officer and Bank’s Leadership Team. * Collaborate with IT teams and the Information Security Officer to design and implement comprehensive security strategies, including controls, monitoring, vulnerability management, and reporting. * Lead threat intelligence meetings and oversee the collection and analysis of relevant security information to proactively mitigate risks. * Define and operate a technology control testing program (design and operating effectiveness) aligned to NIST CSF; coordinate testing execution across IT and control owners and report results, themes, and remediation needs. * Manage technology audit and examination workflows, including coordination through Optro, remediation planning, issue tracking, validation of corrective actions, and closure reporting. * Manage penetration test reporting and governance: coordinate scoping and deliverables with providers, communicate results to stakeholders, track remediation, and ensure retesting/closure activities are completed. * Develop and deliver technology risk, controls, and audit status reporting to stakeholders including the Information Security Officer, CIO/CTO, ERM/Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, and management/Board\-level committees as applicable; escalate emerging risks and control gaps with clear recommendations. * Lead technical cybersecurity assessments of third\-party technology providers and partner with business and operational leaders to evaluate risk and implement appropriate security controls. * Serve as a technical resource for key security functions including access controls, data loss prevention, SIEM/SOAR, and cloud/network/endpoint security. * Own the technology audit readiness and response program, serving as the primary point of coordination for Internal Audit and regulatory examinations; manage audit/exam planning, walkthrough coordination, evidence collection/quality review, and timely delivery of responses. * Manage and maintain technology risk and security governance documentation, including policies, standards, procedures, control narratives, control evidence requirements, and audit\-ready artifacts. * Identify, report, and remediate vulnerabilities across networks, servers, and endpoints. * Manage security information and event management solutions for compliance and incident response. * Lead security technology initiatives and continuous improvement efforts across identity, detection, monitoring, data protection, security automation and defensive security platforms. * Partner with the Information Security Officer to support technical security education and awareness initiatives technology staff and employees. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * 8\+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, cloud or infrastructure engineering, enterprise r, Purview, Entra ID, Conditional Access, and related security technologies. * Demonstrated experience securing hybrid infrastructure, cloud platforms, SaaS applications, networks, endpoints, web applications, APIs, and related security technologies through architecture, monitoring, vulnerability management, and control implementation. * Strong understanding of security operations, threat intelligence, incident response, vulnerability management, penetration testing, security monitoring, SIEM/SOAR, and root\-cause analysis. * Demonstrated ability to develop technology standards, reference architectures, roadmaps, resilience strategies, configuration baselines, diagrams, runbooks while evaluating vendors, solutions and emerging technologies. * Experience supporting technology controls programs in highly regulated environments, including NIST\-based control frameworks, internal and external audits, regulatory examinations, issue remediation, and GRC tooling such as Optro. * Strong understanding of resilient architecture, business continuity, disaster recovery, backup protection, recovery testing, and security considerations for high\-availability services. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical issues into clear risk, business impact, options, and recommendations for technical teams, executives, auditors, regulators, and Board\-level audiences. * Industry certification such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, GIAC, Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect Expert, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent is preferred. **ABOUT BRIDGEWATER BANK:** Picture yourself at one of the Twin Cities’ best places to work, surrounded by people who challenge you, support you, and inspire you to be your best. Welcome to Bridgewater Bank. We’re on a mission to be the finest entrepreneurial bank in the Twin Cities. Like true entrepreneurs, we run fast and lean. We are in constant evolution and the runway for personal and professional growth is long. People are our strength, and that’s why we’ve created and sustained an award\-winning culture that promotes growth and celebrates the big and little wins along the way. At the end of the day, we believe competitive salaries, top\-tier benefits, a hybrid work model, and transparency into the business is a given. Working together toward something meaningful with people you enjoy is just a bonus! **COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS:** The typical annual base pay range for this role is between $144,500 \- $190,000\. Compensation may vary based on individual job\-related knowledge, skills, expertise, and experience. This position is eligible for a discretionary annual incentive program driven by organization and individual performance. Bridgewater Bank provides a broad offering of competitive benefits including (but not limited to): * Healthcare (medical, dental, vision) * Basic term and optional term life insurance * Short\-term and long\-term disability * Parental leave * 401(k) with employer match * Paid vacation \& paid holidays **PLEASE NOTE:** The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for this position. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. It is Bridgewater Bank’s policy to promote equal employment opportunities. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Intelligent Automation Architect
jobs.description: Our Company: BrightSpring Health Services Overview: BrightSpring Health Services is a Louisville‑headquartered leader in complementary home‑ and community‑based health services for complex populations, with integrated clinical and pharmacy solutions across care settings. Following its combination with PharMerica, BrightSpring operates a diversified care and pharmacy platform—serving patients and provider partners nationwide—which makes intelligent automation a pivotal enabler of clinical, operational, corporate, and pharmacy outcomes at scale. We’re seeking an **Intelligent Automation Architect** with deep expertise in **UiPath, Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI and AI\-powered business intelligence, Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, and Agentic AI**. This role will define target architectures, translate business opportunities into scalable solution designs, and lead solutions from concept and architecture through development, deployment, adoption, and measurable enterprise delivery. Responsibilities: **What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)****Architecture \& North Star Alignment*** Define the Intelligent Automation and AI North Star, target\-state architecture, platform strategy, and multi\-year roadmap aligned with enterprise priorities. * Establish secure, scalable, reusable, and supportable reference architectures, design principles, integration patterns, and technology standards. * Translate business capabilities and opportunities into architecture blueprints, solution options, process and data flows, nonfunctional requirements, and implementation roadmaps. * Guide the appropriate use of **UiPath, Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI and AI BI, Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure services, APIs, and Agentic AI** based on strategic fit, business value, complexity, risk, and scale. **Cross\-Team Architecture Collaboration*** Partner with business leaders, product owners, enterprise architects, security, data, infrastructure, operations, and delivery teams to shape priorities and align solutions with the North Star. * Lead discovery and architecture workshops to clarify outcomes, dependencies, risks, design decisions, and the responsibilities of each participating team. * Communicate architecture options, tradeoffs, and recommendations to technical and executive stakeholders, building alignment before delivery begins. * Mentor architects, developers, makers, analysts, and product teams; promote shared patterns, reusable components, and consistent engineering practices across platforms. **Delivery Governance \& Design Assurance*** Drive solutions from architecture through development, testing, deployment, adoption, and operational handoff while maintaining alignment with the approved design and North Star. * Lead architecture checkpoints and design reviews to verify security, integration, data, performance, responsible AI, maintainability, observability, and supportability standards. * Provide technical direction to delivery teams, resolve architectural risks and cross\-team dependencies, and govern design changes without becoming the primary developer for every solution. * Define production\-readiness criteria, monitor architectural conformance, and ensure delivered solutions achieve measurable outcomes and can be sustained at enterprise scale. Qualifications: **Required Qualifications*** **Bachelor’s degree** in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Proven experience architecting enterprise automation, analytics, copilot, and AI solutions from discovery and architecture through development, deployment, and operational transition. * Advanced knowledge of **UiPath**, including Studio, Orchestrator, queues, assets, libraries, Document Understanding, integrations, and enterprise deployment patterns. * Strong architecture and hands\-on prototyping experience with **Microsoft Power Platform**, including Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse, connectors, governance, and application lifecycle management. * Experience designing **Power BI and AI BI** solutions, including semantic models, governed data, dashboards, natural\-language analytics, and decision\-support use cases. * Hands\-on experience designing copilots and enterprise assistants with **Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio**, including grounding, plugins, actions, connectors, and security controls. * Strong knowledge of **Agentic AI** architecture, generative AI, model and tool orchestration, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, evaluation, responsible AI, and human oversight. * Demonstrated ability to lead end\-to\-end delivery, define success criteria, manage feasibility and risk, and produce implementation roadmaps, production\-ready solutions, and measurable outcomes. * Strong understanding of Azure services, APIs, event\-driven integration, databases, identity and access management, source control, DevOps, monitoring, and secure solution design. * Excellent architecture documentation, facilitation, problem\-solving, executive communication, and cross\-functional leadership skills. **Preferred Qualifications*** Experience architecting intelligent automation and AI solutions in healthcare, pharmacy, revenue cycle, clinical, or other regulated environments. * Experience with Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Fabric, Dataverse, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, CI/CD pipelines, and enterprise integration patterns. * Knowledge of process mining, task mining, intelligent document processing, OCR, and automation opportunity assessment. * Experience establishing reference architectures, centers of excellence, platform governance, reusable frameworks, and responsible AI controls. * Relevant certifications such as UiPath Solution Architect, UiPath Advanced RPA Developer, Microsoft Power Platform Solution Architect, Power BI Data Analyst, Azure AI Engineer, or Copilot Studio credentials. * Familiarity with technology evaluation, vendor assessment, architecture review boards, Agile delivery, backlog management, and production transition practices. * Ability to influence stakeholders, mentor engineers and makers, and turn emerging technology into pragmatic, governed enterprise solutions. About our Line of Business: BrightSpring Health Services provides complementary home\- and community\-based health solutions for complex populations in need of specialized and/or chronic care. Through the Company’s service lines, including pharmacy, home health care, and rehabilitation, we provide comprehensive and more integrated care and clinical solutions in all 50 states to over 475,000 customers, clients and patients daily. BrightSpring has consistently demonstrated strong and industry\-leading quality metrics across its services lines, while improving the health and quality of life for high\-need individuals and reducing overall healthcare system costs. For more information, please visit www.brightspringhealth.com. Follow us on Facebook, LinkedIn, and X. Additional Job Information: **Why Join Us?*** Shape the architecture for intelligent automation, copilots, analytics, and Agentic AI solutions that improve healthcare and business operations. * Work across UiPath, Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI and AI BI, Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure, and Agentic AI technologies. * Turn high\-value ideas into secure, scalable, production\-ready solutions with measurable enterprise impact. * Partner with business and technology leaders to establish reusable patterns, governance, and measurable business impact.

jobs.description: **Job Summary** The Fire Protection Engineer, Senior position is responsible for the preparation of detailed Building Code and Life Safety Code analyses and analysis of fire detection, mass notification and suppression systems. Bristol Alliance of Companies (Bristol) is committed to building lasting relationships that reflect our hard work, ingenuity, and dedication to safety. Every employee has an impact on our success, which benefits the Native Culture, land, and people of the Bristol Bay region. Our values: People, Communities, Reputation, Teamwork, Trust, and Truth. **Essential Functions** * Responsible for the preparation of detailed Building Code and Life Safety Code analysis and analysis of fire detection, mass notification and suppression systems. Prepare designs and plans using AutoCAD, Requests for Proposals (RFPs), specifications, and cost estimates, in support of in\-house and Architect/Engineer (A\&E) design bid\-build and design\-build projects, for a wide range of new or rehabilitated DoW facilities and infrastructure projects. Analyze existing buildings and building egress systems to determine adequacy of egress and construction type for existing conditions and proposed changes to buildings and building occupancies. Investigate and recommend corrective measures for deficiencies in existing facilities. Typical design projects include Naval Shore Facilities, including multi\-story offices and quarters, hangars, hospitals, towers, aircraft overhaul facilities, piers, training facilities and a very wide diversity of other new and existing structures and facilities. * Analyze the applicability of fire protection innovative processes, systems, equipment, or techniques and implement such on projects and specifications. Demonstrate knowledge of the latest fire protection systems and methods of construction. Prepare correspondence, engineering studies, and technical reports regarding fire protection and Life Safety related topics. Apply knowledge of detection and suppression system components and how such components are correctly installed or incorrectly installed. Communicate effectively issues to technician level personnel responsible for the installation, testing, and maintenance of fire protection systems and system components. **Competencies** * Knowledge of DoD and Navy guide specifications, criteria and policy, industry codes and standards, and standard practices as related to fire protection engineering design, including the Unified Facilities Criteria (UFC), National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) codes and standards, International Building Code (IBC), International Mechanical Code (IMC), International Residential Code (IRC), FM Global Loss Prevention Data Sheets, Society of Fire Protection Engineer’s Handbook, and various other industry standards. * Provides independent, timely and professional fire protection engineering support, services and consultation for the planning, design, construction and maintenance of facilities for the Navy, Marine Corps, and other Supported Commands, including minor works projects, specific projects, special projects, military construction (MILCON), demolition, maintenance, space utilization and facilities development. Participates in conferences with project stakeholders and collaborates with other engineering and architectural disciplines to ensure system coordination and integration with specific project requirements. * Typical projects include: fire protection engineering services for life safety, type of construction, height and area requirements, separation distances, fire rated construction, spray\-applied fireproofing, firestopping, sprinkler systems, fire alarm systems, mass notification systems, clean agent fire suppression systems, base\-wide fire alarm reporting systems, water distribution systems, hydraulic analysis, fire modeling, and performance based designs of major size and complexity for use in government facilities, including multi\-story office buildings, steam plants, hospitals, housing, manufacturing, training, and similar structures. **Required Education and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree from an ABET accredited Mechanical Engineering or Fire Protection Engineering program. * Minimum of 5 years of Fire Protection System design including at least 1 year working on Capital Improvement projects for a Federal Agency. * Valid driver’s license. **Preferred Education and Experience** * Registration as Professional Engineer (PE) in the discipline of Fire Protection Engineering is desired. * Experience with Microsoft Project. **Work Environment** The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Position may be subject to both inside and outside environmental conditions, noise sufficient to cause the worker to shout. * Position may be subject to a variety of physical conditions – proximity to moving mechanical parts, moving vehicles, electric current, working on scaffolding and high places, exposure to high heat or exposure to chemicals. * Position may be subject to atmospheric conditions – fumes, odors, dusts, mist, gases, or poor ventilation. * Position may be subject to close visual acuity to perform activities such as viewing a computer terminal and extensive reading. **Physical Qualifications** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. * Mobility: must be able to stoop, kneel, reach, walk, lift, grasp, feel, talk, hear, and perform repetitive motions. * Hearing: must be able to hear audible safety alarms. * Visual Acuity: must be adequate to perform above listed tasks in a safe manner and perform activities such as viewing a computer terminal and extensive reading. * Lifting: must be able to exert up to 50 pounds of force occasionally and up to 20 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. **Benefits** Excellent salary and benefits package to include paid time off, paid holidays, comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, life, short\-term disability insurance, and 401(k) plan with employer match. **Equal Opportunity Employer Statement** Bristol companies are equal opportunity employers and offer any available positions to all, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, parenthood, pregnancy, marital status, or changes in marital status, in accordance with applicable state and federal laws. This applies to recruitment, placement, pay, benefits, training, employment status changes, social and recreational programs, and other conditions and benefits of employment. Bristol grants employment preference first to BBNC and Choggiung shareholders, their spouses, or descendants, and second to Alaska Native Corporation shareholders in accordance with P.L. 93\-638\. **Disclaimer** This job description is not intended to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Other duties, responsibilities, and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice. This job description is not a contract or employment. It does not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. All employment with Bristol is “at\-will” which means that Bristol or employee can terminate the employment relationship at any time with or without cause. jobs.title: Real Estate Data & Intelligence Engineer
jobs.description: **About Build** --------------- AI for the Built World: Build has created the agentic AI stack for institutional real estate, automating complex development and acquisitions workflows 90% faster than humans to accelerate the world's most important built projects \- digital infrastructure, energy, industrial \- from concept to completion. Our mission is to accelerate and amplify the world's most important built projects \- inventing a better way to build through a collaboration between human experts and agentic AI. We envision a future where the world's buildings are driven from concept to completion, autonomously. Without delays, cost, and complexity. Enabling people to deliver a magnitude more deals. To make decisions, build relationships and create. To start, we're partnering with the world's biggest built world institutions from $T alternative assets investors, prolific developers and even governments to push the frontier of what's possible. We're backed by c\-suite from Blackstone and OpenAI alongside the world's best venture capital firms. Join us in shaping the future of the Built World and exponentially accelerate your career in the process. We welcome you to do your life's work here. **About the role** ------------------ A database gives you information. Build should tell you what it means and what to do next. Every site Build validates \- power capacity, energisation date, zoning, title, comparables \- depends on pulling together data that lives in hundreds of fragmented sources: parcel and title records, planning and zoning portals, grid and utility data, transaction comps, geospatial layers. This role owns turning that mess into a single, trusted picture of every site and asset, and building the intelligence that sits on top of it. You'll work alongside our geospatial team and our domain experts to decide which sources matter, connect and cross\-reference them, catch inconsistencies and hidden assumptions, and turn the result into answers our AI and our clients can act on. **What you will own** --------------------- * The real estate data layer: ingesting, cleaning, linking and cross\-referencing property, land, power, planning and market data sources into one record per site and asset * Entity resolution and data quality: matching parcels, owners, titles and addresses across sources, and flagging conflicts and gaps before they reach a decision * The intelligence on top: comps selection, valuation and NOI inputs, distress and pricing\-gap signals, and risk and red\-flag detection that our AI workflows and experts use * New sources: finding, evaluating and onboarding the data that makes Build's site validation faster and more accurate than anyone else's * The speed, reliability and coverage of all of the above as Build expands into new markets **Who this might be** --------------------- * A data engineer or data scientist at a real estate data company who has stitched together property records at scale * An engineer on a research, analytics or data team at a brokerage, investor or advisory firm who wants to build rather than report * A geospatial or ML engineer who has built valuation or site selection models on messy real\-world data * Typically a CS, data engineering or similarly technical background, with a few years of experience and a real curiosity about how the built world gets valued and built **How to win at Build** ----------------------- Growing Build requires a radically different approach to company building. As a company we're focused on one outcome: winning. That means we move fast, work with intensity, and demand excellence from ourselves. We operate with intensity but create an environment that allows for a lot of fun together. The result is that we're one of the fastest shipping teams in vertical AI, partnering with the best to automate the world around us. Performance and teamwork are the core of Build's operation. We look for those who are able to do both, who often exhibit a particular ability for; Velocity: You are relentless in asking the right questions to set direction. Once you find the right direction you go all\-in. Excellence: You obsess with being the best. For you, excellence is a non\-negotiable standard rather than an aspiration. Long time horizons: You choose to be in something for the long run, because that's where most of the returns are realized. Ownership: You take full ownership of the outcomes. You're meticulous in your pursuits and believe you can actively shape your environment rather than adapt to it. Customers: You have a passion for the built world and those who shape it. You probably have a quirky hobby or story that relates to your love for building. Integrity: You chose to do the right thing even when it isn't easy. Trust: You only work with people you can trust because it's the only way to do truly extraordinary things. Yield: You have a burning need to see a result on every action you take and you're always looking for routes to do more with less. **What we offer** ----------------- Radical autonomy, real ownership: High standards. Minimal bureaucracy. You own problems end\-to\-end, choose how the work gets done, and are accountable for exceptional outcomes. Ownership is matched with meaningful, generous equity. An accelerated founder's track: Build is for builders. If you want to learn what it actually takes to create a generational company \- Product judgment, execution speed, and accountability \- there is no faster path than building from zero when everything is for grabs. Elite teammates, uncompromising bar: You work with people who think clearly, execute relentlessly, and take full ownership. The team you build becomes the company you build. Growth here is not just professional; it reshapes how you operate and in return how Build operates. Perpetual adventure: We attract the strongest of the strange. Extraordinary experiences are part of the culture \- from the food we eat together to the space we occupy. Intensity is intentional. Shape the built world: We are rebuilding how the physical world gets made. Our software doesn't live in the abstract \- it turns into real projects breaking ground because we exist. We work with the largest institutions, push the frontier of AI, and watch our decisions translate directly into the world around us. Compensation Range: $120K \- $180K

jobs.title: Infrastructure, Senior Engineer
jobs.description: The Senior Engineer, Infrastructure position is core to the implementation and support of all infrastructure including servers, storage, email, telecom, backup, and data centers both on premise and external, network, servers both physical and virtual, storage, firewalls, email, security, mobile devices, back\-ups, business continuity / disaster recovery, operations automation, and documentation. The Senior Engineer, Infrastructure will work with Technology Services senior staff and leadership in the identification of technology needs, design of solutions, vendor management, the project life cycle for the installation of new and upgrading of existing technology, development of better practices around security, policy and procedures, quality assurance, monitoring, metrics, and documentation. This position will work closely with the entire Technology team and serve as the lead for the infrastructure group on Technology and company technology projects Working in a team, you will work to ensure our business operations continue to run by working to ensure system uptime is maintained and new projects are implemented. *Key Responsibilities* * Lead infrastructure initiatives including new installations, upgrades, and ongoing support for servers, storage, firewalls, email systems, telecommunications, backup solutions, data centers, mobile devices, and business continuity/disaster recovery programs. * Evaluate, implement, and support new and emerging technologies while maintaining and optimizing existing infrastructure to ensure reliable service delivery across all enterprise platforms. * Architect, administer, document, and maintain on\-premises, hosted, and cloud\-based infrastructure environments in alignment with established technology standards. * Collaborate with IT support teams and leadership to resolve operational issues, fulfill service requests, and support incident resolution activities. * Design, implement, and maintain monitoring and reporting solutions to ensure visibility into infrastructure performance, capacity, availability, and network utilization. * Conduct system testing, validate infrastructure changes, and provide quality assurance for newly deployed and existing technology solutions. * Develop and maintain processes, procedures, and documentation related to backups, patch management, security updates, mobile device management, data retention, and data center operations. * Establish and maintain infrastructure standards, policies, governance processes, performance metrics, and security practices to ensure operational excellence and compliance. * Provide technical leadership, create and maintain system documentation, support special projects, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. *Experience \& Qualifications* * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. * Experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise technologies including Fortinet, VMware, Barracuda, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Cisco networking, VoIP systems, Veeam, Windows Server, Linux, data centers, and infrastructure monitoring solutions. * Strong systems administration, infrastructure engineering, troubleshooting, and technical documentation skills; industry certifications are a plus. * Demonstrated ability to learn, implement, and support new technologies while maintaining existing enterprise applications and infrastructure. * Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills with strong attention to detail and a sense of urgency. * Effective verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Proven ability to work collaboratively in a team environment, contribute to cross\-functional initiatives, and support continuous learning and professional development. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: The Hospital and Healthsystem Association of Pennsylvania (HAP) is seeking candidates for a Data Engineer in our Strategic Analytics Department. The primary responsibilities of this role are to support HAP’s Strategic Analytics team in building and maintaining reliable, analytics\-ready data infrastructure that enables organizational reporting and informed decision\-making. Working under the guidance of experienced analytics professionals, this entry\-level position assists in the development and maintenance of data pipelines, database objects, technical documentation, and data quality controls across a wide range of data sources including health care, financial, operational, workforce, survey, and other datasets. Candidates for consideration must have a bachelor’s degree in computer science, data engineering, information systems, data science, analytics, engineering, mathematics, statistics, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and technical training. Candidates will have up to two years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, database development, software development, or a related technical role. Relevant internships, cooperative education experience, academic projects, or substantial independent project work may be considered in lieu of professional experience. Experience in health care is preferred but not required. Successful candidates will demonstrate foundational knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts, familiarity with Python or other programming and scripting languages, exposure to database and ETL technologies such as SQL Server, Azure SQL, SSIS, and Azure Data Factory, experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools, particularly Power BI, and familiarity with version control systems such as Git. Candidates must possess strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, excellent attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy, effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate successfully with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders in a team\-oriented environment. HAP offers a generous benefit package (medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, LTD, EAP, tuition reimbursement, FSA, Health Savings Accounts, 401(k) with immediate vesting, wellness programs, professional development, travel accident, vacation, sick, discount programs, work\-life balance, flexibility) and competitive pay. This is a hybrid position. Our office is located in Harrisburg, PA. EEO Employer F/M/veterans/disabled are encouraged to apply. For more information please visit: https://www.haponline.org/About\-HAP/Careers To apply, please send your resume to Kmccoy@haponline.org, or mail to The Hospital and Healthsystem Association of Pennsylvania, Attn: Kim McCoy, 30 North Third Street, Suite 600, Harrisburg, PA 17101\. Job Type: Full\-time Work Location: In person

jobs.title: System Admin, Windows (I, II, III, or IV)
jobs.description: **Our Vision: Be the best at what we do. Our Mission: Improve lives through technology.** **Summary:** “Customer Inspired” isn’t our slogan — it’s our driving force, and C Spire team members live it. We aim to engage the exceptional and embrace operational excellence to best deliver connectivity and technology solutions that advance our communities and customer’s lives. It’s a challenging goal, but we have a winning team that is looking to grow. Help keep the Microsoft infrastructure behind C Spire’s cloud, data center, and enterprise environments reliable and secure. Depending on your experience, you’ll contribute to or lead administration work across Windows systems, identity, virtualization, and Azure—including the foundations that support AI workloads. This role is open at Levels I through IV, with scope and technical leadership aligned to the level of hire.**Responsibilities:** **What You Will Do** In all of your duties, you will have a relentless, obsessive, yet disciplined approach to manage all details to perfection and deliver desired results. * Design, build, and operate cloud, data center, and enterprise Windows systems, progressing from implementation under senior guidance at Level I to architecture and delivery across multiple projects at Level IV. * Administer supported server, identity, endpoint, productivity, cloud, virtualization, and virtual desktop environments, including Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Office 365, Exchange, Azure, VMware vSphere, KVM, VMware Horizon, and Citrix. * Install, upgrade, patch, test, monitor, and troubleshoot systems; provide technical support, participate in on\-call coverage, and document findings and actions when escalating issues. * Identify risks before they affect customers, investigate incidents, and drive lasting fixes—with responsibility for complex escalations and systemic improvements increasing at senior levels. * Build and secure the Windows, identity, and Azure foundations for AI workloads in partnership with AI and data teams, applying appropriate access, logging, and data\-handling controls. * Use, develop, and ultimately set build, deployment, and automation standards; apply PowerShell, DSC, and Ansible, with Python used in senior\-level engineering work. * Use AI\-assisted tools for appropriate engineering, troubleshooting, and documentation tasks, verify their output before use, and establish team review practices at Level IV. * Design for high availability, backup, and disaster recovery, and apply established security and quality practices—defining cross\-team controls and standards at Level IV. * Collaborate with business analysts, product development, implementation, support, vendors, and other teams to deliver effective service and make sound technical decisions. * Grow technical ownership by sharing knowledge and improving a supported technology at Level II, leading designs and mentoring engineers at Level III, and setting technical direction and developing engineers across the team at Level IV. This role offers room to deepen your technical expertise and broaden your ownership as you advance through the engineering levels. jobs.title: APPLICATION DEVELOPER III
jobs.description: JOB PURPOSE: The Application Developer III supports the building of the organization's multi\-tenant healthcare SaaS platform on Microsoft Azure. The platform serves multiple enterprise clients and supports daily operations, including member enrollment and eligibility checks, scheduling, care\-coordination workflows, document management, configurable forms and assessments, letters, reporting, and team communication. The role helps ensure each tenant's data remains strictly isolated and supports secure data exchange with payers and other vendors through APIs and integrations. The position contributes across the whole stack, including APIs, databases, front\-end, cloud infrastructure, and AI features, while setting technical standards for the development team. This senior full\-stack development role supports the advancement of a rapidly growing healthcare platform that is in active development. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: Build features end to end. The back end is an ASP.NET Core API that uses CQRS with MediatR, FluentValidation, and EF Core. The front end is TypeScript, built with React Native for Web (Expo), Redux Toolkit, and RTK Query. Drive the implementation and evolution of our multi\-tenant architecture, with strict data isolation between tenants, strong access controls, and efficient use of resources. Build secure, versioned REST APIs with:Microsoft Entra ID / JWT authentication role\- and capability\-based access control field\-level permissions checks that a user may access each specific record audit logging that meets HIPAA requirements Build and maintain integrations: X12 EDI 270/271 eligibility, e\-signature, contact\-center phone systems, SFTP file exchange, and Microsoft Graph. These run on Azure Service Bus, Azure Functions, and background services. Extend the platform's workflow automation engine, which runs on events and schedules and is built on Durable Task. Work on real\-time features (SignalR) for notifications, chat, and live updates. Build AI features with Azure OpenAI, keeping PHI exposure to a minimum and a person in the loop:an assistant that can call tools document search that answers with citations (Azure AI Search) AI sorting of incoming documents live speech transcription (Azure Speech) that suggests form answers for a user to accept Design SQL Server schemas with our data team, write and tune complex queries, and fix EF Core performance problems on large tables. Ship through GitHub Actions to Azure: container images on App Service (via Azure Container Registry), Azure Functions and Azure Static Web Apps, monitored with Application Insights. Review code, mentor junior and mid\-level developers, and raise the bar on testing (xUnit, Moq, Jest, React Testing Library), documentation and architecture. Work closely with product owners, the data team, and other engineers in an Agile team: sprint planning, stand\-ups, backlog refinement, and retrospectives. Solve hard production problems anywhere in the stack, from slow screens and query plans to authorization failures and Azure configuration. Schedule: 8:30AM – 5:30PM Weekly Hours: 40 Location: On\-Site, 136\-65 37th Avenue, Flushing, NY 11354 QUALIFICATIONS: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field. Required Skills \& Experience Backend 7\+ years building production systems with C\# and ASP.NET Core, including large\-scale, distributed systems. Strong REST API design and security: OAuth 2\.0 / OpenID Connect, JWTs, API keys, validation, error handling, and versioning. You know how to prevent unauthorized record access (IDOR) and leaking internal details in error messages. Strong SQL Server skills: schema design, complex queries and stored procedures, indexing, execution plans and tuning for high data volumes. Production experience with Entity Framework Core, including mapping to existing database\-first schemas, query performance, and migrations. Experience with clean, layered architectures: CQRS/MediatR, repository and unit\-of\-work patterns, dependency injection. Frontend 5\+ years with React: function components and hooks, state management with Redux Toolkit / RTK Query or similar, and performance tuning for large, data\-heavy applications. Expert TypeScript and modern JavaScript (ES6\+), including async patterns. Responsive, accessible UI built on a shared design system and utility CSS such as Tailwind. Experience connecting complex APIs to the UI: loading, error, and permission states, real\-time updates, and server\-side paging, sorting, and filtering. Azure Hands\-on experience with Azure App Service (including container deployments), Azure SQL, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Blob Storage, and Key Vault. Microsoft Entra ID sign\-in and authorization for web apps and APIs. Monitoring and troubleshooting with Azure Monitor and Application Insights. Familiarity with Docker and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions preferred). AI Experience shipping LLM features in production apps, ideally on Azure OpenAI: prompt des tegration and end\-to\-end testing. Swagger/OpenAPI and API tools such as Postman. Expert Git skills in a branch\-and\-pull\-request workflow. Front\-end tooling such as npm/pnpm and modern bundlers (Metro, Webpack, or Vite). Preferred Qualifications: Proven track record of building and deploying complex multi\-tenant SaaS applications at scale. React Native and Expo, especially React Native for Web; NativeWind and Gluestack UI. Healthcare experience: HIPAA, PHI handling, Medicaid/Medicare eligibility, X12 EDI (270/271\), HL7 or FHIR. Workflow and messaging systems: Durable Task / Durable Functions, Service Bus, outbox and idempotency patterns. Real\-time applications with SignalR. Azure AI Search, Azure AI Speech, or document\-processing and PDF\-generation pipelines. Python for automation, data processing, or AI/ML work. Experience leading Agile ceremonies or improving team processes. Open\-source contributions or active involvement in technical communities. Soft Skills Excellent problem\-solving and debugging skills; you find the root cause, not just the symptom. Clear written and spoken communication with both technical and non\-technical people. A natural mentor who builds a collaborative, supportive, high\-performing team. Self\-motivated and always learning, including new technologies and the healthcare domain. Able to influence technical decisions and drive best practices across the team. Physical Requirements Individuals must be able to sustain specific physical requirements essential to the job. This includes, but is not limited to: Standing – Duration of up to 6 hours a day Sitting/Stationary Positions – Sedentary position for a duration of up to 6\-8 hours a day for consecutive hours/periods. Lifting/Push/Pull – Up to 50 pounds of equipment, baggage, supplies, and other items used in the job scope using OSHA guidelines, etc. Bending/Squatting – Have to be able to safely bend or squat to perform the essential functions under the scope of the job. Stairs/Steps/Walking/Climbing – Must be able to maneuver stairs safely, climb up/down, and walk to access work areas. Agility/Fine Motor Skills \- Must demonstrate agility and fine motor skills to operate and activate equipment, devices, instruments, and tools to complete essential job functions (i.e., typing, use of supplies, equipment, etc.) Sight/Visual Requirements – Must be able to read documentation, papers, orders, signs, etc., and accurately type/write documentation, etc. Audio Hearing and Motor Skills (Language) Requirements – Must be able to listen attentively and document information from patients, community members, co\-workers, clients, providers, etc., and intake information through audio processing with accuracy. In addition, one must be able to speak comfortably and clearly with language and motor skills for customers to understand an individual. Cognitive Ability – Must be able to demonstrate good decision\-making, reasonableness, cognitive ability, rational processing, and analysis to satisfy essential functions of the job. **Disclaimer:** Responsibilities and tasks outlined in this job description are not exhaustive and may change as determined by the needs of the company. jobs.title: Hardware Infrastructure Engineer II
jobs.description: CLEAR is building THE secure identity company of the future. Our mission is to make experiences safer and easier—physically and digitally. With more than 43 million Members and a growing network of partners across the world, CLEAR's secure identity platform is transforming the way people live, work, and travel. Whether it's at the airport, stadium, or throughout your everyday life, CLEAR unlocks the magic of frictionless experiences. As CLEAR continues to expand its identity platform across physical and digital environments, our network of kiosks and connected devices forms the backbone of our member experience. Ensuring these systems stay secure, reliable, and always available is mission\-critical, and that's where you come in. We're looking for a Platform Engineer to join our Hardware Operations and Platform Engineering team. You'll be sitting at the intersection of Site Reliability Engineer and Embedded Systems Integration. You'll be architecting and maintaining the software layer that keeps thousands of Linux\-based kiosks online, healthy, and self\-healing, effectively operating a distributed server fleet at the edge. You'll own everything from OS image management to over\-the\-air (OTA) updates, device observability, and system recovery, while ensuring our biometric kiosks deliver a consistent, frictionless experience to every traveler, every time. ### ***What You Will Do*** * Architect and implement OS\-level watchdogs, process monitors, and self\-healing mechanisms to ensure devices automatically recover from failures (service restarts, reboots, or rollbacks). * Manage and enhance our OTA update framework to enable safe, atomic updates via A/B partition swapping and automated rollback when needed. * Develop and maintain Python\-based services that interact with connected peripherals (payment terminals, scanners, sensors) via vendor SDKs and serial interfaces. * Own and maintain our custom Linux image (via Yocto, Buildroot, bootc, rpm\-ostree, etc), managing systemd units, udev rules, and security policies for a locked\-down, production\-grade environment. * Build lightweight monitoring agents to stream logs, metrics, and telemetry (connectivity, performance, temperature) to centralized observability systems such as Datadog or Splunk. * Work closely with software, SRE, and field operations teams to identify pain points and develop scalable solutions that improve reliability and ease of maintenance. ### ***Who You Are*** * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience administering embedded Linux systems * Strong proficiency in Python for system automation, service orchestration, and hardware communication. * Familiarity with A/B update mechanisms (RAUC, Mender, SWUpdate, or custom partition\-switching logic). * Experienced in serial communications (UART, RS\-232, USB\-serial) and SDK\-based hardware integration. * Deep knowledge of service dependencies, timers, and watchdog configuration. * Familiarity with network observability and remote device management at fleet scale. * Committed to operational excellence, focused on designing for resilience, testability, and safe rollback. * Collaborative, pragmatic, and curious; equally comfortable debugging a kiosk in the field or improving CI/CD for edge devices. ### ***Why You'll Love This Role*** * Massive impact: Your work ensures millions of travelers experience CLEAR's identity platform without disruption. * Unique technical challenge: Operate and scale a distributed edge infrastructure at the intersection of IoT and reliability engineering. * End\-to\-end ownership**:** From OS image to telemetry pipeline, you'll own the full stack of machine reliability. * Collaborative culture: Deep cross\-functional partnership with engineering and operations experts to create frictionless identity experiences. * Continuous learning: Work on modern Linux, OTA updates, and observability systems at enterprise scale. ### ***How You'll be Rewarded:*** At CLEAR, we help YOU move forward \- because when you're at your best, we're at our best. You'll work with talented team members motivated by our mission of making experiences safer and easier. Our offices are bright and energetic with an open concept and plenty of conference rooms and casual co\-working spaces. We also offer catered lunches every day and have fully stocked kitchens. Outside of the office, we invest in your well\-being and learning \& development with stipends and reimbursement programs. jobs.title: Production Engineer II
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. ### **Start Your Infrastructure Career at the Center of the AI Buildout** This is an entry point into Production Engineering, not a stepping\-stone support role. You'll be one of the engineers keeping a multi\-billion dollar, rapidly scaling AI cloud business online, from every GPU cluster to every customer workload and every SLA, while you build the foundational skills that turn into a Senior and Staff\-level infrastructure career. We're hiring several Production Engineer II roles as we build out the next generation of our reliability organization. We'll determine which team is the best fit for you after the interview process, based on your background, interests, and where your strengths line up with our needs. The work ranges from broad, cross\-domain operations to deeper specialization in compute, storage, or networking, depending on the team. **What You'll Work On** * Triage and resolve production incidents: parse logs, correlate signals across services, and drive issues to root cause using logs, telemetry, and profiling * Write real automation and tooling in Python or Go to reduce manual toil, including remediation scripts and health checks that catch problems before customers do * Build and improve monitoring, alerting, observability, and telemetry so the team can see problems before they become incidents * Participate in on\-call rotations, respond to alerts, and contribute to blameless post\-mortems * Work directly with senior and staff engineers on real production engineering problems, and grow into more autonomy quickly **Depending on Your Team** * Own the health and reliability of production infrastructure supporting Crusoe's AI cloud, whether working cross\-domain or going deep in one area * Build breadth across Crusoe's infrastructure stack and grow toward a specialization (compute, storage, networking, or continued breadth) over time * On some teams, go deep on one specialization (compute and GPU fleet reliability, storage and distributed storage systems, networking fabric and SDN, Managed AI, Inference, or Managed Cloud) * On hardware\-focused teams, help keep our GPU fleet, including NVIDIA and AMD hardware, running reliably under real production AI workloads * Run validation testing on configuration changes, firmware updates, and infrastructure modifications before they touch production * Learn directly from senior and staff engineers who own the hardware and reliability standards for their domain, and grow toward owning more of that surface area yourself **What You'll Bring** * A CS or EE degree, bootcamp, or equivalent hands\-on experience, plus genuine interest in infrastructure and systems reliability over application development * 3 to 5 years of working proficiency in Python or Go. You're comfortable writing and debugging real code, not just shell one\-liners * Familiarity with Linux fundamentals: processes, networking, filesystems, and how hardware and software interact * Comfort in a fast\-paced, high\-ownership environment with a real on\-call rotation * Strong communication skills. You'll write incident summaries and work with engineers across compute, storage, and networking, not just your own team **Mindset** * Curiosity about how distributed systems fail and a habit of asking "why" past the first answer * Openness to either broad cross\-domain work or early specialization in one domain, depending on where the team needs you **Nice to Have** * Exposure to Kubernetes or container orchestration (not required, we'll teach you what matters here) * Exposure to GPUs, HPC environments, kernel internals, or systems and validation engineering coursework or projects * Prior on\-call, NOC, IT ops, or lab/systems administration experience, plus personal projects, open source contributions, or coursework touching distributed systems, low\-level systems, or hardware **What This Role Is Not** * **This is a role that focuses on reliability, not pure Software Engineering**. You won't be building product features. You'll be keeping GPU, storage, or networking infrastructure healthy and reliable under real production load. * **Not a role where scripting is optional**. You need working proficiency in Python or Go on day one. Real automation work starts immediately, not after a year of ramping. * **Not a help desk or NOC ticket\-passing role**. You'll do real engineering: writing automation, debugging distributed systems, and contributing to design discussions. * **Not a low\-ownership job**. You'll carry on\-call and be expected to grow into more autonomy quickly. * **Not primarily a Kubernetes or orchestration\-tooling job**. Managing a Kubernetes cluster isn't the bar. We're looking for people curious about what's happening below that layer, in the hardware and systems themselves. **Benefits** * Industry competitive pay * Restricted Stock Units in a fast growing, well\-funded technology company * Health insurance package options that include HDHP and PPO, vision, and dental for you and your dependents * Employer contributions to HSA accounts * Paid Parental Leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Teladoc * 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4% of salary * Generous paid time off and holiday schedule * Cell phone reimbursement * Tuition reimbursement * Subscription to the Calm app * MetLife Legal * Company paid commuter benefit; $300 per month **Compensation** Compensation will be paid in the range of $140,000 to $165,000\. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. **Position Summary** We are seeking a highly skilled and visionary Staff Engineer to lead the architecture, development, and scaling of our core applications. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex backend data systems, emerging AI capabilities, and intuitive frontend experiences. As a hands\-on technical leader, you will be responsible for designing rich, interactive dashboards, building resilient backend microservices, and orchestrating deep integrations with diverse data objects and third\-party systems. You will champion our DevOps culture and lead the charge in embedding AI\-driven features into our product suite to automate workflows and deliver intelligent insights. Sitting at the intersection of application development, data integration, and cloud operations, you will guide technical strategy, mentor engineering teams, and ensure operational excellence across the entire technology stack. This position will focus on optimizing our Payer Operations with the goal of building solutions that enrich our Payer metadata, automate our Payer lifecycle contracts, and measure Payer performance. **Responsibilities** * Architecture \& Full Stack Development: Lead the end\-to\-end design, architecture, and development of highly scalable web applications, from responsive, user\-centric frontends to robust backend services. * Dashboarding \& Data Visualization: Architect and implement rich, interactive dashboards and user interfaces that surface complex data insights in an intuitive, performant, and accessible manner. * Backend \& Data Integrations: Design and develop secure, scalable APIs and integration layers. Build seamless connections between our applications and diverse data objects, enterprise databases, and third\-party platforms. * AI Enablement \& Implementation: Champion the integration of AI/ML technologies (e.g., Large Language Models, generative AI, predictive analytics) into core products. Develop intelligent features that automate user workflows and provide advanced data synthesis. * DevOps \& Cloud Infrastructure: Drive continuous delivery and cloud\-native best practices. Architect, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments (Docker/Kubernetes), and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to ensure high availability and rapid release cycles. * Operational Excellence: Establish rigorous standards for monitoring, logging, and performance profiling across the stack. Act as the ultimate escalation point for complex, full\-stack production issues and lead root\-cause analysis. * Technical Leadership \& Mentoring: Serve as a subject matter expert and mentor to frontend, backend, and DevOps engineers. Establish coding standards, drive reusable design patterns, and collaborate closely with product leadership to groom the backlog and shape the technical roadmap. * Self Starter: This role will deal with ambiguity and requires an individual who is comfortable with taking vague requirements and asking questions of stakeholders to be able to develop accordingly. **Required Skills \& Qualifications** * Experience: 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong focus on full\-stack development, system architecture, and scalable applications. * Frontend Expertise: Mastery of modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue) and experience with complex state management and data visualization libraries (e.g., D3\.js, Recharts, Highcharts). * Backend \& API Proficiency: Deep expertise in server\-side languages and frameworks (e.g., Node.js, Python, Java, C\#, or Go). Proven ability to design scalable microservices and event\-driven architectures. * Data Object Integration: Strong experience with relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB), ORMs, and integrating complex, high\-volume data feeds into application layers. * AI Integration Skills: Hands\-on experience integrating AI models and APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) into software products. Familiarity with AI orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain) and vector databases. * DevOps \& Cloud: Expert\-level knowledge of public cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Strong proficiency with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins), containerization, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation). * Problem\-Solving \& Communication: Exceptional analytical skills with an ability to break down complex business requirements into technical solutions. Excellent ability to communicate architectural decisions to both technical teams and business stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building internal developer platforms (IDP) or self\-service tooling for engineering teams. * Familiarity with data streaming technologies (e.g., Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ) for real\-time integrations. * Experience in secure software development lifecycle (DevSecOps) practices and data compliance. **Education** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). **Pay Range** The typical pay range for this role is: $106,605\.00 \- $284,280\.00 This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full\-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short\-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program. Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong. **Great benefits for great people** We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families. This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility. Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments. We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 11/03/2026 Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.
