jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer - Trust and Safety
jobs.description: #### **What's in it for you?** Ready to make a serious impact? Millions of people already rely on Calendly, and we're still in the midst of exciting product growth — it's a fantastic time to join us. Everything you'll work on here will accelerate your career to the next level. If you want to learn, grow, and do the best work of your life alongside the best people you've ever worked with, then we hope you'll consider allowing Calendly to be a part of your professional journey. **About the team \& opportunity** Millions of people use Calendly to book meetings, and most of that happens on public booking pages where anyone with a link can schedule time. That openness is what makes Calendly easy to use, and it's also what makes it a target. The **Trust \& Safety** team keeps Calendly safe without slowing anyone down. We protect everyone who interacts with Calendly: the hosts who share their links, the invitees who book with them, and the email and SMS providers and partners who rely on us to send responsibly. Our work covers three areas: preventing and responding to abuse, protecting the deliverability and compliance of the messages Calendly sends, and keeping messaging costs predictable as the platform grows. Most of our problems are adversarial. We often can't rely on knowing who someone is, so we judge behavior, patterns, and content instead. Attackers change tactics all the time, so we build signals that last from one attack to the next. And we take false positives seriously, because blocking a real customer costs more than letting a spammer through. Engineers work closely with our Trust \& Safety Operations team, who see abuse first and shape what we build. In this role, you will report to the Engineering Manager for the Trust \& Safety team. **A day in the life of a Full Stack Engineer at Calendly** On a typical day, you will be working on: * Building and improving the systems that detect and stop abuse across sign\-up, booking, and messaging, such as spam, phishing, bots, and fraudulent SMS traffic. * Improving the reliability, deliverability, and compliance of the email and SMS notifications Calendly sends. * Shipping new detection carefully: measuring how it performs on real traffic before it acts on accounts, and weighing false positives against false negatives. * Responding to active abuse, including during on\-call, by stopping the damage fast, then replacing quick fixes with durable ones. * Building tools that help our Trust \& Safety Operations team review accounts faster and understand why the system took each action. * Partnering with Product, Operations, and Data to define requirements and measure the impact of what we ship. * Working with other product teams to add protections to the flows they own. * Reviewing implementation plans and pull requests, and sharing what you learn with the team. **What do we need from you?** * 3\+ years of professional software development experience at a SaaS or technology company, including building and running production systems. * Strong backend skills: building services, APIs, and data\-heavy workflows in a service\-oriented architecture. * Experience with Rails, Node/TypeScript, Go, or a comparable language or framework, and a willingness to work across more than one. * Comfort with relational databases and SQL, and with using data to check whether a change actually worked. * An analytical, curious mindset: you think about how a system could be misused, not only how it's supposed to be used. * Good judgment about trade\-offs, such as stopping bad actors without adding friction for real customers. * A commitment to clean, reliable, maintainable code, thoughtful testing, and shipping in small increments. * Clear communication with engineers and non\-engineers alike, including Operations and Support partners. * Comfort and skill with AI tools in your engineering work, including reviewing their output critically. * Availability to take part in an on\-call rotation for critical services. * Authorized to work lawfully in the United States of America as Calendly does not engage in immigration sponsorship at this time. **Nice to have** * Experience in trust and safety, fraud, spam, or abuse prevention. * Experience with email or SMS delivery, such as deliverability, sender reputation, or messaging compliance. * Experience with bot protection, rate limiting, or third\-party risk and verification services. * Experience building rules engines, risk scoring, or ML\-backed decisions in production. * Experience using LLMs to classify or moderate user\-generated content. * Experience with GCP, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, or Redis. The ranges listed above are the expected annual base salary for this role, subject to change. Calendly takes a number of factors into consideration when determining an employee's starting salary, including relevant experience, relevant skills sets, interview performance, location/metropolitan area, and internal pay equity. Base salary is just one component of Calendly's total rewards package. All full\-time (30 hours/week) employees are also eligible for equity awards, and competitive benefits. Eligible Sales employees also qualify for a Sales Incentive program. Calendly uses the zip code of an employee's remote work location, or the onsite building location if hybrid, to determine which metropolitan pay range we use. Current geographic zones are as follows: * Tier 1: San Francisco, CA, San Jose, CA, New York City, NY * Tier 2: Chicago, IL, Austin, TX, Denver, CO, Boston, MA, Washington D.C., Philadelphia, PA, Portland, OR, Seattle, WA, Miami, FL, and all other cities in CA. * Tier 3: All other locations not in Tier 1 or Tier 2 **If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the application or recruiting process, please let your Recruiter know when first connecting with them. Calendly is registered as an employer in many, but not all, states. If you are located in Alaska, Delaware, Hawaii, Idaho, Iowa, Montana, Nebraska, North Dakota, Rhode Island, South Dakota, and West Virginia, you will not be eligible for employment. Note that all individual roles will specify location eligibility.** **All candidates can find our Candidate Privacy Statement** **here** **Candidates residing in California may visit our Notice at Collection for California Candidates here:** **Notice at Collection** This role may require occasional travel for company events, team collaboration, or offsites.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Overview** We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our dynamic development team. In this role, you will lead the design, development, and implementation of scalable, high\-performance software solutions that drive our core systems forward. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to develop innovative features, optimize existing applications, and ensure our infrastructure supports rapid growth and evolving business needs. Your expertise in software engineering principles, system architecture, and modern development practices will be instrumental in shaping the future of our technology landscape. **Responsibilities** * Lead the architecture and design of complex software systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security across cloud infrastructure and on\-premises environments. * Develop robust web applications using JavaScript frameworks such as React or Angular, integrating seamlessly with backend services via RESTful APIs. * Build and maintain microservices architectures utilizing programming languages like Java, C\#, Python, or Ruby on Rails to support scalable system development. * Implement and optimize database solutions using SQL\-based systems such as MySQL or PostgreSQL, ensuring data integrity and performance. * Drive software development best practices through Agile methodologies, including sprint planning, code reviews, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD), and version control with Git or SVN. * Design and implement APIs adhering to REST principles for seamless communication between distributed components. * Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical specifications while applying design patterns for maintainable code. * Ensure system security through RBAC (Role\-Based Access Control), secure coding practices, and compliance with industry standards. * Contribute to the evaluation and integration of cloud infrastructure services such as AWS or Azure to enhance system scalability and resilience. **Experience** * Proven experience as a Senior Software Engineer or similar role with a strong portfolio of developing scalable web applications and backend systems. * Extensive knowledge of IT infrastructure components supporting software deployment in cloud environments like AWS or Azure. * Hands\-on expertise in programming languages including JavaScript (React, Express), Java, C\#, Python, Ruby on Rails, C\+\+, C, or.NET frameworks. * Deep understanding of software design principles, patterns, microservices architecture, RESTful API development, and system design for large\-scale applications. * Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban to foster collaborative project execution. * Experience working with version control tools like GitHub or SVN alongside CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment processes. * Strong background in database management using SQL databases like MySQL or PostgreSQL; experience with NoSQL is a plus. * Knowledge of security best practices including RBAC implementation and secure API development to protect sensitive data. * Ability to work effectively in Linux environments and utilize modern front\-end technologies such as JavaScript frameworks (React) for full\-stack development. Join us to innovate at the forefront of technology by designing systems that are not only powerful but also reliable and scalable! Your expertise will help shape solutions that empower users worldwide while advancing your career in a vibrant tech environment committed to excellence and continuous learning. Pay: $117,000\.00 \- $142,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Faculty Position in Electrical Engineering
jobs.description: The Division of Engineering and Applied Science at the California Institute of Technology invites applications for tenure\-track/tenured faculty positions. We seek highly qualified candidates committed to a career in teaching, mentoring and research excellence in the department of Electrical Engineering. Preference will be given to candidates at the Assistant Professor level; however, well\-qualified applicants at the associate or full professor level may also be considered. Our department is a unique environment where innovative, interdisciplinary, and foundational research is conducted in a collegial atmosphere. We are seeking candidates in the broad area of information systems, including decision systems, systems for science, distributed systems, sensory systems (such as speech and vision), signal processing, data science, data communications and storage, energy systems, control, robotics, artificial intelligence, networking, and human\-in\-the\-loop systems. For tenure\-track candidates, the initial appointment is contingent upon completion of the Ph.D. degree. It is also anticipated that a successful candidate would collaborate broadly with investigators both within and beyond the Engineering and Applied Science Division, as well as in centers at Caltech including, for example, the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, the Center for Sensing to Intelligence, the Center for Autonomous Systems and Technologies, the Institute for Quantum Information and Matter, the Chen Institute for Neuroscience, the Merkin Institute, and the Resnick Sustainability Institute. Applications should be submitted online at **https://www.applications.caltech.edu/jobs/ee** Reviewing of applications will begin on November 8, but full consideration will be given to all candidates who apply by **December 6, 2026\.** The appointment is contingent upon completion of the Ph.D. degree in an appropriate engineering or science related discipline. Applications should include: * A brief cover letter. * Curriculum vitae. * Relevant publications. * A research statement describing research highlights and future goals and plans. * Applicants should submit an education statement that addresses the applicant’s thoughts on classroom and laboratory instruction, mentorship of students and postdoctoral scholars, and ways to foster an inclusive environment for the development of scholars who come to Caltech with many different perspectives and experiences. Questions about the application process may be directed to: ee\-search@caltech.edu. Pay: $125,000\.00 \- $400,000\.00 per year Work Location: In person

Reporting to the VP, Program Management and Engineering, this role oversees software execution across Oracle EBS, microservices, and custom applications. You will mentor developers, streamline CI/CD delivery pipelines, and drive a culture of continuous improvement, urgency, and decisive communication. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities:** * **Leadership \& Talent Development:** Lead, mentor, and grow a team of software engineers; conduct performance management, hiring, and career development. * **Execution \& Delivery:** Oversee application development, code reviews, and release lifecycles using Agile/Scrum/Kanban methodologies. * **Technical Oversight \& CI/CD:** Provide technical guidance across APIs, cloud services, and Oracle EBS integrations; jobs.title: Enterprise Software Architect
jobs.description: **Job Summary** =============== **Key Deliverables and Responsibilities** ========================================= Cambridge’s Enterprise Platform, Architecture \& Data organization owns the foundations the rest of the firm builds on: cloud and infrastructure platforms, integration and API layers, enterprise data, and the architecture standards that connect them. In a FINRA\- and SEC\-regulated environment, security, resilience, data governance, and auditability are design requirements from day one. The Enterprise Architect sets the target\-state architecture for Cambridge’s technology estate and ensures major platform, data, and application decisions move the firm toward it. This senior individual\-contributor role blends strategy, hands\-on design authority, and trusted partnership with business leaders across the organization. **Architecture Strategy and Roadmap** * Define and maintain enterprise target\-state architecture across business, application, data, integration, and technology domains. * Translate business strategy, including Financial Professional experience, client onboarding, trading, operations, and compliance, into multi\-year capability and technology roadmaps. * Lead application portfolio rationalization by identifying redundancy, technical debt, and end\-of\-life risk and building the case for consolidation or modernization. Evaluate build, buy, and partner options, including third\-party platforms, custodial integrations, and fintech vendors. * **Design Authority and Governance** * Chair or lead the Architecture Review Board and establish standards, reference architectures, and patterns for delivery teams. * Maintain Architecture Decision Records so major decisions are traceable and auditable. * Review high\-impact solution designs for alignment with standards, security, resilience, cost, and regulatory requirements. Create paved roads and guardrails that balance governance with delivery speed. * **Platform, Cloud, Integration, Data, and AI** * Shape cloud and hybrid infrastructure strategy with Platform Engineering, including landing zones, identity, networking, and observability. * Drive an API\-first and event\-driven integration strategy that reduces point\-to\-point coupling between core systems. * Guide modernization of legacy applications through re\-platforming, re\-architecture, or retirement with clear sequencing and risk management. * Partner on data platforms, master and reference data, lineage, data products, and embedded governance, classification, retention, and privacy controls. Define reference architectures and guardrails for responsible AI and generative AI, including model access, data boundaries, and human review. * **Security, Resilience, and Leadership** * Embed security\-by\-design, zero\-trust, business continuity, disaster recovery, and operational resilience into reference architectures. * Partner with Compliance, Risk, and Internal Audit so recordkeeping, supervision, surveillance, and third\-party risk requirements are reflected in system designs. Mentor architects and senior engineers, communicate technical trade\-offs clearly, and represent architecture in vendor negotiations, due diligence, and strategic planning. * **What We Are Looking For** =========================== * 10\+ years of experience in technology, including 5\+ years in enterprise or senior solution architecture roles. * Proven success defining and executing target\-state architecture and multi\-year roadmaps at enterprise scale. * Deep hands\-on experience with at least one major public cloud. Azure experience is preferred, along with experience in hybrid environments. * Strong command of integration architecture, including APIs, event streaming, messaging, identity management, and legacy system integration. * Solid grounding in modern enterprise architecture, security architecture, identity and access management, and resilience and disaster recovery design. * Experience leading architecture governance, including review boards, standards, and Architecture Decision Records that teams adopt. * Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to brief executives and challenge engineers with equal credibility. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or equivalent experience. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Financial services experience, ideally in broker\-dealer, registered investment adviser, wealth management, or custody environments. * Familiarity with wealth\-management technology such as Salesforce, portfolio management and rebalancing, trading and order management, account opening, and clearing or custodial integrations. * Exposure to books\-and\-records retention, supervision, surveillance, and vendor risk management requirements. * Experience designing AI, machine learning, and generative AI platforms and guardrails in a regulated setting. * Practical fluency with TOGAF, Zachman, or a similar architecture framework. * Relevant certifications such as TOGAF, professional\-level cloud architect credentials, or CISSP. jobs.description: AI Engineer 4 At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real\-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world\-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. jobs.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer, Cloud Architecture
jobs.description: **Who we are** At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go\-to\-market acceleration has driven industry\-leading growth. In fact, we're the largest and fastest\-growing automotive marketplace, and we've been profitable for over 15 years. **What we do** The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and \~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people\-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion\-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride! **Role overview** CarGurus is hiring a Senior Principal Software Engineer to be the hands\-on cloud architect within our Engineering Platform (EP) organization. We have finished a large lift\-and\-shift to AWS. The next step is helping 300\+ engineers build cloud\-native, SaaS\-ready software that is resilient, secure, and built to scale. In this role you will work hands\-on, side by side with the teams doing the work. You won't belong to a single squad. Instead, you will go wherever the hardest system and cloud architecture problems are, partner with teams to solve them, and leave behind patterns that others can reuse. **What you'll do** * Own system architecture as it connects to cloud architecture: shape how services, data, and jobs map onto AWS, and lay out practical paths from old architectures to new ones. * Partner with Product Engineering teams on their architecture problems. This may mean working closely with a team for a period of time to prototype, help unblock them, and leave behind an architecture they can own. * Act as the technical lead for our AWS relationship. You'll work with AWS solutions architects on service guidance and roadmaps. * Build proofs of concept and reference implementations in code, using Terraform, Python, Java, and similar tools, that teams can build on and that can evolve into standard patterns over time. Explain the trade\-offs behind each one. * Work with Cloud Enablement to advance AWS self\-service and guardrails: HCP Terraform workflows, Sentinel policies, IAM, and account and sandbox strategy. * Design architecture with cost in mind across cloud and AI spend, including attribution, tagging, and controls. * Lead architecture for SaaS maturity and compliance readiness, covering disaster recovery and business continuity, security, performance, dependency ownership, and standardizing our cloud accounts. * Guide architecture for agentic workloads on AWS, such as AgentCore Gateway, Bedrock, OAuth, and machine\-to\-machine identity, in partnership with InfoSec. * Collaborate with our Technical Leadership Team to shape technical direction. Record decisions in ADRs and RFCs and spread them across teams. * Mentor senior engineers and run workshops on cloud\-native best practices. **What you'll bring** * 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including 5\+ years designing and running production systems on AWS. * A software engineer first: you write production\-quality code in at least one of Java, Python, TypeScript, or Go. * Fluent in infrastructure as code with Terraform. * Deep AWS expertise across networking (VPC, Transit Gateway, VPC Lattice), IAM, serverless (Lambda, Batch, API Gateway), containers (EKS), and managed data stores. * Focused on security: least\-privilege IAM, OAuth2/OIDC, and designing for compliance. * Bring a forward\-deployed mindset: you would rather build the prototype than only review the design, and you can still write the think paper that sets direction. * Lead through influence and collaboration without ego. You build trust with engineers, managers, and executives, both inside and outside your own organization. * Write clearly and can explain technical trade\-offs to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Think about cost: you treat cost efficiency as a design requirement. **Working at CarGurus** We reward our Gurus' curiosity and passion with best\-in\-class benefits and compensation, including equity for all employees, both when they start and as they continue to grow with us. Our career development and corporate giving programs, as well as our employee resource groups (ERGs) and communities, help people build connections while making an impact in personally meaningful ways. A flexible hybrid model and robust time off policies encourage work\-life balance and individual well\-being. Thoughtful perks like daily free lunch, a new car discount, meditation and fitness apps, commuting cost coverage, and more help our people create space for what matters most in their personal and professional lives. CarGurus may require in\-person interviews as part of our hiring process, particularly for positions based in our Boston and Dublin offices. Candidates selected for an in\-person interview will be notified in advance. Please be aware that travel expenses are the responsibility of the candidate. **We welcome all** CarGurus strives to be a place to which people can bring the ultimate expression of themselves and their potential—starting with our hiring process. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. We foster an inclusive environment that values people for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. That's why we hope you'll apply even if you don't check every box listed in the job description. We also encourage you to tell your recruiter if you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process due to a disability so we can provide the appropriate support. We want to know what only you can bring to CarGurus. \#LI\-Hybrid

with business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions. * Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, build automation, release management, and IIS configuration. * Experience with automated performance testing or working in regulated data environments. **Software Specific Qualifications and Requirements** * Proficiency in C\# and the .NET / .NET Core framework for building web applications and backend services. * Experience developing responsive web front\-end applications using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., Angular). * Experience implementing server\-side logic, business services, and API integrations (REST required, SOAP a plus). * Experience working  erred:** * Advanced SQL development, including stored procedures, automation, environment configuration, and release management. * Experience developing internal operational systems such as customer service, servicing, collections, or workflow applications. * Work Location and Arrangement: This role will be based out of the **Richmond VA Corporate Office** and have a Hybrid work arrangement. * **Associates based in Richmond work on\-site 4 days per week.** Work Authorization: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. **About CarMax** CarMax disrupted the auto industry by delivering the honest, transparent and high\-integrity experience customers want and deserve. This innovative thinking around the way cars are bought and sold has helped us become the nation’s largest retailer of used cars, with over 200 locations nationwide. Our amazing team of more than 25,000 associates work together to deliver iconic customer experiences. Along the way, we help every associate grow their career and achieve their best, at work and in their community. We are recognized for our commitment to training and diversity and are one of the FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For®. Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: CarMax is committed to bringing together people from different backgrounds and perspectives, providing employees with a safe, welcoming, and inclusive work environment. CarMax is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. **About CarMax Auto Finance** CarMax Auto Finance (CAF) is the captive finance company or wholly owned subsidiary of our retail arm, CarMax Auto Superstore. The annual salary for this position is: $104,000\.00 \- $156,000\.00**May be eligible for bonus and equity.** **Benefits:** Except as otherwise required by state law, CarMax Associates are entitled to the following paid sick, vacation, and holiday time. These values are not just words—they guide our behaviors, decisions, and actions every day. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Looking for a job to get you out of bed?** We are looking for a passionate, experienced Data Engineer to join Casper’s Data Engineering team as we continue building our data warehouse, data lake and platform capabilities. Our vision is supported by leveraging data and insights to drive the business forward. Data Engineering provides the platform that enables Casper to efficiently produce, manage and consume high quality data. As an engineer, you will support the evolution of our data platform and analytics capabilities by driving how we process and model new data sets, develop/iterate on internal tooling and infrastructure, and support secure, scalable, and responsible data practices. Casper (Casper.com) believes everyone should sleep better. That’s why we obsess over designing sleep products that actually make a difference—from the littlest dreamers and beyond. Including mattresses, pillows, and bedding, our entire collection is dreamed up and engineered in\-house by our product and design teams. Sleepers can shop online, visit one of our 40\+ retail locations across the United States, or find us through a growing network of trusted retail partners. This is a hybrid role, requiring that you work 4 days per week from our Richmond, VA office. **When you’re not catching zzz’s, this is what you’ll do...** * Own the storage architecture in Amazon Redshift, including distribution and sort key design, RA3/managed storage tuning, and tiering cold data to S3/Spectrum to keep the warehouse fast and cost\-efficient as data volume grows * Design and maintain dbt models for high\-volume event data at multi\-billion row scale while balancing cost and efficiency. * Build resilient ingestion pipelines from third\-party platforms with idempotent loads so bad or partial loads never silently reach production tables. * Diagnose and resolve pipeline performance bottlenecks and fine tuning workloads between raw to BI layer to prevent data outages. * Set up monitoring and alerting across the pipeline to catch data anomalies before they compound. * Work closely with data analysts to align warehouse design with stakeholder needs and LookML modeling, ensuring a robust, scalable foundation from raw tables through to the semantic layer * Collaborate with other engineers and product managers in solving interesting and challenging problems across our systems * Advance modern, agile software development practices and help build a culture of great engineering and organizational practices * Learn from the team and on your own what you might not know about data infrastructure, business operations, and open source tooling to make you a stronger asset to the team * Preference for familiarity with Redshift, S3, dbt, Airflow, Looker, Trino, Fivetran **Our dream candidate is/has:** * The following technical capabilities developed through at least 3 years of relevant work experience: * + Expert in Python and SQL + Experience with Airflow, containerization and orchestration + Experience with a cloud data warehouse like Redshift or Snowflake + Knowledge of modern BI tools and dbt. + Salesforce, GA4, Shopify experience a plus * A proven engineering background with experience developing data workflows and a good operational understanding of data operations, including processing, storage, quality and management * Experience working with a diverse set of stakeholders and helping them understand the trade\-offs to different product and technical decisions * Appreciation for the business context that drives the need for data solutions and love working on projects to support those efforts * Experience delivering timely, high quality data products and models Targeted Annual Base Salary Range: $115,000\-130,000 USD Casper’s compensation philosophy ensures that the actual base salary is based on factors including but not limited to skills, education, experience, special training, time in position, and/or years of service. We recognize that annual base salary is just one part of a total rewards package. In addition, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, wellbeing resources, and other perks including: * Medical, vision, and dental insurance to help you with those coughs or cavities (too many waffles)... * Paid Time Off. We believe in the power of rest so take the time you need to recharge. * Employee Discount to use on whatever you like (with a few exceptions) and product discounts for friends and family! * Dreaming of your next degree? After one year of service, we’ll help make that dream a little easier with tuition reimbursement. * … and more! If you dream about this stuff this job is probably right for you. We look forward to learning more about you! *Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employer\-sponsored visa support.* *As part of our hiring process, employment offers are contingent on the successful completion of a background check and drug screening, where permitted by law.* Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: **Who We Are:** --------------- Cell Signaling Technology (CST) is a different kind of life sciences company, one founded, owned, and run by active research scientists, with the highest standards of product and service quality, technological innovation, and scientific rigor for over 20 years. We consistently provide fellow scientists around the globe with best\-in\-class products and services to fuel their quests for discovery. Helping researchers find new solutions is our main mission every day, but it's not our only mission. We're also dedicated to helping identify solutions to other problems facing our world. We believe that all businesses must be responsible and work in partnership with local communities, while seeking to minimize their environmental impact. That's why we joined 1% for the Planet as its first life science member, and have committed to achieving net\-zero emissions by 2029\. **The Role:** ------------- The Full Stack Developer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining scalable web applications across both front\-end and back\-end systems. This role partners closely with Product, UX/UI, DevOps, and business stakeholders to deliver high\-quality, secure, and performant solutions that meet organizational needs. The ideal candidate brings strong experience across modern front\-end frameworks, back\-end development, APIs, and database design, along with a collaborative mindset and commitment to continuous improvement. This role operates within a headless CMS architecture (Contentstack) and a Vue.js/Nuxt.js front end, working closely with the Web Marketing team to deliver secure, high\-performing experiences across CST’s global web properties. This position reports to the Director of Web and is located onsite at our Danvers, MA headquarters. **What You'll Do:** ------------------- **Application Development (40%)** * Design, develop, and maintain full stack web applications. * Build responsive and intuitive user interfaces using Vue.js and Nuxt.js. * Develop and maintain back\-end services, APIs, and business logic. Node.js is preferred, to align with the shared JavaScript/TypeScript stack. * Write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code. * Build and maintain content models, components, and integrations within Contentstack (or the organization’s designated headless CMS) to support scalable, reusable web experiences. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to accelerate delivery while maintaining code quality, security, and test coverage. * Participate in code reviews and enforce development standards. **Architecture \& Technical Design (20%)** * Contribute to system architecture decisions and technical design discussions. * Design scalable and secure API integrations. * Support and evolve a headless, API\-first architecture (Contentstack, Nuxt.js/Vue.js) that enables content reuse across web properties and channels. * Ensure optimal performance, reliability, and security of applications. * Monitor and optimize for Core Web Vitals and other web performance benchmarks. * Evaluate and recommend new technologies and tools. **Database \& Integration Management (15%)** * Design and maintain relational and/or NoSQL databases. * Optimize queries and database performance. * Develop integrations with third\-party systems (e.g., ERP, CRM, analytics platforms, SaaS platforms). * Ensure data integrity and adherence to governance standards. **Testing, Deployment \& DevOps Collaboration (15%)** * Develop unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests using modern frameworks (e.g., Vitest, Playwright, Cypress). * Support CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes. * Collaborate with DevOps to ensure secure and efficient production releases. * Troubleshoot and resolve application defects and performance issues. **Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement (10%)** * Partner with Product Owners and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions. * Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand\-ups, retrospectives). * Document technical specifications and processes. * Champion web accessibility (WCAG 2\.2 AA) and SEO best practices across all web properties. * Contribute to ongoing improvements in development practices and tooling. **What You'll Bring:** ---------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). * 5\+ years of full stack development experience Proficiency in: * Front\-end technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript) * Vue.js (Composition API) and Nuxt.js required; experience with React or Angular is a plus. * Hands\-on experience with a headless CMS platform (Contentstack strongly preferred; Contentful, Sanity, or similar considered). * Hands\-on experience with a headless/composable commerce platform (CommerceTools strongly preferred; similar considered) * Hands\-on experience with search infrastructure (Elasticsearch preferred; similar considered) * Back\-end languages (Node.js, Python, Java, C\#, or similar) * Experience with RESTful and/or GraphQL API development. * Strong knowledge of relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and/or NoSQL databases. * Familiarity with Git\-based version control. * Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor). * Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) preferred. * Understanding of secure coding practices and data protection standards (e.g., OWASP Top 10\). * Working knowledge of web accessibility standards (WCAG 2\.2 AA) and SEO fundamentals. * Experience writing automated tests (unit, integration, end\-to\-end) using modern frameworks (e.g., Vitest, Playwright, Cypress, Jest). **Preferred Qualifications:** ----------------------------- * Production experience with Vue.js/Nuxt.js in a high\-traffic marketing or e\-commerce environment. * Experience with GraphQL APIs and modern state\-management patterns (e.g., Pinia). * Familiarity with performance budgets and Core Web Vitals optimization. * Experience with component/design systems (e.g., Storybook). * Experience supporting multi\-region or multi\-language websites. * Experience in life sciences, healthcare, or another regulated industry. This position has a starting base salary range of $157,000 \- $222,000 per year, which the company, in good faith, reasonably expects to pay for this role at the time of posting. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills, qualifications, experience, and internal equity. **What We Offer:** ------------------ At Cell Signaling Technology (CST), we recognize that people will always be our most important asset. Providing a safe, inclusive, and stimulating working environment that understands the importance of diversity, human dignity, and meaningful work is as important as establishing company policies that incorporate excellent health insurance and pay benefits. We recognize that the development of people is the key to their happiness and thus ensure every employee has impactful discussions with their manager and develops actionable performance and professional development plans. Lastly, we are committed to engaging and supporting our employees in committees and philanthropy that benefit their local communities and environment through community investment programs. **Benefits:** ------------- * Medical (BCBS) and Dental (Delta Dental) plans paid at 90% * Vision Insurance * Life Insurance, Short and Long Term Disability * Flexible Spending accounts * 401(k) Plan with 6% match * Tuition Reimbursement * Generous PTO package * Parental Leave * Pet Insurance * Employee Assistance Program * Onsite Subsidized Cafeteria * Free Parking Cell Signaling Technology (CST) is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, status as a veteran or as a member of the military or status in any group protected by applicable federal or state laws. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. **AGENCIES** All resumes submitted by search firms/employment agencies to any employee at Cell Signaling Technology (CST) via email, the Internet, or in any form and/or method will be deemed the sole property of CST unless CST engaged such search firms/employment agencies for this position and a valid agreement with CST is in place. In the event a candidate who was submitted outside of the CST agency engagement process is hired, no fee or payment of any kind will be paid.

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description: **About Ceresti** ================= Ceresti is on a mission to reduce avoidable hospitalizations and improve care for people living with dementia while improving the lives of their families and caregivers. We envision a world in which family caregivers of people living with dementia are supported and have the knowledge, skills, and confidence to provide the best possible care for their loved ones. Ceresti is a tech\-enabled dementia care provider with a differentiated model of care that improves outcomes and delivers guaranteed cost savings by including family caregivers in the care team. We offer health plans and accountable care organizations a turnkey solution for engaging a population that has limited participation in traditional clinical programs. Our culture is rooted in agility, innovation, and collaboration. We believe every idea—no matter how small—can spark a meaningful improvement. Together, we create solutions that make a lasting impact on the healthcare ecosystem, enabling more compassionate and cost\-effective care for those who need it most. **The Role** ============ Ceresti's engineering team is writing a lot of code. This role makes sure it is safe: threat modeled, risk evaluated, dependency\-checked, and tested by someone who knows how an attacker would approach it. The Security Engineer is the bridge between the CISO's office and Engineering. You will sit with developers, read their code, and write your own: security utility tools, automation, logging and parsing scripts, and the integrations that turn raw signal into smarter controls. Security has a front end, a back end, and a lot of scripts, and most of the work is integrating systems and automating the tooling developers already use. You will also break things on purpose. We want someone who builds attack simulations (using AI and the tools we already run) and uses Dev, QA, and Test as a sandbox to prove where the real gaps are rather than arguing about them in the abstract. Your main working partner is Engineering. You will occasionally build something IT runs in Microsoft 365 for example, and IT is often the end user of those tools. **What You Will Do** ==================== **Secure the code Engineering writes** -------------------------------------- * Build and maintain threat models for new and existing systems and features, and keep them current as architecture changes. * Read checked\-in code and assess its security. This role reviews code; it does not only review reports about code. * Own Snyk and Docker Scout: thresholds, findings, and driving remediation with the owning teams. * Review the software bill of materials for outdated or vulnerable components and push fixes through to closure. * Review SAST and DAST output, prioritize what matters, and work the remediation with engineers directly. **Write security tooling and automation** ----------------------------------------- * Build security utility tools and automation that Engineering and the wider company use. * Write scripts for logging, data parsing, and signal enrichment that make controls smarter rather than noisier. * Integrate security systems with developer tooling so the safe path is the convenient one. * Build and tune detection logic and automation that the Security Analyst operates day to day. **Prove the gaps are real** --------------------------- * Build penetration tests and attack simulations using AI and the tools we already run, and use Dev, QA, and Test as a test bed to demonstrate real exposure. * Feed results from Pentest\-Tools and internal testing back into what you build next. * Scope, coordinate, and manage the independent third\-party penetration test required for SOC 2 and HITRUST, and track findings to closure. **Shape the architecture** -------------------------- * Contribute to security architecture and standards, as well as detection logic. * Represent security in engineering initiatives including the mobile app, tablet software, the data lake, and AI and machine\-learning work. * Help secure the production cloud environment (AWS via Aptible) as part of Engineering's platform, as code wherever possible. **What Success Looks Like** =========================== In the first year, we would expect to see: * Threat models exist for the major systems and stay current as architecture changes. * Dependency and container findings from Snyk and Docker Scout are triaged accurately and driven to closure, not just reported. * Engineering consults you early on mobile, tablet, data lake, and AI work. * Security tooling you wrote is in day\-to\-day use, and detections reach the Security Analyst with low noise. * Attack simulations have surfaced at least one real gap that nobody had argued for on paper. * The annual third\-party penetration test is scoped, scheduled, and tracked to closure. **What You Bring** ================== **Required** ------------ * Five to seven years in software or security engineering. Not a first engineering job. * You write code comfortably and would be at home on a development team. Python, Go, or similar. * Hands\-on application security: threat modeling, dependency and container scanning, and reading code for security flaws. * Working knowledge of cloud security in AWS, and of CI/CD pipelines and where security fits in them. * Offensive fundamentals: you can think like an attacker and build a test that proves a point. * The ability to explain a finding to an engineer in terms they will act on. **Preferred** ------------- * Experience with Snyk, Docker Scout, or comparable SAST, SCA, and container tooling. * Detection engineering: writing and tuning rules that hold up in production. * An OSCP\-type certification, or equivalent demonstrable offensive work. * Healthcare, or another environment handling regulated data. * Experience in a company where security was being built rather than inherited. **How you work** ---------------- * You like to experiment, and you want a test bed rather than permission. * You want help thinking through architecture, and you will ask for it. This role has room to grow into that. * You would rather demonstrate a gap, then document it so it gets fixed. * You treat engineers as colleagues to work alongside, not as an audience to review. **What We Offer** ================= * Full\-time remote work * Competitive base salary with final offer based on experience, skills, and location * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits * Equity participation in a growing healthcare technology company * PTO and a culture that respects it * A collaborative, mission\-driven environment where your work directly supports family caregivers and improves outcomes for people living with dementia **Additional Information** ========================== Employment is contingent on successful completion of a background check, consistent with applicable law. Ceresti is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: AI Engineer / Search Engineer

The AI Engineer / Search Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, tuning, testing, and supporting the AI and enterprise search components of the solution. The role will focus on **Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Document Intelligence, semantic and vector search, embeddings, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), metadata\-driven retrieval, document classification, and source\-grounded question answering** within FLRA’s approved Microsoft 365 GCC/Azure environment. **Key Responsibilities** * Design and implement AI\-enabled search capabilities for FLRA’s bargaining unit records. * Configure and optimize **Azure AI Search** indexes, fields, filters, analyzers, semantic configurations, and vector search. * Implement keyword, Boolean, full\-text, metadata, semantic, and vector\-based search capabilities. * Develop and support **natural\-language question answering** and source\-grounded responses using Azure OpenAI or other approved AI services. * Implement **Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)** patterns using FLRA documents, extracted metadata, and search indexes. * Generate, store, and manage embeddings used solutions.** * Strong hands\-on experience with **Azure AI Search** or comparable enterprise search technology. * Experience with **semantic search, vector search, embeddings, similarity search, and relevance ranking**. * Experience implementing **Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)** solutions. * Experience with **Azure OpenAI**, OpenAI APIs, or comparable large\-language\-model platforms. * Experience developing source\-grounded question\-answering solutions. * Strong experience with **Python, C\#/.NET**, or similar programming languages. * Experience with **Azure AI Document Intelligence** or comparable OCR/document\-processing technology. * Experience with document classification and structured metadata extraction. * Experience working with unstructured content such as PDFs, scanned documents, and OCR\-generated text. * Experience designing search index schemas, metadata models, filters, and query strategies. * Experience with text chunking, embedding generation, vector indexing, and retrieval strategies. * Experience with prompt engineering and LLM integration. * Experience evaluating and tuning search relevance and AI\-generated responses. * Understanding of hallucination mitigation, grounding, citations, confidence scoring, and responsible AI practices. * Experience integrating AI/search services with REST APIs, Azure services, or enterprise applications. * Familiarity with Microsoft SharePoint, Microsoft Graph API, and Microsoft 365 environments. * Experience with Git\-based source control, CI/CD, testing, and deployment practices. * Understanding of secure cloud development, identity management, and least\-privilege access. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and technical documentation skills. * Ability to work closely with team and Government stakeholders. * Ability to successfully complete required FLRA personnel security vetting. **Preferred Certifications** * Microsoft Certified: **Azure AI Engineer Associate** * Microsoft Certified: **Azure Data Scientist Associate** * Microsoft Certified: **Azure Developer Associate** * Microsoft Certified: **Azure Solutions Architect Expert** * Microsoft Certified: **Azure Data Engineer Associate** * Microsoft Applied Skills related to **Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, or generative AI** * CompTIA **Security\+** or equivalent security certification jobs.description: Chamberlain Group (CG) is a global leader in intelligent access and Blackstone portfolio company. Powered by our myQ technology, we make access simple and secure for millions of homeowners, businesses, and communities worldwide. Our flagship brands, LiftMaster® and Chamberlain® , are found in 51\+ million homes, and 14 million\+ people rely on the myQ® app daily. The Network and Data Center Facilities Engineer ensures the reliability, efficiency, and operational integrity of the physical infrastructure supporting CGI’s IT and manufacturing environments. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Chooch helps build and run the best Computer Vision AI applications that make cameras intelligent, enhancing productivity \& revenues, while reducing operational costs. Chooch has been named a leading computer vision platform by IDC. **Role Description** We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer (US\-based) to join our team. This is a full\-time, hybrid role with frequent hands\-on experience with customer projects in the Bay Area. The Machine Learning Engineer will be responsible for the successful design, accuracy, and backbone behind our Computer Vision AI applications. This includes data preparation, training, configuring neural networks, deploying networks in real customer locations, and refining computer vision algorithms for healthcare, manufacturing, and retail customers. This role requires frequent interaction with technical and non\-technical customers while working closely within our solutions engineering teams. The Machine Learning Engineering role has opportunity to grow, lead technical projects, and improve current processes while providing meaningful feedback to our product and solutions teams. **Product Description** Chooch AI is a computer vision platform that helps hospitals automate supply room monitoring and inventory management. Using fixed cameras and AI, the platform continuously tracks supplies in storage areas and updates on\-hand counts in real time. When inventory levels fall below defined thresholds, replenishment orders are automatically generated and sent to ERP systems, eliminating manual counts and barcode scanning. Hospitals using Chooch AI significantly reduce critical stockouts, optimize inventory levels, and improve supply chain staff productivity. By turning supply rooms into self\-managing systems, Chooch AI enables clinical and supply chain teams to focus more time on patient care. Responsibilities/What you'll do at Chooch: * Design, train and fine\-tune models for object detection, classification, segmentation, tracking and anomaly detection on real customer video and images. * Adapt pretrained and foundation models (YOLO\-family detectors, ViTs, CLIP\-style and vision\-language models) to new customer use cases with limited labeled data. * Own data pipelines end to end: curation, labeling guidelines, augmentation, synthetic data, and dataset versioning. * Optimize models for production and edge hardware using quantization, pruning, distillation, ONNX export and TensorRT, hitting agreed latency and accuracy targets. * Build evaluation suites with clear metrics (mAP, precision/recall, false\-alarm rates per camera\-hour) and catch regressions before release. * Deploy and monitor models in production, diagnose drift and failure cases, and close the loop with retraining. * Work with product, solutions engineers and customers to turn vague requirements into measurable model specs. * Write clean, tested, reviewed code and contribute to shared ML tooling. Nice to have * Experience with vision\-language models (CLIP, LLaVA\-style models) or open\-vocabulary detection. * Multi\-object tracking and video analytics (re\-identification, action recognition, temporal models). * Few\-shot learning, active learning, or synthetic data generation for low\-data domains. * MLOps tooling: MLflow or Weights \& Biases, Kubernetes, Triton Inference Server, CI/CD for models. * Domain experience in Healthcare, retail and supply chain, manufacturing inspection, workplace safety or video surveillance. Key Components * Model Development and Optimization: Design, develop, and optimize machine learning models for computer vision applications. * Data Management: Collaborate with ML engineers to ensure the collection, processing, and maintenance of high\-quality datasets necessary for model training and testing. * Algorithm Implementation: Implement state\-of\-the\-art computer vision algorithms to improve system accuracy and performance in real\-world scenarios. * Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely within the solutions engineering team to integrate machine learning models into the broader product and systems. * On\-Site Travel and Field Testing: Many of our projects are live deployments with major fortune 500 customers – testing new, innovative ML technologies. Traveling on site is sometimes needed to see the environment, test in the real\-world, and ensure the technology is operating as expected. * Performance Evaluation: Regularly evaluate the performance of computer vision models, using both qualitative and quantitative methods, and iterate to enhance accuracy and efficiency. * Research and Innovation: Understanding of the latest developments in machine learning and computer vision, applying innovative approaches and technologies to solve complex challenges. * Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into effective technical solutions. * Problem\-Solving: Address and troubleshoot complex problems that arise during the development and deployment of computer vision systems. The ideal candidate should be deeply passionate about machine learning and its real\-world applications, particularly in improving and leveraging state\-of\-the\-art neural networks to make an impact. **Requirements** * 3–5 years of industry experience building ML systems, with at least 2 years focused on computer vision. * BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Math or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Strong Python and hands\-on experience with PyTorch (or TensorFlow) for training and debugging deep learning models. * Shipped at least one computer vision model to production, and can explain the trade\-offs made along the way. * Solid grasp of CNN and transformer architectures for detection, segmentation and classification. * Experience with OpenCV and image/video processing: decoding streams, preprocessing, augmentation. * Working knowledge of model optimization for inference (ONNX, TensorRT, quantization or similar). * Comfortable with Docker, Git, Linux and training on GPUs in a cloud environment (AWS/Azure). * Sound ML fundamentals: loss functions, overfitting, class imbalance, evaluation metrics and experiment design. * Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining model behavior to non\-ML stakeholders. **Benefits** Chooch offers extensive benefits including health, dental, vision insurance, 401K with 3% match, extensive PTO, and life insurance policies included.

implement load balancing and traffic routing for business\-critical applications. * **Infrastructure as Code:** Develop and maintain reusable network deployments using Terraform and/or Bicep, integrated with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines. * **Monitoring \& Operations:** Implement network monitoring and diagnostics using Network Watcher, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics; produce design specifications, configuration records, and test evidence to support infrastructure qualification and change control in GxP environments. * **Knowledge Transfer:** Create runbooks, network diagrams, and as\-built documentation, and transition operational ownership to client IT teams by engagement close. **Required Qualifications** * 8\+ years of enterprise network engineering experience, including 4\+ years designing and supporting Azure networking in production. * Deep hands\-on expertise with ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, VNet peering, UDRs, and BGP routing. * Strong experience with Azure Firewall and/or enterprise firewall platforms (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point), including NVA deployments in Azure. * Proficiency with Terraform and/or Bicep, plus scripting in PowerShell, Azure CLI, or Python. * Solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, load balancing, network segmentation, and zero\-trust architecture. * Proven ability to work independently as a contractor, managing your own time and deliverables with minimal supervision. * Able to work on\-site in Hampton, NJ four days per week (Monday through Thursday) for the full engagement. * Authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship. **Preferred Qualifications** * Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ\-700\); Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\) or Azure Administrator (AZ\-104\). * Cisco CCNP/CCIE, Palo Alto PCNSE, or equivalent networking certifications. * Experience in life sciences or other regulated industries, including familiarity with GxP, computer system validation (CSV), and 21 CFR Part 11 considerations. * Experience with Azure Virtual WAN, SD\-WAN integration, Microsoft Entra ID, and Microsoft Defender for Cloud. * Background supporting connectivity for laboratory, manufacturing, or clinical systems. **Key Competencies** * **Technical Ownership:** Takes end\-to\-end accountability for designs, from whiteboard through deployment and documentation. * **Security Mindset:** Builds with least privilege, segmentation, and auditability as defaults, not afterthoughts. * **Problem Solving:** Diagnoses complex, cross\-domain connectivity issues quickly and methodically. * **Client Communication:** Explains technical trade\-offs clearly to client IT leaders, quality teams, and non\-technical stakeholders. * **Documentation Discipline:** Produces clear, accurate, inspection\-ready artifacts suitable for regulated environments. **Work Environment** * Hybrid, full\-time engagement: on\-site in the Hampton, NJ office Monday through Thursday, and remote on Fridays, with availability during core Eastern Time business hours. * Occasional evening or weekend work may be needed for scheduled maintenance windows and cutovers. * As an independent contractor, you determine how the work is performed to meet agreed deliverables, supply your own computer and remote workspace, and are responsible for your own taxes, insurance, and benefits. jobs.title: Staff Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value\-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record\-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team. Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder. Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France. As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on\-site interview as part of the final stages of the process. We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have. We're transforming the collecting experience with technology that brings authentication, grading, and trading into the modern era. Our products are equalizing the playing field by providing tools that make complex research analytics (including pricing, scarcity reports, and historic sales data) accessible to every collector, old or new. Our engineering mission is to democratize technology while promoting innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning throughout the organization. We're looking for a Staff Applied AI Engineer to join the Applied AI function at Collectors. This is an embedded, build\-first role with portfolio\-level ownership: you'll own a full business domain, decide which problems in it are worth solving with AI, and build and ship the solutions end\-to\-end. You'll still prototype fast and prove value in business terms, but your impact compounds beyond your own builds: the patterns you establish, the assets you make reusable, and the roadmap you shape become the way the whole team ships in your lane. This is not a traditional software engineering role, and it's not an architecture\-only role either. We're looking for a product\-minded builder who leads through shipped work: someone who can walk into an unmapped business domain, earn the trust of its leaders, build the first few wins personally, and then turn those wins into a durable portfolio. You'll report to the Head of Applied AI. Remote or hybrid candidates will also be considered. We believe that there is significant value in in\-person collaboration. ### **What You'll Do** * Own a business domain, not just a use case. You'll be accountable for the AI opportunity across an entire lane (for example Operations, Marketplace, or Finance): mapping the workflows, sizing the opportunities, and deciding what gets built, in what order, and why. * Build the hardest use cases yourself. You spend the majority of your time hands\-on. You take the first, riskiest, or most technically demanding builds in your lane from prototype through production, adoption, and measured impact. * Turn one\-off wins into reusable patterns. You notice when three builds share a shape, extract the common asset (a connector, an eval harness, a workflow pattern), and make it something every builder on the team can pick up. * Define success up front and prove it at portfolio level. You instrument outcomes before you build, and you can stand in front of the domain's leadership and account for the cumulative value your lane has delivered. * Design for earned autonomy. You build agents with the traces, evals, and human\-in\-the\-loop gates that let them graduate to more autonomy on evidence, not on elapsed time, and you help set that standard for others. * Operate as a power user of frontier AI. Use Claude, OpenAI, and our orchestration platform daily as your primary tools, and bring a strong, current point of view on models, harnesses, and tooling that informs the team's platform choices. * Win trust at the leadership level. Your stakeholders are function leaders, not just operators. You navigate competing priorities, secure sponsorship, and keep skeptical partners engaged through delivery. * Multiply the builders around you. You review designs and code, unblock senior and mid\-level engineers, raise the hiring bar as an interviewer, and make the people around you measurably better. * Build production grade applications around AI systems. You can design and implement the application layer a  you hold yourself accountable for whether the portfolio moved the numbers, not just whether things shipped. * A force multiplier. You have a track record of making other engineers better through review, mentorship, patterns, or tooling, and people you've worked with would say so unprompted. * A clear communicator. You're equally comfortable with operators on the floor, engineers in review, and executives in a readout, and you can carry a room that started out skeptical. * A continuous learner. You believe staying excellent in this field means never standing still. You actively track the latest models, tools, and techniques as they ship, form your own view on what matters, and bring the best of it back to the team. Salary Range: *The salary range for this position is* $165,848\-$269,259\. *Actual compensation on this range varies based on a variety of non\-discriminatory factors, including location, job level, experience, and skill set. This role may be eligible for bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation, please ask your recruiter for details.* Reasons To Join Us: * Health Insurance: All full\-time employees are eligible to enroll in Medical, Dental, and Vision * Additional Benefits: Full\-time employees are eligible for fertility, commuter, and educational assistance benefits * 401(K) Matching Plan: We are proud to offer a competitive 401k matching plan to our employees to support their future financial goals * Vacation: All salaried employees are eligible for flexible time\-off. * Holiday Pay: All regular, full\-time employees are eligible for ten company paid holidays * Employee Discounts: Employees receive discounts on select grading services for approved submissions * Flexible Hours: Many of our teams offer flexible schedules with varying shifts and will work with you to accommodate your needs * Fun Working Environment: Our team members are invited to participate in celebrations, holiday events, and team building activities Additional Resources: Collectors Tech Blog , PSA * Collectors uses e\-Verify to validate your ability to work legally in the United States. We are aware that there are instances where individuals are receiving job offers that fraudulently allege to be from Collectors or one of our business units. This type of fraud can be carried out through false websites, through fake e\-mails claiming to be from the company or through social media. We never ask for personal information such as your bank account, Social Security numbers or National IDs, nor do we send or request payments for the purchase of business\-related equipment. If you suspect fraud, please reach out to interviewfraud@collectors.com. *We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or other class protected by applicable law. We believe that a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills will better service the diverse community of collectors we support.* *If you require an accommodation to apply or interview with us due to a disability or special need, please email* *interviewaccommodation@collectors.com.* *U.S. residents: for disclosures relating to personal information we collect during the employment application and recruitment process, please see our* *Privacy Notice for U.S. Applicants* *.* For New York Residents: In connection with hiring, Collectors Universe, Inc. uses an automated employment decision tool (Brighthire) to assist in evaluating candidates.
