jobs.title: Full Stack Dev BB R D
jobs.description: **About Us** The Colorado Rockies Baseball Club is embracing the climb, committed to building a championship\-caliber organization on the field, in the clubhouse, and throughout our business operations. Playing at altitude presents unique competitive challenges and opportunities, and we embrace innovation, collaboration, and evidence\-based practices to support elite performance. Rooted in the traditions of America’s pastime, we operate with integrity, service, quality, and trust while striving to create an exceptional experience for our players, staff, and fans. **Position Summary** This is an exciting time to join the Colorado Rockies as we continue to evolve how technology, data, and baseball expertise come together across Baseball Operations. Baseball Systems is helping build the tools and infrastructure that will support the organization’s next chapter, turning data, scouting insights, and organizational knowledge into intuitive applications that help our people evaluate talent, develop players, identify opportunities, and make informed baseball decisions. As a Developer on Baseball Systems, you’ll help build the tools Baseball Operations relies on every day. Your primary focus will be Applications: designing and building the internal web applications that serve scouting, player development, player acquisition, and research, and owning features from data access and backend services through to the interfaces our staff use. You’ll work directly with scouts, analysts, developers, and Baseball Operations leaders to solve meaningful problems and modernize how information is used across the organization. Baseball Systems is a small team, and the work does not stop at the application layer. Where applicable, you’ll also support our Data Platform and ML Engineering work, whether that means building a pipeline that feeds an application, improving how data is modeled and served, or helping put a model output in front of the staff who use it. You’ll grow across the stack while working alongside senior engineers and contributing to our engineering standards. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities** * Build and maintain the internal web applications that serve scouting, player development, player acquisition, and research across Baseball Operations, owning features from data access through to the interface. * Develop the backend services, APIs, and data access that power our applications, along with the user interfaces built on top of them. * Build intuitive, reliable experiences for technical and non\-technical users alike, following the product direction set by Baseball Systems. * Integrate a range of data sources and formats to aggregate, model, and visualize statistical and qualitative information. * Support the Data Platform team where applicable, contributing to the pipelines, data models, and data quality checks that our applications depend on. * Support ML Engineering where applicable, helping integrate models into applications and building the services and tooling that deliver model outputs to staff. * Write well\-tested, maintainable code and maintain existing applications as requirements change or issues arise. * Follow and contribute to engineering best practices related to code quality, documentation, testing, version control, and code review. * Partner with analysts, developers, and Baseball Operations stakeholders to translate business needs into effective software solutions. **Our Team \& Environment** Baseball Systems is the engineering group within Baseball Operations, spanning Applications, Data Platform, and ML Engineering. We build and own the internal platform, working side by side with the analysts, scouts, and researchers who use it. This is a collaborative, on\-site role, and you’ll partner daily with the people your work supports, with real ownership over the features you build. Our applications are modern, typed, full\-stack web applications built on a major cloud platform, alongside a modern data platform and the machine learning workflows that run on it. The environment is actively evolving, so you’ll have input into tooling and design decisions rather than inherit a fixed, legacy system. Experience with our exact technology stack is not required; we value strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn new technologies. **Job Qualifications** * Two or more years of professional software development experience, or an equivalent combination of experience and demonstrated capability. * Experience building and maintaining production web applications, including both backend services and user\-facing interfaces. * Proficiency in a typed language such as TypeScript, with working knowledge of a modern component\-based front\-end framework (such as Svelte, React, or Vue) and core front\-end fundamentals including HTML and CSS. * Experience building backend services and APIs. * Solid SQL skills and experience working with relational databases and modern ORMs. * Experience with a major c perience. * Comfort using AI\-assisted development tools responsibly as part of a modern engineering workflow. **Work Schedule \& Location** * This role generally works standard business hours. Occasional evening or weekend work may be needed to support critical production issues, releases, or time\-sensitive Baseball Operations needs. * This is a full\-time, on\-site position based in the Denver metropolitan area. Remote work is not available for this role. * This position works standard Mountain Time business hours and will travel to Spring Training, affiliate sites, or Club events as needed. **Physical Job Requirements** * This role operates in a professional office and stadium environment. Occasional exposure to crowd noise, outdoor weather conditions, and extended hours during homestands, events, or special functions may be required. * Must be able to remain in a stationary position for extended periods, including sitting at a desk and attending meetings. * Must be able to move throughout office, stadium, and event spaces to access equipment and interact with staff and vendors. * Must be able to communicate effectively by phone, video conference, and in person and exchange accurate information. * Ability to lift up to 15 pounds occasionally, such as a laptop bag or related office materials. **Compensation \& Benefits** * Annual Salary Range: $90,000 \- $110,000 a year. This is a regular\-status, full\-time, exempt position. * As a candidate for this position, your salary and related elements of compensation will be contingent upon your work experience, education, job\-related skills, and any other factors the Colorado Rockies consider relevant to the hiring decision for this position. * In addition to the base salary, the Club believes in providing a very competitive and generous compensation and benefits package for its employees. Benefits include but are not limited to Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with employer match, generous vacation and holiday program, employee parking, employer\-provided game tickets to home games, onsite fitness classes and experiences, employee discounts on merchandise, and so much more! All benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and the terms of official plan documents, which may be modified or amended at any given time. **Application Process** * Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis but must be received by October 21, 2026\. The posting may be removed or extended at any time. * The estimated time to complete the recruitment process is by November 1, 2026\. * A note for Colorado Rockies employees: Please apply via the internal job board in UKG by following these prompts: MENU \> MYSELF \> MY COMPANY \> VIEW OPPORTUNITIES \> select the position \> CONSENT \> APPLY NOW * + If you cannot access UKG, please list your most recent Manager as an Employee Reference on your application. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Rockies baseball is for everyone! We pride ourselves on hiring, developing, and promoting talent as an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, gender, age, religion, disability, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, we will endeavor to provide reasonable accommodation to otherwise qualified job applicants and employees with known physical or mental disabilities in compliance with the ADA. All employment and promotion decisions will be decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business needs. The Colorado Rockies participate in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the United States. Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** We are seeking a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to build, automate, and support highly scalable cloud\-native platforms and digital applications. This role is responsible for improving system reliability, observability, performance, and operational excellence through Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, CI/CD automation, monitoring, and incident management. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with AWS/Azure, distributed systems, platform engineering, and enterprise observability tools, with a passion for reducing operational toil and enhancing platform resilience through automation and intelligent operations. **Responsibilities:** Reliability Engineering \& Operational Excellence * Design, implement, and support highly available, scalable, and resilient cloud\-native platforms and services. * Define, monitor, and maintain Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and Error Budgets to ensure platform reliability. * Identify, analyze, and eliminate reliability and performance bottlenecks across distributed systems. * Lead incident response, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and implementation of preventive measures. * Participate in on\-call support and production operations for mission\-critical applications and services. Observability \& Monitoring * Build and manage enterprise observability solutions leveraging tools such as Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, New Relic, and Open Telemetry. * Develop dashboards, alerts, monitoring strategies, and reporting frameworks that provide actionable operational insights. * Improve Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR) through proactive monitoring and automation. * Establish best practices for logging, distributed tracing, application monitoring, and system health management. Platform Engineering * Develop and enhance shared platform services and infrastructure utilized by multiple engineering teams. * Create self\-service capabilities and automation tools that improve developer productivity and reduce operational overhead. * Design reusable platform components, frameworks, and operational tooling. * Collaborate with architecture, engineering, and product teams to define and execute platform modernization strategies. Cloud Infrastructure \& Automation * Design, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure across AWS and Azure environments. * Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, CloudFormation, Helm, and Kubernetes manifests. * Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, deployments, scaling, and recovery processes. * Improve infrastructure consistency, governance, security, and scalability through automation and standardization. CI/CD \& DevOps Enablement * Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines to enable secure, scalable, and reliable software delivery. * Implement deployment automation, release management processes, and validation controls. * Support GitOps methodologies and continuous delivery practices. * Partner with development teams to improve deployment frequency, quality, and operational stability. Incident Management \& Resilience Engineering * Lead operational readiness assessments, disaster recovery planning, and business continuity exercises. * Develop and maintain runbooks, playbooks, escalation procedures, and automated remediation workflows. * Drive resiliency testing, chaos engineering initiatives, and fault\-tolerance improvements. * Ensure compliance with operational, security, and reliability standards. AI\-Driven Operations \& Innovation * Utilize AI\-powered observability and incident management platforms to enhance operational efficiency. * Leverage predictive analytics and automation to proactively identify risks and prevent service disruptions. * Drive adoption of intelligent operational capabilities that improve system reliability, engineering productivity, and customer experience. * Explore innovative approaches to reduce manual effort and operational toil through automation and AI\-driven solutions. Cross\-Functional Collaboration * Partner closely with Software Engineering, Platform Engineering, Cloud Architecture, Security, and Product teams to deliver reliable and scalable solutions. * Provide technical leadership and guidance on reliability best practices, automation strategies, and operational excellence. * Mentor junior engineers and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the organization. **Qualifications** * 5\+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, Platform Engineering, Cloud Operations, or a related field. * Strong experience with Linux administration, Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud platforms such as AWS and/or Azure. * Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Helm) and CI/CD pipeline automation. * Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python and Bash. * Experience supporting distributed systems, APIs, microservices, and customer\-facing applications in production environments. * Strong knowledge of monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, Open Telemetry, and New Relic. * Experience with incident management, root cause analysis (RCA), performance tuning, disaster recovery, and reliability engineering. * Understanding of Git, DevOps best practices, automation, and cloud\-native technologies. * Strong problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and collaboration skills. * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. The base salary for this position is $115,000 \- $140,000, plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. jobs.title: AI App Lead
jobs.description: Confiz is seeking an AI App Lead in Denver, CO. As the AI Lead you own both the architecture and the hands\-on delivery of AI\-powered applications built on Databricks, Python, and React. You set technical direction for a team of data, ML, and full\-stack engineers while still writing production code yourself. You will design LLM, RAG, and agentic systems on the Databricks Lakehouse, expose them through Python services, and deliver them to users through React front ends. You build secure, scalable, cost\-efficient production solutions, and you are accountable for making sure the code matches the architecture. **Responsibilities** * Leads the end\-to\-end architecture of AI solutions, including LLM applications, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows, from data ingestion to the user interface. * Designs and builds data and ML pipelines on Databricks using Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, MLflow, Databricks Workflows, and Mosaic AI (Model Serving, Vector Search, Agent Framework). * Builds and reviews production Python services (FastAPI or similar) that expose models, retrieval, and agents through secure, well\-documented REST APIs. * Architects and contributes to React (TypeScript) front ends for AI experiences, such as chat interfaces, streaming responses, source citations, and human\-in\-the\-loop review screens. * Selects LLM providers and models (e.g., Databricks\-hosted foundation models, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic) and retrieval options based on quality, latency, cost, and data\-governance fit. * Establishes LLMOps and MLOps practices: model and prompt versioning, automated evaluation, tracing, monitoring, drift detection, and retraining. * Produces architecture and design artifacts for complex AI applications and is accountable for ensuring the delivered code meets them. * Leads code and architecture reviews, and mentors engineers on RAG, agent design, prompt engineering, and evaluation. * Ensures solutions meet security, privacy, and compliance standards, including Unity Catalog access controls, PII handling, guardrails, audit trails, and jobs.title: Senior RPA Specialist
jobs.description: **Overview** You will leverage RPA development tools to replace redundant business processes, analyze the performance of RPA architecture, and refactor workflows for scalability and performance, specifically focusing on automated utility bill transactions. Serving as a key liaison, you will coordinate with external vendors for system setup and collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure all automated processes run seamlessly. **Responsibilities** As an RPA Specialist in the Electronic Space, you will: * **Design, Build, \& Deploy:** Plan, design, and develop automated robots tailored to handle utility bill transactions and complex data processing. * **Monitor \& Optimize:** Continuously monitor production robots, diagnose system exceptions, and fix or refactor code to ensure continuous, reliable business functions. * **Expand \& Innovate:** Proactively analyze current manual operations to identify additional areas of growth, scaling the footprint of automation across the department. * **System \& EDI Integration:** Assist in building and maintaining SFTP/MFT platforms and other specialized transaction systems. * **Vendor \& Internal Collaboration:** Act as the primary technical point of contact to work with external vendors on system configuration, while aligning internally with developers and testers to bring robots online. * **Testing \& Quality Assurance:** Develop and execute rigorous testing protocols to validate robot reliability and data integrity before production deployment. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Backend
jobs.description: Crazy Maple Studio is a rapidly growing entertainment and technology company with offices in the San Francisco Bay Area and Los Angeles. Our flagship platform, **ReelShort**, is a leading vertical streaming app in the U.S., with more than 8 million daily active users (DAU). Through its short\-form episodic content, ReelShort delivers compelling stories designed for today’s mobile\-first audiences. Our portfolio also includes **Chapters**, an interactive storytelling platform featuring immersive drama, fantasy, and romance experiences, and **My Fiction**, a platform dedicated to discovering and creating serialized romance stories. In 2025, Crazy Maple Studio was recognized as one of the **Global Most Loved Workplaces**, reflecting our commitment to fostering a culture that values creativity, innovation, collaboration, and employee well\-being. At Crazy Maple Studio, we’re passionate about pushing creative boundaries, exploring new possibilities in digital entertainment, and building experiences that connect with audiences around the world. **Position Overview:** We’re looking for builders. We’re putting together a small vanguard team, led directly by our executive team, with one mission: find out what AI can really do for entertainment, then ship it. ReelShort already entertains millions of people around the world. This team works outside the normal roadmap. You might take an idea on Monday, have a working demo by Friday, and put it in front of real users soon after. Some experiments will fail fast. The ones that work could become the company’s next big product. If you’ve been waiting for a place where your work gets seen, your judgment is trusted, and your growth isn’t capped by a ladder, this is it. **Why This Team:** * You work directly with the leadership. You’ll use the newest models and tools every day, and you’ll be paid to explore what comes next. * Real ownership. jobs.title: Advanced Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: **About Creative Foam:** Since 1969, Creative Foam has been a leading supplier of cellular and non\-cellular foam and plastic products for customers in the automotive, medical and composite markets. We have manufacturing locations nation\-wide and in Mexico. Our longevity and success are attributable to our innovative people, an abiding passion for quality and an unwavering commitment to our customers. Find your home at Creative Foam! **Competitive Benefits Compensation Package** * Safe working environments * World class benefits * Medical, dental, vision plans and flexible spending accounts * Company paid short term disability, long term disability, and ADD insurance * 401k with employer match * Generous holiday and vacation allotments * Dependent scholarship program * Wellness program * Referral program **Pay** Pay commensurate with education and experience. Creative Foam wants to be a great service provider to our customers. We recognize we can only do that if we are a great employer. Our success is driven by the success of our employees. Our culture focuses on these four core values: * **Be Inclusive\-**Make a difference as a TEAM, work collaboratively and support others in our effort to greatness. Constantly strive for perfection and quickly learn from our mistakes. * **Be Inventive\-**Never stop learning and push the TEAM to strive towards sustained excellence. Aim to provide our customers with the most creative solutions in the market. * **Be Responsible\-**Maintain an equitable relationship with our customers, employees, stakeholders and communities as we develop as a TEAM. * **Be Relentless\-**Demand more from yourself and the TEAM than you think is imaginable, this will drive change and only then will we achieve our goals. **\#WelcomeHomeToCreativeFoam** **Role Overview:** The Advanced Manufacturing Engineer leads the development and implementation of manufacturing processes, capital equipment, automation, tooling interfaces, and production systems for thermoformed, polyurethane (PUR), foam\-molded, and assembled products. Working across operations, quality, product development, tooling, maintenance, and external suppliers, this role industrializes new products and improves safety, quality, delivery, and cost. **Position Scope:** This position translates product and business requirements into production\-ready manufacturing solutions. Responsibilities span process concept development, equipment specification and sourcing, line layout, supplier management, installation, commissioning, validation, launch, and continuous improvement. Reasonable accommodationsmay be providedto enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** **New Product and Process Industrialization** * Develop manufacturing concepts, process flows, equipment requirements, labor plans, capacity models, material\-flow strategies, and line layouts for new products and programs. * Support tooling Design for Manufacturability (DFM) reviews as the secondary manufacturing and industrialization representative, providing input on process requirements, equipment integration, production readiness, quality, capacity, and operational risk. * Support the plant in planning and executing process trials, pilot builds, capability studies, run\-at\-rate activities, equipment validation, production\-readiness reviews, and production launches. **Capital Equipment and Automation** * Specify, source, justify, and implement capital equipment, automation systems, tooling\-related equipment, and supporting utilities. * Develop equipment Requests for Quotation (RFQs) and Statements of Work (SOWs) defining technical requirements, scope, deliverables, responsibilities, timing, acceptance criteria, and change\-control requirements. * Evaluate supplier proposals, prepare capital justifications and return\-on\-investment analyses, and manage machine builders, automation integrators, contractors, and equipment suppliers to approved scope, budget, and timing. * Lead design reviews, factory and site acceptance testing (FAT/SAT), installation, commissioning, operator and maintenance training, run\-off, and final equipment acceptance. **Manufacturing Technology and Process Ownership** * Provide technical leadership for thermoforming and vacuum forming, PUR metering and dispensing, flexible and rigid foam molding, trimming, routing, bonding, robotic handling, vision inspection, and material handling systems. * Define controls and automation requirements for PLCs, HMIs, robotics, servo systems, machine vision, sensors, safety systems, industrial networks, and equipment interfaces. * Partner with maintenance, operations, and suppliers to resolve equipment, tooling, controls, utility, material, and process\-performance issues. * Establish and verify process windows, cycle times, capacity, quality controls, equipment performance targets, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) requirements. **Production Support and Continuous Improvement** * Provide hands\-on engineering support during equipment launch, production ramp\-up, process changes, and resolution of complex manufacturing issues. * Monitor process capability and equipment performance; lead structured root\-cause analysis and corrective actions for safety, quality, scrap, downtime, and throughput concerns. * Improve OEE, throughput, labor efficiency, process capability, material utilization, ergonomics, and total manufacturing cost. **Documentation, Quality Systems and Compliance** * Develop and maintain PFMEAs, control plans, process specifications, standard work, equipment documentation, spare\-parts requirements, and preventive\-maintenance inputs. * Support APQP, PPAP, VDA, ISO, IATF, customer, and internal audit requirements applicable to assigned processes and launches. * Complete or coordinate machine safety risk assessments and ensure equipment and processes comply with company safety requirements, applicable standards, and operational procedures. **Required Education and Experience** * A bachelor’s degree in Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Manufacturing Engineering is required. * A minimum of three years of experience in manufacturing engineering, advanced manufacturing, process engineering, automation engineering, equipment engineering, or new product launch is required. Candidates must have independently led capital\-equipment or production\-line projects from concept and specification through installation, validation, and production launch. **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:** This position has no direct reports but provides technical leadership to cross\-functional teams and directs the work of equipment suppliers, automation integrators, contractors, and other project resources. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Demonstrated ability to develop manufacturing processes and production systems from concept through validated launch and stable production. * Experience specifying, sourcing, installing, commissioning, validating, and improving capital equipment and automated manufacturing systems. * Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical information to plant teams, leadership, customers, machine builders, integrators, and suppliers. * Ability to work independently, manage concurrent priorities, and lead cross\-functional teams. Regular travel of approximately 40–60% is expected to support company plants, equipment suppliers, integrators, and customer locations. * Working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, DOE, root\-cause analysis, process capability, capacity analysis, and OEE. * Ability to interpret product drawings, tooling designs, machine layouts, mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, fluid\-power diagrams, technical specifications, and supplier proposals. * Ability to develop capacity models, cycle\-time analyses, equipment acceptance criteria, capital justifications, budgets, schedules, and technical reports. * Strong project management, supplier management, organizational, and technical leadership skills. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, and working knowledge of AutoCAD, SolidWorks, NX, or comparable CAD/layout tools. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Experience with thermoforming or vacuum forming equipment, trim systems, tool qualification, and thick\-gauge thermoplastic processing. * Experience with polyurethane (PUR), flexible or rigid foam molding, metering and dispensing systems, mold temperature control, and related process equipment. * Experience with robotics, machine vision, PLC\-controlled automation, safety systems, material handling, and equipment integration. * Experience in automotive interiors, headliners, trim systems, NVH foam products, composites, plastics, or other high\-volume manufacturing operations.

jobs.description: **About Cresset** Cresset is a firm built by clients, for clients. As an independent, award\-winning multi\-family office and private investment firm, we are reimagining the way wealth is experienced. Our purpose is to help ensure that both wealth and life are fully optimized\*\*—integrated, intentional, and aligned with each client’s vision of success. We provide access to the caliber of talent, ideas, and investment opportunities typically available to the largest single\-family offices and institutions. Our approach is personalized, entrepreneurial, and client\-first. Cresset was built to endure. This role is responsible for operationalizing the firm’s AI strategy—translating prioritized initiatives into production\-grade workflows, systems, and tools that are embedded into how teams work every day. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer and working in close partnership with the Head of AI Strategy, this leader ensures that AI initiatives are effectively implemented, adopted, and optimized to deliver measurable business impact. You will work closely with Technology, Data, and business teams across Advisory, Investments, Client Service, Operations, and Marketing to design, build, and scale AI\-enabled capabilities that improve efficiency, enhance client experience, and drive firm\-wide productivity. **Key Responsibilities** **AI Solution Delivery \& Execution** * Own end\-to\-end delivery of AI initiatives, from requirements gathering through deployment, scaling, and ongoing optimization. * Translate prioritized use cases and strategic objectives into actionable implementation plans, technical designs, and deliverables. * Ensure AI solutions are production\-ready, reliable, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards. **Workflow Automation \& Process Transformation** * Analyze and redesign business processes to incorporate AI, automation, and intelligent workflows. * Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, increase speed, and improve accuracy across core functions. * Build scalable frameworks and reusable components to accelerate automation across the organization. **Technology Integration \& Architecture** * Partner with Technology and Data teams to integrate AI capabilities into enterprise systems. * Oversee APIs, data pipelines, and system integrations required to support AI\-enabled workflows. * Ensure seamless interoperability across internally built systems and third\-party platforms. **Vendor Implementation \& Management** * Partner with the Head of AI Strategy on vendor selection, then lead implementation, configuration, and ongoing management of AI tools and platforms. * Manage relationships with external vendors and development partners to ensure timely, high\-quality delivery. * Monitor vendor performance and optimize platform utilization to maximize value. **Adoption, Enablement \& Change Management** * Drive firm\-wide adoption of AI tools and workflows through training, onboarding, and embedded support. * Ensure solutions are intuitive, accessible, and aligned with user needs to maximize engagement and usage. * Partner with business leaders to embed AI into team workflows and performance expectations. **Program Delivery \& Performance Management** * Own and maintain a clear, prioritized execution roadmap aligned with the firm’s AI strategy. * Establish delivery standards, timelines, and governance for AI and automation initiatives. * Track and report on adoption, performance, and ROI of deployed solutions, continuously improving outcomes. **Continuous Improvement \& Innovation** * Stay current on emerging AI tools, automation platforms, and best practices. * Rapidly test, iterate, and scale new capabilities to enhance the firm’s AI ecosystem. * Support integration of new capabilities into existing systems, including those related to M\&A activities. **Partnership with Head of AI Strategy** * The Head of AI Strategy defines the vision, priorities, and roadmap for AI across the firm. * The Head of AI Automation \& Enablement owns execution—ensuring those priorities are successfully delivered, adopted, and scaled. This role serves as the critical bridge between strategy and implementation, providing feedback on feasibility, performance, and adoption to continuously refine the firm’s AI strategy. **Qualifications** * 10\+ years of experience in technology delivery, digital transformation, automation, or enterprise systems implementation. * Proven track record of delivering and scaling workflow, automation, or AI\-driven solutions in complex organizations. * Strong hands\-on experience with system integrations, APIs, workflow automation tools, and enterprise platforms. * Familiarity with AI tools and capabilities, including large language models, copilots, and intelligent automation. * Experience managing vendors, implementation partners, and cross\-functional delivery teams. * Strong program and project management skills, with the ability to execute across multiple concurrent initiatives. * Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and deliver measurable outcomes. **Preferred Experience** * Experience in financial services, wealth management, or a regulated industry. * Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Snowflake, Box, and workflow automation tools. * Experience with low\-code/no\-code platforms, RPA, or AI\-enabled productivity tools. * Background in process engineering, systems architecture, or enterprise integration. **What Success Looks Like** * AI\-powered workflows embedded across core business functions * High adoption and sustained usage of AI tools across teams * Seamless integration of AI capabilities into enterprise systems * Significant reduction in manual processes and operational inefficiencies * Measurable improvements in productivity, scalability, and client experience **What We Offer:** At Cresset, we focus on people first. As a service business, our people are our assets. Engaging our clients and employees is our highest priority. Starting salary is $175,000 \- $200,000\. Salary will be based on factors including, but not limited to, experience, licenses/certifications, industry knowledge, and geographic location. It is Cresset’s policy to comply with applicable laws concerning the employment of persons with disabilities, including reasonable accommodation for applicants and employees with disabilities. **Everything Starts With Culture.** **Our Vision** We exist to optimize wealth and elevate life—giving clients the time, clarity, and trusted partnership to pursue what matters most. **Our Values** * Disclosures related to awards, recognitions, and rankings available here. * Barron's Top 100 RIA Firms (issued 09\.2026\). Based on data from July of the prior year through June of the award year. Rankings are determined using a proprietary methodology that considers qualitative and quantitative factors. Cresset paid a licensing fee to use the Barron's award logos. \*\*Wealth Optimized, Life Elevated refers to the firm’s philosophy and process in providing advisory and planning services and is not intended to convey a guarantee of results. Cresset refers to Cresset Capital Management, LLC and its respective direct and indirect subsidiaries and controlled affiliates. For a full list of Cresset subsidiaries and controlled affiliates, please see cressetcapital.com/disclosures/.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer, Managed SIEM
jobs.description: Who We Are: Ready to make a real impact in cybersecurity? At Critical Start, we're not just protecting organizations; we're redefining how it's done. We're a team united by an inspiring purpose: to stop breaches, simplify security, and shape the future of cyber defense. If you're passionate about cutting\-edge technology, thrive in a collaborative environment, and want your work to truly matter, you've found your home. We deliver 24x7 AI\-accelerated, human\-validated detection, investigation, and response across IT and OT. This means we cut through the noise, investigate real threats, and take trusted, SLA\-backed action—all powered by the brightest minds and the latest AI. Since 2012, we've been helping organizations outpace evolving attacks with faster response, fewer escalations, and measurable risk reduction. Innovation isn't just a buzzword here; it's our DNA. We pioneered the first MOBILESOC app for on\-the\-go detection and response, infused AI into automated alert resolution to eliminate noise, and slashed investigation time by an astounding 99\.3%. We're transforming how security teams work, and you could be a part of it. From AI\-assisted triage to analyst copilots that elevate human expertise, we combine machine intelligence with human judgment to deliver outcomes our customer’s trust. If you're looking for a high\-trust, high\-impact team where your ideas are amplified by AI and valued by colleagues and customers alike, Critical Start is the place for you. Come build the future of cybersecurity with us. Want to hear from our team? Watch these videos to gain insights into life at Critical Start or check out our Glassdoor reviews for an inside look. Who You Are: We are searching for a dedicated and proficient Cybersecurity Engineer to join our Managed Security Services team. Your responsibilities will include monitoring and maintaining multiple SIEM environments within the scope of Critical Start's Managed Services offerings. You will collaborate with both team members and clients to onboard and support various security technologies such as Microsoft Sentinel and Splunk, while also creating customized solutions to enhance our services. The perfect candidate should have extensive knowledge of Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) tools, including Microsoft Sentinel and Splunk. What You Will Be Doing?: Your daily tasks involve configuring data sources and log forwarders, creating custom content (dashboards, workbooks, reports, alerts), conducting thorough environment reviews and gap analyses, and fulfilling advanced SIEM requests.* **Maintain Expertise:** Stay at the forefront of the industry by continuously updating your knowledge in SIEM tools. * **Client Engagement:** Deliver our managed services to clients through project\-based workflows related to SIEM technologies. * **Technical Guidance:** Provide technical leadership, expertise, and configuration assistance to both colleagues and clients, helping them maintain robust and effective SIEM security programs. * **Technical Development:** Collaborate on developing technical pathways to foster growth within the organization and lead cross\-functional training sessions. * **Best Practices:** Create and maintain best practices and assist clients in deploying and configuring security policies, log forwarders, data sources, content, and alerts. * **Security Maturation:** Assist clients in maturing their SIEM security products in alignment with industry standards and our program offerings. * **Problem Resolution:** Troubleshoot interactions between data sources and SIEM technologies, as well as API interactions between supported security integrations and our platform (CORR). * **Automation:** Identify opportunities to automate aspects of SIEM engineering workload, enhancing efficiency and accuracy. * **Client Collaboration:** Work closely with clients to address technical concerns, provide value reporting, and configure their environments effectively. * **Documentation:** Develop and maintain comprehensive security documentation, including playbooks, standard operating procedures, and training materials as needed. * **Continuous Learning:** Stay up\-to\-date with the latest security threats and trends, incorporating this knowledge into our security solutions. Obtain and maintain relevant security certifications. * **Team Collaboration:** Collaborate with fellow cybersecurity engineers, product managers, and architects to design and implement innovative security solutions, ensuring the highest level of protection for our clients. What You Will Bring?: **Required Qualifications:*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or equivalent experience and industry certifications. * 2\+ years of experience in a cybersecurity engineering role * 2\+ years of experience with SIEM tools, specifically Splunk \& Microsoft Sentinel. * Proficiency in handling security data sources, log formats, and data ingestion method ical, dental, and vision * Additional Ancillary Benefits offered at 100% employee contribution * Unlimited PTO (Paid Time Off) policy * Paid Parental and Military Leave * Dental and Vision Plan * Employer\-provided Life Insurance, Long\-Term Disability, and Short\-Term Disability coverage * Additional Voluntary Life Insurance coverage * 401(k) Plan with Matching Program * Mines Employee Assistance Program * Monthly Wellness Initiatives * Optional Pet Benefits Discount Plan We prioritize your privacy and security. Please note that Critical Start will never request financial information or sensitive personal data during the interview process. If you encounter any suspicious requests, do not respond and contact us directly at recruiting@criticalstart.com. Thank you for helping us maintain a safe and trustworthy hiring experience. Critical Start welcomes people from all backgrounds and walks of life. One of our core values is to “Do what’s best for our employees,” and that starts with the hiring process by finding the best candidates and providing an environment that upholds equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants, strictly prohibiting any form of discrimination or harassment based on race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy encompasses all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. **Mental and Physical Requirements** It's important to note that specific physical and mental requirements may vary depending on the nature of the office job, organization, and individual responsibilities. **Physical:*** Stationary position for extended periods of time. * Constantly operate a computer. * Occasionally you may be required to move equipment or other items up to 20 lbs. * The ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations. **Mental:*** Must be able to apply established protocols in a timely manner. * Make timely decisions in the context of workflow. * Ability to complete tasks and perform in situations requiring speed deadlines, or productivity quota. * Ability to work effectively and efficiently in high stress situations. * Ability to simultaneously address multiple complex problems. For positions that can or will be performed, in whole or in part, remotely within the U.S., range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation (sales roles only). **Compensation:** The total compensation range (base) being offered for this role is \[$80,000 \- $110,000 USD]. **Additional Compensation:** This role is not eligible for additional or other forms of compensation. **Employment Benefits:** Comprehensive health benefits with generous employer contributions for medical, dental, and vision, unlimited PTO (Paid Time Off) policy, paid Parental and Military Leave, dental and vision plan, Employer\-provided Life Insurance (up to $100K coverage), Long\-Term Disability, and Short\-Term Disability coverage, 401(k) Plan with Matching Program, 24/7/365 availability of Employee Assistance Program. **Application Deadline:** The application deadline for this position is November 20, 2026\. **How to Apply:** Interested candidates are invited to visit our career site and apply for the position: https://www.criticalstart.com/careers/ \#LI\-CV1 \#LI\-Remote

jobs.title: Software Engineer V (Engineering Lead)
jobs.description: As the Engineering Lead for the Bank Processing project, you will own the technical design and hands\-on development of CrossLink’s bank processing platform. You will build backend services, integrate with banking partners, and deliver secure, reliable transaction processing from initial development through production. This role is primarily focused on architecture, coding, and technical problem solving, with the ability to guide and mentor one or two engineers as needed. **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Own the platform architecture and technical design, translating business and banking requirements into practical software solutions. * Personally develop, test, and maintain backend services, APIs, and transaction processing workflows. * Design data models and processing logic for payments, disbursements, reconciliation, and reporting, with a focus on accuracy and auditability. * Implement validation, duplicate prevention, error handling, and recovery mechanisms to protect transaction integrity. * Work with the CTO, business stakeholders, compliance, IT, and banking partners to clarify requirements and resolve technical dependencies. * Establish code quality and testing practices; review contributions and document architecture, interfaces, and operational procedures. * Guide and mentor one or two engineers as needed, coordinating work and resolving technical blockers while remaining an active contributor. * Troubleshoot complex issues and support deployment, monitoring, performance tuning, and production readiness. * Communicate progress, technical tradeoffs, risks, and resource needs to management. * Perform other duties as required. **KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS** * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline required. * 5–10 years of software development experience, including ownership of complex backend systems from design through production. * Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently, explain technical decisions, and collaborate across departments. * Advanced programming skills in Java, C, C\+\+, Go, or an equivalent backend language, with substantial recent hands\-on coding experience. * Strong knowledge of backend architecture, API design, system integration, and reliable transaction processing. * Strong relational database and SQL skills, including schema design, transactions, query optimization, and data integrity; PostgreSQL experience preferred. * Proficiency in troubleshooting and debugging complex applications, including performance and production issues. * Experience with source control, automated testing, CI/CD, logging, and monitoring. * Ability to build secure systems that handle sensitive data. * Ability to lead technical work, review code, and mentor a small number of engineers while maintaining substantial individual development responsibilities. **ADDITIONAL PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience with banking, payment processing, financial systems, or refund transfer platforms. * Familiarity with ACH/NACHA files, settlement, and reconciliation. * Experience developing APIs and backend services in Golang. * Experience serving as a technical lead or mentoring engineers on a small project team. * Knowledge of IIS and .NET development. * Experience with AWS CodeDeploy and CodeBuild. * Familiarity with frontend frameworks such as React or Angular. * Experience working in an agile environment using Jira or similar tools. * Experience with the AWS ecosystem, including compute and deployment services such as EC2 and ECS.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Strategist - NextGen (Remote)
jobs.description: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. **About the Role:** Our Product CTO organization includes a team of Technical Strategy leaders that bring outstanding ideas, the ability to execute, and teamwork to a strategic, high future impact organization. The primary responsibility of this role is to define and drive the company's technical vision, product strategy, and platform narrative for our Next\-Gen SIEM and Log Management products. This role requires deep technical knowledge in AI, SIEM/SOAR, log management, and data analysis and a functional understanding of actual real\-world deployments, extended use\-cases, and customer motivations. The ideal candidate doesn't just advise on strategy: they define what we build, why, and in what order, and they articulate how NGSIEM anchors CrowdStrike's platform consolidation story. jobs.title: Research Engineer, Machine Learning, GeminiApp Personalization, DeepMind
jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages. * 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture. * 3 years of experience with machine learning algorithms and tools (e.g., TensorFlow), recommender systems, deep learning, or personalization. 3 years of experience with software development in either of these programming languages: Python or C\+\+. * ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field. * 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role. * Experience developing accessible technologies. * Experience in Natural Language Processing (NLP), Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI. **About the job** ----------------- At Google DeepMind our mission is to build the world's first general\-purpose learning agent. Central to this mission is the complex task of measuring the intelligence of our prototypes. As a Software Engineer, you will be working with the cutting edge AI agents developed by our exceptional team of Machine Learning and Neuroscience research scientists. Your responsibilities will include everything from creating systems for agent testing using 2D and 3D games to developing test problems within physics simulators. You will create graphical visualization of results, build competitive agent leaderboards and test new algorithms on robots. To succeed in this role you will need to have a strong foundation in software engineering and enjoy working on a wide range of challenging problems within a mission\-driven team. We are the Gemini App team at Google DeepMind, building Google's next\-generation AI assistant. Stay at the forefront of innovation with Gemini, which features native multimodality, an expansive context window of up to 2 million tokens, and excellent performance. Our mission is to empower billions of people by providing deeply personalized and helpful products. In this role, you will help build a personal AI assistant tailored to the unique interests, passions, and curiosities of every individual. Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high\-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority. We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $174000 \- $252000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design, prototype, and build robust, scalable, user\-facing personalization features on the full Gemini App stack. * Perform relevant data analysis of user feedback, logs, and evaluation tasks to identify personalization\-related quality issues and opportunities. * Propose and implement targeted quality improvements via fine\-tuning or prompting. * Develop robust evaluation techniques (both automated and with a human in the loop) to assess and hill\-climb on personalization quality. * Partner closely with research scientists, engineers, and cross\-functional partners (product and program managers) to advance the business goals of the organization. jobs.description: **Location** ------------ USA \- Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Sales \- AE **Compensation** ---------------- * OTE 270k\-330k $185K – $230K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission This range is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills and experience. There may be instances where a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description. Please note that the compensation details listed on US role postings reflect the base salary only and does not include bonus, equity or benefits. **Company Overview** ==================== Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion\-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real\-time APIs for speech\-to\-text (STT), text\-to\-speech (TTS), and building production\-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300\+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice\-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self\-hosted and on\-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. **Company Operating Rhythm** ============================ At Deepgram, we expect an AI\-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day\-to\-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9\-to\-5\. **The Opportunity** ------------------- Enterprises are moving fast from transcribing conversations to automating them. Contact centers, healthcare, financial services and consumer brands are putting voice agents in front of their customers. The buyers range from CX leaders to platform engineers, and the deals turn on latency, reliability, cost per minute and whether the agent holds up in production. Deepgram is hiring a Staff Sales Engineer, Voice Agent to drive adoption of our Voice Agent platform globally. You’ll work alongside every Account Executive on the team as the technical lead on voice agent deals, and you’ll carry a quota for new Voice Agent logos and ARR. Most of your time is spent in front of customers: positioning Deepgram in discovery, winning the technical evaluation and getting customers to production. You report to the VP of Sales. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Win voice agent deals.** Lead discovery, technical qualification, architecture and proofs of concept for Voice Agent opportunities, and own the technical win from first call through production. * **Be the expert in the room.** Whiteboard how a customer's telephony stack (SIP trunks, PBX, CCaaS) connects to their voice agents and where Deepgram fits. Go deep on latency, turn\-taking, interruption handling, function calling, cost per minute and build vs. buy. * **Build what sells.** Ship demos, reference agents and integration patterns across LLMs, telephony/SIP, CCaaS platforms and orchestration frameworks that AEs and customers can use on day one. * **Carry the number.** Own a quota tied to Voice Agent growth and run your pipeline and forecast with discipline. * **Make the team better.** Create the positioning, competitive battlecards, objection handling and enablement that let every AE sell Voice Agent with confidence, even when you are not on the call. * **Bring the field into Product.** Turn patterns from deals into clear, evidence\-backed requirements for our API, SDKs and docs. * **Work the ecosystem.** Partner with CCaaS, telephony and LLM partners to build joint solutions and co\-sell plays. **What You Bring** ------------------ * 7\+ years in customer\-facing technical roles such as solutions engineering, sales engineering, solutions architecture or forward\-deployed engineering, ideally at an API, CPaaS, CCaaS or conversational AI company. * Hands\-on voice agent experience across the stack: telephony (SIP, WebRTC, PBX or CCaaS integration), orchestration (LLM agent frameworks, tool calling, real\-time streaming pipelines) and models (STT, TTS, LLMs). * You build. You've shipped demos, POCs or production integrations in Python, Node.js or similar, and you can show us something you've built. * A track record in revenue\-tied roles. You've been measured on technical wins, pipeline or quota, and you consistently hit your targets. * Comfort leading complex, multi\-stakeholder enterprise deals with everyone from platform engineers to CX executives. * Clear communication. You can walk an engineer through a SIP call flow and a VP through a cost\-per\-minute business case in the same meeting. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Voice agents built on frameworks or platforms like Pipecat, LiveKit, Vapi, Retell or OpenAI Realtime * Contact center domain experience (Genesys, NICE, Five9, Amazon Connect, Talkdesk or similar) * Experience carrying an individual or overlay quota * Hands\-on work with MCP servers, agent harnesses or CLI tools, or open\-source contributions with real adoption * Familiarity with Challenger or a similar sales methodology * Experience selling across both self\-serve and enterprise motions ***Notice****: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @**deepgram.com* *email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.* Compensation Range: $185K \- $230K

jobs.title: Engineer / Technical Project Manager — Junior to Mid-Level
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Engineer / Technical Project Manager **Experience Level:** Junior to Mid\-Level / 1–5 years in engineering, energy systems, project management, or related technical field **Education Level:** Engineering degree preferred; related technical field (energy systems, environmental science, applied science) acceptable **Location:** Must be based in Alaska; Anchorage office presence preferred, Anchorage residents will be expected to come to the office 2–3 days/week when not traveling **Travel:** Site visits to rural Alaska communities expected; frequency determined by project portfolio **ABOUT THE ROLE** DeerStone Consulting is growing its technical team and looking for someone ready to dig in. This is not a support role where you sit behind a senior engineer waiting to be handed tasks; you will own projects. Smaller ones at first, with senior oversight, but yours. You’ll also contribute to larger, more complex efforts alongside our senior technical staff, which means you’ll get exposure to the full project lifecycle fast: development, design, grant support, community engagement, construction coordination, and commissioning. DeerStone is a fast\-moving consulting firm. Projects come in varied shapes, clients have urgent needs, and the work spans technical, relational, and logistical terrain that isn’t always neatly defined. We need someone who is smart, adaptable, and genuinely interested in figuring things out; someone who sees a new challenge as an opportunity, not a problem. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 1\. Project Ownership: Independently manage smaller\-scale renewable energy projects (solar PV, BESS, microgrid) from scoping through construction coordination, with senior technical oversight. 2\. Technical Support: Support senior engineers and project managers on complex multi\-community or large\-scale energy projects; contribute to technical analysis, modeling, design, and documentation. 3\. Technical Analysis: Assist with energy system modeling, equipment evaluation, feasibility analysis, and technical report writing. 4\. Grant \& Proposal Contribution: Contribute to grant applications and funding proposals with technical content, data, and narrative support. 5\. Community Engagement: Engage with Tribal and community clients in a respectful, culturally aware manner; participate in community meetings and stakeholder coordination. 6\. Field Work: Travel to project sites in rural Alaska for site assessments, installation support, and community visits. 7\. Documentation \& Reporting: Maintain accurate project files, schedules, and documentation; contribute to client reporting. 8\. Professional Growth: Grow technically, professionally, and in your understanding of the communities we serve. **QUALIFICATIONS** * 1–5 years of experience in engineering, energy systems, project management, or a related technical field * Engineering degree preferred (mechanical, electrical, civil, energy systems, or related); a related technical degree with strong demonstrated skills is acceptable * Interest in or exposure to renewable energy systems: solar PV, battery storage, microgrids, or hybrid power * Strong organizational skills with the ability to juggle tasks across multiple active projects without dropping things * Clear, confident communicator, in writing and in person, with technical and non\-technical audiences alike * Willingness to travel to rural and remote communities in Alaska, including via small aircraft **WHAT WE’RE REALLY LOOKING FOR** We work in a fast\-paced consulting environment where you get thrown into a lot of things and need to figure them out. The best people on our team are curious, resilient, and energized by variety. Formal experience matters less to us than the right attitude and the ability to learn quickly. Specifically, we’re looking for someone who: * Is genuinely interested in rural Alaska, energy access, and the communities we serve, not just the technical work * Picks things up fast and doesn’t wait to be told exactly what to do * Brings a good attitude into difficult, ambiguous, or high\-pressure situations * Is honest about what they know and what they don’t, and goes and finds out * Wants to grow into a full project and client lead over time Hands\-on experience is a big plus. Field work, installation, construction support, O\&M, or anything that got you out of the office and into the work. Prior exposure to grant writing, technical reporting, rural communities, or Alaska Native culture will make you stand out. EIT or PE candidacy is welcomed but not required. **COMPENSATION \& WORK ENVIRONMENT** DeerStone is a small consulting firm. Compensation is pay\-only; we do not offer a traditional benefits package. Instead, pay is structured to be inclusive of benefits, and we offer a Simple IRA with up to 3% employer matching contributions. What we do offer is a lot of flexibility. We believe in accountability to projects and clients, not to a rigid schedule. We accommodate life, as long as you show up when it counts: for your clients, your team, and your commitments. This position must be based in Alaska. When not traveling, we expect in\-office presence 2–3 days per week (Anchorage) to support team building, collaboration, and the kind of working relationships that make a small firm function well. **HOW TO APPLY** Apply directly through this listing; *must include a Cover Letter.* Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $105,000\.00 \- $165,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Flexible schedule Ability to Commute: * Anchorage, AK 99503 (Required) Ability to Relocate: * Anchorage, AK 99503: Relocate before starting work (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Anchorage, AK 99503

jobs.title: Associate Systems Engineer, Data Management
jobs.description: **Associate Systems Engineer, Data Management** Our field sales professionals rely on proactive technical support during the sales process – and our expert Systems Engineering team always steps up to the mark. We lead the development and implementation of complex and specialized products, applications, services and solutions. From delivering sales presentations and product demonstrations, to developing detailed installation or system integration plans, we ensure customers get the innovative, relevant, interoperable solutions they need. Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a Senior Systems Engineer on our Systems Engineering Team in **the East Region of the US.** **What you’ll achieve** As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will provide pre\-sales technical support to our field sales teams, helping to define the overall Dell Technologies solution for our customers using the full range of company products and services. **You will:** * Build and lead relationships for highly sophisticated customer accounts * Conduct customer needs analysis and anticipate requirements beyond existing solution’s scope * Prepare detailed product specifications to enable the sale of our products and solutions, and deliver impact presentations at customer facilities * Verify operability of sophisticated product and service configurations within the customer’s environment * Perform advanced systems integration and provide technical expertise to design and implement the solution **Take the first step towards your dream career** Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role: **Technical Skills** * Hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud data platform (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Cloudera, Synapse, or similar). * Strong understanding of data warehousing, data lakes/lakehouse, and ETL/ELT concepts (staging, modeling, performance tuning, cost/perf tradeoffs). * Data engineering and integration including unstructured data processing (PDFs, logs, images, text) and transformation into structured/vectorized formats * Strong SQL skills for analytical queries, performance tuning, and data modeling (star/snowflake schemas, dimensional modeling, partitioning, clustering). * Unstructured data \& AI/RAG: Understanding of vector databases (e.g., Elasticsearch, Milvus, pgvector), embedding models, and RAG architectures. Familiarity with document processing pipelines, chunking strategies, and semantic search patterns. * Familiarity with data pipeline and orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Spark, Kafka, cloud\-native ETL tools) and batch vs. streaming patterns. * Understanding of data governance (catalog, lineage, security, RBAC, masking, compliance requirements like GDPR/CCPA). * Analytics, BI, and data science * Ability to design and explain analytics solutions end\-to\-end: from raw data to dashboards and predictive models. * Working knowledge of BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Qlik) and how to connect, model, and optimize for self\-service analytics. * Familiarity with data science and ML workflows (feature engineering, experimentation, model training/deployment, RAG pipeline development, prompt engineering) and tools/languages such as Python, Spark, notebooks, and ML frameworks (e.g., scikit\-learn, MLflow, TensorFlow/PyTorch, LangChain, LlamaIndex at a conceptual level). **Consulting Skills** * Skilled at asking the right questions to uncover technical requirements, constraints, and business drivers. * Can translate ambiguous business problems into clear data and analytics use cases. * Storytelling \& communication * Excellent at translating complex technical topics into clear, business\-oriented narratives for both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Comfortable presenting to large groups and senior stakeholders (CIO/CDO, Heads of Data/Analytics). * Demo \& POC excellence * Able to build and deliver compelling demonstrations that tell a story around customer data and use cases, not just features. * Can structure and run POCs with clear success criteria, timelines, and executive readouts to accelerate technical win. * Competitive positioning * Understands the broader data \& AI ecosystem and can articulate differentiation versus other data warehouses, data lake/lakehouse platforms, and analytics tools. **5\+ years in a customer\-facing technical role such as Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, Data Engineer, Analytics Consultant, or Data Scientist with strong commercial exposure.** **Proven experience architecting and delivering data management, analytics, or data science solutions in one or more of the following areas:** * Cloud data warehouse or lakehouse migrations * Enterprise BI modernization/self\-service analytics * GenAI and RAG implementations for enterprise knowledge management, intelligent document processing, or customer\-facing AI applications * Real\-time or streaming analytics * Advanced analytics / data science enablement * Hands\-on experience with at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and one or more leading data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, Cloudera, BigQuery, Redshift, Synapse).

jobs.description: **Senior Analyst, Agentic AI Engineer** Our team sits at the forefront of Dell's Agentic AI transformation. Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a **Senior Analyst, Agentic AI Engineer** on our **Services Operations AI Transformation** team in **Round Rock, Texas**. **What you’ll achieve** In this position as **Senior Analyst, Agentic AI Engineer**, you will help scale Dell Technologies' enterprise AI transformation by embedding directly with operational teams to identify, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions that improve business outcomes. You will combine hands\-on engineering expertise with program management discipline, translating complex workflows into production\-ready AI agents that automate and enhance operations. Working closely with stakeholders across multiple domains, you will drive solutions from discovery through deployment while helping establish the governance, standards, and processes required to scale AI adoption across the organization. **You will:** * Partner with operations teams to analyze workflows, identify automation opportunities, and translate business processes into scalable AI agent specifications. * Design, develop, test, and deploy AI\-powered agents and workflows using large language models, retrieval systems, and enterprise data sources. * Define evaluation frameworks, monitor production performance, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve solution accuracy and adoption. * Manage AI portfolio intake, tracking, governance, and stage\-gate processes to ensure successful delivery and compliance with enterprise standards. * Create reusable templates, documentation, and best practices that enable broader adoption and scalable delivery of AI solutions across multiple business domains. **Take the first step towards your dream career** **Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table.
