jobs.title: IDT Forward Deployed Engineer, Zora AI
jobs.description: **The Team** This role sits within Zora AI™ by Deloitte, Deloitte's product\-focused asset business for back office capabilities, part of Deloitte Consulting's Innovation \& Delivery Transformation (I\&DT) practice. I\&DT brings an engineering\- and innovation\-led mindset to how Deloitte builds, delivers, and scales technology\-enabled solutions. Forward Deployed Engineers operate at the intersection of client delivery, applied engineering, and product strategy \- partnering with account and product teams pre\-sale to qualify and shape opportunities, and with client and delivery teams post\-sale to prove and accelerate agentic value, feeding real\-world learnings back into the platform roadmap. **Position Summary** As a Product Focused Forward Deployed Engineer (pFDE) within Zora AI™ by Deloitte, you will work directly with clients, Deloitte Consulting's broader consulting practice, and Zora AI's product and engineering teams. Together, you'll advise, demonstrate and architect Zora AI's agentic use cases to meet client's needs \- starting from Deloitte's Zora AI Platform and its inventory of Product based SKUs \- into production\-scale capabilities in each client's environment, powering performance improvement across financial, sourcing \& procurement, Human resource and IT services domains. This is a techno\-functional role: it requires both deep technical skill and deep functional domain knowledge, brought together to adapt agentic capabilities to the specific workflows, data, and nuances of each client. You'll operate at the intersection of client delivery, applied engineering, and product feedback: engaging with clients and core consulting teams both pre\- and post\-sale, and partnering with Zora AI's product and engineering teams to translate field learnings into reusable capabilities. The role draws on functional breadth rather than a single specialty, spanning many functional domains. Recruiting for this role ends on 10/22/2027\. **Work you'll do** * **Presales \& solution shaping.** Partner with consulting teams and Zora AI's account and product teams during the sales cycle \- running technical discovery, demonstrations, and use\-case fit assessments that qualify client needs and shape a credible path to production value. * **Agentic use case development.** Work hand\-in\-hand with clients to build out agentic use cases on Digital Worker Workbench (DWW) \- sometimes adapting and extending Deloitte's library of proven use cases, other times building greenfield to solve a client\-specific problem for proofs of concepts. * **Client enablement \& value realization.** Support client awareness, business case activities, and stay engaged post\-launch to help identify expansion opportunities grounded in real usage. * **Field\-to\-product feedback.** Capture recurring client needs, patterns, and delivery learnings, and translate them into concrete agentic capability requests and reusable extensions for product and engineering teams. The successful candidate would possess these skills: * Client\-facing credibility to translate technical tradeoffs and constraints into clear business decisions, carrying both technical and executive conversations within the same engagement * Genuine techno\-functional profile \- deep technical capability paired with deep functional domain fluency, applying both together to adapt agentic solutions to real client workflows * Strong functional domain knowledge spanning back office domains \- such as finance, sourcing \& procurement, human resources and IT services \- with the versatility to apply it across multiple areas rather than a single specialty * Strong hands\-on configuration skills, including proficiency in agentic concepts and comfort working with APIs, data integration patterns, and cloud\-based services (e.g., AWS) to solution production\-grade capabilities in client environments * Hands\-on experience designing, adapting, or hardening agentic workflows \- multi\-agent coordination, tool invocation, memory/state management \- using modern agent frameworks, with the judgment to take a working use case to a production\-grade client deployment * Intellectual curiosity and a strong pull toward what's next \- actively following how agentic frameworks, tooling, and techniques are evolving, and quick to adopt new approaches in a field where today's stack may look very different in six months * Judgment to size each engagement \- recognizing when an agentic use case can be reused with light configuration, when it needs substantial extension, and when a client problem calls for building greenfield * Comfort supporting commercial and sales\-adjacent activities such as demos, use\-case fit assessments, and solution qualification, alongside post\-sale delivery and value realization work * Ability to build trust and durable working relationships quickly with client stakeholders and account teams in predominantly virtual and distributed delivery environments * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop client\-facing materials, lead technical discovery conversations, and work effectively across distributed teams and international time zones **Qualifications** **Required:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Health Informatics, or a related technical discipline * 4\+ years of experience in software engineering, solution deployment, data engineering, or client\-facing technical delivery roles * Ability to travel up to 25%, on average, based on client and business needs * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. **Preferred:** * Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $159,100\-$224,100\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

As a leader in innovation, we continue to transform the pizza and QSR industry while creating opportunities for team members to learn, grow and thrive. If you're ready to make an impact, build a meaningful career and help shape what's next, there's a place for you at Domino's. **Job Description** As Lead AI Architect, you own the technical architecture for Domino's enterprise AI platform – spanning classical AI, generative AI, and agentic AI. This is the senior individual\-contributor technical authority on AI: you set the direction for how AI capabilities are built, served, orchestrated, and governed, and you drive outcomes through design authority and influence rather than direct reports. You own the reference architecture and the paved road teams build on, and the build\-depth judgment for every incoming ask – production now, minimum viable, scaffolded as a contract for later, or deliberately deferred rather than quietly dropped. This is a deeply hands\-on role for an architect who has delivered AI platforms and solutions at enterprise scale – someone who knows why a technique works and when it survives contact with enterprise data, latency budgets, unit economics, and governance, and who still builds prototypes and reference implementations. Our environment is Azure\-primary with Databricks. **Responsibilities** Architecture Ownership and Direction * Own the enterprise AI reference architecture end to end, establishing scalable standards, principles, and design patterns across business groups. * Own the roadmap for agentic systems platforms, translating business objectives into sequenced technical strategy, milestones, and a build\-depth decision for every use case with explicit, traceable reasoning. * Design and maintain the paved road for AI development – golden patterns for building, serving, evaluating, and integrating models and agents, with an API\-first integration default, MCP by exception against explicit criteria, and guardrails inherited rather than bolted on per team – so teams ship without re\-solving solved problems. * Guide optimization of AI compute and token usage as adoption scales, and lead build\-versus\-buy, model, and framework decisions with evidence – benchmarks, cost per answer, real\-load latency. Semantic Search, Retrieval and RAG Architecture * Chunking, embedding and indexing: design chunking strategy per content type and tune size, overlap, and boundaries against measured retrieval quality; select and evaluate embedding models; own re\-embedding and versioning. * Query construction and hybrid retrieval: implement query rewriting, decomposition, and expansion; combine dense and sparse retrieval with fusion and re\-ranking; manage the recall\-versus\-precision and latency trade\-off explicitly. * Retrieval and response evaluation: instrument recall, precision and faithfulness against curated golden datasets; ground answers in the certified semantic layer and knowledge graphs where they outperform vector retrieval; design for graceful abstention over confident wrong answers. Generative AI Portfolio * Define prompt and instruction management standards – versioning, templating, context budgeting, and regression testing on prompt or model changes. * Own the AI gateway and multi\-model routing, matching each request to the right model on complexity, cost, latency, and quality, and own the benchmarking discipline for how models are compared, selected, and re\-tested as the landscape shifts. * Establish the evaluation harness as a launch gate – offline/online evaluation, LLM\-as\-judge with human calibration, A/B and shadow testing, and an explicit quality threshold we won't launch below. * Hold a clear, evidence\-based position on when prompt engineering suffices versus when fine\-tuning or customization is warranted, and define caching strategy as a deliberate cost and latency lever. Agentic AI Portfolio * Architect the orchestration layer that chains agents, tools, retrieval, and human review – orchestration as the enforced contract, domain agents scoped by journey and business context, and a reusable skills and tool layer where reusability actually lives. * Design memory and context management with an explicit position on what persists, for how long, and under what access rules; define enterprise standards for tool/function calling and MCP server contracts. * Establish agent guardrails – authorization scope, permission models, approval and escalation paths, sandboxing, fallback behavior, and safe failure – plus step\-level tracing, regression data ingestion, transformation pipelines, chunking and indexing strategies, vector and hybrid retrieval, knowledge graphs, metadata models, lineage, provenance, data quality, and access controls, including grounding conversational experiences in structured data (text\-to\-SQL, multi\-turn dialogue). * Model evaluation and production lifecycle engineering. Experience establishing evaluation frameworks and benchmarks (recall@k, NDCG, groundedness, LLM\-as\-judge), automated testing, release controls, model and prompt versioning, observability, quality monitoring, incident response, rollback, and ongoing improvement using MLOps and LLMOps principles. * Security, privacy, responsible AI, and governance. Ability to build identity, authorization, privacy, model security, human oversight, regulatory controls, and auditability into the architecture from the start. Must understand AI\-specific threats such as prompt injection, sensitive\-data leakage, unsafe agent actions, and model or software supply\-chain risk. * Scalability, reliability, performance, and AI economics. Ability to make quantitative architecture decisions on latency, throughput, concurrency, availability, capacity, inference architecture, compute utilization, quality\-versus\-performance trade\-offs, consumption forecasting, and cost optimization, including AI FinOps at scale. * Business and value\-oriented solution architecture. Ability to translate business strategy into qualified AI use cases, measurable outcomes, target\-state architectures, investment priorities, and delivery roadmaps. Must separate value\-producing opportunities from technology demos and tie solutions to operational or financial KPIs. * End\-to\-end delivery with hands\-on technical credibility. Demonstrated ability to move from discovery and architecture through experimentation, production deployment, and operational improvement. Able to build or review prototypes (Python, SQL, Spark), validate assumptions, review implementation designs, diagnose cross\-layer failures, and defend technical trade\-offs, with production depth in DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, and model serving. * Technical leadership and stakeholder influence. Experience defining reusable patterns and standards, leading architecture reviews, mentoring engineers and architects, and aligning product, data science, engineering, infrastructure, security, and business teams. Creates clarity in ambiguity, leads with integrity and humility, and communicates well with executives and practitioners alike. * Substantial enterprise AI delivery experience. A strong record of leading complex AI or ML solutions in production at enterprise scale, typically 10\+ years across software, data, or ML engineering with significant architecture leadership. **Preferred Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft environment: Azure (AI Foundry and Agent Service, Azure OpenAI, Azure ML, AI Search, API Management, Functions), Databricks and Copilot Studio; agent frameworks such as LangGraph or Semantic Kernel and MCP. * Experience in retail, restaurant, e\-commerce, or supply chain with high\-volume, real\-time workloads and streaming (Kafka, Event Hubs) and model risk management. * Production multi\-agent systems and agent runtimes, policy\-aware agent gateways with authenticated tool routing and server registries, and GPU\-accelerated serving stacks. * Contributions to open\-source AI projects, published work, or recognized community involvement. **Additional Information** Benefits: * Paid Holidays and Vacation * Medical, Dental \& Vision benefits that start on the first day of employment * No\-cost mental health support for employee and dependents * Childcare tuition discounts * No\-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs * Fertility benefits * Adoption assistance * 401k matching contributions * 15% off the purchase price of stock * Company bonus All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Reliability Platform
jobs.description: **About the Team** ------------------ The Reliability Platform team develops the systems that empower engineering groups across all of our brands to own the reliability of their services without needing to become reliability experts. Our offerings enable engineers to define and measure service level objectives (SLOs), surface insights to expedite investigations and drive incidents from declaration through root\-cause analysis (RCA) and postmortem. When problems are detected earlier, mitigated faster and followed up on rigorously, our engineers can ship rapidly with confidence and we can collectively ensure that the consumers, merchants and Dashers that depend on DoorDash have the best possible experience. jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Analytics & Data Platform
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== DV is the leader in digital performance solutions, helping our advertiser and agency partners Verify the quality of their digital campaigns, Optimise to improve performance and Prove that they’re achieving their business outcomes, through unbiased 3rd party data and analytics. DV’s mission is to be the definitive source of transparency and data\-driven insights into the quality and effectiveness of digital advertising for the world’s largest brands, agencies, publishers, and digital ad platforms. Since 2008, DV has helped hundreds of Fortune 500 companies gain the most from their media spend by delivering best\-in\-class solutions across the digital advertising ecosystem, helping to build a better industry. Learn more at www.doubleverify.com. **About the Role** ================== **Role Overview** ----------------- You will join the Data \& Analytics Platform (DAP) team within the Pinnacle engineering organization. The DAP team owns and operates two data consolidation platforms — Quantum (contract\-driven, next\-gen) and Analytics 2\.0 (SQL\-driven, legacy) — that ingest, transform, and serve billions of records daily from social platforms, measurement systems, and third\-party partners. The data powers Looker dashboards, customer\-facing reports, and downstream APIs used across DoubleVerify's product suite. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Platform Abstraction \& Design: Design and maintain the YAML\-based "Contract" system that allows users to define data entities, transformations, and SLOs without writing low\-level orchestration code. * Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop the translation engine that converts user contracts into automated dbt models, Airflow DAGs, and Snowflake objects. * API Development: Transition the platform from static configuration files to a dynamic, API\-first architecture, enabling programmatic creation of data artifacts. * Self\-Service Enablement: Build tooling and guardrails that allow business units to deploy their own data solutions while maintaining global standards for governance and security. * Performance \& Scale: Optimize the "translation" layer to ensure that generated jobs are efficient, cost\-effective, and leverage the full power of the Snowflake/dbt stack. * Developer Experience (DevEx): Act as the "Product Manager" for your platform, gathering feedback from internal users to simplify the data development lifecycle. * Design and build data pipelines that process billions of records a day across consolidation, semantic, and externalization layers using the DV Internal Data Platform — a self\-service, contract\-driven architecture where pipelines are defined via YAML contracts and automatically deployed to Snowflake, Airflow, and Looker. * Develop and extend the Contract Interpreter — a Python library (Pydantic, Jinja2\) that reads contract driven platform based YAML and generates dbt models, Airflow DAGs, and environment configurations for each deployment environment (dev, stg, prod). * Lead new initiatives and integrations with the world's largest social platforms (YouTube, TikTok, Meta, Snapchat, Reddit, Netflix, etc.) to measure ad performance end\-to\-end. * Build and maintain the semantic layer — design LookML models, explores, and views that translate consolidated data into customer\-ready analytics through Looker. * Implement and maintain observability — build monitoring, alerting, watermarking, and data consistency checks to ensure pipeline reliability and data freshness at scale. * Leverage AI agents and tooling — contribute to and use the team's AI agent workspace (meta\-repo with AGENTS.md context files, skills, and MCP integrations) to accelerate development, automate workflows, and encode institutional knowledge for AI\-assisted engineering. * Design schema evolution and data migration strategies — manage schema versioning, backward compatibility, incremental vs. full\-refresh deployments, and large\-scale data backfills. * Work in multi\-functional agile teams with end\-to\-end responsibility for product development and delivery — from contract definition to customer\-facing data. * Collaborate directly with engineers from partner platforms on API development and data integration specifications. * Train and mentor a team of software engineers. **Who You Are** =============== **Required Experience \& Qualifications** ----------------------------------------- * Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field. * 5\+ years of experience in a Data Engineering or related role. * Strong SQL skills — advanced querying, performance tuning, window functions, and complex transformations at scale. * Proficiency in Python — building libraries, data processing scripts, and automation tooling (experience with Pydantic, Jinja2, or similar templating frameworks is a plus). * Deep experience with Snowflake — schema design, Snowpipe, streams, tasks, materialized views, clustering, and query optimization. * Experience with dbt (data build tool) — building and maintaining models, macros, custom materializations, and incremental strategies. * Experience with orchestration tools — Airflow / Cloud Composer, DAG design, scheduling, and monitoring. * Experience with cloud platforms — GCP (GCS, BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Kubernetes) or equivalent. * Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts — dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, fact/aggregate table design, and data consistency patterns. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines — GitLab CI, Flyway migrations, or similar deployment automation. * Experience with AI\-assisted development tools — Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar AI coding assistants. Experience building or contributing to AI agent context files (AGENTS.md), skills, or meta\-repo patterns is a strong plus **Preferred Experience \& Qualifications** ------------------------------------------ * Experience building or working with contract\-driven / configuration\-driven data platforms where pipelines are generated from declarative specifications (YAML, JSON schemas). * Experience with Looker / LookML — building semantic models, exploring, aggregating awareness, and dashboard development. * Experience with Kafka — schema registries, topic management, and streaming data integration. * Experience with data quality and observability frameworks — automated testing, watermarking, data integrity validation, and SLA monitoring. * Experience with Terraform or infrastructure\-as\-code for managing cloud resources. * Familiarity with data mesh principles — federated data ownership, data products, and self\-service platform design. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on a number of non\-discriminating factors, including qualifications for the role, level, skills, experience, location, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at DV. The estimated salary range for this role based on the qualifications set forth in the job description is between $107,000\- $212,000\. This role will also be eligible for bonus/commission (as applicable), equity, and benefits. The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description; however, we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be more or less experienced than this job description as posted. **Not\-so\-fun fact:** Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of job criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you have what it takes but you’re not sure that you check every box, apply anyway!

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Must be located near the Bay Area, with reliable transport to San Francisco, CA.** **About Us** ------------ We are a well\-capitalized stealth startup building robotic foundation models and world models for Physical AI. Founded by researchers from leading AI labs, our team works across robot hardware, data, infrastructure, and machine learning. **The Role** ------------ We are hiring **software engineers** to build the systems around our robots: the data and infrastructure that our models are trained on, the tools our researchers and operators use every day, and the product our partners will eventually depend on. We are a small team, so everyone works broadly. This is an implementation role rather than a research role. You will not be designing models; you will be building the systems that let us train, evaluate, and deploy them. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design, build, and operate production software that our research and operations work depends on. * Own systems end to end, from the conversation that surfaces the need through deployment, monitoring, and iteration. * Work directly with ML researchers, robotics engineers, and robot operators, who all sit in the same room as you. * Debug across boundaries, following a problem through services, storage, network, and hardware until it is actually understood. * Build the logging, monitoring, and diagnostics needed to know whether a system is healthy. * Re\-architect what we have ahead of each order\-of\-magnitude increase in scale. * Use AI coding agents to accelerate implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation. * Improve reliability, performance, and maintainability as a matter of routine, not as a separate project. **Qualifications** ------------------ * BS or MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience building and shipping production software that other people depend on. * Strong proficiency in Python, plus Linux and Git. * Experience designing and operating services, APIs, and databases in a cloud environment. * Experience with cloud infrastructure e.g. AWS, GCP * Strong cross\-stack debugging and problem\-solving skills. * The ability to work from a described problem rather than a written specification. * Experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, or comparable tools, including reviewing and validating generated code. * Ownership and initiative: you find problems and solve them without waiting for direction. * Comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment and taking ownership of ambiguous problems. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with robotics, hardware, autonomous systems, or another physical\-world product. * Familiarity with robot data collection, teleoperation, or policy evaluation workflows. * Familiarity with ML data pipeline and GPU training infrastructure **What You Will Gain** ---------------------- * Build the software layer of a robot learning company from its earliest stage. * Work across the complete stack, from raw robot data through foundation models to what customers touch. * Room to move between focus areas as the company and your interests grow. * Help shape the systems and engineering practices of an early\-stage robotics company. **Hiring Process** ------------------ * Introductory video call (30 min) * Technical interview (30 min) * Optional **one\-day** on\-site assessment (paid at $45/hr) * Initial **six\-month contract** with strong potential for a longer\-term opportunity **Logistics \& Benefits** ------------------------- * **Location:** San Francisco, CA (South Beach/SoMa) — on\-site 5 days a week * **Schedule:** Full\-time, 40 hours/week, including a 30\-minute lunch break * **Employment:** W\-2, facilitated through Hire.io * **Compensation:** $45\+/hour, negotiable based on experience * **Benefits:** 12 days of PTO, Cigna Health Insurance

jobs.title: Test Engineer II
jobs.description: **Job Title\-Test Engineer II** The Test Engineer II supports test systems used in DCO product development and manufacturing. This role focuses on executing new test system builds, sustaining existing test systems, and improving existing test systems. **Who are we?** Founded in 1849, Ducommun is the oldest company in California. Starting as a hardware supply store during the California Gold Rush and eventually assisted in the birth of the aerospace industry in Southern California by providing aircraft aluminum to early aerospace pioneers like Lindbergh, Douglas and Lockheed. jobs.title: Builder Developer II/III/IV (Senior Agentic Software Engineer)
jobs.description: ECI is hiring senior\-level **Builder Developers** (Senior Agentic Software Engineers) focused on rewriting how enterprise software is built, tested, and operated using AI. **The Mission:** Use AI to build autonomous agents and workflows that transform legacy ERP systems into modern, AI\-driven platforms. You are not maintaining old code, you are building the future. If you enjoy 4\-hour "alignment meetings" and writing Jira tickets for things an agent could do in 3 seconds, you’re going to hate it here. **Builder** is not just a title; it is a measure of **autonomy, architectural complexity, and "Agentic Leverage."** While a traditional "Senior Software Engineer" might be focused on completing tickets, a **Builder is focused on automating workflows** and owning the execution of AI\-driven modules. ### **Here are the Builder levels we are hiring:** * **BUILDER 2 (Senior):** Focuses on **Agentic Implementation**. This is the "Engine Room" of the team. They don't just use AI; they build the agents. They can take a legacy module and build a LangGraph or CrewAI flow to modernize it with minimal supervision. * **BUILDER 3 (Lead):** Focuses on **Systemic Orchestration**. They design the "Guardrail Layers" and the "Eval Frameworks." They ensure that the agents built by the team are deterministic, cost\-effective, and scalable. * **BUILDER 4 (Principal/Architect):** Focuses on **The Meta\-Platform**. They build the internal "Builder Tools" that the other three levels use. They are looking at the 12\-month horizon of model capabilities and ensuring the ERP architecture is ready for "Autonomous Operation." **Core DNA (Shared Foundation)** * **AI\-Native Workflow:** Use AI tools to accelerate development, testing, and documentation 10x faster than traditional methods. * **Agentic Implementation:** Build, debug, and deploy autonomous agents (LangGraph, AutoGen, Playwright\-LLM hybrids) that navigate complex ERP schemas and business logic. * **Legacy\-to\-Modern Bridge:** Treat 20\-year\-old legacy systems as puzzles for AI\-driven modernization. * **Deterministic Mindset:** Build for 100% reliability with automated validation, evals, and guardrails. **What You’ll Actually Do** * **Build Execution Agents:** Move beyond RAG into **Action**. Build agents that can navigate an ERP schema, identify a data discrepancy, and suggest a fix. * **Automate the "Untestable":** Use AI to wrap legacy business logic in modern unit tests and documentation. * **Prompt Engineering \& Evals:** Use frameworks like **DSPy** to move from "vibes\-based" prompting to programmatic, optimized instructions. * **Rapid Prototyping:** Turn a "what if" into a working AI\-driven feature in days, not months. **The Stack** Python, SQL (Postgres/SQL Server), TypeScript, OpenAI/Anthropic, pgvector/Qdrant, LangChain/LangGraph, dbt, Apache Hop/Airflow, Docker, Weights \& Biases, OpenTelemetry. And, any other tool that helps us achieve greatness. **Who You Are** * **The "Early Adopter" Archetype:** You were using GPT\-3 before it was cool and had a local Llama running the week it leaked. You spend more time on **r/LocalLLaMA**, **GitHub Trending**, and **X (AI Twitter)** than on LinkedIn. * **Agent\-First Thinker:** You don't think in "functions"; you think in "capabilities." You’ve built at least one autonomous agent or complex LLM chain that actually *does* something useful. * **The "Manual Task" Hater:** You have a physical reaction to repetitive work. If you have to do a task twice, you’ve already started drafting the Python script or agentic workflow to automate it. * **Technically Fearless:** You aren't intimidated by spaghetti legacy code. You see a 20\-year\-old undocumented ERP module as a goldmine for AI\-driven refactoring and modernization. * **Rigor over Hype:** While you love the latest models, you care about **Evals**. You know the difference between a "cool demo" and a "production\-grade agent" that handles financial data with 100% accuracy. * **The Tribe Member:** You want to work in an environment where your "AI hacks" and custom automation scripts are celebrated as your greatest contribution, not hidden as "side projects." **Why Join Us?** * **The "Final Boss" of Complexity:** ERPs are the ultimate challenge for AI. If you can automate a General Ledger or a global supply chain, you’ve mastered the hardest problem in software. * **Agentic Autonomy:** We don't do "tickets." We do missions. You’ll have the freedom to choose the models, frameworks, and agent architectures you believe will win. * **The BUILDER Tribe:** You won't be the "only AI person" in the room. You’ll be part of a 4\-person squad of like\-minded enthusiasts who are all obsessed with moving 10x faster. * **No Red Tape:** If the agent works and the evals pass, we ship. We don't have a "Change Management Committee." We have a "Does It Work?" policy. * **The Final Boss:** ERP data is the hardest problem in software. If you want an easy life, go build another photo\-sharing app. If you want to win the game, let’s go!

jobs.title: Network Security Governance & Architecture Engineer
jobs.description: Eaton’s Corporate Sector division is currently seeking a Network Security Governance \& Architecture Engineer. The position will be based at our facility in Beachwood, Ohio. The role is eligible for a hybrid work setup (3 days in office, 2 days remote each week). The expected annual salary range for this role is $146000 \- $215000 a year. This position is also eligible for a variable incentive program. Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. The Network Security Governance \& Architecture Engineer maintains a compliance and risk\-based security strategy, architecture guardrails and control requirements that govern how Eaton's networks are designed, connected and defended \- including emerging architectures such as SASE/SSE, SD\-WAN, cloud and multi\-cloud networking, ZTNA, private wireless/5G, edge and OT/IoT connectivity. The role translates threat intelligence, regulatory obligations, and Zero Trust principles into enforceable standards, reference designs and measurable assurance, and governs adoption through architecture review, exception management and risk reporting rather than day\-to\-day execution. The engineer is the Cybersecurity authority for network security architecture, standards and compliance. Cybersecurity retains accountability for security requirements, architecture guardrails, control intent, compliance interpretation, assurance and risk oversight; Infrastructure and Network Engineering retain responsibility for design implementation, configuration, maintenance and run\-state operations; Security Operations retains responsibility for detection engineering, tuning and 24x7 monitoring. This role sets the requirements and verifies outcomes \- it does not operate the controls. **What you’ll do:** ------------------- * Own network security standards, guardrails and reference architectures: Define requirements, approved patterns and target\-state reference designs for segmentation, secure connectivity, remote access, network access control, firewall and policy management, DNS security, web/proxy controls, encrypted\-traffic visibility and privileged network access. Maintain a published standards portfolio with clear ownership, review cadence, deviation criteria and a documented exception process. * Translate threat intelligence into control strategy: Assess adversary tactics, techniques and procedures affecting enterprise, cloud, remote\-access, product\-connected and industrial network paths, and convert them into prioritized standard changes, control requirements and detection intent. Focus on the strategic requirements rather than the tuning of individual rules. * Define detection requirements and validate coverage: Specify the network telemetry, logging standards and detection use cases required across SIEM, NDR, firewall, proxy, DNS, VPN and SASE/SSE platforms, and validate that coverage exists for priority attack paths. Partner with Security Operations \- who builds and tunes the detection content \- to close telemetry and coverage gaps and to correlate network signal with identity, endpoint and cloud events. * Direct risk\-informed threat hunting: Set hunt priorities and hypotheses based on MITRE ATT\&CK, Eaton's threat profile and known architectural weaknesses; sponsor and review hunts executed with Security Operations; and convert findings into standards, control and telemetry improvements with tracked owners. * Advance Zero Trust and segmentation strategy: Own the multi\-year target\-state model for trust boundaries, microsegmentation, least\-privilege connectivity and containment across IT, cloud, OT and product\-connected networks. Define maturity milestones, sequencing and adoption criteria, and partner with Infrastructure and Enterprise Architecture to align secure designs with operational and business requirements. * Run the network control assurance program: Establish a repeatable, risk\-based program to verify that required network controls are implemented and effective \- including control testing scope, evidence standards, configuration and exposure\-path review, exception governance and aging, and remediation prioritization based on exploitability and business impact. Report results into governance forums with accountable owners. **Qualifications:** ------------------- **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution * Minimum 10\+ years of experience in information security, network engineering or security architecture * Minimum 4 years’ experience in setting security standards, architecture requirements or governance for enterprise networks. * Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. jobs.title: ML Platform Engineer, Distributed Training
jobs.description: **About Egen:** Egen is a fast\-growing and entrepreneurial company with a data\-first mindset. We bring together the best engineering talent working with the most advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights. We are committed to being a place where the best people choose to work so they can apply their engineering and technology expertise to envision what is next for how data and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving tough problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If this describes you, we want you on our team. *Want to learn more about life at Egen? Check out these resources in addition to the job description.* Meet Egen Life at Egen Culture and Values at Egen Career Development at Egen Benefits at Egen **About the opportunity** ------------------------- We're looking for an engineer who is equally at home running a GPU training platform and the large\-scale model training that runs on it. You'll be embedded with a healthcare and life\-sciences AI client that trains foundation models on a large GKE\-based H200 and GB200 cluster. The client is reorganizing so that its foundation\-model platform and its agent platform teams work more closely together. The role centres on the training stack and the scientists who use it. Solid infrastructure knowledge and experience are required, but the client already has strong SRE and infrastructure capacity, so running the cluster isn't the focus: you'll partner with that team and understand the training workloads well enough to tune, benchmark, and debug them end to end. You'll work alongside other Egen engineers and client scientists, and you'll own your area outright. ### **What You Will Do:** ### **Training platform** * Work with the client's infrastructure team on the GKE training platform (GPU node pools, job queueing and scheduling, quota and capacity) from the training workload's side. * Diagnose and fix platform failures at the root (for example a controller that keeps running out of memory) rather than restarting them. * Tune multi\-node GPU networking (RDMA/GPUDirect, NCCL) for training throughput. ### **Distributed training** * Run, scale and debug multi\-node distributed training with PyTorch (FSDP, DeepSpeed, Megatron or NeMo\-style) and Ray Train. * Profile jobs and remove bottlenecks across compute, memory, input pipelines and interconnect. ### **Benchmarking and evals** * Design and run performance benchmarks for the cluster and training stack: throughput, scaling efficiency, cost per run. * Build and maintain model evaluation harnesses so changes to the platform or training recipes are measured, not assumed. * Instrument training and the platform with telemetry and monitoring, and keep end\-to\-end pipeline tests running against what users actually run. **Ownership on the client team** * Treat the platform as your own: proactively find issues, plug gaps and propose solutions before anyone asks, keep the team informed of status and risks, and look after the scientists who use it. * Explain and defend your design decisions to client engineers and scientists in detail. * Stay effective while the client's priorities and team structure change. ### **Your Technical Toolkit:** * **Core Languages**: Mastery of Python and shell scripting * **AI/LLM Ecosystem**: Extensive experience with Google Gemini, GPT\-4, or LLaMA; deep knowledge of Prompt Engineering and Fine\-tuning * **Data \& Search**: Expertise in Vector Databases (Vertex AI Vector Search, pgvector, etc.) and implementing Semantic Search * **Infrastructure**: Hands\-on experience with Google Cloud (Vertex AI) and building scalable software architectures * **Frameworks**: Proficiency in LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar orchestration layers * **Mindset:** A strong software engineering foundation—you write clean, maintainable code and understand the full SDLC ### **Basic Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of engineering experience, with recent hands\-on work on GPU training infrastructure and large\-scale training. * **Strong Python software engineering:** production\-quality code, tests and code review. Coding is central to this role, not an afterthought. * **GKE and GPU scheduling:** Kubernetes on Google Cloud with GPU node pools, job queueing (Kueue or similar), and capacity and quota management. * **Distributed PyTorch and Ray Train:** has personally run and debugged multi\-node training jobs. * **RDMA and GPU networking:** GPUDirect/RDMA, NCCL tuning, multi\-node GB200 (or H200\) topology. * **Benchmarking and evals:** has designed performance benchmarks and model evaluations, and used them to make decisions. * Deep enough understanding to explain how and why a system works, without leaning on AI coding tools to carry the reasoning. * A track record of visible ownership: present, communicative, and accountable on a demanding team. ### **Personal Attributes:** ### **Nice to have** * Healthcare or life\-sciences data (genomics, clinical, biomedical), and working under HIPAA. * Observability and telemetry for training platforms: metrics, tracing, alerting, end\-to\-end pipeline testing. $159,300 \- $219,245 a year This position may be hired at multiple levels. Final leveling is determined during the interview process based on a candidate's experience, skills, and interview outcomes, and the applicable salary range will align with the final level assigned. Compensation is determined based on factors including experience, expertise, interview performance, and geographic location, where applicable. **Compensation \& Benefits:** This role is eligible for our competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package to support your well\-being: * Comprehensive Health Insurance * Paid Leave (Vacation/PTO) * Paid Holidays * Sick Leave * Parental Leave * Bereavement Leave * 401 (k) Employer Match * Employee Referral Bonuses Check out our complete list of benefits here \- \>https://egen.ai/people/\#benefits **Important:**All roles are subject to standard hiring verification practices, which may include background checks, employment verification, and other relevant checks. **EEO and Accommodations:** Egen is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to inclusion, diversity, and equity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Egen will also consider qualified applications with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Egen welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates during all aspects of the selection process. Please advise the talent acquisition team if you require accommodations during the interview process. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist I, Cheminformatics
jobs.description: Eikon Therapeutics is a new biopharmaceutical company employing revolutionary technology at the intersection of chemistry, engineering, computation, and biology to discover novel treatments for life\-threatening diseases. Eikon's discovery platform is built on groundbreaking innovations from its founders (Nobel Prize, 2014\), culminating in the creation of microscopes which enable real time, molecular\-resolution measurements of protein movement in living cells, thereby unlocking otherwise intractable classes of proteins as drug targets. **Position** We seek a Senior Scientist with a demonstrated ability of successfully applying Cheminformatics and ML technologies to drive the discovery programs. You will collaborate closely with computational chemists, medicinal chemists, software engineers and machine learning experts to turn assay and structure\-activity data into interpretable information for decision making. As an integral member of our Drug Discovery team, you will make a real and direct impact on accelerating the drug discovery process and ultimately benefiting patients. **About You** You're a cheminformatics expert who loves to solve difficult problems and are not discouraged by challenges. You have a passion for drug discovery and thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment. You are curious, love challenges, and enjoy pushing the edge of technology to solve important problems with creative solutions. You're collaborative by nature, resourceful, open\-minded, data\-driven, and can operate with a sense of urgency. **What You'll Do** * Develop and apply cheminformatics data\-mining algorithms for the analysis of molecular modeling, virtual screening, and structure\-activity relationship (SAR) analysis. * Process and analyze chemical and biological datasets to evaluate properties such as drug\-likeness, ADMET properties, dosing, etc. * Utilize molecular fingerprints, descriptors, and similarity metrics for compound clustering, classification, and regression. * Assist in development, maintenance, and monitoring of AI/ML models used for property prediction. * Optimize data pipelines for processing and storing chemical structures using cheminformatics toolkits (e.g., RDKit). * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate computational approaches into curation and analysis workflows. * Maintain best practices in data integrity, reproducibility, and documentation of QSAR AI/ML models. * Provide guidance on the application of modern cheminformatics, ML/AI methods for library design (e.g. diversity, focused, fragment, DEL) and analyzing large datasets from HTS campaigns to building predictive models from them. * Routinely employ expert knowledge and analysis of SAR, physiochemical and ADMET properties. * Work alongside medicinal chemists to further triage emerging hits from HTS. * Collaborate closely with our data science team to integrate cutting edge AI/ML tools into our chemistry and drug discovery processes. **Qualifications** * Ph.D. plus 5 years of relevant experience; or Master's plus 14 years of relevant experience; or Bachelor's plus 16 years of relevant experience. * Expertise in cheminformatics data analysis, data mining, and machine learning models to solve drug discovery problems. * Expertise with ligand\-based design approaches, QSAR, multiparameter optimization to rationalize SAR and design novel molecules. * Expertise in scientific programming languages such as python, with experience using RDKit and other cheminformatic libraries and data analytics (Spotfire, DataWarrior, D360\). * Experience in virtual screening, HTS triaging, hit calling, and diversity analysis. * Familiar with commercial platforms and ELN/registration systems (Schrödinger, OpenEye, MOE, Dotmatics, DataBricks, KNIME). * A track record of publications, patents and/or conference presentations in computational chemistry and/or drug discovery. * Excellent problem\-solving abilities and the ability to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic research environment. * Strong communication skills with the ability to convey complex scientific concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. At Eikon, employee compensation also includes bonus and equity compensation, in addition to several generous benefit programs, including: * 401k plan with company matching * Medical (premiums covered by Eikon at 95%), dental and vision insurance (premiums covered by Eikon at 100%) * Mental health and wellness benefits * Weeklong summer and winter holiday shutdowns * Generous paid time off and holiday policies * Life/AD\&D Insurance (premiums covered by Eikon at 100%) and optional supplemental employee\-paid life/AD\&D policies * Enhanced parental leave benefit * Daily subsidized lunch program when on\-site The expected salary range for this role is $178,000 to $215,250 depending on skills, competency, and the market demand for your expertise. Eikon is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment. We are currently not accepting any new third\-party agencies or firms at this time. Please do not forward unsolicited agency resumes to our website, employees or Human Resources. Eikon Therapeutics will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or firm associated with unsolicited resumes.

Join our elite team of healthcare professionals, providing the Right Care, at the Right Time, in the Right Place. **Job Description:** At Elara Caring, we care where you are and believe the best place for your care is where you live. We know there’s no place like home, and that’s why our teams continue to provide high\-quality care to more than 60,000 patients each day in their preferred home setting. This means you have countless ways to make a difference as a **Data Engineer**. Being a part of something this great starts by carrying out our mission every day through your true calling: developing an amazing team of compassionate and dedicated healthcare providers. To continue to be an industry pioneer in delivering unparalleled care, we need a **Data Engineer** with commitment and compassion. Are you one of them? If so, apply today! **Why Join the Elara Caring mission?** * Work in a collaborative environment. * Be rewarded with a unique opportunity to make a difference * Competitive compensation package * Tuition reimbursement for full\-time staff and continuing education opportunities for all employees at no cost * Opportunities for advancement * Comprehensive insurance plans for medical, dental, and vision benefits * 401(K) with employer match * Paid time off, paid holidays, family, and pet bereavement * Pet insurance **As a Data Engineer you’ll contribute to our success in the following ways:** * Develop and support SQL Server and Snowflake platforms for enterprise reporting and analytics. * Build ETL/ELT pipelines integrating clinical, operational, financial, and external data into the Elara Insight Data Platform. * Maintain trusted data models and assets supporting dashboards and self\-service analytics. * Optimize platform performance, reliability, scalability, data quality, and costs. * Support SQL Server operations and Snowflake modernization while ensuring data integrity and business continuity. * Partner with business and technical teams to deliver data solutions aligned with organizational needs. * Maintain CI/CD, Git source control, and automated deployments. * Follow data governance, security, HIPAA, and Elara Caring policies. * Perform other duties as assigned. **What is Required?** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, scientific discipline, or a related field is required. * Minimum 5 years of experience in data This role pairs transmission planning expertise with mathematical optimization to solve some of the hardest problems in grid planning: selecting least\-cost, technically sufficient mitigation portfolios and quantifying their economic value. You will design, prototype, and productionize optimization methods for problems that are large, non\-linear, and mixed\-integer by nature, such as choosing which network upgrades, storage, or operational measures resolve violations across many scenarios and contingencies. A Bachelor's with equivalent experience will be considered. * 3\+ years of experience applying optimization to power systems problems (e.g., transmission expansion planning, optimal power flow, unit commitment, resource or portfolio planning), in industry or research. * Strong foundation in mathematical optimization: linear, mixed\-integer, and non\-linear programming, convex relaxations, and decomposition methods. * Proficiency in Python and at least one optimization modeling framework (e.g., Pyomo, JuMP, CVXPY, PuLP, gurobipy) and commercial or open\-source solvers (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, Xpress, HiGHS, Ipopt). * Solid understanding of power flow, contingency analysis, and transmission planning concepts, including the US transmission system and ISO/RTO structures. * Strong communication skills: able to explain complex models, assumptions, and results to engineers and non\-technical audiences. * Excellent problem\-solving skills, especially in diagnosing infeasibility, numerical issues, and scaling challenges in large models. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Hands\-on transmission planning or interconnection study experience (steady\-state, short circuit, dynamic stability) using tools such as PSS/E, PSLF, PowerWorld, TSAT, or TARA. * Experience with transmission expansion planning, network upgrade cost allocation, or interconnection cluster studies (e.g., SPP DISIS, MISO DPP, PJM cycle studies). * Experience with production cost or capacity expansion models (e.g., PLEXOS, PROMOD, GridView, Aurora, PowerSIMM) and economic planning metrics (APC, adjusted production cost, benefit\-cost ratios). * Experience with stochastic or robust optimization and scenario\-based planning under uncertainty. * Familiarity with power systems optimization packages (e.g., PowerModels.jl, pandapower, PyPSA, MATPOWER). * Software engineering practices: Git, testing (pytest), code review, and deploying models in cloud or distributed environments. * Knowledge of machine learning methods used to accelerate optimization (e.g., surrogate models, warm\-starting, constraint screening). * Publications or open\-source contributions in power systems optimization. Be a part of an innovative team shaping the grid of the future through advanced energy intelligence. For more than half a century, Electric Power Engineers (EPE) has partnered with power and energy clients across the globe, providing consulting expertise and energy intelligence software solutions for complex engineering and grid modeling challenges. As leaders in the renewables space, we are focused on building a modern, secure, and resilient grid. Join us in making an impact on the communities we serve and the environment in which we live. product features across React, .NET Core/Python, and supporting infrastructure — from design through operation. * Bring concrete tradeoffs to design discussions — performance, complexity, blast improvements when they matter, and welcome the same on your own PRs. * Pick up improvements you notice along the way — tech debt, alerting gaps, missing tests — without waiting to be asked. ### **What jobs.title: Senior Tax Professional - AI Tax Engineer
jobs.description: **Join Filed as an AI Tax Engineer: bring your expertise to the platform tax professionals rely on, work alongside a team of CPAs, and help shape where the profession goes next. Full\-time, on\-site in New York.** **Filed is building the first AI tax preparer trusted by America's accounting firms.** The accountant is irreplaceable. The work surrounding them isn't. Filed takes on that surrounding work, from the moment client documents arrive to the plan a firm hands back, so tax professionals can spend their time on judgment, advice and the client relationship. Filed works inside the software firms already use (CCH Axcess, UltraTax, Lacerte, Drake and ProConnect) across individual, business, trust and exempt organization returns. We're backed by Northzone, Neo, Raine and Day One Ventures. Read more in TechCrunch. ### **What we should tell you about the role** Filed is built for tax professionals, by a team that includes them. Our CPAs sit at the center of the company. They decide what quality means in everything Filed does, and they shape what we build next. As an AI Tax Engineer, you'd join that team. This is a strategic role. You'll bring years of practice experience to the product, work with our product and engineering leads on where Filed goes next, and work directly with the firms that run on it. Your judgment ends up in a platform used by firms across the country, instead of staying inside one practice. We think the profession deserves better than the busywork that has grown up around it, and that the people doing this work should spend their time on the parts that need their expertise. This role is how we make sure Filed delivers on both. We hire for this role on a rolling basis rather than to a fixed headcount. If you're the right person, we'd rather meet you now than wait for a req to open. ### **Here's why this is a terrible job** * You won't sign returns anymore. If client work is the part you love most, this may not be the right fit. * There's no off\-season. Firms rely on Filed year\-round, so we need someone fully committed to this role. * There's no established playbook. The role is new, and you'll help define it. * We're building something new, so not everything we try will work the first time. ### **Here's why it's the best career choice you'll make** * Your expertise shapes a platform used by firms across the country. * You'll see how dozens of firms run their practices, and help raise the standard for all of them. * No billable hours or utilization targets. * Tax expertise drives product decisions here. You'll be at the table when they're made. * You'll help move the profession toward more advisory work and less busywork, from inside the company building what comes next. ### **The teammate we're looking for** * Has years of practice behind them and strong views on how the work should be done. * Cares about the profession and wants to see it valued for judgment, not hours. * Can explain a technical tax position clearly to people outside tax. * Is curious about how technology can change the work. * Is comfortable pushing back on anyone, including us. ### **What you'll be responsible for** * Being a tax expert at the center of how Filed works, alongside our team of CPAs, and setting the standard for quality across everything we ship. * Partnering with product and engineering to decide what we build next, from document intake through to tax planning. * Working closely with customer firms, understanding how they run their practices, and turning that into product direction. ### **Your hard skillset** * Licensed CPA with at least 5 years of experience. * Based in or able to commute to New York. * Deep experience in at least one of CCH Axcess, UltraTax, Lacerte, Drake or ProConnect. * Comfortable across individual and business returns, including partnerships and K\-1s. ### **Your soft skillset** * Clear writing. Much of your influence will happen in documents and comments. * Strategic thinking. You see past the return in front of you to the practice behind it. * Ownership. When you spot a problem, you follow it through to the fix. * Comfort with ambiguity and a small team that moves fast. * Credibility with partners and preparers alike. ### **Growth and levels** * This role grows with the product. As Filed takes on more of the work surrounding the accountant, your scope grows with it. * You'll work directly with leadership and help shape how Filed's tax team is built. * Strong performers will have room to lead the function as it grows. ### **The process** * Intro call (30 minutes) * Practical tax case with our team (60 minutes) * Final round with leadership (60 minutes) Two and a half hours in, you'll know whether this is the right next step in your career. **Department:** Tax Experience **Location:** On\-site, New York **Employment type:** Full\-time **Compensation:** $100,100 to $118,300 base per year, plus equity ### **About Filed** Filed is an AI tax preparer that helps firms prep faster, scale smarter, and stay in control, without breaking what already works. It's not a replacement for human judgment. It's a new kind of leverage for those who carry the weight of tax season year after year.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **THE POSITION** Our roster has an opening with your name on it FanDuel is looking for a Data Support Engineer to advance our data capabilities and ensure the reliability and performance of our critical data pipelines and infrastructure. FanDuel's competitive edge is enabled by our ability to leverage accurate and timely data for informed decision\-making. As a Data Support Engineer, you will be a valued member of the Data Support team, maintaining exceptional standards and servicing the needs of data consumers across the company. You will ensure the health of our data infrastructure, contribute to the delivery of reliable, timely, and consumable data, and combine technical troubleshooting with proactive monitoring. You'll have the opportunity to work in an agile environment where you will team up with colleagues having experience in data engineering, machine learning and more. In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs. **THE GAME PLAN** Everyone on our team has a part to play * Provide on\-call technical assistance to analysts, data consumers, and data engineering teams, responding to inquiries relating to query optimization, reporting anomalies, complex data pipeline issues, failed jobs, and data inconsistencies. * Investigate and resolve data quality issues in response to system alerts or notifications from stakeholders, ensuring compliance with internal/external audits and control practices. * Design and implement batch and real\-time data pipelines to the data warehouse or data lake using data transformation technologies, enhancing monitoring dashboards and support tools. * Lead impactful initiatives to enhance data pipelines and other data operations capabilities while mentoring and onboarding new support data engineers. Identify operational inefficiencies and implement automation solutions to reduce manual intervention. * Create and maintain technical support documentation, including FAQs, troubleshooting steps, support runbooks, and a knowledge base of solutions to recurring issues. * Drive operational best practices and shape workflows for routine consumer support, operations monitoring, incident management, and problem management. * Administer account access to tools across the technology stack in accordance with our governance policies. Able to join team's On\-call Pager duty rotation to ensure 24/7 coverage and timely response to critical data issues. * **THE STATS** What we're looking for in our next teammate * Minimum of 3\+ years of experience in data engineering with focus on operational support * Advanced SQL skills with proven query optimization experience * Strong problem\-solving skills with ability to take ownership and accountability for issues through resolution * Python programming proficiency for automation and data processing * Experience with cloud data platforms (AWS, Databricks, Spark) * Understanding of data warehousing and ETL/ELT processing * Experience with dimensional data modeling, batch data ingestion, and real\-time technologies like Kafka or Kinesis * Working knowledge of orchestration and monitoring tools (Airflow, Datadog, Databand, DataFold, Monte Carlo, Prometheus, Grafana) * Strong incident management and root cause analysis capabilities * Customer\-oriented mindset with focus on delivering high\-quality support services and attention to detail * Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills * Proven ability to work effectively within teams and across organizational boundaries * Experience owning and coordinating issues across multiple time zones * Experience identifying operational inefficiencies and implementing automation solutions using AI techniques Preferred Qualifications: * Experience with data streaming patterns and tools like Dbt * Familiarity with CI/CD practices for data pipelines (BuildKite or Github Actions) * Familiarity with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Looker * Exposure to database design, performance analysis, and data quality metrics * Exposure to Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI applications **ABOUT FANDUEL** FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including America's \#1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry's unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance\-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product. In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV\+, its leading direct\-to\-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico. The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company's affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia. FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT). **PLAYER BENEFITS** We treat our team right We offer amazing benefits above and beyond the basics. We have an array of health plans to choose from (some as low as $0 per paycheck) that include programs for fertility and family planning, mental health support, and fitness benefits. We offer generous paid time off (PTO \& sick leave), annual bonus and long\-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits, pet insurance, and more \- check out all our benefits here: **FanDuel Total Rewards**. \*Benefits differ across location, role, and level. FanDuel is an equal opportunities employer and we believe, as one of our principles states, "We are One Team!". As such, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, local or federal law. We believe FanDuel is strongest and best able to compete if all employees feel valued, respected, and included. FanDuel is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please email Benefits@fanduel.com. ***The applicable salary range for this position is $116,000 \- $152,250 USD, which is dependent on a variety of factors including relevant experience, location, business needs and market demand. This role may offer the following benefits: medical, vision, and dental insurance; life insurance; disability insurance; a 401(k) matching program; among other employee benefits. This role may also be eligible for short\-term or long\-term incentive compensation, including, but not limited to, cash bonuses and stock program participation. This role includes paid personal time off and 14 paid company holidays. FanDuel offers paid sick time in accordance with all applicable state and federal laws.*** ***It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. **The Role** Are you a builder who has already shipped AI that changed how a business runs? Fanatics wants you. We're hiring full\-time Applied AI Engineers to join a small, senior team that sits at the center of how Fanatics transforms itself with AI. Our goal is simple and ambitious: make Fanatics a leaner, faster, more automated company. Each Applied AI Engineer works like a tiger team: embed with a business function, find its biggest bottlenecks, replace slow, manual work with AI agents and workflows that actually run in production, then move on to the next challenge. This is a doer's role, not an advisory one. You'll own problems end to end: define them, design the solution, build it, prove it works, and drive adoption. You'll have real autonomy, executive visibility, and a direct line to leadership, with joint reporting to the CFO and Corporate AI Transformation Lead. We're looking for someone with prior experience doing applied AI work at a startup or fast\-growing company, who is used to moving quickly with limited resources and is ready to bring that pace to a global brand. **What You'll Do** * Embed within corporate functions across the business, find the workflows where AI can remove the most manual effort or unlock the most growth, fix them, then rotate to the next function. * Design, build, and deploy production\-grade agents and agentic workflows using frontier models (Claude, GPT, Gemini) and the modern agent stack: MCP servers, agent SDKs, orchestration tools, browser and computer use, and evals. * Move fast: take a high\-impact use case from concept to working solution in weeks, not quarters, and prove it with measurable results. * Think in systems and bias toward solving the problem, not toward building for its own sake. jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
jobs.description: FinWise Bank is seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test to establish and scale quality engineering practices across the FinTech Connect API, the Nexus API, and the Tallied Credit Card Application. This role will design and implement the automation frameworks, CI/CD quality gates, test planning practices, release\-readiness reporting, and AI\-assisted testing capabilities needed to support reliable delivery across critical financial technology platforms. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on technical quality engineer who thinks like a developer, understands complex API and integration ecosystems, and can build durable test infrastructure rather than relying primarily on manual validation. This person will partner closely with software engineering, DevOps, product, architecture, and business stakeholders to improve release confidence, reduce production risk, and accelerate delivery. Key Responsibilities * Design, build, and maintain reusable API, integration, regression, smoke, contract, and end\-to\-end test automation frameworks for FinTech Connect, Nexus, and Tallied. * Define and implement CI/CD quality gates for pull requests, merges, release candidates, and production readiness. * Create formal test plans for major releases, partner integrations, regulatory\-impacting workflows, and credit card application changes. * Develop automated tests for REST APIs, backend services, integration workflows, data validation, authorization logic, account servicing, transaction flows, and partner\-facing interfaces. * Establish contract testing, mocking, stubbing, and service virtualization practices for external providers, partner integrations, and dependent systems. * Implement load, performance, resiliency, negative\-path, and failure\-mode testing for high\-volume API and credit card workflows. * Use AI\-assisted tooling to generate test scenarios, expand edge\-case coverage, accelerate regression suite creation, and identify gaps in requirements or acceptance criteria. * Use AI\-assisted analysis to validate automated test results, summarize failures, detect anomalies, and distinguish product defects from test data, environment, dependency, or automation issues. * Build release\-readiness dashboards and quality metrics covering regression health, defect trends, coverage, performance, test reliability, and release risk. * Partner with developers, product owners, DevOps engineers, and architects to define testable requirements, improve observability, and shift quality practices earlier in the delivery lifecycle. * Support after\-hours post\-release smoke testing for critical production workflows when needed. * Mentor QA engineers, software engineers, and delivery teams on automation standards, testability, AI\-enabled quality practices, and quality\-first engineering habits. Required Qualifications * 5\+ years of software quality engineering, SDET, test automation, or related software engineering experience. * Strong experience designing, building, and maintaining automated test frameworks for APIs, backend services, and integration workflows. * Hands\-on programming or scripting experience with one or more modern languages such as TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, C\#, Python, or similar. * Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or comparable platforms. * Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON, HTTP, authentication and authorization patterns, service dependencies, and distributed systems. * Experience with automated regression testing, smoke testing, integration testing, contract testing, and release validation. * Practical experience with test data management, environment readiness, defect triage, and root\-cause analysis. * Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders and communicate quality risks clearly. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and systems\-thinking skills. Preferred Qualifications * Experience in fintech, banking, payments, lending, credit card, or other regulated financial services environments. * Experience testing microservices, event\-driven architectures, message broker\-based systems, message queues, or third\-party integration ecosystems. * Experience with tools and concepts such as Postman, Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Pact, WireMock, JMeter, k6, Docker, Kubernetes, OpenAPI/Swagger, Kafka, SQL, or cloud\-native testing practices. * Experience using AI or LLM\-assisted tools to generate tests, review code, analyze failures, or improve test coverage. * Experience creating release\-readiness dashboards, quality scorecards, or executive\-level reporting on software quality and release risk. * Understanding of compliance\-sensitive testing practices, secure test data usage, audit evidence, and production\-adjacent validation. Success Measures * Reusable automation framework established and adopted across priority FinTech Connect, Nexus, and Tallied workflows. * Automated regression and smoke test coverage available for critical API, integration, and credit card application paths. * CI/CD quality gates implemented for high\-risk changes and release candidates. * Formal test plan template and release\-readiness reporting adopted by delivery teams. * Improved visibility into regression health, defect trends, performance risk, and release confidence. * Reduced reliance on manual regression testing and faster identification of high\-impact defects. Working Expectations This is a senior, hands\-on technical role with broad ownership of quality infrastructure. The SDET will be expected to work from the Murray, Utah headquarters, operate independently, influence engineering practices across teams, balance tactical delivery needs with long\-term automation strategy, and participate in critical release validation activities as needed. ***Background checks are required on all bank employees due to the accessibility of Personally Identifiable Private Information.*** ***AAP/EEO Statement*** *FinWise is an equal opportunity employer and dedicated to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.
