If that is you, please apply!** **How We Operate** ================== * **Be a barrel.** Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role. * **Insane urgency.** We drive everything forward as fast as possible. * **Reason from first principles.** Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins. * **Love of the game.** The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward. * **Build something that actually matters.** If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world. **The Security \& Corp IT Team** ================================ **The Security \& Corp IT team protects the people, systems, and infrastructure behind the largest AI compute buildout in history.** Examples of key problems the team is working on: * Build detection and response coverage across cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), endpoint, and identity telemetry for a company whose attack surface spans corporate IT and gigawatt\-scale data center infrastructure. * Run incident response end to end, from first alert through containment, remediation, and postmortem, without a large SOC to fall back on. * Stand up detection\-as\-code pipelines so every detection is versioned, tested, and deployed like software rather than hand\-edited in a console. * Harden corp IT foundations (identity, device management, access) so security scales with headcount instead of lagging it. **Role Scope** ============== * Build the detection engineering function from the ground up: telemetry pipelines, detection content, alert routing, and response runbooks, with coverage you can defend against a threat model, not just a tool checklist. * Own detection\-as\-code end to end, writing detections across cloud and endpoint sources with tests, version control, and CI so a bad rule never ships silently. * Lead incident response for high\-severity events, driving containment and root cause, and closing out each incident with detections that catch the same class of attack next time. * Drive automation of triage and enrichment in Python (or similar) so alert volume scales without proportional headcount. * Partner directly with leadership on security strategy, translating threat landscape and detection gaps into a prioritized roadmap with clear tradeoffs. * Work across corp IT and infrastructure teams to get the telemetry, logging, and access you need, and to fix the root causes your detections keep surfacing. **What We're Looking For** ========================== **The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly,** **tell us where you would.** * 8\+ years in security operations, detection engineering, or incident response, with time spent at a high\-growth tech company, cloud\-native infrastructure provider, or top\-tier MDR/threat intel firm. * You've built or scaled a detection engineering function, not just operated inside one: you can point to the program, the pipeline, and the coverage that exist because of you. * Deep hands\-on experience writing detections against cloud telemetry (AWS, GCP, or Azure control plane and audit logs) and endpoint telemetry (EDR event streams, OS\-level signals). * Strong scripting and automation skills in Python or similar, enough to build and maintain detection\-as\-code pipelines yourself rather than spec them for someone else. * Incident response experience at a company operating at significant scale, where you led response under pressure and your postmortems changed how the company operates. * You operate as a technical lead without heavy management overhead: you set direction, make the calls, and do the work. * You work well across corp IT and infrastructure teams in a fast\-moving environment, and you get telemetry and fixes shipped by making the case, not by escalating. * Bonus: experience securing GPU clusters, HPC environments, or physical data center infrastructure, or contributions to open\-source detection content (Sigma, community rule sets). We are committed to pay equity and transparency. Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law. *You will receive a confirmation email once your application has successfully been accepted. If there is an error with your submission and you* ***did not*** *receive a confirmation email, please email careers@fluidstack.io with your resume/CV, the role you've applied for, and the date you submitted your application\- someone from our recruiting team will be in touch.* Compensation Range: $224K \- $344K

jobs.title: Senior Penetration Tester
jobs.description: Forward Financing is a financial technology company based in Boston, Massachusetts with team members throughout the United States, Dominican Republic, and Canada. The company is on a mission to unlock the capital that fuels small businesses across America. Recognized as a Best Place to Work by Built In Boston and certified as a Great Place To Work, Forward is investing in its employees, technology, and customer experience – with long\-term success in mind every step of the way. As a Senior Penetration Tester, you'll find the vulnerabilities in Forward Financing's software before an attacker does. You'll pentest our core systems along with the AI systems and agents our engineers are shipping, and help shape how we test software that AI helped write. Our engineering organization is moving fast with AI, and our security testing needs to move at the same pace. **In this role you will:** * Conduct manual penetration tests against each of our systems, and build the AI\-assisted tooling and automation that extends how much ground those tests can cover. * Help define how we pentest AI. Bring us new ideas for testing LLM applications, agents, and agent\-generated code, and build the ones that work into our regular testing. * Triage findings from our SAST tools, fix the vulnerabilities that are real, and tune the rules that produce false positives. * Perform secure code review across web applications, APIs, and AWS infrastructure. * Build tooling and security services within the Forward application stack, including AI\-assisted tooling that speeds up the security team's own work. * Support the test\-to\-production review process so AI\-built work is security\-reviewed before promotion. * Explain risk to engineers in enough detail that they can prioritize and fix what you found. **Why you should apply:** * Shape a growing function: Our security program is early enough that your work sets the standard. You'll have influence over how we test, what tooling we build, and how we secure AI\-built software. * Mission driven company: Forward is a trusted source of fast, flexible funding for small businesses that have often been underserved by traditional financing options. When you join the team, you will help ensure all small businesses have access to the financial support they need to succeed. * Flexibility is a top priority: Our employees are empowered to choose where they want to work (whether that’s from home, in the office, or a combination of both) with flexible hours. **Role Requirements:** ---------------------- * 5\+ years in application security, offensive security, or product security. * Hands\-on pentesting and code\-review depth across web applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure (AWS). * A hacker mentality. You're curious about how systems break, and you keep pulling on threads after the scanner comes back clean. * Interest in using AI to solve problems, whether that's in your own workflow or in the systems you're testing. * Understanding of AI/LLM attack surface: prompt injection, insecure agent tool use, and vulnerabilities characteristic of AI\-generated code. * Experience with modern programming languages such as Ruby, Python, TypeScript, or Go, and with secure SDLC practices. * Ability to communicate risk and priorities to other security and software engineers. * Typically has a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or equivalent technical degree, or equivalent industry experience. **Nice to have:** ----------------- * Experience pentesting or red\-teaming LLM applications and agentic systems. * OSCP/OSWE or comparable offensive certifications. * Experience contributing to bug\-bounty or external testing programs. * Background in fintech or other regulated environments. **Compensation:** ----------------- **Annual Targeted Salary:** $143,000\-$183,000 CAD **Annual Target Bonus:** 10% At Forward Financing, we're committed to fair and transparent compensation. We believe in providing a compensation package that recognizes your skills, experience, and the unique value you bring to our team. We take a market\-basedapproach to pay, regularly reviewing benchmark data to ensure our compensation remains competitive, equitable, and aligned with our performance\-driven culture. Final offers are determined by a variety of factors, including the candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, specific skills, and internal equity. This approach ensures that our compensation is competitive and equitable. Your recruiter will provide specific details on the expected base and variable earnings as it pertains to this specific role. This position is to fill an existing vacancy. **Total Rewards:** ------------------ Additionally, we offer a comprehensive total rewards package, including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, a flexible time\-off policy, paid parental leave, RRSP match, wellness reimbursement, volunteering days, annual professional development budget, and charitable donation match. Forward is proud to be a remote\-first company, keeping workplace flexibility a top priority for our employees. As a business, we are focused on impact; we are more concerned with your contributions to the success of the company than where you get your work done. To help facilitate in\-person collaboration, employees are welcome to work from one of our premiere office locations. When we aren’t collaborating to drive business and support our customers, we’re finding virtual and in\-person ways to get to know our colleagues, celebrate team wins, and have fun together! **Our Culture: The Forward Compass** ------------------------------------ The Forward Compass is the standard we hold for ourselves and one another—guiding how we lead, collaborate, and show up every day to move in the same direction. * **Back the Builders:** We are wired to fuel customer progress, not just provide support. * **Rooted in People:** We create an environment that balances deep connection with the extreme ownership and honesty required to reach our highest potential. * **Flying V:** We move through coordinated effort with speed and urgency to achieve what no individual could do alone. * **Always Forward, Never Finished:** We pursue growth with a relentless drive that keeps us ahead of the competition. **About Us:** Forward Financing is a fintech company based in Boston, Massachusetts with team members throughout the United States, Dominican Republic, and Canada. The company is on a mission to unlock the capital that fuels small businesses across America. Whether facing challenges accessing traditional financing or simply needing a convenient, flexible solution, Forward is committed to funding more of the millions of small businesses nationwide. By simplifying the requirements, streamlining the process, and using advanced proprietary technology, Forward is often able to deliver approvals within hours and funds that same day – giving more businesses the financial opportunity they need to thrive. Plus, with their dedicated teams and award\-winning service, customers get personalized support when they need it most. Since 2012, Forward has expanded access to capital by providing over $4\.8 billion in funding to more than 92,000 small businesses. The company is A\+ rated by the Better Business Bureau with an Excellent / 4\.7 stars rating on Trustpilot.com. Recognized as a Best Place to Work by Built In Boston and certified as a Great Place To Work, Forward is dedicated to empowering both its team and the customers they serve, helping them succeed and thrive. **Equal Opportunity Employment Information** -------------------------------------------- It is the policy of Forward Financing to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, religion, national origin, status, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by law. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Please let us know should you require any accommodations. As part of our commitment to a streamlined and equitable hiring experience, we use AI tools to assist with candidate screening and assessment. Compensation Range: $145K \- $183K

jobs.description: **Data Engineer** California College Guidance Initiative * Full\-Time * Remote Within California With Occasional Travel All Candidates Must Currently Live Full\-Time in California * **Overview of Role** The California College Guidance Initiative (CCGI) is looking for a data engineer to join the Cloud Infrastructure Team. As part of the team, you will be a key contributor in the expansion, refinement, and continued development of CCGI’s infrastructure utilizing Snowflake and Amazon Web Services (AWS), as well as continuing to build out our data analytics and engineering tools . The ideal candidate has extensive experience building out data ETL/ELT workloads, including the testing, maintenance, and refinement of containerized workloads in cloud architectures. The Data Engineer should also have experience successfully scaling up an organization’s data intake from batch to streaming data, as well as automating data delivery. This person is comfortable working with data storage and can troubleshoot data accessibility via SQL, Python, shell scripting, AWS, Snowflake, and take on a leadership role in special projects when needed. Additionally, this person should have experience developing technical documentation and implementing security governance protocols. While there are no direct supervisory responsibilities for this position, the ideal candidate will have proactively and successfully collaborated with other subject matter experts to move time\-bound projects to completion. Additionally, the ideal candidate will have experience working with K\-12 or education data and/or have an interest in large educational systems and the equity challenges students face when navigating such systems. Other duties as assigned by your supervisor. * **What Technical Skills Do You Need?** * Relevant BA/BS in Computer Science, Statistics, Informatics, Information Systems, or another quantitative field. management. * Advanced proficiency with cloud data warehousing analytical tools such as Snowflake, Redshift, Spark, Kafka, etc. * Expert SQL knowledge (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) and Talend, etc. * Advanced proficiency with scripting languages like Python, Scala, R, etc. * Advanced proficiency building and optimizing data pipelines and data sets. * A successful history of manipulating, processing and extracting value from large structured and unstructured datasets. * Demonstrated ability to consistently develop strong technical documentation * Advanced certifications such as SnowPro Core, AWS Cloud Practitioner Certification, or AWS Certification, Solutions Architect \- Associate are a plus Experience working with K\-12 data and/or education data is encouraged * **What Intangibles Do You Need?** * Strong data analysis and decision\-making skills with the ability to take abstract brainstorming and generate concrete proposals for action. * Ability to advance projects without detailed supervision, prioritize tasks, California’s educational institutions—K\-12 Local Education Agencies (LEAs), the California Community Colleges (CCC), the California State University (CSU), the University of California (UC), and the California Student Aid Commission (CSAC)—to smooth the path to college and career for all California students, especially those who have been underrepresented in higher education. CCGI advances efforts to improve students’ transitions from K\-12 to higher education by streamlining the college and financial aid application processes, while providing educators with the information necessary to inform data\-driven counseling practices and real\-time decision\-making. The Maintenance Engineer I plays a critical role in ensuring the operational efficiency and safety of real estate properties. medical informatics architecture (VMware and Storage Solutions). * Knowledge of Linux Architecture. * Experience of using Postgresql * Industry\-specific certifications in relevant technical jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: At GSK, we unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. Our ambition is to positively impact the health of 2\.5 billion people over the next decade. We are building a future where state\-of\-the\-art software, AI, and machine learning enable us to discover new therapies and personalized medicines that drive better outcomes for patients—at reduced cost and with fewer side effects. The Applied AI team sits at the intersection of business need and technical capability within the AI/ML department. We directly support business units with AI/ML\-related challenges, acting as ambassadors for responsible AI across the organization. This role is your opportunity to work at the frontier of applied machine learning in one of the world’s leading biopharma companies, translating cutting\-edge AI research into real scientific and business impact **About the Role:** As an Applied AI Engineer, you will be embedded within cross\-functional teams to deliver practical, high\-impact AI/ML solutions aligned with GSK’s R\&D and business priorities. You will partner closely with scientists, product teams, and domain experts to design, build, and deploy machine learning models and AI\-powered tools that accelerate drug discovery, improve decision\-making, and enable responsible use of AI across the enterprise. This role is hands\-on and consultative in equal measure. You will evaluate use\-case feasibility, prototype solutions rapidly, architect model integrations, and transfer knowledge so that partner teams can operate independently. You will also contribute to the development of reusable patterns, baseline models, and tested pipelines for common AI/ML tasks within GSK’s approved. **Key Responsibilities:** **Advisory \& Solution Design** * Provide tailored guidance to business units on AI/ML use cases, feasibility, model selection, and deployment options, particularly in scientific domains without active AI/ML engineering efforts. * Co\-design prototypes and proof\-of\-concepts (PoCs) with product and domain teams to validate ideas quickly and de\-risk larger investments. * Translate complex stakeholder requirements into well\-scoped technical solutions with clear success criteria and handover plans. **Model Development \& Deployment** * Build, train, evaluate, and iterate on ML models for real\-world scientific and business problems—including but not limited to NLP/LLM applications, knowledge graphs, causal inference, computer vision, and predictive modeling. * Package trained models into production\-ready services (APIs, containerized deployments) using GSK’s cloud infrastructure (GCP/AWS/Azure). * Develop and maintain agentic AI systems, multi\-agent architectures, and LLM\-based tools where appropriate. * Share reusable patterns, baseline models, and tested pipelines for common AI/ML tasks. * Embed privacy, ethics, and regulatory considerations into every engagement from the outset. **Knowledge Transfer \& Enablement** * Run workshops, seminars, and hands\-on training sessions to increase AI literacy across the organization. * Embed within business/research units for time\-limited engagements (typically 6–8 weeks) to accelerate delivery and transfer skills. * Communicate relevant issues, requests, and opportunities from business units back to AI/ML product leads. **Why you?** ============ **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline; OR equivalent professional experience as a software/ML engineer. * 2\+ years of professional experience developing and deploying machine learning models (with a Bachelor’s); 2\+ years with a Master’s or PhD. * Expertise in Python, including ML/data science libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, scikit\-learn, pandas, numpy). * Experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). * Strong understanding of ML fundamentals: supervised/unsupervised learning, deep learning, model evaluation, feature engineering, and experiment tracking. * Experience working in cross\-functional teams and communicating technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders. * Experience working in healthcare, pharma, or biological domains. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience in pharma, biotech, or life sciences—particularly in drug discovery, genomics, clinical data, or biological data analysis. * Hands\-on experience building LLM\-based applications, agentic AI systems, RAG pipelines, or multi\-agent architectures (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen). * Experience with knowledge graph construction, causal inference, or large perturbation models. * Familiarity with single\-cell RNA\-seq, spatial transcriptomics, CRISPR assay data, or other high\-dimensional biological datasets. * Experience with MLOps practices: CI/CD for ML, model monitoring, experiment tracking (MLflow, Weights \& Biases), and reproducible re ase salary for new hires in this position ranges $136,125 to $226,875\. The US salary ranges take into account a number of factors including work location within the US market, the candidate’s skills, experience, education level and the market rate for the role. In addition, this position offers an annual bonus and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program which is dependent on the level of the role. Available benefits include health care and other insurance benefits (for employee and family), retirement benefits, paid holidays, vacation, and paid caregiver/parental and medical leave. If salary ranges are not displayed in the job posting for a specific country, the relevant compensation will be discussed during the recruitment process. Please visit GSK US Benefits Summary to learn more about the comprehensive benefits program GSK offers US employees. **Why GSK?** **Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.** GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2\.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale. People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. Deep production engineering experience is essential. Prior AI or LLM experience is valuable but not required. We welcome engineers who have personally designed, implemented, and operated services that coordinate workflows and state across multiple systems. Experience building an AI integration is useful when accompanied by evidence of correctness, evaluation, and operational ownership. You will partner with product, design, security, and other Copilot engineering teams to make governance capabilities trustworthy and straightforward to adopt across various client surfaces. We value curiosity, maintainable systems, clear communication, and collaboration. How we build is as important as what we ship. Partner with IT and technical owners to improve preventive controls, monitoring, and operational resilience. * Ensure the organization can detect, assess, contain, recover from, and learn from security incidents. Clarify escalation and decision paths; coordinate with Engineering, Legal, Privacy, Communications, and business leaders; and ensure corrective actions are completed and validated. * Own security risk management, compliance strategy, audit readiness, and control effectiveness. Support frameworks and customer or regulatory requirements relevant to Glean’s business, which may include SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI, and FedRAMP. Track meaningful outcomes in risk reduction, vulnerability remediation, incident readiness, and control effectiveness. * Build and grow a high\-performing team across security engineering, enterprise security, detection and response, and governance. Set clear ownership, develop technical and p  and vulnerability management. You can engage credibly with senior engineers on architecture and remediation choices. * Experience building and operating effective security, detection, and incident\-response programs, including leading through high\-severity incidents and ensuring lessons result in durable improvements. * Practical expertise in security risk management, governance, compliance, and audit readiness, with the judgment to distinguish control completion from actual risk reduction. * A track record of partnering with Product and Engineering to ship secure products and embed security in fast\-moving development organizations. * Experience building, leading, and retaining strong multidisciplinary teams; setting priorities; allocating resources; and creating clear accountability across teams. * Excellent executive communication and judgment. You bring a collaborative, pragmatic leadership style that earns trust while holding a high bar for security outcomes. * Especially valuable: Experience securing enterprise AI, machine\-learning, LLM, or agentic systems, including data handling, model and application boundaries, tool access, and adversarial testing; using automation or AI\-enabled techniques to improve security analysis, detection, investigation, or remediation; supporting regulated customers or programs such as FedRAMP; or preparing a company for public\-company or IPO\-level governance and disclosure expectations. **Location** ------------ * This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our San Francisco Bay Area office). **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- The standard base salary range for this position is $424,300 \- $489,400 annually. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary:** This position designs, develops, deploys, and supports custom software applications, data integrations, and automation tools that improve patient care and organizational operations. The Software Engineer uses AI\-assisted development tools and practices to deliver secure, reliable, and well\-documented solutions across the full application stack. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Designs, develops, tests, and maintains full\-stack web applications, including user interfaces, application programming interfaces (APIs), and back\-end services, using modern web development frameworks and component libraries * Uses AI\-assisted development tools, coding assistants, and large language models (LLMs) to plan, write, review, test, refactor, and document code, and validates all AI\-generated output for accuracy, security, and compliance before use * Develops AI\-enabled applications and workflows, including prompt design, knowledge\-base and document retrieval, and secure connections between AI models and organizational data sources * Provisions, configures, and maintains development, testing, demo, and production environments on local workstations, on\-premises virtual servers, and cloud hosting platforms; monitors, troubleshoots, and resolves application and hosting issues * Designs, administers, and optimizes relational, document, graph, and file\-based databases, including schema design, query development, performance tuning, backups, and access controls * Builds and supports integrations, interfaces, and data exchanges with the organization’s electronic health record (EHR), reporting databases, and other third\-party platforms and vendor APIs * Develops scripts and automated processes to extract, transform, load, analyze, and report on data; routinely works with spreadsheet, CSV, JSON, Markdown, and other structured and unstructured file formats * Applies secure development practices and HIPAA privacy and security requirements, including safeguarding protected health information (PHI), managing credentials, enforcing role\-based access, and maintaining audit logging * Uses version control, code review, automated testing, and deployment processes to manage code changes and releases * Creates and maintains technical documentation, including system architecture, data dictionaries, deployment procedures, and end\-user guides * Gathers requirements from clinical, operational, and administrative staff, translates business needs into technical solutions, and explains technical concepts, trains, and supports end users **Other Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Grace Health recognizes that managing patient care is a team effort involving both clinical and non\-clinical staff. All employees must embrace a team\-based approach to patient care and understand that each role is important to our success. * Team members must demonstrate excellent communication and coordination skills to provide quality patient care. * Care coordination includes communication with community organizations, health plans, facilities, and specialists. * Care team members must understand and embrace the concept of population health management and proactively address the needs of patients and families served by the practice. * Team members must demonstrate the skills and knowledge necessary to communicate effectively with vulnerable patient populations. * Team members must participate in Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI) activities within the organization to ensure patients receive high\-quality care. * All team members will be involved in improving quality outcomes. * Team members will participate in the review and evaluation of practice performance and help identify opportunities for improvement. * Team members will participate in Grace Health's advocacy program. **General Duties:** * Follows all organizational policies and procedures, including administrative, clinical, quality assurance, and personnel policies. * Maintains satisfactory attendance, including attendance at meetings and completion of assigned tasks. * Maintains timely documentation of all work assignments. * Maintains patient confidentiality. * Routinely keeps the supervisor informed regarding attendance and job assignments. * Demonstrates flexibility and the ability to multitask. * Works effectively and efficiently. * Works cooperatively with providers, administration, and peers. **Qualification Requirements:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to support and advance Grace Health's mission while satisfactorily performing each essential duty. The requirements listed below represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities required for the position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. **Skills:*** Proficiency in office productivity software, including word processing, spreadsheet, presentation, and email applications, required * Proficiency in modern programming and scripting languages used for web development, data processing, and system automation required * Experience with modern front\-end and back\-end web development frameworks, component libraries, and styling frameworks required * Working knowledge of SQL and experience with both relational and non\-relational databases required * Proficiency with version control systems and collaborative development workflows required * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools and large language models in a professional setting preferred * Ability to critically evaluate, test, and validate AI\-generated code and content * Experience with cloud hosting platforms, server virtualization, and containerization preferred * Experience integrating with EHR systems, healthcare data standards (such as HL7 and FHIR), or healthcare reporting databases preferred * Knowledge of HIPAA privacy and security requirements and secure coding practices preferred * Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills and ability to quickly learn new technologies * Ability to self\-manage, prioritize multiple projects, meet deadlines and be accountable * Excellent customer service, interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills * Demonstrate sensitivity to, and respect for, a diverse population **Education and/or Experience:*** Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience * Two or more years of experience in software, web application, or database development * Healthcare industry experience and a portfolio of completed software projects preferred **Physical Demands:** The physical demands described herein represent those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, sit, and use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls. The employee occasionally is required to reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl, and taste or smell. The employee must occasionally lift and /or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. **Work Environment:** Grace Health is a faith\-based, federally qualified health center (FQHC). We provide primary healthcare services to underserved, underinsured, and uninsured individuals throughout southeastern Kentucky. jobs.title: Senior QA Data Engineer
jobs.description: ***\*\*This is a fully remote position.*** **Gradient AI:** Gradient AI is a leading provider of AI solutions for the Group Health and P\&C insurance industries. Our solutions improve loss ratios and profitability by predicting underwriting and claim risks with greater accuracy, as well as reducing quote turnaround times and claim expenses through intelligent automation. Gradient AI's SaaS platform leverages a vast industry data lake comprising tens of millions of policies and claims, providing insurers with high resolution, data\-driven insights. Customers include some of the most recognized insurance carriers, MGAs, MGUs, TPAs, risk pools, PEOs, and large self\-insured employers across all major lines of insurance. Founded in 2018, Gradient has experienced strong growth every year, and recently raised $56 million in Series C funding from top Insurtech investors. **About the role:** We are looking for a detail\-oriented and creative thinker to join our team as a Senior QA Data Engineer. In this role, you will establish the next generation of data quality and testing at Gradient AI. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring the quality and trustworthiness of the customer data that powers our products by designing, building, and running automated data quality checks across our data pipeline. This individual will collaborate with engineering and customer\-facing teams to catch data issues before they reach production. The ideal candidate is meticulous, comfortable working in an agile environment, a team player, a strong communicator, and ready to hit the ground running at a fast\-growing AI startup. **How will you make an impact:** * Build and maintain an automated data quality suite that runs on data refreshes through Airflow, replacing manual, per\-customer validation. * Define checks as code (dbt tests, Soda, custom SQL) managed through version control and CI, including baseline checks so that new pipelines get coverage by default. * Validate loads for completeness, sequencing, and schema before processing, and halt or quarantine failures. * Reconcile data across Databricks layers and against downstream outputs such as pricing tools, at the portfolio, group, member, and claim level, using tolerance thresholds. * Detect anomalies, edge cases, and unexpected changes in historical data between loads. * Define severity levels and per\-customer overrides and produce a data quality report for each customer that gates promotion to downstream consumers. * Track quality metrics over time to retire flaky checks and close coverage gaps. * Partner with engineers so that new pipelines ship with checks built in, and give engineers, stakeholders, and project managers timely feedback on quality issues and risk. **Skills needed to succeed:** * 5\+ years of professional experience in quality assurance with a strong focus on backend automated testing. * Hands\-on experience building automated data tests with Soda, dbt, or similar frameworks. * Strong SQL skills (Spark SQL a plus) and familiarity with Python. * Experience with Airflow or similar orchestration tools, and with Databricks or a similar lakehouse environment (Delta Lake). * Familiarity with version control and CI/CD. * Solid understanding of testing principles, including functional, integration, and regression testing, applied to data pipelines. * Excellent analytical, debugging, and root\-cause skills. * Strong verbal and written communication skills, including clear defect reports and quality summaries for technical and non\-technical audiences. * Ability to work independently and coach others on testing best practices. * Bonus: Experience with health insurance or healthcare data, anomaly detection or data observability tools, or front\-end test automation tools such as Cypress or Playwright. **Tools we use:** dbt, Soda, SQL (Spark SQL), Python, Airflow, Databricks (Delta Lake) **What we offer:** * A fun, team\-oriented startup culture. * Generous stock options \- we all get to own a piece of what we're building. * Unlimited vacation days. * Flexible schedule that supports working from home. * Full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, and more. * Ample opportunities to learn and take on new responsibilities. We are an equal opportunity employer. Salary Range: $130,000\-150,000 base salary annually. This role is also eligible for an annual performance bonus, equity grant, and a comprehensive benefits package. In accordance with the Massachusetts Pay Transparency Law, we are providing a good\-faith salary range for this position at the time of posting. The actual salary offered will depend on the level at which the candidate is hired, as well as their experience, skills, qualifications, and location. Compensation may grow over time through merit\-based increases, promotions, and company\-wide adjustments. If your salary expectations fall outside this range, we still encourage you to apply so we can have a conversation.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer - Loki | NASA | Remote
jobs.description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40\+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X. We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open\-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation\-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career\-defining opportunity. **This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the US and Canada.** **What is Grafana Cloud?** Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, traces, and profiles with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, and Pyroscope – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack. The Databases team owns and operates the telemetry databases that are Mimir for metrics, Loki for logs, Tempo for traces, and Pyroscope for profiles. Our databases are offered as a hosted service in Grafana Cloud, and additionally as on\-premise solutions with Grafana Enterprise Metrics, Grafana Enterprise Logs, and Grafana Enterprise Traces. They are multi\-tenant distributed systems implemented in Go and operating at scale on Kubernetes across all major Cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure). As a company we are remote\-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. **Mimir Squad** The Mimir squad has two sub\-squads, Ingest and Query, which together maintain the Mimir OSS project, and additionally own and operate Grafana Cloud Metrics across three major cloud providers. Engineers on the team focus on optimizing the efficiency and resilience of processing, storing, and querying metrics at large volumes. These services operate at a large scale and performance is key to keeping the offering competitive and running smoothly. A Mimir engineer has various work streams. They likely are engaged in a larger project with another engineer, as well as mixing in some performance and reliability improvements discovered through operating the system in production. They are also responsible for writing and reviewing PRs and design documents from other engineers in the squad, shepherding automated release rollouts, and participating in the on\-call rotation for their systems. **What will you be doing?** * Take a very active role in influencing our roadmap and your own career objectives * Work with your team to deliver new features, then use the results to iterate and improve. * Drive projects from initial idea all the way to operations once it is in the hands of customers * Embrace our open\-source culture and contribute to other projects that may not directly fall within your team’s scope * Design, build, operate, and maintain critical systems, owning the reliability, performance, and availability * Be a part of your team’s follow\-the\-sun on\-call rotations and take ownership of the services you’re running * Support other team members, participate in design discussions and collaborate with the team * Learn new skills by gaining a deeper understanding of our cloud product and our customers and getting to know the codebase of a large distributed system As we are remote\-first and our engineering organization is entirely remote, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so an independent attitude and good communication skills are a must. **What are we looking for in you?** **You are a motivated self starter with a bias towards action. You are customer focused. We build everything with our users in mind. You have a passion for creating intuitive products that fit customers’ needs** * Pragmatism: You are able to take on complex challenges and break them down to achieve short feedback loops: to analyze, design, and build modular solutions, deliver MVPs, gather data and feedback and then progress iterative ainstorming ideas all the way to shipping a product to the customer’s hands in a self\-driven way * Some experience with developing software that runs in the Cloud *or* some experience with systems engineering * Some experience with being on\-call and following the DevOps model * Experience writing clean, robust, and performant software that is easily maintained by others * Familiarity with observability systems, know when to use metrics, logs, traces, to debug a problem **Nice to haves:** * Experience working with Kubernetes is highly desirable * Experience working with queue systems, e.g. the Kafka protocol * Been a user of Grafana and Prometheus in operational roles (including on\-call for your team at a previous employer or just using these tools on hobby/homelab projects) * Exposure to microservices architecture and distributed systems, or a desire to learn * Familiarity with the concept of infrastructure as code In the United States, the base compensation range for this role is USD 154,000 \- USD 185,000\. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here. * *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range \& benefits at the beginning of the process.* * *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range \& benefits at the beginning of the process.* **Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:** * **100% Remote, Global Culture \-** As a remote\-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. * **Scaling Organization** – Tackle meaningful work in a high\-growth, ever\-evolving environment. * **Transparent Communication** – Expect open decision\-making and regular company\-wide updates. * **Innovation\-Driven** – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. * **Open Source Roots** – Built on community\-driven values that shape how we work. * **Empowered Teams** – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. * **Career Growth Pathways** – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. * **Approachable Leadership** – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. * **Passionate People** – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. * **In\-Person onboarding** \- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. * **Balance is Key** \- We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *\*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.* **Equal Opportunity Employer:** *Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.* *Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.* \#LI\-Remote *For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our* *privacy policy**.*

jobs.title: DevSecOps Presales Solutions Engineer - Mid-Atlantic region (Remote in VA, MD, PA, NC, DE, NJ, or DC)

By taking a three\-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation's top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best\-fit solutions that mitigate risk. **General Description** The DevSecOps Presales Solutions Engineer will collaborate with Account Executives and senior AppSec \& AI engineering leadership to drive new business within the Mid\-Atlantic region, with a focus on Application Security (AppSec) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) security with the ability to grow into Vulnerability Management and Cloud Security. This presales role is designed for an engineer with 3\+ years of presales experience who wants to grow their technical and customer\-facing skills alongside experienced practitioners. jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer
jobs.description: Harbor IT is a leading Managed Service Provider (MSP) specializing in delivering cutting edge Cybersecurity, IT, and Cloud Services to a diverse portfolio of clients. We pride ourselves on our commitment to excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction. Harbor IT is backed by investment firm Worklyn Partners since 2022 and has built a national platform through acquisition and rapid organic growth. Our mission is to manage our clients’ technology and mitigate their cyber risks, so that they don’t have to. **POSITION OVERVIEW** The Senior Network Engineer is Harbor IT's technical authority for network design and delivery, owning the architecture, engineering standards, and delivery quality for networking engagements across the client portfolio. This role leads pre\-sales design work, drives complex network implementations, and sets the technical standard for Harbor IT's networking domain \- spanning LAN/WAN, wireless, SD\-WAN, network security, and next\-generation campus and branch architectures. The Senior Network Engineer has deep hands\-on expertise with Extreme Networks and Fortinet platforms, both of which are core to Harbor IT's networking stack and required experience for this role. Beyond delivery, this role contributes to the practice by developing standards, reviewing peer designs, mentoring junior engineers, and engaging clients as a trusted advisor on infrastructure strategy. The ideal candidate brings enterprise\-class architecture experience, strong vendor platform depth, and communication skills to operate effectively in both technical and client\-facing contexts. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Own network architecture and design across Harbor IT's professional services engagements including campus LAN, WAN, SD\-WAN, wireless, and network security deployments. * Serve as technical lead and delivery authority on complex network implementations \- providing hands\-on engineering support and directing engineers and field resources through project execution. * Lead pre\-sales solution design for networking opportunities including discovery sessions, architecture documentation, bill\-of\-materials development, and technical proposal support. * Design, configure, deploy, and validate Extreme Networks (campus switching, wireless, ExtremeCloud IQ) and Fortinet (FortiGate, FortiSwitch, FortiAP, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer) solutions as primary Harbor IT\-supported platforms. * Develop and maintain Harbor IT's networking architecture standards, design templates, and configuration baselines to drive consistency and reduce delivery risk across the engineering team. * Conduct network assessments and health reviews for existing clients, producing findings reports and remediation roadmaps that translate technical risk into business language. * Collaborate with solutions architects and account managers during pre\-sales to validate scope, identify technical risk, and produce accurate statements of work. * Mentor and develop junior and mid\-level network engineers through project participation, design reviews, and direct technical coaching. * Maintain working knowledge of relevant vendor ecosystems including competitive platforms, licensing models, support structures, and roadmap direction. * Represent Harbor IT's networking practice in client\-facing settings including architecture reviews, executive briefings, and technology strategy discussions. **QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS** * Expert\-level hands\-on experience with Extreme Networks platforms including campus switching (EXOS/VOSS), wireless (ExtremeCloud IQ, AP series), and network management \- required. * Expert\-level hands\-on experience with Fortinet platforms including FortiGate firewalls, FortiSwitch, FortiAP, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, and FortiClient EMS \- required. * Strong architecture and design depth across LAN/WAN, campus networking, SD\-WAN, network segmentation, VLANs, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), and next\-generation firewall policy design. * Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into network architecture designs and produce clear, client\-ready documentation including diagrams, BOMs, and design rationale. * Experience leading network deployments as the senior technical resource \- coordinating field engineers, managing vendor resources, and validating final configurations against design intent. * Solid understanding of network security principles including zero\-trust segmentation, NGFW policy, NAC, and secure SD\-WAN as applied to enterprise and mid\-market environments. * Strong written and verbal communication skills \- able to present architecture recommendations to both technical and non\-technical audiences and contribute to pre\-sales proposals. * Comfortable operating in an MSP professional services environment with concurrent client engagements, billable utilization expectations, and cross\-functional coordination with PMs, architects, and account teams. **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Network Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline. Equivalent experience considered. * 7\+ years of network engineering and architecture experience, with at least 3 years in a senior architecture or lead engineer role. * Hands\-on Extreme Networks experience required. ExtremeCloud IQ or EXOS/VOSS certification strongly preferred. * Hands\-on Fortinet experience required. NSE 4 minimum required, NSE 7 or higher strongly preferred. FortiGate and FortiManager expertise essential. * Additional certifications a plus: CCNP (routing and switching or enterprise), CWNA/CWSP, SD\-WAN vendor certifications. * MSP or consulting delivery background preferred over pure enterprise IT \- experience managing multiple concurrent client environments is a meaningful differentiator. **WORK ENVIRONMENT** * Senior technical role within Harbor IT's Professional Services department, operating in an EOS\-managed, growth\-stage MSP environment with shared accountability across engineering, architecture, and project delivery functions. * Remote\-first with occasional travel to client sites for network assessments, project deployments, and architecture reviews \- infrequent but expected. * Direct client exposure across enterprise, healthcare, agribusiness, and defense\-adjacent verticals with complex, multi\-site network environments. **BENEFITS** * Competitive base salary commensurate with experience * Health, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match * Unlimited PTO Base salary 150\-175K range

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer | AI & Automation
jobs.description: Hello Management is seeking a skilled, independent full\-stack developer to design, build, improve, and maintain business applications, integrations, and automation solutions. This is a hands\-on development role focused on delivering reliable software, connecting business systems, improving existing functionality, and creating practical AI\-enabled workflows. It is not primarily a helpdesk or platform\-administration role. You will collaborate with the Technology Manager and business stakeholders to translate requirements into clear, testable technical deliverables. We are looking for someone who can take a defined technical assignment and execute it independently, with strong attention to functionality, reliability, security, and documentation. **Key Responsibilities** **Application Development \& Maintenance** * Develop, troubleshoot, enhance, and maintain web applications, dashboards, and business reporting tools. * Build, enhance, and maintain internal business applications and digital tools that support operational efficiency. * Deliver prioritized features and fixes in short Agile cycles, with defined ownership, target timelines, code review, testing, and documented handoff. * Use AI\-assisted development responsibly, reviewing and testing generated code before delivery. **Systems, Integrations \& Automation** * Implement software integrations and automated workflows based on defined business requirements. * Build reliable integrations using supported interfaces, appropriate access controls, and sound data\-handling practices. * Develop and maintain AI\-enabled automations that reduce repetitive work while supporting appropriate oversight, error handling, and accountability. * Coordinate with business\-system specialists on integrations, shared workflows, and data consistency. **Technical Execution \& Support** * Troubleshoot technical issues related to assigned applications, configurations, and integrations. * Test implementations, identify defects, and complete necessary corrections. * Maintain organized code, technical documentation, and change records. * Follow established development, information\-security, access\-control, testing, and release procedures. * Keep assigned tasks updated on a shared workboard, participate in weekly planning and reviews, and promptly flag blockers, dependencies, or delivery risks. **Required Skills \& Experience** * Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining web applications. * Practical experience with modern web development languages, frameworks, and maintainable application architecture. * Experience with APIs, authentication, system integrations, and workflow automation. * Familiarity with source control, collaborative development, and code\-review workflows. * Experience with databases, debugging, testing, error handling, data reliability, and troubleshooting live applications. * Ability to use AI\-assisted coding tools effectively while reviewing and validating generated code. * Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently. * Good written communication and organizational skills. **Preferred Technical Experience** **Experience in the following areas is particularly valuable:** * Full\-stack web application development and maintenance. * Relational databases, authentication, and secure data access. * Cloud hosting, deployment pipelines, and version control. * AI\-assisted coding and agent\-based development methods. * Workflow automation and no\-code or low\-code integrations. * Third\-party APIs and business\-system integrations. * Familiarity with AppFolio or similar property\-management platforms, including vendor\-supported integrations, APIs, and workflow automation, is a plus but not required. Candidates do not need experience in every area listed but should be comfortable learning unfamiliar technologies. **What We're Looking For** * Can independently plan and complete assigned technical deliverables, make sensible progress asynchronously, and raise questions before making unsupported assumptions. * Has practical experience building and maintaining working solutions, not just generating code. * Understands the importance of testing, documentation, and secure development. * Can communicate progress, technical limitations, and implementation concerns clearly. * Takes ownership of assigned deliverables and follows through to completion. * Is adaptable, organized, and interested in using technology and AI to improve business operations. **Scope \& Delivery Boundaries** * Deliver assigned work with clear documentation of completed changes, validation, and outstanding items. * Follow company approval processes for sensitive access, system changes, and releases. * Coordinate priorities, feedback, and technical decisions with the Technology Manager and relevant specialists. **Working Arrangement** This is a full\-time, remote position. Work is coordinated through weekly Agile planning, a shared task board, clear priorities, and review/QA before completion. Final schedule, compensation, and engagement details will be discussed during the selection process. Candidates must be available to work a full\-time schedule aligned with U.S. Mountain Time (MT) business hours and collaborate with a U.S.\-based team. Specific daily hours will be confirmed during hiring. **How to Apply** Please submit: * A brief introduction describing your relevant technical experience. * Two relevant, anonymized examples of applications, integrations, or automations you personally built or maintained; explain your role, testing approach, and measurable result. * Your experience using AI\-assisted coding tools responsibly, including how you validate generated code and handle secrets or confidential data. * Your full\-time compensation expectations, earliest start date, country/time zone, and confirmation that you can work U.S. Mountain Time (MT) business hours. Our priority is finding a reliable technical professional who can independently deliver quality work and grow with our technology initiatives. Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Benefits: * Flexible schedule * Work from home Application Question(s): * Do you have hands\-on experience developing and maintaining production web applications, including working with APIs, databases, and system integrations? * Which AI\-assisted coding tools have you used, and how do you review and test the code they generate? * Do you have experience working with AppFolio, property\-management software, or integrations involving similar business platforms? * What are your compensation expectations for this full\-time remote position? jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: About HappyRobot HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email \- they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23\) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide. Our platform is battle\-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. The Role As a Customer Success Manager, you will own the post\-sale relationship with a portfolio of large, enterprise customers. You will make sure each customer sees real, measurable value from their AI workforce, and then help them expand it to new workflows, teams, and regions. You will work side by side with our forward\-deployed engineers, deployment strategists, and account executives, and you will be the voice of the customer inside HappyRobot. This is a strategic role, not a support role. Our customers are adopting a new kind of technology, and you will guide them from first deployment to a fully scaled AI operation. We are especially interested in candidates with a logistics background who can earn the trust of large, complex organizations and speak the language of their operations teams. What You Will Do * Own a portfolio of large enterprise accounts and act as the primary day\-to\-day and executive\-level contact. * Drive adoption and time\-to\-value by defining success metrics with each customer, such as resolution time, load coverage, calls automated, and cost savings. * Run regular business reviews that translate performance data into clear business outcomes and next steps. * Identify and lead expansion opportunities into new use cases, business units, and geographies, partnering closely with Sales. * Partner with forward\-deployed engineers and deployment strategists to scope, launch, and iterate on new workflows. * Monitor account health, anticipate risk, and lead renewals with a clear view of value delivered. * Capture customer feedback and turn it into actionable input for Product and Engineering. * Build repeatable playbooks, onboarding materials, and best practices as the Customer Success function scales. What You Bring * 4 to 7 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar customer\-facing role at a B2B SaaS or technology company, with experience managing enterprise accounts. * **Preferred:** Hands\-on logistics, freight, or supply chain experience (for example at a freight broker, 3PL, carrier, shipper, or logistics technology company), ideally managing large, multi\-stakeholder accounts. * A track record of driving adoption, retention, and expansion, with comfort owning renewal and growth targets. * Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate with both operators on the floor and C\-level stakeholders. * Comfort with data. You can read usage and performance metrics, build a clear narrative around them, and recommend next steps. * Technical curiosity. You do not need to code, but you should be comfortable discussing integrations, APIs, workflows, and AI concepts with customers and engineers. * A bias for ownership and speed, with the ability to thrive in ambiguity at a fast\-growing startup. Nice to Have * Experience with AI, automation, or voice products. * Familiarity with TMS, WMS, or CRM systems. * Spanish, Portuguese, or another language, given our LatAm and international customer base. * Prior experience at an early\-stage or high\-growth startup. Why Join Us * Join a world\-class team of engineers and builders. * Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital, and Eurazeo. * Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship. * Comprehensive benefits including healthcare, dental, and vision coverage. * Competitive salary \+ equity in a high\-growth startup. Our Operating Principles **Extreme Ownership** We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame\-shifting. If something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it is not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We do not wait for someone else to solve it. We lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us. **Craftsmanship** Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. We aim to deliver jaw\-dropping outcomes by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build, even when nobody is watching. **We are “majos”** Be friendly and have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine and honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego. **Urgency with Focus** Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We are running a high\-speed marathon, not a sprint with no strategy. **Talent Density and Meritocracy** Hire only people who can raise the average; exceptional performance is the passing grade. Ability trumps seniority. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. **First\-Principles Thinking** Strip a problem to physics\-level facts, ignore industry dogma, and rebuild the solution from scratch. We do not copy\-paste solutions. Compensation Range: $120K \- $180K

jobs.title: Architect-Network Engineer
jobs.description: **Lifepoint Health has an opportunity for an Architect\-Network Engineer!** **You must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship.** **Location: Remote** **Travel: Travel up to 25% (To facilities)** **Job Summary** The Network Security Architect is responsible for responsible for the enterprise architecture, design, and technical direction of Lifepoint Health’s network infrastructure across routing, switching, wireless, SD\-WAN, data center, and cloud connectivity in a large, distributed healthcare environment. This role is within the Network Engineering team, who has responsibility for translating business, clinical, and security requirements into scalable, resilient, and supportable network solutions. Working across Network Services, Network Security, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, application teams, and vendor partners, this role ensures solutions align with the overall IT infrastructure roadmap and are delivered in partnership with Network Services for ongoing operational support. **Essential Functions** **Architecture \& Design** * Leads network architecture, planning, design, and engineering efforts across routing, switching, wireless, SD\-WAN, data center, and cloud connectivity, ensuring solutions are scalable, resilient, and aligned with the overall IT infrastructure roadmap and business needs. * Designs, pilots, and validates network solutions and new technologies, and supports their implementation with Network Engineering, Network Services, and other IT teams. * Evaluates emerging technologies and recommends adoption as they relate to the design policies, standards, reference architectures, and procedures. * Ensures consistent design documentation and diagram standards, including high\-level diagrams for IT leadership and low\-level diagrams for engineering teams. * Participates in lifecycle and standardization planning for network hardware, software, and licensing to maintain supportability and reduce risk. **Collaboration and network technologies, including configuration of Aruba, A  architectures (802\.11\), and data center networking, including Ethernet topologies and network segmentation. * Expertise in routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, static routes) and SD\-WAN policy design with Palo Alto Prisma SD\-WAN, Viptela, Fortinet, or other SD\-WAN solutions. * Knowledge of firewall platforms, and of network security integration. * Knowledge of telecom services (MPLS, broadband, DIA) and of Azure and Google Cloud connectivity. * Experience with network management and observability platforms such as LogicMonitor, Aruba Central, Meraki Dashboard, and Prisma SASE/Strata Cloud Manager. * Working knowledge of network automation, scripting, and modern productivity tools to improve engineering efficiency and reduce manual effort. * Skilled in protocol analysis and problem determination. * Ability to manage projects, ensuring projects are clearly defined, systematically executed, and results oriented, in adherence with project management best practices, processes, and standards. * Established skills to coach and mentor less experienced Network Engineers. * Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate technical information to technical and non\-technical audiences, including executive leadership. * Ability to work independently and in a cross\-functional team, providing appropriate and timely feedback to senior team members and management as required. **Organizational Expectations** * Maintains compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and supports hospital and department policies, procedures, and standards. * Consistently supports the mission, vision, values, and goals of the hospital and Lifepoint Health. * Acts in a positive, proactive, and professional manner when interacting with employees, leaders, physicians, patients, visitors, and community partners. * Maintains confidentiality, complies with HIPAA requirements, and handles sensitive business and patient information appropriately. * Demonstrates accountability for workplace safety and completes assigned education, training, and mandatory requirements in a timely manner. * Maintains required licensure, certification, and professional credentials, if applicable, in good standing. **Work Environment** * Remote based position * Business hours from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Monday through Friday (40 hours weekly)\- schedules may vary based on business necessity * Well\-lit, ventilated, and climate\-controlled office and hospital environments with routine office equipment. In hospital settings, the individual may be exposed to hazards and unusual elements that require appropriate safety precautions. * Travel up to 25% as required for business needs, including potential overnight travel by land and/or air. **EEOC Statement** “Lifepoint Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Lifepoint Health is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity for all applicants and employees and complies with all applicable laws prohibiting discrimination and harassment in employment.” We employ and provide care to people from all walks of life. We are committed to promoting healing, providing hope, preserving dignity and producing value with an inclusive workforce in which diversity is leveraged, respected, and reflective of the patients, family members, customers and team members we serve.Lifepoint Health is a leader in community\-based care and driven by a mission of Making Communities Healthier. Our diversified healthcare delivery network spans 29 states and includes 63 community hospital campuses, 32 rehabilitation and behavioral health hospitals, and more than 170 additional sites of care across the healthcare continuum, such as acute rehabilitation units, outpatient centers and post\-acute care facilities. We believe that success is achieved through talented people. We want to create places where employees want to work, with opportunities to pursue meaningful and satisfying careers that truly make a difference in communities across the country.
