jobs.title: Search & AI Discovery Architect
jobs.description: Description: **Build your career with Heritage Auctions, the world’s largest collectibles auctioneer.** Celebrating its 50th anniversary in 2026, Heritage Auctions has spent five decades connecting collectors with extraordinary objects and the stories behind them. Headquartered in Dallas, Texas, with offices across the United States and around the world, Heritage serves more than 50 auction categories, including Coins, Sports, Comics, Entertainment, Historical, Jewelry, Fine and Decorative Art, Luxury Accessories, Wine, and many more. Join a collaborative, fast\-paced company where curiosity is valued, expertise is celebrated, and every day offers an opportunity to work with remarkable pieces of history and culture. **SUMMARY:** Heritage Auctions is seeking a Search \& AI Discovery Architect to make Heritage’s information easier for people and AI systems to discover, understand, trust, and cite across traditional search engines, AI\-powered search, answer engines, assistants, and emerging agent ecosystems. This role combines deep search knowledge with hands\-on technical architecture and experimentation. You will own the technical designs, information and relationship models, standards, feasibility assessments, dependencies, implementation guidance, and validation that support Heritage’s search and AI\-discovery strategy. You will personally build prototypes and reference implementations, then partner with Engineering to turn validated approaches into production capabilities. As part of our Enterprise AI team, reporting to the Manager, Enterprise AI, you will work closely with the SEO and AEO Strategy Manager, who owns commercial strategy, growth priorities, the delivery backlog, and business outcomes. You will advise and influence the growth roadmap through technical evidence and emerging capabilities. Success means making Heritage a more accessible and trusted source for auctions, collectibles, valuations, provenance, historical objects, and market intelligence while preserving the meaning and accuracy of its information. In partnership with the SEO and AEO Strategy Manager, you will support improved visibility and citations for strategic topics and a measurable contribution to qualified traffic, registrations, consignments, bidding activity, purchases, and revenue **BENEFITS:** * Medical, Dental, Vision coverage * Paid time off * 401k savings plans * Onsite gym with access to a personal trainer **COMPENSATION**: Commensurate on experience **LOCATION**: South of Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport, NW corner of W. Airport Freeway (Hwy. 183\) and Valley View Lane **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Define, document, and govern technical standards for crawlability, indexing, rendering, canonical URLs, metadata, internal linking, structured data, content architecture, and search performance. Maintain reusable implementation patterns that reduce ambiguity and repeated research. Assess how Heritage’s inventory, archives, specialist expertise, and market data are exposed to search engines and AI systems, and identify barriers to accurate discovery, retrieval, attribution, and citation. * Develop information models, reusable schema patterns, and knowledge and relationship graphs that distinguish an object from its auction appearances, an active offering from a historical auction result, and an estimate from a realized price. Preserve provenance, relevant dates, price definitions, and reliable links between records. Work with Heritage specialists, Data Services, and Engineering to validate entity definitions, attributes, identifiers, and relationships. Validate that discovery outputs preserve these distinctions. * Translate business priorities into clear technical designs, requirements, dependencies, tradeoffs, and acceptance criteria for Product and Project Management, Web, Data Services, and Engineering. Provide practical implementation guidance and test cases, surface risks and unresolved dependencies early, and help resolve technical gaps through production delivery and validation against intended behavior * Personally build prototypes and reference implementations using Heritage data to test technical approaches, expose assumptions, and demonstrate proposed standards. Run focused experiments, compare results, and iterate before recommending broader adoption. * Evaluate APIs, data feeds, agent access, Model Context Protocol (MCP) capabilities, and emerging discovery approaches, providing practical guidance on security, data availability, feasibility, and integration. Track evolving schema practices, naming conventions, and changes in how search engines and AI agents discover and interpret information. Use experimental evidence to explain their practical implications and proactively surface capabilities and constraints that should inform or reshape planning while following agreed business priorities. * Establish technical and discovery baselines with the SEO and AEO Strategy Manager and relevant analytics partners. Measure and validate implemented improvements for information accuracy, crawlability, index coverage, structured\-data quality, and accessibility to search and AI agents. Collaborate on measurement of visibility, citations, qualified traffic, conversions, and agreed business outcomes, distinguishing technical performance from commercial results. * In your first 90 days, work with the SEO and AEO Strategy Manager, Engineering, Data Services, Web, and Heritage specialists to establish discovery, technical\-accessibility, and information\-accuracy baselines for an agreed representative scope. Identify the most consequential barriers and dependencies, agree on a representative category’s information model and pilot acceptance criteria, and build and test a reference implementation. Deliver a measurable implemented pilot with Engineering and validate results against the baselines and acceptance criteria, including information accuracy and accessibility to search and AI agents. Document results, remaining limitations, and recommendations for the next business\-prioritized improvements Requirements: **QUALIFICATIONS:** * Experience in technical SEO, web architecture, digital marketing technology, organic growth, or a related discipline, with strong knowledge of crawlability, indexing, website structure, metadata, canonicalization, and search performance. * Broad technical understanding of front\-end websites, back\-end systems, structured data, APIs, data flows, and AI\-discovery integrations. * Ability to build and test prototypes and reference implementations and translate them into practical implementation guidance. * Ability to model entities and relationships clearly and preserve the meaning of complex information across systems. * Familiarity with AI\-powered search, large language models, answer engines, and emerging discovery practices. * Ability to translate business and marketing objectives into technical requirements and explain capabilities, constraints, and tradeoffs to technical and nontechnical partners. * Experience partnering with developers, data engineers, product or project managers, marketers, and business stakeholders. * Strong analytical, research, communication, and problem\-solving skills, including the judgment to evaluate unfamiliar technologies and recommend a practical path forward. * A strong sense of ownership for technical outcomes, including proactively identifying opportunities, surfacing risks, resolving gaps, and following work through validation. **PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:** * Experience implementing or guiding schema, structured\-data, knowledge\-graph, or entity\-modeling initiatives. * Familiarity with answer engine optimization (AEO), generative engine optimization (GEO), entity authority, or LLM visibility measurement. * Working knowledge of JavaScript\-rendered websites, content management systems, APIs, data feeds, and modern web architecture. * Familiarity with agent integrations, MCP, or other methods for making organizational content available to external AI systems. * Experience with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, Adobe Analytics, Salesforce, Robohead, or similar platforms. * Experience with marketplaces, ecommerce, luxury goods, auctions, collectibles, or other expertise\-driven industries Heritage Auctions welcomes and encourages applications from women, minorities, veterans, mature workers, and persons with disabilities. EOE

jobs.title: Security Engineer, ML Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Why work at Higgsfield AI?** Higgsfield AI is the fastest\-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $1B in annual revenue run rate, 30M\+ users worldwide, 6M\+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. We're building at the absolute frontier of AI\-powered video creation and next\-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high\-impact team shaping the future of AI\-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like. **About the role:** Higgsfield AI is looking for a highly technical, hands\-on ML Security Engineer to join Higgsfield Security and own security across our GPU clusters and AI/ML infrastructure, from model training to inference and production deployment. In this role, you will work as part of the Security team and closely with our ML and Infrastructure teams to design, implement, and operate security controls that protect models, data, and underlying infrastructure. Your core responsibilities will include securing GPU compute environments, assessing infrastructure and AI/ML vendors, and enforcing security requirements through technical controls, deployment policies, and verified remediation. We're looking for someone who combines deep security engineering expertise with a practical, solutions\-oriented mindset. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across cloud environments, Kubernetes, Linux, and GPU infrastructure, and understands how to balance security, performance, and reliability in a fast\-moving AI environment. This role carries direct ownership of GPU infrastructure security and the security requirements that third\-party providers must meet to support Higgsfield’s workloads and data. **What you'll do:** **AI/ML \& GPU Infrastructure Security** * Own the security of GPU clusters supporting distributed training and production inference across cloud and rented datacenter environments. * Harden GPU hosts, operating systems, drivers, container runtimes, Kubernetes clusters, and workload scheduling configurations; reduce privileged access and unnecessary exposure. * Secure distributed training environments and GPU workloads through isolation, access controls, and data movement restrictions. Validate isolation between tenants and workloads across compute, networking, and storage, including shared GPU environments where applicable. * Design and implement controls to protect sensitive datasets, model checkpoints, weights, and customer data. * Strengthen inference security through tenant isolation, service authorization, secure model loading. * Partner with ML and Platform Engineering teams to integrate security into infrastructure design and development workflows. **Vendor Security Assessment \& Enforcement** * Lead technical security assessments of GPU infrastructure providers, datacenter operators, and other AI security vendors that process Higgsfield data and support AI workloads. * Evaluate vendor architecture and evidence covering tenant isolation, privileged access, data handling and retention, use of customer data for model training, encryption, vulnerability management, and incident response. * Translate security requirements into enforceable technical controls, including approved configurations, and continuous checks for configuration drift. * Track internal and vendor security findings to closure with accountable owners and deadlines, validate remediation, and escalate unmet requirements. Document any approved exceptions with compensating controls and expiration dates. **Cloud \& Platform Security** * Design, implement, and maintain security controls across Linux, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, networks, and third party datacenter environments. * Secure infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and access to third\-party infrastructure providers. Restrict and audit vendor and administrator access to cluster management interfaces and production systems. * Implement least\-privilege access, workload identity, secrets management, encryption, and auditable access controls. * Identify and remediate vulnerabilities and configuration risks across production systems, including GPU hosts, drivers, and container runtimes, coordinating changes with infrastructure owners to maintain service reliability. **Security Operations \& Risk Management** * Develop and maintain detection and response capabilities for infrastructure and AI\-specific security threats, including unauthorized GPU workloads, privilege escalation, and suspicious data transfers. * Investigate and respond to potential credential compromise, unauthorized data access, model theft, and compromised workloads. * Partner cross\-functionally to implement practical security improvements that account for the performance, scalability, and reliability requirements of GPU workloads. **Requirements:** * Strong hands\-on experience in Security Engineering, Infrastructure Security, Platform Security, or a related technical discipline. * Deep understanding of Linux, Kubernetes, networking, and cloud infrastructure security. * Practical experience securing or operating GPU clusters or distributed AI/ML infrastructure, with an understanding of training and inference workloads, GPU drivers and runtimes, and workload isolation. * Experience designing and implementing security controls across complex, distributed production environments. * Strong knowledge of identity and access management, workload isolation, encryption, secrets management, and least\-privilege principles. * Experience conducting technical vendor security assessments, evaluating supporting evidence, and driving remediation with external providers. * Ability to identify, investigate, and remediate security vulnerabilities and infrastructure threats. * Proficiency in scripting or programming languages such as Python, Go, or Bash. * Experience partnering with Infrastructure, Platform, or ML Engineering teams to implement security solutions. * Strong technical ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to prioritize security risks in a fast\-paced environment. * A hands\-on, collaborative approach with the ability to independently drive security initiatives from design through deployment, verify that controls work in production, and hold internal teams and vendors accountable for agreed security requirements. **Compensation \& Benefits** * We offer a competitive and thoughtfully structured compensation package designed to align with impact, experience, and long\-term growth. * **Base Salary:** The anticipated salary range for this role is **$200,000 \- $300,000**, depending on experience, skills, scope, and location. * **Bonus:** This role is Bonus eligible and may participate in the Company's discretionary annual bonus program. * **Equity:** In addition to cash compensation, employees are eligible to participate in the company’s stock option program and share in Higgsfield’s long\-term growth. * **Benefits:** We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees professionally and personally, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a competitive 401(k) retirement plan with company matching, and additional benefits and perks. * The opportunity to work on ambitious AI products alongside a highly experienced, fast\-moving, and international team. * Significant ownership, direct impact, and opportunities for professional growth as the company scales. This is a **hybrid role based in the San Francisco Bay Area**. Team members are expected to work from our San Francisco office **three full days per week**, with the remaining days worked remotely and are expected to be available during agreed working hours and to maintain sufficient overlap with the relevant team’s time zone. We value in\-person collaboration, active communication, responsiveness, and close partnership across teams. *Higgsfield AI is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.description: Founded in 2013, Home Chef is the leading meal solutions company with both a retail and online presence. In 2023, Home Chef introduced a new brand, Tempo! Tempo features a rotating selection of ready\-to\-heat meals delivered directly to your door. These meals are better\-for\-you versions of familiar favorites, designed to save you time and reduce stress while maintaining a healthy lifestyle. Our Tempo menu includes options that are protein\-packed, fiber\-rich, calorie and carb conscious, keto\-friendly, and dietitian\-approved. Similar to our recipes, we recognize that variety is the spice of life, and therefore, our employees also bring their uniqueness and color to our fantastic team. We're eager to work with humble team players and pragmatic next\-level thinkers to innovate on Home Chef's offerings. A Software Engineer II at Home Chef is an experienced software developer who is proficient in the languages and frameworks commonly used at the company. In this role, you will leverage a deep understanding of the codebase to independently implement high\-quality solutions, translating business problems into technical solutions. You will anticipate the cross\-functional implications of your team's work and effectively communicate with team members and stakeholders. You will review the work of other engineers and provide constructive feedback, and investigate and troubleshoot production errors when required. ***Writing code to solve business problems and handling tickets*** * Utilize Ruby on Rails framework with a postgres database to complete feature development * Write code proficiently in React, Javascript and CSSPerform deploys in a Heroku environment * Demonstrate experience with backend development, design and implementation * Demonstrate experience interacting with a database (relational, NoSQL, caching), feature implementation and optimization * Ship and maintain reliable, scalable, efficient code * Regularly troubleshoot and resolve production errors and identify root causes * Develop mobile features for iOS and Android using React Native ***Reviewing the work of teammates, collaborating with others*** * Give actionable feedback to unblock peers and help your team deliver * Contribute to discussions to influence the roadmap and product development of Home Chef tools * Communicate and write code clearly while pair programming * Communicate about the trade\-offs of various technical approaches and solutions * Regularly review the work of others on the team and provide directional feedback * Participate in regular team meetings to help with product roadmap planning and team efficiency ***Key Traits and Behaviors:*** **Taking Ownership**: We do whatever is necessary to get the job done \- no job is too big or too small. We are willing to do any task at any level \- and get our hands dirty (at a meal solutions company, sometimes we all have to do the dishes!). We work with speed, setting realistic but aggressive timelines. We do not allow a lack of perfection to get in the way of progress. **Pragmatic, Next\-level Thinker**: We explore new methodologies and strategies and are not constrained by conventional thinking or 'the way we have always done it'. We take calculated risks in order to learn and innovate with speed, or 'test and learn'. We pride ourselves on using data and insights to drive practical decisions in our fast\-paced environment. **Humble Team Player**: We work collaboratively and effectively with colleagues, always putting company and team needs ahead of personal achievement. We are open to different points of view when weighing a decision, pulling in different people to provide fresh and unique perspectives. **Qualifications** The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, ability, and/or other characteristics needed for this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities. * At least one year of experience shipping production code * Have built and shipped major features in Ruby on Rails and/or React * Must be comfortable working with version control such as GitHub * Must be well\-versed in at least one code editor (VS Code, Sublime, Vim, etc.) * Must be comfortable working with tools like Slack and GSuite * Must be willing to respond to on\-call events when they occur. * SQL knowledge is a plus, but not required * Experience with Heroku a plus * Experience with React Native a plus * Up to one year of post\-high school training such as in a business school, community college or vocational training * This position requires 0% travel ***More About Us*** ------------------- **Perks and benefits** * Candidates can experience Home Chef as a customer \- enter promo code PEOPLE30 for $30 off your first order! * Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance available * Paid holidays, sick time and vacation time * 401k program * Flexible spending accounts for qualified medical, dependent care, parking, or transit expenses ### **How We Work Together** **We are humble team players.** We are warm and gracious with team members and customers. We seek feedback to improve ourselves \- and respectfully listen to and accept input. **We are pragmatic next\-level thinkers.** We come up with novel and unique ideas. We explore new strategies to avoid being constrained by conventional thinking. **We take ownership.** We approach ambiguous problems, prepared to dive in, get curious, and learn more. We are results\-driven, always challenging ourselves to exceed goals. ### **Be at Home at Home Chef** We all show up authentically at Home Chef. alerting infrastructure so the platform is operable and debuggable at scale. * **Full\-Stack Feature Delivery:**\*\* Contribute to product feature development end\-to\-end using TypeScript and knowledge of HIPAA requirements, particularly secure transmission, storage, and access control for PHI * Experience with Next.js and React sufficient for full\-stack feature contribution * Demonstrated ownership of complex backend systems end\-to\-end, from architecture through production operation * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tools and LLM coding harnesses (Claude Code, Pi Agent, Cursor, Codex, or similar) **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in healthcare, financial services, or other highly regulated industries * Exposure to event\-driven required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. jobs.description: **What We Do:** Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote\-first team working to make enterprise\-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection. Huntress now secures more than 5M endpoints and 16M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other. **Reports to: Engineering Manager** **Location: Remote US** **Compensation Range: $200,000 \- $220,000 base plus bonus and equity** **About the Team** Huntress protects the small and mid\-sized businesses that attackers assume can't afford a security team. The Detection Platform team builds the engines and pipelines that turn billions of raw telemetry events into the signals our 24/7 SOC acts on. Every detection Huntress ships, across endpoint, identity, SIEM, and third\-party EDR, runs through systems this team owns. We measure ourselves on two things: time to detection and detection engine uptime. **About the Role** We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer to help build and rebuild these systems without disrupting the SOC that depends on them, and to make their behavior predictable under load. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role: you'll lead major workstreams, set direction that other engineering teams build against, and write and review production code every week. **What You'll Own** * **Detection engine and pipeline modernization.** We're rewriting our detection engine to support the full Sigma v2 specification, including stateful correlation of patterns across many events over time. In parallel, we're reworking several existing detection pipelines and building new ones, moving off the bespoke per\-product detectors we've accumulated and onto a common platform. You'll lead major workstreams across both and own the validation approach that proves a reworked pipeline still behaves like the one it replaces, so we can turn old paths off knowing we haven't lost anything. * **Reliability and behavior under load.** A detection pipeline that quietly stops producing signals is worse than one that crashes loudly, and detection volume spikes for reasons we don't always control. You'll build the guarantees that make quiet failure impossible: end\-to\-end latency measurement, liveness coverage, and alerting that fires when expected work stops arriving. You'll also build the mechanisms that keep a spike bounded and recoverable. * **Event schemas and data contracts.** Our schema and transformer layer are what several other engineering teams build their detections against. You'll help drive toward a coherent internal standard and build the validation and drift\-detection tooling that catches upstream changes before they break detections. **What We're Looking For** **Required** * Deep experience designing, building, and operating production distributed systems at scale, primarily in Go, with the range to work across several layers of the stack. * You have replaced or substantially re\-architected a live, high\-throughput system without breaking its consumers, and you can walk us through how you proved the new path was equivalent, staged the cut\-over, and decided it was safe to retire the old one. * Experience with high\-volume event or data pipelines, and a good feel for how they behave under load: where things queue, where they fall behind, and what happens to correctness when they do. * Strong operability instincts. You design observability in rather than retrofitting it, and you've built alerting that catches the absence of expected work, not just errors. * Demonstrated technical leadership across team boundaries. You've set a direction that other teams had to build against and raised the engineering bar around you, without needing positional authority. * Judgment about production quality: when a system is good enough to ship, when it needs more evaluation, and when it shouldn't ship at all. * Hands\-on experience with AI coding tools, and a point of view on using them well, where correctness is a security outcome. **Strongly Preferred** * A background in security operations or security engineering: time spent writing or tuning detections, or working in a SOC. You know what makes a detection maintainable, how fast noise erodes a SOC's trust in its tooling, and why a missed detection is a different class of failure than a noisy one. * Experience with detection\-as\-code or other rule\- and DSL\-driven systems, including the parsing and evaluation work that supporting a specification properly entails. * Experience building platform tooling for non\-engineer authors such as rule writers, analysts, and researchers, where the product surface is a language, an API, and a feedback loop. * Ruby on Rails experience. Some of our pipeline and application code is Rails, and you'll occasionally read and review Ruby. It's a nice\-to\-have, not a requirement; we'll help you ramp. **Our Stack** You'll work primarily in Go across our detection engines, pipelines, and the services around them, with Kafka, Temporal, Redis, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, and Kubernetes across AWS and Azure. We are at the forefront of New England's ongoing transition to clean energy. The Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) is a hands\-on engineering role responsible for improving the reliability, observability, performance, and operational efficiency of ISO New England's IT services. The SRE works across infrastructure, platform, cyber security, and application teams to reduce operational toil, improve service resilience, and implement scalable automation solutions. This role has a strong emphasis on observability engineering, automation, Splunk administration, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC). The ideal candidate will possess hands\-on experience with Splunk or demonstrate a strong willingness to develop expertise in the platform. Experience with Terraform, automation technologies such as Python and PowerShell, and the ability to leverage AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate engineering solutions are key components of the role. **What we offer you:** * A stable, mission\-driven workplace where your impact truly matters * A highly engaged work environment that values inclusion, collaboration, and employee safety and wellbeing * Competitive compensation with a base salary \+ performance bonus * Robust benefits package, including: + Enhanced 401(k) and financial planning support + Tuition reimbursement and professional development + Wellness programs, including an onsite gym + Flexible work hours + Employee Business Networks + Free coffee at our onsite café * Hybrid work environment (3 days/week onsite) * Distance\-based relocation assistance available **How you will make an Impact** * Build and maintain observability, monitoring, logging, alerting, and telemetry platforms (e.g., Splunk, Dynatrace, administrative overhead * Develop meaningful KPIs and dashboards for business and IT service health * Engineer and implement resilience patterns including HA, DR, and automated failover * Partner with jobs.title: AI Software Developer
jobs.description: **Are you a software developer who knows how to use AI to move faster without sacrificing quality?** Do you enjoy taking a business need, turning it into a working solution, and iterating quickly alongside stakeholders? IdeaTek is looking for an **AI Software Developer** to build and deploy internal software solutions using AI\-assisted development tools as a core part of the development process. This is a hands\-on role for an experienced developer who knows how to use AI to accelerate coding, testing, debugging, and deployment while applying strong technical judgment to validate the quality of the output. You’ll work directly with managers and business stakeholders to understand needs, determine priorities, and quickly turn ideas into usable solutions. The environment is agile, flexible, and highly iterative—you’ll be expected to move quickly, adapt as requirements evolve, and streamline the development lifecycle. This role is open to remote candidates located in **Kansas**. **A Day in the Life** Your day may begin with a conversation with a manager or stakeholder to understand a business problem or new software need. From there, you’ll define the approach, use AI\-assisted development tools to build an initial solution, test the output, and iterate based on feedback. Throughout the day, you may be developing a new internal tool, enhancing an existing application, validating AI\-generated code, troubleshooting an integration, or working directly with a stakeholder to refine requirements. You’ll balance speed with sound technical judgment—knowing when an AI\-generated solution is ready to move forward and when it needs further review or refinement. This isn’t a role built around long development cycles or rigid processes. You’ll be trusted to prioritize, experiment, iterate, and deliver practical solutions that solve real business problems. **What You’ll Do** *Key responsibilities include:* * Develop, test, and deploy software solutions using AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude to accelerate coding, debugging, testing, and delivery * Apply software development experience and technical judgment to review, validate, and improve AI\-generated outputs before deployment. * Work directly with stakeholders to understand business needs, clarify requirements, and rapidly prototype, iterate, and deploy practical software solutions as priorities evolve * Enhance internal applications, workflows, automations, and integrations. * Troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and implement timely fixes or improvements. * Collaborate with internal developers, business teams, and third\-party partners as needed. * Maintain appropriate documentation for developed solutions, integrations, and workflows. * Continuously evaluate new AI development tools and techniques that can improve speed, quality, or efficiency. **What We’re Looking For** *To be considered for this role, you’ll need the following required qualifications:* * **3\+ years of professional software development experience.** * Hands\-on experience with **Claude or similar AI development tools**. * Experience integrating applications with third\-party systems or APIs * Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in agile, iterative environments and explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences. * Experience working directly with stakeholders to understand business needs. * Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to evaluate multiple approaches and determine practical solutions. * Demonstrated ability to own and deliver assigned work with minimal supervision. **What Will Help You Stand Out** *Preferred Qualifications:* * Experience identifying opportunities to apply AI to improve internal processes or business operations. * Telecommunications, fiber, or technology industry experience. **Desired Attributes** *Beyond the qualifications, these attributes are what make someone a great fit for our team:* * **AI\-Native** – You naturally look for ways to use AI to accelerate development and improve how work gets done. * **Technically Curious** – You continuously experiment with new tools, approaches, and technologies. * **Pragmatic** – You focus on building solutions that work and create value rather than overengineering. * **Fast\-Moving** – You’re comfortable testing, iterating, and delivering quickly. * **Adaptable** – You can shift priorities and adjust your approach as business needs evolve. * **Collaborative** – You enjoy working directly with stakeholders and translating their needs into technical solutions. * **Accountable** – You take ownership of what you build and apply sound judgment before putting solutions into production. **Why Join IdeaTek?** IdeaTek is a cutting\-edge telecommunications company dedicated to bringing fast, reliable internet to underserved communities. We're a passionate team of innovators and problem\-solvers committed to making a difference in the lives of our customers. At IdeaTek, we value our employees and foster a culture of collaboration, growth, and community involvement. A few of the key ways we strive to make employees feel valued include: * Competitive pay \+ bonus potential * Medical, dental, vision, life, and 401(k) with match * Free coaching/counseling for employees \& families * Free internet service (if available in your area) or internet reimbursement * Tuition reimbursement for personal and professional growth * Community engagement opportunities * Culture that values results, effort, and integrity **Our Core Values** * ***We are Trustworthy*** – We build confidence through transparency, follow\-through, and dependability. * ***We count on Big Thinkers*** – We don’t just imagine the future—we create it with bold, actionable ideas. * ***We have a Resilient Spirit*** – We embrace challenges, bounce back from setbacks, and keep striving for more. * ***We stand on Belief*** – We believe everyone deserves access to technology that helps them learn, grow, and thrive. * ***We foster Connectedness*** – Our work goes beyond broadband—we build real connections within our team and our communities. * ***We drive Innovation*** – We're always looking for ways to improve and redefine what's possible. **Ready to Apply?** If you're excited about using AI to build software faster, solve real business problems, and help shape how IdeaTek develops technology, we'd love to hear from you. **Apply today!** *This role is not eligible for Visa sponsorship.* *This role is not eligible for relocation.* *Salary and benefits commensurate with experience.* *Equal Opportunity Employer.* *This employer uses E\-Verify.*

jobs.title: Senior IT Engineer
jobs.description: **About InVita Healthcare Technologies** InVita Healthcare Technologies delivers the world’s most comprehensive human biologics software solutions managing blood, organ, and tissue workflows, enabling unmatched visibility and compliance to improve patient outcomes and save lives. Trusted by blood organizations, organ procurement organizations, hospitals, forensic laboratories, public health agencies, and government institutions worldwide, InVita's solutions empower organizations to fulfill their mission, optimize operations, and better serve their communities. Learn more at **invitahealth.com****.** **Job Title:**Senior IT Engineer **Department:**Information Technology **Reporting to:**Chief Information \& Security Officer **Location:** Baltimore, MD (Hybrid– In\-Office 3 days per week) **Hours of work:** Typical hours of work are from 8:30 AM until 5:30 PM local time Monday through Friday. Flexibility of Working Hours dependent on location. Additional hours may be necessary as needed. This position is exempt from overtime. **Compensation:** $85,000 \- $100,000 annually. Range is commensurate with experience. **Position Summary** The Senior IT Engineer is a senior technical member of the global Information Technology team responsible for the administration, support, security, and continuous improvement of the company’s corporate technology environment. This is primarily a hands\-on technical position, with approximately 10–15% of the role dedicated to team coordination, operational leadership, and management responsibilities. The Senior IT Engineer serves as the designated second\-in\-command to the Global IT Manager and assumes responsibility for day\-to\-day IT operations when the Global IT Manager is unavailable. In addition to technical responsibilities, this position owns selected vendor relationships and contracts, coordinates defined IT initiatives, mentors other IT team members, and assists the Global IT Manager with maintaining consistent technology standards and operating practices across the company’s global locations. **Role Expectations** The Senior IT Engineer is expected to spend the majority of their time performing technical and operational work. Approximately 10–15% of the position will involve delegated leadership responsibilities, including coordinating team activities, managing selected vendors and initiatives, mentoring other IT personnel, and acting on behalf of the Global IT Manager when required. This position does not replace the Global IT Manager’s responsibility for overall IT strategy, personnel management, budgeting, and organizational leadership. Rather, it provides operational depth, technical leadership, and management continuity within the global IT organization. **Key Success Measures** Success in this position will be measured by the reliability and security of assigned systems, effective resolution of complex technical issues, quality and consistency of IT operations, successful management of assigned vendors, adherence to corporate technology standards, contribution to integration initiatives, development of other IT team members, and the ability to maintain effective IT operations when acting on behalf of the Global IT Manager. **Key Responsibilities** **IT Operations \& Engineering**: * Provide senior\-level administration and support for the company’s corporate technology environment. * Administer and maintain identity, endpoint, collaboration, networking, security, and productivity platforms. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues escalated from other members of the IT team. * Implement and maintain standardized configurations for corporate endpoints, applications, and infrastructure. * Manage user accounts, access permissions, authentication, endpoint configuration, and related lifecycle activities. Support employee onboarding, offboarding, equipment provisioning, account changes, and access reviews. * Identify opportunities to automate routine IT processes and improve operational efficiency. * Maintain appropriate monitoring, alerting, documentation, and operational procedures for supported systems. **Deputy IT Leadership:** * Serve as the designated second\-in\-command for global IT operations. * Act on behalf of the Global IT Manager during vacations, absences, or other periods when delegated responsibility is required. * Coordinate daily IT priorities, workload, escalations, and operational issues when acting for the Global IT Manager. * Provide guidance and technical direction to other IT team members. * Assist with prioritization and assignment of support requests, projects, and operational activities. * Escalate significant operational, security, personnel, or business issues to appropriate leadership. * Participate in IT planning, prioritization, and operational decision\-making with the Global IT Manager. * Provide continuity of IT leadership without removing the position’s primary focus on hands\-on technical work. **Vendor \& Contract Owners maintain system documentation, configuration standards, procedures, inventories, and operational runbooks. * Maintain accurate documentation for systems and services within assigned areas of responsibility. * Develop procedures that enable other IT personnel to effectively support systems and services. * Participate in problem management and root\-cause analysis for recurring or significant IT issues. * Recommend and implement improvements to reliability, security, supportability, and employee experience. **Qualifications** * Significant experience in information technology, systems administration, infrastructure, endpoint management, or a related technical role. * Demonstrated ability to independently manage and troubleshoot complex IT systems and services. * Experience supporting Microsoft 365, Entra ID/Azure AD, endpoint\-management platforms, and enterprise collaboration technologies. * Experience with Windows and macOS enterprise environments. * Working knowledge of networking, identity and access management, endpoint security, authentication, and cloud technologies. * Experience managing or coordinating third\-party technology vendors. * Ability to coordinate the work of other technical personnel and provide direction during operational issues. * Strong troubleshooting, organizational, documentation, and communication skills. * Ability to work effectively with employees and technical teams across multiple geographic locations and time zones. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Microsoft Intune and Jamf. * Experience supporting geographically distributed or international organizations. * Experience participating in mergers, acquisitions, or technology integrations. * Experience within a healthcare, SaaS, technology, or regulated environment. * Familiarity with SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO, NIST, or similar security and compliance frameworks. * Experience managing technology contracts, licensing, and vendor renewals. * Microsoft, Apple, security, cloud, ITIL, or other relevant technical certifications. **Physical Demands and Work Environment:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions. While performing the duties of this position, prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer may be required. Additionally, the employee is regularly required to talk or listen. The employee frequently is required to use hands or fingers, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, sit; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. *This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) incumbent in this position. Employee(s) will be required to follow any other job\-related instructions and perform any other job\-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments.* *This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an "at\-will" relationship.* *InVita provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.* **The pay range for this role is:** 85,000 \- 100,000 USD per year(Maryland)

jobs.description: **Full Stack Developer** **Base Salary**: $145,000 **Location**: Seattle, Denver, Minneapolis, Charlotte **Work Model**: Onsite **Travel Requirements**: 10\-15% travel required **Reports To**: Senior Full Stack Developer, Manager **About Indigenous Pact PBC, Inc:** Established in 2017 Indigenous Pact PBC, Inc., a certified B\-Corporation, set out on a mission to create health equity for American Indians and Alaskan Natives. As part of a global movement of certified B\-Corporations, we aim to balance purpose and profit by meeting the highest social, environmental, legal, and public standards to build a more sustainable and inclusive economy. Indigenous Pact's dedicated, experienced, and knowledgeable team brings decades of experience working in Indian Country. We help strengthen and improve the sustainability of Tribes and Tribal Organizations' health, wellness, and long\-term care programs and services. Indigenous Pact specializes in developing customized and turn\-key solutions to generate sustainable revenue, increase healthcare access, and improve health outcomes for all Native Americans. **Job Summary:** Indigenous Pact is seeking a talented and experienced Full Stack Developer to join our healthcare technology team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications using modern backend and frontend frameworks while advancing Indigenous Pact's healthcare technology platform and AI\-enabled capabilities. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to build innovative solutions that improve patient care, optimize healthcare workflows, and ensure compliance with healthcare standards and regulatory requirements. This role will help establish reusable application components, shared services, and development standards that can be leveraged across Indigenous Pact's technology ecosystem. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with a passion for emerging technologies, intelligent automation, and practical AI solutions. **Essential Job Functions:** * Full Stack Development: Develop and maintain scalable web applications utilizing backend and frontend frameworks for dynamic and responsive user interfaces * Solutions Architecture \& Integration: Design scalable solutions and integrate applications with third\-party healthcare systems through APIs and interoperability services * Provider\-Facing Application Development: Design and develop applications that support clinical workflows, patient management, scheduling, documentation, and care delivery processes * Telehealth \& Digital Care Solutions: Develop and enhance telehealth applications, virtual care capabilities, remote monitoring tools, and integrated communication solutions * Enterprise Platform \& Automation Development: Develop shared services, reusable application components, automation capabilities, and development standards that support multiple solutions across the Indigenous Pact technology ecosystem * AI\-Enabled Solutions Development: Design, develop, and support AI\-enabled capabilities that improve care delivery, business operations, workflow automation, decision support, and user experiences * Cloud, Data \& Security: Develop secure, scalable healthcare applications leveraging cloud services while ensuring compliance with HIPAA and healthcare security standards * Testing \& Quality Assurance: Perform testing, code reviews, and quality assurance activities to ensure reliable, secure, and high\-performing solutions * Documentation \& Support: Maintain technical documentation and provide ongoing support for deployed applications and services * Innovation \& Continuous Improvement: Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that improve healthcare outcomes and operational efficiency **Required Skills/Abilities:** * Proficiency in modern frontend application development using React, Svelte, or equivalent frameworks * Proficiency in Python application development and modern backend development frameworks * Proficiency in SQL and relational database design * Experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs * Familiarity with Azure cloud services and modern application deployment practices * Experience integrating third\-party applications, APIs, and services * Strong analytical, debugging, and problem\-solving skills * Ability to design scalable, maintainable, and reusable software solutions * Experience with, or strong interest in, AI\-enabled applications, intelligent automation, and emerging technologies * Strong communication skills with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field preferred * 3\+ years of full stack software development experience building modern web applications * Experience designing, developing, testing, and supporting production web applications * Experience building and integrating RESTful APIs and third\-party services * Experience working with SQL databases and modern cloud\-hosted application architectures * Experience collaborating with business stakeholders and cross\-functional technology teams * Experience supporting healthcare, care delivery, or business applications preferred * Experience with AI\-enabled applications, intelligent automation, healthcare interoperability (HL7/FHIR), and/or HIPAA\-compliant solutions preferred **Physical and sensory demands:** * This position will require extended periods of sitting, typing, and working on a computer screen. * Close vision is required for computer work. **Working environment:** * Expected working hours of 8:00am to 5:00pm. * Occasional travel to Indigenous Pact work sites may be required. **Why Choose Indigenous Pact?** Building a strong culture and exhibiting our core values is important to us. When you join Indigenous Pact, you are joining a team that values: * **Empathy** is at the heart of everything we do—we listen, we understand, and we put ourselves in the shoes of others, whether it's our teammates, our clients, or the communities we serve. * **Wisdom** is about learning from experience, being thoughtful in our work and making decisions that are grounded in knowledge and insight. It's about taking the time to get things right. * **Bravery** is having the courage to take bold risks, challenging the status quo, and knowing that growth happens when we push our limits. * **Transformation** drives us to continuously grow—both as a company and as people. It's about not being afraid to change and to keep pushing forward in the pursuit of excellence. Visit our Careers page (https://www.indigenouspact.com/careers) where we encourage you to learn more about the characteristics that are important to us (and we hope you bring them as well) such as Healthcare\-focused, growth mindset, self\-motivated, collaborative, resilient and adaptable. Beyond the job opportunity and incredible culture, we also offer: * Indigenous Pact's PTO Policy includes vacation, wellness and 11\+ company\-paid holidays * Competitive benefits including 401(k), Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance * Open, transparent lines of communication with leadership * Committed to giving back to improving our communities and environmental impact * A development\-focused environment where you have autonomy to drive your career path *Indigenous Pact is an equal opportunity employer, and we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and barrier\-free work environment for all employees and candidates. Preference will be given to qualified native applicants; however, all qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. Must be able to provide Indian Preference documentation if claimed. If accommodation is required during any stage of the recruitment process, please contact any member of our HR team. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for interviews will be contacted.*

jobs.title: SURE/ Domain Specialist – Maintenance, Reliability & Inspection (Oil & Gas)
jobs.description: **We are seeking a hands\-on domain specialist in maintenance, reliability, Operations and inspection who can connect operational expertise with data, engineering, and AI delivery. The role will translate field and engineering challenges into deployable solutions, guide multidisciplinary teams from discovery through adoption, and build the client\-facing and technical capabilities needed to progress into a Forward Deployed Engineer role within 2–3 years.**  **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Serve as the domain authority for maintenance, reliability, and inspection processes across upstream, midstream, or downstream operations. * Map end\-to\-end workflows from anomaly detection through root cause analysis, decision\-making, and corrective or preventive action. * Engage client SMEs, engineers, operators, and business leaders to understand operational challenges, clarify priorities, and validate solution approaches. * Plan and facilitate discovery, design, and validation workshops using structured questioning to uncover requirements, pain points, constraints, and value opportunities. * Translate domain needs into use cases, user stories, data requirements, business rules, acceptance criteria, and solution designs for data and engineering teams. * Identify opportunities for AI, analytics, and automation to accelerate root cause analysis, predict failures, recommend actions, and improve maintenance execution. * Evaluate data\-driven and physics\-based model outputs for operational relevance, explainability, safety, and engineering validity. * Partner with product, data, AI, and software engineering teams to prototype, test, deploy, and continuously improve solutions in the client environment. * Support data readiness assessments, solution validation, user acceptance testing, rollout, training, and adoption with end users. * Define success measures and track business outcomes such as reduced downtime, improved reliability, faster investigation, inspection efficiency, and avoided cost. * Troubleshoot functional, data, workflow, and adoption issues during pilots and production deployment, coordinating resolution across client and technical teams. * Document decisions, reusable patterns, lessons learned, and domain assets; contribute to proposals, demonstrations, and solution discussions. **Required Skills and Experience** ================================== * 8–10 years of experience in maintenance, reliability, asset integrity, or inspection within the Oil \& Gas industry. * Strong knowledge of root cause analysis, FMEA, RCM, condition monitoring, risk\-based inspection, defect management, and maintenance work processes. * Practical understanding of rotating or fixed equipment, degradation and failure mechanisms, operating envelopes, and key reliability and integrity indicators. * Working knowledge of equipment sensor and time\-series data, inspection records, work orders, failure history, engineering documents, and master data. * Ability to assess the operational relevance of physics\-based, statistical, and machine\-learning models and challenge outputs constructively. * Awareness of modern AI capabilities, including predictive analytics, anomaly detection, knowledge graphs, generative AI, and workflow automation. * Ability to conduct credible technical conversations with client SMEs while communicating clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Proven experience leading workshops, resolving ambiguity, making practical trade\-offs, and guiding decisions to clear outcomes. * Strong problem\-solving, structured thinking, written communication, and executive presentation skills. * Comfort working in multidisciplinary, fast\-paced teams with changing priorities and direct accountability for outcomes. * Candidates authorized to work for any employer in the United States without employer\-based visa sponsorship are welcome to apply. Infosys is unable to provide immigration sponsorship for this role at this time.

This role works across multiple disciplines including controls engineering, robotics, motion control, machine vision, and system integration to deliver reliable and efficient automation solutions. The position focuses on developing and supporting control systems, PLC/HMI programming, motion control applications, robotic integration, machine vision systems, and automation concept development. The Automation Engineer will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to optimize manufacturing processes, improve equipment performance, and support continuous improvement initiatives while ensuring automation equipment. * Create and maintain electrical schematics, control system documentation, and automation design specifications. * Assist in concept development and feasibility studies for new automation equipment and process improvements. * Integrate and troubleshoot machine vision systems including Keyence, Cognex, and other industrial vision platforms. * Support robotic integration, programming, and troubleshooting for systems such as FANUC and Universal Robots. * Configure and troubleshoot industrial communication networks including Ethernet/IP, EtherCAT, PROFINET, and related industrial protocols. * Support implementation of motion control systems including servo drives, VFDs, and motor control systems. * Participate in equipment commissioning, startup, validation, and jobs.title: J-JACK Mobile App & Embedded Systems Developer — iOS, Android, ESP32 & Hydraulics
jobs.description: J\-JACK Mobile App \& Embedded Systems Developer — iOS, Android, ESP32 \& Hydraulics Company: Jay Logistics \& Trade LLC Product: J\-JACK Smart Bluetooth Hydraulic Jack Location: Houston, Texas / Remote or Hybrid, depending on hardware testing requirements Compensation: $3,000 per month after the agreed commercial launch milestone, plus eligibility for a management\-approved sales participation agreement Anticipated Start: Following the qualifying J\-JACK preorder launch or commencement of final\-product production, as established in a written agreement About J\-JACK Jay Logistics \& Trade LLC is developing J\-JACK, a smart hydraulic jack that combines mechanical lifting technology, embedded electronics, and mobile connectivity. We are seeking an experienced developer who can take responsibility for designing, coding, testing, and delivering the J\-JACK mobile application and its integration with the product’s embedded control system. This position requires hands\-on development experience across iOS, Android, ESP32, and Arduino\-based systems, along with a practical understanding of hydraulics. The ideal candidate understands how software commands translate into physical equipment behavior and can collaborate closely with mechanical, electrical, and manufacturing personnel. This is a hands\-on engineering position. Candidates must be able to personally develop and troubleshoot working software and firmware, demonstrate previous projects, and support development through production readiness. Position Overview The developer will help turn J\-JACK’s product requirements into a complete application and connected\-device experience. Responsibilities include application design, mobile development, Bluetooth communication, embedded integration, data handling, testing, documentation, and launch support. The application and firmware must operate together reliably. Device behavior must account for interrupted connections, invalid commands, power changes, sensor faults, and other conditions that can occur when controlling physical equipment. Final features and control permissions will be determined through engineering review, hardware capabilities, testing, and management approval. Primary Responsibilities Mobile Application Design and Development * Design clear, intuitive application screens for iOS and Android. * Develop wireframes, user flows, interactive prototypes, and production application interfaces. * Build and maintain the application using an appropriate native or cross\-platform technology stack. * Recommend the development approach based on hardware compatibility, reliability, maintainability, and long\-term support. * Create device discovery, pairing, connection, reconnection, and connection\-status experiences. * Develop device setup, operating instructions, equipment status, alerts, and troubleshooting screens. * Implement approved control functions with clear feedback, appropriate confirmations, and safeguards against accidental commands. * Support different screen sizes, supported operating system versions, and accessibility requirements. * Prepare application builds, release documentation, and submissions for the Apple App Store and Google Play. * Troubleshoot crashes, performance issues, operating system changes, and customer\-reported defects. ESP32, Arduino, and Embedded Integration * Develop, review, and troubleshoot ESP32 firmware using Arduino frameworks and/or ESP\-IDF. * Write maintainable embedded C/C\+\+ code. * Design and document communication between the mobile application and embedded controller. * Implement Bluetooth Low Energy services, characteristics, command formats, acknowledgments, and status updates. * Integrate applicable sensors, switches, motor controls, relays, and other approved electronic components. * Work with electrical engineers to verify signal requirements, wiring assumptions, component interfaces, and power behavior. * Implement command validation, timeouts, watchdog behavior, and fault reporting. * Establish defined device behavior during connection loss, restart, low voltage, and interrupted operations. * Support secure device provisioning and firmware updates where technically appropriate and approved. * Maintain firmware versions and compatibility information across prototype and production hardware. Hydraulics and Equipment Control * Apply practical knowledge of hydraulic jacks, pumps, valves, actuators, pressure, loading, and controlled movement. * Understand how electrical and software commands affect hydraulic operation. * Collaborate with mechanical and hydraulic specialists to define permissible operating states and control sequences. * Identify situations where software behavior could produce unintended equipment movement. * Help integrate available pressure, position, load, temperature, or other feedback, depending on the final hardware design. * Develop software around engineering\-approved operating limits and fault responses. * Support controlled be ing commercial milestones approved by management: * Commercial launch of J\-JACK preorders; or * Commencement of production for the final J\-JACK product. The applicable milestone, start date, working hours, engagement classification, payment schedule, and scope will be confirmed in writing before work begins. This posting does not request unpaid development before that agreed start date. Any earlier development engagement would require a separate paid agreement. Sales Participation Opportunity In addition to base compensation, the selected candidate may be eligible for sales participation ranging from 0\.25% to 0\.75% of defined eligible J\-JACK sales. The final percentage and payout cap will be determined by management and documented in a separate written agreement. Management will consider relevant experience, technical responsibility, contribution to delivery, and ongoing involvement. The agreement will define: * Whether participation is calculated on gross or net eligible sales. * Which products, sales channels, and transactions qualify. * Treatment of discounts, taxes, shipping charges, refunds, cancellations, and chargebacks. * When participation begins and how long it continues. * Reporting and payment schedules. * Any performance milestones or continued\-service requirements. * The maximum payout or other agreed cap. * Treatment of participation when the engagement ends. This sales participation opportunity does not represent company ownership or stock unless a separate equity agreement expressly grants ownership. No sales volume or participation payout is guaranteed. How to Apply Apply through Indeed with: * Your current resume. * A portfolio, GitHub profile, or examples of relevant work. * Links to iOS and Android applications you helped develop. * A brief explanation of your personal contribution to those applications. * Examples of ESP32, Arduino, or Bluetooth\-connected hardware projects. * A summary of your hydraulic equipment or hydraulic control\-system experience. * Your location, availability, and ability to support hardware testing. * Confirmation that you understand the stated compensation and anticipated commercial launch timing. Please do not submit confidential code or materials belonging to another employer or client. Indeed Screening Questions * What iOS and Android applications have you personally designed, coded, and released? Please provide examples and describe your contribution. * Describe an ESP32 or Arduino project you developed. What hardware did it control or monitor? * Have you implemented Bluetooth Low Energy communication between a mobile application and an embedded device? Explain your approach. * What direct experience do you have with hydraulic systems, hydraulic jacks, pumps, valves, or related equipment? * How would you approach connection loss or an invalid command while a mobile application is communicating with physical equipment? * What experience do you have with databases, backend APIs, device diagnostics, and secure data handling? * Have you supported a connected hardware product through production or commercial launch? * Are you available to participate in hardware testing in Houston, or coordinate testing remotely with our engineering team? * Do you understand that the planned base compensation is $3,000 per month beginning on an agreed paid start date following a qualifying commercial milestone? * Do you understand that any 0\.25%–0\.75% sales participation is subject to a separate written agreement defining eligibility, calculation, duration, and a management\-approved payout cap? Equal Opportunity Jay Logistics \& Trade LLC considers qualified applicants based on relevant skills, experience, and ability to perform the responsibilities of the position. Pay: $45,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Health insurance * Stock options Education: * Bachelor's (Preferred) Experience: * Machine learning: 6 years (Preferred) * Arduino: 5 years (Required) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== At Justworks, you'll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset \- our people. We're helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We're data\-driven and never stop iterating. If you'd like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we'd love to hear from you. We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team. Our Values If this sounds like you, you'll fit right in. **Who You Are** =============== You are self\-driven and like to work with others to remove roadblocks. You are curious, and love to explore and learn new technologies. You have demonstrated the ability to build, deploy and maintain large\-scale, complex applications. You care more about solutions and impacting the customer experience than using a particular tool or framework. **Your Success Profile** ======================== **What You Will Work On** ------------------------- * Independently own larged\-scoped projects from initial discovery through launch with a focus on outcomes and customer impact * Collaborate with a cross functional team to find solutions to customer challenges * Improve the performance, reliability, and scalability of our existing systems * Promote engineering excellence through technical leadership, knowledge\-sharing and mentorship * Add capabilities to our high\-volume, fault\-tolerant processing infrastructure * Enhance our testing, monitoring and continuous deployment infrastructure * Keep extremely sensitive data compartmentalized and secure **How You Will Do Your Work** ----------------------------- As a Senior Software Engineer, *how* results are achieved is paramount for your success and ultimately result in our success as an organization. In this role, your foundational knowledge, skills, abilities and personal attributes are anchored in the following competencies: **Good judgment** \- the exercise of critical thinking, analyzing and assessing problems and implications, identifying patterns, making connections of underlying issues, understanding risks and developing mitigation strategies, and taking ownership of the outcome. **Resourcefulness** \- taking a can\-do approach, even in the face of obstacles and constraints by assessing what's in front of you and effectively and efficiently optimizing what you have, whether it's working on something new or thinking about how to do something better. **Teamwork and communication** \- putting our collective best together through documentation, collaboration, relationship\-building, listening, empathy, recruiting, and evangelism.Influence and leadership \- fostering a community of knowledge\-sharing, collaboration, mentorship, and forward\-thinking. **Skills and knowledge** \- the capacity to actively learn and apply specific domain knowledge, know\-how, and best practices to continually enhance and improve. In addition, all Justworkers focus on aligning their behaviors to our core values known as **COGIS**. It stands for: * **Camaraderie** \- Day to day you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You're an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others. * **Openness** \- Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You're curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others. * **Grit** \- You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You're committed, earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude. * **Integrity** \- Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You're honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example. * **Simplicity** \- Be like Einstein: "Everything should be made as simple as possible, but no simpler." **Qualifications** ------------------ * Minimum of 5 years of professional hands\-on experience * Mastery of modern server side languages, Golang is a plus but not required * Proficiency with SQL * Proficiency with cloud infrastructure management, preferably AWS * Experience supporting and mentoring other engineers and acting as a "force multiplier" * Experience working closely with designers and product managers **Technologies Used** --------------------- * Golang, Ruby on Rails, Javascript, MySQL, Kafka, AWS, Git, Memcache, Redis, ElasticSearch, Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, CircleCI, DataDog The base wage range for this position based in our New York City Office is targeted at $188,000\.00 to $242,000\.00 per year. \#LI\-AD1 \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-JS1 Actual compensation is based on multiple factors that are unique to each candidate, including and not limited to skill set, level of relevant experience, and specific work location. Salary ranges for positions based in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location. For more information about Justworks' Total Reward Philosophy, including all of the perks and benefits we are proud to offer our team members, please visit Total Rewards @ Justworks. **Diversity At Justworks** ========================== Justworks is committed to maintaining a workplace where diversity of identity, culture, and life experience is the norm and is celebrated authentically and respected consistently. Diversity in our work, our people, and our product drives creativity and innovation, entrepreneurial leadership and integrity, competitiveness, and collaboration throughout our business and in the market. We depend on our differences to make our team stronger, our workplace more dynamic, and our product accessible to all of our customers. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer open to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or familial status, disability, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status. Justworks is fully dedicated to providing necessary support to candidates with disabilities who may require reasonable accommodations. We also provide reasonable accommodations to employees based on their sincerely held religious beliefs, as well as for other covered reasons consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. If you're in need of a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at accommodations@justworks.com. Your comfort and success matter to us, and we're here to ensure an inclusive experience. Our DEIB Report
