jobs.title: Senior Technical Specialist – Utilities and Central Energy
jobs.description: POSITION SPECIFICATION **Position:** Senior Technical Specialist**Department:** Utilities \& Central Energy (UCE)**Reporting Relationship:** Engineering Manager, UCE COMPANY BACKGROUND KFI Engineers is a recognized industry leader in facility infrastructure design and performance. Since 1996, our culture of collaboration and unique capabilities have allowed us to make a difference in the way infrastructure and processing projects are delivered. Headquartered in St. Paul, MN, with numerous regional offices throughout the United States, and a team of hundreds of professionals, we offer opportunities to continue your career with mentorship programs, career growth support, and continued education. With KFI, we find a way to provide creative solutions to unique projects while providing the same care we would expect if we were the client. For more information about KFI Engineers and our culture, please visit www.kfi\-eng.com. The Utilities and Central Energy (UCE) group specializes in large central plant work, particularly for district energy serving cities, universities, hospitals, and manufacturing campuses. Our expertise covers both energy production and distribution. We have expertise in sustainable energy production, simple and combined cycle, combined heat and power, and medium voltage power. Our clients look for us to lead large complex projects from concept to completion, including startup, check\-out, and commissioning. POSITION OVERVIEW \& RESPONSIBILITIES The Senior Technical Specialist is one of the most advanced engineering roles at KFI and plays a key role in delivery of technical services by providing industry\-leading expertise in an engineering discipline or other area of specialization. This individual will typically have at least 15\+ years of experience in their area of expertise and be recognized by both clients and peers as among the leading practitioners of it regionally or nationally. The objective of this position is to leverage the individual’s knowledge and experience across all KFI’s relevant business units and projects where applicable. Key responsibilities include leading complex technical projects, designing systems, supervising or mentoring less experienced engineers, preparing technical reports and presentations, and ensuring compliance with standards and regulations. Specific accountabilities will include, but not be limited to, the following: **Project Execution*** Plan, direct, and supervise complex engineering projects and teams. * Support the lead discipline engineer in problem definition, design approach, and technology selection. * Meet with clients and customers when requested to support major decisions and defining project goals. * Provide technical consultation and guidance to the project team as requested or determined to be necessary. * Periodically review the progress of project deliverables for quality, technical accuracy and compliance with KFI standards. * Execute or lead the execution of project tasks where appropriate due to degree of difficulty, client preference, or other considerations. * Assist in investigation and root cause analysis of equipment and system failures and implementing preventative measures into KFI standards. * Work autonomously, developing and implementing solutions to complex problems. **Business Development*** Maintain an active role in a technical society or professional association. * Regularly present and/or publish in forums that provide exposure for KFI. * Engage current and prospective clients through participation in conferences, trade associations, and technical society activities. * Support project pursuits by participating in pre\-proposal meetings and discussions, contributing to and/or reviewing proposals, and participating in selection interviews. * Develop and deliver technical presentations or seminars for KFI’s clients on topics relevant to their business. **Standards Development*** Develop and maintain standard requirements for the quality and content of deliverables including drawings, specifications, and reports. * Identify and guide the development of tools to improve productivity and quality of work including design standards, quality review guidelines, and standard details. * Maintain the currency and technical quality of master specifications. **Staff Development*** Lead or mentor the technical development of peers and less experienced staff through regular interaction with project teams. * Utilize project quality control reviews and lessons\-learned sessions as teaching opportunities to increase staff knowledge and eliminate repetitive errors. * Recommend formal training and staff development necessary to maintain KFI’s technical expertise at an industry\-leading level. * Develop and deliver internal training for KFI staff as requested or determined to be necessary. Other duties as assigned. QUALIFICATIONS Required * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Structural, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical field. * 15\+ years of experience. * Professional Engineering license (P.E.) required. * Strong knowledge of industry standards, codes, and best practices. * Proven ability to build strong client relationships and establish credibility with internal and external stakeholders. * Excellent communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills. * Ability to present complex information to diverse audiences, synthesize ideas into actionable recommendations, and positively influence outcomes. * Strong planning, analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills. * High attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities. * Proficiency with computer technology and business software, including Microsoft Office. * Travel: May include up to 25% domestic travel Preferred * Master’s degree or higher in Engineering or a related discipline. * Experience with advanced engineering design, analysis, and project management. * Demonstrated leadership experience in managing large\-scale engineering projects. * Experience with advanced engineering software tools and simulation platforms. * Familiarity with emerging technologies and innovation trends within the professional, scientific, and technical services sector. **Working Conditions:*** Some work locations will feature the tough terrain typical of construction sites or require lifting or moving field testing equipment. CORE BEHAVIORS Accountable* Demonstrates persistence in the achievement of goals. * Acts with a sense of urgency. * Takes responsibility for own actions. Business Focus* Demonstrates agility, adapts well to changes. * Works well under pressure. * Meets commitments to internal/external customers. Project Execution* Plans projects well, managing last\-minute rushes and disruptions. * Balances Speed and Quality. * Looks for improvement in our delivery, tools and processes. * Other duties as assigned. Demonstrates Respect for Others* Keeps others adequately informed. * Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views. * Adapts communication style and method based on audience and situation. Team Player* Balances team and individual responsibilities. * Shares expertise with others. * Inspires respect and trust. **Benefits:** At KFI, our comprehensive benefit program provides our employees with the resources to support their health, wellness and financial well\-being. Full\-Time employees have access to:* Health, dental and vision insurance coverage * Virtual health services * Health Savings Account (HSA) \& Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) for HDHP enrollees with KFI contributions * Flexible Spending Account * 401(k) plan * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, life and AD\&D insurance * Employee Assistance Program * Paid Time Off to include Earned Sick and Safe Time in accordance with state laws * Paid Volunteer Time Off * Company Paid Holidays * Tuition Reimbursement * Bereavement Leave * Voluntary benefits offered include life, accident, critical illness coverage **Salary Range:** $157,500 \- $197,000 annually. The final agreed upon compensation is based on individual qualifications, experience, work location, and education. This position is eligible for an annual bonus. Please note this job description is not designed to cover a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. This position is not eligible for Visa sponsorship.*Equal Opportunity Employer – Veterans and Disabilities*

jobs.title: Engr, Software 1
jobs.description: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. **Group/Division** The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high\-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA's Central Engineering organization is made up of nine Centers of Excellence (CoEs) spanning disciplines like automation, motion control, sensors, platform design, and packaging. Each CoE contributes not only technical deliverables but also deep expertise, best practices, and advanced tools that elevate both what we build—and how we build it. **What You'll Do** In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high\-impact work across your area of expertise. **Responsibilities** -------------------- Engineers in the Software team will be working on building and maintaining infrastructure vital for large scale experimentation and deployment of HPC solutions. Domains in which a successful candidate will be encouraged to chip in, will include, data management and data loading, support for machine learning and deep learning model training. Although familiarity with Machine Learning and Deep Learning solutions would be a huge plus, this is primarily a Software Engineering position. Successful candidates are passionate about software and will have outstanding skills and hands on experience with development in C/C\+\+ and Python in a Windows/Linux environment. Deep conceptual understanding of multi\-threaded, multi process and distributed software systems is vital. **Crucial Skills** ------------------ Object Oriented Design \& Programming in Java or C\+\+ Scripting languages like Java Script, Python; Data Structures and algorithms Linux System Programming Distributed systems **Desirable Skills** -------------------- Cloud technologies for network, storage, containerization and compute clusters. Building and configuring Linux kernels, and designing and fixing network infrastructure; Linux Device Driver Development Understanding of various networking stacks GPU Architectures and CUDA (CuGraph, CuData, CuML etc). Distributing computing frameworks like Apache Spark, DASK; Creating the techniques and methods to integrate multiple hardware and software subsystems to seek sophisticated technical challenges; Data science skills to acquire, transform and present data from various sources to build powerful debugging and analysis software **Qualifications** ------------------ BS in Math, CS, Engineering or related field. **Minimum Qualifications** Bachelor's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience **About KLA** We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us. **Total Rewards** Base Pay Range: $38\.66 \- $65\.73 Per Hour\&\#xa;Primary Location: USA\-NY\-Remote\-US03K KLA’s total rewards package for employees may also include participation in performance incentive programs and eligibility for additional benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, life, and other voluntary benefits, 401(K) including company matching, employee stock purchase program (ESPP), student debt assistance, tuition reimbursement program, development and career growth opportunities and programs, financial planning benefits, wellness benefits including an employee assistance program (EAP), paid time off and paid company holidays, and family care and bonding leave. Interns are eligible for some of the benefits listed. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed reflects the pay for this position in the primary location identified in this posting. Actual pay depends on several factors, including state minimum pay wage rates, location, job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education level or training. We are committed to complying with all applicable federal and state minimum wage requirements where applicable. If applicable, your recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for your preferred location during the hiring process. **Use of AI Statement** At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem\-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset. **Equal Opportunity Statement** KLA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us at talent.acquisition@kla.com or at \+1\-408\-352\-2808 to request accommodation. For additional information, view the US Know Your Rights poster on the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission website.

jobs.title: Enterprise Architect
jobs.description: Attention: Kapitus is aware that individuals posing as recruiters may be communicating with job seekers about supposed positions with Kapitus. Kapitus has received reports that the content and method of communication can vary, but messages may contain requests for payment (e.g., fees for equipment or training) and/or for sensitive financial information. Kapitus will **never** ask a candidate for employment for payment or financial information during the initial application or interview process. All open positions are posted in location specific employment portals available at www.kapitus.com/careersAll legitimate Kapitus job postings on employment sites will direct candidates to complete an application through these portals before completion of the hiring process. Candidates with additional questions or concerns regarding any recruiting communications or Kapitus' recruiting process in general should email **recruiting@kapitus.com** **Please note: This position is 100% remote for candidates residing in Virginia. Candidates residing in Maryland and Washington, DC are also encouraged to apply and must be willing to work a hybrid schedule from our Arlington, VA office.** Kapitus has helped small and midsize businesses access capital for two decades, funding roughly $2 billion to date and building toward $6 billion and beyond. We originate, decision, fund, and service financing every day across a growing set of products and partner channels. As we scale, we are investing in the technology foundation that growth depends on, and we are creating our first dedicated Enterprise Architect role to lead it. This is a build\-and\-shape role, not a maintain role. You will define the target\-state architecture for the entire lending lifecycle, stand up the architecture practice that keeps it coherent, and sequence the modernization that unlocks the next phase of growth. You will work shoulder to shoulder with engineering, product, data, and security leaders, and your decisions will reach the platform that moves real money for real businesses. **What You Will Do:** * Own the end\-to\-end architecture. Produce and maintain a living, current, AI\-crawlable map of how a deal flows from lead through decisioning, funding, servicing, and collections, and the systems, data stores, integrations, and owners behind it. Make it the single reference the whole organization trusts. * Set the target state and sequence the path to it. Define the modernization roadmap, including the core\-platform runtime uplift, decoupling decisioning from the core, the move toward a modern lending core, and the environments and infrastructure\-as\-code that let change ship safely. Sequence the work against the product roadmap so each initiative unblocks a business outcome. * Establish the canonical data model. Define Kapitus\-owned data models for the core decisioning inputs (credit bureau, cash flow, KYB), and a vendor\-adapter layer so data providers plug in behind a stable internal contract. This removes single\-vendor lock\-in and enables failover and champion\-challenger testing. * Integrate the data and AI architecture, and keep it coherent. Partner closely with the Chief Data and AI Officer's organization so the data platform, the analytics and reporting products, the cross\-team decisioning\-data pipeline, and the machine\-learning and model\-deployment lifecycle fit cleanly into the enterprise architecture. Hold the operational\-versus\-analytical data split (real\-time to the transactional store, analytical to the warehouse), define the ownership boundaries and contracts where data, engineering, and product meet so nothing sits orphaned between organizations, and maintain how that domain fits the overall picture as it evolves. * Lead integration and event\-driven architecture. Shape the API and eventing standards (REST, webhooks, event buses), the partner\-API contract, and the middleware that connects Salesforce, the core platform, AWS services, and third parties. * Design for security and resilience from the start. Make authentication, secrets management, least\-privilege, audit logging, disaster recovery, high availability, and observability first\-class attributes of every design, in a regulated\-lending context. * Stand up architecture governance. Run a lightweight, respected practice: architecture principles, decision records (ADRs) with real trade\-off analysis, a design\-review gate, and build\-versus\-buy and total\-cost\-of\-ownership discipline. Keep it enabling, not bureaucratic. * Partner, do not dictate. Bring product, engineering, the data and AI organization, and security into architecture decisions early through joint, rolling planning, and translate technical choices into business terms for executives and into clear guidance for engineers. * Govern responsible AI enablement. Shape the guardrails and standards for AI\-assisted development and for model deployment and governance, in partnership with the data and security organiza ility** – Up to 10% annually * **Health Insurance:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and employer\-paid vision plans through UnitedHealthcare (UHC), with various coverage levels available to meet the needs of our employees and their families. Additional perks through UHC include: Sweat Equity, free subscription to the Calm App, UHC rewards, Real Appeal, and Quit For Life. * **Flexible Spending Account:** Set aside pre\-tax dollars from your paycheck to pay for qualified out\-of\-pocket medical, dental, vision, pharmacy or dependent care expenses. * **Lifestyle Spending Account:** Employer sponsored post\-tax benefits that allow reimbursement for expenses related to physical, mental and financial well\-being. * **100% Company Paid Insurances:** Kapitus fully covers the cost of basic short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, as well as vision insurance, ensuring our employees have comprehensive protection without any personal expense. * **Voluntary Insurance:** Supplemental life insurance as well as enhanced short\- and long\-term disability coverage are available through Mutual of Omaha, providing additional security for our employees. Additionally, Colonial Accident and Hospitalization insurances are also available, offering further protection against unforeseen events. * **Paid Maternity and Parental Leave:** Beyond state\-mandated leave policies, Kapitus provides company\-paid maternity and parental leave, supporting our employees during important family milestones. * **Commuter Benefits:** We offer pre\-tax benefits on parking and commuter expenses to cover travel to and from work. * **LifeBalance Program:** Enhance your lifestyle with our LifeBalance membership, which offers discounts on outdoor activities, the arts, health, and fitness. Additional benefits include: + Pet and car insurance discounts. + Financial services such as LegalShield. + Relaxation and stress management tools. * **Plum Benefits Discount Program:** Access exclusive discounts on shows, travel, car rentals, and more, enriching your personal and family life. * **Tuition Reimbursement:** Pursue further education with up to $5,000 annually in tuition reimbursement, plus opportunities to attend relevant conferences and career development events. Managed through our LSA plan, Kapitus Academy. * **Travel Reimbursement:** We also offer travel reimbursement for all work\-related travel, supporting your involvement in career and personal development activities. * **Paid Time Off and Sick Time.** * **Retirement Benefits**: Our 401K plan is managed through Fidelity. To support your long\-term financial goals, the company provides a 25% match on your contributions, up to 6% of your annual salary. **About Kapitus:** Kapitus is one of the most reliable and respected names in small business financing. As both a direct lender and a marketplace built with a trusted network of lending partners, we can provide small businesses with the financing they need when, and how it is needed. We have spent our entire existence building a culture that makes us excited to come to work in the morning. Our company is fast paced, teammates need to be self\-directed and have an internal motivation to do the right thing, even when the right thing takes a lot of hard work. integration • Lead tooling proof of concept exercises, define evaluation criteria, run technical bake\-offs, and produce recommendation documentation for architecture review • Perform and direct positives, and drive remediation with owning engineering teams • Manage third\-party penetration test scoping, vendor coordination, finding validation, and retest closure • Maintain and enforce guardrails for AI\-assisted development, including approved AI coding tools, agentic tooling, MCP server usage, and dependency provenance controls addressing supply chain and slopsquatting risk Team role definition, interview loop design, candidate assessment, and onboarding • Conduct performance reviews, set individual objectives, and manage performance concerns in partnership with HR • Define career paths, technical skill matrices, and individual development plans for application security engineers • Allocate work and manage team capacity against the program roadmap and inbound intake demand • Provide technical mentorship on secure code review, exploitation technique, tooling operation, and finding write\-up quality • Provide input to headcount planning and offshore resourcing requests for review by the Global Enterprise Security Architect • Define runbooks, playbooks, and repeatable procedures so that AppSec operations are not dependent on individual knowledge • Manage jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Lunon is an AI\-native consulting firm in New York City, backed by General Catalyst. Most companies don't need another deck about AI. They need an engineer who can walk in, understand the operation, and ship. That's what we do: we embed engineers inside the business and stay until the software runs without us. In the last year we took a steel fabricator from "we think AI could help" to a quoting system their reps use every day. Our open\-source research system ranks first on DeepResearch Bench. The team is young and moves fast. Everyone here has a wide skill set, works with the newest tools as they land, and owns what they ship end to end. Nobody hands you a ticket. This role builds most of what ships on our next engagement: a private\-equity\-backed call analytics company with thousands of recorded conversations a day. A Senior Forward Deployed Engineer sets direction. You make it real inside the client's environment. * *Fully remote, US\-based. Lunon is headquartered in New York City.* * *Some travel to client sites, a few days at a time, fully covered.* **What you'll do** ------------------ * Build the speech and text pipelines, LLM workflows, and integrations the client runs on. * Deploy to the client's cloud, instrument what you ship, and fix what breaks. * Write the tests, evals, and docs that keep it working after the engagement ends. * Learn the client's business fast, and say so early when the plan meets reality. **What you'll need** -------------------- Experience matters here. We judge it by what you've shipped and kept running, not by a number of years. * You've shipped something with LLMs in it that people actually used. * You've worked inside a codebase you didn't write. * You can show the work: a repo, a demo, or a write\-up. * You use AI coding tools every day and judge the result by the system and its output, not the language. * You can travel to client sites and are authorized to work in the US. **Nice to have** ---------------- Apply even if none of these are true. * You've built with speech\-to\-text, conversation analytics, or large volumes of unstructured text. * You've integrated with a CRM, a telephony platform, or a data warehouse. * You've shipped a side project to real users and kept it alive. **How we hire** --------------- * A 30\-minute conversation with the team about what you've shipped and what we're building. * A technical deep\-dive on one system you owned, from the business problem to production. * A working session on a real client problem with the team. * References, then an offer. We aim to finish in two weeks. **Beware of recruitment fraud.** All official correspondence comes from a lunon.ai email address. We will never ask you to share bank account information, cash a check, or purchase equipment as part of the hiring process. Compensation Range: $110K \- $130K

jobs.description: **Luxury Presence** is building the AI growth platform for real estate. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business. **Role Overview** ----------------- We're looking for a **Staff Product Manager** to own how our clients get found in search and AI: more than 20,000 real estate websites, each competing in its own market, with a real business depending on the outcome. This is a platform product, where one good product decision reaches thousands of businesses at once. Search is being rebuilt in real time. Our clients are evaluated by Google, by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini, and by every prospective seller who asks an assistant which agent they should call. Together, we build game\-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. jobs.title: Systems Engineer (Firmware)
jobs.description: **Company Overview** ==================== Each year, 2\.5 trillion hours are spent on household chores. At Matic, we’re on a mission to recapture that lost time, and we’re doing it by revolutionizing home robotics. Our first product, also called Matic, is a Wall\-E\-esque floor cleaning robot. We've built what amounts to "full self\-driving in the home” with real\-time 3D mapping, adaptive path\-tracking, and a precise semantic understanding of the home. Our breakthroughs in spatial AI allow Matic to work reliably in real homes, using only RGB cameras and neural networks running on\-device. **Privacy First** ----------------- What happens in the home, stays in the home. Our robots are private by design, with all data processing performed by the robot itself, not in the cloud. **Our Approach** ---------------- Before the iPhone, consumers adopted several distinct devices; cell phones, PDAs, and portable music players each served a particular need. We believe in a similar progression for home robotics, starting with single\-purpose robots and building iteratively toward more complex capabilities over time. **Our Culture** --------------- Matic is a tight\-knit and collaborative team, singularly focused on building products our customers will cherish. We're ultra\-hardworking people committed to solving tough problems that save precious time and energy. **About the role** ================== As the name “firmware” may imply, this role closes the gap between our software and our hardware. In this role, you will be the hardware team’s window into Matic’s software, and you will be the software team’s window into Matic’s hardware. Firmware engineers are fundamentally cross\-discipline and are expected to operate with product\-focused systems\-level thinking. **What you’ll do** ------------------ Firmware at Matic is a broad domain, and you will work on a wide variety of projects such as: * Bring\-up and support for hardware changes (electrical and mechanical). For example: + A new sensing mechanism to detect when the waste bag is full from water during mopping \- requires updating device drivers to interface with the new sensor, implementing tests to ensure the new system is working as expected during assembly, and coordinating robot behaviors to accommodate the new system (data filtering, updating the bag fullness check). * Design and improve the behavioral logic and controls algorithms for Matic’s physical systems * Analyze robot logs along with motor and sensor data to debug hardware failures. For example: + Customer reports their Matic isn’t charging despite being properly docked + Employee testing their Matic at home mentions that their robot suddenly started making weird clicking sounds while mopping * Support internal processes with tooling to interface with Matic’s motors and sensors **What we look for** -------------------- We're looking for strong software experience with electromechanical projects. This likely includes deep experience with microcontrollers (bare\-metal programming, RTOS, communication protocols), a fundamental understanding of electronics (schematics, datasheets, motors, sensors, batteries), and intuition for physical systems (motors, moving parts, materials). You should have strong experience writing embedded C/C\+\+, and we hope you are eager to learn Rust if you aren’t already familiar with it (see: why we use Rust). ### **Must haves:** * 2\+ years of industry experience or equivalent (e.g. grad school) * Core software skills: + data structures, control flow, computer systems + deep experience with systems programming language(s): C, C\+\+, rust, etc. + experience / comfort with scripting / prototyping language(s): python, etc. * Experience with hardware (the more the better): + Motors (brushed and brushless DC, drivers, operating principles) + Controls systems + Sensors (datasheets, device drivers, data filtering) + Electrical fundamentals + Mechanical intuition + You’ve built things (robots, PCBs, 3D\-printing, anything) * Experience with microcontrollers (STM32, PIC, ESP32, etc.) * Soft\-skills: + Multi\-disciplinary team \& leadership experience + Thinks broadly, connecting insights from across the system to solve problems + Meticulous, detail oriented, organized + Fixated on edge\-cases and testing ### **Nice to have:** * Friendly \& approachable personality + non\-combative, selfless, team\-first mentality * Higher\-level robotics exposure: + computer vision, machine learning, path planning, SLAM **We’d love to hear from you if…** ---------------------------------- * You love diagnosing complex electromechanical issues * You are genuinely motivated to help those around you * You are passionate about learning outside of your normal comfort zones * You are excited to do great work **Compensation** Base $120,000 — $200,000 Actual Compensation will depend on skills, experience and qualifications. Base Salary is one part of the total compensation package. The role is also eligible for equity through the company’s discretionary equity program, along with a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision coverage access to a 401(k) plan.

Technical Leadership \& Collaboration * Serve as the subject matter expert for Databricks architecture and implementation. * Provide technical leadership and guidance to data engineers, developers, and cross\-functional teams. * Lead architecture discussions, design reviews, and technical decision\-making. * Collaborate with cloud infrastructure, DevOps, analytics, and business intelligence teams. * Identify opportunities to improve data accessibility, platform efficiency, and overall data capabilities. Required Qualifications * 8\+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, data warehousing, or related technical disciplines. * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with Databricks, including designing and implementing enterprise solutions. * Demonstrated experience leading at least one end\-to\-end Databricks implementation, from architecture and initial setup through production deployment. * Strong understanding of Databricks Lakehouse architecture, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Apache Spark. * Advanced proficiency in Python, PySpark, and SQL. * Experience designing and implementing scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and data integration solutions. * Strong experience with at least one major cloud platform: Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform. * Experience with cloud\-based data storage, data warehouses, and distributed processing technologies. * Strong understanding of data modeling, data governance, data security, and performance optimization. * Experience migrating or modernizing legacy data platforms into cloud\-based architectures. * Ability to develop architecture diagrams, technical documentation, and implementation roadmaps. * Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate with technical teams and business stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications * Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional or Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate. * Databricks Certified Data Architect (if applicable to current certification offerings) or other advanced Databricks credentials. * Experience implementing Databricks in multiple enterprise environments. * Experience with Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, AWS Glue, Amazon S3, or similar cloud services. * Experience with Terraform, infrastructure as code, and automated deployment pipelines. * Familiarity with dbt, Airflow, or other orchestration and transformation technologies. * Experience integrating Databricks with Power BI, Tableau, or other analytics platforms. * Understanding of streaming data architectures and real\-time processing. * Experience supporting machine learning, AI, or advanced analytics workloads. * Experience with enterprise data platform modernization initiatives. What Success Looks Like * Successfully architect and implement a production\-ready Databricks environment. * Establish scalable, repeatable, and well\-governed data architecture standards. * Deliver reliable data pipelines and integration frameworks that support enterprise reporting and analytics. * Improve data processing performance, accessibility, and operational efficiency. * Provide technical leadership that enables engineering teams to effectively develop and maintain solutions within Databricks. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is a hands\-on architect who has personally designed, built, and implemented Databricks environments, rather than someone whose experience is limited to maintaining or developing within an established platform. jobs.title: Senior Manager, HPC Engineering
jobs.description: Site: Mass General Brigham Incorporated Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not\-for\-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high\-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham. **Job Summary** Mass General Brigham Digital supports the clinical, operational, research, and academic missions through secure, reliable, and user\-centered technology services. Digital Research Operations provides specialized platforms, infrastructure, and support services that enable investigators, research staff, trainees, and collaborators to conduct data\-intensive biomedical research across Mass General Brigham. Join our scientific computing team and help researchers unlock the potential of a new, world\-class high\-performance computing platform. By enabling researchers to move from idea to analysis, discovery, validation, and translation more efficiently, the platform supports larger and more complex datasets, more ambitious scientific questions, reproducible and collaborative science, and faster progress toward research findings that can ultimately improve care for our patients. The Senior Manager, HPC Engineering leads the engineering, architecture, reliability, operations, technical roadmap, and ongoing evolution of our high\-performance computing environment. This role is accountable for the technical health of the environment, including compute hardware, high\-speed networking, storage, operating systems, configuration management, scientific software stacks, researcher\-facing applications, automation, monitoring, incident response, and operational readiness. The Senior Manager serves as the senior technical owner for HPC and partners closely with the Senior Manager, HPC Researcher Experience to ensure the environment is reliable, scalable, secure, well\-documented, and aligned with current and future researcher needs. This includes maturing core services while advancing new capabilities such as data adjacency, enclave computing, advanced data movement, benchmarking, and emerging scientific computing workflows. The role also manages the Managed Services partner relationship, setting operational expectations and ensuring effective day\-to\-day operations, vendor coordination, maintenance execution, incident response, escalation management, and continuous service improvement Principal Duties and Responsibilities * Own the technical strategy, operating model, reliability, and continuous improvement of the HPC platform, including compute, storage, networking, operating systems, configuration, software, automation, monitoring, and operational standards. * Own the HPC platform architecture and technical roadmap, ensuring that compute, storage, networking, software, automation, security, data adjacency, enclave capabilities, and operational capabilities evolve to meet current and future research needs. * Lead engineering activities for HPC hardware, GPU and CPU compute nodes, high\-speed interconnects, storage systems, network connectivity, operating system images, firmware, drivers, configuration management, and platform lifecycle management. * Own the scientific computing software environment, including schedulers, modules, containers, compilers, libraries, researcher applications, Open OnDemand, and other tools required to support data\-intensive biomedical research workloads. * Own workload management practices for the HPC environment, including scheduler configuration, queues, partitions, job policies, GPU and CPU allocation, fair\-share models, utilization optimization, and performance tuning. * Lead benchmarking and performance engineering practices, including workload profiling, bottleneck analysis, system tuning, baseline benchmark development, vendor performance validation, and evaluation of emerging technologies to improve platform performance and researcher productivity. * Lead capacity planning and platform lifecycle planning, including utilization forecasting, hardware refresh planning, storage growth analysis, procurement input, and recommendations for future platform investments. * Own change, release, and configuration management practices for the HPC platform, ensuring that system updates, software deployments, security patches, configuration changes, and maintenance activities are planned, tested, documented, and communicated. * Establish engineering practices for platform resilience and operational continuity, including backup and recovery coordination, maintenance planning, runbooks, recovery procedures, change controls, and incident readiness. * Develop and mature automation for user provisioning, storage provisioning, access controls, environment configuratio r tools, researcher applications, and software lifecycle practices in multi\-user scientific computing environments. * Experience managing managed services providers, vendors, consultants, service\-level expectations, incident coordination, maintenance planning, performance reviews, and escalations in complex technical environments. * Demonstrated ability to lead platform operations, improve reliability, manage incidents, analyze root causes, plan capacity, reduce operational risk, and mature engineering practices using metrics and operational data. * Knowledge of security, HIPAA and privacy principles, compliance, identity and access management, and risk management practices relevant to healthcare or academic research environments preferred. * Familiarity within an Agile/SCRUM process. **Working Model:** * 1\-4 days per week onsite at Assembly Row in Somerville, MA, with an average of at least four days on\-site per month. * A quiet, secure, compliant workspace is required for remote workdays, and will be viewed and confirmed via Microsoft Teams Video on day 1 for all remote and/or hybrid hires * MGB will ensure that candidates have a HIPAA\-compliant workspace **Additional Job Details (if applicable)** **Remote Type** Hybrid **Work Location** 399 Revolution Drive **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40 **Employee Type** Regular **Work Shift** Day (United States of America) **Pay Range** $117,707\.20 \- $171,204\.80/Annual **Grade** 8 At Mass General Brigham, we believe in recognizing and rewarding the unique value each team member brings to our organization. Our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and any offer extended will take into account your skills, relevant experience if applicable, education, certifications and other essential factors. The base pay information provided offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications; however, it does not encompass all elements contributing to your total compensation package. In addition to competitive base pay, we offer comprehensive benefits, career advancement opportunities, differentials, premiums and bonuses as applicable and recognition programs designed to celebrate your contributions and support your professional growth. We invite you to apply, and our Talent Acquisition team will provide an overview of your potential compensation and benefits package. **EEO Statement:** 0100 Mass General Brigham Incorporated is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religious creed, national origin, sex, age, gender identity, disability, sexual orientation, military service, genetic information, and/or other status protected under law. The framework is comprised of ten competencies (half People\-Focused, half Performance\-Focused) and are defined by observable and measurable skills and behaviors that contribute to workplace effectiveness and career success. jobs.title: Lead AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ A career with us means you’ll work alongside exceptional people and be empowered to reach your professional and personal goals. Our employees are at the foundation of what enables MassMutual to deliver on our purpose to help people secure their futures and protect the ones they love. We embrace the idea that we all are stronger and better through our support for one another. We strive to create a culture where employees feel valued and are celebrated for who they are. **Job Description** ------------------- **The Opportunity** MassMutual’s AI Platform Engineering team is seeking an impact\-driven AI Platform Engineer, to apply the AI platform where it matters most: improving how MassMutual builds and runs technology. Embedded directly with IT teams across the portfolio, you will diagnose where engineering and operational effort goes, design and hands\-on deliver AI\-enabled solutions across the full software development lifecycle, including cybersecurity, and prove the results with data. You will pair enterprise\-level strategy with deep implementation skill, turning what you learn in the field into reusable patterns and platform capabilities. **The Team** This is a unique opportunity to work on the team that builds and operates the platform powering MassMutual’s AI initiatives. The team operates at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, AI/ML systems, and developer experience—delivering foundational capabilities that shape how the entire organization builds and deploys AI. We partner closely with AI engineering, product, and cloud engineering teams across the enterprise, and we invest in growth through a culture of peer learning, candid feedback, and shared technical standards. This team is defined by a shared commitment to engineering excellence, clear documentation, and the kind of technical leadership that makes hard problems tractable. **The Impact** * Embed with IT portfolio teams and deliver outcomes hands\-on—work shoulder to shoulder with engineering and operations teams, moving quickly from discovery to working solution to production, in their real environments, toolchains, and constraints. * Apply the AI platform across the full SDLC—requirements and design, code generation and review, test automation, CI/CD, release, legacy modernization, and production support—to measurably improve build and run efficiency. * Build and ship the hard parts yourself—agentic workflows, integrations with existing engineering and operations toolchains, evaluation harnesses, and automation—then package successes into reusable accelerators, playbooks, and reference implementations other teams can adopt. * Embed security and responsible AI into every engagement—threat modeling for AI use cases, secure pipelines, access and secrets management, software supply chain integrity, audit logging, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. Translate governance and compliance requirements (e.g., NIST AI RMF, OWASP LLM Top 10\) into practical controls teams can adopt without slowing delivery. * Define the AI\-enabled engineering strategy for the IT portfolio—assess workflows across teams, prioritize opportunities by measurable value, and translate them into a sequenced roadmap with clear business cases. * Establish baselines and measure results—define build and run efficiency metrics (e.g., cycle time, deployment frequency, quality, toil, incident volume, time to resolve, and cost), track adoption and return, and report outcomes to senior IT leadership. * Serve as the senior technical escalation point for the most complex adoption and integration challenges across teams. Run design reviews, provide deep technical feedback, and pair with engineers on the gnarliest problems. * Close the loop with platform engineering—translate field learnings into prioritized capability requests, ADRs, and design input that improve the platform, without owning core platform build. * Drive adoption through influence—lead change with directors and engineering leaders across the portfolio, communicate technical trade\-offs clearly to technical and executive audiences, and represent the platform to senior stakeholders. * Raise the technical bar across the organizationby mentoring leads and senior engineers, running enablement and communities of practice, and setting the standard for AI\-assisted engineering—without managing anyone directly. **The Minimum Qualifications** * 12\+ years total experience in software engineering, DevOps/platform engineering, SRE, security engineering, or solutions engineering, including 5\+ years at lead, staff, or principal level with multi\-team or enterprise\-wide technical scope. * Proven record of delivering measurable build and run efficiency gains in large, complex IT environments—from strategy through hands\-on implementation. * Forward\-deployed or customer\-facing engineering experience: embedding with teams, running discovery, shaping ambiguous problems into working solutions, and driving ad ifics of the assistance you need. California residents: For detailed information about your rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), please visit our California Consumer Privacy Act Disclosures page. MassMutual will accept applications on an ongoing basis until such time as a candidate has been offered employment. The job description includes the main duties of this position, which may evolve over time. You may be required to perform other duties not listed. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. Salary Range: $172,000\-$225,700 **Award\-Winning Culture** -------------------------- MassMutual is guided by a single purpose: We help people secure their future and protect the ones they love. As a company operated for the benefit of our members and participating policyowners, we are defined by mutuality and our vision to provide financial well\-being for all Americans. It’s more than our company structure — it’s our way of life. We are a company of people protecting people. Our company exists because people are willing to share risk and resources and rely on each other when it counts. We strive to build a thriving community where everyone is valued, included, and feels that they belong. At MassMutual, we Live Mutual. **How We Work** --------------- MassMutual’s flexible workplace approach combines the importance of connecting in person and the flexibility of working remotely. Our hybrid model puts collaboration first with employees coming in at least three days per week to our spectacular campus settings and also enjoying the flexibility of remote Fridays, company\-wide remote weeks, and a bank of flexible remote weeks to use throughout the year. **Benefits for the whole you (and your loved ones)** ---------------------------------------------------- There’s more to your life than your job and there’s more to your aspirations than a paycheck. We take a holistic view of compensation and benefits that provides the flexibility to create a healthy balance in your life for work, family, and community. We offer the benefits you’d expect, like medical, dental, 401(k), and generous vacation time, but we also offer ones you might not expect, like three paid days for volunteering, a $1,250 annual Well\-Being Wallet, and up to 320 hours of caregiver leave. Explore some of our offerings below. ### **Paid Time Off** * In addition to generous vacation time, paid holidays, and flexible holidays, MassMutual offers 'take care' time to care for yourself or someone you love—whether for physical illness or mental health. ### **Health \& Well\-Being** In addition to top\-line medical and dental coverage, personalized mental health solutions, on\-site and virtual health coaching, and much more, MassMutual reimburses employees up to $1,250 per year for eligible expenses supporting mental, physical, and financial well\-being. ### **Financial Well\-Being** In addition to competitive salaries and bonuses, educational assistance programs, and much more, MassMutual offers up to a 10% total 401(k) benefit, consisting of a 5% company match and a 5% annual contribution. ### **Taking Care** MassMutual offers generous maternity and parental leaves, as well as bereavement leave to mourn the loss of a loved one (and the employee defines 'loved one'). In addition, we offer up to 320 hours of caregiver leave to help employees support loved ones in times of need. ### **Giving Back** MassMutual offers three paid days for employees to volunteer with eligible nonprofits of their choice, and the MassMutual Foundation matches employee donation dollars to eligible nonprofit organizations up to $5,000 annually. ### **Commuter Benefits** MassMutual offers a Qualified Commuter Program through which eligible employees can pay qualified workplace commuting expenses with before\-tax dollars, as well as a commuter wallet option for employees based at Boston and NYC campuses.

jobs.title: Lead AI & Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Location**: This is a hybrid remote/in\-office role. ***Medidata follows a hybrid office policy in which employees who are hired for an in\-person position are expected to work on site a certain number of days per week following Company policy.*** **About our Company**: Medidata is powering smarter treatments and healthier people through digital solutions to support clinical trials. Celebrating over 25 years of ground\-breaking technological innovation across more than 38,000 trials and 12 million patients, Medidata offers industry\-leading expertise, analytics\-powered insights, and one of the largest clinical trial data sets in the industry. More than 1 million registered users across approximately 2,300 customers trust Medidata's seamless, end\-to\-end platform to improve patient experiences, accelerate clinical breakthroughs, and bring therapies to market faster. A Dassault Systèmes brand (Euronext Paris: FR0014003TT8, DSY.PA), Medidata is headquartered in New York City and has been recognized as a Leader by Everest Group and IDC. Discover more at www.medidata.com. Listen to our latest podcast, from Dreamers to Disruptors, and follow us at @Medidata. **About the Team**: We are seeking a **Lead AI \& Data Engineer** to design, build, and deploy production\-grade AI solutions and data products. In this role, you will lead the development of AI\-powered solutions leveraging large language models (LLMs), retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agent orchestration, and modern data architectures to enable new AI\-driven capabilities across our **Virtual Twin** ecosystem. The ideal candidate combines deep data engineering and AI\-native development expertise to build scalable, secure, and reliable AI\-enabled data solutions. You will drive technical architecture, data pipeline development, AI integration, and engineering best practices, translating complex business and clinical research requirements into production\-ready solutions. You will work closely with product management, data science, platform engineering, and clinical experts, to deliver innovative capabilities that enable intelligent workflows and data\-driven decision\-making. **Responsibilities**: * Engineer scalable, automated data pipelines and AI\-powered solutions using modern AI technologies, vector databases, and automation, applying CI/CD practices jobs.title: Principal R&D Engineer
jobs.description: We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on \- 6 Nov 2026 Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. **A Day in the Life** ===================== The Structural Heart portfolio within Medtronic’s Interventional Cardiology Therapies (ICT) Operating Unit is looking for a Principal R\&D Engineer. This role will support the development and expansion of transcatheter heart valve replacement technologies through advanced clinical and preclinical imaging analysis, computational and anatomical modeling, and research activities for Structural Heart therapies. This role will partner with engineering, clinical, and scientific teams to analyze cardiovascular imaging datasets, develop predictive models, evaluate device\-anatomy interactions, and generate evidence that supports product development, preclinical studies, and future therapy advancement. The Structural Heart group develops transcatheter technologies for the treatment of valvular heart disease and aortic conditions. This team supports a broad portfolio of transcatheter valve replacement and repair therapies, including technologies used to treat aortic, pulmonary, mitral, and tricuspid valve disease. This position is based at our Mounds View, MN facility and requires a minimum of 4 days per week on\-site for in\-person collaboration. This role may require up to 10% travel to support business objectives, in\-person meetings and project activities. **In general, the following responsibilities apply for the Principal R\&D Engineer which includes, but is not limited to the following:** * Analyze clinical and preclinical imaging datasets including computed tomography (CT), ultrasound, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), and fluoroscopy to support product development and use\-condition assessment * Develop anatomical reconstructions, segmentation workflows, and measurement methodologies using advanced 3D imaging software and analytical tools * Create, validate, and maintain image\-processing, measurement, and data\-analysis workflows using Python and MATLAB * Develop predictive models and virtual patient assessments to evaluate anatomy\-device interactions and support screening methodologies * Partner with modeling, design, testing, and clinical teams to support research, feasibility, and product development activities * Generate technical documentation, scientific reports, presentations, and supporting evidence for engineering and research activities * Collaborate with external physicians, researchers, and cross\-functional stakeholders to advance structural heart technologies and clinical understanding Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance within the imaging and cardiovascular modeling domain * **Required Qualifications** Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Scientific, Engineering, Math with 7\+ years of experience OR Master's degree with 5\+ years of engineering or scientific experience OR PhD with 3\+ years of engineering or scientific experience * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience analyzing cardiovascular imaging data using CT, ultrasound, MRI, or fluoroscopy * Experience with image segmentation, anatomical reconstruction, 3D modeling, CAD software, or quantitative image analysis * Experience developing analytical tools, scripts, or workflows using Python and/or MATLAB * Experience authoring technical documentation, reports, and presentations supporting research or product development activities * Experience with structural heart, transcatheter valve, or cardiovascular medical device development/manufacturing * Knowledge of cardiac anatomy, physiology, pathology, and valve disease, including mitral and tricuspid anatomy * Experience with statistical shape modeling, computational fluid dynamics (CFD), finite element analysis (FEA), or other physics\-based modeling techniques * Experience developing or validating machine learning models for medical imaging or anatomy\-device interaction analysis * Experience working within regulated medical device environments, including design controls, FDA regulations, Quality System Regulations (QSR), and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) * In depth knowledge of mitral and tricuspid valve and surrounding structures * Experience with catheter\-based procedures Preclinical experience * For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214\.2(h)(4\)(iii)(A) is required. **Physical Job Requirements** The
