jobs.title: Staff Software Integration Engineer
jobs.description: **Merlin (NASDAQ: MRLN)** is a publicly traded aerospace and defense company building a non\-human pilot to deliver full\-stack autonomy for any aircraft from takeoff to touchdown. The Merlin Pilot autonomy system powers a growing range of aircraft and mission profiles and has been proven through hundreds of autonomous flights from Merlin's global flight test facilities, including Kerikeri, New Zealand; Smithfield, Rhode Island; and soon, Bedford, Massachusetts. Headquartered in Boston, Merlin is expanding its organization to accelerate the development and deployment of its autonomy platform, helping customers solve some of aviation's most pressing challenges, from pilot shortages to improving flight safety. Backed by some of the world's leading investors prior to its public listing, Merlin continues to advance the certification and commercialization of autonomous flight across commercial and defense aviation. ### **About You:** You are a hands\-on systems software engineer who takes ownership of complex software and hardware integration efforts, from architecture through deployment and operation. You write disciplined, maintainable code and troubleshoot methodically across real\-time applications, Linux hosts, networks, and physical equipment. You work independently, collaborate across engineering disciplines, and help other engineers build on what you deliver. As part of Merlin’s Virtual Test Environments (VTE) team, you will own software connecting aircraft avionics, hardware\-in\-the\-loop test environments, simulation models, and flight\-test data systems. Your work will enable engineers to exercise aircraft systems before flight, observe their behavior, and capture and replay data to investigate issues. ### **Responsibilities:** * Own the architecture, development, and sustainment of real\-time I/O software and telemetry infrastructure supporting aircraft integration benches and simulation environments. * Develop modern C\+\+ software on embedded Linux targets to interface with avionics hardware, manage periodic execution and watchdogs, and integrate generated aircraft simulation models. * Develop and maintain hardware abstraction layers using UEI PowerDNA equipment, vendor SDKs, low\-level I/O APIs, and device drivers. * Integrate ARINC 429, CAN, serial, and discrete I/O using aircraft interface control documents; validate message encoding, signal mapping, update rates, and error handling. * Develop and maintain asynchronous Rust services that ingest multiple telemetry sources, synchronize and order samples, and stream data to flight\-test displays and recording systems. * Implement robust binary protocols and network interfaces using UDP, TCP, and messaging technologies such as ZeroMQ, accounting for packet loss, ordering, buffering, and client liveness. * Build capabilities for timestamp alignment, session recording, data retrieval, and simulation replay that make integration issues reproducible. * Maintain cross\-compilation, packaging, and deployment workflows for ARM Linux targets and Linux hosts, including Yocto SDKs, CMake, Debian packages, systemd, Docker, and Docker Compose. * Establish automated verification through unit tests, hardware integration tests, parser fuzzing, and Python\-based smoke tests and tooling. * Partner with avionics, aircraft software, flight dynamics, and flight test engineers to reproduce aircraft integration conditions in the lab and resolve issues across software and hardware boundaries. ### **Qualifications:** * Strong proficiency in modern C\+\+, including resource management, concurrency, error handling, and maintainable systems software design. * Experience developing timing\-sensitive software on Linux, including fixed\-period execution, watchdogs, thread synchronization, and reliable startup and shutdown. * Deep familiarity with Linux host and embedded systems, including services, permissions, networking, software builds, deployment, and system\-level diagnostics. * Experience integrating avionics or comparable hardware interfaces, including ARINC 429, and the ability to interpret and implement interface control documents. * Experience developing binary serializers and parsers, with attention to byte order, framing, validation, malformed inputs, and protocol compatibility. * Strong understanding of UDP/TCP networking and asynchronous data pipelines, including buffering, packet loss, ordering, backpressure, and connection management. * Experience with embedded Linux cross\-compilation and deployment using vendor SDKs and build systems such as CMake. * Proficiency in Python for engineering tools, test automation, and data\-processing workflows. * Experience developing Rust services, or substantial experience with asynchronous systems programming and the ability to become productive in Rust. * Experience with automated testing, continuous integration, Git\-based version control and code review, and Jira or comparable issue tracking. * Demonstrated ability to own  ur Boston lab to integrate and troubleshoot equipment. ### **Nice to Have:** * Direct experience with UEI PowerDNA/PDNA SDKs or comparable data acquisition and avionics interface platforms from vendors such as NI or Ballard. * Experience with async Rust using Tokio, channels, serde, and axum. * Familiarity with ARINC 429 labels, SDI/SSM fields, CAN messaging, MIL\-STD\-1553, and RS\-232/RS\-422 serial communications. * Experience with IRIG time, NTP, clock alignment, and timestamp\-ordered merging of asynchronous data sources. * Experience with Curtiss\-Wright IADS or similar flight\-test telemetry, ground\-station, or engineering data\-display systems. * Experience with Yocto SDKs, ARM targets, Debian packaging, systemd services, and Linux device\-driver development or troubleshooting. * Familiarity with flight dynamics and integrating generated six\-degree\-of\-freedom aircraft models into real\-time execution environments. * Experience with GoogleTest, pytest, parser fuzzing, and CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions, including self\-hosted runners. * Experience with Docker\-based deployment on lab or edge systems, S3 data storage, and automated simulation replay workflows. * Experience with REST APIs, JSON schema validation, Cap’n Proto, SQL, or diagnostic interfaces using GL Studio, React, or HTML5\. * Aviation experience through professional work, flight simulation, or a pilot’s license. The compensation range provided is reflective of **base salary only**, and is a good\-faith estimate based on a wide range of factors. The actual offer will be determined by a variety of factors including the candidate's qualifications, skills, experience, education, and training. Highly competitive equity grants are considered part of Merlin's total compensation package. Additionally, Merlin offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees. This position is based on\-site at Merlin HQ in Boston, MA. Once you’re here, you’ll enjoy a variety of on\-site perks designed to make your workday enjoyable and convenient. These include catered lunches featuring a rotating menu of delicious options, an assortment of snacks to keep you fueled throughout the day, and a selection of beverages, including coffee, tea, and other drinks, to keep you refreshed. Our goal is to create an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally. Merlin Labs offers an innovative, entrepreneurial, and team\-focused startup environment. We also offer a top\-notch benefits package (health, dental, life, flexible paid time off, and 401k with match) and work/life integration. Being part of the Merlin team allows you to become part of a small team that supports professional development while working together to achieve our mission. Merlin Labs is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, genetic information, sex (including pregnancy), gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military service or obligation or disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. All job offers are contingent upon the candidate passing background and reference checks. At this time, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or consider candidates who require visa transfers. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to: people@merlinlabs.com Merlin Labs does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from candidates.

jobs.title: Principal Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: POSITION SUMMARY: This position leads the design, build, operation, and continuous improvement of MSD’s Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud platform across manufacturing, commercial, CRO, and SaaS business segments, operating as a player\-coach who provides technical direction, sets standards, and develops engineers while remaining deeply hands\-on in architecting cloud infrastructure, automating delivery pipelines, and supporting production workloads. The Principal Cloud Engineer leads the Cloud Engineering and DevOps teams and partners closely with company stakeholders, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Systems, Software Engineering, the Methodical Mind product team, and the BAL CRO organization. The role champions automation, secure\-by\-design infrastructure, GxP and 21 CFR Part 11 alignment, and measurable business outcomes from MSD’s cloud investment. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: * Lead, mentor, and develop the Cloud Engineering and DevOps teams: set technical direction, establish engineering standards and runbooks, conduct performance management and career development conversations, and recruit and onboard new talent. * Architect, build, and operate MSD’s AWS environment across multiple accounts using AWS Organizations, Control Tower, and a landing\-zone reference architecture; design for high availability, security, scalability, and recoverability. * Stay deeply hands\-on: write and review production Terraform, author CI/CD pipelines, debug production incidents, optimize cluster and database performance, and contribute code that the team will live with for years. * Own and evolve MSD’s Infrastructure\-as\-Code standard (Terraform preferred; CloudFormation and CDK as needed), including module libraries, state management, branching and review patterns, and integration with CI/CD. * Operate and extend MSD’s container and compute platforms (Amazon ECS, EKS/Kubernetes, EC2, Lambda, and serverless services) and the cluster\-management, ingress, observability, and security tooling around them. * Design and operate MSD’s cloud networking foundation — VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, hybrid connectivity to on\-prem (Nutanix AHV) and partner environments, Route 53, and edge services — in alignment with security and compliance requirements. * Own the CI/CD platform (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or comparable) and the developer\-platform tooling that accelerates delivery while enforcing required quality, security, and validation controls. * Partner with Cybersecurity on cloud security engineering: IAM, KMS encryption, secrets management, GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config, vulnerability management, and SIEM (SIEMonster/Wazuh) integration; lead remediation of cloud security findings. * Lead Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices: define SLOs/SLIs, on\-call rotations and incident response, observability standards (CloudWatch, CloudTrail, OpenSearch, Prometheus/Grafana, distributed tracing), capacity planning, and disaster\-recovery testing. * Partner with Enterprise Systems, Software Engineering, Methodical Mind, and BAL Services teams on cloud\-native solution design, application onboarding, and migration patterns; provide architectural guidance and design reviews. * Support MSD’s regulated environment: ensure cloud platforms, deployment processes, and change\-control practices align with FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GxP, ISO 27001, and SOC 2 expectations; contribute to validation, audit, and assessment activities. * Manage strategic vendor relationships (AWS, IaC and platform tooling vendors, managed service providers) and serve as the senior technical voice in vendor architecture and capacity discussions. * Develop and own the cloud platform roadmap; partner with IS/IT leadership on multi\-year planning, budgeting, and capability investment decisions. EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or related discipline; equivalent combination of education and experience considered. Master’s preferred. * Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, or DevOps roles. * Minimum 7 years of hands\-on AWS engineering experience across core services (EC2, ECS, EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB, VPC, IAM, KMS, CloudFront, API Gateway, Route 53, CloudWatch, CloudTrail). * Minimum 3 years of demonstrated people\-leadership experience: managing engineers (direct reports or formal tech leads), setting goals, conducting performance reviews, and developing team capability. * Strong, demonstrable Infrastructure\-as\-Code experience with Terraform (preferred), CloudFormation, and/or AWS CDK at scale, including module design and reuse, state management, and CI\-integrated workflows. * Deep experience operating containerized workloads on Amazon ECS and/or Amazon EKS (Kubernetes), including cluster lifecycle, autoscaling, ingress, service mesh, and platform tooling (Helm, ArgoCD, or comparabl tten and verbal communication skills, including the ability to articulate technical trade\-offs to executive audiences and external auditors and to author architecture decision records, runbooks, post\-mortems, and roadmap narratives. * A professional presence and strong interpersonal skills for interacting in a courteous, timely, and diplomatic manner with all levels of employees as well as other parties/stakeholders involved in the company to influence and drive consensus on cloud architecture, engineering standards, and platform adoption * Demonstrated propensity to be creative, collaborative, proactive, and self\-motivated in the execution and completion of assigned accountabilities. * Ability to provide day to day guidance/mentoring to others in a consistently supportive and collaborative approach. * Continuous\-learning mindset; tracks AWS service releases, emerging cloud\-native patterns, platform\-engineering practices, and AI\-assisted infrastructure tooling relevant to MSD’s roadmap. * Strong critical thinking and sound judgment in handling ambiguous, cross\-functional technical problems with competing priorities and regulatory constraints. PHYSICAL DEMANDS: * This position requires the ability to communicate and exchange information, utilize equipment necessary to perform the job, and move about the office and facilities. WORK ENVIRONMENT: * This position is performed in a traditional office environment, or a hybrid model. **COMPENSATION SUMMARY** The annual base salary for this position ranges from $131,600 to $205,625\. This salary range represents a general guideline as MSD considers other factors when presenting an offer of employment, such as scope and responsibilities of the position, external market factors, and the candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities, education and experience. Employees may qualify for a discretionary or non\-discretionary bonus in addition to their base salary. These annual bonuses are intended to recognize individual performance and enable employees to benefit from the Company's overall success. **BENEFITS SUMMARY** At MSD, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to support our employees' well\-being and financial security. In addition to competitive salaries, our benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, along with prescription benefits. We provide a 401(k) plan with company matching, flexible spending accounts, and company\-paid short\- and long\-term disability insurance as well as group life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance. Our offerings also encompass paid vacation, paid sick leave, paid holidays, and paid parental leave, along with an employee assistance program. Additional voluntary perks include a fitness club membership contribution, pet insurance, identity theft protection, home and auto insurance discounts, and optional supplemental life insurance. **EEO/AA STATEMENT** MSD is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, making employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, national origin, age, protected veteran status, pregnancy, disability status, or any other protected characteristic. For our full EEO/AA and Pay Transparency statement, please visit here (https://www.mesoscale.com/en/our\_company/careers/equal\_employment\_opportunity\_statement). Meso Scale Diagnostics uses E\-Verify (https://www.e\-verify.gov/) to validate the work eligibility of candidates. Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Machine Learning
jobs.description: Meta is seeking an Engineering Manager to lead machine learning engineering teams building state\-of\-the\-art recommendation systems at scale. In this role, you will manage teams of ML engineers and technical leaders working on Meta Recommendation Systems (MRS) — from data pipelines and model development to training infrastructure and production deployment. You will shape the technical strategy for recommendation and ranking initiatives, drive SOTA model adoption within your teams, and partner closely with product, data science, and research to deliver recommendation systems that have meaningful impact across Meta's products and platforms. ### **Engineering Manager, Machine Learning Responsibilities:** * Manage multiple teams of ML engineers and technical leaders delivering large\-scale recommendation and ranking systems across model development, training, evaluation, and production serving * Drive the technical strategy and roadmap for MRS initiatives, influencing decisions around SOTA model architectures, recommendation algorithms, and deployment approaches * Actively engage with technical direction and code quality across teams, staying current with state\-of\-the\-art research in recommendation systems and applying cutting\-edge techniques * Partner with product, data science, and research to define recommendation system problem formulations, prioritize ranking experiments, and translate model improvements into measurable product outcomes * Recruit, develop, and retain ML engineers and engineering leaders with deep expertise in recommendation systems and ranking models * Champion adoption of SOTA techniques in recommendation systems, including deep learning approaches, transformer\-based models, and multi\-objective optimization * Proactively identify and resolve execution risks across recommendation system projects, including data quality issues, model performance regressions, training instability, and infrastructure bottlenecks * Establish a team culture that values code quality, rigorous experimentation practices, and continuous learning from recommendation systems research * Hold leaders accountable for performance, technical depth in ranking and personalization, and cross\-functional engagement * Represent the team's work and priorities to leadership, communicating recommendation system tradeoffs, SOTA advances, and strategic implications clearly ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * 8\+ years of experience in software engineering with a focus on machine learning systems, including model development, training pipelines, or ML infrastructure * 4\+ years of experience managing engineering teams, including experience managing other engineering leaders * Experience driving technical strategy and roadmap decisions for ML systems across the full model lifecycle, from data ingestion through production serving * Experience partnering cross\-functionally with product, data science, and research teams to define ML problem scope and deliver measurable outcomes * Experience recruiting, developing, and retaining ML engineering talent and building high\-performing teams in ambiguous, high\-impact areas ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Track record of building recommendation systems that directly influenced product metrics at significant scale * Experience with state\-of\-the\-art recommendation system architectures including deep learning, transformer\-based models, and neural collaborative filtering * Experience with large\-scale personalization systems, user modeling, and multi\-objective ranking optimization * Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements) * Demonstrated ability to evaluate and adopt emerging techniques from top ML conferences (RecSys, KDD, NeurIPS, ICML) into production systems * Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews) * Track record of implementing SOTA research papers into production recommendation and ranking systems * Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies * Experience managing teams working on large\-scale recommendation, ranking, or retrieval systems in a production environment * Hands\-on background in ML model development using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, with specific experience in recommendation models ### **About Meta:** Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics. Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E\-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment. Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations\-ext@meta.com. $219,000/year to $301,000/year \+ bonus \+ equity \+ benefits Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. jobs.title: Network Production Engineer, Delivery Engineering
jobs.description: The Network Infrastructure team is responsible for designing, building, and operating one of the largest networks in the world. Networking is at the core of all Meta products and experiences, and we are looking for Network Production Engineers who are interested in solving complex technical challenges in the Backbone, Datacenter, and AI Network domains. The scale of the network and its continuous expansion presents an opportunity to work on and solve interesting engineering challenges in the datacenter network domain. jobs.title: Software Engineer I
jobs.description: **The Role** We are seeking a Software Engineer I, Full Stack to join our product development team working on Incydr, our Insider Risk Management product. In this role, you will work as a full stack engineer with an emphasis on the front end of the Incydr web application, building features that help security teams protect corporate data and reduce insider risk. You will implement user interfaces in React and TypeScript, while also contributing to the backend services and APIs — built primarily in Kotlin and Java and hosted on AWS — that power those experiences. You will consume and help design APIs, maintain a consistent, high\-quality user experience, and collaborate with User Experience, Product Management, Information Experience, and other development teams to provide features that bring value to our customers and help them secure their collaboration culture. **AI\-First Engineering at Mimecast** Mimecast is an AI\-first engineering organization. Our teams actively leverage AI\-powered development tools across all facets of engineering, from code development to testing, documentation, and operations. We're looking for engineers who don't just use AI tools but champion their adoption and establish new ways of working. **What You’ll Do:** * Implement full stack code for assigned projects — from front\-end interfaces to backend services and APIs — starting with well\-scoped pieces and growing toward owning small features end to end, with an eye toward supportability, testability, and a consistent user experience. * Write unit, integration, and system tests across the frontend and backend of your team's code. * Test, debug, and troubleshoot across the Incydr web stack, from the UI down to backend services. * Partner with teammates to ship end\-to\-end features spanning UI and services. * Contribute to infrastructure\-as\-code and help manage deployment of services owned by the team. * Assist with production issues and escalated customer questions for the web application and services owned by the team. * Participate in the team’s on\-call rotation to support production services and respond to incidents as needed. * Document code and review code and design docs from others. * Demo progress on team deliverables. * Participate in story mapping and authoring sessions. * Contribute to process improvement efforts within engineering. * Participate in design discussions and code reviews, asking questions, contributing, and accepting feedback. * Learn about new things and share that with your team and others. * Collaborate with teammates throughout the product development organization including product owners, UI/UX designers, QA analysts, technical writers, and customer champions. **What You’ll Bring:** We're looking for engineers with established fundamentals and the aptitude to grow — we care as much about your ability to learn as your current skill set, and strong candidates will have experience across many of these areas without necessarily checking every box. * 1\-2 years of professional software engineering experience, with a full stack background and an emphasis on frontend development. * Experience with React and TypeScript fundamentals including components, props, hooks, etc. * Experience with modern HTML and CSS techniques. * Experience translating designs/mockups into functional, responsive user interfaces. * Experience with frontend testing frameworks (e.g. Cypress, Playwright, or similar). * Familiarity with REST APIs and integrating client\-side applications with backend services; experience building or maintaining those APIs is a plus. * Exposure to backend languages such as Kotlin or Java, and to data repository technologies (e.g. PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch), is a plus. * Experience with object\-oriented development, microservices, or multi\-tier systems is a plus. * Familiarity with continuous integration and deployment concepts. * Experience with agile/lean development processes. * Comfortable taking ownership of deliverables as part of a team. * Comfortable working in a collaborative environment, both offering and asking for help when it's needed. * Comfortable working with non\-technical staff. * Passion for building interfaces and systems that work well for users. * Able to communicate technical ideas to peers in written and verbal form. * Experience with design systems and web performance is a plus. **What We Bring:** Join our Incydr Product Development team to accelerate your career journey, working with cutting\-edge technologies and contributing to projects that have real customer impact. You will be immersed in a dynamic environment that recognizes and celebrates your achievements. Mimecast offers formal and ‘on the job’ learning opportunities, maintains a comprehensive benefits package that helps our employees and their family members to sustain a healthy lifestyle, and importantly \- working in cross functional teams to build your knowledge! Our Hybrid Model: We provide you with the flexibility to live balanced, healthy lives through our hybrid working model that champions both collaborative teamwork and individual flexibility. Employees are expected to come to the office at least two days per week, because working together in person: * Fosters a culture of collaboration, communication, performance and learning. * Drives innovation and creativity within and between teams. * Introduces employees to priorities outside of their immediate realm. * Ensures important interpersonal relationships and connections with one another and our community! The base salary range for this position is $100,000\-$150,000 plus benefits. This range represents the minimum and maximum new hire compensation for this role. The position may also be eligible for incentive plans and additional benefits, in accordance with company policy and local regulations. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location with individual compensation also dependent on factors such as qualifications, experience, and skills. Final offers will reflect these considerations and may vary accordingly. **Belonging at Mimecast** Cybersecurity is a community effort. That’s why we’re committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone – unless they’re a cybercriminal, of course. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, and we’d encourage you to join us whatever your background. We particularly welcome applicants from traditionally underrepresented groups. We consider everyone equally: your race, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ability, marital status, nationality, or any other protected characteristic won’t affect your application. If you require any adjustments or accommodations due to a disability, or any other reason that may help you in your interview process, please let us know by emailing careers@mimecast.com. *Due to certain obligations to our customers, an offer of employment will be subject to your successful completion of applicable background checks, conducted in accordance with local law.* *It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment.*

jobs.description: **City/State:** Yonkers, New York **Grant Funded:** No **Department:** IT \- Data \& Analytics Health Research Informatics **Work Shift:** Day **Work Days:** MON\-FRI **Scheduled Hours:** 8:30 AM\-5 PM **Scheduled Daily Hours:** 7\.5 HOURS **Pay Range:** $124,000\.00\-$155,000\.00 **The AI Computational Engineer will work on the operational development of Health Research Informatics at Montefiore Einstein, building dependable data and AI capabilities that help investigators move from a research question to governed data access, cohort discovery, study feasibility, analysis, and reproducible results. The role combines hands on computer science research with implementation of reusable services. This individual may focus on different data types or methods while sharing responsibility for rigorous evaluation, documentation, and investigator support.**  **Key Responsibilities:** ========================= * Develop and maintain research data pipelines that integrate clinical records, text, imaging, and other approved data sources. Document data definitions, quality checks, metadata, lineage, and transformations to support FAIR aligned reuse. * Help implement standardized, governed data access workflows and reusable tools for cohort discovery, phenotyping, trial feasibility, recruitment planning, and research analytics. Translate investigator needs into scoped requirements and track delivery. * Develop, benchmark, and validate AI methods, including information extraction, multimodal models, large or vision language models, and interpretable or knowledge informed approaches when suitable for the use case. * Turn validated methods into maintainable research services and interfaces, with version control, automated tests, monitoring, user documentation, and clear handoff to authorized operational partners. * Set evaluation plans with investigators and clinical experts, including baselines, validation splits, human review, error analysis, reproducibility checks, and assessment of subgroup performance and potential bias. * Work with ICTR, the Data Science Institute, and Montefiore data, IT, security, privacy, and oversight partners to implement approved access and governance requirements. Prepare technical evidence for review and escalate higher risk use cases through established channels. * Support investigators through consultations, demonstrations, training materials, and reusable examples; contribute technical content to publications, grants, and multi\-site research collaborations. Track service measures such as request turnaround, cohort or feasibility output quality, reuse of methods, model performance, and investigator feedback; report progress and operational issues to the CRIO. * ### **Qualifications:** **Required:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, data science, or a closely related quantitative field, plus substantive experience building machine learning or data intensive software; a master’s degree may provide that experience. * Strong Python programming skills and practical experience with a modern machine learning framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. * Demonstrated ability to prepare complex datasets, run controlled experiments, assess model performance, and communicate limitations clearly. * Experience using Git and working collaboratively on documented, maintainable software or research pipelines. * Ability to translate needs across technical and nontechnical colleagues, prioritize practical work, and learn biomedical and research operations concepts **Preferred:** * Master’s degree or equivalent research or industry experience in AI, computer science, biomedical informatics, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * Experience in one or more of the following: medical imaging; clinical NLP or information extraction; large language or vision language models; multimodal learning; clinical or other sensitive research data. * Experience with GPU or high\-performance computing, reproducible model training and inference, containers, SQL, APIs, or research data platforms. * Familiarity with clinical research workflows, FAIR data practices, common data models, biomedical ontologies, data provenance, human review, or responsible AI assessment. Evidence of research communication and user focused delivery through publications, presentations, open\-source work, training, or documented deployed projects. * Montefiore Health System, Inc. is an equal employment opportunity employer. jobs.title: Principal Orchestration Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary** ----------- Motion Industries is seeking a Principal Orchestration Engineer to serve as a technical leader for our enterprise Databricks platform and the next generation of data and intelligent applications built on it. This role will combine deep Databricks platform expertise with hands\-on engineering and architecture. You will help design, administer, govern, and evolve the Databricks environment while establishing the engineering patterns that enable Enterprise Intelligence teams to build reliable data products, analytics solutions, AI/BI Genie experiences, and AI agents at enterprise scale. This is not simply a Databricks developer or administrator role. You will own technical patterns across the platform, from workspace architecture, security, governance, deployment, and workload orchestration through the emerging AI capabilities that consume enterprise data. As our capabilities mature, you will play a leading role in extending the platform into conversational analytics and agentic AI using Databricks AI/BI Genie, Mosaic AI, large language models, and related technologies. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. You will personally engineer solutions while establishing the standards, reference architectures, frameworks, and best practices that allow the broader Enterprise Intelligence organization to scale. **What You'll Actually Do** =========================== **Databricks Platform Engineering \& Architecture** --------------------------------------------------- * Serve as a principal technical authority for the Databricks platform within Enterprise Intelligence. * Design and evolve the architecture of our Databricks environment across development, testing, and production workloads. * Establish scalable patterns for workspace configuration, compute, SQL warehouses, jobs, workflows, security, networking, and platform integrations. * Design and implement governance and access\-control patterns using Unity Catalog. * Establish platform standards for identity, permissions, service principals, secrets, and secure access to enterprise data. * Develop repeatable deployment and configuration patterns using infrastructure\-as\-code and CI/CD practices. * Partner with cloud, security, DevOps, and data engineering teams to ensure the platform meets enterprise requirements for reliability, security, performance, and supportability. * Monitor and optimize platform performance, compute utilization, reliability, and cost. **Data \& Workload Orchestration** ---------------------------------- * Architect reusable orchestration patterns for data pipelines, analytics workloads, intelligent applications, and automated processes. * Build and maintain Databricks Jobs and Workflows for production workloads. * Create standardized engineering patterns that move solutions consistently from development through production. * Develop reusable libraries, frameworks, templates, and automation that improve engineering velocity across the Enterprise Intelligence organization. * Partner with data engineers to establish reliable patterns for ingestion, transformation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and recovery. * Integrate Databricks workloads with Azure services, enterprise applications, APIs, and other data platforms. * Establish observability and operational standards that allow teams to quickly identify and resolve production issues. **Data Governance \& Platform Standards** ----------------------------------------- * Implement scalable data governance patterns using Unity Catalog and related Databricks capabilities. * Help establish standards for data access, lineage, metadata, data quality, security, and environment separation. * Design platform guardrails that enable teams to move quickly while maintaining appropriate governance and controls. * Partner with data product, security, architecture, and business teams to translate enterprise governance requirements into practical engineering patterns. * Establish reference architectures and technical standards for common platform use cases. **Genie \& Intelligent Applications** ------------------------------------- As Enterprise Intelligence expands its AI capabilities, this role will help establish the technical foundation for intelligent applications built on Databricks. * Design and develop Databricks AI/BI Genie experiences grounded in governed enterprise data. * Establish patterns for designing data products and semantic context that allow Genie and other AI experiences to accurately understand enterprise data. * Build and integrate AI agents that securely interact with governed data, business logic, APIs, and enterprise systems. * Develop retrieval and grounding patterns for applications that require enterprise context. * Establish evaluation, monitoring, tracing, security, and governance practices for production AI applications. * Explore and implement capabilities within the Databricks Mosaic AI ecosystem as Enterprise Intelligence's agentic architectu atform, workload, performance, and reliability issues. **Software \& Data Engineering** -------------------------------- * Expert\-level Python. * Strong SQL and data\-querying skills. * Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals including source control, automated testing, CI/CD, code review, and modular application design. * Experience designing APIs and integrating enterprise systems. * Deep understanding of modern data engineering patterns including ingestion, ETL/ELT, transformation, orchestration, and data modeling. * Experience building production\-grade data pipelines. * Strong understanding of data governance, security, lineage, observability, and data\-quality principles. **Cloud \& DevOps** ------------------- * Strong experience working with Microsoft Azure or comparable enterprise cloud environments. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code and automated environment configuration. * Understanding of identity and access management, networking, secrets management, and cloud security. * Experience implementing monitoring and observability for production systems. * Strong understanding of performance and cloud\-cost optimization. **AI \& Intelligent Applications** ---------------------------------- Experience in this area is strongly preferred, with the expectation that the role will become increasingly involved in AI engineering as the capability matures. * Experience building or configuring Databricks AI/BI Genie spaces. * Familiarity with Databricks Mosaic AI capabilities. * Experience developing applications using large language models or LLM APIs. * Understanding of retrieval\-augmented generation, semantic search, embeddings, and grounding patterns. * Familiarity with AI agent architectures and orchestration frameworks. * Understanding of AI evaluation, observability, security, and guardrail concepts. Deep Databricks platform expertise is more important to this role than experience with any single AI framework. **Experience \& Background** ============================ * 8\+ years in software engineering, data engineering, platform engineering, cloud engineering, or related technical roles. * Significant hands\-on experience designing and operating enterprise data platforms. * Demonstrated depth with Databricks in production environments. * 3\+ years operating in a senior, lead, staff, principal, or comparable technical leadership capacity. * Proven ability to take complex technical capabilities from architecture through production. * Experience establishing engineering standards and reusable technical patterns across teams. * Ability to work across data engineering, analytics, cloud infrastructure, security, DevOps, architecture, and business teams. * Proven ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. * Ability to lead through technical influence, mentoring, architecture, and hands\-on engineering rather than direct people management. **LICENSES \& CERTIFICATIONS:** None required. **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:** No Supervisory Responsibility **BUDGET RESPONSIBILITY:** No COMPANY INFORMATION: Motion offers an excellent benefits package which includes options for healthcare coverage, 401(k), tuition reimbursement, vacation, sick, and holiday pay. plus. * Online gaming experience is a BIG PLUS! jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer

jobs.title: Senior Firmware Engineer, Ground Software
jobs.description: **Who we are** Neros is a defense technology company rebuilding America's drone industrial base. We design and manufacture high\-performance unmanned systems that are tested in combat, iterated at startup speed, and built at massive scale. Our team culture is fast, hands\-on, and obsessed with closing the gap between design and deployment. As drones transform the character of warfare, Neros is delivering the systems the West needs to compete on the modern battlefield and deter the adversaries of democracy. We're hiring engineers, operators, and builders who want to move fast, take on extreme ownership, and get capability into the hands of warfighters in months, not years. **What you will be doing** Neros builds drones for the modern battlefield. As a Senior Firmware Engineer on our Ground Software team, you will build the firmware that runs on our ground control hardware \- the equipment operators hold in the field to fly the aircraft and see what it sees. You'll work across microcontroller and embedded Linux targets, own the latency and reliability of the operator's control path, and take your work from the bench to the field. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain firmware for ground control hardware across microcontroller and embedded Linux targets * Own operator input handling, the communication link to the aircraft, and telemetry and video receive on the ground side * Own latency and reliability across the operator's control path, from input to transmission * Define the ground side of the aircraft\-to\-ground interface with the flight software team, including behavior when the link degrades * Bring up and debug new ground hardware alongside electrical engineering * Write unit and integration tests for your firmware, partnering with our test organization on hardware\-in\-the\-loop and field testing **You should have the following** * Strong embedded **C, C\+\+, or Rust** in resource\-constrained environments — you have shipped firmware that runs on real hardware in the field * Real\-time firmware experience: interrupts, DMA, timing budgets, and the bugs that only show up under load * Hands\-on **board bring\-up and hardware debugging** — oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and failures that don't reproduce in a debugger * Working knowledge of embedded communication interfaces — UART, SPI, I2C, USB, Ethernet * Track record of taking firmware from first boot to production with light direction * Test discipline appropriate to firmware that people depend on in the field **Nice to have** * **Embedded Linux** — building services and device interfaces on an embedded Linux system; Yocto or Buildroot exposure * Linux networking and IP\-based radio or datalink integration * Video pipelines on embedded hardware — capture, decode, display, latency * RC radio or ground controller firmware — **ExpressLRS, EdgeTX/OpenTX**, or similar * Experience moving a product from a microcontroller to an embedded Linux platform * You fly — FPV, RC, or drones generally **US Salary Range** $180,000 – $252,000 USD The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. jobs.title: Analytics Engineer 5 - Ads Identity & Signals
jobs.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode \- pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting\-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. In 2022 we launched a new lower\-priced, ad\-supported tier, and we are building an in\-house, world\-class ad\-tech ecosystem to give our members more choice and to offer advertisers a premium, better\-than\-linear\-TV experience. We are looking for the founding members of this new business area for Netflix. The Identity \& Signals team builds the identity foundation of the Netflix ads business — the graph and matching systems that let us recognize the same person or household across signals, devices, and partner data sources, and that determine which signals we can responsibly and accurately use for targeting, measurement, and reporting. We build and maintain the identity graph, run and evaluate entity\-matching and resolution pipelines, and manage relationships with identity providers so that advertisers and internal teams can trust the signals underneath every campaign. This is a foundational role on a small, high\-leverage team. You will build the analytics and data infrastructure that powers identity matching and graph construction — designing the tables, pipelines, and metrics that let the team and its stakeholders understand match quality, coverage, and drift over time. You'll work end\-to\-end: from raw signal ingestion, through matching logic and graph construction, to the dashboards and data products that make identity health visible and actionable across the company. **In This Role, You Will** * Design, build, and maintain the data models and pipelines that support identity graph construction, entity matching, and identity resolution across first\-party and third\-party signals. * Partner with data engineering and software engineering to productionize matching logic, ensuring pipelines are scalable, well\-tested, and monitored for data quality and drift. * Build metrics, dashboards, and analytics that quantify match rate, match quality, coverage, and graph stability, and that surface anomalies before they affect downstream campaigns. * Work closely with data science to evaluate and improve matching algorithms, providing the clean, well\-documented data and features needed to test and iterate on models. * Manage and evaluate the analytics relationship with external identity providers (e.g., Experian, TransUnion, LiveRamp), including onboarding new sources, validating match performance, and monitoring ongoing data quality. * Translate identity graph and matching concepts — nodes, edges, match confidence, deterministic vs. probabilistic matching — into clear, actionable insights for product, sales, and other non\-technical stakeholders. * Collaborate with product and cross\-functional partners to define identity requirements, evaluate trade\-offs (accuracy vs. coverage vs. privacy), and prioritize roadmap work. Communicate technical decisions, trade\-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences at all levels of the company. * **We Are Looking For** * 5\+ years of experience as an analytics engineer, data engineer, or similar role working with large\-scale data. * Experience working with graph data structures and graph\-based data models (e.g., property graphs, graph databases, or graph analytics on top of relational/columnar stores). * Familiarity with entity matching / identity resolution concepts — deterministic and probabilistic matching, fuzzy matching, blocking/candidate generation, and match quality evaluation. * Knowledge of, or direct experience working with, identity providers such as Experian, TransUnion, LiveRamp, or similar data/identity partners. * Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience building and maintaining production data pipelines. * Experience designing data models, metrics, and dashboards that make complex technical systems understandable to non\-technical stakeholders. * Demonstrated ability to collaborate closely across data engineering, software engineering, data science, and product teams. * Ability to work independently, drive your own projects, and make compelling cases for prioritization. Embodies the Netflix values while bringing a new perspective to continue improving our culture. * **Nice To Have** * Experience with ad\-tech identity concepts — cross\-device identity, household graphs, cookie/ID deprecation, or media measurement. * Experience with graph databases or graph\-processing frameworks (e.g., Neo4j, Neptune, GraphFrames, or similar). * Familiarity with our ML/data stack (Metaflow) or comparable large\-scale data tooling. * Experience working with privacy\-sensitive data and an understanding of relevant data governance and privacy considerations for identity data. * Experience applying GenAI to boost developer/analytics productivity. Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $330,000\.00 \- $566,000\.00\. This compensation range will vary based on location. Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family\-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full\-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full\-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here . Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here . Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal\-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service. Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled.

provisioning, and troubleshooting. * Build and maintain Schema Registry and Avro\-based data contract workflows, including schema validation, compatibility, versioning, and safe evolution. * Build and maintain KSQL or equivalent near\-real\-time transformation patterns where appropriate. * Improve Airflow/MWAA orchestration patterns, DAG templates, scheduling, backfills, retries, dependency management, and operational reliability. * Improve dbt platform capabilities, including project conventions, macros, testing, materializations, restricted\-data patterns, and Airflow integration. * Develop reusable TypeScript, Python, and/or Kotlin libraries and reference implementations for producing, consuming, validating, and moving data. * Contribute to Snowflake integration patterns, data exports, toolsets, and secure access paths without taking ownership of stakeholder\-specif omation. * Familiarity with Avro or another schema and serialization system, data quality controls, compatibility management, and event\-driven design. * Demonstrated ability to debug complex failures across distributed systems and communicate the diagnosis clearly. * Strong security instincts, including least privilege, secrets management, environment isolation, audit trails, and safe handling of restricted data. * Ability to document technical requirements and operating procedures so that other teams can successfully use the platform. * Ability to lead initiatives, make sound tradeoffs, and work effectively with product engineering, analytics, data science, security, and infrastructure partners. * Practical experience creating AI\-assisted developer workflows, agentic automation, reusable AI skills, or tool\-using LLM applications. * Understanding of AI safety and reliability practices, including grounded retrieval, permissions, human\-in\-the\-loop approvals, observability, evaluation, and controlled production rollout. * Experience with Kafka/MSK upgrades, capacity planning, performance tuning, or multi\-environment operations. * Experience building self\-service platform products, internal developer platforms, or paved paths. * Experience with data observability, lineage, data contracts, incident automation, or support\-ticket automation. * Experience with one or more of TypeScript, Python, and Kotlin client libraries or SDKs. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Why NinjaTech AI** We are building the unmetered intelligence workforce: autonomous AI agents that do real, end\-to\-end work for enterprises instead of just answering questions. Since founding in 2022 we have gone from research to agents running production workloads inside real companies, on secure, isolated infrastructure, backed by SRI International, DCVC, and Candou Ventures. This is a small, senior team moving at startup speed on one of the most consequential problems in technology, and the Forward Deployed Engineer sits at the sharpest edge of it: your work lands in front of real customers in weeks, not quarters, and directly shapes how the world's most demanding enterprises adopt agentic AI. If you want the shortest possible line between what you build and the outcomes it creates, this is a rare seat. **Why this role exists** When we close a large enterprise deal, the contract is the start of the hard part, not the end. The customer has bought an outcome, an "unmetered intelligence workforce" doing real work inside their business, and someone has to make that outcome real, fast, inside their systems, their security constraints, and their messy data. That someone is the Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE). We attach an FDE to every large enterprise account. They embed with the customer, build the first high\-value agentic workflows on our platform, and own technical success from kickoff through go\-live and expansion. The FDE is how a signed contract becomes a renewed and expanded one. **What you'll own** * **Land the deployment.** Embed with a newly\-closed enterprise customer, rapidly learn their operations and data, and stand up the first production agent workflows on NinjaTech in weeks, not quarters. * **Build custom, tailored solutions.** Wire our platform into the customer's real systems (their data sources, identity, ticketing, CRMs, internal APIs) and build the bespoke automations, prompts, tools, and guardrails that make agents useful for their jobs\-to\-be\-done. * **Be the technical face of NinjaTech in the room.** Run working sessions with everyone from the customer's frontline operators to their CISO and CTO. Translate their vision into an architecture, and translate our platform into their language. * **Drive adoption and expansion.** A deployment that isn't used doesn't renew. Instrument usage, hunt for the next high\-value workflow, and turn a beachhead into an org\-wide rollout. Your success metric is customer outcomes that drive net revenue retention. * **Clear enterprise gauntlets.** Own the technical side of security review, isolated\-VM/data\-residency requirements, SSO/SCIM, SOC 2 / DPA questionnaires,and procurement's technical due diligence. * **Close the loop to Product.** You see what breaks in the field first. Feed sharp, prioritized signal back to core engineering; occasionally upstream a fix or a reusable component so the next deployment is faster. **What we require** * **Engineering background.** You're a genuine builder. Proficient in Python and at least one of TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, or Go; comfortable across data plumbing, APIs, and a bit of front\-end when a demo needs it. * **Genuine curiosity about agentic AI and LLM systems:** prompt/tool design, evals, orchestration, guardrails, and the failure modes of agents in production. You don't need to have built them at scale, but you should be hungry to. * **Data fluency.** You can wrangle messy, large\-scale, real\-world data and reason about storage, pipelines, and cloud infrastructure. * **Executive presence and operator empathy.** You can hold a credible technical conversation with a CTO and sit with a frontline user to understand their actual workflow. You listen before you build. * **Bias to ship.** You move with speed and precision, iterate with users, and are energized (not frustrated) by evolving objectives. * **Willingness to travel** up to \~25% to customer sites, and to be onsite in Austin, TX. **What we value (nice\-to\-haves)** * Experience integrating into regulated or security\-sensitive enterprise environments (isolated VMs, on\-prem/VPC, SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP\-adjacent). * Prior forward\-deployed / solutions\-engineering / delivery experience at an enterprise\-software or infra company. * A track record of turning a first deployment into a much larger footprint. **Compensation \& logistics** * Base range $80K to $120K depending on level and experience, plus meaningful equity and a delivery/expansion\-linked bonus. * Onsite in Austin, TX; \~25% travel to customer sites. * Full benefits (medical / dental / vision, etc.). **Equal opportunity** NinjaTech AI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

jobs.title: Principal Data Center Facilities Engineer
jobs.description: As a Principal Data Center Facilities Engineer with an electrical focus, you will serve as a senior technical resource for Oracle’s mission\-critical data center in West Jordan, Utah. Provide engineering leadership for critical infrastructure maintenance, repairs, troubleshooting, and emergency response, with an emphasis on electrical safety, power availability, and system redundancy. Plan and oversee maintenance through the computerized maintenance management system (CMMS), develop and vet operating and emergency procedures, and lead incident resolution and corrective actions. Guide design reviews, develop scopes of work and requests for proposal (RFPs), and lead infrastructure projects through commissioning, testing, validation, and operational handover. Build training modules, mentor team members, and strengthen the technical knowledge and operating practices of the on\-site team. This position requires working on\-site each workday at Oracle’s data center in West Jordan, Utah. Candidates must live within commuting distance or be willing to relocate before starting. Remote and hybrid work arrangements are not available. Participation in after\-hours emergency support is required. **Key Responsibilities** **Critical Infrastructure Operations and Maintenance** * Provide on\-site technical leadership for Oracle’s data center in West Jordan, Utah, with primary responsibility for the reliability, safety, and performance of critical electrical infrastructure. * Oversee preventive and corrective maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs for electrical distribution, switchgear, uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, generators, transfer systems, and associated controls. * Use the computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) to plan and schedule maintenance, track work orders and repairs, maintain equipment records, and verify work completion and documentation. * Lead electrical load and capacity management, evaluate equipment condition and operating trends, and maintain power redundancy during maintenance, equipment failures, and infrastructure changes. * Coordinate with mechanical, controls, and operations teams to address system dependencies and maintain overall facility reliability. **Emergency Response and Operational Improvement** * Lead the technical response to critical infrastructure incidents, coordinate troubleshooting and repairs, and support safe, timely service restoration. * Apply emergency operating procedures, assess changing conditions, and coordinate escalation and communication with appropriate teams. * Lead post\-incident technical reviews, root cause analyses, and corrective and preventive actions to reduce recurrence. * Identify and implement improvements using equipment performance data, maintenance history, and lessons learned. * Participate in after\-hours emergency support and respond on\-site as required. **Procedures, Safety, and Change Management** * Develop, review, and validate standard operating procedures (SOPs), methods of procedure (MOPs), emergency operating procedures (EOPs), and electrical switching plans. * Vet procedures and proposed work for technical accuracy, electrical safety, system dependencies, redundancy, and potential operational impact. * Evaluate maintenance and project risks, verify readiness before work begins, and oversee execution in accordance with approved procedures and safe working practices. * Prepare and review change requests, communicate operational risks and mitigation plans, and represent facilities engineering in change advisory board (CAB) reviews. * Maintain accurate operating documentation, electrical drawings, equipment information, and records of infrastructure changes. **Engineering Reviews and Project Leadership** * Serve as the site’s electrical subject matter expert for complex operational issues, infrastructure upgrades, and engineering initiatives. * Review designs, equipment specifications, and proposed modifications for maintainability, capacity, reliability, and compatibility with site operations. * Develop scopes of work and technical requirements for requests for proposal (RFPs), evaluate vendor proposals, and provide technical recommendations. * Lead assigned infrastructure projects, coordinating scope, schedules, resources, risks, and deliverables with internal teams and external partners. * Coordinate project execution with design, construction, commissioning, and operations teams to protect operating systems and support successful delivery. **Commissioning, Testing, and Validation** * Review commissioning plans, test procedures, and acceptance criteria for new or modified critical infrastructure. * Participate in and oversee equipment testing, functional verification, and integrated systems testing to validate performance under normal, maintenance, and failure conditions. * Track deficiencies, coordinate corrective work, and verify resolution before operational acceptance. * Support operational handover by verifying that equipment records, drawings, procedures, training, spare parts, and maintenance requirements are complete. **Training and Knowledge Sharing** * Develop and maintain technical training modules covering electrical systems, operating procedures, maintenance practices, troubleshooting, and emergency response. * Deliver training, mentor team members, and assess practical understanding and readiness to perform assigned work. * Lead drills and scenario\-based exercises to strengthen emergency preparedness and consistent operating practices. * Share lessons learned and establish consistent technical practices across the on\-site team. **Vendor and Contractor Oversight** * Coordinate vendor and contractor scheduling, site access, work planning, and execution. * Review service reports and completed work for technical quality, documentation, and compliance with approved scope and procedures. * Support contract reviews, change orders, cost estimates, and procurement of critical spare parts and maintenance resources. * Monitor vendor performance and resolve issues affecting safety, work quality, schedules, or facility reliability. **Collaboration and Team Development** * Communicate technical issues, operational risks, and project status clearly to site leadership, partner teams, and other stakeholders. * Prioritize competing maintenance, incident, and project demands based on safety, operational risk, and business needs. * Contribute to candidate interviews, technical assessments, and hiring recommendations. * Continuously strengthen personal expertise and team capabilities through training, feedback, and review of industry practices. **Work Location** This position requires working on\-site each workday at Oracle’s data center in West Jordan, Utah. Candidates must live within commuting distance or be willing to relocate before starting. Remote and hybrid work arrangements are not available.

jobs.title: Principal Electrical Engineer, AI Infrastructure Hardware
jobs.description: Our OCI Hardware Development organization designs server and rack\-scale systems and works closely with partners to develop and integrate new platforms for demanding AI and enterprise workloads. We’re seeking an experienced System Technical Lead with strong hands\-on board design expertise to join our team in Burlington, Massachusetts. You’ll own board designs and lead engineering work across Oracle teams and development partners to help design and deliver Oracle’s next generation of servers and rack\-scale systems. Your work will span component selection, schematic capture, electrical analysis, and PCB implementation alongside CAD designers and signal and power integrity engineers. You’ll also help shape system architecture and lead technical reviews with joint design manufacturing (JDM) and original design manufacturing (ODM) partners, evaluating designs, resolving trade\-offs, and driving design changes. The role calls for someone equally comfortable designing a board and leading its integration into a complete platform. You’ll remain hands\-on through prototype bring\-up, lab debug, and validation, and stay involved through production and sustaining engineering. You’ll see your engineering decisions take shape in hardware deployed across Oracle’s cloud. The position is based on site at our Burlington engineering campus, where hands\-on lab work and daily collaboration with engineering partners are central to the role. * Develop and own board designs, including component selection and qualification, schematic capture, board floor planning, and electrical design analysis using industry\-standard CAD tools. * Design and integrate processor, accelerator, memory, power delivery, storage, and networking circuitry, including high\-speed interfaces and sideband/control buses such as PCIe, DDR, Ethernet, SPI, and I2C/I3C. * Define PCB design constraints and work closely with CAD designers on stackup, component placement, and routing. Collaborate with signal and power integrity engineers on pre\-layout and post\-layout analysis to achieve electrical performance and manufacturability targets. * Develop board and system validation plans and coordinate their execution. Perform hands\-on prototype bring\-up, rework, debug, and root\-cause analysis using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other lab equipment; implement and verify corrective actions. * Help shape server and rack platform architecture, defining electrical requirements, system interfaces, and validation criteria. Resolve trade\-offs in performance, reliability, power, cost, and manufacturability. * Provide technical leadership across electrical, mechanical, FPGA, firmware/software, validation, compliance, and operations engineering, working with Oracle teams, technology partners, and JDM/ODM engineers from concept through volume production. Establish clear technical ownership, coordinate engineering work across teams, resolve dependencies, and drive timely engineering decisions. * Lead architecture, schematic, PCB layout, and validation reviews to ensure product requirements, quality objectives, and compliance targets are met. Identify design gaps and integration risks, document required changes, and work with internal and partner engineers to implement and verify them. * Coordinate hardware/firmware interfaces, power sequencing, system management, and diagnostics with engineering teams to resolve integration issues and improve platform reliability and serviceability. * Partner with project managers and engineering leads to define milestones, prototype deliverables, validation schedules, and risk mitigation plans. Communicate technical progress, dependencies, and risks, and recommend actions to keep development on track. * Author and maintain engineering documentation, including system and board specifications, block diagrams, bills of materials, hardware/firmware interface definitions, test reports, and configuration guides. * Work with component vendors, manufacturing, operations, and supply chain teams on new product introduction (NPI), resolving build issues and meeting cost and production readiness objectives. Support sustaining engineering through field issue resolution, alternate component qualification, and component end\-of\-life transitions. Mentor and support junior engineers, share design and debugging expertise across teams, and improve engineering practices based on lessons from development and production. * Success in this role depends on earning the trust of engineers across disciplines and working effectively with internal teams and development partners. You’ll bring people together to resolve technical disagreements, make sound design decisions, and keep development moving. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field and 7 years of technical engineering experience; or a master’s degree in these fields and 5 years of experience; or a doctorate in these fields and 3 years of experience; or 11 years of technical engineering experience. * Relevant experience in server, storage, or compute platform development, combining hands\-on board design with cross\-functional technical leadership. * Demonstrated ownership and execution of complex board designs, including component selection, schematic capture, electrical analysis, floor planning, and PCB implementation using tools such as Cadence Concept and Allegro. Experience guiding CAD designers and conducting detailed schematic and layout reviews. * Practical knowledge of high\-speed signal and power integrity, PCB stackup, routing constraints, and power delivery, with experience applying these principles in collaboration with specialist engineers. * Hardware design experience incorporating high\-performance CPUs (Intel, AMD, or ARM\-based) and relevant combinations of GPUs, DDR memory, PCIe interfaces, power regulation, storage, networking, and sideband/control buses. * Hands\-on board bring\-up, debug, root\-cause analysis, and prototype validation using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other lab equipment, including development and execution of test plans. * Experience bringing hardware through the product lifecycle, from requirements and concept development through detailed design, system integration, validation, and production, with an understanding of sustaining engineering. * Demonstrated ability to lead hardware engineering work across internal teams and JDM/ODM design partners, translate system requirements into technical deliverables, establish design ownership and acceptance criteria, and resolve cross\-functional dependencies. * Experience leading technical reviews of externally developed hardware, including schematics, PCB layouts, bills of materials, and validation results. Ability to document required design changes, assess their impact on integration and qualification, and work with partner engineers to implement and verify them. * Ability to develop clear engineering documentation and communicate design trade\-offs, progress, and risks to engineering leadership, program stakeholders, and partner teams. Excellent collaboration, communication, and mentoring skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions across organizational boundaries. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Recent board design experience with advanced server platforms, including multi\-socket designs, Intel or AMD CPUs, NVIDIA or AMD accelerators, PCIe Gen5 and later, DDR memory technologies, NVIDIA NVLink, or other advanced interconnects. * Knowledge of hardware/firmware integration, system diagnostics, software architecture, or platform firmware such as BIOS/UEFI and BMC. * Recent experience serving as a system technical lead, technical project lead, or technical program lead for data center server, storage, or GPU platforms while maintaining hands\-on board design responsibilities. * Experience developing and deploying hardware platforms for cloud or hyperscale data centers, including rack\-level integration. * Experience working directly with JDM/ODM engineering teams through NPI, including prototype builds, design qualification, engineering change control, manufacturing readiness reviews, and production ramp. Familiarity with global safety, electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), and environmental compliance requirements and certification processes. * **Location** : Not Remote \| On\-Site in Burlington, MA

scale, covering service accounts, scoped tokens, OAuth grants, and machine credentials across our SaaS and AWS estate. * Secure our AWS environment end to end, including IAM, network segmentation, logging, encryption, and workload protection across S3, EKS, and Terraform. * Enforce and tune our security tooling so it does real work, including GitHub Advanced Security (CodeQL, secret scanning, push protection), branch protection, and CODEOWNERS\-enforced review on sensitive paths. * Review AI and third\-party vendor integrations before they touch PHI, evaluating data flows, retention, and recurring issues back into the development process. * Support HIPAA Security Rule technical safeguards, stand up detection and response capabilities, and build the automation that lets a small security function operate with outsized leverage. **What We're Looking For — Qualifications \& Requirements** Required * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. * 6\+
