jobs.title: Senior Test Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Oteemo is an industry\-leading technology consulting firm at the forefront of AI\-driven, cloud native, enterprise DevSecOps transformation. We build intelligent, automated, secure systems for organizations tackling their toughest technical and business challenges and we're pushing the boundaries of what AI, generative AI, and agentic systems can do in production, not just in theory. Join us and you'll work alongside recognized experts on cutting\-edge projects that blend cloud native architecture, extreme automation, and AI/ML at the core. We foster a dynamic, inclusive, and collaborative culture built on continuous learning, where your ideas shape real outcomes for our clients. If you're passionate about building what's next in AI and cloud technology and want to do it with a team that sets the standard rather than follows it, Oteemo is where you belong. **Job Description** We're looking for a Senior Test Engineer to prove that a regulated energy utility's new non\-persistent Azure developer desktops meet their SLA and security controls. Every phase ends in an exit gate judged against agreed targets: boot under about 1 minute, IDE cold start under about 15 seconds, source control and Copilot reachable 99% or more, and zero TLS\-interception failures. You'll turn those targets into automated, repeatable tests and build the mocks and synthetic data that keep production out of the sandbox. **Key Responsibilities:** * SLA \& Performance Validation: Turn the SLA into a measurable test plan with pass/fail thresholds and own phase\-gate acceptance; baseline the on\-premises VDI and score AVD and Horizon on the same harness; automate logon, boot, IDE cold start, and concurrent\-workload tests with Login Enterprise or LoadGen. * Connectivity \& Toolchain Validation: Run synthetic reachability checks for Git, Copilot, artifact repositories, and MCP endpoints through inspected egress; write NuGet, npm, pip, and Docker smoke tests that catch TLS or endpoint\-agent breakage first. * Security \& State Validation: Run negative tests proving production is unreachable, public endpoints are denied, App Control and EPM behave as designed, and every action reaches the SIEM; prove desktops rebuild clean while repos, caches, and tooling survive. * Test Data, Mocks \& Containers: Build synthetic data generators, masked\-subset tooling, and mock APIs (WireMock, Postman, Microcks) so no test touches production; jobs.title: AI Transformation Lead
jobs.description: At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state\-of\-the\-art SaaS product, which harnesses Generative AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn’t just in the hands of big brands \- we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. You will be the strategic and technical owner of transformation engagements on a defined set of accounts. The most informed voice on what Pencil should do for each client and how the work gets done. You set the thesis, structure the engagement from first principles, co\-design the recommendations and timelines with Forward Deployed Engineers and Creative Leads, lead the client through the enterprise\-wide change required to make it stick, and stand behind quality and performance once the work ships. You own the recommendations and the narrative we tell our clients. **Key responsibilities:** * Implementation Leadership: Own the narrative told to the client and the strategic and tactical plan that drives the engagement, setting the transformation thesis, co\-designing the recommendations with Forward Deployed Engineers and Creative Leads * Structured Problem\-Solving: Take ambiguous client problems and structure them from first principles into a clear set of hypotheses, workstreams, and sequenced decisions everyone can act on. * Change Management Leadership: Lead clients through enterprise\-wide transformation, moving them beyond siloed pilots into integrated, AI\-driven workflows \- navigating complex stakeholder landscapes, identifying blockers and champions, and engineering the buy\-in that scaled AI adoption requires. * AI Process Design: Translate abstract GenAI concepts into clear, repeatable operating processes that client teams can execute confidently day\-to\-day. * Product Feedback Loop: Act as the voice of the customer internally, feeding insights back to Product and Engineering \- what's missing, what's broken, what's worth doubling down on \- so Pencil's roadmap stays enterprise\-ready. * Transformation Blueprints: Codify what works on your accounts into repeatable Blueprints the rest of the team can run, so every successful engagement leaves behind a sharper playbook than the one before it. **Your background:** * A strong academic record in a quantitative or analytical discipline \- STEM, economics, engineering, or business \- that taught you to break hard problems apart and defend your reasoning under scrutiny. * Minimum of 5 years' experience in consulting, in\-house transformation, programme management, or enterprise tech implementation \- with exposure to technology, digital strategy, and/or operations. * AI\-native in your day\-to\-day. You already use Claude Cowork; experience with Claude Code or other agentic tooling is a strong plus. You don't wait to be told to automate something. * Tech\-fluent and hands\-on. You're in the Pencil platform yourself \- configuring agents, prototyping, stress\-testing recommendations \- and you can hold your own in a technical conversation with a client's engineers about their stack. Lightweight engineering \- SQL, scripts, reading code \- is a strong plus. * Confident with senior stakeholders. You can carry a client meeting on your own, give direct feedback, and stay composed when scope shifts. * A track record of delivering complex, cross\-functional, often ambiguous work to a high standard and on time. * Marketing, advertising, or agency experience helps, but it’s not what sets candidates apart **You’ll Thrive Here If You…** * Are Provocative and Brave: You aren't afraid to challenge a customer’s existing way of working if it means helping them avoid long\-term implementation challenges. * Are an Ally to Change: You are comfortable with ambiguity and change, and you take pride in being a trustworthy partner who helps others navigate the "new and unknown." * Believe in Enterprise Adoption: You are obsessed with seeing technology move away from “pilot purgatory" and towards an embedded, value\-driving part of a company’s culture and success. * Embody Pencil Values: You lead with transparency, agility, and a focus on measurable impact, ensuring our values are mirrored in the customer’s own transformation journey. **KPIs \& Success Measures** * Enterprise Adoption: Depth and breadth of Pencil usage across a customer's teams, departments, and use cases once the rollout is live. * Time\-to\-Value: Speed at which your accounts reach their first defined success metric or ROI milestone after engagement kickoff. * Quality of Transformation Narrative: How well your transformation thesis and the strategic and tactical planning survive delivery without major rework, and the performance the recommendation drives for the client post\-launch. * Product Feedback Impact: Quality and reach of insights fed back to Product and Engineering that keep Pencil's roadmap enterprise\-ready. * Blueprint Contribution: Successful documentation and internal adoption of repeatable "Transformation Blueprints" based on customer wins. **Benefits:** * 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme * Health insurance / private medical cover * Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development * Remote \- work from anywhere in your home country * Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy * Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for UK employees * Flexible working hours

jobs.title: Principal Product Engineer, US
jobs.description: ***Note:*** *Partly is headquartered in Austin, TX with offices in London, UK, Christchurch, NZ and Auckland, NZ. Wherever you're based, we'll connect you with your nearest office for onboarding, and fly you to join the full team for our quarterly "Season Openers" (we cover travel and accommodation). If you're relocating to join us, we can also assist with relocation costs.* **Our Story** ------------- Partly is building the infrastructure for anyone to repair anything. We believe everything built should be repairable, and we're building frontier AI to put repair knowledge to work, starting with the $2tn automotive market. Our model, Interpreter, is the first AI purpose\-built to understand repair. Trained on 1M\+ car models and 1B\+ parts, it reads a repair job the way an estimator does, resolves damage into the exact purchasable part, and shows its reasoning with a confidence score. On real production jobs, an estimator working with Interpreter reaches 98\.8% parts\-list accuracy, against 92\.1% with today's tools. It powers PartlyRepair, used by collision shops, workshops and suppliers to take the admin off the job; PartlyLabs, the agentic infrastructure enterprises use to deploy Interpreter across their own workflows; and a developer API. Founded by ex\-Rocket Lab engineers, we've raised a $50m Series B led by DST Global (Anthropic, Airbnb, Meta, TikTok, Spotify), with Blackbird Ventures, WNDR, Activant Capital, Icehouse Ventures, Square Peg, Airtree and Ecliptic Venture Capital. Hear it from the team: Why Partly exists and AI at Partly. **The role** ------------ **You’re a builder: an experienced engineer who wants to understand the customer’s problem, work out a useful solution, and build it yourself.** You’re happiest close to customers and hands\-on in the code, turning what you learn into software that improves how people work. Strong engineering is table stakes. Your experience gives you the judgment to make sound technical decisions, move quickly, and take solutions through to production autonomously. You use that independence to focus on customer value. You’ll work closely with a Product Manager and design to understand problems and shape solutions. You bring your own product judgment, work through the details as you build, and stay accountable for whether the result makes a meaningful difference. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * **Understand the work firsthand.** Spend time with estimators, parts managers, appraisers, repairers, and suppliers. Understand their workflows, constraints, and workarounds well enough to distinguish what they ask for from what would make a meaningful difference. This is a core weekly activity. * **Shape the product with your PM.** Bring customer insight, technical understanding, and evidence from what you’ve shipped into decisions about priorities and solutions. Work closely with your PM to challenge assumptions, weigh opportunities, and decide what’s worth building. * **Build with autonomy.** Take a shared understanding of the customer problem through technical design, implementation, and production. Connect the user experience to the underlying systems and make engineering decisions independently. Work with your PM and design when new evidence or trade\-offs change the product direction. * **Move quickly through good judgment.** Find the simplest approach that serves the customer. Know when to prototype, when to invest, which compromises are acceptable, and where reliability or correctness must hold. Own the consequences of those decisions. * **Choose the right way to learn.** Use observation, interviews, manual tests, prototypes, or production code according to what you need to find out. Use AI\-assisted tools where they help you learn and deliver faster. * **Follow through on outcomes.** Define success with your PM, instrument what you build, and stay accountable for adoption, customer value, and production performance. Reconcile customer feedback with usage data, investigate when they disagree, and change direction when the evidence calls for it. * **Build trustworthy agentic experiences.** Work out where automation genuinely helps, where people need control, and how the experience and underlying systems earn trust in high\-stakes workflows. Make the product feel clear, fast, and dependable to the people using it. **Multiply the team’s impact** ------------------------------ Your contribution should make the people and systems around you more effective. * **Set strong examples.** Demonstrate good engineering judgment, customer understanding, and pragmatic delivery in work others can learn from and build on. * **Build repeatable solutions where they help.** Recognise recurring problems and create shared components, tools, or patterns that make future work faster and more reliable. Know when a focused solution is enough and when an abstraction earns its complexity. * **Coach through real work.** Pair with teammates, give thoughtful reviews, and explain the r e what you learn.** Make useful customer insights, technical lessons, and approaches easy to find and apply across the team. **What you bring** ------------------ ### **The engineering baseline** * **Established senior engineering capability.** You have substantial experience building and operating production software—typically five or more years—with clear evidence of independent ownership. You can explain the architecture, constraints, failure modes, and trade\-offs of technically demanding work you personally delivered. Demonstrated capability matters more than years or previous titles alone. * **Engineering autonomy and sound judgment.** You can take an ambiguous problem through to a production solution without needing engineering direction. You know when to seek specialist input and remain accountable for how the whole solution works. * **Strong engineering across the product.** You can work across the user experience, backend services, and data flows needed to solve the problem. Your depth may vary by area, but you can reason about the system as a whole, make consequential technical decisions, and protect the quality that matters. * **A track record of moving quickly and responsibly.** You simplify scope, use effective tools, and make deliberate technical trade\-offs. You can show where that judgment accelerated delivery, what quality you protected, and what happened to the compromises afterwards. ### **What makes you right for this role** * **Customer and business understanding.** You have a habit of spending time with users in their work context and can show how that understanding changed what you built—or whether you built it at all. * **Ownership of outcomes.** You care whether customers use the solution and whether it improves their work. You can connect your decisions to customer value and business results, and you follow through beyond launch. * **Product judgment and craft.** You help decide what should exist, how it should work, and what to leave out. You build experiences that feel clear and dependable to time\-pressured, non\-technical users. * **A close, active partnership with your PM.** You contribute to product thinking throughout discovery and delivery, bringing your own customer understanding and technical judgment. You can move forward without a detailed specification while keeping your PM involved in consequential product decisions. * **Comfort with uncertainty.** You work with your PM to clarify the problem, then independently work through the unknowns involved in building the solution. You make progress without needing every detail settled upfront. * **An analytical approach.** You can define useful measures with your PM, get the evidence you need, and act on it. You distinguish what the data shows from what you’re assuming. * **A habit of helping others succeed.** You make your reasoning clear, give useful feedback, and leave behind code, tools, and knowledge that others can build on. ### **Particularly relevant experience** * Founder, founding engineer, or early startup work with substantial personal ownership of customer problems and technical delivery. What you owned, learned, and delivered matters more than the company’s eventual size or success. * Operational or workflow\-heavy B2B products, marketplaces, or systems serving multiple types of user. * AI\-assisted or agent\-driven features in production, especially where human oversight and trust matter. * Evidence that you changed or abandoned something you believed in because customer feedback or results showed a better path. Experience in automotive, repair, parts, or insurance is useful, as is familiarity with Rust, which is part of our stack. Neither is required. You don’t need every technology or domain experience listed here. The essential requirements are established engineering independence and demonstrated ownership of customer problems and outcomes. If you can show those through an unconventional background, we’d like to hear from you.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Path Construction is seeking an AI Engineer to lead the development and implementation of AI\-powered applications and custom software that improve how we build, manage, and operate our projects. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex business challenges through technology and wants to help shape the future of construction through AI, automation, and innovation. The ideal candidate brings a strong background in software engineering, artificial intelligence, and application development, with the ability to translate business needs into practical technology solutions. This individual will partner with teams across the company to identify opportunities for AI, automate workflows, and develop proprietary tools that improve efficiency and support long\-term growth. Our AI Engineer will design, develop, test, and deploy AI solutions, integrate them with existing business systems, and help create innovative software that gives Path a competitive advantage. **About Path Construction** Path Construction is a national general contractor headquartered in Arlington Heights, IL, with projects and offices throughout the country. Founded in 2008, Path provides a wide range of construction services across diverse sectors, including healthcare, higher education, multifamily, hospitality, retail, self\-storage, senior living, transportation, water and wastewater treatment, convention centers, laboratories, correctional, and institutional projects. **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test, and deploy AI\-powered applications and custom software that improve business operations and project execution. * Identify opportunities to automate workflows and implement AI solutions across estimating, operations, project management, recruiting, accounting, and other business functions. * Collaborate with business leaders and project teams to translate operational needs into practical AI and software solutions. * Integrate AI solutions with existing business systems, including Procore, P6, Autodesk, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and other construction platforms. * Research, evaluate, and implement emerging AI technologies that improve productivity, efficiency, and decision\-making across the organization. * Develop proprietary software, internal tools, and innovative technology solutions that support Path's long\-term growth and competitive advantage. * Ensure AI solutions follow best practices for security, data privacy, and responsible AI use. Build strong relationships across the organization and communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * **Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field. * 3\+ years of professional experience in AI engineering, software engineering, machine learning, or application development. * Strong programming skills in Python, C\#, JavaScript, or similar languages, with experience building AI\-powered applications, automation tools, or custom software. * Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), generative AI, APIs, and modern AI platforms such as OpenAI, Azure AI, Anthropic, Google Vertex AI, or similar technologies. * Experience integrating software with enterprise platforms such as Procore, P6, Autodesk, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, or other business systems is preferred. * Construction, architecture, engineering, or real estate development experience is a plus. * Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for innovation and a desire to help build new technology solutions that drive the company's growth and competitive advantage. * Strong communication, problem\-solving, and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across all levels of the organization **Benefits** * Annual Salary Range: $100,000 \- $130,000 * Bonus Plan * 401(k) * PTO * Health, Dental, Vision, Life, Long\-Term and Short\-Term Disability Insurance * Company cellphone and computer * Certification Training * Financial and Mental Health Support through a third party * Travel and Entertainment Discount Program

jobs.title: Sr Staff Software Engineer, AI Innovation
jobs.description: **The Company** PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. **Job Summary:** Join AI Growth \& Innovation, where you take emerging AI from zero to N \- building and enhancing agentic systems, real\-time voice, and multimodal experiences directly in production with real customers. As a Senior Staff Engineer, you'll turn ambiguous problems and emerging tech into a point of view, then prototype fast to prove or disprove hypotheses and scale what works into reliable, secure products. You'll own high\-visibility bets end\-to\-end, from research through production. Day to day: research new models and frameworks, launch experiments with safe\-rollout practices, track metrics like quality, latency, cost, and impact, and extend our agent platform's orchestration, tool use, and evaluation. You will be someone who moves beyond established playbooks, builds scrappy prototypes to test reality fast, and partners with product, design, and engineering to turn validated ideas into platform capabilities. **Job Description:** **Essential Responsibilities:** * Makes technical decisions affecting multiple teams, crossing organizational boundaries * Establishes conventions \& processes to be followed by other employees * Actions determine the utilization of company resources (people, money, assets) and affect the effectiveness of the company * Handles multiple, multi\-team initiatives simultaneously, using judgement to prioritize among more issues than can be handled individually. Understands evolving industry capabilities \& practices and can judiciously apply up* \-to\-date information for optimal results * Competent at communicating technical issues with non\-technical audiences * Spreads their behavior, principles, and knowledge as a means of improving technical results of other employees (via many means – modeling behavior, 1:1s, working sessions, quality documentation) * Partners with product management, to ideate solutions to business problems \& goals **Minimum Qualifications:** * 8\+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. **Additional Responsibilities \& Preferred Qualifications****:** **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Senior or staff\-level engineering experience, with impact beyond your own code * A track record of shipping to real users and scaling early ideas into reliable, secure, cost\-efficient products * Hands\-on experience building with LLMs or agentic systems, at work, in a startup, or on serious independent projects * A bias toward fast, scrappy prototyping: given an ambiguous problem, you'd rather build a rough version and test it against reality than debate it on paper first * Comfort with ambiguity and strong research instincts: you learn fast, design quick experiments to prove or disprove a h ybook * Drive and ownership: you take on stretch problems, go beyond your scope, and follow through until it ships * Strong engineering fundamentals in at least one modern language * Clear communication with engineers and executives **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Real\-time voice or multimodal experience * Automated evaluation and observability for AI systems * Deep knowledge on model fine\-tuning, trade\-offs, and when to use it **Subsidiary:** PayPal **Travel Percent:** 0 * The base pay for this role will depend on where you work and the relevant experience and expertise you bring. The expected range of pay for this role by location is: **Primary Location \| Pay Range:** San Jose, California: ($196,500\.00 \- $291,500\.00 Annually) **Additional Location(s) \| Pay Range:** No other locations are assigned to this requisition currently. Additional compensation for this role may include an annual performance bonus, equity, or other incentive compensation, as applicable. PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one\-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact\-us. For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in\-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations. **Our Benefits:** At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset\-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice\-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health. **Who We Are:** **Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com. **Belonging at PayPal:** Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal. Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community. We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Enterprise Knowledge Platform
jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ The Enterprise Knowledge Platform team builds the data and action layer that connects Perplexity's agents to the systems where enterprise work happens. Useful agents need more than access to APIs: they need to discover the right tools, understand an organization's data and terminology, and act reliably within its permissions. This team brings native connectors, MCP servers, and CLI\-backed tools into a consistent platform, and builds the marketplace through which customers adopt integrations and partners extend the ecosystem. This is a product and platform engineering role with end\-to\-end ownership, from designing connector infrastructure and semantic models to shipping the experiences customers use to discover, connect, and activate integrations. You'll build the runtime that executes tool calls, the knowledge layer that makes enterprise context reusable across connectors, and the developer and marketplace foundations that help the ecosystem grow. Working with AI Research and Enterprise teams, you'll turn fragmented systems into reliable, permission\-aware capabilities that agents can use to complete real work. The impact is direct: every improvement helps customers put their existing software and knowledge to work through Perplexity. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Own the connector runtime that registers, hosts, and executes native connectors, hosted MCP servers, and CLI\-backed tools through a consistent agent\-facing interface. * Build the semantic and knowledge layer, including tool and entity schemas, capability metadata, relationships, organization\-specific terminology, and reusable corrections, while preserving provenance and source\-system permissions. * Design discovery, search, and recommendation systems that help agents find relevant tools and context and help users and organizations choose integrations that fit their work. * Build the marketplace and activation experience end to end, from browsing and recommendations to installation, configuration, admin enablement, and ongoing adoption. * Make connector execution reliable and observable, with structured results, retries, idempotency, pagination, rate\-limit handling, and recovery from partial failures. Own reliability targets, production monitoring, and incident response. * Implement connector authentication, credential isolation, and permission enforcement, partnering with Trust \& Governance, Security, and Backend Platform on shared policies and tenant boundaries. * Build the onboarding and publishing path for internal teams and external partners, including schemas, test fixtures, validation, review, and versioning. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 4\+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of owning complex backend systems from design through production operation. * Strong system design skills, including building reliable, scalable platforms that integrate heterogeneous APIs and services with clear security and isolation boundaries. * Strong proficiency in a backend language such as Python, Go, or Rust, and hands\-on experience with cloud infrastructure such as AWS and Kubernetes. * Deep expertise in at least one of the following: + Connector runtimes, API platforms, or MCP servers, including authentication and authorization. + Schema design, semantic modeling, or knowledge systems that capture relationships and organizational context. + Search, ranking, recommendation, or tool discovery systems. + Marketplaces, developer platforms, or enterprise onboarding and activation experiences. * Ability to work across backend infrastructure and customer\-facing product experiences, translating complex integration requirements into clear APIs, developer tools, and intuitive workflows. * Sound technical judgment in security\-sensitive, distributed systems, balancing credential isolation, permission correctness, and failure behavior with performance, usability, and delivery speed. * A track record of leading ambiguous, cross\-team initiatives from architecture through adoption, setting technical direction for shared platforms, and raising engineering quality through mentorship. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification. We value demonstrated impact, deep ownership, and the initiative to turn ambiguity into results.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Agent Identity Management
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions: **Is this identity synthetic?** Detect AI\-generated and manipulated voice and video. **Is this identity risky?** Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals. **Is this identity known?** Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals. Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose\-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI\-driven interactions. Pindrop protects billions of high\-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real\-world interactions annually and protected by 300\+ patents. Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG. ### **What you'll do** AI agents are becoming participants in customer and enterprise interactions. Organizations need more than a signal that a caller or participant is AI: they need to establish who the agent is, whom it represents, what it is permitted to do, and what evidence supports that decision. Pindrop is extending its real\-time identity trust platform to help enterprises safely service authorized AI agents across communication channels, with verifiable identity, delegated authorization, risk\-based controls, and auditable proof of access. As Senior Product Manager, Agent Identity Management, you will take primary ownership of this emerging product area\-from customer validation and product strategy to MVP execution, customer adoption, and commercialization. You will work autonomously with Research, Engineering, Security, Design, and go\-to\-market teams, making informed technical and commercial trade\-offs while building a scalable enterprise offering. This is a hands\-on individual\-contributor role for someone who owns outcomes, not just a feature backlog. * Own the product vision and roadmap for agent identity management: agent identification, identity verification, authorization signals, and secure servicing decisions, beginning with real\-time voice interactions and expanding as customer needs validate. * Lead customer discovery with enterprises, contact center leaders, security and identity teams, and agent ecosystem partners; translate workflows, threat models, and trust requirements into prioritized product opportunities. * Define end\-to\-end experiences for agent registration or discovery, verified agent claims, delegated user or business authority, risk\-based step\-up, policy integration, and evidence\-rich audit trails \- with clear boundaries between Pindrop and enterprise decisions. * Partner with Research, Engineering, and Security to evaluate technical approaches such as cryptographic identity assertions, public\-key verification, anti\-spoofing, replay protection, and trust signals; make pragmatic tradeoffs across security, usability, interoperability, and time to market. * Drive early\-access programs, prototypes, and customer pilots; establish hypotheses, measurable success criteria, and fast feedback loops to validate product\-market fit and a repeatable deployment model. * Work with adjacent Pindrop product teams to connect agent identity capabilities with deepfake detection, authentication, risk intelligence, and real\-time policy/orchestration workflows. * Shape integrations and ecosystem strategy across enterprise contact center platforms, agent providers, and identity infrastructure. Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success on differentiation, positioning, pricing, packaging, launches, and customer expansion. * Own measurable product and commercial outcomes \- including pilot\-to\-production conversion, adoption, successful authorized\-agent servicing, security decision quality, integration time, audit coverage, and revenue potential. Diagnose performance or adoption gaps and drive improvements across teams. ### **Who you are** * A zero\-to\-one product builder who is comfortable creating clarity in an emerging market and equally motivated by shipping, learning, and iterating. * Customer\-obsessed and threat\-aware: you understand both the value of enabling legitimate agent interactions and the consequences of weak identity or authorization. * Technically fluent and analytical: you can challenge assumptions, use product and operational data to diagnose issues, and partner credibly with researchers and engineers on APIs, security controls, architecture, and platform trade\-offs. * A clear communicator and cross  for organizations servicing AI interactions. You will define how enterprises determine who an AI agent is, whom it represents, what it is permitted to do, and what evidence supports that decision. * Lead discovery directly with enterprise contact center leaders, security and identity teams, and agent ecosystem partners. You will drive early\-access programs, test hypotheses with design partners, and establish product\-market fit. * Move beyond feature\-backlog management to own measurable product, operational, and commercial outcomes. You will build the executive presence, strategic judgment, and operational track record required to develop into a broader business leader. * Travel: This US\-based position, requires at least 6 trips per year for team on\-sites, cross\-functional workshops, and company events. ### **What we offer** As a part of Pindrop, you'll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice\-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here's a snapshot of the benefits we offer: * Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long\-term success. * Remote\-first environment \- giving you flexibility and autonomy in how you structure your day. * While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in\-person moments through regular team on\-sites, company\-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success. * Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) * Generous health and welfare plans to choose from \- including one employer\-paid "employee\-only" plan! * Best\-in\-class Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution * Low\-cost vision and dental plans for you and your family, providing comprehensive coverage and peace of mind. * Paid Parental Leave \- Including birth, adoptive \& foster parents * + One year of diaper delivery for your newest addition to the family! It's our way of welcoming new Pindroplets to the family! * Recurring monthly phone and internet allowance to help cover essential connectivity costs and support flexible work. * Enhanced fertility and GLP\-1 benefits to support family\-building journeys and personalized health needs. * Annual Learning \& Development stipend to support your professional growth, skill\-building, certifications, and continued education. \#LI\-Remote \#LI\-HB1 **Not sure if this is you?** ---------------------------- We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you're not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time. ### **AI \- A Transformative Force** At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting\-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine. Pindrop may use AI tools to help prioritize job applications for human review. The AI tool may analyze your work experience and skills to assess fit for the role, but does not consider your name or contact details. Applications with the strongest match to job requirements are prioritized for human review; not all applications may be individually reviewed. ### **Pindrop is an Equal Opportunity Employer** Here at Pindrop, it is our mission to create and maintain a diverse and inclusive work environment. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, disability, marital and/or veteran status.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Research Scientist - Safety Environments
jobs.description: **About Plato** =============== Plato is an applied research lab building the foundational infrastructure to train specialized AI agents. We turn real\-world data streams into high\-fidelity simulated environments that generate the training signal needed to make capable models. Our work supports frontier labs, hyperscalers, and enterprises building AI systems for complex, high\-stakes work. Today, only a handful of players can train models for capable work. Compute and algorithms are rapidly commoditizing, but reinforcement learning data remains the bottleneck. Plato is changing that by automatically scaling training environments from proprietary real\-world data. **Why Apply** ============= * Work with the frontier: Build safety environments and benchmarks that research teams at leading AI labs can use to measure emerging capabilities and misaligned behavior. * Real ownership: Help set Plato’s safety evaluation agenda, from the research questions worth testing to the evidence we share with lab partners. * Research to production: Work with engineers to turn experimental designs into runnable environments, with a short path from an idea to an evaluation labs can use. **The Role** ============ Plato is hiring an individual contributor researcher to design safety environments and benchmarks, starting with evaluations that measure how well AI models can improve themselves and other models. You will establish a new research direction at Plato, designing safety\-relevant benchmarks and working with engineers to turn them into runnable environments. Your initial focus will be measuring AI R\&D capabilities, including experiment design, model training, and research replication. You will also investigate reward hacking, sabotage, deception, and other misaligned behavior. The work spans research design, empirical evaluation, and failure analysis, with substantial ownership of the research agenda. Some environments may also be used in training to reduce the behaviors they reveal. **What You’ll Do** ================== * Design Safety Benchmarks: Measure AI research automation and self\-improvement. Define tasks, baselines, budgets, and success criteria that separate meaningful progress from superficial completion. * Build Safety Environments: Design environments that expose reward hacking, sabotage, deception, and failures to follow intended constraints. * Hold the Evaluation Bar: Investigate contamination, grader weaknesses, task ambiguity, and shortcuts that could make a result misleading. * Track Frontier Capabilities: Run experiments with current models, inspect trajectories and failures, and measure how capabilities change across models and over time. * Work with Engineering: Turn research designs into reproducible environments with clear scoring, useful instrumentation, and documented limitations. * Share the Findings: Translate results into benchmark releases, research reports, and concrete recommendations for lab partners. **Required Qualifications** =========================== * Recent Research: Hands\-on work in frontier\-model evaluation, benchmarks, or AI safety in the past one to two years. * Research Track Record: Meaningful contributions to papers, released benchmarks, public reports, or comparable empirical work. We care about the quality of your work and your contribution more than credentials or years of experience. * Current Model Knowledge: Practical familiarity with current frontier models and a specific, evidence\-based view of their capabilities, limitations, and likely development. * Experimental Judgment: You can explain what an evaluation measures, how it could be gamed, and which conclusions its results do and do not support. * Research Ownership: Ability to turn an ambiguous question into a concrete experimental design and collaborate closely with engineers to implement it. * Safety Focus: Interest in measuring safety\-relevant capabilities and behavior, including the tradeoffs when evaluation environments are also used for training. * Bay Area Based: Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, or willing to relocate. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Designed and released a benchmark, particularly for AI R\&D, long\-horizon agents, dangerous capabilities, or AI control. Relevant reference points include RE\-Bench, MLE\-bench, and PaperBench. * Experience in an independent evaluation or safety organization, a frontier lab safety team, or pre\-deployment testing with labs or government evaluation bodies. * Direct research on models conducting ML experiments, training or improving other models, replicating papers, or completing extended research tasks. * A software engineering background or programming skills that let you implement environments, evaluation harnesses, and analysis tools yourself. * Experience publishing rigorous empirical research, including work at major machine\-learning venues. Compensation Range: $275K \- $450K

Engineering Standards:** Define and evolve team\-wide data engineering standards, architectural documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives within an Agile environment. **Requirements** jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - AI/ML Infrastructure Engineer, RL Post-training
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ Preference Model is a superintelligence data research company. We build RL environments for training capable, better\-aligned superintelligences. Almost every aspect of how a model behaves is shaped by the reward signals it's trained on. The biggest problem with AIs today is that they don't always do what we intend. Sometimes that's because they aren't capable enough, and sometimes it's because they aren't aligned. Both problems come down to the training objectives. We're trying to address both of these issues in the most direct, highest leverage way available to us, which today means researching how to build RL environments better, not just for the AIs of today but for the AIs as they will be when they outsmart us. Over the past year, we've built RL environments for several frontier labs, and we're backed by $16M in seed funding led by a16z. Our founding team has previous experience on Anthropic’s data team building data infrastructure, and datasets behind Claude. **About the Role** ================== Frontier research moves only as fast as its infrastructure permits. Building solid infrastructure is foundational to our mission of pushing self\-directed learning as far as it can go. We are looking for **Senior** **ML Infrastructure Engineers** to build the infrastructure and systems that power the **frontier of post\-training on large language models**. This role involves building scalable infrastructure to enable high\-throughput systems and shape how our research is run, bringing us closer to models that can train themselves on what they aren't yet good at. **What You Will Do** ==================== * Design, build, and scale the compute, scheduling, and data infrastructure that powers post\-training research on our in\-house RL environments * Develop and maintain core ML framework primitives and internal tooling that researchers rely on daily, accelerating reproducible experimentation and reducing time from idea to result * Build evaluation and benchmarking infrastructure, monitoring, logging, and debugging tooling, and automated testing and deployment systems, so failures are caught early and infrastructure stays reliable as it scales * Partner directly with Research Engineers to translate research needs into infrastructure requirements, and ship fast in response to their feedback **What We are Looking For** =========================== * Strong software engineering fundamentals and hands\-on experience building production\-grade LLM inference and training infrastructure (ideally from the ground up) * Experience building LLM training/inference internals such as transformers, distributed training, and working on inference libraries like vLLM, SGLang, Megatron * Experience working on RL training frameworks like Slime, veRL, Ray Train, SkyRL, Miles * Significant experience and understanding of distributed systems principles, and have hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) and container orchestration (Kubernetes), building systems for high\-throughput, low\-latency workloads * Have experience with data engineering tools and building robust, scalable data pipelines * Proficiency in core ML frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX * Can balance production rigor with the pace of fast\-moving research, and communicate infrastructure tradeoffs clearly to researchers who aren't infra specialists **What We Offer:** ================== * Competitive cash and equity compensation (\>90th percentile) * Ownership and autonomy in a fast moving startup environment * Opportunity to work alongside senior and staff engineers from frontier labs and infrastructure companies, plus top ML engineers * Health, vision, dental, benefits * 401K match * Lunch provided everyday onsite * Weekly snack orders * Visa sponsorship \& relocation support available **We value diverse perspectives and experiences. If you're excited about this role but don't check every box, we still encourage you to apply.** Compensation Range: $200K \- $350K

jobs.description: At ProService, we exist to empower employers to succeed in Hawai?i. More than 3,000 local businesses rely on us for payroll, HR, and benefits, and many run their day on tools like Toast, QuickBooks Online, and NetSuite. When those systems talk cleanly to ours, a restaurant owner closes payroll without re\-keying hours. When they don’t, a small business loses time it doesn’t have. This role owns that connection. You’ll build and run the integrations marketplace that links our customers’ business systems to our HR platform, blending strong engineering with real product ownership. Success looks like customers connecting in minutes, data that stays accurate without manual work, and problems fixed before anyone has to report them. **IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL** * Design, build, and launch integrations with platforms like Toast, QuickBooks Online, and NetSuite using OAuth 2\.0, webhooks, and polling * Own the integrations marketplace end to end, including the catalog, connect and disconnect flows, connection health, and a roadmap prioritized with Product * Architect reusable serverless patterns on AWS (Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, DynamoDB) in Python, TypeScript, and React/Next.js so each integration ships faster than the last * Partner directly with customers on bespoke integrations with ProService APIs, and with vendor developer programs on sandbox access, certification, and API changes * Build monitoring and alerting that catches sync failures before customers notice * Uphold code quality through testing, code reviews, and CI/CD, and support production reliability through on\-call rotations **IS THIS ROLE RIGHT FOR YOU?** This is an ownership role, not a ticket queue. You’ll also talk directly with customers and partners to shape what gets built next. These expectations are not optional — they’re the job. The team works on Hawai?i Standard Time, so Southern California candidates should expect a workday that starts mid\-morning and runs into the early evening. **WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TEAM** You’ve shipped production\-grade software in a SaaS or product\-driven environment, and you’ve built third\-party integrations that stay reliable. That means experience with OAuth 2\.0 token lifecycle, webhooks, pagination, data mapping, and vendor API versioning. Hawaii\-based candidates are preferred, followed by candidates in Orange County. Remote candidates must be available during Hawaii Standard Time (HST / UTC\-10\) business hours. Hawaii (Hybrid): In office Tuesday – Thursday \| Option for Remote Monday \& Friday Southern California (Remote): Hours: Hawaii Standard Time (HST / UTC\-10\) **COMPENSATION** The base compensation for this position is $110,000\.00 – $137,000\.00 per year depending on experience and qualifications. **WHY PROSERVICE** ProService is a Hawaii\-based PEO combining payroll, HR, and benefits expertise with purpose\-built technology — all backed by the best local service in the islands. Backed by Silver Lake and recognized as one of Hawai?i’s Best Places to Work for 20 consecutive years, we’re a team of high performers united by one mission: Empowering Employers to Succeed in Hawaii. * **A PROhana unlike any other.** We assume the best in each other, give feedback focused on what’s right—not who’s right—and show up every day. This isn’t just a workplace. It’s a community. * **Do work that matters.** You’ll see exactly how your contributions move the needle—meaningful problems, real decisions, and a seat at the table. * **Grow without a ceiling.** Internal roles post first, and we reimburse certifications, conferences, and memberships. Your growth is our growth. * **Compete, collaborate, and win together.** High expectations, real accountability, and a team of experts ready to help you push through any obstacle. * **Total rewards built around your whole life.** Fully paid healthcare, 401(k) matching, paid parental leave, student loan assistance, employee assistance programs, and paid time off—just to name a few.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack BI Architect / Fabric Data Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Us** At Proactive Technology Management, we're transforming how businesses harness data to drive innovation and informed decision\-making. As leaders in the SMB space, we leverage cutting\-edge technologies to deliver actionable insights that give our clients a competitive advantage. We're seeking a **Senior Full\-Stack BI Architect / Fabric Data Engineer** to design and implement innovative, domain\-driven data solutions that humanize data and empower decision\-makers. If you have a passion for making data meaningful and impactful, we want to hear from you! ### **Role Summary** As a Senior Full\-Stack BI Architect / Fabric Data Engineer, you will lead the design and development of robust, enterprise\-grade data solutions that prioritize human\-centric design through the use of ubiquitous language and domain\-driven principles. You will leverage deep expertise in medallion architecture, advanced data modeling, and visualization to ensure our clients receive intuitive, actionable insights. Your technical expertise in the Microsoft Cloud Data Stack, DAX, Power Query M, SQL, and Spark Python will drive success in building scalable, user\-friendly solutions. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Lead the design and implementation of ETL/ELT pipelines within a **medallion architecture** (Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers) to ensure data quality, scalability, and accessibility across use cases. * Architect and develop advanced data models that reflect **domain\-driven design principles**, aligning with business domains and using **ubiquitous language** to ensure clarity and usability for all stakeholders. * Design and implement star and snowflake schemas, along with **medallion schema practices**, to provide flexible, high\-performance data structures for analytics. * Create dynamic, user\-centric dashboards and advanced reports in Power BI, empowering stakeholders with real\-time insights and actionable metrics. * Leverage DAX and Power Query M to craft sophisticated calculations and transformations that enhance data usability and business relevance. * Build and optimize SQL\-based solutions for database management, queries, and data integration, ensuring efficiency and scalability. * Use Spark Python for processing large datasets and performing advanced analytics to meet complex business requirements. * Collaborate with business leaders and cross\-functional teams to understand data needs, define key performance indicators (KPIs), and ensure alignment with organizational goals. * Stay informed on advancements in data engineering, business intelligence, and analytics, continuously driving innovation and improvement. Mentor team members to build organizational capacity in BI and data engineering best practices. * **Requirements** ### **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field; advanced certifications in data engineering or BI are a plus. * 7\+ years of experience in data engineering, BI architecture, or a related role, with a focus on enterprise\-grade solutions. * In\-depth expertise in **medallion architecture**, data modeling (star schemas, snowflake schemas), and best practices for data warehousing. * Proven ability to implement **domain\-driven design (DDD)** principles, ensuring data solutions reflect business domains and are accessible through ubiquitous language. * Expert\-level proficiency in Power BI, DAX, Power Query M, and SQL, with demonstrated success delivering scalable, impactful BI solutions. * Strong programming skills with Spark Python for advanced data processing and analytics. * Experience with the Microsoft Cloud Data Stack (Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric) and other cloud technologies. * A track record of translating complex datasets into intuitive insights, creating value for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Exceptional problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment. Strong communication and leadership skills, with a focus on collaboration and stakeholder engagement. * **Benefits** * Competitive compensation tailored to senior\-level expertise. * Opportunities to shape data strategy and lead transformative BI projects. * Ongoing professional development through advanced training and certifications. * A supportive, innovative culture that values diversity, inclusion, and creativity. * Flexible remote work arrangements to support work\-life balance. * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) retirement plan with company match If you're ready to lead the next evolution of business intelligence—harnessing the power of **medallion architecture, domain\-driven design,** and user\-centric modeling—apply today. Help us transform data into a powerful, humanized tool for business success.

jobs.title: Associate Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Provectus is a **Premier AWS partner** and an **Anthropic Preferred Partner** at the forefront of applied AI, helping enterprises turn Claude, agentic systems, and their own data into measurable business outcomes. With offices in North America, LATAM, and EMEA, we partner with clients worldwide. Our work centers on two verticals — Financial Services \& Insurance and Healthcare \& Life Sciences — where we deploy five pre\-built AI Blueprints: Submission Flow, Portfolio Lens, Asset Flow, Revenue Flow, and Evidence Lens. Each rebuilds a critical business process front to back, shipped from working code. You'll learn the customer's job before you automate it. Most AI projects fail the same way: someone gathers requirements, someone writes a spec, and a team ships a workflow nobody uses. We think the requirements step is the bug. So we remove it. As an **Associate Forward Deployed Engineer,** you'll join each engagement paired with a Senior FDE. Together you'll spend time alongside the client to understand their workflow and business needs. Then you'll help rebuild that work from first principles, and write real production code for it. You won't start from zero: every engagement begins from a Blueprint that has already shipped for a customer in that industry, and what you learn in the field goes back into it. This role is for early\-career engineers who want to learn how AI gets deployed in the real world — and who'd rather learn by building than by watching. ### **What You'll Need:** * A degree in computer science, engineering or another STEM field * 0–2 years of experience; internships, co\-ops and research * You built projects, where you integrated AI as a part of your SDLC (internship, research or hackathon entry) that you can walk us through in depth: what worked, what broke, and what you'd change * Hands\-on Claude Code basics * Strong programming fundamentals in Python or TypeScript * Curiosity and speed of learning — you pick up unfamiliar subjects quickly and ask good questions, especially about how real businesses work * Good commication skills \- ability to explain complex technical subjects to non\-engineers * Willingness to spend real time learning a client's job before you write code. It's the most unusual part of this role, and the most valuable * Location \& Work Arrangement: This role requires **working on\-site from our New York office 3 days per week** ### **Great If You Have:** * Cloud basics: AWS/Azure/GCP, containers, CI/CD AI/ML coursework or foundations * Comfort with ambiguity — our engagements start open\-ended by design Interest or coursework in financial services, insurance, healthcare or asset management * Data pipelines or SQL; classical ML or MLOps (PyTorch, SageMaker, MLflow); infrastructure\-as\-code * Open\-source contributions, hackathon projects or public writing on applied AI * Claude certification or AWS certification ### **What You'll Learn:** * How to deploy LLM and agentic systems into regulated production — banks, insurers, health systems * How to build evaluation harnesses: defining what "working" means, then measuring it * Cloud delivery on AWS Claude Code in production, working toward Claude certification * A real business domain — insurance underwriting, healthcare revenue cycle, asset management * How to work with clients: their operators, engineers and executives ### **Your first 90 days:** * Foundations — onboarding into our Blueprints, our delivery stack (Claude Code, AWS) and how we build evals, plus a primer on your first client's industry * The seat — join an engagement with your senior FDE. Shadow the operator, then do the work yourself * Your first piece — own a scoped part of a production system, with code review and your senior FDE beside you ### **What You'll Do** * Take the seat — learn a client's function from the inside, and help redesign it alongside your senior FDE and the Forward Deployed Executive * Build — ship production code for LLM applications, agentic workflows, and retrieval and extraction pipelines * Build the evaluation harness before the feature — define what working means, then measure it * Take systems to production on AWS, and feed what you learn back into the Blueprint * Grow into ownership — your team is measured by the client's business results, not by hours. Drive adoption, because a system nobody uses hasn't shipped — and build credibility with the client's engineers and operators ### **What you'll get:** * A senior FDE paired with you on every engagement, a named mentor accountable for your growth * Regular feedback and a clear path to Forward Deployed Engineer * Frontier delivery work across Cowork Activation, Agentic SDLC and Blueprint Activations in Financial Services and Healthcare * Real production experience in regulated industries most early\-career engineers never see * Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI and cloud solutions * Full\-time model * Unlimited Vacation policy * Generous health, vision, and dental insurance * 401(K) matching plan * Salary base range: $120\-145k. The salary range is determined through interviews and a review of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, and alignment with market data. ### **How We Hire** * **Technical task** — Complete a practical engineering task to demonstrate your programming fundamentals, problem\-solving skills, and ability to work with AI\-powered solutions. * **Intro conversation** — Discuss your background, projects, and what you're looking for in your next role. * **Task discussion** — Join a discussion about your approach to the task, what you'd build next, and how you'd evaluate whether it works. No LLMs are permitted during this session. **Why we ask for a task** We're growing and want to find the right fit. The task is a small investment of your time that gives you an opportunity to demonstrate your engineering skills, AI maturity, and ability to think independently. It also helps us verify that we're evaluating a real person rather than a bot. We're not using your work in our products or for client projects. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description: **About Qualitate** Qualitate is building the AI\-native primary intelligence platform for enterprises, investment firms, and asset managers. We automate the entire primary research workflow, from study design and expert recruitment through AI\-moderated interviews and insight synthesis – replacing weeks of manual research with hours of high\-signal output. Expert research is a broken industry dominated by legacy incumbents with expensive, manual, and slow services. Investment and corporate strategy teams spend hundreds of hours coordinating intermediaries, scheduling expert calls, and synthesizing insights across fragmented providers. The process takes weeks to produce short\-lived intelligence. Qualitate transforms this workflow by autonomously conducting expert discussions at scale using AI. Qualitate’s AI Moderator interviews thousands of experts simultaneously each month, capturing forward\-looking purchasing plans, competitive displacement, and real\-time ROI signals. The platform turns these interviews into quantified, time\-series outputs tracking over 10,000 public and private companies, queryable instantly in natural language. Our customers include some of the world’s largest enterprises, hedge funds, PE firms, credit investors, and venture capital firms. **The Role** Join Qualitate as our first dedicated security engineer. At 45 people, the security program you build is the one the company will scale on. You’ll harden our cloud environment, build logging, monitoring, and detection, remediate findings from penetration tests, and serve as the security reviewer on design docs for new features and architecture changes. You’ll also lead ISO 27001 from start to finish: scoping, risk assessment, implementing controls, and getting us through the certification audit, with evidence collection automated instead of tracked in spreadsheets. This is a high\-ownership role. You’ll be a part of our founding engineering team to define our security architecture and roadmap, and you’ll write and ship production code, not just review it. Our customers are hedge funds, PE firms, and large enterprises with demanding security requirements, so the systems you secure and the certifications you earn directly shape how fast we grow. The problems are specific to our platform: protecting confidential expert interviews and customer research, securing an AI system that runs thousands of interviews a month, and reaching ISO 27001 without slowing engineering down. You’ll report to our CTO, lead our response when something goes wrong, and partner with our VP of Compliance and Legal on policy, customer security reviews, and our broader compliance program. We’re looking for someone with 4\+ years of security engineering experience, including hands\-on compliance work, who thrives in fast\-moving environments where the surface area is wide and the team is lean. **Who This Role Is For** * **4\+ years of experience in security engineering.** Ideally some of it at a startup or high\-growth SaaS company where you secured cloud infrastructure hands\-on and also helped build a compliance program. * **Strong Cloud and infrastructure security skills.** Experience securing AWS or GCP environments, including IAM, network security, logging and monitoring, secrets management, and encryption. You can read and write infrastructure\-as\-code. * **Penetration testing rigor.** You can contribute to a production code base and address issues raised in a penetration test. * **ISO 27001 experience.** You’ve helped take a company through ISO 27001 certification, including scoping the ISMS, running risk assessments, writing the Statement of Applicability, implementing controls, and managing the audit. SOC 2 Type II experience is a plus. \[You’ve built the technical controls behind an ISO 27001 or SOC 2 Type II certification, such as access management, logging, vulnerability management, and encryption, and automated evidence collection rather than tracking it in spreadsheets. Familiarity with ISMS scoping, risk assessments, or the Statement of Applicability is a plus.] * **Fluent with AI models and agentic coding tools.** You use AI in your daily workflow, understand the security and data governance risks of building with LLMs, and know how to defend against risks like prompt injection and data leakage. This is core to how we work. * **High ownership, low ego.** You work independently, communicate proactively, and don’t wait to be told what to build. You’re comfortable making architecture decisions and defending them in code review. **What Sets You Apart** * Hands\-on experience with security tooling such as SIEM, EDR, CSPM, and vulnerability or container image scanning, and with compliance automation platforms like Vanta or Drata. jobs.title: Cybersecurity Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** Red Canary is seeking a skilled Cybersecurity Software Engineer to develop, maintain, and improve software solutions that help detect, investigate, and respond to cybersecurity threats. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software engineering, security\-focused development, and problem\-solving, with an interest in building reliable systems that protect organizations from evolving cyber threats. In this role, you will collaborate with software engineers, security researchers, and threat detection specialists to develop security tools, improve data processing capabilities, and strengthen the reliability of security\-focused applications. You will contribute to the software development lifecycle while helping deliver scalable solutions for identifying suspicious activity and supporting incident investigations. **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test, and maintain security\-focused software applications. * Build backend services, APIs, and data\-processing components for cybersecurity systems. * Develop reliable software for collecting, processing, and analyzing security\-related data. * Collaborate with security researchers and detection engineers to improve threat detection capabilities. * Identify and resolve software defects, performance bottlenecks, and reliability issues. * Implement secure coding practices and support application security reviews. * Write automated tests and participate in code reviews. * Improve system scalability, availability, and operational performance. * Maintain technical documentation and follow established engineering standards. * Investigate technical issues and contribute to continuous product improvements. **Requirements** * Experience in software engineering, application development, or a related technical field. * Proficiency in a programming language such as Python, Go, Java, or TypeScript. * Understanding of data structures, algorithms, APIs, and software design principles. * Familiarity with databases, distributed systems, and data\-processing workflows. * Knowledge of software testing, version control, and debugging practices. * Understanding of secure coding principles and common application vulnerabilities. * Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving abilities. * Effective communication and collaboration skills. **Preferred Skills** * Experience developing cybersecurity products, security automation tools, or threat detection systems. * Familiarity with SIEM platforms, endpoint detection and response (EDR), or security telemetry. * Knowledge of cloud security, container technologies, and distributed architectures. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and production monitoring. * Understanding of authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure API design. * Familiarity with incident response workflows and security operations. **About the Company** Red Canary is a cybersecurity company that helps organizations identify, investigate, and respond to cyber threats. Its security platform combines threat detection technology, security expertise, and managed detection and response capabilities to help organizations improve their security operations. Pay: $110,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Relocation assistance Work Location: In person

Engineering or Project management. (Master’s Degree preferred) * OSHA10/30 certification **Salary Range:** $98,500\-$125,000 **Benefits:** * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance

jobs.description: **Build What Matters at RevStar** **Position:** Data \& AI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) * **Reports To:** Product Manager/Engineering Lead * **Location**: Remote (AZ, DC, FL, GA, IA, IL, ME, NY, NJ, SC, TX, VA) * **Employment Type:** Full\-Time W2 **Job Summary** At RevStar, we build cutting\-edge cloud, data, and Generative AI solutions that transform how enterprise organizations operate. As an Advanced AWS Consulting Partner, we don’t just deliver code—we solve complex business problems, modernize legacy infrastructure, and deploy production\-grade cloud native and AI applications that drive real business value. Above all, our team operates on three core principles: * **Self\-Mastery:** We hold a high bar for how we think, communicate, and improve. * **Ownership:** We own outcomes, not just effort. * **Shared Destiny:** We rise or fall together. We are seeking a Data \& AI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our Digital Solutions Practice.
