As an FDE, you are both a master cloud builder and a trusted technical advisor. You will own the full delivery lifecycle for high\-impact enterprise accounts—architecting resilient cloud\-native environments, modernizing legacy infrastructure, and deploying state\-of\-the\-art AWS Generative AI (Amazon Bedrock, Q, SageMaker) architectures. Simultaneously, you will drive AWS adoption and consumption growth by identifying new workloads, building POCs, and driving strategic technical alignment with client executive leadership. **Key Responsibilities** * **Hands\-On Cloud Architecture \& Implementation:** Design, build, and deploy secure, scalable, and resilient cloud architectures on AWS using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation) and modern microservices/serverless patterns (Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, DynamoDB). * **Enterprise Customer Delivery:** Serve as the primary technical leader on strategic enterprise client engagements. Partner with CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Infrastructure/Engineering, and client development teams to translate complex business goals into high\-performing AWS solutions. * **Cloud Migration \& Application Modernization:** Lead large\-scale migrations from on\-premises data centers or legacy platforms to AWS (using AWS Application Migration Service, Database Migration Service, etc.) and re\-architect legacy monolithic applications into modern serverless or containerized architectures. * **AWS Generative AI \& Machine Learning:** Architect and deploy enterprise GenAI and ML workloads leveraging Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Vector Databases (OpenSearch, Pinecone, pgvector), and custom RAG implementations. * **Drive Platform Adoption \& Growth:** Partner with RevStar account leadership to identify new, high\-value cloud workloads within client accounts, driving AWS consumption expansion and clear ROI for client executive stakeholders. * **Technical Mentorship \& Practice Building:** Coach and mentor Cloud Engineers and Solutions Architects. Drive internal RevStar accelerators, reusable Terraform modules, AWS Well\-Architected Review frameworks, and cloud delivery best practices. **Requirements** Qualifications \& RequirementsTechnical Expertise:* 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in Cloud Architecture, DevOps/SRE, or Software Engineering with a focus on AWS. * 3\+ years in a client\-facing consulting, Solutions Architecture, or Forward Deployed Engineering role. * Deep AWS Core Expertise: Mastery across core AWS services (IAM, VPC, EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudFront, Route 53\). * Infrastructure as Code (IaC) \& CI/CD: Expert\-level proficiency in Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation, along with automated CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, AWS CodePipeline). * AWS GenAI \& Data Services: Practical experience with Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Glue, Redshift, or OpenSearch for building data platforms and AI solutions. * AWS Certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional and/or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional required. Specialty certifications (Security, Machine Learning, Data Analytics) are a plus. Client \& Business Acumen:* Enterprise Track Record: Proven experience leading technical delivery for Fortune 500 or mid\-market enterprise clients (Healthcare, Financial Services, Retail, or SaaS). * Consulting \& Communication Skills: Outstanding verbal and written communication; adept at whiteboarding complex architectures, building working POCs/demos, and presenting to C\-level executives. * Growth Mindset: Ability to spot technical expansion opportunities, conduct AWS Well\-Architected Reviews, and advocate for cloud modernization to expand account footprint. **Benefits** * **Paid Time Off** – Take the time you need to recharge and stay productive. * **Remote\-First Working Environment** – Collaborate from anywhere while staying connected with our global team. * **Comprehensive Health Coverage** – Medical, Dental, Vision * **401(k) Retirement Plan** – Plan for your future with access to a company\-sponsored 401(k) program. * **Annual Learning \& Development Stipend** – Invest in your skills with conferences, certifications, or courses. * **Peer Mentorship \& Coaching** – Learn from experienced engineers, product managers, and architects to accelerate your growth. * **Professional Growth Opportunities** – Exposure to cutting\-edge AWS GenAI, data, and cloud technologies across diverse industries. * **Company Outings \& Volunteer Opportunities** – Build relationships and give back to the community. * **Collaborative, Innovative Culture** – Work alongside top talent in a fast\-paced, supportive environment that values curiosity and initiative. **Equal Opportunity Employment** At RevStar, we don’t just accept differences — we celebrate them, we support them, and we thrive on them for the benefit of our employees, our customers, and our community. RevStar is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. **Reasonable Accommodations** RevStar is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, contact HR at hr@revstarconsulting.com. **E\-Verify** Our company participates in E\-Verify to confirm work authorization for all newly hired U.S. employees; this process applies strictly to direct W\-2 hires and is not applicable to independent contractor roles.

jobs.title: Salesforce Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Role description** **Salesforce Forward Deployed Engineer** Build agents on Agentforce, extend them with custom MCP servers, and ship both alongside the people who use them. **EXPERIENCE** 6–9 years in Salesforce **What you’ll do** A Forward Deployed Engineer works where the business problem actually lives. You’ll embed with a business team, learn their process in enough detail to argue about edge cases, and then build the thing — in their org, against their data, with them watching. The feedback loop is days, not quarters. The work is a mix of three things. First, Agentforce: designing agents, topics, and actions on the platform, grounding them in Data Cloud, and tuning them until they behave in production. Second, custom MCP servers you design and write in Python, which connect agents (Agentforce and others) to systems and capabilities the platform doesn’t cover out of the box. Third, the core Salesforce engineering that makes both dependable: Apex, LWC, Flow, integrations, and a data model that holds up under real volume. **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Run discovery directly with business stakeholders — process walkthroughs, org audits, data profiling — and turn what you learn into a design, not a backlog of tickets. * Design, build, and deploy Agentforce agents: topics, instructions, guardrails, and actions backed by Apex, Flow, prompt templates, and APIs. * Ground agents in the right data using Data Cloud, retrieval, and the Einstein Trust Layer, with an eye on accuracy, latency, and cost. * Decide, case by case, whether a capability belongs in a native Agentforce action or a custom MCP server, and build the connection between them when it’s the latter. * Design and build custom MCP servers in Python that expose Salesforce objects, SOQL queries, Apex endpoints, and business actions as well\-scoped agent tools, with clear input schemas, useful error messages, and permissions that respect the org’s sharing model. * Build on\-platform: Apex (triggers, Queueable, Batch, async patterns), Lightning Web Components, Flow, Platform Events, and a data model you’d defend in review. * Integrate Salesforce with external systems — REST and GraphQL APIs, OAuth 2\.0 flows, Named Credentials, External Services, middleware — handling retries, idempotency, and rate limits properly. * Evaluate agent behavior end to end: write test cases, measure topic routing and action accuracy, and find failure modes before a user does. * Own deployment and quality — SFDX, scratch orgs, CI/CD, Apex test coverage that means something, and governor\-limit awareness as a design habit rather than a bug fix. * Leave documentation and runbooks behind, so the team you embedded with can operate what you built after you move on. **REQUIREMENTS** **Salesforce depth** * 6–9 years building on the Salesforce platform. * Production Apex at scale: bulkification, asynchronous patterns, governor limits, trigger frameworks. * Lightning Web Components and solid front\-end fundamentals (JavaScript, HTML, CSS). * Declarative fluency — Flow, validation rules, sharing and visibility — and judgment about when not to write code. * Data modeling, large\-data\-volume considerations, and integration architecture. * Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Experience Cloud in production. **Agentforce, MCP, and Python** * Hands\-on Agentforce experience: building agents with topics and actions, Prompt Builder, Agent Builder, and Data Cloud grounding. * Strong Python — you’ve shipped and maintained services, not just scripts. * Hands\-on experience building custom MCP servers or comparable LLM tool\-use integrations (function calling, agent frameworks, retrieval pipelines). * A working mental model of how LLMs fail, and the habit of designing tools that fail safely. * API design, authentication, and secrets handling in an environment with real compliance constraints. * Comfort with Git, CI/CD, containers, and cloud deployment. **How you work** * You’re effective in front of non\-technical stakeholders — you can run the meeting, not just attend it. * You move under ambiguity and know which corners are safe to cut in a prototype and which ones aren’t. * You write clearly. Design docs, decision records, and handoff notes are part of the job. **BONUS** * Salesforce certifications — Agentforce Specialist, Data Cloud 360 Consultant, Platform Developer II, Application Architect, or Integration Architect. * Production Agentforce deployments with measurable business outcomes. * Data Cloud implementation experience beyond basic grounding. * Open\-source contributions to MCP servers, agent tooling, or the Salesforce developer ecosystem. * Prior consulting, solutions engineering, or forward\-deployed work at a product company. * Experience with evaluation frameworks for LLM applications. **Skills** **About RCG Global Services** At Myridius, we transform the way businesses operate. Formerly known as RCG Global Services, our more than 50 years of expertise now drive a new vision—propelling organizations through the rapidly evolving landscapes of technology and business. jobs.title: AI Data Operation Lead, Autonomy
jobs.description: Rivian Autonomy is seeking an AI Data Operation Lead to lead the people and processes that turn vehicle data into reliable training and evaluation datasets. Within the AI Platform organization, you will bring together labeling delivery, data quality, curation, and human review to support the development of our autonomous driving models. You will lead internal teams and external partners, with accountability for delivery, quality, and cost. This includes making sure the data we send for annotation is usable, that accepted labels meet the model teams' requirements, and that reviewers can turn difficult driving events into actionable feedback for engineering. You will work closely with Perception, Planning, Data Infrastructure, Eval Infrastructure, and Product to translate model\-development priorities into operational plans and provide evidence for release decisions. We are looking for a leader who can develop managers and specialists, make clear tradeoffs when demand exceeds capacity, and build an operation that improves as our models, tools, and vehicle fleet evolve.* **Lead the organization.** Set the operating plan for AI data operations, develop team leaders, and define responsibilities across employees, contractors, and vendors. Build capacity plans that account for annotation, quality review, and rework across concurrent programs. * **Deliver data that model teams can use.** Translate training and evaluation needs into labeling specifications, reviewer guidance, delivery milestones, and acceptance criteria. Work with model teams on taxonomy changes and keep delivery aligned with their development cycles. * **Improve data quality and yield.** Own the operational checks that determine whether collected vehicle data is ready for curation and labeling. Partner with collection and engineering teams to resolve sensor, calibration, and data\-quality issues before they consume downstream annotation capacity. * **Own vendor performance and spend.** Set service levels and quality expectations, evaluate suppliers, and manage capacity, pricing, and budgets with Finance and Procurement. Reconcile accepted work with invoices and address delivery or quality shortfalls through clear corrective actions. * **Develop human evaluation and triage operations.** Build review workflows with autonomy and systems engineers to investigate driving events, classify recurring failures, and assemble the evidence needed for root\-cause analysis. Feed those findings into scenario selection, evaluation datasets, and targeted data requests. * **Run the operation with consistent metrics.** Establish a shared view of accepted\-data volume, quality, turnaround time, backlog, rework, collection yield, and cost. Use these measures to identify constraints, allocate review capacity, and make delivery commitments teams can plan around. * **Improve tools and automation.** Partner with Data Infrastructure, Eval Infrastructure, and Applied General AI on labeling tools, prelabels, automated quality checks, and assisted triage. Define operational requirements and validate improvements against measured quality and reviewer effort before scaling them. * 10\+ years leading operations, including at least 5 years supporting autonomous vehicles, robotics, or complex machine\-learning programs, with responsibility for budgets or a P\&L. * Experience managing annotation partners across domestic and international locations, including commercial negotiations, staffing plans, and service delivery. * Enough technical depth in AI development to discuss data requirements and failure analysis with engineers and turn those discussions into clear work for operations teams. * A record of developing managers and specialists, establishing ownership, and adapting team structures as priorities change. * Strong analytical judgment: you can separate a quality problem from a capacity or tooling problem, test the cause, and follow through on the fix. * Clear communication across engineering, product, finance, and operations, with the ability to make prioritization decisions and explain their impact on delivery. **Bonus Points*** Direct experience supporting autonomous driving or other physical AI systems through data production and evaluation. * Experience applying large language models, multimodal models, or generative AI to annotation and human\-review workflows.

jobs.description: We are seeking a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to play a foundational role in building and deploying our next\-generation Large Driving Model (LDM) for the Rivian Autonomy stack. To solve this, we are leveraging massive\-scale Machine Learning powered by millions of miles of driving data. In this highly impactful role, you will own a full vertical of the LDM lifecycle, from large\-scale data curation and post\-training pipelines through to rigorous evaluation to implement and perfect specific, advanced driving capabilities. As a Staff Engineer, you will lead the AI strategy for these capabilities, serving as a primary technical authority. Your work will directly translate to the daily experience, comfort, and safety of our customers, which is critical to the core mission at Rivian. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of generative and foundation models in the physical world, shipping cutting\-edge improvements to customers, and driving technical consensus across a high\-performing team, we want to talk to you. * **End\-to\-End Vertical Ownership:** Spearhead the development of specific advanced driving capabilities by owning the full lifecycle within the Large Driving Model (LDM), including targeted data curation, post\-training alignment, and rigorous evaluation pipelines. * **Model \& System Design:** Examine and optimize all aspects of successful model design, ensuring high\-quality supervision, robust validation strategies, and scalable architectures capable of bridging the gap between offline LDM training and on\-road performance. * **Technical Leadership:** Act as a recognized technical authority within the Autonomy department, offering definitive guidance on current and future technology decisions, model architectures, and data strategies. * **Strategic Tradeoffs:** Possess an in\-depth grasp of the business, safety, and operational implications of various technology tradeoffs, effectively balancing them according to the company's timeline and product needs. * **Engineering Excellence:** Empower fellow engineers by architecting scalable, easily extendable, and collaborative ML systems and codebases. Establish best practices for the broader LDM team. * **Cross\-Functional Alignment:** Display the ability to influence technical roadmaps and foster consensus across perception, planning, and platform teams, even during challenging technical discussions. * **Production Focus:** Take charge of deploying, supervising, and enhancing the real\-world, on\-road performance of your models as they transition from the development phase into customer vehicles. * M.S. or Ph.D. in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field. * 7\+ years of industry experience working on complex, production\-grade Machine Learning systems, with a track record of operating at a Staff or Lead level. * Expert\-level knowledge and hands\-on experience with Python and PyTorch. Experience with large\-scale distributed training frameworks is highly preferred. * Deep expertise in state\-of\-the\-art foundation models, post\-training paradigms (fine\-tuning, alignment), and approaches for perception, prediction, or planning in the autonomous driving or robotics space. * Proven ability to own full ML data verticals, demonstrating mastery over data curation, synthetic data generation, and building robust evaluation frameworks for complex behavioral models. * Solid foundational understanding of linear algebra, geometry, optimization, algorithms, and data structures. * Exceptional communication skills with a demonstrated ability to set technical direction, guide the team toward it, and build consensus in a fast\-paced environment. * Passionately motivated to take ambiguous, complex ideas from development and validation all the way to a verified, shipping product. * Hands\-on approach: Proactively identifies systemic gaps, writes critical path code, and fills in technical voids where needed. * Prior experience with Automotive Self\-Driving stacks or similarly complex, safety\-critical Robotics Systems.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Are you passionate about pushing the boundaries of technology in the Gen AI space? Rohirrim is seeking a **Full Stack Engineer** to mentor engineers, provide technical direction, and drive the development of cutting\-edge applications. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment and enjoy leading by example while staying hands\-on with coding, we want to hear from you! ### **Why Join Rohirrim?** At Rohirrim, we're at the forefront of innovation in the Gen AI space. Joining our team means being part of a dynamic environment where your leadership and expertise make a tangible impact on our products and team growth. **Full Stack Engineer** **Location:** Hybrid, 3 days/week onsite in McLean, VA **About Us** Rohirrim is pioneering the future of enterprise AI with Rohan, our patented, domain\-aware generative AI platform. We help Fortune 1000 companies, aerospace and defense organizations, and government agencies automate complex processes like RFP creation and knowledge management. We're a fast\-growing, mission\-driven team building cutting\-edge AI products that reshape how enterprises work. **Role Overview** We're looking for a Full Stack Engineer to help build and improve our generative AI\-powered enterprise web applications. The work is split roughly 50/50 between backend and frontend, and we're flexible on that split. You'll own features end to end, from APIs and database design to polished UI. You'll work closely with senior engineers, product managers, and UI/UX designers. It's a hands\-on role with real ownership and plenty of room to grow your skills in AI/LLM application development. **Responsibilities** * Build and maintain backend services and APIs in Nest.js/Node.js, integrating with databases, LLM providers, and external systems. * Develop frontend features in Angular/TypeScript that deliver intuitive, reliable user experiences. * Implement generative AI features within Rohan, including LLM integrations, prompt design, and retrieval\-augmented workflows, with guidance from senior engineers. * Write efficient, maintainable SQL queries and help design database schemas for new features. * Own features from design through deployment, including testing, code reviews, and production support. * Take part in system design discussions, contributing ideas and learning how AI capabilities are architected into the platform. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver secure, scalable AI\-driven solutions. **Qualifications** * 3\+ years of professional experience as a Full Stack or Software Engineer. * Solid experience with TypeScript/JavaScript. * Hands\-on experience with Nest.js/Node.js or a similar backend framework. * Hands\-on experience with a JavaScript UI framework (Angular, React, or Vue). * Working knowledge of SQL, including writing queries and basic schema design. * Familiarity with CI/CD tooling; Azure DevOps a plus. * Interest in generative AI and eagerness to build LLM\-powered features. * Experience integrating with LLM providers/APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI). * Exposure to prompt engineering or retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG). * Experience with Angular specifically. * Experience in enterprise SaaS, government, or aerospace/defense environments

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: We are a healthcare technology company that provides platforms and solutions to improve the management and access of cost\-effective pharmacy benefits. Our technology helps enterprise and partnership clients simplify their businesses and helps consumers save on prescriptions. As a leader in SaaS technology for healthcare, we offer innovative solutions with integrated intelligence on a single enterprise platform that connects the pharmacy ecosystem. With our expertise and modern, modular platform, our partners use real\-time data to transform their business performance and optimize their innovative models in the marketplace. **Position Summary** The Senior Data Engineer owns the data platform end to end — designing, building, and maintaining the infrastructure, pipelines, and governed data layers that power analytics and downstream consumers across the organization. This is a hands\-on engineering role centered on cloud data platform development, pipeline orchestration, and data modeling at scale. The guiding principle is to build once, consume everywhere — define transformations and metrics a single time, governed and version\-controlled in the warehouse, then serve them consistently to every downstream consumer: BI tools, client\-facing reporting, and AI systems. The ideal candidate is comfortable building data platforms and systems from scratch, thrive in a platform development and maintenance environment, and brings strong hands\-on experience with Snowflake and workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow and dbt (or equivalent platforms). This role does not own BI visualization — your work spans raw ingestion through the governed gold layer. **Key Responsibilities** **Data Platform Development \& Maintenance** * Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and platform infrastructure on Snowflake. * Architect and implement end\-to\-end data flows from source ingestion through the silver and gold layers. * Own platform reliability, performance tuning, and ongoing maintenance — treating the data platform as a product. * Build systems from the ground up where needed; evaluate existing systems and refactor for scale, cost efficiency, and maintainability. * Establish engineering standards: version control, CI/CD, testing frameworks, and documentation for all platform components. **Pipeline Orchestration \& Workflow Management** * Design and maintain orchestration workflows using Apache Airflow (or equivalent) to schedule, monitor, and manage data pipelines. * Ensure pipeline reliability, observability, and failure recovery through alerting, logging, and automated retries. * Coordinate dependencies across upstream sources and downstream consumers with well\-defined SLAs. **Gold\-Layer Modeling \& Metrics** * Design, build, and maintain gold\-layer data models and a governed metrics layer in Snowflake using dbt — clean, tested, documented, and version\-controlled. * Establish metric definitions as the single source of truth: calculated once, reused everywhere, with clear ownership and change management. * Push transformation and calculation logic upstream into the warehouse so the consumption layer stays simple, consistent, and high\-trust. * Partner with analytics and BI stakeholders on the boundary between pipelines (data engineering) and consumption (analytics/reporting). * Structure and document data models so they meet the governance and consistency requirements of AI agents and autonomous analytical systems. **AI\-Native Development** * Build with coding agents and AI\-assisted tooling as a primary part of the workflow — accelerating pipeline development, data modeling, documentation, and testing. * Independently set up and manage development environments, repositories, and the tooling needed to work effectively with agentic systems. * Help establish team practices and standards for building data infrastructure in the AI era. **Quality, Governance \& Platform Judgment** * Champion data quality, consistency, and trust across all platform layers — ensuring data holds up under scrutiny from any downstream consumer. * Contribute to platform architecture decisions; identify opportunities for automation, templating, and process improvement. * Apply sound engineering judgment to evaluate build vs. buy decisions and tooling trade\-offs. **Qualifications** **Required** * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in data engineering — building pipelines, data models, and platform infrastructure in a data\-driven organization. * Snowflake:Proven, hands\-on production experience building data models and transformations in Snowflake. Deep familiarity with Snowflake architecture, performance optimization, and cost management. * Workflow Orchestration (must have):Hands\-on experience with Apache Airflow or an equivalent DAG\-based orchestration platform (e.g., Prefect, Dagster, Mage). Ability to design, deploy, and operate complex pipeline workflows. * dbt:Demonstrated experience using dbt for transformation modeling, testing, and documentation in a production warehouse environment. Equivalent semantic layer tooling experience considered. * Strong SQL proficiency — able to write, optimize, and review complex queries across large datasets. * Experience building data platforms or systems from scratch — not just extending existing infrastructure but designing and standing up new ones. * Comfort with platform development and maintenance as a long\-term ownership model — not just project delivery. * Fluency working in the AI era: building with coding agents, setting up development environments, and using AI tooling as a core productivity multiplier. * Familiarity with software engineering practices: version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and code review. * Strong communication skills — able to translate business requirements into technical data platform decisions. **Preferred** * Experience in pharmacy benefits management, healthcare technology, or a related regulated industry. * Experience with cloud infrastructure and data platform tooling (AWS, Azure, or GCP) alongside the data stack. * Familiarity with data governance frameworks, data contracts, or data mesh principles. * Experience with streaming or near\-real\-time data pipelines (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis, Spark Streaming). * Exposure to semantic/metrics layer tooling (e.g., MetricFlow, Cube, LookML). * Experience building demo environments or client\-facing data products. Salary Range: 145,000 \- 165,000 RxSense believes that a diverse workforce is a more talented and productive workforce. As such, we are an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. Our recruitment process is free from discriminatory hiring practices and all qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, ancestry, age, or national origin. Neither will qualified applicants be discriminated against on the basis of disability or protected veteran status. We believe in the strength of the collaboration, creativity and sense of community a diverse workforce brings.

jobs.title: Senior full-stack engineer
jobs.description: **About the role** We're hiring a senior full\-stack engineer to lead day\-to\-day development of Opportunity Tracker, our construction opportunity\-management platform. The application helps teams manage leads, evaluate which opportunities to pursue, coordinate work, and track pricing and decisions. You'll lead development of Opportunity Tracker, building new features and improving the application as customer needs evolve. You'll help shape technical decisions and support other engineers through code reviews and shared problem\-solving. You'll work alongside our engineering and implementation team and help guide technical decisions as we grow. **What you'll do** * Build and maintain features across the React frontend, TypeScript backend, and PostgreSQL database. * Take work from understanding the problem through implementation, testing, review, and release follow\-up. * Turn customer needs and team feedback into practical product improvements. * Learn the product's business workflows so your technical decisions support how customers actually work. * Identify bugs, technical risks, and maintainability problems, then propose practical ways to address them. * Help shape the application's architecture and keep it running reliably. * Protect customer data through careful authorization, tenant isolation, validation, and database changes. * Review code, explain decisions, and help other engineers improve. **What we're looking for** You have experience building and maintaining production web applications across the full stack. You're comfortable working in an existing codebase, understanding its design, and improving it without rewriting it unnecessarily. You should bring: * Strong TypeScript and React experience, including forms, data fetching, and complex application workflows. * Experience building backend services and APIs with Node.js or a comparable backend platform. * Solid relational database skills, including SQL, data modeling, migrations, and transactions. * An understanding of authentication, authorization, and protecting data in applications used by multiple customer organizations. * Experience testing features, diagnosing problems, and supporting software after release. * Clear communication about technical decisions, uncertainty, and delivery risks. We value initiative and sound judgment. You ask questions when requirements are unclear, understand the problem before implementing a solution, and follow through without needing every step prescribed. When you spot an issue outside your immediate task, you raise it and help decide what should happen next. You stay organized, take feedback well, and keep developing your engineering skills. You're curious about changes in software development and can distinguish a useful tool or technique from something that adds complexity without solving a real problem. **Our stack** We use TypeScript across a React frontend and Node.js backend, with PostgreSQL and AWS. Our tools include Fastify, tRPC, Drizzle ORM, Docker, Terraform, and GitHub Actions. You don't need experience with every tool we use. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn matter more than an exact stack match. Experience with multi\-tenant business applications is especially relevant. **Location and benefits** This is a full\-time, in\-person role based in Canonsburg, PA. You'll work on\-site with our team. This role is not remote or hybrid. Benefits include: * 401(k). * Health, dental, and vision benefits, with reimbursement toward coverage you choose. * Paid time off and holidays. The anticipated base salary range is $100,000–$150,000 annually, depending on relevant experience and qualifications. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid holidays * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Global Sustaining Controls and Vision Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Founded in 1976, Samtec is a privately held, $950 million global manufacturer of a broad line of electronic interconnect solutions, including High\-Speed Board\-to\-Board, High\-Speed Cables, Mid\-Board and Panel Optics, Precision RF, Flexible Stacking, and Micro/Rugged components and cables. Samtec Technology Centers are dedicated to developing and advancing technologies, strategies and products to optimize both the performance and cost of a system from the bare die to an interface 100 meters away, and all interconnect points in between. With 40\+ international locations and products sold in more than 125 different countries, Samtec’s global presence enables its unmatched customer service. **Summary/Objective:** Lead and develop the global sustaining controls and vision engineering teams responsible for designing, building, programming, deploying, and troubleshooting electrical, pneumatic, machine vision, machine learning, and related software systems for manufacturing equipment. Ensure solutions meet internal customer time\-to\-market needs, associate safety expectations, inspection and quality requirements, scalability needs, and applicable compliance standards. **Essential Functions/ Responsibilities:** * Manage global sustaining controls and vision engineering teams supporting the dynamic requirements of Samtec operations and driving the advancement of new technologies. * Provide technical leadership for solutions that meet global process and machine safety, quality, compliance, repeatability, maintainability, and scalability standards. * Lead the global sustaining controls and vision engineering teams in prioritizing projects, managing resource allocation, project communications and progress tracking to ensure on\-time successful completion. * Lead and develop sustaining resources for core competencies across electrical hardware design, controls programming, machine vision, machine learning, and software development. * Establish and maintain best practices, design standards, programming standards, and consistent global solutions for the Sustaining teams that enable the Samtec roadmap. * Work collaboratively with internal customers and cross\-functional teams to resolve production equipment, inspection, controls, and software issues. * Collaborate and work with other Samtec engineering teams to develop and standardize processes and equipment designs. * Support the planning and execution of capital appropriation requests for development of new equipment and optimization projects. Support production teams for duplicate equipment builds / integrations. * Develop and maintain team KPI’s to track performance and measure the impacts to the business. * Establish analytics and machine learning into the workflows of the global teams. Work to proliferate and enable Samtec’s Scada system across released machine platforms. *“The responsibilities as defined are intended to serve as a general guideline for this position. Associates may be asked to perform additional tasks depending on strengths and capabilities”* **Preferred Experience:** * 7 \- 10 years related engineering experience in manufacturing. * 3\-5 years of management experience. * Proficient in control relays, pneumatic solenoids, pneumatic controls, motion controllers, servomotors, stepper motors, etc. * Motion Controller and PLC programming experience (Trio Motion Controller preferred). * Operator Interface programming experience (Red Lion preferred). * Knowledge and understanding of the SDLC, practices and patterns. * Operational knowledge of various programming languages and data storage technologies including Visual Studio, C\#, Visual Basic, SQL Server, Mongo DB, Angular, Blazer, Node, MongoDB, Dev Ops, etc. * Knowledge and understanding of PID loop control. * Proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) * Working knowledge of 3D design software (preferably SolidWorks) * Excellent technical, problem solving and analytical abilities. * Must be able to sit / stand for at least 90 consecutive minutes. **Education:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a relevant engineering degree (or equivalent experience). These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Junior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview:** ARE you a junior software engineer who wants to understand how software actually works, not just how to make it compile? Are you the type of person who reads the stack trace before asking, who wants to know *why* the system is built the way it is, and who would rather learn from engineers with decades of production scars than from a tutorial? If you are early in your career and craving the kind of environment where you become exceptional rather than merely employed, this could be the opportunity for you. **About Sound Decisions:** This position is posted by Sound Decisions Recruiting on behalf of a client. Sound Decisions is a technical recruiting firm led by a software engineer, focused on matching engineering talent with strong teams. **Written From the Perspective of Our Client:** We focus on building highly scalable, reliable merchant payment technologies using the latest, most reliable technologies and engineering practices. We use modern AI tools to accelerate implementation, improve documentation and increase test coverage. AI is an engineering aid, not a substitute for judgment, communication, review or accountability. Our philosophy is explicit: AI exists to make the engineers already here more capable as they grow, and it is judged on whether it does. The core belief is that we grow through great minds, discussions and collaborations, and success is driven through a series of great judgments and decisions by people who love the craft of creating software. This role exists to give you Silicon Valley startup experience inside a structured, deliberate learning environment: a small senior team, real production scope early, and the time and mentorship to develop into an exceptional engineer. Your purpose in the first year is to develop a great understanding of the craft and excellent debugging skills, so that you become the bulwark between what AI produces and what reaches a customer. **What experience we're looking for:** * Working knowledge of software development fundamentals: data structures, complexity, state, and how a request moves from a browser to a database and back. We care more about how you reason than how long you have been paid to do it; there is no minimum years requirement. * Experience with, or demonstrated ability to learn, TypeScript and full\-stack web development. * Familiarity with Git and the core concepts of pull requests, merging, branching and code review. * A decent level of maturity with AI coding tools: you have used them on in personal or open source projects, you have been burned by them at least once, and you can describe what you check before you trust the output. * The ability to work independently on defined tasks while asking for help when appropriate, and the judgment to tell the difference. * Comparable experience counts. Building backend or full\-stack applications with Node.js and TypeScript is directly relevant; Scala and functional programming are valuable but not required. (Note: this experience does not have to come from a professional setting, but the expectation is that it can be delivered at a professional level.) **We expect** **You are learning Managing Up (working with your lead and senior engineers):** * Develop how to understand priorities: know which ticket matters this week and why. * Learn to provide solutions, not just problems: arrive with what you tried, what you found, and what you think. * Learn to anticipate needs: if a change touches the portal, you already checked who consumes it. * Build credibility: small promises kept, every time. **You will develop and learn** **The craft:** * How to debug from first principles: read the trace, form a hypothesis, isolate, prove it, then fix it. This is the skill AI cannot do for you and the one that makes you valuable. * How production payments software is designed for correctness under rules that change. * How a functional\-programming codebase (Scala) thinks, and why a type system is a design tool rather than a chore. * How to get precise, measurable output from AI tooling: clean instructions, scoped sessions, verification before merge. * How to write documentation and tests that a stranger can trust six months later. **What behaviors define success in this role:** * Attention to detail and the ability to spot ambiguities * proficient managing your time and accountable for your actions. * Great at communicating: clear writing and speaking in all channels, an active listener, and the wisdom to understand (OR ask) the forum in which ideas and concepts should be challenged. * Able to explain what you built and why to a senior engineer and to a business counterpart without hiding behind jargon. * Able to work with guidance, balance multiple activities, and meet deadlines, and to take instruction and turn it into shipped code without needing it repeated. * Operating with integrity. * Considerate of who's in the room and who needs to be in the room. * Taking notes in meetings for yourself and  open\-source experience building full\-stack applications, APIs, integrations or workflow automation. * Prior experience in a startup or similarly fast\-moving environment. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools with a willingness to learn responsible review, testing and security practices. * Fintech or e\-commerce domain exposure. **Shared values:** * The team understands that a bug can take hours and a new feature can take minutes with AI, and has the ability to weigh those efforts correctly. Lines of code does not make the engineer, nor do shiny new buttons. * Committed to developing implementations of repeatable success through coding standards, knowledge repositories for AI, and implementing reliable, consistent solutions. * Retrospective learning on what can be done better in the future. * A dedication to quality assurance using the latest tooling, and a commitment to higher reliability and coverage through research\-driven, best\-practice implementations. * A commitment to delivering value to our customers through great engineering. **Role responsibilities:** * Contribute to software development across multiple projects and languages. * Maintain existing systems and implement new features in a full\-stack capacity. * Help translate product and business workflow requirements into practical software solutions. * Support prototyping of new products and integrations, including reference implementations and UML\-based integration mappings. * Create and maintain clear User Guides, API documentation, and implementation documentation. * Write unit, functional, and automated tests with guidance from senior engineers. * Use AI tools responsibly to accelerate learning, coding, debugging, documentation, and test creation, and validate everything they produce. * Participate in Git\-based code reviews and apply feedback constructively. * Follow the concepts of an agile process and contribute to planning, delivery, and continuous improvement. * Communicate clearly, raise risks early, and collaborate with teammates across engineering and product. **Day\-to\-day:** This role carries a full\-stack title and, since everyone here uses AI first, a good share of the work is maintenance across the stack: understanding existing code, extending it safely, and keeping the services that consume our common libraries and present data to merchants reliable. Early on you will work closest to the portal and the outlying services; as you learn the system you will take on non\-architectural tickets end to end, front end and back end, and you will be in the room for the design discussions that shape them. **Interview Process (estimate 4\-5 weeks):** * SD Screening * SD Ran Technical Discussion (not a coding test) * SD Ran Behavioral * First Client Interview * Technical Discussion \+ Working Session * CEO Meeting * In\-Person Fly Out Meeting (where a member of the engineering team will come and spend time in person) **Benefits that matter to you** **Medical/Dental/Vision:** * Our client covers 85% of the employee premium for medical, dental and vision and 30% of the Dependents premium. Medical benefits are provided by Anthem Blue Cross PPO. * Basic Life Insurance * Long\-term disability * FSA * Participation is available on the 1st of the month after the start date **Team Travel \& Events:** * Twice a year travel for inperson events with the team. **Remote Work Benefits:** * Monthly shared workspace reimbursement * Monthly work from home expense reimbursement **Retirement:** * A 401k and Roth IRA provided by Betterment. * All full\-time employees are eligible to participate in the plan after 1 month of employment. * Our client has a 100% match of the first 2% of deferred compensation to eligible employees. **Vacation Policy:** * Unlimited planned vacation days **Company\-wide day off:** * Each quarter everyone in the company takes 1 day off **Growth \& Mentorship:** * A dedicated focus and environment to help you develop into a great engineer.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Data Replication Engine (C++ / Databases)
jobs.description: **About Stelo** --------------- For over 30 years Stelo's products have freed organizations from the complexities and difficulties of static data pipelines. Our software is an enterprise\-class data replication tool that delivers data dynamically from anywhere to anywhere for BI analysis, reporting, and prediction, or for managing business operations, B2B interactions, and supply chains. Stelo combines powerful, purpose\-built software with world\-class service and support. From end\-to\-end expertise and problem ownership to deep knowledge of all operating systems, platforms, and database systems, Stelo gets customers up and running and keeps them there. **Stelo Software Engineer** --------------------------- Stelo is hiring a Software Engineer to work on the engine behind our data replication platform: the software that moves live data between Db2, Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and cloud platforms such as Snowflake and Databricks, for customers who depend on it every day. The engine is built in C\+\+ and Java, and you will work in both. Our ideal candidate is a database engineer first and a strong C\+\+ programmer second. What sets this work apart is the database knowledge it demands. You understand how databases work, from the SQL on the surface to the drivers that carry it to the transaction logs underneath. We especially value experience with IBM Db2\. You work independently on a small remote team and own what you build through to production. You also use AI coding assistants as real leverage, as we do every day. You know what to build, you review generated code critically, and you prove it correct before it ships. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design, build, test, and maintain core components of the replication engine, from capture through apply. * Integrate with a wide range of sources and targets: Db2, Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MySQL; cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Kafka and Microsoft Fabric. * Keep replication correct, resilient, and fast across on\-premises and cloud environments, and tune data movement across CPU, memory, I/O, and network. * Work with support, QA, and product to investigate complex customer issues and ship robust, timely fixes and enhancements. * Help shape design decisions for the platform, including the internal APIs, data structures, and abstractions that simplify cross\-database support and configuration. * Write well\-documented, testable code, and review your teammates' code. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Strong SQL and a working understanding of database internals, such as transaction logs, recovery, locking and isolation, query execution, or replication. * 5\+ years building production systems\-level or backend software in C\+\+ (for example databases, storage engines, distributed systems, message brokers, or other high\-throughput services). * Hands\-on ODBC or JDBC experience: connection lifecycle, statement execution, parameter and result\-set handling, and diagnostics (SQLSTATE, vendor error codes). * Solid command of multithreading and synchronization in C\+\+, including locks, condition variables, and thread\-safe data structures. * Cross\-platform C\+\+ development for Windows (Visual Studio, MSBuild) and Linux (GCC), including debugging and profiling on both. * Professional use of AI coding assistants, with the judgment to review and test what they produce. * Clear written and spoken communication, and comfort working on a fully remote, distributed team. * Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with IBM Db2, especially journaling on Db2 for i. * Hands\-on experience with data replication, change data capture (CDC), ETL tools, or log\-based data movement. * Hands\-on experience with JDBC drivers and performance tuning across multiple relational databases. * Integration experience with Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Microsoft Fabric. * Working proficiency in Java. * Networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, SSL/TLS) and experience diagnosing connectivity and performance issues in hybrid environments. * Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD practices. * Experience with gRPC and Protocol Buffers. **Structure and Compensation** ------------------------------ * The position is 100% remote, full\-time, and exempt * Stelo will provide all necessary computer equipment * Employee is responsible for providing a suitable workspace * Employee will be assigned a fixed weekly schedule * Candidate should expect to work Pacific time hours most days * Salary $130,000\-$180,000 commensurate with experience * Generous health insurance coverage, employee benefits and retirement matching **Why Work at Stelo?** ---------------------- Stelo's small, dedicated team has enjoyed a 100% remote workplace since the company's founding. We have working from home and the flexibility it offers down! Combined with Stelo's excellent benefits and an unwavering appreciation for work/life balance, Stelo is an environment where team members have a chance to stretch and grow along with the company. * 100% remote workplace * Competitive salaries * Medical insurance for you and your family * Monthly HSA contributions * 3 weeks paid vacation * 11 Stelo holidays * Matching retirement contributions * Annual bonuses

jobs.description: *To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.* Job Category Software Engineering Job Details **About Salesforce** Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. Agents are changing how people build software and analyze data. Slack’s data platform needs to support both agents that surface insights, and developer tools that use data to provide quantitative feedback in the product iteration process. We’re looking for a Staff or Senior Staff engineer to help build out Agentic Analytics at Slack. You’ll collaborate on technical direction, build, and go from early prototypes through production. Your work could span many parts of the data stack: ingestion, infrastructure, semantic layers, and the interfaces that make data useful to humans and AI agents. You’ll partner with engineers across Data Engineering, Data Science, product, core infrastructure, and developer experience to quickly iterate on high leverage problem spaces and ship pragmatic solutions. **You’ll help us** : * Build data platform for agents. Design APIs, MCPs, and tools that let agents map data concepts to the right entities in the data warehouse. * Make data digestible. Improve our semantic layer so people and agents alike can navigate metric definitions, lineage, ownership, and reliability. * Make data on time (or provide signal when it’s not). Build ingestion and infrastructure for timely analytics, and experimentation. Evaluate tradeoffs between freshness, accuracy, reliability, and cost. * Ship tools that make data easy to analyze. Make it easy to draft accurate queries, do root cause analysis, and build visualizations. * Own the path to production. Drive architecture, implementation, rollout, and adoption. * Raise the engineering bar across teams by helping engineers make good design decisions, resolve technical dependencies, and grow through mentorship and leading by example. **How you work matters** : * You’re a high velocity engineer. You decompose problem spaces into digestible chunks and constantly iterate. * You’re biased toward action. You love to prototype to test ideas and get feedback early, but are okay throwing away bad ideas. * You can quickly build context in unfamiliar areas. You can move between a pipeline, a service, or a developer tool, build enough context to contribute. You also know when to ask for help when it speeds things up. * You balance speed and judgment. You can get a prototype off the ground quickly, but also build a reliable and scalable production system **Minimum qualifications** : * 8\+ years of experience building and operating a data platform * A track record of leading complex technical projects across teams as an individual contributor * Strong software engineering skills balanced with deep data expertise * Clear technical communication and the ability to build alignment with engineers, data scientists, analysts, and product partners * Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python, Go, Java, or similar **Bonus points for** : * Experience building infrastructure or tools for AI agents * Experience with semantic layers, metrics platforms, data catalogs, or lineage. These might include familiarity with tools like Airflow, dbt, Databricks, sqlmesh, Datahub, Superset or Snowflake * Expertise in SQL \& Python to build data pipelines * Experience building APIs, SDKs, or self\-service platforms that other engineers use. * Practical experience using AI development tools to accelerate implementation while maintaining engineering quality. **Technologies We Use:** Data: Trino, Spark, Pinot, Hive, Airflow, Iceberg, Spark, Datahub, Kafka Storage: S3 Infrastructure: Terraform, AWS Languages: Python, Go, SQL, Scala, Typescript Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. jobs.description: **Who we are** Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. **About the role:** Want to build the data foundation powering AI and self\-serve analytics at scale? As part of Samsara's Marketing Data and Analytics (MDA) Engineering team, you will shape the technical roadmap alongside our BI and Data Science peers. You will architect core Databricks pipelines, Gold Layer tables, and semantic models, turning ambitious, ambiguous business challenges into high\-value data products, autonomous agents, and cross\-functional automation. This role is open to candidates residing in the US. **You should apply if:** * **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Your efforts will result in real\-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. * **You are the architect of your own career:** If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. * **You're energized by our opportunity:** The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. * **You want to be with the best:** At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high\-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. **In this role, you will:** * Partner on defining the strategy and multi\-quarter roadmap for MDA's data and AI foundation. * Architect and own Samsara's marketing data infrastructure: ETL/ELT pipelines, Databricks Gold Layer tables, and the core data models that power segmentation, targeting, automation, and analytics. * Design the semantic layers, data dictionaries, and structured documentation that enable self\-serve BI and conversational analytics, partnering with the BI team to ensure core sales and marketing KPIs are built on trusted, well\-modeled data. * Translate ambiguous business questions from Marketing, Sales, and R\&D into clear requirements and scalable solutions, working autonomously without dedicated PM support and influencing decisions with data and sound reasoning. * Lead complex, cross\-team initiatives end to end: stand up new data pipelines and integrations quickly, manage risk across interdependent teams, and own the reliability and data quality of what ships. * Serve as the senior technical lead for the team's hardest problems: raise the bar for engineering quality and code review, remove bottlenecks that slow multiple teams, and mentor engineers and analysts. * Drive the strategic use of AI to solve ambiguous, high\-impact problems: build AI\-enabled data products and agents, with the integrations, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation practices that keep them reliable and trustworthy. * Identify and automate manual workflows with AI across Marketing and GTM teams, taking ideas from concept to prototype to production and influencing org roadmaps. * Ship high\-quality Python and SQL, increasingly by directing agentic coding tools, while holding a high bar for reviewing and verifying AI\-generated work before it reaches production. * Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. **Minimum requirements for the role:** * 8\+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or AI engineering, including deep hands\-on data engineering experience. * Expert\-level Python and SQL, with strong hands\-on data modeling and DBT experience. * Deep experience with data warehouse and lakehouse architectures, ETL/ELT, and the modern data stack, including hands\-on Databricks (or similar, such as Snowflake or BigQuery).  re engineering background beyond data or AI engineering, with a track record of turning ambiguous, unfamiliar problems into well\-architected, delivered solutions. * Expertise in data visualization and building dashboards for sales and marketing KPIs. * Familiarity with go\-to\-market data and systems: CRM (e.g., Salesforce), marketing automation, web analytics, and MarTech tools. * Experience building interactive applications with Streamlit, Claude workflows, or web frameworks. * Data science, machine learning, or predictive analytics experience. * Comfort working in an exploratory environment, testing and iterating on new data sources and methodologies. **Total Rewards** At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above\-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long\-term success: a flexible, employee\-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. **Flexible Working** At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in\-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on\-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. **Belonging at Samsara** At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. **Accommodations** Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. **Our Commitment to Authenticity** We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. **Fraudulent Employment Offers** Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us\-greenhouse\-mail.io or @mail3\.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **SUMMARY:** The AI Engineer makes Saturn's data decision\-ready. The role builds one reliable data foundation across SAP S/4HANA, Ignition, Excel, and external market data, automates the reporting produced from it, and applies AI so that management receives analysis and recommendations directly, without the manual collecting, reconciling, and formatting steps in between. The role reports to the CFO and works with the Executive and Plant Leadership Teams. It is a hands\-on position: the incumbent builds the data models, reports, and AI solutions personally and is accountable for their accuracy. The role also makes the wider organization AI\-ready by raising data quality at the source, building skills across the functions, and setting the rules for responsible use of data and AI. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** include the following. Other duties may be assigned.**Data Quality and the Data Foundation*** Make high\-quality base data an organizational standard: define entry rules, master data discipline, and data quality measurement together with the functions, which remain accountable for the accuracy of the data they create. * Build and operate one data foundation that connects SAP S/4HANA, Ignition and production systems, Excel\-based sources, and external market data such as Nielsen, as a Single Source of Truth. * Establish consistent KPI and master data definitions and documented calculation logic, so that every report and every AI answer uses the same numbers. * Work with the functions to eliminate the causes of poor data rather than correcting data downstream. **Automated Reporting for Decision\-Making*** Automate the recurring executive and plant reporting so that management information is produced without manual collecting, reconciling, or formatting. * Inventory existing reporting, consolidate duplicates, and retire the manual spreadsheets that automated reporting replaces. * Deliver executive\-level output: few, clear views showing performance, drivers, and recommended action, so that leadership receives decisions to make rather than data to process. * Use AI to generate commentary, variance explanations, and meeting\-ready summaries from the underlying data, with human review before release. **Forward\-Looking Analytics*** Move reporting from describing the past to anticipating the future: forecasting, scenario and sensitivity analysis, and early\-warning indicators. * Apply AI and statistical methods across all available data \- financial, operational, machine, quality, and market \- to identify trends, anomalies, and predictive maintenance opportunities. * Quantify the financial impact of operational trends so that leadership sees the P\&L consequence, not only the metric. **AI Solutions and Automation*** Identify, prioritize, and implement AI and automation use cases across all functions, each with a business case and a measured benefit. * Build and maintain AI agents and automated workflows that connect to Saturn's systems and perform real work, rather than standalone chat usage. * Test and monitor the quality of AI output, and keep a human accountable for every decision. **Making the Organization AI\-Ready*** Build data and AI capability across the organization: train and coach employees at all levels in the practical, day\-to\-day use of AI, reporting, and automation tools. * Identify where AI changes how work is done, and lead the change so that new ways of working are adopted and the replaced routines are retired. * Make company knowledge and process documentation structured, current, and retrievable, so that both employees and AI systems can use it. * Set and maintain the rules for responsible use of data and AI, aligned with heristo group policy and recognized frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, and the EU AI Act, including protection of customer\- and partner\-confidential data from external AI services. **ERP and Process Optimization*** Support the optimization of SAP S/4HANA and related business processes, ensuring that data, reporting, AI, and automation requirements are built into the system landscape. * Partner with KAM serv.it, PMO IT saturn petcare, functional teams, and external providers as the business\-to\-IT translator, and support process mapping and process mining. **Supervisory Responsibilities:** None**Qualifications:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.**Education and/or Experience:*** Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field; master's degree preferred. Equivalent demonstrated capability may be considered. * 5\+ years of hands\-on expe ge\-management skills, including the ability to present to executives. Candidates should be prepared to present examples of their own work. **Computer and Technology Skills \- Required:*** SQL at a working level: able to query, model, and transform data independently. * Advanced Excel and advanced proficiency in a modern business intelligence platform (Power BI preferred; SAP Analytics Cloud an advantage), including data modeling. * Practical experience extracting and modeling data from an ERP system, preferably SAP S/4HANA. * Hands\-on application of generative AI in a business setting: AI agents, workflow automation, retrieval over company documents, and the judgment to know where AI should and should not be used. **Computer and Technology Skills \- Preferred:*** Python, or an equivalent language, for data processing and automation. * Industrial and machine data: Ignition, historians, MES, OPC\-UA or MQTT. * A modern data platform such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, SAP Datasphere, or SAP Business Data Cloud. * Statistical forecasting or machine learning; process mining tools such as Signavio or Celonis; familiarity with AI governance frameworks. **Language Skills:** Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions and procedural manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of the organization. German language speaking skills is another advantage. **Mathematical Skills:** Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and ability to apply concepts such as: fractions, percentages, ratios and proportions to practical situations. **Reasoning Ability:** Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form. **Physical Demands:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms. The employee is required to stand, walk, sit, and talk and hear. The employee must regularly lift and / or move up to 15 pounds, frequently lift and / or move up to 30 pounds and occasionally lift and / or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distant vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. **Allergen Awareness** Products produced in this facility may contain the following allergens: Egg, Shellfish, Fish, Gluten. **Disclaimer:** The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified. Job descriptions are not intended to create a contract, nor are they to be construed to constitute contractual obligations of any kind or a contract of employment between Saturn Petcare Inc. and any of its employees. The provisions of job descriptions have been developed at the discretion of management and may be amended or cancelled at any time by Saturn Petcare Inc. with or without notice. Employment with Saturn Petcare Inc. is voluntarily entered, and the employee is free to resign at will at any time, with or without cause. Similarly, Saturn Petcare Inc. may terminate the employment relationship at will at any time, with or without notice or cause, so long as there is not violation of applicable federal or state law.

jobs.title: ERP Developer
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** ---------------- The ERP Developer is responsible for developing, customizing, maintaining, and optimizing Servotronics' Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system. This role combines technical development with ERP reporting and data analysis to improve business processes, automate workflows, and support data\-driven decision making. Working cross\-functionally, the ERP Developer translates business requirements into scalable solutions while ensuring system reliability, data integrity, and compliance with development standards. **What you will do:** --------------------- * Develop, maintain and enhance ERP workflows, scripts and automations to meet business needs and improve system performance. * Partner internally within IT, externally with software vendors, and cross\-functionally with Operations, Finance, Supply Chain, Quality, and other departments to gather requirements, manage projects, and deliver effective technical solutions. * Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and KPI's; analyze ERP data to identify trends, resolve discrepancies, and support business decisions. * Support integrations with third\-party vendors, including EDI, customer portals, and automation tools. Validate data flows and maintain data accuracy and consistency. * Conduct unit and integration testing, resolve ERP and reporting issues, and support system upgrades and enhancements. * Respond to ERP\-related support requests submitted through the company's ticketing system, troubleshoot reported issues, document resolutions, and escalate complex problems as needed. * Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, improve reporting, and enhance operational efficiency. * Maintain technical documentation, report specifications, and user guides. Provide technical support and training on ERP functionality and reporting tools. * Follow established development, testing, and change control procedures while maintaining system security, reliability, and data integrity. * Perform additional responsibilities as required to support IT initiatives and cross\-functional projects. **What sets you apart:** ------------------------ ### **Qualifications:** **Required:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field. * Minimum of 2 years of experience in ERP development or enterprise application programming. * Proficiency in SQL and relational databases. * Experience with ERP development tools and reporting platforms (e.g., Crystal Reports, SSRS, or similar technologies) * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions. **Preferred:** * Experience with ERP platforms such as IQMS (EIQ)(DELMIAWorks), SAP, Epicor, or Oracle. * Experience with programming or scripting languages such as Python and PowerShell. * Experience with system integrations, APIs, and middleware tools. * Familiarity with manufacturing, finance, and/or supply chain operations. * Experience with Power BI, data visualization, KPI development, and/or advanced reporting. * Knowledge of source control, software deployment, and change management practices. ### **Competencies:** . Effective Communication . Follow Through . Analytical Thinking . Collaboration * Systems Thinking . Customer Focus . Self\-Directed ### **Physical Requirements:** **Hearing:** Adequate to perform job duties in person, over the telephone, and on the production floor. **Speaking:** Must be able to communicate clearly in person, over the telephone, and on the production floor. **Vision:** Visual acuity adequate to perform job duties, including visual examination of manufactured parts and reading information from printed sources and computer screens. **Other:** May require frequent lifting and carrying items weighing up to 30 pounds unassisted, including assisting coworkers when required. Adequate physical ability including sufficient manual dexterity to perform the requisite manufacturing duties. Requires frequent bending, reaching, repetitive hand movements, standing, walking, squatting and sitting, with some heavy lifting, pushing and pulling exerted regularly throughout a regular work shift.
