jobs.title: Senior DataOps Engineer
jobs.description: Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960\. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again. But Scout is more than just a brand, it's a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work. The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn't been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all\-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built\-in gas\-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range. At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go\-getter with unrivaled passion. Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now! #### **What you'll do** Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick\-up truck \& rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following: * Contribute to the design, implementation, automation, maintenance, and operational support of enterprise\-scale cloud data platforms leveraging Databricks, AWS cloud services, and modern Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices. * Lead the design, development, optimization, and operational management of enterprise\-scale ETL/ELT pipelines within Databricks. * Build and maintain scalable batch and streaming data pipelines using PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, and Databricks Workflows. * Configure, optimize, and manage Databricks clusters for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency. * Work closely with software development and systems teams to build Data Integration solutions. * Design and build Data models using tools such as Lucid, Talend, Erwin, MySQL workbench. * Define and enhance enterprise data model to reflect relationships and dependencies. * Review application data systems to ensure adherence to data governance policies. * Design and build ETL (Python), ELT(Python) infrastructure, automation, and solutions to transform data as required. * Design and Implement BI dashboards to visualize Trends and Forecasts. * Design and implement data infrastructure components, ensuring high availability, reliability, scalability, and performance. * Design, train and deploy ML models * Implement monitoring solutions to proactively identify and address potential issues. * Collaborate with security teams to ensure the data platform meets industry standards and compliance requirements. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including product managers, developers, and business partners to ensure robust and reliable systems. **Location \& Travel Expectations**: * This role is **remote** and based within the United States. * Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time. #### **What you'll bring** We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You'll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment. You'll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring: * Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or related field or equivalent work experience. * 8\+ years of hands\-on experience as DataOps Engineer in a manufacturing or automotive environment. * Experience with streaming and event\-based architecture. * Experience implementing data lakehouse solutions using Databricks. * Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform). * Proficient in building data pipelines using languages such as Python and SQL. * Experience with AWS based data services such as Glue, Kinesis, Firehose or other comparable services. * Experience with Structured, unstructured and time series databases. * Solid understanding of cloud data storage solutions such as RDS, DynamoDB, DocumentDB, Mongo, Cassandra, Influx. * Several years of experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure. * Proven ability to develop and deploy scalable ML models. * Hands\-on experience in designing, training, and deploying ML models * Strong ability to extract actionable insights using ML techniques * Ability to leverage ML algorithms for forecasting trends and decision\-making * Excellent problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills. jobs.title: Support Engineer II
jobs.description: **JOB SUMMARY:** A **Support Engineer II**’s responsibilities are to deliver enterprise\-level technical support to our bank associates. This position will diagnose and resolve software, hardware, and network issues, assist with application installations, and provide both remote and on\-site support. Additionally you will communicate via email, ticketing systems, and phone, offering timely solutions and clear guidance. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** * **Asset Management**: Manage IT assets using ServiceNow, overseeing the full lifecycle from procurement to retirement. Maintain inventory, stockrooms, and perform audits using barcode scanning. * **Hardware Support**: Deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot laptops, desktops, servers, and peripherals. Track warranties, leases, and depreciation. * **Ticket Resolution**: Resolve escalated tickets from Support Engineer I and mentor junior team members. * **Technical Troubleshooting**: Diagnose and resolve issues related to VPN, Windows 10/11, Office 365, and other desktop/laptop environments. * **Application Support**: Install, configure, and troubleshoot bank\-specific and productivity applications, following vendor guidelines. * **Active Directory \& Peripherals**: Manage user accounts and support multi\-functional printers, AV equipment, and other peripherals. * **Imaging \& Deployment**: Image and deploy devices to both campus and remote locations. * **Inventory \& Logistics**: Handle shipping, receiving, and inventory tracking of hardware assets via ServiceNow. * **On\-Site Support**: Provide in\-person technical support and equipment installation at Seacoast Bank locations. Replace battery backups and troubleshoot network/server issues as needed. * **On\-Call Rotation**: Participate in a 24x7 on\-call support rotation. * **Mergers \& Acquisitions**: Support M\&A activities, which may involve extended travel and overnight stays. * **Issue Ownership**: Take full ownership of reported issues, ensuring resolution and user satisfaction. * **Documentation**: Maintain accurate records of technical procedures, solutions, and asset data. * **Collaboration**: Escalate unresolved issues appropriately and collaborate with internal teams to ensure timely resolution. * **Customer Service**: Guide users through troubleshooting steps via phone, email, or in person, ensuring systems are fully functional post\-resolution. * **Other Duties**: Perform additional tasks or project work as assigned by the department manager or team lead. **EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:** * Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Equivalent experience (including military service) with relevant certifications may be considered. * Certifications such as Microsoft, CompTIA, Cisco, or ITIL are a plus. * Proven experience as a Support Technician II, Desktop Support, or IT Help Desk Technician II. * Proficiency with the ServiceNow platform for ticketing and asset management. * Hands\-on experience with Windows OS, hardware, and mobile devices. * Strong understanding of computer systems, AV equipment, and network fundamentals. * Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and customer service skills. * Ability to travel to branch and back\-office locations (25%–50%), including overnight stays. * 3\-5 years of experience in a support, help desk, or desktop technician role. * Travel to various Seacoast Bank locations across Florida, with travel expected 25%–50% of the time, including occasional overnight stays. *The Statements above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills. Because these statements are general, the job description is used for a variety of purposes including job evaluations; performance reviews; recruitment; etc. All Associates are required to adhere to the highest legal and ethical standards applicable to our industry. It is the policy of Seacoast Bank that all Associates will be familiar and compliant with all regulatory, legal, ethical and Bank risk mitigation requirements pertaining to both our industry and their individual roles. This includes the on time, successful completion of annual required training post\-hire and effective execution of role responsibilities.* \#LI\-PF1 Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

This role performs the critical engineering work required to deliver high‑fidelity, production‑grade data that powers machine learning models, feature stores, and generative AI applications. Operating as a “day‑one” builder, the Gen AI Engineer designs and delivers data pipelines that bridge legacy on‑premise systems—including mainframes, SQL Server, and DB2—with modern cloud platforms such as Snowflake and AWS/Azure AI ecosystems. The role ensures that data is not merely transferred, but deliberately engineered to meet the statistical, performance, and governance requirements of model training, inference, and RAG‑based AI systems. Remote role, open to any U.S. state. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Designs, builds, and maintains resilient ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from on‑premise systems, AWS services (S3, RDS), and Azure platforms (Blob Storage, Azure SQL), centralizing and curating data for consumption in Snowflake and downstream AI services. * Develops and maintains feature stores and analytically optimized datasets that support machine learning workflows, ensuring data is clean, versioned, reproducible, and statistically valid for Data Science teams. * Engineers data pipelines that enable generative AI use cases, including the automated extraction, transformation, chunking, and loading of structured and unstructured data into vector databases across AWS and Azure environments. * Acts as a Snowflake power user and technical lead, implementing advanced data modeling patterns, Snowpipe automation, and compute and storage optimization to support high‑concurrency analytics and AI workloads. * Executes non‑invasive data extraction strategies to unlock mission‑critical data from decades‑old legacy systems while preserving system stability and avoiding disruption to core business operations. * Designs and manages complex, cross‑platform data workflows using orchestration tools such as Airflow, AWS Step Functions, and Azure Data Factory to ensure reliable, synchronized data movement across the organization’s multi‑cloud architecture. * Partners closely with central IT, database administrators, infrastructure, and security teams to resolve connectivity and access challenges—including PrivateLink, IAM, network segmentation, and firewall controls—while securing production approval for new data integrations. * Implements automated data quality, validation, and observability frameworks to detect data drift, anomalies, and integrity issues that could negatively impact production analytics, machine learning, or AI systems. * Drives efficiency across the data ecosystem by optimizing storage, compute usage, and query performance in Snowflake, AWS, and Azure, ensuring responsible cost management and measurable ROI for Transformation Office initiatives. Operates as a dedicated engineering partner to MLOps, Data Science, and AI teams, rapidly iterating on evolving data requirements and translating experimental use cases into scalable, production‑ready data solutions. * **ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONS and RESPONSIBILITIES** * Performs other duties as assigned. Travel as required. * **QUALIFICATIONS** **Education \& Licensing** Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field from an accredited college or university preferred. **Experience** Six (6\) years of hands\-on data engineering experience, with a track record of building production\-grade pipelines for Data Science and AI in multi\-cloud environments or equivalent combination of education and experience required. **Skills \& Knowledge** * Expert\-level proficiency in Snowflake architecture, including data sharing, performance tuning, and the integration of Snowflake with external cloud AI services * Advanced, hands\-on knowledge of AWS (S3, Glue, Lambda) and Azure (Data Factory, Synapse) data services * Mastery of Python, SQL, and PySpark. Deep experience with data orchestration and containerization (Docker) * Proven ability to interface with "old world" tech (on\-premise SQL, Mainframe extracts, flat files) and transform it for modern cloud consumption * A strong understanding of the specific data needs for Machine Learning (feature engineering) and Generative AI (vectorization and embedding pipelines) * A "get\-it\-done" attitude, capable of navigating enterprise bureaucracy and technical debt to ship code at the speed required by a Transformation Office * Ability to work in a team environment Ability to meet or exceed Performance Competencies * **WORK ENVIRONMENT** When applicable and appropriate, consideration will be given to reasonable accommodations. **Mental** **:** Clear and conceptual thinking ability; excellent judgment, troubleshooting, problem solving, analysis, and discretion; ability to handle work\-related stress; ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously; and ability to meet deadlines **Physical** **:** Computer keyboarding, travel as required **Auditory/Visual** **:** Hearing, vision and talking The statements contained in this document are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by a colleague assigned to this description. jobs.title: Data and AI Engineer
jobs.description: #### **Join us in Seattle and help shape how Sellen builds with data and AI.** Sellen Construction is looking for a Data and AI Engineer to help automate manual work across the business. Reporting to the Director of Data Platforms, this person will gather requirements from business stakeholders and build trusted, well\-governed solutions. About 40% of the role is building AI agents and automated workflows, mainly in the Microsoft stack (Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure AI Foundry). Examples include document intake and routing, RFI and submittal triage, and meeting summaries. Another 40% is data engineering: building pipelines out of Vista, Procore, UKG and SharePoint, and maintaining Sellen’s analytics layer and semantic models in Microsoft Fabric. The remaining time goes to data quality and governance, including CUI/CMMC boundaries, and to supporting the Data Analyst with certified datasets. \*\*The position is located in South Lake Union full\-time. **Your Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of relevant work experience in data engineering, software development, or systems integration, with exposure to the requirements, processes, and functions of general contracting preferred. OR * 3\+ years of experience with direct responsibility for building and maintaining data pipelines, integrations, or automation solutions, including: + Designing and building ETL/ELT pipelines and data integrations. + SQL and Python (or a similar language) for data transformation and automation. + Integrating enterprise systems through REST APIs (Procore, Viewpoint Vista, UKG, or similar ERP/project management platforms preferred). + Cloud data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, or Synapse. + Data modeling, data quality, and governance practices. + Building AI\-enabled automations or agents using LLM platforms, Power Automate, or similar tools. + Version control (Git) and deployment practices for production systems. **LICENSES / CERTIFICATIONS** * One or more of the following, or equivalent (preferred): * Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL\-300\). * Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP\-600\). * Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Fundamentals (DP\-900\). * Microsoft Certified: AI Business Professional (AB\-730\). **KNOWLEDGE** * Strong working knowledge of construction operations practices, processes, and commercial construction project context (preferred). * Strong working knowledge of the information required by preconstruction and construction operations in day\-to\-day decision\-making and in the creation of schedules, estimates, and budgets (preferred). * SQL and DAX, including working with semantic models and star schemas. * Microsoft Fabric and Power BI Service (preferred). * Data governance concepts, including data ownership, data quality, metadata, and data classification. * Practical use of AI tools for analysis, and awareness of their limits (preferred). * Agile development framework. **SKILLS** * Process improvement through automation: Finds manual, repetitive workflows across operations, preconstruction, and the field, and replaces them with reliable automated solutions. * Project planning and delivery: Breaks pipeline, integration, and agent projects into milestones, ships working pieces in stages, and manages priorities across competing requests. * Engineering judgment: Designs data pipelines and AI workflows that are maintainable, monitored, and secure. Decides when to build, when to buy, and when not to automate. * Problem solving: Troubleshoots data quality issues, failed integrations, and unexpected model or agent behavior by finding the root cause instead of applying patches. * Ownership and reliability: Treats production pipelines and automations as services. Owns them end to end, from monitoring and alerting through fixes. * Responsible AI and data governance: Builds with security, access controls, and compliance in mind, including handling CUI and sensitive project data appropriately. * Communication skills: + Technical documentation: Writes clear runbooks, data definitions, and architecture notes so others can support and extend the work. + Requirements and collaboration: Turns loosely defined business needs from non\-technical stakeholders into working solutions, and partners closely with the data analyst, who uses the data this role produces. **ABILITIES** * Demonstrate critical and holistic thinking. * Ability to communicate comfortably and effectively with new and diverse groups of people. * Ability to influence others and lead change. * Ability to critically analyze complex and varied information to make recommendations. * Ability to leverage technology to facilitate communication and collaboration. * Comfortable collaborating across functions to identify data analytics problems and execute solutions with technical rigor and data\-driven insights. *The full salary range for this position is* ***$118,000 to $145,000****. New hires typically start between* ***$118,000 and $138,000****, depending on direct professional experience and qualifications. The bonus target for this role is* ***5%*** *of annual base earnings. Learn more about Sellen's Fair Pay Workplace certification, our bonus plan, and other rewards and benefit programs here (https://www.sellen.com/wp\-content/uploads/2024\-Sellen\-Benefits\-at\-a\-Glance.pdf).* **About Sellen** Sellen's purpose is to improve the lives of those around us \- *as builders, partners and neighbors*. Our goal is to hire the best talent and develop the strongest project teams in the industry. If you bring strong skills, thrive in a project environment, and enjoy team spirit and collaboration, please introduce yourself. **Our Benefits** At Sellen, we provide our team members with an environment that promises safety, stability, and values mental health. jobs.title: Sr Web Application Developer
jobs.description: ### **The Opportunity** Settlor is a fast\-growing software company focused on building innovative solutions for the title, escrow, and real estate industries. We are looking for a Senior Web Application Developer who is not only experienced, but truly passionate about coding \- someone who is always curious about what is possible with the latest features of our chosen frameworks and languages, and who would rather understand a system than just extend it. As a Senior Web Application Developer, your impact is immediate. You will drive the design and implementation of the real estate applications at the center of our platform, working closely with the engineers who built the framework, the design patterns, and the back end of our software. You won't just close tickets; you will shape architecture, raise the bar in code review, and level up the engineers around you. Our team demonstrates and values technical thought leadership, and this is a role where that leadership is expected and rewarded. We are a small but mighty team, which means the scope here is real. The decisions you make about structure, performance, and practice will still be visible in this codebase years from now. If the idea of working hard, learning new things every day, and being part of a nimble and savvy product team sounds appealing, we want to hear from you. This is a hybrid position based in Denver, Colorado. Typical office hours are 8:00 AM until 5:00 PM; Monday and Thursday at home, Tuesday and Friday in the office, with Wednesday as scheduled weekly/monthly. ### **Why Join Settlor?** * **Impact**: Your work directly influences our customers' experience with our platform and our company and is foundational to our long\-term growth and evolution. * **Culture**: A collaborative, "no\-ego" environment where we celebrate wins and learn from losses. We purposefully operate in a hybrid\-office environment because we believe in the power of teams and relationships, and we have learned that both are best built and nurtured in\-person. * **Growth**: Often hard to find in the age of A.I. and constant turnover with software engineers, we invest in professional and personal growth as demonstrated by our high\-retention of engineers who started their careers with us and have found little reason to look elsewhere. * **Customer\-Centric**: We build for the long haul by prioritizing solutions to real\-world challenges for our customers. Your work ensures we evolve in lockstep with our users' needs, creating a product they truly love and trust. * **Technical Thought Leadership**: Architecture and design patterns are discussed openly here, and senior engineers have a real seat at the table on technology selection. * **Self\-funded and privately\-held**: Not looking for hyper\-growth on an aggressive timeline. We want to build an organization thoughtfully and strategically, with solid processes and culture. ### **What You’ll Do** * **Architecture \& Design**: Drive the design and implementation of robust, scalable web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks (Vue 3\) and backend technologies (Python/Flask/FastAPI), and contribute to system architecture decisions and technology selection. * **Feature Leadership**: Lead development efforts for new features and improvements to existing applications, ensuring high\-quality code and architectural integrity. * **Mentorship**: Serve as a technical mentor and coach, actively leveling up the engineering team through rigorous code review and the championing of best\-in\-class development practices. * **Complex Problem Solving**: Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across the full development stack. * **API \& Integration Work**: Implement and maintain RESTful APIs that interface with various internal and external services. * **Agentic Practice**: Help define how this team uses AI coding agents — the review standards, the guardrails, and the boundaries around our 'system of record' data — and keep architectural integrity intact as throughput goes up. * **Quality \& Reliability**: Ensure application security, performance, and reliability through proper testing methodologies. * **Continuous Improvement**: Explore and experiment with new features and best practices in Vue, Python, and related frameworks to keep our products at the cutting edge. * **Agile Execution**: Participate in agile development processes, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives. * **Documentation**: Develop and maintain documentation for code, APIs, and system architecture. ### **What You Bring** * **The "Startup Mindset"**: You are comfortable with autonomy, thrive in a fast\-paced environment, and are willing to wear multiple hats. * **Depth of Craft**: You have 5\+ years ideating, building, designing, and maintaining web applications, and you take pride in producing high\-quality deliverables. * **Technical Command**: You know Vue or an equivalent JavaScript framework and Python with FastAPI, Flas oss functions, translate business requirements into technical solutions, communicate openly, and take feedback constructively, even under pressure. * **Detail Discipline**: You have a sharp eye for details, catch issues before they become problems, and maintain high standards of accuracy without losing sight of broader goals. * **Love of Data**: Our software platform is built around critical, 'system of record' data, so you need to be comfortable reasoning about data models, integrity, and the trends or gaps in a data set. * **Industry Context**: Experience in Real Estate Tech (PropTech) or Mortgage and Real Estate Brokerage is highly preferred; experience in the Title Insurance \& Escrow/Closing industry would be amazing. ### **Your Education \& Experience** We believe there are specific educational backgrounds and professional experiences necessary or strongly preferred in order to be successful in this position. Necessary: * A related bachelor's degree or commensurate experience * 5\+ years of professional experience building and maintaining production web applications * Strong working knowledge of a modern JavaScript framework and a Python web framework * Proficient in clear, professional written and verbal communication * Experience mentoring developers and leading technical projects Preferred: * Production experience with Vue 3 and with FastAPI or Flask * Experience designing and maintaining RESTful APIs across internal and external integrations * Experience owning architecture decisions and technology selection on a team * Hands\-on experience directing agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) on production codebases * Experience in real estate, mortgage, and/or banking industries Bonus Points: * Experience in the Title and Escrow industry * Experience with enterprise SaaS at multi\-tenant scale * Open\-source contributions, talks, or writing that show how you think ### **Why You’ll Love It Here** We believe you do your best work when you have the freedom to be flexible, backed by a team that's always in your corner. * **Competitive Pay**: $135,000 to $165,000 base salary * **Growth**: Rapid career progression as we scale our customer base and our company. * **Health and Wellness**: We offer full health benefits (medical, dental, and vision) and matching 401(k) retirement plans * **Work\-Life Balance**: Flexible time\-off program that empowers work\-life balance * **Dress Code**: Come as you are. Shorts, hoodies, and t\-shirts are great \- just no smelly sandals. * **Office Culture**: Background music, afternoon board games, puzzle tables, and a fully stocked snack kitchen (plus occasional breakfast burritos for good behavior!). * **Prime Location**: A quick scooter ride to RiNo, and steps away from local coffee, breweries, golf simulators, a dog park, Beat the Bomb, and Topo Designs HQ. **At this time, we are only considering applicants who are already eligible to work for any U.S. employer without company sponsorship.** We anticipate candidates with the necessary skills, background, and passion for this position to receive the base salary and benefits package as outlined above; we also appreciate that candidates with the preferred or ideal background and experience referenced above may demand more. *Settlor is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, citizenship status, color, creed, disability, ethnicity, genetic information, gender (including gender identity and gender expression), marital status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other status or condition protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.* Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. jobs.title: Factory Data Engineer
jobs.description: **A Snapshot of Your Day** As the Factory Data Engineer, you will play a critical role in building the reliable data foundation for our new Large Power Transformer factory in Charlotte, NC. You will develop and maintain data pipelines, integrations, and scalable data infrastructure that connect operational and enterprise data and make it accessible for analytics, reporting, and digital manufacturing solutions. This role is based in Charlotte, North Carolina and closely connected to on\-site operations. You will work side\-by\-side with manufacturing, operations, digitalization, IT data teams, system owners, and external vendors. If you enjoy solving complex integration challenges and turning fragmented factory data into dependable, well\-documented data products, this role offers a unique opportunity to shape the data foundation of a factory of the future. **How You’ll Make an Impact** * Build reliable data foundations by designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data ingestion pipelines and integrations for factory operations. * Connect critical data sources, integrating operational and enterprise systems including MES, SAP, PLM, IIoT connectors, APIs, and other factory platforms. * Enable the Factory Data Cloud, supporting its architecture, data flows, and dependable use as a foundation for analytics and digital solutions. * Improve data accessibility, making trusted data available to analysts, process owners, and digital use cases while supporting appropriate access controls. * Strengthen data quality and reliability by implementing quality checks, monitoring data availability, troubleshooting failures, and addressing source\-system issues. * Document data assets and interfaces, maintaining clear technical documentation for pipelines, mappings, dependencies, and data definitions. * Partner across functions, working with the Digital Transformation Officer, Data Analyst, IT data teams, operations, and MES/SAP/PLM system owners to translate business needs into sustainable data solutions. * Coordinate integration delivery, managing dependencies with internal stakeholders and external vendors and proactively addressing risks caused by non\-harmonized sources or access constraints. **What You Bring** * 5\+ years of experience in data engineering, systems integration, industrial data, automation, or a related role, preferably in manufacturing or another operational environment. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Automation, Industrial Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Hands\-on experience developing and maintaining data pipelines, integrations, and scalable data infrastructure. * Strong working knowledge of SQL, APIs, data platforms, and data integration patterns. * Experience integrating enterprise and operational systems; exposure to MES, SAP, PLM, IIoT, or factory data platforms is strongly preferred. * Experience implementing data quality checks, monitoring data availability, troubleshooting integration issues, and maintaining technical documentation. * Strong problem\-solving and systems\-thinking skills, with a reliable and methodical approach to delivery. * Experience with modern cloud\-based data platforms (Azure preferred), AWS, Snowflake, Python, SQL, ETL/ELT frameworks, and industrial connectivity technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, or similar platforms is preferred. * Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders and collaborate across operations, IT, digitalization, and external partners. * Candidates must be willing to relocate to Charlotte, NC, if they are not already based in the area. * Legal authorization to work in the United States without the need for current or future employer\-sponsored work authorization. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: Siteimprove is the leader in agentic content intelligence. Our platform brings accessibility, analytics, SEO/AEO, and content strategy together in one system, where AI agents work alongside marketing and digital teams to produce content that is accessible and easy to find. Every customer, user, and increasingly every AI agent that touches the Siteimprove platform goes through systems owned by the Access team: sign\-in, single sign\-on, federation with customer identity providers, and the authorization layer that decides who can see and do what. We're looking for a Software Engineer with real depth in authentication, authorization, and identity provider (IdP) systems. You'll design and build the services that secure the Siteimprove platform, work with enterprise and public\-sector customers' SSO setups, help us meet FedRAMP requirements, and shape how AI agents and machine clients authenticate against our APIs and MCP servers. This is a hands\-on role with a lot of technical ownership. You'll be one of the people others on the team, and across engineering, come to with identity questions. ### **What we will be doing** * **SSO and federation:** Build and run our login, session, MFA, and token services. Own SAML and OIDC integrations with customer IdPs (Okta, Entra ID, Ping, ADFS), from metadata and certificate rotation to enterprise edge cases. * **Provisioning:** Own the user lifecycle across SCIM, JIT provisioning, and deprovisioning. * **Authorization platform:** Evolve our centralized permissions and authorization services, including the models (RBAC, ABAC, ReBAC), APIs, and caching, so product teams get fast, consistent access decisions. * **Agent identity:** Define how AI agents, MCP servers, and integrations authenticate and get delegated, least\-privilege access through OAuth 2\.x (token exchange, scoped short\-lived tokens), with consent and auditability built in. * **Security and compliance:** Design against account takeover and token abuse. Implement FedRAMP identity controls (FAL2, signed and encrypted assertions, FIPS\-validated cryptography), and work with Security and GRC on audit evidence and addressing vulnerabilities. * **Reliability:** Raise the bar for reliability and observability on services where an outage means nobody can log in. * **Technical leadership:** Lead design reviews and build\-vs\-buy decisions, mentor engineers, and be the go\-to identity expert across engineering. * Travel may be required; a valid passport is required * Perform other duties as assigned ### **What we will require of you** * **Engineering depth:** 6\+ years of professional software engineering, with at least 3 years building or running authentication, authorization, or identity systems in production. * **Backend stack:** Strong backend skills in C\#/.NET or Java, and a willingness to work in whichever one a given service uses. * **Protocol expertise:** Deep, practical knowledge of OAuth 2\.0/2\.1, OpenID Connect, and SAML 2\.0: grant types, token formats JWT, PKCE, token lifetimes and revocation, and assertion signing and encryption. * **IdP experience:** Hands\-on experience with at least one IdP, whether in\-house, open source (such as Keycloak), or commercial (such as FusionAuth, Auth0, Okta, Entra ID, or Cognito), including integrating customer IdPs for enterprise SSO. * **Authorization design:** Experience designing authorization models and permission services that stay correct and fast at scale. * **Security mindset:** A solid grasp of identity threats (token theft and replay, session fixation, CSRF, open redirects, IdP\-initiated SSO risks) and how to design against them. * **Cloud\-native systems:** Experience building distributed services on AWS or Azure, including containers, CI/CD, and production observability. * **AI\-native delivery:** You use AI tools every day to understand code, generate tests, and ship faster. * **Clear communication:** You can explain a tricky identity trade\-off to engineers, product managers, and auditors. ### **What we will love about you** * Experience with FedRAMP, or other government compliance programs, and with NIST SP 800\-63 identity and federation assurance levels. * Experience with FIPS 140\-validated crypto modules, HSM or KMS\-backed key management, and certificate lifecycle automation. * Experience with policy engines or fine\-grained authorization systems such as OPA, Cedar, OpenFGA, or other Zanzibar\-style systems. * Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) authorization spec, OAuth token exchange, or workload identity (CIMD, IAM roles for service accounts). * Experience with SCIM 2\.0\. * Experience leading a migration between identity platforms without disrupting customers. ### **What you'll love about us** We’re building the next generation of AI\-powered content intelligence, helping organizations unify accessibility, SEO/AEO, analytics, and content performance into one platform. If you’re energized by solving complex problems, working cross\-functionally, and contributing to a product with real\-world impact, we’d love to connect.### **In addition, we hope you will appreciate:** At Siteimprove, we're committed to supporting your wellbeing both at work and beyond. Our Denmark benefits are designed to help you thrive personally and professionally. **Rest and relaxation:** Generous time off including Danish holiday entitlements, five additional FF Days, child sick leave, and bereavement leave. **Comprehensive benefits**: Health insurance, company\-paid mobile phone support, and internet allowance to support your day\-to\-day needs. **Prepare for the future**: Danica pension with employer contributions to help support your retirement goals. The base salary for this role will fall within the posted range and is determined by experience, qualifications, and location.**Siteimprove is an equal opportunity employer** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or other legally protected status. Siteimprove is a global corporation that has developed data practices to ensure your personally identifiable information is appropriately protected. Please note that personal information may be transferred, accessed, and stored globally as necessary for the uses and disclosures stated in accordance with our Privacy Policy at https://siteimprove.com/en/privacy/. **FedRAMP Authorization Notice for Job Postings** This position may involve access to systems, information, or customer environments that are subject to the Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP). jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: Skillable is a 100% remote and virtual tech company that’s modernizing the world of training. Come share your professional magic with highly talented, driven and fun colleagues who believe in the power of “skilling.” Experience what a team focused on doing the right thing feels like! Our talented people are what makes us friendly and have fun! We work together to create amazing solutions and experiences for our customers and their clients. We utilize our employees’ personal strengths to help grow our company and ensure our team is living their best, authentic life. We share our appreciation for our team members regularly during all\-hands, a workplace appreciation tool, regular shoutouts in our Teams channels, social media, amongst more. Our remote\-first work environment blends work and life without the added pressure of commuting or feeling guilty about leaving early to visit the dentist. Come work with us and learn what teamwork and integrity blended with an emphasis on well\-being and balance can do for your career and lifestyle! We're an AI\-first engineering team, and we treat that as a discipline, not a shortcut. Every engineer here works with agentic coding tools — Claude Code and GitHub CoPilot are key drivers in our daily work, which changes the shape of the job: * You'll spend more of your time on design, decomposition and review, and less on typing. Agents handle much of the implementation; you own the architecture, the verification and everything that ships. * We invest in the system that makes AI effective: project context, custom agents and skills, MCP integrations and multi\-agent code review. Improving that system is engineering work here, and it's part of the role. * Judgment matters more, not less. Knowing when to hand work to an agent — and when not to — is a skill we hire for and grow. * Skillable's whole business is proving skills by doing. jobs.description: Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Our team builds and owns the machine learning infrastructure that powers personalized experiences across Snap. As a centralized ML platform team, we enable teams across the company to deploy, optimize, and serve sophisticated machine learning models reliably and efficiently at scale. We own the end\-to\-end inference stack for recommendation models, embedding\-generation models, and self\-hosted large language models. Our platform supports nearly every major organization at Snap, including Ads, Content, Growth, Lenses, Security, and My AI. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Streamlit
jobs.description: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. **Build the foundation for faster, safer innovation.** Snowflake’s AI Data Cloud supports critical enterprise workloads across multiple clouds and regions. As AI accelerates software development, the volume and pace of change are outgrowing what engineers can manually review, coordinate, and monitor. Moving faster requires systems that make safe delivery and trustworthy experimentation an integral part of how engineering works. The Parameters \& Experimentation team builds the configuration, feature\-flagging, and experimentation infrastructure that enables Snowflake engineers to introduce capabilities, control exposure, and measure outcomes. We’re looking for a hands\-on Principal Software Engineer I to help build its next generation, combining deep distributed\-systems engineering with an AI\-first approach to developer productivity and operational intelligence. You will shape technical direction, solve challenging systems problems, and lead initiatives across engineering teams. The opportunity is to build the next\-generation platform so that increasing development velocity translates into faster customer value without relying on ever\-increasing manual oversight. **AS A PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:** ----------------------------------------------------------- * **Architect and build distributed infrastructure.** Design scalable configuration and feature\-flag services with low\-latency evaluation, clear consistency guarantees, fault isolation, and predictable behavior during failures. * **Make a safety scale with change velocity.** Build automated validation, targeted exposure, progressive rollouts, health\-based guardrails, and dependable rollback. Reduce manual coordination while making changes observable, auditable, and recoverable. * **Advance experimentation.** Partner with engineering and data science teams to build reliable assignment, exposure tracking, and measurement infrastructure that helps teams evaluate changes and make evidence\-based decisions. * **Build and work AI\-first.** Make AI integral to how you design, implement, test, and operate software. Embed AI\-powered capabilities into the platform for configuration discovery, risk assessment, rollout planning, and impact analysis. Establish rigorous evaluation, security, and reliability standards for these capabilities, and drive adoption of AI\-first practices across the team. * **Lead from architecture through adoption.** Translate ambiguous needs into practical designs and milestones. Deliver intuitive APIs, libraries, and self\-service tools; guide incremental migrations and simplify the full lifecycle from flag creation to retirement. * **Raise the engineering bar.** Write and review production code, diagnose complex failures, own operational outcomes, and mentor engineers. Influence across teams through technical depth, clear communication, and sound judgment. **OUR IDEAL PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:** ---------------------------------------------------- * 12\+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership of complex backend or infrastructure initiatives spanning multiple teams. * Deep experience designing, building, and operating large\-scale distributed systems, with strong understanding of concurrency, consistency, caching, failure recovery, and performance. * Strong computer science fundamentals and hands\-on proficiency in Java, Go, C\+\+, or a comparable backend language, plus experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. * An AI\-first engineering practice: you actively use AI throughout the software lifecycle and can demonstrate how it improves your execution, problem\-solving, and quality. You are ready to build AI\-powered platform capabilities and help others adopt this approach. * A track record of turning ambiguous problems into delivered systems, balancing architectural investments with incremental progress, and driving adoption across engineering organizations. * Clear written communication, low\-ego collaboration, strong ownership, and experience mentoring senior engineers. * A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Especially relevant:** Experience with feature\-flag or configuration platforms, distributed control planes, progressive delivery, experimentation infrastructure, or AI\-powered developer tools. **Help build the systems that let engineers innovate faster than manual processes can support, with the evidence and safeguards that critical workloads demand.** Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role: * The estimated base salary range for this role is $264,000 \- $379,500\. * Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s bonus and equity plan. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending \& health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits. To comply with pay transparency requirements and other statutes, you can notify us if you believe that a job posting is not compliant by completing this form.

jobs.title: Sr Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Join a multibillion\-dollar global company that brings together amazing technology, people, and operational scale to become a powerhouse in the memory industry. Headquartered in Rancho Cordova, California, Solidigm combines elements of an established, successful technology company with the spirit, agility, and entrepreneurial mindset of a start\-up. In addition to the U.S. headquarters and other facilities in the U.S., the company has international presence in Asia, Europe, and the Americas. Solidigm will continue to lead the world in innovating new Memory technologies with aspirations to be the \#1 NAND memory company in the world. At Solidigm, we view problems as opportunities to define innovative solutions that hold the power to change the world and unleash the potential technological needs that the future holds. At Solidigm, we are One Team that fosters a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture that embraces individual uniqueness and empowers us to bring our best selves to deliver excellence in support of Solidigm's vision and mission to be the go\-to partner for optimized data storage solutions. You can be part of the takeoff of an innovative business that develops cutting\-edge products, delivers strong business value for customers, provides an engaging workplace for its employees, and serves a greater impact on the world. This is a golden opportunity for the right applicant to join us and help design, build, and lead Solidigm. We want a diverse team of dedicated professionals who will not just be Solidigm team members but contribute to how we shape the future of the organization. We are seeking applicants who will grow and thrive in our culture; be customer inspired, trusting, innovative, team\-oriented, inclusive, results driven, collaborative, passionate, and flexible. **Job Description** Come join our Data Center Engineering Team and work on one of the most advanced 3D\-NAND and SSD technology portfolios in the world. As the global leader in the semiconductor industry, Solidigm possesses many industry\-leading SSD technologies including the most capable Quadruple Level Cell (QLC) NAND Flash products. In this position you will join a fast\-paced team developing new, cutting\-edge firmware for Solidigm Solid State Drives (SSD). You will utilize and grow your experience in embedded architecture, external interfaces, and product constraints, along with the ability to develop architectures/features that meet these constraints while providing new value for the platform. You will use and gain experience in storage interface standards such as NVMe, PCIe, SATA, and SAS. The team utilizes Agile development methodologies, therefore, excellent communication skills and the ability to work closely with team members, both locally and across the organization is required. As a **Firmware Engineer** your regular responsibilities include but are not limited to: * Develop, review, document, and maintain product source code in C/C\+\+ * Analyze and develop firmware per internal and external (customer) specifications * Perform unit and system level testing including failure analysis and debug of product issues as part of development and validation phases * Develop low\-level firmware, system architectures, operating systems, device architectures, in partnership with hardware and ASIC design teams * Cross multiple firmware disciplines to develop and grow across the entire SSD architecture * Work with project stakeholders turning product requirements into development and validation plans * Participating in and role modeling an Agile/Kanban development culture which emphasizes product quality, team accountability, and continuous improvement * Coordinate priorities and activities with other engineering stakeholders to accomplish committed milestones A successful candidate will demonstrate: * The ability to listen, understand and respond professionally to partner questions and issues while building trust * Excellent written and presentation skills * A history of self\-starting and effective multitasking, with strong influence and leadership skills * A history of working in teams and/or feature development through the different stages of a product lifecycle. **Qualifications** Candidates must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Requirements listed below would be obtained through a combination of schoolwork/classes/research and/or relevant previous job and/or internship experiences. ***Minimum Requirements:*** The candidate must have a bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or Computer Science or a related field 7\+ years of experience in the following areas: * Software or firmware development experience in an embedded systems environment with programming in C/C\+\+ * Embedded firmware development running in a real\-time operating system (RTOS), with hardware and software interactions * Firmware development environments including compilers, debuggers, emulators, and toolchains ***Preferred Requirements:*** * Storage industry (SSDs or enterprise storage) * Embedded development techniques using hardware and firmware tools * Structured software development and practices, analytical problem solving, innovation and a mindset of continuous improvement * Enterprise storage interface protocols (e.g., SATA, SAS, PCIe, and NVMe) * SSD or enterprise storage device security protocols and techniques (e.g., Opal, ESSC, and AES) * Software/firmware development processes including workflow and continuous integration validation * DevOps process strategies, tools and execution, from code check\-in through Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery * Project planning, estimation, and risk management * Customer requirements definition, clarification, and technical assessment * Development of unit tests for code coverage and quality validation **Additional Information** This position is also eligible to participate in Solidigm's restricted stock unit (RSU), restricted cash unit (RCU), and cash bonus programs. In addition, Solidigm offers a benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, supplemental life and AD\&D insurance; short\- and long\-term disability; healthcare and dependent care flexible spending accounts, and a company match on eligible 401(k) plan contributions. The compensation range for this role is $128,960 \- $201,500\. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location. *Powered by SmartRecruiters \-* *Candidate Privacy Policy*

jobs.title: Security Engineer - GRC Sales
jobs.description: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. ### **ABOUT THE ROLE:** We are seeking a mid\-to\-senior Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) professional focused on third\-party risk management and customer trust. This role sits at the intersection of cybersecurity GRC, vendor management, and sales enablement: you will act as a security\-minded presales engineer for the sales team, develop enough depth in the SpaceXSI technical environment to accurately complete customer vendor security questionnaires, join customer meetings as the security and compliance subject matter expert, and help operate third\-party risk and vendor management processes. The ideal candidate brings a cybersecurity and GRC perspective — fluent in how AI LLMs, CI/CD pipelines, identity and access management, DevOps, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and IT/AI governance actually work in production — and can translate that understanding into clear, credible answers for enterprise buyers without slowing deals or overstating our posture. *This role may also include additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to support the team and evolving business priorities.* ### **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Support the sales organization as a cybersecurity/GRC presales partner: attend customer and prospect meetings, present our security and compliance posture, and answer technical and control\-related questions with accuracy and judgment. * Own and continuously improve responses to customer vendor security questionnaires, RFPs, SIG/CAIQ\-style assessments, and due\-diligence requests; maintain a reusable knowledge base of control narratives grounded in how SpaceXSI actually operates. * Build and maintain working fluency across the SpaceXSI environment — AI/LLM systems and model governance, CI/CD pipelines, identity and access management, DevOps and DevSecOps practices, Kubernetes platforms, and governance of IT and AI environments — sufficient to answer customer questions and escalate appropriately to engineering when needed. * Partner with Engineering, Security, Legal, and Product to keep questionnaire content, Trust Center materials, and security collateral current as architecture, controls, and certifications evolve. * Translate customer security requirements into actionable internal asks; help distinguish must\-have contractual or control commitments from unreasonable or out\-of\-scope demands. * Contribute to policies, standards, and procedures related to third\-party risk, customer assurance, and vendor security due diligence. * Coordinate with the broader GRC and security teams on overlapping frameworks and evidence (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, privacy commitments) so external answers remain consistent with our internal control environment and GRC tooling (e.g., Vanta). * Identify patterns in customer questionnaires and deal blockers; feed those insights back into product, engineering, and GRC roadmaps to reduce friction over time. * Create and present concise status updates on questionnaire volume, deal\-impacting security asks, vendor risk posture, and emerging customer assurance themes to sales leadership and GRC stakeholders. * Champion clear, honest customer communication — building trust by explaining what we do, how we govern AI and infrastructure, and where we are intentionally scoping risk. ### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Security, Cybersecurity, or in an engineering/STEM field. * 5\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, GRC, third\-party risk management, security assurance, or a closely related role with customer\-facing or sales\-adjacent responsibilities. * Demonstrated experience completing or owning customer vendor security questionnaires and participating in security due\-diligence discussions with enterprise buyers. * Working technical fluency across several of the following: AI/LLM or ML platforms, CI/CD pipelines, identity and access management, DevOps/DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — enough to understand control implications and speak credibly with engineers and customers. * Solid understanding of common security and compliance frameworks used in customer assurance (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF) and how controls map to questionnaire language. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain cybersecurity and GRC concepts to sales, customers, legal, and engineering audiences. ### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * 7\+ years of cybersecurity, GRC, third\-party risk, or customer trust / security assurance experience (mid\-to\-senior scope). * Prior experience in a presales security, solutions engineering (security), customer trust, or sales\-enablement GRC role at a technology, cloud, or AI company. * Hands\-on or deeply adjacent experience with vendor risk management programs — onboarding assessments, continuous monitoring, contract security exhibits, and residual\-risk reporting. * Familiarity with AI governance topics relevant to customer diligence (e.g., model data handling, prompt/output controls, training\-data boundaries, ISO 42001 / NIST AI RMF concepts, EU AI Act awareness). * Experience maintaining a Trust Center, security FAQ library, or questionnaire knowledge base; familiarity with GRC platforms such as Vanta, Drata, or similar is a plus. * Ability to read architecture diagrams, IAM models, and pipeline/Kubernetes high\-level designs and turn them into accurate, non\-jargon customer narratives. * Comfort operating in fast\-moving deal cycles while protecting accuracy — knowing when to say "I'll confirm with engineering" versus answering from established evidence. * Working knowledge of data privacy frameworks (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) as they appear in enterprise security and vendor assessments. * Certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, CRISC, CTPRP, CIPT, CIPP/US, or similar preferred. * Experience supporting public sector, financial services, or other highly regulated customer diligence processes is a plus. ### **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:** $100,000 \- $258,000 USD Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short \& long\-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks. *SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

jobs.title: Security Engineer, Kubernetes
jobs.description: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. ### **ABOUT THE ROLE:** We protect the platform that runs X and SpaceXSI. We don't just report issues, we actively look for real risks and exploits in our Kubernetes environments and turn them into durable fixes and tooling. You will secure the platform behind X and SpaceXSI's infrastructure, products, and workloads. If you know pod and platform security, think in attack paths, and want to build the defenses that make the platform safer at scale, we want to hear from you. **We Value** * Understanding how Kubernetes can actually be abused, not only how it is configured * Shipping practical controls and tooling over writing policy documents * Least privilege and defense\-in\-depth at fleet scale * Clear findings and fixes that platform teams can act on * Safe, constrained validation that does not put production at risk ### **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Secure the platform end to end: nodes, clusters, pods, roles, tokens, secrets, service\-to\-service communication, and the supply chain * Find and remediate overprivileged permissions, dangerous pod and workload settings, and escalation paths in operators, admission, networking, identity, and monitoring * Assess our own platform the way an adversary would, including container and pod breakout, privilege escalation, and movement across workloads, using safe and constrained validation, then fix what you find * Design and build security tooling and automation, including AI\-assisted analysis, that catches risky configuration and overprivilege before or after it ships * Strengthen identity and secrets handling so workloads receive only the access they need * Improve supply\-chain security through secure base images, continuous scanning, and related controls * Review changes that affect RBAC, operators, ServiceAccounts, network policies, and anything running with elevated privileges * Partner with platform and product teams as a security owner, taking problems from identification through rollout * Contribute to fleet\-wide hardening, policy enforcement, and safer defaults ### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:** * 3\+ years in platform security, Kubernetes security, or offensive security against production infrastructure * Deep knowledge of pod and workload security: privileged containers, capabilities, host namespaces, host path mounts, service accounts, RBAC, admission control, and network isolation * Working knowledge of identity, secrets, workload identity, service\-to\-service trust, supply chain, runtime, and cloud access * Able to think like an attacker, measure blast radius, and turn the path into a detection, control, or tool * Comfortable with operators, custom resources, Helm, and GitOps workflows * Able to build or modify security tooling in Go, Python, or Rust when a control needs automation * Bonus: Image scanning, SBOMs, secure base images, policy\-as\-code (Kyverno, OPA), multi\-cluster environments, runtime detection, and security testing of customer\-facing application * Open to working out of one of our offices: Palo Alto, Austin, DC, or New York. ### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * Experience developing AI\-driven security tools or integrating AI into security workflows * Familiarity with Kubernetes\-based environments and securing cloud\-native infrastructure * Proven ability to drive technical decisions and influence security practices across teams * A passion for challenging the status quo and building transformative security solutions * Strong collaboration skills, with experience working in dynamic, cross\-functional teams * A sense of humor and adaptability to thrive in a fast\-paced, mission\-driven environment ### **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:** $100,000 \- $258,000 USD Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short \& long\-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks. *SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

recognize and escalate security or privacy events. * Assist with projects, implementations, migrations, clinic openings, go\-lives, planned maintenance, vendor coordination, disaster recovery, and business continuity activities. * Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve service, controls, standardization, and automation. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:** ------------------------------------- * Strong troubleshooting skills across endpoints, identity, Microsoft 365, connectivity, applications, and user workflows. * Working knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune concepts, MFA, role\-based access, networking, and secure remote support. * Ability to use logs and diagnostic tools, document findings, and distinguish symptoms from probable root causes. * Foundational knowledge of Azure, cloud operations, monitoring, backup, scripting, automation, APIs, JSON, and cybersecurity principles. * Understanding of HIPAA\-aligned PHI handling, least privilege, secure sharing, auditability, and healthcare downtime procedures. * Clear communication, sound prioritization, accountability, teamwork, and willingness to learn. **REQUIRED EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION AND/OR TRAINING:** --------------------------------------------------- * High school diploma or equivalent required; Success in this role is defined by four outcomes: (1\) a funded, governed, and executing plan to exit the mainframe and retire COBOL\-dependent applications on a public timeline; (2\) a production\-ready AI and advanced analytics program that improves operations and decision\-making under a clear risk and privacy framework; (3\) measurable improvement in reliability, security, and service to program offices and local education agencies; and (4\) a rebuilt technology organization that can attract and keep modern engineering, data, and product talent. The Florida Department of Education (FDOE) is seeking a transformation\-minded Chief Information Officer to serve as the agency’s senior technology executive and statutory agency CIO under section 282\.3055, Florida Statutes. This is not a caretaker role. The next CIO will retire a remaining mainframe and COBOL/DB2 estate that still underpins core statewide education operations, stand up a durable cloud and data platform, and scale artificial intelligence in a way that is useful to districts, colleges, and the Department—without compromising student privacy, cybersecurity, or public trust. A completed feasibility study frames enterprise mainframe modernization as a multi\-year program—three phases over six years, with an estimated total cost of approximately $151 million—covering student data collection, education finance calculations, financial reporting, transcript exchange, assessment reporting, school identification, and capital outlay. Year\-one work includes a program management office, COBOL and DB2 inventory and business\-rule extraction, knowledge transfer from a shrinking specialist workforce, and cloud foundation work consistent with Florida’s cloud\-first policy and Chapter 60GG cybersecurity rules. The CIO will own that program end to end and will be judged on whether the mainframe actually goes away. **DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:** (Note: The omission of specific job duties does not preclude management from assigning specific duties not listed herein if such duties are a logical assignment to the position.) The Florida Department of Education (FDOE) has an open position that is responsible for executing the following functions: **1\.** **Enterprise modernization and mainframe exit** * Own the enterprise mainframe modernization program as a single accountable executive—scope, sequence, budget, vendors, risk, and legislative reporting. * Complete and maintain a full inventory of COBOL, CICS, DB2, batch, and interface assets; extract business rules; map data and process dependencies; and publish a system\-by\-system retire, rewrite, replace, or encapsulate decision. * Stand up a Program Management Office with independent verification and validation, stage\-gate funding, and monthly executive dashboards that a non\-technical cabinet and legislative staff can read. * Move remaining workloads off the mainframe to cloud\-native or commercially supported platforms consistent with s. 282\.206, F.S. (cloud\-first), Northwest Regional Data Center and enterprise hosting policy, and Chapter 60GG\-2, F.A.C. * Protect continuity of FEFP funding calculations, survey/data collections, transcripts, assessments, MSID, PECO, and related mission systems during cutover. No “big bang” that puts a school year at risk. * Capture institutional knowledge from retiring mainframe specialists before it walks out the door; convert it into documented product and data contracts. **2\. Scale artificial intelligence—responsibly and in production** * Publish and execute an agency AI strategy covering use\-case intake, model risk, human\-in\-the\-loop rules, procurement, evaluation, and retirement of tools that do not perform. * Prioritize high\-value, low\-regret uses first: document intelligence, code and test generation for modernization, service\-desk deflection, data\-quality assistance, legislative and policy research support, and internal knowledge retrieval. Expand to instructional e schedule of 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday. Telework is not available for this role. **APPLICANT INFORMATION \& HIRING REQUIREMENTS** Application Information: * Your Candidate Profile (application) must be complete in its entirety. * Work History (in easy to review chronological order) Consists of: + Any position held by a State of Florida agency + Any position held by a Florida University + All periods of employment from high school graduation + All periods of current or prior unemployment + Gaps 3 months of more must be accounted for\* + Any Education + Any Volunteer Experience + Your resume and application must match * + **Gaps 3 months of more must be addressed** – you will need to account for and explain any gaps in employment including unemployment. You can either list these in your application under Period of Employment or attach a word document listing your gaps. * It is unacceptable to use the statement “See Resume” in place of entering work history. Your candidate profile will be converted to your official application. * Include your supervisor names and phone numbers for reference checks or the contract information for your Human Resources office to verify current or former employment. * Experience, education, training, knowledge, skills and/or abilities as well as responses to pre\-qualifying questions must be verifiable to meet the minimum qualifications. Hiring Information and Requirements: * The Bureau of Personnel Management reviews every application for prior State of Florida and Florida University work history in the People First system. * If claiming Veteran’s Preference, the candidate **MUST** attach supporting documentation such as the DD214 and your VA Letter that reflects level of disability if applicable. Applicable to career service positions only. * If claiming Right to First Interview, the candidate **MUST** attach a copy of your official layoff letter when applying. This only applies to employees laid off from Career Service positions. Applicable to career service positions only. **Equal Opportunity** The State of Florida is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not tolerate discrimination or violence in the workplace. Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation, as defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act, must notify the agency hiring authority in advance. The State of Florida supports a Drug\-Free workplace. All employees are subject to reasonable suspicion drug testing in accordance with section 112\.0455, F.S. Successful applicants will be screened in accordance with Chapter 435, F.S., as applicable. If you are missing any of the items above, your packet may be held up at the final review step. NOTE: *Responses to qualifying questions must be clearly supported by the state application and any omission, falsification, or misrepresentation in the answering of the qualifying questions will be cause for immediate elimination from the selection process.* **If you experience problems applying online, please call the People First Service Center at (877\) 562\-7287** Candidates requiring a reasonable accommodation, as defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act, must notify the agency hiring authority and/or People First Service Center (1\-866\-663\-4735\).
