jobs.title: Senior Programmer Analyst - MaineDOT Data Warehousing Team
jobs.description: ***If you are a current State of Maine employee, please submit your application through the internal application process using the Find Jobs report in PRISM. Seasonal employees who do not have PRISM access should apply through the State’s career page and indicate on the application that they have previously worked for the State.*** --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *.* **Office of Information Technology** **Opening Date:** October 20, 2026 **Closing Date:** November 3, 2026 **Grade / Admin Unit:** 27 / Professional/Technical **Job Class Code:** 0866 **Salary:** $75,234\.74 \- $105,714\.46\*/Annually (\*includes a 23\.66% recruitment and retention stipend, and eligible for a 5% training bonus) **Position Number:** 200024881 **Location:** Augusta **Hybrid Work Location:** This position is a hybrid telework/onsite position. The onsite location is in Augusta, Maine. All work, including telework, must be completed within the borders of the State of Maine. ***Currently, this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship or STEM OPT extensions.*** You are a talented senior\-level IT professional who is driven toward success. You enjoy exploring data, designing and implementing complex data structures and processes, and transforming data into knowledge. You can work independently but can also work collaboratively as part of a larger unit on multifaceted initiatives. If this describes you, we want you on our TEAM!! **OVERVIEW:** The Department of Administrative and Financial Services (DAFS) Office of Information Technology (MaineIT) provides information technology support to over 13,000 employees. MaineIT oversees large scale enterprise applications that support the critical and diverse business needs of the State of Maine and its agencies. MaineIT is seeking a highly talented individual who will represent our **C.A.R.E.** values in all that they do. At MaineIT we: * Practice **Customer\-focus** , ensuring that our customers are heard, and their needs are met. * Hold ourselves to a high level of **Accountability** by being transparent with our stakeholders. * Maintain an effective level of **Responsiveness** by providing timely updates in a proactive manner. * Strive to provide **Empathy** driven, people\-focused services by applying emotional intelligence skills and behaviors. **JOB DESCRIPTION:** The Maine Office of Information Technology (OIT) is seeking a Senior Programmer Analyst to support the Maine Department of Transportation (MaineDOT) Database and Data Warehousing Team. This position is responsible for the analysis, design, development, configuration, implementation, and maintenance of enterprise databases and data analytics systems, including MaineDOT’s Data Marts and centralized Data Warehouse. Potential candidates should be confident in their database and data warehousing skillsets, as a large portion of assignments will require these skillsets. Database design, implementation, and support responsibilities might also extend to work for our application development and geospatial teams as needed. **WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU?** * The MaineDOT strives to support economic opportunity and quality of life by responsibly providing their customers the safest and most reliable transportation system possible, given available resources. We can feel good about helping to support them in that mission. * You will be developing data solutions that inform business decisions being made at the very highest levels of MaineDOT management. * There will be opportunities to help shape the future direction of the DB/DW team as we look towards modernizing existing processes and blaze paths towards newly emerging data domains. * You could add your individual style to our evolving team culture. Collaboration is key. Fresh ideas and perspectives are most welcome. * Do you like being surrounded by smart people? Then our division is a good place to find yourself. You will be interacting with lots of talented IT professionals and lots of very experienced business partners daily. This includes many MaineDOT engineers and specialists who are subject matter experts in the areas in which they serve. * There will be endless opportunities to ask questions, learn, share, and teach. * You will help us define what our new cloud\-based reality looks like as we continue to migrate more\-and\-more databases, applications, and services to the cloud. * There will be many of opportunities to discuss what the “future of AI” means to us, and how we can best leverage all its potential. * Things tend to evolve quickly within our team and within our division. This helps to keep boredom at bay and provides tremendous opportunities for those who like to contribute t is essential. Take time for yourself using **13 paid holidays, 12 days of sick leave,** and **3\+ weeks of vacation leave** annually. Vacation leave accrual increases with years of service, and overtime\-exempt employees receive personal leave. * **Health Insurance Coverage** – The State of Maine pays **85%\-100%** of employee\-only premiums ($11,857\.68\-$13,950\.24 annual value), depending on salary. Use this chart to find the premium costs for you and your family, including the percentage of dependent coverage paid by the State. * **Health Insurance Premium Credit** – Participation decreases employee\-only premiums by 5%. Visit the Office of Employee Health and Wellness for more information about program requirements . * **Dental Insurance** – The State of Maine pays 100% of employee\-only dental premiums ($365\.28 annual value). * **Retirement Plan** – The State of Maine contributes 14\.06% of pay to the Maine Public Employees Retirement System (MainePERS), on behalf of the employee. * **Gym Membership Reimbursement** – Improve overall health with regular exercise and receive up to $40 per month to offset this expense. * **Health and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts** – Set aside money pre\-tax to help pay for out\-of\-pocket health care expenses and/or daycare expenses. * **Public Service Student Loan Forgiveness** – The State of Maine is a qualified employer for this federal program. For more information, visit the Federal Student Aid office . * **Living Resources Program** – Navigate challenging work and life situations with our employee assistance program. * **Parental leave** is one of the most important benefits for any working parent. All employees who are welcoming a child—including fathers and adoptive parents—receive **forty\-two (42\) consecutive calendar days of fully paid parental leave** . Additional, unpaid leave may also be available, under the Family and Medical Leave Act . * **Voluntary Deferred Compensation** – Save additional pre\-tax funds for retirement in a MaineSaves 457(b) account through payroll deductions. State employees are eligible for an extensive and highly competitive benefits package , covering many aspects of wellness. Learn about **additional wellness benefits** for State employees from the Office of Employee Health and Wellness . Note: Benefits may vary somewhat according to specific collective bargaining agreements and are prorated for anything less than full\-time. *There's a job and then there's purposeful, transformative work. Our aim is to create a workplace where you can learn, grow, and continuously refine your skills. Applicants demonstrate job requirements in differing ways, and we appreciate that many skills and backgrounds can make people successful in this role.* *As an Equal Opportunity employer, Maine State Government embraces a culture of respect and awareness. We are committed to creating a strong sense of belonging for all team members, and our process ensures an inclusive environment to applicants of all backgrounds including diverse race, color, sex, sexual orientation or gender identity, physical or mental disability, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, familial status or genetics.* *If you’re looking for a great next step, and want to feel good about what you do, we’d love to hear from you. Please note reasonable accommodations are provided to qualified individuals with disabilities upon request.* **Thinking about applying?** Research shows that people from historically excluded communities tend to apply to jobs only when they check every box in the posting. If you’re currently reading this and hesitating to apply for that reason, we encourage you to go for it! Let us know how your experience and passion set you apart. . **If you are unable to complete the online application, please contact the Human Resources representative listed on the job opening you are interested in applying for. They will work with you for an alternative method of submitting.**

jobs.title: Software Engineer II – Enterprise Application Development
jobs.description: We are looking for a Software Engineer II to join our Enterprise Application Development team and help build the software that runs our retail convenience store business. Our team designs, develops, maintains, and supports applications in\-house, giving engineers the chance to work directly with the business and see the impact of what they build. We work across a broad range of applications, systems, and business processes, so there's always something new to learn. This is a mid\-level role for someone with professional experience and technical confidence who can contribute independently, bring fresh perspective to the team, and keep growing their technical and business knowledge. What You'll Do: * Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and support enterprise applications. * Analyze complex technical and business problems and develop effective solutions. * Work with business analysts, stakeholders, and technical team members to understand requirements and business processes. * Contribute to technical designs and application architecture. * Develop and support RESTful APIs, backend services, and system integrations. * Participate in peer code reviews and collaborative development practices. * Troubleshoot production issues, identify root causes, and implement lasting solutions. * Improve application performance, reliability, maintainability, and security. * Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve applications and business processes. * Stay current with emerging technologies and contribute ideas that improve how we build and support software. What Sets You Apart: * A self\-starter who takes ownership and moves work forward without constant direction. * Naturally curious about how systems, technology, and the business behind them work. * An engaged contributor who brings ideas, asks questions, and looks for better ways to solve problems. * Comfortable working through unfamiliar problems and picking up new technologies. * Able to respectfully challenge existing approaches and contribute to technical decisions. * A strong communicator who works effectively with both technical and non\-technical people. * Takes pride in building quality software and improving the systems and processes around it. Required Qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent education and experience. * 3–5 years of professional software development experience. * Strong understanding of software development fundamentals and strongly typed programming languages such as C\#, Java, Kotlin, or similar. * Proficiency with SQL and relational databases. * Professional experience developing or consuming RESTful APIs. * Proficiency working with Linux\-based containers and containerized applications. * Solid understanding of container orchestration concepts. * Experience with source control, code reviews, testing, debugging, and modern software development practices. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications: * C\# / .NET * Spring Boot * Kotlin * SQL Server * PostgreSQL * Docker * Linux / Ubuntu * Azure DevOps and Azure Pipelines * CI/CD practices * Microservices architecture * Automated testing * AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, or similar Our Technology Our development environment includes: .NET \| Spring Boot \| Kotlin \| SQL Server \| PostgreSQL \| RESTful APIs \| Docker \| Azure DevOps \| Azure Pipelines \| Git \| Linux/Ubuntu You won't need experience with every technology listed. We value strong engineering fundamentals, adaptability, and the ability to learn. Our containerized environment is continuing to evolve, with container orchestration part of our longer\-term technology roadmap. Benefits: * Starting Pay: $85,000 \- $100,000/year salary. * 100% company paid retirement\- Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). * Health, Vision \& Dental benefit package. * YMCA discount program. * Monday \- Friday (in office). As you grow into the role, you'll take on rotating after\-hours on\-call support. Why Join Us? You'll work on software that matters to the business, alongside a team that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. You'll work across a diverse technology landscape, learn how a complex retail organization operates, and help shape the future of our applications. If you're curious, engaged, and want to build more than just software, we'd like to meet you. To help provide our employees with a safe work environment, we are a drug free workplace.

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **About You** ------------- We’re seeking a senior technical leader whose background combines substantial AI/ML research expertise with hands\-on engineering experience. You’ll help shape the architecture and technical direction of our intelligent systems. The remit extends beyond implementation as an individual contributor: you’ll uncover unanswered questions, develop experiments to investigate them, and take ownership of AI development from initial research through production. Your experience should combine research depth, typically gained through a PhD or equivalent industry research, with substantial work making AI systems dependable on complex, real\-world production data. You’ve created evaluation frameworks, investigated LLM failure modes, and learned to distinguish impressive benchmark results from meaningful evidence of reliability. You bring informed perspectives on measuring AI performance and deploying systems safely in environments where the consequences matter. AI is central to both our products and our working practices. Across research, engineering, and operations, we make extensive use of AI tools to accelerate execution and support clearer thinking. Everyone is expected to adopt this approach. At a senior level, that means demonstrating how AI can amplify informed judgment without replacing it. Healthcare offers both extensive data and significant responsibility. We’re looking for someone who understands the importance of both. **Your Responsibilities** ------------------------- ### **AI Strategy \& Research** * Own the technical strategy for AI/ML across our clinical intelligence products, covering information extraction, summarization, reasoning, and retrieval. Carry that strategy through to implementation. * Assess weaknesses in existing systems, including inconsistent performance, missing coverage, and evaluation methods that overlook failures encountered in practice. * Follow developments in LLMs, clinical NLP, retrieval\-augmented generation, RLHF/RLAIF, agents, and structured prediction, bringing relevant advances into production. * Establish how we evaluate and benchmark models, prioritizing measures relevant to patient care rather than metrics selected simply because they are straightforward to collect. ### **Production Systems \& Engineering** * Develop and enhance production pipelines for clinical entity extraction, summarization, chart abstraction, and structured inference from unstructured clinical text. * Shape and refine our use of RAG, prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, and model selection, applying rigorous evaluation throughout. * Oversee secure AI deployment that complies with HIPAA and SOC 2, focusing on accuracy, auditability, and the risks associated with hallucinations. ### **Technical Leadership \& Collaboration** * Provide technical guidance on AI decisions, helping the team determine which approaches to explore, diagnose problems, and assess whether models are ready for release. * Partner directly with clinical subject matter experts to understand how outputs support clinical workflows, where they fall short, and how quality should be defined in practice. * Mentor engineers and strengthen the team’s understanding of AI/ML best practices, including effective use of AI tools in everyday technical work. **Required Experience \& Skills** --------------------------------- ### **Essential Requirements** * Substantial expertise in modern AI/ML, LLMs, NLP, information extraction, or a closely related discipline, supported by direct work with leading approaches rather than theoretical familiarity alone. * A PhD in ML, NLP, computer science, or a related discipline, OR comparable research depth evidenced by publications, substantial open\-source contributions, or impactful AI work in industry. * Experience creating and owning evaluation frameworks, including defining what to measure, accounting for Goodhart’s Law, and identifying regressions, rather than only executing existing evaluations. * Demonstrated experience progressing AI systems from research or prototypes into dependable production deployments, with a clear understanding of their limitations and the causes of failure. * At least 8 years of software engineering experience, predominantly focused on AI/ML systems. ### **Technical Expertise** * Fluency in Python, either PyTorch or JAX, and the core ML tooling used for training, fine\-tuning, inference, and quantization. * Practical experience working with LLMs through prompting strategies, RAG architectures, RLHF/preference tuning, instruction tuning, or model distillation. * Strong data capabilities spanning SQL, pipeline design, annotation tools, and dataset curation, alongside an understanding that data quality underpins much of AI performance. * Experience using NLP libraries such as Hugging Face and spaCy, together with production model\-serving infrastructure such as vLLM, TGI, or equivalent tools. * Skilled use of AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar. You actively guide and scrutinize these tools rather than accepting their responses without challenge. You understand when to explore further, when to reject an output, and how to organize tasks to obtain useful results without overlooking subtle errors. ### **Working Approach** * An AI\-first approach grounded in practical understanding of where AI provides meaningful benefits and where it does not. This should be reflected in your coding, research, and daily problem\-solving. * The judgment to recognize when a model should not be released, balanced with the pragmatism to deploy imperfect systems where risks are understood and contained. * Comfort navigating open\-ended research questions, combined with the discipline needed to turn uncertain findings into production systems. * Genuine interest in the clinical domain and recognition of the responsibility involved in developing high\-stakes AI. ### **Additional Experience** * Familiarity with clinical NLP, healthcare data standards such as HL7 and FHIR, ICD/CPT coding, or previous healthcare AI work. * Experience in structured prediction, building medical knowledge graphs, or extracting information from clinical data. * Publications or applied research contributions covering NLP, LLMs, clinical AI, or evaluation methods. **Technology Environment** -------------------------- Python · PyTorch · Hugging Face · PostgreSQL · BigQuery · dbt · FastAPI · Google Cloud Platform · LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) · Jupyter / Streamlit

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack** ---------------------------------------- ### **Overview** We’re partnering with a **fast\-growing healthcare technology company** building an AI\-driven platform that reduces clinician admin work in **in\-home care**, enabling more time with patients. The product is already used in real clinical workflows at scale, and the team is expanding LLM\-powered automation across the platform. ### **The Role** They’re hiring a **Senior Software Engineer** to scale core backend services and ship new **Generative AI / LLM workflows** into production. ### **What You’ll Do** * Build and scale backend services (e.g., **FastAPI**, **Postgres/MongoDB**) * Develop APIs and infrastructure integrating with **LLMs / GenAI** * Prototype quickly, then harden systems for reliability, security, and scale * Improve architecture, observability, and engineering standards * Deploy services with **Docker** and **AWS** * Collaborate cross\-functionally; mentor as needed ### **Requirements** * **7\+ years** backend engineering experience * Experience shipping in **high\-growth** environments * Distributed systems and data\-heavy architecture experience * Production GenAI/LLM experience (or strong interest) * High bar for code quality and reliability

jobs.title: Senior Researcher
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Senior Researcher **Location:** Bay Area or NYC · Onsite **Employment:** Full\-time **Compensation:** $200k – $300k ### **About the Organization** An innovative AI\-driven biotech startup specializing in integrating high\-throughput biology with generative AI technology to accelerate the discovery and development of therapeutic antibodies. The company’s platform has been validated through multiple partnerships with pharmaceutical companies, providing access to differentiated antibodies that are challenging to identify with traditional methods. Their digital biology and AI platform enables rapid Generate\-Test\-Learn\-Optimize cycles for high\-throughput, function\-focused antibody design, targeting areas such as immunology, inflammation, and metabolic diseases, with a mission to improve human health through digital therapeutic discovery. ### **The Role** The organization is seeking a Senior Researcher to develop and train generative models central to their antibody discovery platform. The focus will be on antibody design, protein structure prediction, and broader biomolecular modeling. The candidate will work with large\-scale deep learning models trained on proprietary high\-throughput data, directly contributing to iterative design and validation cycles. This position offers an opportunity to design antibodies computationally, observe high\-throughput testing results, and refine models based on experimental feedback. ### **Responsibilities** **Model Development \& Research** * Design, train, and assess deep learning models for antibody and protein engineering, including structure prediction and generative architectures. * Create models that predict binding affinity, maturation potential, developability, and facilitate de novo antibody design. * Investigate novel architectures, contribute original research, and publish findings as appropriate. **Data \& Platform** * Utilize large proprietary antibody datasets generated via high\-throughput biological assays to train and improve models. * Integrate computational models with experimental data, closing the loop between in silico predictions and wet\-lab validation. * Scale models across extensive GPU clusters, employing hundreds or thousands of GPUs in parallel computing environments. **Collaboration \& Impact** * Collaborate with protein engineers, biologists, and platform engineers to translate models into therapeutic candidates. * Engage with the broader research community through open\-source contributions and academic dissemination. ### **Qualifications** **Essential** * Deep expertise in antibody design, protein modeling, or structural biology, including hands\-on model training experience in these areas. * Practical experience with deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch or JAX), especially in training large models from scratch. * Experience with distributed training on multiple GPUs. * Possession of a PhD or Master’s degree in machine learning, computational biology, computer science, or related fields, or an equivalent research record. * Demonstrated research through publications at top\-tier conferences such as NeurIPS, ICML, or ICLR. * A strong drive for innovation and a passion for foundational progress in the space. **Preferred** * Experience working with generative models for protein or antibody sequence and structure design. * Knowledge of experimental antibody discovery workflows such as display technologies or high\-throughput screening. * Contributions to open\-source modeling tools or frameworks used by the research community.

jobs.title: Software Engineer

jobs.title: Research Statistician
jobs.description: #### **Syensqo is all about chemistry. We’re not just referring to chemical reactions here, but also to the magic that occurs when the brightest minds get to work together. This is where our true strength lies. In you. In your future colleagues and in all your differences. And of course, in your ideas to improve lives while preserving our planet’s beauty for the generations to come.** **We are looking for:** We are looking for a Research Statistician – Innovation \& Data Science who is passionate about applying statistics, experimental design, and data science to solve scientific, innovation, and customer challenges. You will serve as a key statistical partner to scientists, chemists, engineers, technical sales teams, and customers—helping teams design smarter experiments, extract meaningful insights from data, and make faster, more confident decisions across growth, adjacent innovation, and incremental improvement projects. A key part of your role will be building statistical capability across the organization through training, coaching, and hands\-on project support in Design of Experiments (DOE), statistical analysis, optimization, and customer trials. You will also help advance the application of machine learning, artificial intelligence, and advanced analytics to innovation challenges. **We count on you for:** * Provide statistical leadership and consulting across innovation projects, from early exploration through optimization, validation, and customer implementation. * Partner with scientists, chemists, and engineers to translate technical questions into effective experimental strategies. * Design and analyze experiments using appropriate DOE methodologies, including screening, factorial, response surface, mixture, custom/optimal designs, and multi\-response optimization. * Apply statistical modeling and analysis to laboratory, application, pilot, manufacturing, and customer\-generated data, translating results into clear insights and actionable recommendations. * Partner with technical sales teams and customers to design and interpret statistically sound customer trials, product comparisons, and validation studies. * Develop and deliver practical training in DOE, statistical analysis, data interpretation, and customer trial design for scientists, engineers, and technical sales professionals. * Coach project teams in applying statistical methods independently and develop practical tools, templates, and best practices to strengthen organizational capability. * Use statistical approaches to reduce experimental workload, accelerate learning, and improve the quality and speed of innovation decisions. * Collaborate on machine learning, artificial intelligence, predictive modeling, and advanced analytics projects, ensuring appropriate statistical rigor, validation, robustness, and interpretation. **You can count on us for:** * The opportunity to have a visible impact on innovation and growth by solving challenging scientific, engineering, and customer problems. * A collaborative environment spanning scientific disciplines, technologies, applications, commercial teams, and customers. * A diverse portfolio of projects, from exploratory research and product development through customer validation and commercialization. * The opportunity to shape and strengthen statistical and DOE capabilities across the organization. * Opportunities to expand your expertise at the intersection of statistics, experimental science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. * An environment that values curiosity, continuous learning, collaboration, and new ideas. **You will bring:** * An advanced degree in Statistics, Applied Statistics, Data Science, or a related quantitative/scientific discipline, with deep formal training and demonstrated expertise in applied statistics. A Ph.D. or equivalent level of advanced statistical expertise and relevant applied experience is strongly preferred. * Demonstrated expertise in Design of Experiments (DOE), statistical modeling, optimization, and analysis of experimental data. * Experience applying statistical methods to complex scientific, engineering, product development, manufacturing, or customer problems. * Advanced proficiency with statistical and data\-analysis software such as JMP, Minitab, R, Python, SAS, or comparable platforms; expertise in JMP and/or Minitab is highly valued. * Strong knowledge of regression, analysis of variance, multivariate methods, model development and validation, uncertainty, and statistical visualization. * The ability to understand the underlying scientific or business problem and select an appropriate statistical approach—not simply analyze a provided dataset. * Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex statistical concepts practical and understandable for diverse audiences. * A collaborative and consultative approach, with the ability to work effectively with and influence customers, scientists, technical sales professionals, and business leaders. * An interest and demonstrated ability in teaching, coaching, and developing statistical capability in others. * Curiosity about chemistry, materials, processes, applications, and the customer challenges behind the data. * Strong interest in machine learning and artificial intelligence, with the ability and motivation to contribute to projects applying these technologies. * Experience with Python or R and exposure to machine learning, predictive modeling, or advanced analytics is highly desirable. * Experience in chemicals, specialty materials, formulations, materials science, industrial R\&D, or a related technical environment is preferred. **You will get:** * Competitive salary and benefits package. The U.S. base salary range reasonably expected to be paid for this position is $98,000 \- 140,000\.00 per year. Since actual compensation packages are based on a variety of factors unique to each candidate we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted base salary range. Total compensation for this role also includes bonus and/or other incentives * 16 or more weeks of maternity/paternity and co\-parenting leave, according to local regulations. * Training platform for all employees. * Free well\-being sessions (physical and psychological). **Additional information:** This is a hands\-on, collaborative, and influential technical role. You will move between statistical analysis, scientific problem\-solving, teaching and coaching, and interactions with customers and commercial teams. You should be comfortable asking challenging questions, influencing experimental approaches, and helping multidisciplinary teams understand what the data can—and cannot—support. Travel may be required to support collaboration with technical teams and customers. About us * Syensqo is a science company developing groundbreaking solutions that enhance the way we live, work, travel and play. Inspired by the scientific councils which Ernest Solvay initiated in 1911, we bring great minds together to push the limits of science and innovation for the benefit of our customers, with a diverse, global team of more than 13,000 associates. Our solutions contribute to safer, cleaner, and more sustainable products found in homes, food and consumer goods, planes, cars, batteries, smart devices and health care applications. Our innovation power enables us to deliver on the ambition of a circular economy and explore breakthrough technologies that advance humanity. * At Syensqo, we seek to promote unity and not uniformity. We value the diversity that individuals bring and we invite you to consider a future with us, regardless of background, age, gender, national origin, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, ability or identity. We encourage individuals who may require any assistance or accommodations to let us know to ensure a seamless application experience. We are here to support you throughout the application journey and want to ensure all candidates are treated equally. If you are unsure whether you meet all the criteria or qualifications listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. * Syensqo is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. \#LI\-RC1 \#Hybrid

jobs.title: Test Engineer 1
jobs.description: Position Description: **About Us** With more than 50 years of experience, Transportation Research Center Inc. (TRC Inc.) is an independent mobility testing, research, and engineering firm serving industry leaders worldwide. Operating across Ohio, California, Arizona, and Minnesota, TRC offers comprehensive testing, validation, and research services spanning vehicle dynamics, durability, crash safety, advanced driver assistance, automated vehicle technologies and more. Through world\-class proving grounds, specialized laboratories, and advanced research facilities, TRC provides the expertise and resources to advance the mobility landscape. **Autonomous Vehicle Test Engineer** **About the Role** Join TRC Inc. as part of our dedicated engineering team embedded on\-site with a leading autonomous vehicle developer. As an AV Test Engineer, you will shape the future of mobility by evaluating prototype autonomous systems from end to end. Rather than passive mileage collection, our mission is focused on intentional edge\-case discovery, extreme limit testing, and fault injection validation across physical vehicles, closed\-course proving grounds, and Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) test benches before software and hardware configurations reach public roads. **The Top 3 Qualities We Look For** ? Systematic Problem Solver: You approach anomalies methodically, isolating issues layer by layer across physical wiring, power, communication buses, firmware, and software stacks. You focus on preserving data, reading fault codes, and identifying the true root cause rather than just treating symptoms. ? Data\-Driven Automator: You believe test execution is only half the job; the other half is understanding system response. You leverage Python scripting and data parsing to turn raw vehicle telemetry into meaningful insights, automated test scripts, and repeatable validation pipelines. ? Safety\-Minded Team Player: You bring an uncompromising commitment to testing safety, thrive when solving ambiguous problems, and communicate technical findings clearly and objectively across diverse cross\-functional teams. **What You Will Do** ? Design and Author Tests: Translate high\-level system requirements into robust Design Verification Plans (DVPs) with clear parameters, boundary controls, and pass/fail criteria. ? Lead Multi\-Environment Testing: Execute testing across closed\-course tracks, physical prototype vehicles, and HIL test benches, collaborating closely with track dispatch, test conductors, and safety drivers. ? Manage Operational Test Modes: Guide vehicles safely through testing stages, from manual baseline runs (Mode 1\) to supervised autonomous runs (Mode 2\) and fully autonomous, high\-intensity limit / fault injection testing (Mode 3\). ? Integrate and Triage Vehicle Systems: Diagnose bus communication drops, firmware mismatches, and hardware anomalies using standard diagnostic protocols (UDS, DoIP) and lab equipment. ? Build Automation and Analytics: Write reusable Python scripts to parse time\-series logs, automate track scenarios, and build visual dashboards (such as Webviz or Jupyter notebooks) that streamline test reporting. ? Collaborate and Report: Track defects and systemic behavior in issue tracking systems (such as Jira), avoiding subjective terminology in favor of data\-backed, objective failure modes. **Where You Can Make an Impact** Test Engineers share a common core foundation and are matched with specialized workstreams based on interest and expertise: ? Vehicle Platform Integration: Testing physical and simulated interaction between the autonomous driving system and the base vehicle chassis. ? Sensing \& Perception: Validating LiDAR, Radar, and camera performance across extreme environments, adverse weather, and occluded target scenarios. ? Bring\-Up \& Flashing Operations: Standing up newly delivered prototype vehicles, managing flashing pipelines, and resolving base firmware mismatches at multiple testing sites. ? Motion Control \& Dynamics Simulation: Evaluating steering precision, lateral and longitudinal controls, and tire hydroplaning dynamics. ? Commercialization \& Offboard Operations: Validating driverless cabin comfort, thermal controls, low\-power sleep modes, and Over\-the\-Air (OTA) fleet updates. ? Structured Scenario Testing \& Benchmarking: Designing high\-fidelity track scenarios (soft targets, dummy pedestrian interactions, and multi\-vehicle choreography) while executing competitor benchmarking campaigns to evaluate autonomous decision\-making and safety margins against industry standards. ? Proving Ground V\&V: Running complex track campaigns, mileage accumulation, and real\-time field troubleshooting. ? Hardware Systems \& Architecture: Executing systemic defect triage, persistent diagnostic testing, and cybersecurity validation. **What you Bring** Core Qualifications: ? Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Systems, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, Robotics, or a related discipline. New college graduates and experienced engineers alike are encouraged to apply. ? Mindset: Strong understanding of systems engineering, requirements decomposition, and structured verification methods. ? Driving Credentials: Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record, plus the ability to pass internal closed\-course safety driver training (L1/L2 certifications). ? On\-Site Collaboration: Ability to be on\-site during core operational hours (9:30 AM to 2:30 PM) alongside vehicles, test benches, and track personnel. Required Core Skills: ? Working knowledge or proficiency in Python (NumPy, Pandas, Pytest) for test automation, data analysis, and log parsing. ? Familiarity with in\-vehicle networking (CAN, CAN\-FD, Flexray, LIN, Automotive Ethernet) and diagnostics (UDS, DoIP). ? Hands\-on experience with lab instrumentation (multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, breakout harnesses) gained through industry work, coursework, or academic lab projects. ? Comfort working in Linux environments, using Git version control, and managing tasks in Jira or equivalent tracking tools. Preferred Domain Experience (Any of the following is a plus): ? Hands\-on involvement in collegiate engineering design teams (such as Formula SAE, Baja SAE, RoboMaster, or Autonomous Vehicle clubs) or engineering internships. ? Exposure to HIL and simulation platforms: dSPACE, Vector VT, MATLAB/Simulink, or CAPL. ? Familiarity with bus analysis tools: Vector CANoe, CANape, CANalyzer, or Dewesoft DAQ. ? High\-accuracy GPS/INS systems (e.g., OxTS, NovAtel) or track target systems (e.g., pedestrian target platforms, soft targets). ? Exposure to vehicle telematics, OTA update frameworks, or thermal/power management testing ? Familiarity with ECU flashing pipelines, bootloaders, or flash toolchains. ? Exposure to robotics and perception frameworks: ROS / ROS 2, OpenCV, or sensor calibration toolsets. ? Interest or experience in vehicle dynamics testing: automated steering robots, load cells, or outriggers. Working Environment \& Expectations ? Setting: A mix of offices, engineering garages, labs, and proving ground test tracks. ? Field Work: Occasional work outdoors in Arizona weather conditions, including summer heat and direct sun, with appropriate safety protocols in place. ? Mobility: Physical ability to position yourself comfortably in vehicle cabins and around sensor mounts when setting up instrumentation. ? Travel \& Schedule: Schedule flexibility to support critical milestone releases, with travel up to 20% to partner test sites as needed.

A collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across cross\-functional teams. **Nice to Have \| AI Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC)*** AI Assisted Design \& Architecture * AI Augmented Development * Intelligent Code Review \& Quality Engineering * Leverage AI tools (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT, Domain\-specific AI tools) to accelerate system design, generate architecture patterns, sequence diagrams and recommend scalable solutions across microservices and data platforms. We love to invest in our team members! ***The Best Kept Secret in Retail*** **Tailored Brands** is North America’s leading specialty retailer of menswear, famous for world\-class customer service and unique offerings like tailoring and custom suits. jobs.description: ### **Who We Are:** Ghost Story Games is a self\-publishing game development studio founded by Ken Levine (Creative Director of System Shock 2, Bioshock, and Bioshock Infinite) and former Irrational Games developers. The studio's mission is to create narrative\-driven experiences rooted in immersive world building and gameplay. **The Challenge** ----------------- Ghost Story Games is seeking a talented remote Principal Game AI Engineer to join us on Judas, the highly anticipated game led by Ken Levine (System Shock 2, BioShock series). Unique in its bold, creative vision, Judas is also built upon novel technology by which the visual world, gameplay, and story unfolds in meaningful, dynamic ways. hardening. * Manage server lifecycle activities including provisioning, upgrades, system migrations, and decommissioning. * Develop and maintain system documentation, standards, and operational procedures. **Azure IoT \& Cloud Operations** * Support and maintain Azure IoT deployments, including Azure IoT Hub and Azure Device Provisioning Service (DPS). * Assist with onboarding, provisioning, and minimal downtime. * Coordinate with regional teams, vendors, and stakeholders to resolve complex technical issues. * Assist with disaster recovery planning, testing, and business continuity initiatives. **Key Competencies \& Skills** * Experience with the following is required: + Ubuntu Linux Administration + Azure IoT Hub + Azure Device Provisioning Service (DPS) + Networking Scripting (Bash, Python, or PowerShell) + Monitoring and Performance Management + Security Best Practices and System Hardening **Education and Experience Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\-7 years of experience administering Linux systems, preferably Ubuntu. * 2\-3 years of using C\#/.NET. * Strong proficiency in TypeScript and React for front\-end UI. * Experience building and operating software in both on\-premises/customer\-hosted environments and cloud\-native multi\-tenant environments, with an understanding of how debugging, deployment, and scaling differ between the two. * Hands\-on experience with AWS DynamoDB, RDS, SQS (or an equivalent cloud provider) in production environments. * Experience with microservices patterns (service discovery, API gateway, messaging/queueing, data partitioning). * Experience with automated testing at multiple levels. * Strong Git skills and hands\-on experience with GitHub Actions for CI/CD. * Strong troubleshooting skills for distributed systems in production. * Solid understanding of cloud\-native architecture and AWS best practices. * Familiarity with observability tooling and practices (OpenTelemetry, structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics\-based alerting) to support proactive issue detection. **Desirable Skills** * Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and experience defining AWS infrastructure using CloudFormation (or AWS CDK) to support predictable and repeatable environments. * Chromeleon, Cytiva UNICORN, Agilent OpenLab, along with knowledge of instrument integration pattern and practices is a strong plus. **Soft Skills Needed:** * Excellent verbal and written Instead of relying on fragmented tools and manual campaign management, COOL AI executes thousands of real\-time micro\-optimizations across search, social, display, video, and connected TV—helping customers launch faster, optimize continuously, and achieve stronger business outcomes.** **Our innovation and growth have earned industry\-wide recognition, including being named a 7\-time recipient of the Inc. 5000 list of America's Fastest\-Growing Private Companies, a 2\-time Deloitte Technology Fast 500 honoree, recognized on Crain's New York Fast 50, honored by the Digiday Media Awards for helping modernize digital media, and named one of Adweek's Top 10 Fastest Growing Solution Providers globally.** **We're building the future of advertising, where every signal becomes intelligence and every optimization drives performance. As we continue to grow globally, we're looking for curious, ambitious people who want to work with cutting\-edge AI technology, solve complex challenges, and help redefine what's possible in modern advertising.** **About the Role** ------------------ **The COOL Company is seeking a Chief of Staff \& AI Integration to work directly with the Founder \& CEO. This is a high\-trust, hands\-on operator who turns CEO priorities into accountable execution while leading practical, secure AI adoption across our businesses. The role sits at the intersection of executive operations, strategic projects, data, technology, and change management.** **You will translate decisions into clear owners and deadlines, remove cross\-functional bottlenecks, design and deploy AI\-enabled workflows, and demonstrate their business impact. You will partner with the CTO, functional leaders, and the People Team; you will not replace functional ownership, act as the CTO, or independently commit the company to external actions.** **Challenges and Opportunities** -------------------------------- **We operate across media, creative AI, advertising technology, publisher monetization, and other growth initiatives. With global teams, frequent commercial opportunities, and a fast\-moving CEO, the opportunity is to build a repeatable operating system that gets important work done faster, with fewer handoffs and better visibility.** **The first priority is implementing useful AI—not producing slide decks about AI. Success means deployed workflows that employees actually use, measurable hours saved, clearer decisions, better follow\-through, and strong data\-security controls.** **Responsibilities and Duties** ------------------------------- **CEO effectiveness and execution** * **Own the CEO’s strategic operating cadence: weekly priorities, leadership follow\-ups, meeting preparation, decision logs, and status updates.** * **Convert CEO and leadership discussions into a prioritized action register with owners, deadlines, dependencies, and escalation paths; follow through to completion.** * **Prepare concise executive briefs using approved sources such as CRM, meetings, project systems, and communications; distinguish facts, assumptions, and recommendations.** * **Surface missed commitments, risks, and cross\-functional bottlenecks early; push for decisions without creating unnecessary meetings.** **AI integration and automation** * **Audit high\-friction workflows across Sales, Account Management, Marketing, Product, Engineering, Finance, People, and Operations, then prioritize use cases by impact, feasibility, risk, and adoption.** * **Design, prototype, and implement secure AI workflows using approved tools and integrations, including meeting\-to\-action systems, reporting, CRM hygiene, knowledge retrieval, and repetitive process automation.** * **Work with the CTO and security owners on system access, permissions, privacy, vendor selection, data retention, accuracy checks, and human approval gates.** * **Move pilots into durable production processes with documentation, exception handling, monitoring, training, assigned owners, and measurable results.** * **Build lightweight reporting on workflow usage, quality, time saved, cost, and business outcomes. Retire or refine automation that does not work.** **Strategic projects and organizational leverage** * **Run selected cross\-functional initiatives on the CEO’s behalf, including growth projects, process redesign, and integration planning, from charter through measurable delivery.** * **Partner with the People Team and department heads to establish clear roles, SMART goals, and productive leadership rhythms.** * **Improve the quality of business reviews and dashboards, using leading and lagging indicators rather than anecdotal updates.** * **Draft internal communications and recommendations; obtain appropriate approvals before sending external messages or making sensitive changes.** **Qualifications** ------------------ **Professional Competencies** * **6\+ years in high\-ownership business operations, chief of staff, strategy and operations, consulting, product operations, or automation/transformation roles; meaningful time partnering with a founder or executive team strongly preferred.** * **Demonstrated record of shipping cross\-functional changes and building reliable operating processes, not just advising on them.** * **Hands\-on fluency with current AI products, LLM workflows, automation platforms, APIs/integrations, and data systems; able to prototype personally and work with engineers on production\-grade implementations.** * **Strong command of CRM, spreadsheets, dashboards, project management, meeting intelligence, and structured documentation. Experience in advertising/media/MarTech is a plus, not a prerequisite.** * **High analytical rigor: can define baselines, evaluate ROI, measure adoption, and investigate inaccurate or misleading outputs.** * **Exceptional written communication, project management, prioritization, stakeholder leadership, and executive judgment.** * **Sound security and confidentiality instincts; understands human\-in\-the\-loop approvals and sensitive\-data handling.** **Cultural Competencies** * **Sleeves Up: personally executes and takes end\-to\-end ownership.** * **100% Viewability: transparent status reporting, candid feedback, and immediate escalation of issues.** * **Be Defiantly Great: relentlessly improves systems and challenges inefficient defaults.** * **Unconditional Empathy: treats colleagues as partners and designs workflows that help them succeed.** * **Calm under ambiguity, discreet, curious, resourceful, low\-ego, and comfortable holding senior leaders accountable.** **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- **Within 90 days: a trusted CEO action and reporting cadence, at least five useful AI\-enabled workflows in production, measurable usage and time\-savings baselines, and demonstrably faster leadership follow\-through. At six months: adoption is sustained across relevant teams and the measurable goals in the accompanying hiring scorecard are being met.** **Role Details and Benefits** ----------------------------- **Reports to: Founder \& CEO \| Employment: Full\-time \| Level: Senior individual contributor / executive operator** **Location: Miami or New York preferred, with regular in\-person collaboration and travel as needed. Final arrangement subject to approval.** **Compensation and benefits: Competitive package to be finalized by the CEO and People Team; company benefits and any incentive/equity eligibility will be confirmed during recruiting.**

jobs.description: **Department Description:** At Disney, we’re storytellers. We make the impossible, possible. The Walt Disney Company (TWDC) is a world\-class entertainment and technological leader. Walt’s passion was to continuously envision new ways to move audiences around the world—a passion that remains our touchstone in an enterprise that stretches from theme parks, resorts and a cruise line to sports, news, movies and a variety of other businesses. Uniting each endeavor is a commitment to creating and delivering unforgettable experiences — and we’re constantly looking for new ways to enhance these exciting experiences. The Enterprise Technology mission is to deliver technology solutions that align to business strategies while enabling enterprise efficiency and promoting cross\-company collaborative innovation. Our group drives competitive advantage by enhancing our consumer experiences, enabling business growth, and advancing operational excellence. **Team Description:** We are the Finance Engineering \& AI team, and we exist to be Finance's technical partner — for FP\&A, Payroll, Controllership, and Tax \& Treasury alike — turning business process needs into working software and intelligent automation. Our AI Platform team designs and builds the intelligent automation layer that streamlines and scales finance workflows, while our Business Process Applications team owns and operates the core systems finance relies on every day. Together, we combine deep finance domain expertise with custom engineering to give Finance both a stable operational backbone and a path toward an increasingly automated future. **What You’ll Do:** Disney Financial Insights (D\-Fi) is a new platform reimagining how Finance teams and budget owners across Disney interact with financial data — replacing manual pulls, static reports, and email\-driven approvals with one AI\-powered, orchestrated experience built on top of Disney financial systems. We're hiring a Senior Manager, AI \& Machine Learning, as the founding engineering leader for this AI framework: a hands\-on manager and technical lead who will build and run a global engineering team based in Buenos Aires AR, delivering the AI/ML layer, the intelligent data foundation, software workflows/orchestration, and natural\-language experience that sits at the center of D\-Fi. This is a build\-from\-scratch mandate — you'll be shaping team structure, engineering practices, and technical architecture from an early stage (MVP in progress), not inheriting a mature system. This role is also expected to be hands\-on — stepping in on implementation, unblocking technical issues in real time, and reviewing code with the depth that comes from doing the work yourself, not scenario modeling, the natural\-language experience — is built on a governed, semantic data foundation rather than one\-off pipelines. * **Be the stakeholder\-facing technical lead.** Act as the business finance transformation leads on driving adoption across the enterprise — both finance workers and budget owners. **Required Qualifications \& Skills:** * 10\+ years of software and/or ML engineering leadership experience, with a strong track record of owning technical direction and architecture for complex systems end\-to\-end. * Demonstrated experience architecting and shipping production LLM/AI applications — not just prototypes. * Production experience with LLM application architecture — RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and context/retrieval design at scale * Working knowledge of LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent) and vector databases/retrieval stores (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, or Snowflake Cortex Search) * Strong data modeling background, ideally including semantic/governed data layers (not just raw pipelines) * Ability to read, write and review Python code * Working knowledge of modern web/full\-stack technical voice in front of senior business stakeholders — able to translate finance/business problems into technical scope, and technical trade\-offs into business language. **Preferred jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **Who are we:** We’re a leading Northeast family\-owned food, agricultural products, and agricultural services organization headquartered in Pennsylvania. We provide animal nutrition and feeds; specialty protein production, processing, and marketing; on\-farm protein production services; and grain, fertilizer, and ingredient procurement. We’re a stable company with strong core values, great benefits, competitive wage structure, and a safe and healthy work environment. With over 850 team members, we're a growing company in an essential sector – agriculture! Learn more here: https://www.thewengergroup.com **What your day looks like:** **POSITION SUMMARY:** The Systems Engineer is responsible for the design, administration, reliability, security, and continuous improvement of the organization's enterprise infrastructure across corporate, manufacturing, and remote locations. The role provides hands\-on ownership of on\-premises virtualization, Microsoft Azure infrastructure services, enterprise backup and disaster recovery, storage platforms, Windows Server, and related core services. This position serves as a senior technical escalation point and project resource, helping ensure that business\-critical systems are resilient, recoverable, scalable, well documented, and aligned with operational and security requirements. The Systems Engineer balances day\-to\-day operational support with lifecycle planning, modernization, automation, and infrastructure project delivery. **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:** * Design, implement, and maintain enterprise IT infrastructure, including physical and virtualized servers, cloud platforms, and storage solutions. * Develop and optimize hybrid cloud strategies (AWS, Azure, on\-premises) to ensure scalability, security, and cost efficiency. * Define system security architectures, including access controls, identity management, and compliance with best practices (NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2\). * Evaluate and integrate emerging technologies such as AI\-driven automation, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible). * Manage Windows Server and Linux environments, ensuring high availability, performance, and security. * Administer and optimize virtualization platforms (VMware vSphere, Hyper\-V, Nutanix) for compute efficiency and workload distribution. * Implement backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity plans to mitigate risks and ensure uptime. * Optimize enterprise storage solutions (SAN, NAS, cloud storage) to support business applications and data growth. * Lead cloud migrations and optimization initiatives, ensuring a seamless transition to AWS, Azure, or hybrid cloud solutions. * Automate system deployments and configurations using PowerShell, Ansible, Terraform, or Python. * Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure automation and self\-healing systems. * Integrate cloud\-native security controls such as AWS IAM, Azure Security Center, and cloud SIEM solutions. * Implement and enforce system security best practices, including patch management, hardening, and jobs.title: (Staff / Senior Staff) AI Infra Engineer, Inference Infrastructure
jobs.description: ### **About The Role** We're looking for a software engineer, reliability\-minded but still a builder, to own what happens in production to the Kubernetes\-native control plane that provisions and runs our GPU inference fleet. The platform team builds the manifest\-driven API and controllers that let the inference team declare what they need, a cluster, a model deployment, a capacity change, and get it reconciled underneath. Your job is to keep that promise true in the real world: triaging InfiniBand issues when prefill and decode nodes stall exchanging KV cache over RDMA, diagnosing hero\-model and LoRA\-serving faults that don't show up in generic health checks, and extending the automated self\-healing system so each new failure mode becomes a permanent fix instead of a recurring page. The core value we're after is keeping the decoupling real even when things break, and keeping the fleet efficient without that efficiency becoming a new source of instability. You'll own SLOs and error budgets for inference serving, lead incident response, and turn what postmortems teach you into actual changes in the controllers and automation, not just updated runbooks. You'll also work the reliability side of capacity efficiency, since a mistuned defragmentation or bin\-packing pass is itself a production risk. Strong candidates have hands\-on production\-reliability experience on large\-scale distributed or GPU\-serving systems, are comfortable troubleshooting InfiniBand/RDMA and Kubernetes controller/CRD\-based platforms, and think about GPU infrastructure, and the tools that keep it reliable, as software to be engineered. A product mindset applies: the on\-call experience, the clarity of an alert, and the judgment built into an automated remediation are things you ship and iterate on. ### **Responsibilities** * Operate the provisioning state machine in production: own the health of the host lifecycle pipeline, discovery, inference bring\-up, GPU driver/CUDA validation, health checks, decommission/RMA, triaging stuck or failed state transitions at fleet scale and feeding real failure patterns back into how the states and transitions are designed. * Triage and extend automated self\-healing: when the node\-scanning and remediation platform misses something, a new failure mode, an InfiniBand issue in disaggregated prefill/decode serving, a GPU Xid variant, a hero\-model or LoRA\-specific fault, diagnose it live, drive the fix to production, and turn it into a new detection/remediation plugin so it's automatic the next time. * Own end\-to\-end reliability of the pipeline: hold the SLOs and error budgets for provisioning and fleet health, lead incident response when idempotency, retry, rollback, or drift assumptions break down in practice, and drive the systemic fix, not just the hotfix. * Partner with the inference/ML platform team from the production side: be the one who knows how real cluster topologies, interconnects, and scheduling constraints actually fail in the field, and feed those failure modes back as first\-class requirements into the platform's abstractions. * Work alongside machine learning researchers, engineers, and product managers to bring our latest technologies into production, enabling advanced research through awesome engineering. * Introduce new techniques, tools, and architecture that improve the performance, latency, throughput, and efficiency of our model inference stack. * Build tools to give us visibility into our bottlenecks and sources of instability, then design and implement solutions to address the highest\-priority issues. * Lead reliability cross\-functionally: build coalition across infra, ML platform, and product teams around shared reliability priorities, manage stakeholders through incidents and roadmap trade\-offs, and represent the reliability point of view in planning so it shapes decisions before they ship, not after an outage. ### **Requirements** * Experience operating a provisioning or host\-lifecycle pipeline in production, comfortable troubleshooting stuck or failed state transitions (discovery, bring\-up, GPU driver/CUDA validation, health checks, decommission/RMA) at fleet scale, and translating real failure patterns back into improvements to the state machine’s design. * Deep experience owning production reliability for large\-scale distributed systems; GPU/ML\-serving infrastructure experience is a strong plus. * Hands\-on experience troubleshooting InfiniBand/RDMA networking issues, ideally in a multi\-node training or disaggregated\-inference context — comfortable reading IB port counters and subnet manager logs, not just application metrics. * Familiarity with the operational realities of multi\-tenant model serving (LoRA/adapter\-based serving) and with running differentiated SLOs across model pools of different priority. * A demonstrated track record of eliminating operational toil through automation and tooling you built yourself, not just process or documentation. * Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes controller/CRD patterns, reconciliation loops, and node\-level health/remediation systems. * Comfort with event\-driven architectures, backpressure/circuit\-breaking design, and treating observability (metrics, logs, traces) as something built into a system, not added after an incident. * A software\-engineering mindset first: you write and ship production code, and you think about GPU infrastructure as software to be engineered, not a fleet to be manually operated. ### **About Together AI** Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose\-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high\-performance inference that scales reliably, fine\-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier\-level specialized models, and pre\-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400\+ trillion tokens a month. ### **Compensation** We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance and other competitive benefits. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is: $250,000 \- $320,000 \+ equity \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job\-related knowledge. ### **Equal Opportunity** Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more. Please see our privacy policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy.
