jobs.title: Vice President, Data & AI
jobs.description: Job Description Transcarent is seeking a **V****P** **of** **Data \& AI** to lead the technology foundation that powers data and artificial intelligence across the company. This executive will own the strategy, architecture, and execution of Transcarent’s enterprise data and AI platforms: ensuring our teams have trusted, scalable, secure, and modern infrastructure to build intelligent products, power AI\-enabled experiences, and put data to work across the organization. The VP of Data \& AI will lead Data Engineering and AI/ML platform capabilities while partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Clinical, Security, and business leaders. This leader will build and operate the foundational platforms, data products, infrastructure, and capabilities that enable our company to move faster. Success in the first 6–12 months will mean establishing a clear Data \& AI platform strategy and architecture; improving the reliability, quality, and accessibility of enterprise data; accelerating the path from AI experimentation to production; and building a scalable platform operating model that supports Transcarent’s next phase of growth. **What** **You’ll** **Do** * **Define and lead** **Transcarent’s** **Data \& AI platform strategy**, establishing the architecture, roadmap, standards, investment priorities, and operating model for the foundational capabilities that power data and AI across the company. * **Own and evolve the enterprise data platform**, ensuring Transcarent has scalable, reliable, secure, and well\-governed infrastructure for ingesting, integrating, transforming, storing, and serving data across products and business functions. * **Lead Data** **and AI** **Engineering**, establishing strong engineering practices and building the pipelines, services, data products, and infrastructure required to make trusted data available throughout the organization. * **Build the platform for AI at scale**, creating the infrastructure, tooling, services, and standards that enable teams to rapidly develop, evaluate, deploy, monitor, and improve machine learning, generative AI, agentic, and other AI\-powered capabilities. * **Accelerate the path from AI experimentation to production**, reducing friction between promising prototypes and scalable, secure, reliable capabilities embedded in Transcarent products and workflows. * **Establish reusable Data \& AI capabilities**, enabling Product and Engineering teams to leverage common data services, models, APIs, AI services, tooling, and infrastructure rather than creating fragmented solutions independently. * **Partner closely with Analytics leadership**, ensuring analytics teams have reliable, accessible, well\-modeled, and appropriately governed data while maintaining clear ownership between platform/data engineering and analytics. * **Establish mature enterprise data governance**, including data quality, lineage, metadata, definitions, access, interoperability, lifecycle management, and stewardship in partnership with Analytics, Security, Privacy, Legal, and business stakeholders. * **Drive platform reliability and operational excellence**, establishing clear standards and measures for performance, availability, scalability, observability, cost efficiency, developer experience, and technical debt. * **Build and lead a world\-class Data \& AI Platforms organization**, developing strong leaders and technical talent while creating a culture of ownership, experimentation, engineering excellence, speed, and continuous improvement. **What** **We’re** **Looking For** * Significant leadership experience building and scaling data engineering, data platform, AI/ML, or related technology organizations in complex, high\-growth environments. * Proven experience defining and executing a modern enterprise data platform strategy, including architecture, data engineering, infrastructure, governance, and platform operations. * Deep understanding of modern cloud data architectures, data pipelines, data modeling, distributed systems, APIs, data products, and the technologies used to operate data platforms at scale. * Strong understanding of modern AI architecture and infrastructure, including ML platforms, LLMs, generative AI, agentic systems, model deployment, evaluation, observability, and emerging AI development patterns. * Demonstrated experience taking AI/ML capabilities from experimentation into reliable, scalable production environments. * Experience building internal platforms that enable Product, Engineering, Analytics, Data Science, or other technical teams to build and ship faster. * Strong product mindset with experience treating technical platforms as products—including understanding users, prioritizing roadmaps, driving adoption, and measuring platform effectiveness. * Proven ability to make thoughtful build\-versus\-buy decisions and navigate a rapidly evolving ecosystem of cloud, data, and AI technologies. * Experience establishing strong practices around data qu ce leading major data platform modernization, consolidation, or post\-acquisition technology integration efforts. **Measures of Success** Success in this role will be measured by the strength, scalability, and impact of the Data \& AI foundation this leader builds, including: * Reliability, quality, accessibility, and performance of Transcarent’s enterprise data platform. * Speed and ease with which Product, Engineering, Analytics, and AI teams can discover and use trusted data. * Reduction in time required to move AI capabilities from experimentation into production. * Adoption and reuse of shared data and AI platform capabilities across the organization. * Improvements in developer productivity and reduction of fragmented or duplicative data and AI infrastructure. * Effectiveness of data governance, privacy, security, responsible AI, and platform controls. * Platform scalability, reliability, observability, and cost efficiency. * Strength, engagement, and effectiveness of the Data \& AI organization. **Who we are** Transcarent is the One Place for Health and Careᵀᴹ, bringing medical, pharmacy, and point solutions together with the WayFindingᵀᴹ experience, the first and only generative AI\-powered health and care platform for health consumers. Our WayFinding experience, paired with transparent and consumer\-driven pharmacy care, 2nd.MD expert medical opinions, and virtual primary care, works seamlessly with comprehensive Care Experiences – Cancer Care, Surgery Care, and Weight Health – to support people with all of their health needs, simple or serious. More than 1,700 employers and health plans rely on us to provide information, guidance, and care, empowering health consumers with more choice, an experience they love, access to higher\-quality care, and lower costs for 21 million Members. For more information, visit transcarent.com, and follow us on LinkedIn. **At Transcarent, our values guide everything we do:** * **People First:** We prioritize our Members, clients, and each other in every decision * **Care:** Every decision starts with improving health and care for our Members * **Resilience:** We push boundaries and take the uncharted path to change an industry * **Results:** We take ownership, solve with speed, and deliver for our people and each other * **Humble and Human:** We lead with humility, bring fun to tough moments, and go further together **Total Rewards** Individual compensation packages are based on a few different factors unique to each candidate, including primary work location and an evaluation of a candidate’s skills, experience, market demands, and internal equity. Salary is just one component of Transcarent's total package. All regular employees are also eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock options. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to: * Competitive medical, dental, and vision coverage * Competitive 401(k) Plan with a generous company match * Flexible Time Off/Paid Time Off, 13 paid holidays * Protection Plans including Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, and Supplemental Insurance Mental Health and Wellness benefits * Transcarent is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are a person with a disability and require assistance during the application process, please don’t hesitate to reach out! Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often don’t apply unless they meet 100% of the job criteria. While we have worked to consolidate the minimum qualifications for each role, we aren’t looking for someone who checks each box on a page; we’re looking for active learners and people who care about disrupting the current health and care with their unique experiences. Department Technology Location Remote, California, United States Experience 10 \- 20 Years Salary Range USD 265,000 \- 285,000 (Annual)

jobs.title: Network Engineer/Help Desk Technician
jobs.description: **Network Engineer: Full Time / Part Time, Employee Relevant Work Experience: 1\-10\+ Years Career Level: Experienced (Non\-Manager)** **PLEASE NOTE: This is an in\-office position in Crestwood KY (just north of Louisville KY)** WHEN WAS THE LAST TIME YOU ENDED YOUR WORKDAY WITH A SMILE? It’s a great time to join our Service Desk team. Get access to all the tools and benefits of working with a larger firm while maintaining the feel of a small business environment. Not only do we take pride in what we do, we have a few laughs, stay relatively casual, and take pride in knowing we’re delivering best\-in\-class service while doing it. YOUR creativity, energy and “take no prisoners” attitude are what we need to augment our growing team of A\-list talent. If you do not have a great customer service attitude or you are a jerk, please do not apply. We have a no jerks allowed policy…sorry. Transitional Technologies, in business since 2003, is hiring a Network Engineer to service, support and interact with our clients by way of providing pro\-active network management and services. Transitional Technologies will consider hiring only the ultimate team player and well\-rounded individual. Transitional Technologies is located in Louisville, KY and serves clients in the Louisville Metro region. Don’t worry though, most of the work we do is remote, so you won’t be driving all over the place unless things get very, very ugly. Network Engineer Role Description: All positions for the Service Desk require drive and determination to help us support our client base. We are looking for an individual who is a problem\-solver and has a proven track record of working within a team environment to successfully address challenging user computing issues and is accustomed to leveraging technical training opportunities to improve their skills. Our Service Desk is responsible for maintaining user up time and improving users’ computing experiences through effective remote monitoring, maintenance and problem identification and resolution activities, as well as growing and developing the organization’s perception with existing customers through exceptional customer service. Candidates must be energetic and focused with a strong motivation to learn new technologies and management and maintenance processes. This piece of the position requires dedication, persistence, follow\-up, effective utilization of provided resources and unbeatable, super\-hero movie caliber customer service. Job duties include utilizing our remote monitoring and management (RMM) and professional services automation (PSA) solutions along with other service\-specific tools and technologies to deliver remote user support services and update service request information, answer technical support calls, assign ticket severity, prioritize work accordingly, and collaborate and work with other staff and vendor support resources to resolve issues. Overall relationship management and the ability to coordinate required resources to respond to complex IT requirements are desired. Other requirements include participating in ongoing training and attainment of manufacturer certifications, developing and maintaining relationships with user and vendor contacts, and preparing and presenting service and monitoring reports to management regularly. Minimum Requirements: 1\. Associates or Bachelor’s Degree or relevant experience/certifications. 2\. Minimum three years technical support experience, preferably delivering services in the SMB (small to midsize business) market 3\. Excellent knowledge of our supported software and technologies (PSA and RMM Familiarity) 4\. Superior documentation and writing capabilities (good way to show this would be your cover letter) 5\. Strong interpersonal skills required to effectively communicate with customers, staff and vendor 6\. Passion for teamwork, problem solving and exceptional customer service 7\. Must be well spoken, organized, detail\-oriented, dependable and flexible 8\. Valid driver’s license and proof of insurance 9\. Background check and drug screen required 10\. Reliable transportation 11\. Have a great sense of humor and capable of having fun This Position Entails: 1\. To perform technical triage on inbound customer requests. 2\. Receive and stage computer equipment for deployments. 3\. Travel to customer locations as needed. 4\. The ability to learn quickly and adapt to changing requirements, in fact, things change so fast around here it’s best that you LOVE being challenged by change. 5\. Planning, coordinating, directing and supervising ongoing projects to insure completion within scope, timeline and budget. 6\. Troubleshooting network, equipment and service\-related problems with remote control technologies. Now that I think on this though, if you can do this from your living room, well, that’s a plus. 7\. An unshakable, ravenous desire to AGGRESSIVELY expand your knowledge. Expect to obtain multiple vendor certifications within your first 90 days of employment (training materials and mentoring provided), and that’s just the warmup! 8\. Analyzing remote monitoring reports to identify capacity and performance issues and re\-mediate them. 9\. A passion for creating a memorable customer service experience. If you had a lemonade stand as a child and out\-earned that snot\-nosed kid across the street because you were offering a unique lemonade buying experience by way of perhaps car side service or complementary napkin or cookie, you’re probably in the right ballpark. 10\. The ability to help the team manage, maintain, troubleshoot and support our users’ networks, equipment, software and services. Before you contact us, please consider these questions: \* Can I articulate the primary functions of a Service Desk, its design according to best practice and suggest improvements to an existing series of Service Desk processes using my experience in these environments? \* Can I demonstrate my familiarity with LabTech or other comparable RMM toolsets? \* Can I demonstrate my skills focused on the design, preparation, installation and configuration of a server in a client/server environment? \* Can I demonstrate my skills focused on the design, preparation, installation and configuration of workstations in a client/server environment? \* Can I describe my skills pertaining to the configuration of hardware firewalls, network switches and Internet routers? \* If I take this job, will I be OK with being hazed as the “newbie” for at least 3 months or until Transitional Technologies hires another employee, whichever comes first? \* Can I describe past experience when questioned about my ability to build an entire company network from the ground up: Everything from initial planning phase to installation to providing troubleshooting and technical support? \* Can I design and configure every piece of hardware and software in that network? \* Can I provide references that will confirm my ability to consult with business owners and decision makers on a daily basis in order to make intelligent recommendations and purchasing decisions for their technology? \* Can obtain multiple vendor certifications in 90 days? An answer of “YES! I can absolutely deliver on this! WHERE DO I SIGN UP!!?!” to all of the above is required for the Network Engineer position and will be discussed during phone and in\-person interviews. Please, when submitting resumes and cover letters, consider the above questions and tailor said documents to demonstrate these qualities. Any mix of Microsoft, Cisco, Connectwise Manage/Automate, VMWare and CompTIA Certifications considered a MAJOR plus. Pay: $35,000\.00 \- $75,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance Application Question(s): * Are you a Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE)? Can you articulate the primary functions of a service desk describe past experience troubleshooting issues? Are you familiar with SyncroMSP/RMM toolsets? Can design, prepare and configure a server and/or workstation in a client/server environment? Can you configure hardware firewalls, network switches and Internet routers? Can you setup an Exchange mailbox in Outlook and on an iPhone? Can you image a computer? Can you provide references? Are you OK with being called the "newbie" around the office for a while? The position you are seeking is: Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Traversal** Traversal is the AI Site Reliability Engineer (AI SRE) for the enterprise. Production complexity was already outpacing what engineering teams could manage manually, and AI\-generated code is accelerating that gap. Traversal is built for that challenge, autonomously understanding and reasoning across even the largest, most complex production environments to diagnose, fix, and prevent incidents. Our mission is to free engineers from endless firefighting and give them more time to focus on creative, high\-impact work. Today, Traversal operates in mission\-critical environments at some of the world’s largest enterprises. Our roots remain deeply embedded in AI research, and we’ve brought together researchers from institutions including MIT, Harvard, Berkeley, Columbia, and Cornell with world\-class technical staff and operators from companies like Google, Meta, Datadog, ServiceNow, and Citadel Securities to take on one of the hardest problems for AI to solve. Traversal is backed by Sequoia Capital, Kleiner Perkins, Hanabi, NFDG, and American Express Ventures. ### **The Role** As a Security Engineer at Traversal, your mission is to raise the security floor across the company by building AI\-native security mechanisms tailored to how we work. This is not a compliance role, and it isn’t about the basics like adding SAST to pipelines. You’ll partner with our security leadership team to shape the security roadmap across product, cloud, and infrastructure, and you’ll own broad\-scope projects within it: designing and shipping the secure foundations Traversal engineers build on, and driving us toward a future where automated verification, not manual code review, decides whether a change is safe to ship. You’ll also build security capabilities directly into Traversal’s products and cloud infrastructure to safeguard our enterprise customers and their data. Traversal serves Fortune 50 enterprises across multi\-tenant environments, BYOC deployments, and several compliance regimes. Your work will span application behavior, identity, infrastructure, deployment boundaries, data security, and access controls, continuously pushing Traversal’s security posture forward. We welcome strong software and infrastructure engineers who have owned security\-critical systems and want to specialize in security. We also welcome experienced security engineers who want to build. Either way, you’ll lead and deliver your area independently. This is a senior, high\-impact role: you’ll own foundational security systems end to end. As your scope grows, you’ll also set technical direction across related work streams and build capabilities other teams adopt and extend. ### **Responsibilities** * **Secure Constructs \& Paved Paths**: Design and ship the libraries, defaults, and workflows that make the secure way to build at Traversal the easiest way. * **Security Invariants \& Guardrails:** Define and implement controls that continuously verify security properties across our products and cloud infrastructure. * **Build Security into Products:** Design and ship security capabilities in Traversal’s products that support enterprise security teams. * **Findings to Fixes:** Discover issues, verify them, assess them, ship fixes with system owners, and add tests or controls that prevent recurrence. * **Security Architecture:** Architect security systems and major components, defining the interfaces, invariants, and evolution paths that let them scale across SaaS and BYOC deployments. * **Delivery \& Adoption:** Lead multi\-phase rollouts, migrations, and deprecations across teams with careful sequencing and de\-risking, and land them with enablement and measurable success criteria. * **Operational Ownership:** Ship operationally complete systems with monitoring, alert quality, runbooks, and safe rollout and upgrade paths; debug and resolve security issues in your area. * **Technical Direction:** Set direction for scoped security domains, connect technical work to customer and business outcomes, and use results to shape the follow\-up roadmap with product and engineering leadership. * **Mentorship \& Leverage:** Mentor engineers and emerging technical leaders, and create patterns, libraries, and reference implementations that let others extend your work without depending on you. ### **Requirements** * 4\-6\+ years building or securing production software or infrastructure at technically rigorous companies or teams, including sensitive, mission\-critical systems. * Proven ability to independently lead ambiguous, cross\-team security projects from design through implementation, migration, and adoption, with minimal structure. * Strong programming skills in a language such as Python, Rust, or Go and the ability to work effectively in an existing codebase. * Hands\-on depth in application security or cloud security, with working knowledge of the other, gained either in a security role or by owning security\-critical systems as a software or infrastructure engineer. * Technical depth in risk assessment. Looks at standards like NIST \& SOC2 as a starting point, and not necessarily the right baseline. * Practical understanding of authentication, authorization, trust boundaries, secrets, and common failure modes in distributed systems. * Clear written communication and a collaborative approach to technical disagreements. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience with enterprise customer security requirements. * Experience building on and securing infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g., Terraform) and container orchestration systems (e.g., Kubernetes). * Detection engineering, security telemetry, or automated control validation. * Offensive testing experience paired with shipped remediations. * Experience with applying formal methods for security. You don’t need experience in every area above. We’re interested in what you’ve built, how you made decisions, and how your work changed the systems and teams around you. ### **Compensation** We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance, and additional benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this full\-time, in\-person role in New York is $240,000\-$300,000, plus equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are based on location, level, and role. Individual compensation is determined by experience, skills, and job\-related knowledge. ### **Why You Should Join Us** Traversal is a place to take on hard, meaningful problems with real ownership from day one. You’ll work alongside people who challenge you to grow, learn constantly, and help define a new category of infrastructure software. We think long term, move quickly, and hold a high bar without taking ourselves too seriously. We offer competitive salary and equity packages, health insurance, fertility benefits, a great tech setup stipend and flexible time off. Plus in\-office snacks, team happy hours and outings, an annual company offsite, and plenty of built in time to collaborate across teams. Traversal is fully in\-office, 5 days a week, based in New York near Madison Square Park. We have a collaborative, hard\-working culture and are energized by building the future of AI\-powered software maintenance.

jobs.title: CSCD Business Analyst I
jobs.description: **Job Summary** --------------- Provides routine technical consulting and support services for defining, developing and improving functional or business processes to meet user and organizational needs. Works with departmental management and staff to define problems and management requirements. Serves as a liaison between department users and the Information Technology organization in order to provide technical solutions to meet user needs. Possesses expertise in supporting basic department applications and functions. May assist with process redesign and documentation, as required for simple applications. Works under moderate supervision, with limited latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgment **DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS:** This is the first in a series of four business analyst\-related job classifications within the Information Technology job family. Provides routine technical consulting and support services for defining, developing and improving functional or business processes to meet user and organizational needs. The Business Analyst I performs routine Information Technology functions and may perform basic computer hardware and software installation, network administration and database management within a department. This classification may require a flexible work schedule in order to meet the needs of the department. **Duties and Responsibilities** ------------------------------- * Provides routine technical consulting and support services for defining, developing and improving functional or business processes to meet user and organizational needs. Works with departmental management and staff to define problems and management requirements. * Solicits and interprets client requests, documents client needs and automated procedures and works with users to improve business processes. Proposes alternatives appropriate within the broader context of County Information Technology and other operations and technology. * Resolves day\-to\-day technology needs of the department with a focus on the analysis of processes, dissecting problems and suggesting solutions. Reviews business processes, analyzes existing procedures and systems and makes recommendations for improvements. Develops process performance measures and assists in planning the transition to a new process. * Participates in continuous review and update to ensure that processes meet changing departmental and organizational conditions. Identifies processes for improvement, documents existing processes, and identifies and analyzes gaps between current processes and the desired state. * Interfaces and collaborates with other Information Technology staff in the design of new programs, processes, projects and software. Assists with analysis, design, programming, validation, testing, training and maintenance. Assists with application testing and product defect tracking. Interfaces with software project team members to assist with requirements and testing activities. Participates in the coordination and monitoring of software development activities. May review programs written by others. Establishes test procedures and tests and debugs programs. * Serves as a liaison with Information Technology System (ITS) in network administration within a user department. May possess primary responsibility for administration, installation, maintenance and troubleshooting of a stand\-alone departmental network. * Assists in or installs computer hardware, software and peripheral devices, as required. Performs diagnostics and troubleshoots problems encountered by department users and provides limited user training. Coordinates technical support work provided by Information Technology System (ITS). Assists in maintaining the inventory of department hardware and software. * Assists in evaluating, acquiring and implementing vendor hardware and software for user department. Collaborates with users, researches product information, assesses available technology, makes recommendations and may assist with the purchasing process. * Assists in the creation and/or development of enhancements needed for complex departmental databases. Maintains production, development and test database systems to meet user needs and provides systems support and security for self\-contained departmental databases. * Uses reporting tools to assist in the development of simple reports which are needed for department business processes and statistical reports which are used by management to help them evaluate department productivity and workload. * Assists in researching departmental data and in recommending effective use of business information. Documents and catalogues business and information system processes. * Assists in or configures document management systems. * Participates in cross\-functional project teams involving various levels of internal and external participants. Facilitates team building to identify and resolve system or process problems. * May develop and maintain department specific Internet or Intranet websites. * Provides end\-user and system support for specified department applications and functions. * Produces periodic status and operational reports for management review. Performs other job\-related duties as assigned. * **Minimum Requirements** ------------------------ **Education and Experience:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration or a directly related field; OR, Any combination of education and experience that has been achieved and is equivalent to the stated education and experience and required knowledge, skills, and abilities sufficient to successfully perform the duties and responsibilities of this job. **Licenses, Registrations, Certifications, or Special Requirements:** Valid Texas Driver’s License. **Preferred:** Microsoft Certified Systems Engineer (MCSE) Certification. Certified Novell Administrator (CNA) Certification. Certified Novell Engineer (CNE) Certification. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:** **Knowledge of:** * Policies, practices, procedures and terminology of assigned function. * Federal, State, Local and County applicable laws, rules, regulations and guidelines. * Information technology hardware, software and peripherals as related to assigned function. * Existing automated business applications and their relationships to each other and interfaces with other automated systems. * Software engineering and the software development lifecycle. * Computer equipment to include word processing, spreadsheets, databases and a variety of software packages. **Skill in:** * Understanding technical problems and solutions in relation to current, as well as future, business environment. * Problem\-solving and decision\-making. * Training users on computer applications. * Network administration and maintenance. * Translating moderately complex concepts for peers and customers. * Installing, maintaining and troubleshooting of hardware, software and peripherals. * Both verbal and written communication, including presentations and communicating technical issues in non\-technical language. **Ability to:** * Learn and utilize department’s case\-management system. * Identify and analyze end\-user problems and develop practical technological solutions. * Work independently and efficiently and as part of a team. * Manage time well, perform multiple tasks and organize diverse activities. * Research, compile, analyze, interpret and prepare a variety of memorandums or reports. Establish and maintain effective working relationships with departmental clientele, representatives of outside agencies and providers, other County employees and officials, and the public. * **Work Environment \& Other Information** ----------------------------------------- Physical requirements include the ability to lift/carry up to 35\-40 pounds occasionally, visual acuity, speech and hearing, hand and eye coordination and manual dexterity necessary to operate a computer and office equipment. Subject to standing, sitting, walking, climbing, crawling, bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, pushing, pulling, reaching, twisting, balancing, repetitive motion, and squatting to perform the essential functions. Subject to exposure to variations in extreme heat, cold, mechanical, fume/odor, and dust/mites. Work Hours: Monday\-Friday, 8:00 \- 5:00 PM; May be occasionally on call or required to respond to emergency or critical issues outside of normal working hours. Location:411 W 13th St, Austin, TX 78701 Department: CSCD Adult Probation Criminal, Education, and Employment Background Checks Required. For updates or questions on this position, contact: Antisha.Walley@traviscountytx.gov. **This job description is intended to be generic in nature. It is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities. The essential duties, functions and responsibilities and overtime eligibility may vary based on the specific tasks assigned to the position.**

jobs.title: Senior DevOps / Release Engineer
jobs.description: TrendAI™, the global AI security leader and enterprise business unit of Trend Micro, empowers organizations with full AI visibility and consolidated security that inspires confidence, drives innovation, and eliminates risk. At TrendAI™, we’re always seeking exceptional talent; people who want to collaborate with the best and push boundaries together. Here, your work goes beyond building a career. You will help protect what matters and play a vital role in shaping a safer, more trustworthy AI\-powered future. AI Fearlessly. Job Description: LOCATION On\-Site / Hybrid (Austin, TX) Position Summary TrendAI is seeking a Senior DevOps / Release Engineer to own the CI/CD, build, release, and infrastructure backbone for our on\-premises network security appliance, shipped as both physical hardware and virtual editions. The appliance is a large Java monolith built through Ant and gated primarily by GitHub Actions, with a shrinking legacy Jenkins footprint you will help retire as its current build\-toolchain versions reach end\-of\-life/end\-of\-support. A blocking\-mode agentic PR reviewer and an AI\-based PR responder already run in production against it: a live system to mature, not a greenfield one to invent. You will build automated gates protecting release branches, sign and stage releases, and keep self\-hosted runners and lab infrastructure healthy, balancing the rigor of physical/virtual lab release cycles with the modernization of cloud microservices and agentic automation. Secondary to that primary workload, you will extend the same CI/CD and infrastructure discipline to a companion set of Go and Node microservices deployed to AWS via Terraform/Terragrunt and the Serverless Framework. This is a senior IC role with broad autonomy over tooling and infrastructure decisions, and a mandate to push AI\-assisted automation into daily operations rather than treat it as a side experiment. Responsibilities 1\. Own and operate the scheduled CI/CD pipeline suite (regression/BVT, integration, UI/functional, and nightly or on\-demand workflows) for the on\-prem appliance across main and release branches, triaging failures daily and distinguishing real regressions from lab or environmental noise. 2\. Author, refactor, and maintain GitHub Actions workflows and reusable actions for the appliance product, including migrating the remaining legacy Jenkins jobs onto GitHub Actions ahead of their build\-toolchain's end\-of\-life/end\-of\-support window, workflow\-dispatch orchestration across multiple repositories, matrix builds, self\-hosted runner targeting, and secrets/permissions hygiene. 3\. Eliminate manual "build cop" duties by architecting and operating preventative branch gates: GitHub Merge Queue (or equivalent), speculative/batch merging, and automated flaky\-test quarantine that removes unreliable tests from the gate without removing signal, so main and release branches never break. 4\. Administer GitHub organization structure: repositories, branch protections, teams, user access, and the lifecycle of branches including cleanup of associated builds and artifacts when branches are deleted. 5\. Modernize and maintain build/lab infrastructure supporting the appliance (bare metal and virtual), driving the transition toward ephemeral runners, automated patching, and declarative infrastructure\-as\-code, on both direct\-managed hosts and machines shared with other teams. 6\. Manage code signing and release packaging for the appliance: sign builds destined for continuous regression use, track and apply detection or definition\-file updates through their PR lifecycle, and keep versioned build metadata consistent across the systems that consume it (test schedulers, release trackers). 7\. Eliminate manual release bookkeeping by designing automated release\-note and changelog generation from conventional commits and PR metadata (e.g., semantic\-release), so release readiness reporting requires no hand\-curated changelog page; coordinate fresh\-install of validation/scan targets (physical and virtual) against the latest signed build. 8\. Run, maintain, and administer third\-party security and quality scanning pipelines (SAST/SCA and vulnerability scanners such as Coverity and Black Duck) across products, including version upgrades and license/user administration for the platforms themselves, and automate the triage of actionable findings into tracked engineering work. 9\. Harden build environments by extending the OIDC\-based, short\-lived credential pattern already used in the microservices' CI (no static IAM keys) to appliance build and lab systems, replacing long\-lived static secrets and passwords with short\-lived, least\-privilege identity mechanisms. 10\. Extend the AI\-assisted automation already running in production (a blocking\-mode agentic PR reviewer gating findings before merge, an AI\-based PR responder) into new categories of repetitive operational work: triage, log/report summarization, release notes drafting,  administering static analysis platforms (Coverity, Black Duck, or comparable) at the license/version/user\-management level, not just as a consumer of their findings. 5\. Experience designing agentic or LLM\-assisted operational workflows end to end: identifying candidate tasks, building the automation, and defining the guardrails that keep it safe in a regulated or compliance\-sensitive environment. 6\. Experience designing merge\-queue or speculative\-merge systems (GitHub Merge Queue, Bors, Mergify, or comparable) and automated flaky\-test detection/quarantine that keep a shared branch continuously green without manual intervention. 7\. Cloud infrastructure experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP) including infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform/Terragrunt, CloudFormation, or comparable), useful for the microservices support scope. 8\. Container orchestration experience (Kubernetes or comparable) for deploying and operating microservices in staging or production. 9\. Experience owning or migrating artifact/container registries (e.g., Harbor, JFrog Artifactory, or comparable) at organization scale. 10\. Experience with the Serverless Framework or comparable (AWS Lambda, API Gateway) for microservice deployment automation. 11\. Experience leading or contributing to a CI/CD platform migration (e.g., Jenkins to GitHub Actions or another modern platform), including sequencing cutover so release branches stay protected throughout. About the team This team owns the CI/CD, build, and release infrastructure that powers our network security appliance family alongside our companion cloud microservices platform. We sit at the intersection of engineering, QA, and release management, keeping automated pipelines, build systems, and delivery gates running so the organization can ship with confidence. We take pride in eliminating manual toil, modernizing legacy build infrastructure with care, and championing AI\-augmented automation while holding an uncompromising bar for operational stability, security, and release integrity. What We Offer You: You're important to us. What matters to you, matters to us too. Trend Micro provides benefit options for you and your family. Here some of the top\-rated benefits that employees enjoy today: Comprehensive health benefits and paid time off package Pre\-partum, maternity, parental, medical leave and adoption assistance Mental Health Wellness Program \& Annual Wellness Incentive 401(k) with company match Pet Insurance Collaborative and innovative culture We are committed to fostering a professional, respectful, and inclusive work environment that promotes collaboration and high performance. We value diverse backgrounds and perspectives and welcome candidates who bring unique strengths and experiences. If you’re excited about this role and believe you can contribute and grow with us, we encourage you to apply. Be Passionate. Be Innovative. Be a Trender. This position does not offer sponsorship for work permit applications or renewals, either now or in the future. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment\-based visa sponsorship, both currently and moving forward. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Conversational AI)
jobs.description: ### **Why TrueML?** TrueML is a mission\-driven financial software company that aims to create better customer experiences for distressed borrowers. Consumers today want personal, digital\-first experiences that align with their lifestyles, especially when it comes to managing finances. TrueML’s approach uses machine learning to engage each customer digitally and adjust strategies in real time in response to their interactions. The TrueML team includes inspired data scientists, financial services industry experts and customer experience fanatics building technology to serve people in a way that recognizes their unique needs and preferences as human beings and endeavoring toward ensuring nobody gets locked out of the financial system. ### **About This Role:** TrueML is on a mission to humanize the recovery process for distressed borrowers through AI and machine learning. As our **Senior Product Manager** you will be the person who brings conversational AI to life inside our platform — across voice, chat, and the messaging channels our consumers and clients already use. ### **What You'll Do:** * **Roadmap \& Strategy:** Define and own the conversational AI roadmap across voice and chat, balancing consumer impact, client demand, operational readiness, and platform build\-vs\-adopt decisions. * **Conversation Design \& Omnichannel Integration:** Establish behavior standards for AI agents—including authentication, intent recognition, hardship handling, and human handoffs—ensuring a unified consumer experience across voice, chat, SMS, and email. * **Partnerships \& Technical Surface:** Manage vendor relationships and specify requirements for telephony and CRM/servicing system integrations. * **Performance \& Compliance:** Drive operational metrics (latency, containment, cost per resolution) while partnering with Legal and Compliance to adhere to regulatory frameworks like FDCPA, Reg F, and TCPA. * **Cross\-Functional Operational Readiness:** Prepare Operations, Client Success, and Compliance teams with training, runbooks, escalation paths, and key metrics prior to feature launches. ### **Who You Are:** * **Experience:** 5\+ years of 0\-1 Product Management experience, with a track record of shipping products that moved business metrics. Fintech, collections, lending, or other regulated financial services experience is a strong plus. * **LLM Experience:** You have shipped LLM\-based capabilities in production. You can reason about prompting, retrieval, evaluation, guardrails, latency, and failure modes well enough to partner credibly with engineers — and to know when an impressive demo is not yet a product. * **Conversational AI Fluency (hard requirement):** Hands\-on experience with voice agents, chat agents, IVR, or contact center technology. * **Strong Analytical Skills:** When you have a question about conversation or outcome data, you answer it yourself. * **The "Double\-Sided" Mindset:** Experience with B2B2C products, balancing what the client configures against what the consumer experiences. * **A Master of Ambiguity:** You thrive in "roll\-up\-your\-sleeves" environments where the path isn't always marked, turning conflicting inputs into solid, actionable plans. For U.S.\-based hires, the overall base salary framework for this role currently spans $136,000 to $180,000\. The applicable base salary range for any individual hire depends on the geographic labor market associated with the employee’s primary work location along with other factors such as relevant skills, experience, and qualifications. Geographic labor markets are divided into "tiers" based upon a number of factors, including cost of living. Below, you'll find a few example cities representative of each tiers: * **U.S. Geo Tier 1** (i.e. San Francisco, New York City, Boston) * **U.S. Geo Tier 2** (i.e.Austin, Denver, Phoenix) * **U.S. Geo Tier 3** (i.e.Kansas City, Jacksonville, Indianapolis) We encourage you to speak to your recruiter to learn more about our compensation philosophy as well as discuss our benefits, total rewards, and opportunities for growth.#### **What We Offer (Perks \& Benefits)** * Flexible vacation * Medical/dental/vision insurance * Traditional/Roth retirement savings options * Company\-paid disability and life insurance * Flexible Spending Account \& Limited FSA * Family\-friendly parental leave, volunteer and voting time off * On\-demand wellness platform access for you and 5 friends and family * PerkSpot discount program for 900\+ merchants nationwide #### **Remote Work, Travel Expectations \& Physical Requirements:** This role supports a global, cross\-functional business and operates primarily in a Remote\-First environment. However, flexibility outside of standard business hours and occasional local or international travel may be necessary for global operations support, company meetings, training, offsites, and collaborative projects. This position primarily involves computer\-based work, requiring extended periods at a computer, participation in virtual meetings, and use of standard office technology. We will consider reasonable accommodations to enable individuals to perform the essential functions of the role. Maintaining a reliable internet connection and a professional work environment is expected. The ability to protect confidential company, employee, customer, and business information while working outside of a company office is also required. #### **Personally Identifying Information** We collect personal information for employment purposes. We do not sell personal information. Most of the information we have is provided to us by you and/or collected as part of the employment process. For more details on how we use, share, and delete personal information see our Privacy Policy. #### **Dedication to Diversity \& Inclusion** We are an equal opportunity employer. We promote, value, and thrive with a diverse and inclusive team. Different perspectives contribute to better solutions and this makes us stronger every day. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or other protected characteristics.

jobs.description: Description: **Company Overview** TrueScripts Management Services provides prescription benefit management expertise at a personal and customized level to ensure optimum value at the lowest possible cost for clients across the United States. This role serves as a key technical resource supporting Application Engineers, business stakeholders, and external trading partners by ensuring data is accessible, trusted, secure, and available where and when it is needed. The Data Engineer works closely with software development teams to deliver scalable data services, integration frameworks, and operational data solutions within Microsoft Azure. orchestration pipelines using Azure services and modern integration patterns. * Develop and support integrations between internal applications, third\-party vendors, clients, healthcare partners, and other external data trading partners. * Design and implement APIs, file exchange processes, and system\-to\-system integrations that support business operations and application development. * application functionality and business processes. * Build and support Azure\-based storage platforms, databases, and data services that enable application and analytics workloads. * Develop secure processes for exchanging data through APIs, flat files, SFTP, EDI transactions, healthcare interoperability standards, and other integration mechanisms as required. * Support real\-time and near real\-time data processing requirements where business needs warrant. * Design and implement monitoring, alerting, logging, and recovery processes for data pipelines and integrations. * Troubleshoot and resolve data quality, integration, performance, and reliability issues across development, test, and production environments. * Develop automation solutions that improve reliability, consistency, and operational efficiency. * Maintain documentation for integrations, data flows, APIs, pipelines, and supporting technologies. * Participate in architecture discussions and contribute recommendations related to scalability, reliability, performance, interoperability, and security. * Utilize source control, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices to support reliable deployment and maintenance of data solutions. * Ensure compliance with company security standards and regulatory requirements related to healthcare and sensitive information. * Support AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics initiatives through the delivery of trusted and accessible data assets. * Stay current with Microsoft Azure services, modern data engineering practices, and emerging technologies. Requirements: **Qualifications** **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field preferred, or equivalent professional experience. * Minimum of five years of professional experience in data engineering, data integration, application development, or a related technical discipline. * Strong experience with Microsoft SQL Server and advanced SQL development. * Experience building and supporting ETL/ELT processes and large\-scale data integrations. * Experience designing and implementing cloud\-based solutions within Microsoft Azure. * Experience with Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, Storage Accounts, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, or similar Azure services. * Experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs and modern integration technologies. * Strong understanding of relational database design, data integration patterns, and data lifecycle management. * Experience working with source control and DevOps platforms such as Azure DevOps and Git. * Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues involving data movement, integrations, and system interoperability. * Strong analytical thinking, problem\-solving skills, and attention to detail. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Databricks, or similar cloud data platforms. * Experience supporting healthcare, pharmacy benefit management, claims processing, or highly regulated industries. * Familiarity with HIPAA, PHI, PII, and healthcare data security requirements. * Experience working with healthcare interoperability standards such as FHIR, HL7, NCPDP, or EDI transactions. * Experience with Python, PowerShell, C\#, or other scripting and automation technologies. * Experience with event\-driven architectures, messaging platforms, and asynchronous integration patterns. * Familiarity with Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, Event Hubs, or related technologies. * Experience supporting machine learning, AI, or advanced analytics initiatives. * Experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Devin, or Windsurf. * Experience operating within Agile or iterative software delivery environments. \#LI\-VM1

Performing this job regularly requires use of hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools or controls, sit, talk, hear and stand. Employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Work Environment: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Live the **experience**. From professional empowerment to continual learning opportunities. From ongoing investment in new and emerging technologies to a career of self\-determination. At Ulta Beauty, our tech team is critical to our scalability—and is recognized that way. We’ve been defined as a “mature start\-up.” A place where interdepartmental exposure, open doors, and genuine collaboration is ubiquitous. Where challenges come fast and furious, requiring agility, mental dexterity, and creativity. Where **our passion for better solutions** drives us and is core to who we are. We’re engineering for the future of retail, and it’s no\-holds\-barred. But for those motivated by continual change and ambiguity, by superior leadership, by whip smart colleagues who will press you daily for your very best, you’ll find that virtually nothing’s impossible at Ulta Beauty. : **NOTICE OF JOB OPPORTUNITY** **COMPANY:** Ulta, Inc. **LOCATION:** 1000 Remington Blvd., Suite 120, Bolingbrook, IL 60440 **TITLE:** Lead Artificial Intelligence Engineer **HOURS:** Monday to Friday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm **DUTIES:** Direct and oversee the full lifecycle execution of complex AI initiatives, bridging the gap between exploratory data science and production engineering, including formulation and statistical modeling to deployment and scaling. 5\.0% Contribute technical leadership to the development and optimization of advanced algorithms for recommendation and decision engines, utilizing techniques such as collaborative filtering, embeddings, clustering, reinforcement learning, and constrained optimization. 5\.0% Architect and deploy GenAI solutions: Design pipelines for Large Language Models (LLMs) including fine\-tuning, RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation), and prompt engineering for enterprise retail use cases like analytics augmentation and decision support. Co\-ownership (with other Engineering Lead peers and Engineering Practice lead) of governance and standards for AI engineering related portions of these technologies. 15\.0% Ensure "Enterprise Readiness": Take ownership of the non\-functional requirements of AI systems, explicitly optimizing models for low\-latency inference, high throughput, data privacy compliance, and cloud cost efficiency. Help enforce adherence of others engineering team members to standards. 10\.0% Build production\-grade pipelines: Transition code from experimental notebooks to modular, version\-controlled software packages. Implement automated training pipelines, CI/CD for ML, and robust monitoring for data drift and model degradation; establish team’s practices for this space. 10\.0% Code Quality \& Standards: Responsible for defining and enforcing engineering standards within the Enterprise AI team, including unit testing, documentation, peer code reviews, and reproducibility frameworks. 10\.0% Translate business needs into technical specs: Partner with business and IT product teams to refine vague use cases into concrete engineering requirements, identifying technical risks early in the project planning process. Represent as a decision maker within the team for AIML engineering topics, and act as a primary point of contact for the Engineering domain within a team. 10\.0% Advise on emerging areas of technology and AI; evaluate and recommend AI technologies, frameworks, and tools to maintain cutting edge capabilities. 5\.0% Proactively look for opportunities to drive AI innovation, promote and advocate for those capabilities within Agile delivery framework. 5\.0% Project Estimation \& Planning: Own detailed technical roadmaps, providing accurate time and effort estimates for the Engineering phases of projects. 5\.0% Engineering Standards: Promote adherence to statistical best practices and software engineering principles across the engineering team, fostering a culture of technical excellence. 10\.0% Communication: Present technical results and architectural decisions to senior stakeholders, effectively communicating the trade\-offs between model complexity, performance, and cost. Serve as an escalation point and technical authority for the team. 10\.0% **REQUIREMENTS:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics or other quantitative field. Seven (7\) years in any occupation with experience working in data science, machine learning or AI. Seven (7\) years in any occupation with experience working in data science, machine learning or AI must include: Seven (7\) years of experience writing production\-quality object\-oriented code (Python or C\+\+) and working with ML frameworks such as scikit\-learn, TensorFlow, or similar, including five (5\) years of experience building low\-latency or real\-time ML systems; Seven (7\) years of experience designing, building, and deploying large\-scale recommender or decisioning systems, including techniques such as ranking, clustering, and other unsupervised learning methods; Seven (7\) years of experience building and deploying production ML systems on cloud platforms (Google Cloud, Azure, or AWS); Six (6\) years of experience applying optimization techniques in production environments, including large\-scale ML or decisioning systems such as operational research, offer optimization, or revenue maximization; Five (5\) years of experience working in the Retail Industry; Five (5\) years of experience building scalable, production\-grade real\-time inference services using Docker, with CI/CD and monitoring; Three (3\) years of experience as Sr AI or ML Engineer with demonstrated ability to drive technical direction and own AI tech solutions; Three (3\) years of experience designing and developing reinforcement learning models in real\-world or production settings; Two (2\) years of experience working with large language models (LLMs); Two (2\) years of experience building or integrating large\-scale batch ML pipelines using cloud\-native event\-driven systems (e.g., Pub/Sub) and containerized execution (e.g., GKE); Two (2\) years of experience developing agentic solutions within Databricks and Google Gemini Enterprise leveraging ADK, LangGraph – including multi\-agent orchestration patterns; Two (2\) years of experience partnering with AI Architects and Product team to translate requirements into agentic design patterns, defining orchestration and automation agentic behavior. Experience must also include: Experience working with large\-scale data processing and analytics platforms, including Apache Spark and Databricks, for feature engineering, model training, and data pipelines; Experience with relational databases including Postgres, Bigquery and MySQL; Document databases including MongoDB; and low\-latency databases including BigTable; and Experience building and delivering complex ML solutions from inception to launch. **SALARY**: $214,365 \- $215,365 per year **APPLY:** https://careers.ulta.com/careers/544938 *Ulta offers a standard benefits package. See a full list of benefits: https://careers.ulta.com/careers/about\-us/benefits\-and\-career\-development* : The pay range for this position is $214,365\.00 \- $215,365\.00 / Year with the opportunity for eligible associates to earn additional compensation pursuant to the Company’s bonus plan. Exact pay will be based on factors including, but not limited to relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, level, shift, geographic location, and business and organizational needs. Full\-time positions are eligible for paid time off, health, dental, vision, life and disability benefits. Part\-time positions are eligible for dental, vision, life, and disability benefits. For additional information concerning our benefits, visit our Benefits and Career Development page: https://learn.bswift.com/ulta About: At **Ulta Beauty** (NASDAQ: ULTA), ***the possibilities are beautiful***. Ulta Beauty is the largest North American beauty retailer and the premier beauty destination for cosmetics, fragrance, skin care products, hair care products and salon services. We bring possibilities to life through the power of beauty each and every day in our stores and online with more than 25,000 products from approximately 500 well\-established and emerging beauty brands across all categories and price points, including Ulta Beauty’s own private label. Ulta Beauty also offers a full\-service salon in every store featuring—hair, skin, brow, and make\-up services. *We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest records, conviction records, or other criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of any applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the New York City Fair Chance Act.*

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: Unify is building the **first AI\-native outbound platform** where agents and sellers work side by side. We help revenue teams identify buyers already in market, enrich accounts with data from 40\+ sources, and execute personalized, multi\-channel outreach—all from a single AI\-powered workspace. Trusted by some of the most innovative go\-to\-market teams, Unify enables reps to spend less time on manual work and more time building relationships, delivering up to **90% time savings** on list building and **19% higher output per rep**. We're building a team of curious, ambitious people who care deeply about craftsmanship, move with urgency, and thrive in fast\-paced environments. If you're excited about shaping the future of AI and building products that redefine how modern revenue teams work, we'd love to meet you. **About the role:** =================== As an Applied AI Engineer at Unify, you will bring new agent capabilities from zero to one and build the systems that make them work in production. You’ll own the agent harnesses that turn model capabilities into useful actions: planning, tool execution, context management, memory, and error recovery. You will work closely with product, design, and engineering to build agents that research accounts, identify opportunities, and execute GTM workflows. You’ll move quickly from prototype to customer usage, then use evaluations and real execution traces to make the product better. If you want to build production AI systems and own the outcome from first experiment through launch, this role is for you. **What You’ll Do:** =================== * **Build agent harnesses:** Design the execution loops, tool interfaces, context, and memory that let agents complete complex workflows reliably. * **Ship AI products end to end:** Turn ambiguous customer problems into working features, connecting agents to Unify’s data, integrations, and workflow infrastructure. * **Make quality measurable:** Build evals from real customer tasks, and use traces and failure analysis to improve agent behavior. * **Build for production:** Own reliability, latency, and cost. Make long\-running tasks resumable, handle tool failures, and give users visibility and control over agent actions. * **Experiment with new capabilities:** Test models, prompting strategies, retrieval approaches, and orchestration patterns. Measure what improves outcomes and bring it into the product. * **Shape our AI foundation:** Build reusable tools and engineering practices that help the team ship faster, partnering with product and design to prioritize the work that matters most to customers. **Who You Are:** ================ * You have 3\+ years of software engineering experience and hands\-on experience shipping LLM applications or agents to production. * You have built systems with tool calling, multi\-step execution, and evaluations. You understand how the software around a model affects what it can accomplish. * You are a strong programmer in TypeScript or Python, with experience building backend systems and integrating APIs. You’re comfortable owning a feature across the stack. * You think empirically. You define success, run experiments, inspect failures, and use evidence to decide what to build next. * You care deeply about customers and can turn a high\-level product idea into a deployed solution. You balance speed with sound engineering judgment. * You take initiative, learn quickly, and collaborate generously. You’re comfortable with ambiguity and make the people around you better. Compensation Range: $250K \- $320K
