At Unique Vacations, Inc. we know our company is most powerful when everyone can make their mark. **When you do what you love, you will be empowered to create the future that you want!** **APPLY, CREATE, IMPACT:** If you’re ready to make an impact on one of the world’s most renowned hospitality brands, we invite you to apply for the **Senior Network Security Engineer** via our career portal: http://www.uvcareers.com/ **JOB DESCRIPTION:** The Senior Network Security Engineer is a hands\-on technical role responsible for managing and continuously hardening the network security controls and tools of Unique Vacations, Inc. (UVI) across its data centers, corporate offices, call centers, and cloud environments. The role owns FortiManager and the FortiGate security policies, FortiAnalyzer, FortiClient EMS and VPN user access, Darktrace network detection and response, and FireMon firewall policy management, and is a primary contributor to PCI DSS network compliance. The position partners closely with Network Engineering, which operates the firewalls and VPN gateways, as well as Systems Administration, the Security Operations team, managed security providers, and vendors. The role has no direct reports at this time and is based in Miami, Florida. **JOB ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** **Firewall Security Management (FortiManager)** * Own FortiManager as the central security management platform, including policy packages, shared objects, threat feeds, naming standards, upgrades, and backups. * Define and maintain FortiGate security controls, including IPS, application control, web and DNS filtering, threat\-intelligence and geo\-blocking, and centralized IP and URL block lists. * Review firewall rule, NAT, and connectivity requests for business need, least privilege, and exposure before implementation by Network Engineering. * Perform periodic firewall rule reviews and track remediation of unused or overly permissive rules with Network Engineering. **Security Monitoring and Detection** * Administer FortiAnalyzer, ensuring reliable log collection, retention, reporting, and forwarding to the SIEM. * Administer the NDR platform (Platform: Network, Email, and Identity), including appliances, upgrades, model tuning, and integrations. * Build and maintain security alert integrations to Microsoft Teams and Jira using properly governed service accounts. **VPN User Access** * Own the VPN access model, including SAML authentication and AD/MFA group mapping, aligned with least privilege. * Manage FortiClient EMS (on\-premises and cloud), review and approve VPN access requests, and onboard contractors and vendors. * Troubleshoot user access issues and escalate gateway or infrastructure issues to Network Engineering. **PCI DSS and Firewall Policy Management** * Operate FireMon for device onboarding, scheduled compliance reports, and change reporting. * Perform quarterly network device audits, produce PCI DSS evidence, and drive remediation with Network Engineering. * Support the annual PCI network assessment and ensure changes do not expand PCI scope or weaken segmentation. **Incident Response and Operations** * Serve as a technical escalation point for network\-related security incidents, including blocking, isolation, and containment. * Participate in the Information Security on\-call rotation and follow the change\-management (CAB) process for all changes. **Projects, Documentation, and Vendors** * Lead the security workstreams of network, data center, and cloud (AWS and Azure) projects. * Create and maintain runbooks, standards, and inventories so that no knowledge depends on a single person. * Manage relationships and support cases with vendors and partners such as Fortinet, Darktrace, and FireMon. * Other duties as required by management. **COMPETENCE REQUIREMENTS:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **Qualifications include:** **Fortinet Expertise:** Advanced hands\-on experience with FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiClient EMS, and FortiGate security features in a multi\-site environment. **Network Security:** Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, segmentation, NAT, IPS, VPN, DNS, and web filtering, with enough routing and HA knowledge to partner effectively with Network Engineering. **Detection and Compliance:** Experience with Darktrace or similar NDR, SIEM (Splunk preferred), and PCI DSS 4\.0 network requirements. **Identity and Automation:** Experience with Okta SAML and Active Directory, plus scripting or automation (Python, PowerShell, FortiOS CLI, or Power Automate). **Communication and Ownership**: Able to work independently, document thoroughly, and drive issues through validated closure. **EXPERIENCE:** Outlined below are the academic qualifications and length and type of experience deemed necessary by Unique Vacations Inc. in order to perform the role of **Senior Network Security Engineer** competently. **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline preferred. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree. **Experience:** 5\+ years of network security or network engineering experience, including 3\+ years administering Fortinet security platforms in an enterprise environment. * Experience supporting PCI DSS or other regulatory audits with network security evidence. * Experience with firewall policy management tools (FireMon, Tufin, AlgoSec, or Nipper) is preferred. * Certifications: Fortinet NSE 4 / FCP required or obtained within 6 months; NSE 7 / FCSS, CCNP Security, GIAC, or CISSP preferred. **BENEFITS:** We offer a full benefits package including: * Health * Dental * Vision * Employer paid life insurance, STD, and LTD * Sick days * Vacation days * 9 Holidays * Tuition assistance * Parental leave * 401K plan with a generous company match **Additional perk:** After 6 months of continuous employment, you may visit the resorts we represent at a discounted rate. Once you visit one of the properties, you will not only experience the best of what the brand has to offer but you will get to see first\-hand what makes us so passionate and most of all so “Unique”. **ABOUT UNIQUE VACATIONS:** Unique Vacations Inc. is an affiliate of the worldwide representative **of Sandals and Beaches Resorts** – exclusively providing, marketing, public relations, advertising, promotions, and creative services to showcase the Luxury Included experience, which the guests have come to adore for 40 years and counting for Sandals and Beaches Resorts. Designed for couples in love, Sandals Resorts boasts 19 Luxury Included resorts located on the Caribbean’s best beaches in Jamaica, Bahamas, Barbados, Antigua, Curaçao, St. Lucia, St. Vincent and Grenada. The family\-friend resorts for everyone, Beaches Resorts offers three magnificent locations in Jamaica and Turks \& Caicos. We are headquartered in sunny South Florida – a hop, skip and a jump from the glorious Caribbean islands. Learn more about the brands we represent at www.sandals.com and www.beaches.com.

jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Description** The Senior AI/ML Engineer is responsible for building and operating the foundation that puts AI to work across the organization: the Azure infrastructure AI workloads run on, the patterns every engineering team uses to develop with agents, and UNOS’s own production agents. UNOS will be building everything from conventional machine learning models to generative AI workflows to more autonomous agentic solutions; this role makes them run in production, safe for protected health information by default, with evaluation, monitoring, and cost under control. This role requires a strong background in cloud /infrastructure engineering and the ability to apply that expertise to AI technologies while continuing to advance AI capabilities across UNOS. This role provides an opportunity to shape the trajectory of AI and agentic development and make a real difference in people’s lives, in a domain spanning healthcare, logistics, clinical science, and biotech. **Key Responsibilities** * Provision AI infrastructure on Azure as code, including model deployments in Microsoft Foundry and Databricks, GPU capacity, agent runtimes, as well as the networking, identity, and secrets around them. * Stand up open\-weight and frontier models on UNOS infrastructure under a pattern approved by Security and Privacy for protected health information (PHI). * Develop the technical policies and build controls into the platform itself: per\-agent identities, least\-privilege access, private endpoints, allow\-listed models, and audit evidence produced as a byproduct of normal use. * Run shared model access across providers, with routing, quotas, tracing, and cost attributed to each team and use case. * Build sandboxed environments where engineers run coding agents against real repositories, with no production credentials inside. * Define UNOS’s standard patterns for agentic development and publish them as working templates and reference implementations. * Integrate AI into CI/CD for pull\-request review, test\-failure triage, and security findings. * Build and ship UNOS’s own agents, in UNOS One products and for internal operations, including tool access, retrieval, orchestration, and human approval where a decision requires it. * Build the path from prototype to production in UNOS One, so a working proof of concept ships without being rebuilt. * Own evaluation and release for agents and conventional models alike, including test sets, staged rollout, rollback, and monitoring. * Baseline and track the time from idea to working proof of concept, and the quality of what ships. * Teach agentic development across UNOS through pairing, working sessions, and code review, and mentoring engineers in the AI function. * Recommend build\-or\-buy decisions on AI platforms and tools, with cost and risk stated. * Perform other duties and support additional administrative priorities as assigned, consistent with the general scope and level of the position. **Minimum Requirements** * Approximately six (6\) years of experience building and running production systems, including at least three (3\) years owning cloud infrastructure as code. **Critical Skills** * Production cloud depth, Azure preferred (equivalent AWS or GCP experience considered), with Terraform or Bicep: virtual networks, private endpoints, managed identities, role\-based access, secrets, and policy. * Strong handle on fundamental principles of AI/ML (e.g. train/test/validation, overfitting, calibration, eval methods) * Hands\-on provisioning of AI workloads, including model serving endpoints, quota and capacity, GPU compute, and cost controls. * An LLM\-based system built and run in production, past the demo stage, including tool calling or agents, retrieval, evaluation, and tracing. * Experience working under HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, FedRAMP, or a similar control framework, translating controls into configuration and evidence. * Daily practice with coding agents such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or Cursor. * Strong proficiency in Python, containers, and Kubernetes or an equivalent orchestrator. * Demonstrated record of changing how a team works without managing it, through establishing useful repeatable patterns that reduce team burden and shorten time to solution or insight. * Ability to choose what to build first with incomplete information and ship working versions early. **Additional Skills \& Qualifications** * Experience with Microsoft Foundry, Foundry Agent Service, Azure OpenAI, or Azure API Management as an AI gateway. * Experience with Databricks, including Unity Catalog, Model Serving, and MLflow. * Experience serving open\-weight models with vLLM, SGLang, or similar, including quantization and GPU capacity planning. * Experience building MCP servers or other tool interfaces over existing APIs and legacy systems. * Experience with agent security, including prompt\-injection defenses, tool permissions, and sandboxing. * Experience operating conventional machine learning: training pipelines, model registries, and drift monitoring. * Experience with HL7 FHIR or EHR integration; organ donation and transplant experience is a plus. **Education** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science,Engineering or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered. **Physical Requirements** * General office demands + Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. + Frequent reaching, handling, and fine manipulation for using office equipment, filing, and managing paperwork. + Manual dexterity sufficient to operate a keyboard, mouse, and other office tools. + Occasional standing, walking, and bending. + Ability to lift up to 10\-20 pounds occasionally. + Vision abilities required include close vision for computer work and reading documents. + Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer – Azure Cloud & Migration
jobs.description: Description: **About UpSwell** UpSwell is a fast\-growing marketing agency helping businesses across the country grow through innovative direct mail and digital marketing solutions. As a five\-time Best and Brightest Company to Work For, we're proud of the talented people, collaborative culture, and entrepreneurial spirit that make UpSwell a great place to build a career. We're a team of smart, driven, and curious people who move quickly, solve problems, challenge ideas, and take pride in delivering exceptional work. We believe in giving people the opportunity to make an impact, take ownership, and grow as the business grows. As we continue to expand, we're looking for exceptional people who bring fresh perspectives, strong technical expertise, and a genuine desire to make things better. **About the Opportunity** We're looking for an experienced, hands\-on **Senior DevOps Engineer** to take ownership of our Microsoft Azure cloud environment and lead a critical infrastructure modernization initiative. This is a high\-impact opportunity for someone who enjoys building, improving, and managing cloud environments—not simply maintaining them. You'll play a central role in migrating our existing private cloud infrastructure to Microsoft Azure, establishing a secure and scalable cloud foundation, and ensuring our systems are reliable, efficient, and positioned to support continued business growth. Reporting directly to the CTO, you'll have significant technical ownership and the opportunity to influence our cloud architecture, infrastructure strategy, automation, security, and operational practices. The ideal candidate combines deep Azure expertise with strong problem\-solving skills, sound technical judgment, and the ability to independently drive complex initiatives from planning through execution. We're looking for someone who can see the bigger picture, anticipate challenges, take initiative, and build solutions that support the business today while preparing us for what's next. **Key Responsibilities** ### **Cloud Migration \& Infrastructure Modernization** * Lead the end\-to\-end migration of UpSwell's private cloud infrastructure to Microsoft Azure, targeting completion within the first six months. * Assess existing infrastructure, applications, databases, networks, and dependencies to develop a comprehensive migration strategy. * Design and implement a secure, scalable Azure architecture aligned with Microsoft best practices. * Develop and execute phased migration plans, including testing, cutover strategies, contingency planning, and post\-migration validation. * Minimize business disruption while ensuring data integrity, system availability, and operational continuity. * Coordinate with external migration partners, vendors, and internal stakeholders throughout the project. * Identify opportunities to consolidate infrastructure, eliminate unnecessary costs, and improve overall system performance. ### **Azure Cloud Management \& Reliability** * Own the day\-to\-day administration, performance, availability, and reliability of the Microsoft Azure environment. * Manage Azure infrastructure, including virtual machines, networking, storage, databases, application services, and related cloud resources. * Establish and maintain monitoring, alerting, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity processes. * Proactively identify performance issues, infrastructure risks, and opportunities to improve system reliability. * Maintain appropriate service\-level objectives, recovery procedures, and operational documentation. * Lead troubleshooting and resolution of infrastructure incidents, including participation in on\-call support. ### **Monitoring, Integrations \& Security** * Implement comprehensive monitoring and visibility across Azure resources, applications, and API integrations. * Manage and monitor API connectivity, performance, errors, and security using Azure API Management and related tools. * Utilize Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, and other observability tools to identify issues and improve performance. * Maintain secure identity and access management practices using Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, and other Azure security capabilities. * Implement cloud security best practices, including vulnerability management, access controls, secrets management, and security monitoring. * Partner with internal teams and external providers to investigate and resolve security concerns. * Support applicable security, compliance, and audit requirements. ### **DevOps, Automation \& Continuous Improvement** * Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Actions. * Build and manage infrastructure as code using Terraform, Bicep, or similar technologies. * Automate infrastructure provisioning, deployments, monitoring, and routine operational tasks. * Support containerization and orchestration technologies, including Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service, as appropriate. *  l role in an on\-premises or private cloud migration to Azure or another major public cloud platform. * Strong understanding of Azure networking, compute, storage, databases, identity management, and security. * Hands\-on experience with infrastructure as code, preferably Terraform or Bicep. * Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. * Strong experience with Azure monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization. * Working knowledge of API management, integrations, and cloud security best practices. * Proficiency in PowerShell and experience with Python, Bash, or similar scripting languages. * Experience with cloud cost management and infrastructure optimization. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and organizational skills. * Ability to independently manage priorities, make sound technical decisions, and deliver projects in a fast\-paced environment. * Ability to participate in an on\-call support rotation. **Preferred Qualifications** * Microsoft Azure certifications, including Azure Solutions Architect Expert, DevOps Engineer Expert, or Azure Administrator Associate. * Experience with Azure Migrate, Azure Site Recovery, and database migration technologies. * Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure Kubernetes Service. * Familiarity with Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, and Azure Policy. * Experience supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar security and compliance frameworks. * Experience managing external migration partners, cloud vendors, or managed service providers. * Experience supporting cloud infrastructure in a growing, multi\-location organization. **What Will Make You Successful** * **You take ownership.** You're comfortable being accountable for the environment you manage and following through from planning to execution. * **You're a problem solver.** You enjoy tackling complex technical challenges, identifying root causes, and developing practical solutions. * **You think strategically and execute hands\-on.** You can design the right solution and roll up your sleeves to implement it. * **You're proactive.** You anticipate potential issues, identify opportunities for improvement, and take action before problems escalate. * **You value security and reliability.** You understand the importance of building infrastructure that is stable, secure, and scalable. * **You communicate effectively.** You can explain technical decisions, risks, and recommendations in a way that makes sense to different audiences. * **You're always learning.** You stay current with emerging cloud technologies and continuously look for smarter ways to work. **Why Join UpSwell?** At UpSwell, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of a critical technology initiative and help shape the cloud infrastructure that supports our continued growth. You'll work directly with technology leadership, contribute to meaningful modernization projects, and have the autonomy to make a real impact. We offer a collaborative work environment, opportunities for professional development, competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, a 401(k) retirement plan with company matching, paid time off, paid holidays, and a hybrid work schedule. **Work Arrangement** This is a full\-time, hybrid position based in Marietta, Georgia, requiring two full days in the office each week. Occasional travel of up to 10% may be required. This position also includes participation in on\-call support for critical cloud infrastructure incidents, including outside normal business hours as needed. **Equal Opportunity Employer** UpSwell is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Customer Support Engineer
jobs.description: VAST Data is looking for a Customer Support Engineer to join our growing team! This is a great opportunity to be part of one of the fastest\-growing infrastructure companies in history, an organization that is in the center of the hurricane being created by the revolution in artificial intelligence. **"VAST's data management vision is the future of the market." \- Forbes** VAST Data is the data platform company for the AI era. We are building the enterprise software infrastructure to capture, catalog, refine, enrich, and protect massive datasets and make them available for real\-time data analysis and AI training and inference. Designed from the ground up to make AI simple to deploy and manage, VAST takes the cost and complexity out of deploying enterprise and AI infrastructure across data center, edge, and cloud. Our success has been built through intense innovation, a customer\-first mentality and a team of fearless VASTronauts who leverage their skills \& experiences to make real market impact. This is an opportunity to be a key contributor at a pivotal time in our company’s growth and at a pivotal point in computing history. **Summary** As a Customer Support Engineering team you will be regarded as a VAST Data technical expert and, as such, you will be involved in daily technical operations and escalations. You will be a part of VAST “Flight Crew” for our customers, working with a small team of other Support Engineers and Success Managers to handle all post\-sales activity for the customer. The main responsibilities include responding to customer issues (reactive and proactive), evaluating the problem, using hands\-on\-keyboard skills to solve for the issue, and escalating to engineering with as much detail as possible when you can’t. You will also be involved in developing and testing and solutions in strategically and tactically significant applications and use cases, including file protocols, machine learning, object storage, and high\-performance computing at customer sites and in the lab. You will work directly with customers, and various business functions: consulting pre\-sales teams on technical sales activities, supporting Professional Services with onsite field activities and our engineering teams to solve technical problems. **The Role** * **﻿**Build trusted customer relationships based on your customer\-first mindset, technical excellence and command of VAST product * Respond to technical support issues quickly, working hands\-on\-keyboard to solve or escalate the issues while being highly communicative * Complete daily technical operations as needed for the customers, working technical issues to full resolution and closure. * Perform and support field services for customers: installations, upgrades, break\-fix and expansions as needed * Submit and manage Feature Requests and/or Bugs into product marketing and development teams. * Advocate for the priorities of your assigned accounts and continuously track and follow up on bugs, feature requests and escalations. * Identify opportunities to provide continuous improvement for customers to ensure full adoption and usage of VAST products. * Support and guide VAST data account teams on account technical status and activities. * Manage workload to balance meeting KPIs and VAST SLAs with ensuring customer happiness and satisfaction Requirements: * Overall 5\+ years of experience in customer\-facing, pre\-sale/post\-sale positions working with complex storage solutions. * Ability to manage own time and case load with rapidly changing priorities * Extensive knowledge and experience in the enterprise IT infrastructure, networking and storage space is required, along with a broad understanding of the enterprise software world. * Knowledge and working experience in common Linux system administration tasks and Linux OS in general. * Good understanding of networking, and working experience with network configurations on Linux and network troubleshooting * Scripting and programming \- bash scripting is required; must be familiar with one or more other programming language * Significant experience required in the areas of file systems and scale\-out NAS Implementation * An advantage to candidates that have In\-depth knowledge and hands\-on experience with S3 and high\-performance computing. * Excellent business written and verbal communication and presentation skills. * An advantage to candidates that have hands\-on lab and hardware management experience. * An advantage to candidates that have experience working in a rapidly growing entrepreneurial, dynamic start up. * MS or B.Sc. in CS, CE, EE or related fields. * Ability to travel. To be successful in this role, you will need to travel around 20% of the time. * Rotational weekend shift once every 8\-12 weeks and occasional holiday coverage.

jobs.title: Sr. Security Engineer - Cybersecurity
jobs.description: **SUMMARY:** VSE Aviation is building a dedicated IT Integration Team, and this role, the Senior Cybersecurity Integration Engineer, brings every acquired site up to VSE security standards, from post\-closure activities through architecture buildout and handoff to steady\-state operations. This is a senior individual contributor role, and the engineer is trusted to move without waiting for direction. Working alongside the IT Technology Services Integration Specialists, the engineer is the security lead for firewall and network architecture, identity and Zero Trust, endpoint, email protection, and SIEM onboarding. The primary focus is network security: perimeter design, firewall buildout, and segmentation at sites VSE has just acquired and does not yet fully understand. This scope covers the full security scope at a newly acquired site. The engineer designs within VSE's standards and tooling, brings proposed changes back to the cybersecurity team, and partners with security operations through implementation so each site reaches steady\-state monitoring without disrupting the business. The position is field\-based: travel to acquisitions at both domestic and international sites is required approximately 80% of the time, including overnight, weekend, and on\-call coverage during go\-live and hyper care periods. **DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:** Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: **Assessment and Containment** * Execute the day\-one security onboarding checklist for acquired site personnel and systems. * Assess and document the acquired entity's existing security posture, including known vulnerabilities, unmanaged assets, privileged accounts, and control gaps; produce a written risk summary for IT and business leadership. * Conduct initial network reconnaissance and perimeter review, including inbound exposure, remote access paths, and third\-party connections. * Escalate to cybersecurity leadership on indicators of active or historical compromise, proposed risk acceptances, deviations from VSE security standards, and unplanned spending. **Firewall and Perimeter Buildout** * Lead the physical and logical deployment of perimeter firewalls at integration sites. * Configure firewall rule sets, site\-to\-site and remote\-access VPN, and inspection policy per VSE standards. * Validate firewall posture through policy review, traffic analysis, and post\-deployment testing. * Coordinate with the Infrastructure team on network segmentation design and firewall placement relative to LAN, wireless, and OT/warehouse systems. * Decommission or isolate legacy perimeter devices and third\-party remote access after cutover. **Identity and Zero Trust** * Implement Zero Trust Network Access controls, enforcing least privilege across user roles, systems, and applications. * Configure Conditional Access policies, device compliance requirements, and application access controls in Microsoft Entra ID. * Enforce User Assignment Required on all enterprise applications and remediate legacy authentication. * Configure and validate MFA and identity protection for all user accounts, including service and privileged accounts. * Validate Zero Trust posture through access review, policy testing, and monitoring dashboards. **Security Tooling and Telemetry** * Work with the IT point of contact at the acquired company to deploy and configure endpoint detection and response (EDR) across all acquired\-site devices and servers; confirm full coverage against the asset inventory. * Integrate the acquired site into VSE's SIEM platform, ensuring log source onboarding, ingestion health, and alerting coverage. * Implement email security tooling aligned to VSE standards, including anti\-phishing, secure email gateway, and DLP policy. * Validate that security telemetry is being monitored and that alerting is routed correctly before declaring the site integration complete. **Equipment, Vendor, and Licensing Management** * Coordinate with vendors to order security hardware, including firewalls and endpoint sensors. * Manage vendor relationships for security tooling, including licensing, and support escalations. * Manage security application license allocations and ensure compliance with vendor agreements. * Track hardware delivery, inventory, and deployment readiness against the integration schedule. **Closeout, Documentation, and Continuous Improvement** * Maintain per\-site integration documentation: architecture diagrams, rule sets, exceptions, and residual risk. * Produce a formal security handoff package transitioning the site to steady\-state IT and security operations. * Track and drive closure of open security findings and accepted\-risk items after cutover. * Surface integration milestones, blockers, and cross\-team dependencies in integration stand\-ups and the shared IT Integration project workspace. * Serve as the cybersecurity contributor in PMO\-led integration project closeouts, presenting security outcomes, residual risk, and unresolved findings for each completed site. * Maintain and improve VSE's cybersecurity integration playbook and supporting documentation, translating lessons learned from each closeout into updated standards, checklists, and effort estimates that inform security requirements and risk assumptions on future integrations. * Other duties as assigned. **MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:** *Demonstrated firsthand experience is the primary screening criterion for this role. Certifications are treated as supporting evidence and are not a substitute for a verifiable record of building and defending enterprise networks.* * Bachelor’s degree in information technology, cybersecurity, or a related field + Or an additional 3 years of specific work experience in lieu of degree. * 7 years of firsthand network security engineering in a multi\-site enterprise environment, including at least three years at a senior or lead level. * Demonstrated ability to own a security architecture end to end: assess, design, build, validate, document, while following defined standards, and hand off with no senior engineer above them. * Deep, demonstrable enterprise firewall experience: physical deployment, rule set design and cleanup, NAT, site\-to\-site and remote\-access VPN, and inspection policy on a major next\-generation firewall (NGFW) platform. Candidates should be able to walk through firewall deployments they personally designed and built. * Proven network segmentation design experience, including the ability to segment a network the candidate did not build and does not have complete documentation for. * Strong routing and switching fundamentals: VLANs, dynamic routing protocols, and ACLs. * Practical experience migrating production firewalls and VPN appliances off legacy platforms without causing a business outage. * Demonstrated ability to assess an unfamiliar environment and build a migration plan that brings it to standard, including compensating controls for business\-critical systems that must remain in place and accessible to the business. * Working expertise in Microsoft 365 and Entra ID security, including Conditional Access, MFA, and identity protection. * Practical experience deploying and operating an EDR platform at scale. * Track record of building to an established enterprise security standard and improving it within a team. * Comfortable operating independently in the field while staying closely connected to an in\-house security team. * Willingness and ability to travel up to 75% to acquisition sites, including occasional short\-notice travel. **PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS:** * Prior experience as technical lead on M\&A technology integration, carve\-outs, or divestitures. * Experience presenting security risk findings to executives or acquiring company leadership. * Vendor firewall certification (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco) or an industry certification such as CISSP or GIAC (GSEC, GCIH, GCIA). * Experience in aviation, aerospace, defense, or another regulated manufacturing or MRO environment. * Familiarity with NIST CSF, NIST SP 800\-171, or CMMC control expectations. * Experience securing warehouses, shop floor, or OT\-adjacent environments where downtime tolerance is low. * Scripting, automation, or AI\-assisted tooling (PowerShell, Python) to speed up onboarding and validation at scale. **OTHER:** * Remote\-based role with sustained periods on\-site at acquisition locations; travel may reach 75% during active integration cycles. * Occasional after\-hours and weekend work required to support cutover windows. * Must be able to lift and rack network and security hardware (up to 40 lbs.) and work in data closets, MDF/IDF spaces, and warehouse environments. * Must be able to meet any customer\- or contract\-driven background screening requirements. * The selected applicant will be subject to a background check and drug testing.

jobs.title: Senior Software QA Engineer
jobs.description: As a Senior Software QA Engineer, you are the quality owner for the platforms that originate, underwrite, close, and service our business purpose loans. You will define how we test, build the automation that makes releases fast and safe, and raise the quality bar across engineering teams working in an environment of high\-volume transactions, sensitive borrower and financial data, and third\-party integrations. This is a hands\-on role with broad influence. You will write code, shape test strategy, and mentor other engineers and QA team members on building quality in from the start. **Duties and Responsibilities** * Define and drive the test strategy for web, mobile, API, and back\-end systems, covering functional, regression, integration, performance, and security testing. * Design, build, and maintain automated test frameworks and suites, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines so every release is validated automatically. * Review requirements and designs early, and partner with product managers and engineers to define acceptance criteria and catch defects before code is written. * Test the loan lifecycle end to end, including applications, underwriting rules, pricing, document handling, closing, funding, and servicing, along with the third\-party integrations behind them. * Verify that systems meet the security, privacy, auditability, and regulatory requirements of the lending industry, including correct handling of PII and financial data. * Own release readiness: triage and prioritize defects, run regression and smoke testing, and give clear go or no\-go recommendations. * Build and manage test data and environments that mirror real lending scenarios without exposing production data. * Track quality metrics such as defect escape rate, test coverage, and flaky test rate, and use them to improve how we build and ship. * Mentor engineers and QA team members, and promote testing best practices across teams.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: As a Staff Software Engineer, you are a senior individual contributor who leads technical direction for a team or group of teams. You take on our most complex and ambiguous engineering problems, design the systems behind our loan origination, underwriting, and servicing platforms, and raise the quality of engineering across the organization. You will work in an environment of high\-volume transactions, sensitive borrower and financial data, and third\-party integrations. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. You will still write code, but your largest impact comes from architecture, unblocking teams, and growing the engineers around you. **Duties and Responsibilities** * Lead the technical direction and architecture for systems owned by one or more teams, and align that work with the broader platform. * Break down ambiguous, high\-impact problems into clear plans, and drive them from design to delivery across teams. * Design systems for scale, reliability, security, and maintainability, and make pragmatic tradeoffs between them. * Write, review, and improve code in high\-impact and high\-risk areas, especially lending\-critical workflows such as underwriting, pricing, and closing. * Partner with product managers, QA, design, and business stakeholders to turn challenging business problems and vague requirements into clear technical plans. * Lead design reviews and technical decisions, building consensus across teams with different priorities. * Own the technical integrity of integrations with loan origination systems, credit bureaus, pricing engines, and other third\-party vendors. * Build security, privacy, auditability, and regulatory requirements into our systems, including correct handling of PII and financial data. * Mentor senior and mid\-level engineers, and set standards for code quality, testing, and operational excellence.

jobs.title: Lead Mechanical Technician
jobs.description: **Via Separations** is a Boston\-area startup dedicated to enabling process efficiency and intensification for the industrial sector. In 2024, Via delivered its first commercial facility and changed the narrative around market\-driven energy technologies that drive value for industrial customers. At the intersection of engineering, society, and impact, our team is passionate about making a difference and building the technology and organization to do it. We are a fast\-paced, interdisciplinary team backed by leading venture capital firms, and we are looking to add talented, mission\-driven people to our cohort. We are **passionate** about transformative impact, **optimistic** about scientific progress, and **unafraid** of hard problems. We believe that our people are our unfair advantage, and drive our mission forward. We embrace the diversity of our team for creative solutions and believe the best ideas come from the intersection of disciplines and perspectives. We want you to join us! **Role Description** Via Separations is seeking a Lead Mechanical Technician to join our Internal Systems group. As the Lead Mechanical Technician, you will lead the assembly, fabrication, and build\-out of internal test equipment, including test skids and pilot support systems consisting of pumps, controls, piping, valves, instruments, and wiring. You will be responsible for maintaining and troubleshooting existing test skids and assets. This is a hands\-on technical leadership position requiring the ability to read and work from engineering drawings, source and order material, and operate hand and shop tools safely while working around hazardous liquids and gases. This role is based on\-site in Watertown, MA, with primary work in our lab space, and may involve occasional travel to support field\-deployed pilot units. **Responsibilities Include:** **Build \& Assembly** * Assemble and fabricate internal test equipment and skids, including pumps, piping, valves, instrumentation, controls, and electrical/wiring components. * Read and interpret engineering drawings, P\&IDs, and specifications to plan and execute builds accurately. * Order and track material required for builds, coordinating with engineering and procurement to ensure correct specifications and timely delivery. * Use hand tools and shop equipment — including cut\-off saws and pipe threading machines — to fabricate and install piping and structural components. * Lead build sequencing and task assignment for assigned projects, ensuring work meets quality and safety standards. * Support shipping and receiving activities as needed, including building crates and packaging large items and equipment for outgoing freight. * Coordinate with external trades, including electricians, plumbers, and HVAC contractors, to support the installation, maintenance, repair, and upgrade of laboratory equipment and lab facility systems in support of lab test equipment. **Maintenance \& Troubleshooting** * Maintain, inspect, and repair existing test skids and internal systems to keep them in safe, reliable operating condition. * Troubleshoot mechanical, piping, instrumentation, and electrical issues on test equipment, identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions. * Coordinate with process and systems engineers on equipment modifications, upgrades, and recurring issues. **Safety \& Leadership** * Work safely and confidently around hazardous liquids and gases, following all relevant safety protocols and PPE requirements. * Serve as a technical lead for build and maintenance activities, mentoring other colleagues and helping enforce shop safety and quality standards. * Identify and escalate safety concerns, near\-misses, or process deviations promptly. **Required Qualifications:** * 10\+ years of hands\-on experience assembling, fabricating, and maintaining mechanical and piping systems, including pumps, valves, piping, instrumentation, and basic electrical wiring. * Ability to read and work directly from engineering drawings, P\&IDs, and specifications. * Experience using hand tools and shop equipment, including cut\-off saws and pipe threading machines. * Comfortable and safety\-conscious working around hazardous liquids and gases. * Experience ordering or specifying material for fabrication or maintenance work. * Strong troubleshooting skills across mechanical, piping, and basic electrical/controls systems. * Knowledge of reverse osmosis (RO) and high\-pressure system components, operation, and safe handling. * Ability to lead tasks and provide direction to others on a build or maintenance job. * Able to work independently with minimal oversight, prioritizing and managing tasks with sound judgment. * The position requires the use of PPE (eye protection, respirator, etc.) and strict adherence to safety procedures when working with hazardous liquids and gases, pressurized systems, and powered shop equipment. * Candidates must be able to lift up to 50 pounds, undergo background and drug screening, and spend extended periods standing and performing hands\-on mechanical assembly and fabrication tasks. * U.S. work authorization is required for this role. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Prior experience in a lab, industrial test/fabrication, or field equipment deployment environment. * Familiarity with piping codes and material standards (e.g., ASME B31\.3\) and basic instrumentation/controls wiring. * Experience with chemical process equipment or corrosive service materials (e.g., stainless steel, specialty alloys.) **We Offer:** * Competitive compensation package, including equity options * Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance * Disability \& Life Insurance * 401(k) * 12 weeks paid Family Leave * Flexible PTO * Paid time off for Company holidays * Onsite gym In addition to the base salary range listed above, Via's compensation package includes an annual performance bonus and equity options. Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they believe they can perform every job description task. We are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and that candidate may come from a less traditional background. Via may consider an equivalent combination of knowledge, skills, education, and experience to meet minimum qualifications. If you are interested in applying, we encourage you to think broadly about your background and skill set for the role! At Via, we value and prioritize diversity of thought, access, and experiences, and are an equal opportunity employer by choice. We consider all qualified applicants equally for employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, protected veteran status, religion, physical or mental disability, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or any other basis protected by law, ordinance, or regulation. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II
jobs.description: Virta Health is on a mission to reverse metabolic disease in one billion people. Current treatment approaches aren’t working—over half of US adults have either type 2 diabetes or prediabetes, and obesity rates are at an all\-time high. Virta is changing this by helping people reverse their metabolic condition through innovations in technology, personalized nutrition, and virtual care delivery reinvented from the ground up. We have raised over $350 million from top\-tier investors, and partner with the largest health plans, employers, and government organizations to help their employees and members restore their health and take back their lives. Join us on our mission to reverse metabolic disease in one billion people. This role is a blend of **real\-world impact, technical challenge, and modern tooling**. You’ll help build and evolve Virta’s **data engagement platform** — the system that turns partner and internally derived data into eligibility decisions and campaign\-ready member audiences. You’ll anchor the engineering behind **Member Marketing**, which ensures the right members hear about Virta at the right time, and the **Coverage Eligibility** data it depends on, which determines whether someone can access life\-changing care. You’ll create a **trusted, observable path** from raw data to member outreach: making identity, deployment context, data freshness, and transformation behavior explainable; designing safe recovery and replay mechanisms; and building **reusable data capabilities** that replace one\-off operational workflows. You’ll **modernize file\- and API\-based data exchange** through explicit contracts, automated validation, observable workflows, and event\-driven integrations where appropriate — reducing manual intervention without assuming every partner can adopt the same integration model. We work in an **AI\-augmented** way. evolving audience and workflow requirements into reusable platform capabilities, keeping business policy cleanly separated from technical implementation. * **Design for correctness and auditability in regulated workflows**, including data provenance, consent and suppression controls, rollback, replay, and safeguards against incorrect or cross\-customer data use. * **Modernize legacy, file\-based processes** toward well\-contracted, event\-driven integrations with strong observability, resilience, and security. * **Own systems end\-to\-end** — from architecture through operations — driving improvements in reliability, partner experience, and long\-term maintainability. * **Apply an experiment mindset** (Build\-Measure\-Learn) to validate assumptions and focus on outcomes over output, using AI\-assisted tooling where it improves speed and quality without compromising correctness. **90 Day Plan** =============== Within your first 90 days at Virta, we expect you will do the following: ### **First 30 Days: Learn \& Connect** * **Understand Virta’s data ecosystem** — architecture, key data flows, systems for Coverage Eligibility and Member Marketing, and how partners interact with Virta’s platform. * **Get familiar with existing processes and pain points** around file\-based exchanges, partner onboarding, data quality, and incident patterns. * **Build relationships** with key stakeholders: engineering teammates, product managers, the data team, and partner\-facing roles. * **Observe real\-world partner data issues**, reviewing tickets, Slack threads, and postmortems to identify recurring themes. ### **Days 31–60: Contribute \& Experiment** * **Ship production code**: contribute meaningfully to an in\-flight initiative touching data flows or partner integrations. * **Identify and propose a targeted improvement** using the Build\-Measure\-Learn loop — e.g., automating a partner data\-quality check or protot ata domains**, such as eligibility, claims, EHR, or member marketing — especially in regulated or partner\-integrated environments. * Experience with **customer\-data, marketing\-automation, or audience\-activation platforms** such as Braze, Segment, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or comparable systems. * Prior work **modernizing legacy data flows**, including migrations from SFTP/file\-based systems to API\- or engineering work — e.g., for test generation, documentation, data mapping, or observability. * Previous roles where you've had to **influence without formal authority**, or drive change across teams or systems you didn’t own directly. **Our Work Stack** ================== We don’t expect candidates to know everything on day one, but here are some of the tools we currently use day\-to\-day: accelerate development, testing, documentation, and product use cases **Languages \& Tooling** * Golang (primary language for backend services) * Python (for data tooling, automation, AI workflows) * JavaScript/TypeScript (for internal tools and platform UIs) **Values\-driven culture** ========================== Virta’s company values drive our culture, so you’ll do well if: * You put **people first** and take care of yourself, your peers, and our patients equally * You have a strong sense of **ownership** and take initiative while empowering others to do the same * You prioritize positive empowerment through open access of information * You are **evidence\-based** and prioritize data and science over seniority or dogma * You **take risks and rapidly iterate** Is this role not quite Who Are We: Vivint Smart Home is the leading provider of smart home services in North America. Vivint delivers an integrated smart home system with in\-home consultation, professional installation and support delivered by its Smart Home Pros, as well as 24\-7 customer care and monitoring. Dedicated to redefining the home experience with intelligent products and services, Vivint serves more than two million customers throughout the U.S. **Job Functions:** Position requires in\-office presence in Seattle, WA on a hybrid schedule for Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday with a work from home day on Friday. The position will start remote and then will move into the hybrid schedule. **Job Requirements** -------------------- ### ### **Required Technical Skills \& Experience** * **Experience:** Minimum of 5 years of professional software development experience. * **Education:** BS in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related technical field. * **Core Languages:** Strong proficiency in **C** and modern **C\+\+**. * **Embedded Linux:** Deep understanding of the embedded Linux ecosystem (kernel, device drivers, and the boot chain: bootloader, device tree, init). * **Build Systems:** Hands\-on experience building and customizing Linux distributions using **Yocto**, **Buildroot**, or similar. * **Hardware Debugging:** Proven track record with board bring\-up and debugging at the hardware/software boundary (reading schematics/datasheets; utilizing JTAG, logic analyzers, and oscilloscopes). * **BSP Integration:** Experience evaluating and integrating vendor\- or partner\-delivered BSPs and drivers. * **Additional Languages:** Experience with **Python** or **Rust**. * **IoT Protocols:** Solid understanding of common web/IoT protocols (HTTP, MQTT, JSON, Protobufs). * **Development Environment:** Proficiency with compiling, cross\-compiling, unit testing, and debugging within Linux environments. ### ### **Highly Desirable Skills (Nice\-to\-Have)** * Direct experience collaborating with JDM/ODM or contract manufacturing partners on hardware/software co\-development. * Familiarity with wireless communication protocols (Wi\-Fi, BLE, Zigbee, Z\-Wave). * Experience with SoC platforms from vendors like NXP, Rockchip, Qualcomm, etc. * Understanding of embedded security fundamentals (secure boot, OTA updates, and device provisioning). * Experience leveraging generative AI developer tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to design, build, debug, and review production software. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer – Healthcare AI
jobs.description: **About the Opportunity** Our client is a fast\-growing healthcare AI startup that achieved **30x revenue growth over the past year**. The company develops and deploys AI agents directly within leading healthcare systems, working with organizations such as Mayo Clinic and Cleveland Clinic to improve clinical workflows and operational efficiency. We're looking for **Forward Deployed Engineers** who enjoy combining hands\-on software development with direct customer collaboration. This is a founding\-level, high\-ownership opportunity where you'll serve as the bridge between healthcare professionals and a production AI platform, turning complex clinical challenges into reliable, real\-world solutions. **What You'll Do** * Work directly with physicians, hospital IT teams, and clinical stakeholders to understand their workflows, challenges, and technical needs. * Translate loosely defined clinical ideas into production\-ready AI agents. * Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents end\-to\-end. * Develop evaluations (evals) to validate the reliability and performance of deployed agents. * Continuously improve AI solutions based on clinical guidelines, user feedback, and operational requirements. * Troubleshoot technical issues and deliver improvements quickly. * Take full ownership of the development and deployment process, from identifying a problem to delivering a working solution. * Collaborate with engineering, product, and customer teams in a fast\-paced startup environment. **What We're Looking For** * **1–6 years of professional experience** in full\-stack software engineering, forward\-deployed engineering, or a related role. * Strong hands\-on experience with **Python** for backend development. * Experience with **React and TypeScript** for frontend development. * Practical experience with **Rust, Kubernetes, and AWS**. * Experience developing, deploying, and maintaining production software. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments. * Excellent communication skills and confidence working directly with customers and nontechnical stakeholders. * A demonstrated record of exceptional performance, rapid career progression, or meaningful contributions to demanding engineering teams. * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related STEM field. * Availability to work on\-site in San Francisco. * Experience in a high\-growth startup, forward\-deployed engineering environment, or a demanding software engineering team, with demonstrated technical ownership and strong problem\-solving skills. * Proven ability to collaborate directly with customers, understand complex requirements, and deliver production\-ready technical solutions. **Additional Advantages** * Experience in healthcare or health technology. * Experience building AI agents or working with production AI applications. * Familiarity with clinical workflows, healthcare systems, or regulated environments. * Experience with infrastructure tooling such as Helm. * Background in early\-stage or rapidly scaling, venture\-backed companies. **Compensation and Support** * **Annual salary:** $180,000–$285,000 USD, based on experience and seniority. * **Equity:** Included in the compensation package. * **Relocation support:** Available. * **Visa sponsorship:** Available, including eligible H\-1B and TN sponsorships and visa transfers. **Why Join?** This is an opportunity to help shape a rapidly growing healthcare AI company at an early stage, with significant ownership over technical solutions that are deployed in real clinical environments. You'll work closely with healthcare professionals, tackle complex engineering challenges, and see the direct impact of the software you build. Pay: $180,000\.00 \- $285,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Relocation assistance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Clinical Data Scientist
jobs.description: Description**Location:** Indianapolis, IN Metro (Hybrid / 3\-Day Onsite) *(Open to Regional/EST Candidates with Onsite Travel)* **Contract Type:** Contractor Full\-Time / Enterprise Project Engagement (Outsourced via Xenon7\) About Xenon7*Where elite tech talent meets world\-class opportunities! At Xenon7, we work with leading enterprise clients and innovative startups on high\-impact projects across Data, AI, Cloud, and Software Engineering. Our expertise in AI solution architecture and specialized technical talent allows us to partner with enterprise leaders on transformative initiatives, driving innovation and business growth.* Role purpose Lead the development and application of digital twins to improve clinical trial design and support evidence\-based clinical development decisions. The role prioritizes digital\-twin, simulation, and AI/ML expertise, supported by clinical\-development experience and close partnership with trial\-design experts. Position overview You will join a multidisciplinary clinical development environment and partner with clinical scientists, physicians, biostatisticians, pharmacometricians, biomarker experts, data scientists, data engineers, and other stakeholders. You will translate clinical development questions into quantitative strategies and deliver interpretable analyses that inform protocol design, patient selection, endpoint strategy, dosing, operational planning, and decision\-making under uncertainty. The role prioritizes digital twins as the primary capability for simulating patients, disease trajectories, treatment response, and clinical trials. The successful candidate will bring strong digital\-twin, simulation, and AI/ML expertise, along with sufficient clinical\-development knowledge to work effectively with trial teams. Deeper trial\-design expertise can be developed through close collaboration with clinical scientists, biostatisticians, and pharmacometricians. Key responsibilitiesDigital\-twin development and validation* Lead the design, development, and evaluation of digital twins of patients, disease trajectories, treatment response, or clinical trials using clinical trial and relevant external data. * Combine mechanistic, statistical, causal, and machine learning approaches to create fit\-for\-purpose digital twins that can be simulated under alternative populations, interventions, dosing strategies, endpoints, or trial designs. * Define use cases and contexts of use with clinical and quantitative experts so each digital twin addresses a specific trial\-design or development decision. * Assess calibration, validation, robustness, transportability, uncertainty, and practical relevance using appropriate internal and external evaluation strategies. * Develop reproducible workflows and reusable digital\-twin components that can be applied across programs or therapeutic areas. Clinical trial design and quantitative decision support* Partner with trial teams to frame development questions and evaluate design options, including target populations, eligibility criteria, enrichment strategies, comparators, endpoints, visit schedules, dosing strategies, and operational tradeoffs. * Use digital twins and complementary simulation methods to compare plausible scenarios, characterize uncertainty, and support model\-informed decision\-making. * Work closely with statisticians and pharmacometricians so analyses complement established trial\-design methods and align with clinical and regulatory objectives. * Communicate assumptions, limitations, and decision\-relevant insights clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Data integration and scientific collaboration* Analyze and integrate clinical trial data and, where relevant, biomarkers, imaging, digital health data, omics, patient\-reported outcomes, and real\-world data. * Partner with data engineering and platform teams to create analysis\-ready datasets, data\-quality checks, lineage, and reproducible pipelines. * Contribute to scientific documentation, presentations, publications, and responsible adoption of digital\-twin methods across clinical development. Model quality and responsible use* Define the intended use, decision context, success criteria, and limitations of each model before development. * Ensure models are interpretable, auditable, reproducible, and supported by evidence appropriate to their intended use. * Apply appropriate governance, privacy, security, and scientific\-review requirements for clinical data and analytical outputs. * Clearly distinguish exploratory analyses from validated decision\-support evidence and avoid overclaiming model capability. **Requirements*** PhD in data science, statistics, biostatistics, pharmacometrics, computer science, biomedical informatics, engineering, mathematics, operations research, or a related quantitative field. * Demonstrated experience developing digital twins, virtual patients, disease\-progression models, clinical trial simulations, synthetic controls, or closely related computational models. * Strong experience applying machine learning, statistical modeling, causal inference, or simulation to biomedical, healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other complex scientific data. * Strong programming skills in Python, R, or a comparable analytical language, with experience using version\-controlled and reproducible workflows. * Sufficient clinical\-development knowledge to frame relevant questions and collaborate effectively with clinical and quantitative trial experts. * Ability and interest to deepen clinical trial\-design knowledge through partnership with clinical scientists, biostatisticians, and pharmacometricians. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and demonstrated effectiveness in cross\-functional scientific collaboration. Preferred qualifications* Strongly preferred: experience supporting clinical trial design, protocol development, clinical development strategy, model\-informed drug development, or regulatory\-facing quantitative evidence. * Familiarity with one or more trial\-design topics, such as endpoint strategy, sample size or power assumptions, patient selection or enrichment, longitudinal outcomes, missing data, adaptive designs, or decision criteria. * Knowledge of digital\-twin architecture and validation, supported by expertise in causal inference, Bayesian modeling, survival analysis, longitudinal modeling, clinical trial simulation, or synthetic controls. * Experience with clinical data standards and common clinical\-development data sources. * Experience with biomarker, imaging, omics, digital health, or real\-world data and integration of multiple data modalities. * Experience with scalable cloud\-based analytical environments. * Track record of translating analytical work into decisions, reusable capabilities, publications, presentations, or other measurable scientific impact.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: #### **ABOUT** **XSOLLA** Xsolla is a global video game commerce company headquartered in Los Angeles. It helps developers from indie to AAA fund, distribute, market and monetize their games, and acts as merchant of record for 1,500\+ developers worldwide. For more information, visit xsolla.com. ### **The role** We are hiring a **Software Engineer, Web3** for **Xsolla****ZK**, Xsolla's Web3 ecosystem on a zkSync\-based L2\. It includes: * smart wallets built on account abstraction; * SDKs that game studios and partners use to bring players on\-chain; * infrastructure backend services for tokenizing in\-game items and currencies; * ecosystem dApps: a DEX, an NFT marketplace and an auction. This is a senior fullstack role: you work across backend, frontend and smart contracts. #### **WHAT YOU WILL OWN** * Features end to end: backend, frontend and production * The on\-chain / off\-chain architecture of your product: what lives in contracts, what lives in services, and how the two stay consistent. You make these decisions and justify them in writing * Security and correctness of what you ship: signing flows, interactions with contracts that hold user assets, keys and secrets * Production operation of your services, as part of the team's on\-call rotation #### **WHAT YOU WILL DO** * Build backend services in Go and TypeScript: chain indexing, transaction relaying, event processing, APIs for dApps and SDKs * Build infrastructure backend services for tokenizing in\-game items and currencies * Build dApp frontends in React: wallet connection, transaction signing, on\-chain state in the UI * Integrate smart wallets into products: accounts, paymasters, bundlers * Develop SDKs used by game studios and partners * Monitor services and contracts in production and take part in on\-call * Review code * Set up and maintain AI tooling in the repositories (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor: rules, context, harness) so the team uses it effectively ### **Required** **Experience** * 5\+ years of commercial software development, with senior\-level production experience across backend and frontend * dApps that you shipped to production and maintained **Web3 libraries and wallets** * viem and wagmi in production: clients and transports, contract reads and writes with typed ABIs, event subscriptions, wagmi hooks and connectors, caching and invalidation of on\-chain state * How wallet signers work: EOAs, browser and embedded wallets, smart accounts; personal\_sign (EIP\-191\) and typed data (EIP\-712\); the EIP\-1193 provider; network switching * Hands\-on experience with smart wallets: UserOperations, gas sponsored via paymasters, signature validation for contract accounts (ERC\-1271\) **Backend** * Go and TypeScript (Node.js) for production services * Processing on\-chain events: idempotency, reorg handling, retries * Asynchronous messaging and event\-driven design (Kafka, RabbitMQ or NATS): delivery guarantees, ordering, reprocessing * Relational databases (PostgreSQL) and caching (Redis) * Designing REST and gRPC APIs: versioning, backward compatibility **Frontend** * React and TypeScript: rendering model, state management, performance * Web security fundamentals: XSS, CSRF, CSP, safe handling of signatures and keys in the browser **Smart contracts** * Reading and understanding Solidity contracts and the EVM (storage, gas, call semantics, proxy upgrade patterns, access control) well enough to integrate with them safely and review changes * Common contract vulnerability classes (reentrancy, front\-running / MEV, oracle manipulation, signature replay) and how they affect the off\-chain side **Operations** * Containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) at the level of deploying and debugging your own services * Observability (we use Datadog; experience with Prometheus, Grafana, ELK / Graylog or OpenTelemetry also counts): metrics, logs, tracing and alerting for services and contracts; diagnosing incidents in production **Engineering practices** * Testing: unit, integration, E2E * Git, CI/CD (GitLab CI or similar) **AI\-assisted engineering** * Daily hands\-on use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) for development and review, including configuring them for a repository **English** * Spoken English at B2 level or higher ### **Nice to have** * zkSync / ZK Stack and the specifics of the zk\-rollup stack * Designing, writing and testing smart contracts in Solidity with Foundry; deploying and upgrading them safely * Building ERC\-4337 infrastructure yourself (bundlers, paymasters); EIP\-6963, EIP\-5792 * DeFi: DEX and AMM mechanics * NFTs and marketplaces: ERC\-721, ERC\-1155, auction mechanics * L2 infrastructure: running nodes, indexers, bridges * Designing SDKs for external developers * Gaming domain experience #### **HOW WE WORK** * **Decisions in writing.** Significant technical decisions are written up as an RFC or ADR that lays out the options and trade\-offs. We discuss the document, not a blank whiteboard. * **AI is part of everyday engineering.** We use AI coding tools for development and review, and we treat configuring them for a codebase as real engineering work. #### **HOW WE HIRE** * **Intro call.** Your background, your motivation and the role. * **Technical interview.** Built directly on the *What you will own* and *Required* sections above. We won't ask about anything this posting doesn't promise. * **Bar raiser.** An engineer from outside the hiring team checks that you raise the overall engineering bar. #### **THE TEAM** You will work alongside product managers, designers, smart contract, backend and frontend engineers, QA and DevOps. #### **BENEFITS** We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well\-being of our employees and their families through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes medical, dental, and vision, PTO, and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we're not just building a business; we're cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play. #### **EMPLOYMENT DETAILS** * **Location:** Remote (worldwide) * **Employment Type:** Full\-time * **Schedule:** 10:00–19:00 (flexible) * **Contract:** Employment agreement (entity or EOR arranged per candidate location) #### **EQUAL EMPLOYMENT STATEMENT** Xsolla is dedicated to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, language, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, political beliefs, disability, age, marital status, social background or other characteristics.
